Operation_Name_English: Hands Help - Phase 3
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ruke pomažu - faza 3
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Overall objective: increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care in the municipalities of Viškovo and Klana. Specific objective: providing support and support services in everyday life to the elderly and OSI in the municipalities of Viškovo and Klana. Activities: informing target groups about the possibility of inclusion in the project (radio, flyer, web page), employment of 12 people at 30 months. (6 persons in the municipality of Klana, 6 persons in the municipality of Viškovo) who will provide support and support in the daily life of 72 beneficiaries, procurement of basic hygiene supplies for the beneficiaries involved, monitoring and control of the services performed by the project team - project manager (Viškovo) and administrator (Klan).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj: povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi na području općina Viškovo i Klana. Specifični cilj: pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i OSI na području općina Viškovo i Klana. Aktivnosti: informiranje ciljanih skupina o mogućnosti uključivanja u projekt (radio, letak, web str.), zapošljavanje 12 osoba na 30 mj. (6 osoba u općini Klana, 6 osoba u općini Viškovo) koje će pružati potporu i podršku u svakodnevnom životu 72 korisnika, nabavka osnovnih higijenskih potrepština za uključene korisnike, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga od strane projektnog tima - voditelja projekta (Viškovo) i administratora (Klana).

Operation_Name_English: Nedelišće Cultural Centre
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Centar kulture Nedelišće
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project "Culture Centre Nedelišće" is to contribute to the increase of cultural activity in the municipality of Nedelišće through the introduction of innovative services in culture for the population and through the preservation of culture, tradition and heritage of the local population to contribute to better social inclusion, attractiveness of the area as a place for a pleasant life and work, especially for young families. The central problem identified in this project proposal is the lack of space and services in the community that would encourage the local population, people of the third age, members of the Roma national minority, children and young people, Croatian war veterans and victims of the Homeland War, artists and the general public to increase social engagement in the field of cultural activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta „Centar kulture Nedelišće“ je doprinijeti povećanju kulturne djelatnosti u općini Nedelišće kroz uvođenje inovativnih usluga u kulturi za stanovništvo te kroz očuvanje kulture, tradicije i baštine lokalnog stanovništva doprinijeti boljoj socijalnoj uključenosti, atraktivnosti područja kao mjesta za ugodan život i rad, posebice za mlade obitelji. Središnji problem koji je identificiran u ovom projektnom prijedlogu je nedostatak prostora i usluga u zajednici koje bi potaknule lokalno stanovništvo, osobe treće životne dobi, pripadnike romske nac. manjine, djecu i mlade, hrv. branitelje i stradalnike Domovinskog rata, umjetnike i širu javnost na veći socijalni angažman u području kulturnih djelatnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a kindergarten in Karakasica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja dječjeg vrtića u Karakašici
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project Construction of a kindergarten in Karakasica will build and equip a new kindergarten facility for 4 new day stays (2 day stays for the nursery group, 2 day stays for the kindergarten group) for 64 children, which will create infrastructural and material capacities for the availability and provision of inclusive service in early childhood education and care (RPOO) in a smaller rural environment that will increase the participation of vulnerable groups in the RPOO, ensure quality socialization and psychophysical development of children, increase the employment rate, as well as the overall improvement of living conditions of children, parents and the total population of the City of Sinj. The planned services will also result in the recruitment of 13 employees.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta Izgradnja dječjeg vrtića u Karakašici izgradit će se i opremiti novi objekt vrtića za 4 nova dnevna boravka (2 dnevna boravka za jasličku skupinu, 2 dnevna boravka za vrtićku skupinu) za 64 djece, čime će se stvoriti infrastrukturni i materijalni kapaciteti za dostupnost i pružanje inkluzivne usluge u ranom predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (RPOO) u manjoj ruralnoj sredini kojim će se povećati sudjelovanje ranjivih skupina u RPOO, osiguranje kvalitetne socijalizacije i psihofizičkog razvoja djece, povećanja stope zaposlenosti, kao i ukupno poboljšanje životnih uvjeta djece, roditelja i ukupnog stanovništva Grada Sinja. Planirane usluge rezultirat će i zapošljavanjem 13 djelatnika.

Operation_Name_English: Wastewater drainage and treatment system of the Agglomeration of Velika Gorica – Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sustav odvodnje i pročišćavanja otpadnih voda Aglomeracije Velika Gorica – faza 2
Category_Label: Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The GREEN GORICA WASTE WASTE WATER SYSTEM SYSTEM includes the necessary investments in the sewage and wastewater treatment system in the Velika Gorica area for the purpose of meeting the requirements and in order to comply with the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive 91/271/EEC. The project consists of two phases. • Phase 1 of the project includes investment investments within the OPKK 2014-2020 financial period. • Phase 2 of the project covers investment investments within the financial period of the PKK 2021-2027. Phase 2 consists of: • Upgrade of the UPOV, in accordance with the prescribed level of purification (74.000 ES, III. degree).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt SUSTAV ODVODNJE I PROČIŠĆAVANJA OTPADNIH VODA AGLOMERACIJE VELIKA GORICA uključuje potrebna ulaganja u sustav odvodnje i pročišćavanja otpadnih voda na području Velike Gorice u svrhu ispunjavanja uvjeta i s ciljem usklađivanja s Direktivom o pročišćavanju komunalnih otpadnih voda 91/271/EEZ. Projekt se sastoji od dvije faze. • 1.faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja OPKK 2014-2020. • 2.faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja PKK 2021-2027. 2.faza se sastoji od: • Nadogradnja UPOV-a, sukladno propisanoj razini pročišćavanja (74.000 ES, III. stupanj).

Operation_Name_English: Loans for the modernization of production
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Krediti za modernizaciju proizvodnje
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this financial instrument is to stimulate the productivity and competitiveness of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises by providing more favourable financing conditions for investments that contribute to the goals of the digital transformation of businesses and enterprises.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog financijskog instrumenta je poticanje produktivnosti i konkurentnosti mikro, malih i srednjih poduzetnika kroz omogućavanje povoljnijih uvjeta financiranja investicija kojima se pridonosi ciljevima digitalne transformacije poslovanja i poduzeća.

Operation_Name_English: the Da Vinci Laboratory
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Da Vincijev laboratorij
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Da Vinci Lab" includes scientific-popular events consisting of a theoretical and practical part. In the theoretical part, the participants learn about Leonardo da Vinci's life and discoveries, his paintings such as Vitruvius' man and key inventions such as the bird wing plane, perpetuum mobile, catapult, tank and bicycle. In the practical part, they use 3D pencils to make replicas of Vitruvius man and plane and construct a catapult. Participants retain their work. Finally, with the help of VR glasses, they explore virtual reconstructions of space or historic cities such as Florence. Workshops also cover the basics of VR and AR, hardware and software, design of VR/AR experiences, applications in STEM education, ethics.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Da Vincijev laboratorij" obuhvaća znanstveno-popularna događanja koja se sastoje od teoretskog i praktičnog dijela. U teoretskom dijelu, sudionici se upoznaju sa životom i otkrićima Leonarda da Vincija, njegovim slikarskim djelima poput Vitruvijevog čovjeka te ključnim izumima kao što su avion s ptičjim krilima, perpetuum mobile, katapult, tenk i bicikl. U praktičnom dijelu koriste 3D olovke za izradu replika Vitruvijevog čovjeka i aviona te konstruiraju katapult. Sudionici zadržavaju svoje radove. Na kraju, uz pomoć VR naočala, istražuju virtualne rekonstrukcije svemira ili povijesnih gradova poput Firence. Radionice također pokrivaju osnove VR-a i AR-a, hardver i softver, dizajn VR/AR iskustava, primjene u STEM edukaciji, etiku.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a bicycle-pedestrian path in the streets of A. Šenoe and V. Nazor in Koprivnica Bregim
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističko-pješačke staze u ulicama A. Šenoe i V. Nazora u Koprivničkim Bregima
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Building a cycling-pedestrian path in the streets of A. Šenoa and V. Nazor in Koprivnički Bregim’ will combine the two existing cycling-pedestrian paths that will form a whole, thus solving the problem of an unsafe road that poses a danger to all road users. The road leads to the center of the settlement and all important facilities, and on the other side to the road that connects the settlement with the city of Koprivnica and it moves a large number of vehicles, agricultural machines, but also pedestrians and cyclists. The target group of the project is all residents of the village of Koprivnički Bregi, who pass the road on a daily basis, and who will use bicycles more as zero-carbon vehicles with the realization of the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Izgradnje biciklističko-pješačke staze u ulicama A. Šenoe i V. Nazora u Koprivničkim Bregima“ spojit će se dvije postojeće biciklističko-pješačke staze koje će zajedno činiti cjelinu, čime će se riješiti problem nesigurne prometnice koja predstavlja opasnost za sve sudionike u prometu. Prometnica vodi prema središtu naselja i svim bitnim sadržajima, a s druge strane prema cesti koja spaja naselje s gradom Koprivnicom te se njome kreće velik broj vozila, poljoprivrednih strojeva, ali i pješaka i biciklista. Ciljnu skupinu projekta čine svi stanovnici naselja Koprivnički Bregi, koji svakodnevno prolaze prometnicom, a koji će realizacijom predmetnog projekta više upotrebljavati bicikle kao vozila s nultom stopom emisije ugljika.

Operation_Name_English: WANTS - GENERAL LOVAS - PHASE IV.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI - OPĆINA LOVAS - FAZA IV.
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of the project are to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups in the territory of the municipality of Lovas. The realization of the goals will be enabled by providing support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. The main activities relate to the provision of support and support services in everyday life as well as the provision of long-term care. Activities are related to the provision of support and support services to persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities, related to the organization of food, performed household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and meeting other needs with the distribution of packages of necessities on a monthly basis.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta su povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina na području općine Lovas. Realizacija ciljeva omogućit će se pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Glavne aktivnosti se odnose na pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu kao i osiguranje dugotrajne skrbi. Aktivnosti se odnose na pružanje usluge potpore i podrške osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom, a koje se odnose na organiziranje prehrane, obavljane kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene te zadovoljenje drugih potreba uz podjelu paketa potrepština na mjesečnoj razini.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a walking and cycling trail in Ivana Brlić Mažuranić Street in Ruščica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja pješačke i biciklističke staze u Ulici Ivane Brlić Mažuranić u Ruščici
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to build a pedestrian-cycling trail in Ivana Brlić Mažuranić Street in Ruščica in order to improve the safety of all road users, provide better connections on the daily migration line between Klakar Municipality, neighbouring municipalities and Slavonski Brod, and reduce pollutant emissions. In the street there is a regional school and a football stadium and it is the main link between the Municipality of Klakar and Slavonski Brod. Given the inadequacy of the existing infrastructure, there is a high risk of endangerment of all transport stakeholders, and the implementation of the proposed project will largely mitigate it. The target groups of the project are children, parents of young children, local population, recreational cyclists and cyclotourists.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgradnja pješačko-biciklističke staze u Ulici Ivane Brlić Mažuranić u Ruščici kako bi se unaprijedila sigurnost svih sudionika u prometu, omogućila bolja povezanost na liniji dnevnih migracija između Općine Klakar, susjednih općina i Slavonskog broda te smanjile emisije onečišćujućih tvari. U ulici se nalazi područna škola i nogometni stadion te je upravo ona glavna poveznica između Općine Klakar i Slavonskog broda. S obzirom na neadekvatnost postojeće infrastrukture, izražen je visok rizik ugroženost svih dionika u prometu, te će se isti provedbom predloženog projekta u znatnoj mjeri mitigirati. Ciljne skupine projekta su djeca, roditelji male djece, lokalno stanovništvo, rekreativni biciklisti i cikloturisti.

Operation_Name_English: SKIIZ - STEM Through Game and Entertainment
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SKIIZ – STEM Kroz Igru i Zabavu
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project to strengthen the capacity of civil society organisations to promote STEM reflects the medium-term vision of the National Education Plan until 2027. Problems in early childhood education, vocational education and the use of digital technologies were identified. The project proposes a holistic approach to the popularization of STEM through cooperation between CSOs, schools and scientific institutions, strengthening teachers' capacities and promoting STEM knowledge among 930 children and dozens of teachers. It will include 4 schools, 1 kindergarten, 370+ workshops and 36+ public events with the aim of creating an inclusive STEM community that will stimulate interest and further education of children and teachers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt za jačanje kapaciteta organizacija civilnoga društva u promociji STEM-a odražava srednjoročnu viziju Nacionalnog plana obrazovanja do 2027. Identificirani su problemi u ranih i predškolskim odgoju, strukovnom obrazovanju te primjeni digitalnih tehnologija. Projekt predlaže holistički pristup popularizaciji STEM-a kroz suradnju OCD-a, škola i znanstvenih institucija, ojačavajući kapacitete učitelja te promičući STEM znanja među 930 djece i desecima učitelja. Obuhvatit će 4 škole, 1 vrtić, 370+ radionica i 36+ javnih događanja s ciljem stvaranja inkluzivne STEM zajednice koja će potaknuti interes i daljnje obrazovanje djece i učitelja.

Operation_Name_English: Teaching assistants VI - Elementary school Garešnica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoćnici u nastavi VI - OŠ Garešnica
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is to provide students of elementary school Garešnica with disabilities with teaching assistants/professional communication mediators in order to successfully integrate into the regular educational system, which would lead to easier emotional functioning and socialization of students. Main activities of the project: - selection of candidates for teaching assistants/professional communication mediators - introduction into the work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators - work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators - project management and administration
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog projekta je učenicima OŠ Garešnica s teškoćama u razvoju osigurati pomoćnike u nastavi/stručne komunikacijske posrednike kako bi se što uspješnije uključili u redovni odgojno-obrazovni sustav, što bi dovelo do olakšanog emocionalnog funkcioniranja i socijalizacije učenika. Glavne aktivnosti projekta: - selekcija kandidata za pomoćnike u nastavi/stručne komunikacijske posrednike - uvođenje u rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika - rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika - upravljanje projektom i administracija

Operation_Name_English: Kindergarten in Rupotina
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dječji vrtić u Rupotini
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: Reconstruction and equipping of the existing second-purpose building in the business center in Rupotina in Solin will provide additional capacities and enable the registration of 52 children from the city of Solin in 3 new stays. One stay is for a nursery group and two stays are for kindergarten groups. The implementation of the project will enable the socialization and integration of children and provide their parents with conditions for easier functioning on the family and business plan knowing that their children are taken care of. The aim of the project is to provide additional infrastructural and material capacities to increase the availability of early childhood education and care in the city of Solin by building 3 new daily stays (for two kindergartens and one nursery group).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcijom i opremanjem postojeće građevine druge namjene u poslovnom centru u Rupotini u Solinu, osigurat će se dodatni kapaciteti te omogućiti upis 52 djece iz grada Solina u 3 nova boravka. Jedan boravak odnosi se na jasličku skupinu, a dva boravka se odnose na vrtićke skupine. Provedba projekta omogućit će socijalizaciju i integraciju djece te njihovim roditeljima osigurati uvjete za lakše funkcioniranje na obiteljskom i poslovnom planu znajući da su im djeca zbrinuta. Cilj projekta je osigurati dodatne infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja u gradu Solinu izgradnjom 3 nova dnevna boravka (za dvije vrtićke i jednu jasličku skupinu).

Operation_Name_English: Together in society
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno u društvu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. The main activities relate to the provision of support and support services in addition to the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies, and include: Recruitment of service providers for min. 6 members of the target group, monitoring and control of performed services, procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Glavne aktivnosti se odnose na pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština, a uključuju: zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za min. 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: By certifying the growth of G.T. Trade d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do rasta tvrtke G.T. Trade d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The company G.T. Trade d.o.o. has conducted a business analysis and identified problems that will be solved by the implementation of the project, including reduced competitiveness, inability to prove quality, lack of traceability of documentation and unoptimized business processes. Objective of the project: strengthen the company's capacities through the introduction of ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 50001 standards, i.e. optimization and improvement of 9 business processes, which will contribute to increasing its (international) competitiveness, facilitating access to the international market and increasing the competitiveness of SMEs by certifying management systems in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards = preconditions for the growth of sales revenues (15.1%) and export revenues (30.1%), by 2028. (m+2).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka G.T. Trade d.o.o. je provela analizu poslovanja i identificirala probleme koji će se riješiti implementacijom projekta, uključujući smanjenu konkurentnost, nemogućnost dokazivanja kvalitete, nepostojanje sljedivosti dokumentacije i neoptimizirane poslovne procese. Cilj projekta: osnažiti kapacitete tvrtke kroz uvođenje normi ISO/IEC 27001 i ISO 50001 tj. optimizaciju i unaprjeđenje 9 poslovnih procesa, a što će doprinijeti povećanju njezine (međunarodne) konkurentnosti, olakšavanju pristupa međunarodnom tržištu i povećanju konkurentnosti MSP-ova certifikacijom sustava upravljanja u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi = preduvjeti za rast prihoda od prodaje (15,1%) i prihoda od izvoza (30,1%), do 2028. (m+2).

Operation_Name_English: DETECTIVE SYSTEM, SIGNALYSIS AND ALARMATION OF THE WATER PRODUCT WITH REDUNDANCIAL AND SERIAN COMMUNICATION FOR APPLICATION ON SHIPS
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SUSTAV ZA DETEKCIJU, SIGNALIZACIJU I ALARMIRANJE PRODORA VODE SA REDUNDANCIJOM i SERIJSKOM KOMUNIKACIJOM ZA PRIMJENU NA BRODOVIMA
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project deals with the development of water intrusion detection, signalling and alarm system (DSA) with redundancy and serial communication for application on ships. The aim is to increase the safety of vessels, navigation, reduce installation and maintenance costs and ensure a marine habitat from potential ship damage and the most important human lives. Innovation includes serial communication and automatic correctness control. The system will be tested for resilience in terms of cybersecurity. The project will ensure the protection of intellectual property and produce a feasibility study. Expected results include a prototype DSA system, technical documentation and trademark protection. The project is linked to the S3 Blue Growth Strategy.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se bavi razvojem sustava za detekciju, signalizaciju i alarmiranje prodora vode (DSA) s redundancijom i serijskom komunikacijom za primjenu na brodovima. Cilj je povećati sigurnost plovila, plovidbe, smanjiti troškove instalacije i održavanja te osigurati morsko stanište od potencijalnih brodskih havarija te najvažnije ljudske živote. Inovativnost uključuje serijsku komunikaciju i automatsku kontrolu ispravnosti. Sustav će biti ispitan na otpornost u vidu kibernetičke sigurnosti. Projekt će osigurati zaštitu intelektualnog vlasništva i izraditi studiju izvodljivosti. Očekivani rezultati uključuju prototip DSA sustava, tehničku dokumentaciju i zaštitu žiga. Projekt je povezan s S3 strategijom Plavog rasta.

Operation_Name_English: Light massive products – innovative multi-value expansive foam method in furniture
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Laki masivni proizvodi – inovativna metoda ekspandirajuće pjene u namještaju više dodane vrijednosti
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in large enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the Project is to encourage structural changes in the existing business of the Applicant by developing new products in the identified priority niche and to encourage the resolution of key societal challenges. The expected result of the Project are light massive slabs enriched with expanded foam based on soluble oligomers of biomass macromolecules. The project addresses the problems of excessive dependence of the Applicant on LOHN jobs, lack of investment in innovative technological solutions and design of their own products and the inability to establish their own recognizable brands. The target groups of the Project include the economic, scientific-educational and educational sectors. The project plan foresees a duration of 36 months, with a total value of €2.639.694,67
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj Projekta je potaknuti strukturne promjene u postojećem poslovanju Prijavitelja razvojem novih proizvoda u identificiranoj prioritetnoj niši te potaknuti rješavanje ključnih društvenih izazova. Očekivani rezultat Projekta su lake masivne ploče oplemenjene ekspandirajućom pjenom na bazi topljivih oligomera makromolekula biomase. Projekt adresira probleme prekomjerne ovisnosti Prijavitelja o LOHN poslovima, nedostatka ulaganja u inovativna tehnološka rješenja i dizajna vlastitih proizvoda te nemogućnosti uspostavljanja vlastitih prepoznatljivih robnih marki. Ciljne skupine Projekta obuhvaćaju gospodarski, znanstveno-obrazovni i odgojno-obrazovni sektor. Projektni plan predviđa trajanje od 36 mjeseci, uz ukupnu vrijednost od €2.639.694,67

Operation_Name_English: STEM: Engineers of the Future
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM: Inženjeri budućnosti
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The STEM project: The goal of the Engineers of the Future is to strengthen the capacities of the Croatian Association for Project Management for the implementation of programs in the field of promotion of STEM areas among students. Through capacity building activities of civil society organizations, cooperation activities with higher education institutions and educational institutions and implementation of activities of promotion of STEM areas among beneficiaries, the capacities of civil society organizations involved in the project will be strengthened for further design and implementation of programs of promotion of STEM areas. The project will be thematically based on STEM areas in which the partner higher education institution specializes.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt STEM: Inženjeri budućnosti ima za cilj ojačati kapacitete Hrvatske udruge za upravljanje projektima za provedbu programa u području promocije STEM područja među učenicima. Kroz aktivnosti jačanja kapaciteta organizacije civilnog društva, aktivnosti suradnje s visokim učilištem i odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama te provedbu aktivnosti promocije STEM područja među korisnicima, ojačati će se kapaciteti organizacije civilnog društva uključene u projekt za daljnje osmišljavanje i provedbu programa promocije STEM područja. Projekt će se tematski bazirati na STEM područja u kojima je partnersko visoko učilište specijalizirano.

Operation_Name_English: Schools of Equal Opportunities in Međimurje County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Škole jednakih mogućnosti u Međimurskoj županiji
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Schools of Equal Opportunities in Međimurje County" will support the inclusion of 75 students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions per school year. In this way, the conditions will be provided for the improvement of their educational achievements, successful socialization and emotional functioning in primary and secondary schools that Međimurje County is the founder of. Međimurje County with project partners, 26 primary and secondary schools, will provide continuous support to students with disabilities in the period from the school year 2024/2025 to 2026/2027. The result of the project will be a positive impact on the target group, students, but also parents, other students, teachers and the community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Škole jednakih mogućnosti u Međimurskoj županiji" pružat će se potpora uključivanju 75 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske i srednjoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove po jednoj školskoj godini. Na taj će se način osigurati uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješnu socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje u osnovnim i srednjim školama kojima je Međimurska županija osnivač. Međimurska županija s projektnim partnerima, 26 osnovnih i srednjih škola, osigurat će kontinuiranu podršku učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u razdoblju od školske godine 2024./2025. do 2026./2027. Rezultat projekta će biti pozitivan utjecaj na ciljnu skupinu, učenike, ali i roditelje, ostale učenike, učitelje i zajednicu.

Operation_Name_English: And the third age in my home
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: I treća dob u domu mom
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will increase social inclusion and reduce the risk of institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. A support and support service will be provided with the procurement and distribution of a package of supplies for a minimum of 180 end-users. It is planned to hire 30 service providers to provide assistance in the home. The activity of the project will consist of monitoring and control of the services performed according to monthly reports, communication and visibility through which they will be promoted in the community. Project management and administration is a project activity that will ensure its quality implementation, user satisfaction as well as economic efficiency of project activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se povećati socijalna uključenost te umanjiti opasnost od institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Pružit će se usluga potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština za minimalno 180 krajnjih korisnika. Planira se zapošljavanje 30 pružatelja usluga koji će obavljati usluge pomoći u kući. Aktivnost projekta činit će praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga prema mjesečnim izvješćima, komunikacija i vidljivost putem kojih će se promovirati u zajednici. Upravljanje projektom i administracija je aktivnost projekta koja će osigurati njegovu kvalitetnu provedbu, zadovoljstvo korisnika kao i ekonomsku učinkovitost projektnih aktivnosti.

Operation_Name_English: By certifying the growth of COMMINUS d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do rasta tvrtke COMMINUS d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Comminus d.o.o. has conducted business analysis and identified problems that will be solved by the implementation of the project, including reduced competitiveness, inability to prove quality, lack of traceability of documentation and unoptimized business processes. Objective of the project: strengthen the company's capacities through the introduction of ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 20000-1 standards, i.e. optimization and improvement of 9 business processes, which will contribute to increasing its international competitiveness, facilitating access to the international market and increasing the competitiveness of SMEs by certifying management systems in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards = preconditions for achieving the growth of sales revenue (30%) and export revenue (15.1%), along with the growth of the number of employees, by 2028.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Comminus d.o.o. je proveo analizu poslovanja i identificirao probleme koji će se riješiti provedbom projekta, uključujući smanjenu konkurentnost, nemogućnost dokazivanja kvalitete, nepostojanje sljedivosti dokumentacije i neoptimizirane poslovne procese. Cilj projekta: osnažiti kapacitete tvrtke kroz uvođenje normi ISO/IEC 27001 i ISO/IEC 20000-1 tj. optimizaciju i unaprjeđenje 9 poslovnih procesa, a što će doprinijeti povećanju njezine međunarodne konkurentnosti, olakšavanju pristupa međunarodnom tržištu i povećanju konkurentnosti MSP-ova certifikacijom sustava upravljanja u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi = preduvjeti za ostvarenje rasta prihoda od prodaje (30%) i od izvoza (15,1%), uz rast broja djelatnika, do 2028.

Operation_Name_English: Wish for Krapinske Toplice
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI za Krapinske Toplice
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The Municipality of Krapinske Toplice is the Applicant for the project "WANTS for Krapinske Toplice". Specific objective 1 will be achieved through the implementation of mandatory project activities of the Call. Providing support and support services for the elderly and persons with disabilities in their daily lives. 15 providers of support and assistance services will be recruited through the implementation of the project and 90 members of the target group will be provided. The project ensures increased social inclusion and prevention of institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The target groups are persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities (18 years of age and above) and are as well measurable outcomes and indicators in line with and contributing to the rules of the Call.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Općina Krapinske Toplice je Prijavitelj na projekt "ZAŽELI za Krapinske Toplice". Kroz provedbu obveznih projektnih aktivnosti Poziva ostvarit će se Specifični cilj 1. Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Provedbom projekta zaposlit će se 15 pružatelja usluga potpore i pomoći, a usluga će biti pružena 90 pripadnika ciljane skupine. Projektom se osigurava povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Ciljane skupine su osobe starije od 65 godina i odrasle osobe s invaliditetom (18 i više godina) te su kao i mjerljivi ishodi i pokazatelji u skladu s pravilima Poziva te doprinose istima.

Operation_Name_English: STEMAFOR
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEMAFOR
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The STEMAFOR project solves the problem of declining interest of children and young people in STEM in Rijeka and its surroundings. The objectives are to empower civil society organisations to promote STEM and to improve the STEM skills of teachers and students. Activities include educating 7 employees and volunteers of the Association Point, conducting 360 STEM workshops for 900 students in 5 schools, and setting up 36 STEM stands, mini fairs and exhibitions at frequent locations for 3 years. The project is justified by the need to improve the quality of STEM education, increase the interest of students and strengthen the capacity of CSOs to implement STEM programs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt STEMAFOR rješava problem opadanja interesa djece i mladih za STEM u Rijeci i okolici. Ciljevi su osnaživanje organizacija civilnog društva za promociju STEM-a te unapređenje STEM vještina učitelja i učenika. Aktivnosti uključuju edukaciju 7 zaposlenika i volontera Udruge Točka, provođenje 360 STEM radionica za 900 učenika u 5 škola, te postavljanje 36 STEM štandova, mini sajmova i izložbi na frekventnim lokacijama tijekom 3 godine. Projekt je opravdan zbog potrebe za poboljšanjem kvalitete STEM obrazovanja, povećanjem interesa učenika i osnaživanjem kapaciteta OCD-a za provedbu STEM programa.

Operation_Name_English: Dogana Cultural Center
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kulturni centar Dogana
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve public cultural infrastructure through the renovation and equipping of the Dogana Cultural Centre. The applicant is the City of Imotski and the project partner of cultural institutions Public Open University Imotski. The implementation of the project will make it possible to increase the number of visitors, especially members of vulnerable groups, for which new services tailored specifically to their needs will be developed. The project will enable more active participation of residents of Imotski and visitors in cultural life and will create preconditions for the development of innovative services in culture. The target groups that will benefit from the implementation of the project are all potential visitors, members of vulnerable groups, artists, cultural associations and the business community through spillover effects.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je unaprjeđenje javne kulturne infrastrukture kroz obnovu i opremanje Kulturnog centra Dogana. Prijavitelj je Grad Imotski a projektni partner ustanova u kulturi Pučko otvoreno učilište Imotski. Provedba projekta omogućit će povećanje broja posjetitelja osobito pripadnika ranjivih skupina za koje će se razviti nove usluge posebno prilagođene njihovim potrebama. Projekt će omogućiti aktivniju participaciju stanovnika Imotskog i posjetitelja u kulturnom životu te će stvoriti preduvjete za razvoj inovativnih usluga u kulturi. Ciljne skupine koje će imati koristi od provedbe projekta su svi potencijalni posjetitelji, pripadnici ranjivih skupina, umjetnici, udruge u kulturi i poslovna zajednica kroz spillover efekte.

Operation_Name_English: INO VAUČER INELTEH
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: INO VAUČER INELTEH
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: INELTEH d.o.o., with 30 years of experience in marine electronics, develops innovative products ITES-MS-130 electronic mermaid and ITMLA signal amplifiers. The ITES-MS-130 uses an ultrasonic defrosting principle and operates in extreme conditions from -25°C to 55°C, eliminating the need for compressed air. ITMLA amplifiers convert electrical sizes into current/voltage signals, are resistant to electromagnetic interference and allow for local adjustment. The project includes cooperation with KONČAR - Electrical Engineering Institute d.d. for testing, with the aim of commercializing products on the global market. The project contributes to the smart specialization strategy of Croatia by improving the safety, efficiency and sustainability of maritime transport.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: INELTEH d.o.o., s 30 godina iskustva u brodskoj elektronici, razvija inovativne proizvode ITES-MS-130 elektroničku sirenu i ITMLA pojačala signala. ITES-MS-130 koristi ultrazvučni princip za odleđivanje i radi u ekstremnim uvjetima od -25°C do 55°C, eliminirajući potrebu za komprimiranim zrakom. ITMLA pojačala pretvaraju električne veličine u strujne/naponske signale, otporna su na elektromagnetske smetnje i omogućavaju lokalno podešavanje. Projekt uključuje suradnju s KONČAR - Institutom za elektrotehniku d.d. za testiranja, s ciljem komercijalizacije proizvoda na globalnom tržištu. Projekt doprinosi strategiji pametne specijalizacije Hrvatske kroz unapređenje sigurnosti, učinkovitosti i održivosti pomorskog prometa.

Operation_Name_English: Tesla STEM Academy: Learning through innovation and entertainment
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Teslina STEM akademija: Učenje kroz inovaciju i zabavu
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: NIKOLA TESLA NETWORK - NIKOLA TESLA network together with partners Center for Local Community Development Alba, Faculty of Electronics and Computing in Zagreb, elementary school Vladimir Nazor from Duga Resa, elementary school J.Dalmatinac from Šibenik and elementary school Dr.Turić from Šibenik is implementing the project " Tesla STEM Academy: Learning through innovation and entertainment. The project lasts 24 months and aims to strengthen the capacities of applicants and partners and promote STEM among children and students.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: NIKOLA TESLA NETWORK - MREŽA NIKOLA TESLA zajedno s partnerima Centar za razvoj lokalne zajednice Alba, Fakultetom elektronike i računalstva u Zagrebu, OŠ Vladimir Nazor iz Duge Rese, OŠ J.Dalmatinca iz Šibenika te OŠ dr.Turića iz Šibenika provodi projekt " Teslina STEM akademija: Učenje kroz inovaciju i zabavu". Projekt traje 24 mjeseca te ima za cilj jačanje kapaciteta prijavitelja i partnera te promociju STEM-a među djecom i učenicima.

Operation_Name_English: Business improvement through the certification of the management system of the company "PortfolioMetrics d.o.o."
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unapređenje poslovanja kroz certifikaciju sustava upravljanja poduzeća "PortfolioMetrics d.o.o."
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Business improvement through the certification of the management system of PortfolioMetrics d.o.o.’ is aimed at strengthening international competitiveness through the implementation of ISO 27001 and ISO 22301 standards. The aim is to ensure compliance with European DORA regulation, increase data security, crisis resilience and improve business processes. Activities include analysis of the current situation, development of security policies, implementation of management systems and employee education. Expected results are reducing operational risks, increasing sales and export revenues, expanding to international markets and strengthening customer and partner confidence, while ensuring long-term business sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Unapređenje poslovanja kroz certifikaciju sustava upravljanja poduzeća PortfolioMetrics d.o.o.“ usmjeren je na jačanje međunarodne konkurentnosti kroz implementaciju ISO 27001 i ISO 22301 standarda. Cilj je osigurati usklađenost s europskom regulativom DORA, povećati sigurnost podataka, otpornost na krizne situacije te unaprjeđenje poslovnih procesa. Aktivnosti uključuju analizu postojećeg stanja, razvoj sigurnosnih politika, implementaciju sustava upravljanja i edukaciju zaposlenika. Očekivani rezultati su smanjenje operativnih rizika, povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza, širenje na međunarodna tržišta te jačanje povjerenja klijenata i partnera, uz osiguranje dugoročne održivosti poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: "It is good to do good" - prevention of institutionalization and
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Dobro je činiti dobro" - prevencija institucionalizacije I
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support in everyday life for 180 people aged 65+ and adults with disabilities who will be provided with meals, provide assistance in maintaining personal hygiene and performing household chores through the procurement and distribution of packages of necessities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružiti uslugu potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 180 osoba s navršenih 65+ godina starosti te punoljetnim osobama s invaliditetom kojima će se kroz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština osigurati i zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba, osigurati obroci, pružiti pomoć pri održavanju osobne higijene i obavljanju kućanskih poslova.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the link between education and the labour market
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje povezanosti obrazovanja i tržišta rada
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: As part of the ESF project ‘Implementation of the CROQF and development of tools in linking education and the labour market’, the MROSP started the process of harmonising education with labour market needs. In order to further connect education and the labour market, it is necessary to continue improving the process for advanced labour market monitoring through the further development of the CROQF system, regulated professions and skills mapping as well as services in the acquisition of competencies of the workforce through the upgrading of the Advanced Labour Market Monitoring Portal with new functionalities and connecting with the databases of institutions that are not yet included in the data exchange, improving the recommendations for enrolment policy, upgrading and updating the skills catalogue and creating the model of individual learning accounts (ILA).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: U okviru ESF projekta „Implementacija HKO-a i razvoj alata u povezivanju obrazovanja i tržišta rada“ MROSP je započeo proces usklađivanja obrazovanja s potrebama tržišta rada. U cilju daljnjeg povezivanja obrazovanja i tržišta rada potrebno je nastaviti unaprjeđenje procesa za napredno praćenje tržište rada kroz daljnji razvoj sustava HKO-a, reguliranih profesija i mapiranja vještina kao i usluga u stjecanju kompetencija radne snage kroz nadogradnju Portala za napredno praćenje tržišta rada novim funkcionalnostima i povezivanje s bazama podataka institucija koje još nisu uključene u razmjenu podataka, unaprjeđenje preporuka za upisnu politiku, nadogradnju i ažuriranje kataloga vještina te izradu modela individualnih računa za učenje (ILA).

Operation_Name_English: Establishment of information security and business continuity management system for the company UTILITAS I.T.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uspostava sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću i kontinuitetom poslovanja za tvrtku UTILITAS I.T.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Establishment of information security and business continuity management system for the company UTILITAS I.T." is implemented for a duration of 12 months with the aim of facilitating the accessibility to the international market and increasing the international competitiveness of the Applicants. The implementation of the project introduces the information security management system ISO 27001:2022 and the business continuity management system ISO 22301:2019 which are in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards. The project addresses the problem of lack of internationally recognized certificates and compliance with industry standards, which limits the competitiveness of UTILITAS I.T., reduces the trust of clients and partners and makes it difficult to enter new markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Uspostava sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću i kontinuitetom poslovanja za tvrtku UTILITAS I.T." provodi se u trajanju od 12 mjeseci s ciljem olakšanja pristupačnosti međunarodnom tržištu i povećanja međunarodne konkurentnosti Prijavitelja. Provedbom projekta uvodi se sustav upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću ISO 27001:2022 i sustav upravljanja kontinuitetom poslovanja ISO 22301:2019 koji su u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi. Projekt adresira problem nedostatka međunarodno priznatih certifikata i usklađenosti s industrijskim standardima, što ograničava konkurentnost tvrtke UTILITAS I.T., smanjuje povjerenje klijenata i partnera te otežava ulazak na nova tržišta.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of IFS Food quality and food safety management system in the company BRIOŠ TIM d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom i sigurnosti hrane IFS Food u tvrtku BRIOŠ TIM d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project implements the management system IFS Food ver. 8 which solves the problem of traceability, business and production process problems, which will increase the level of food quality and safety, enable access to the international market, increase the company's competitiveness and increase the level of customer confidence. The aim of the project is to improve food traceability, solve the problems that arise in the business and production process, increase food quality and safety, ensure the conditions for entering the international market, increase competitiveness and increase the level of trust with customers, which will contribute to the sustainable development of the industry in the area of the City of Vodnjan and IŽ. The target group are large retail chains and end-users are consumers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se uvodi sustav upravljanja IFS Food ver. 8 čime se rješava problem sljedivosti, problemi u poslovanju i proizvodnom procesu, čime će se povećati razina kvalitete i sigurnosti hrane, omogućiti pristup međunarodnom tržištu, povećati konkurentnost tvrtke te povećati razina povjerenja kupaca. Cilj projekta je unaprijediti sljedivost hrane, riješiti probleme do kojih dolazi u poslovanju i procesu proizvodnje, povećati kvalitetu i sigurnost hrane, osigurati uvjete za izlazak na međunarodno tržište, povećati konkurentnost te povećati razinu povjerenja kod kupaca, što će doprinijeti održivom razvoju industrije na području Grada Vodnjana i IŽ. Ciljna skupina su veliki trgovački lanci, a krajnji korisnici su potrošači.

Operation_Name_English: AI supported smart platform for alternative SME financing
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: UI podržana pametna platforma za alternativno financiranje MSP
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: With the implementation of the project, an evolutionary upgrade of the innovative digital platform for alternative SME financing is planned, with a particular focus on the development of integrated modules for creating dynamic, authentic profiles and ‘pitcheva’ users. The key goal is to ensure that the process of creating profiles and proposals is as automated as possible, with maximum personalization. These elements are essential for the successful commercialisation of the platform. This will make it possible to connect investors with SMEs in a much more precise way and improve the user experience. The development process will include targeted testing and validation through testing, ensuring the long-term sustainability of the platform on the market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta planira se evolucijska nadogradnja inovativne digitalne platforme za alternativno financiranje MSP-ova, s posebnim naglaskom na razvoju integriranih modula izrade dinamičnih, autentičnih profila i „pitcheva“ korisnika. Ključni cilj je osigurati što veću automatizaciju procesa kreiranja profila i prijedloga, uz maksimalnu personalizaciju. Ti elementi ključni su za uspješnu komercijalizaciju platforme. Na taj način omogućit će se znatno preciznije povezivanje investitora s MSP-ovima i poboljšanje korisničkog iskustva. Razvojni proces obuhvatit će ciljana ispitivanja i validaciju kroz testiranje, čime će se osigurati dugoročna održivost platforme na tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Rest from care at the Ozalj Community Service Centre
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmor od skrbi u Centru za pružanje usluga u zajednici Ozalj
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project provides an innovative social service of rest from care to people who care for a household member dependent on their support in the Karlovac County, which contributes to the development of innovative social services with the aim of preventing institutionalization and greater inclusion in the community in the Republic of Croatia. The service will be used by 25 parents of caregivers/carers through the provision of care for their child with disabilities or an adult with disabilities in their own home or in the premises of the Centre for the provision of services in the Ozalj community, and through the organization of workshops and excursions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt osigurava inovativnu socijalnu uslugu odmor od skrbi osobama koje skrbe o članu kućanstva ovisnom o njihovoj podršci na području Karlovačke županije, što doprinosi razvoju inovativnih socijalnih usluga s ciljem prevencije institucionalizacije i veće uključenosti u zajednicu u Republici Hrvatskoj. Uslugu će koristiti 25 roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja putem osiguravanja skrbi za njihovo dijete s teškoćama u razvoju ili odraslu osobu s invaliditetom u vlastitom domu ili prostorima Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Ozalj, te kroz organiziranje radionica i izleta.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of quality management system (ISO 9001) and information security management system (ISO 27001) in the company SIGIT d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom (ISO 9001) i sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću (ISO 27001) u poduzeće SIGIT d. o. o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of the company SIGIT d.o.o. is focused on the implementation of quality management system according to ISO 9001 standard and information security management system according to ISO 27001 standard. The aim of the project is to optimize business processes, increase the reliability and security of services and ensure compliance with internationally recognized standards. The implementation of these systems will enable better organization within the company, protection of sensitive data and raising the quality of services to a higher level. The results of the project include increasing client confidence and improving internal processes, and thus increasing sales and export revenues and creating the basis for further business growth and expansion.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt poduzeća SIGIT d.o.o. usmjeren je na implementaciju sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema normi ISO 9001 i sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema normi ISO 27001. Cilj projekta je optimizacija poslovnih procesa, povećanje pouzdanosti i sigurnosti usluga te osiguranje usklađenosti s međunarodno priznatim standardima. Implementacija ovih sustava omogućit će bolju organizaciju unutar poduzeća, zaštitu osjetljivih podataka te podizanje kvalitete usluga na višu razinu. Rezultati projekta uključuju povećanje povjerenja klijenata te unaprjeđenje internih procesa, a time i povećanje prometa prihoda od prodaje i izvoza te stvaranje temelja za daljnji rast i širenje poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Level Crossing Assurance and Modernisation Project – Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Projekt osiguranja i modernizacije željezničko-cestovnih prijelaza – II. faza
Category_Label: Other reconstructed or modernised railways
NUTS3_Label: Krapinsko-zagorska županija|Brodsko-posavska županija|Virovitičko-podravska županija|Požeško-slavonska županija|Koprivničko-križevačka županija|Međimurska županija|Bjelovarsko-bilogorska županija|Šibensko-kninska županija|Karlovačka županija|Varaždinska županija|Osječko-baranjska županija|Vukovarsko-srijemska županija|Primorsko-goranska županija|Grad Zagreb
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the Project is the securing and modernization of 94 level crossings and one pedestrian crossing with automatic electronic signalling and safety devices that use modern devices with light signals in LED technology and strong bells to ensure safe traffic flow, while at 79 LCP, in addition to the above, the installation of semi-guards is planned. Phase II covers 84 level crossings and one pedestrian crossing. Out of the total number of crossings, 10 RACs are covered through Phase I of the Project and part of the costs for the works carried out on these 10 RACs from Phase I and the cost of expert supervision under Unit No 6/22-EU starting from May 2023 will be claimed through the SSC in Phase II, since these costs have not previously been claimed through the SSC in Phase I.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet Projekta je osiguranje i modernizacija 94 željezničko-cestovna i jednog pješačkog prijelaza automatskim elektroničkim signalno-sigurnosnim uređajima koji za osiguranje sigurnog odvijanja prometa koriste moderne uređaje sa svjetlosnim signalima u LED tehnologiji i jakozvučna zvona, dok je na 79 ŽCP a, uz navedeno predviđena i ugradnja polubranika. II. faza obuhvaća 84 željezničko-cestovna i jedan pješački prijelaz. Od ukupnog broja prijelaza, 10 ŽCP-a obuhvaćeno je kroz I. fazu Projekta te će dio troškova za izvedene radove na tih 10 ŽCP-a iz I. faze te trošak stručnog nadzora po Ug. br. 6/22-EU počevši od svibnja 2023.g. biti potraživan kroz ZNS u II fazi s obzirom da navedeni troškovi prethodno nisu potraživani kroz ZNS u I. fazi.

Operation_Name_English: Help from a woman has no price III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoć žene nema cijene III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: By applying for the project, we want to improve the quality of life of older people and people with disabilities by providing them with support through assistance in the delivery of groceries, etc. The stated goal will be achieved through the employment of 20 people in the Šibenik-Knin County for the purpose of supporting and supporting 120 end users in their daily activities and will ensure the control of the work of employed people through the employment of coordinators. People who are interested in working with the target group will be able to work continuously for a period of 30 months, which will increase their chances of employment at the end of the project because it will become more competitive on the labour market. These activities will improve the quality of life of the target group and make their daily lives easier.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavom projekta želimo poboljšati kvalitetu života starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom pružajući im podršku kroz pomoć u dostavi namirnica i sl. Navedeni cilj će se ostvariti kroz zapošljavanje 20 osoba na području Šibensko-kninske županije u svrhu potpore i podrške 120 krajnjih korisnika u njihovim svakodnevnim aktivnostima te će se osigurati kontrola rada zaposlenih osoba kroz zaposlenje koordinatora. Osobama koje su zainteresirane za rad s ciljanom skupinom omogućit će se kontinuirani rad u periodu 30 mjeseci što će im povećati šanse za zaposlenjem po završetku projekta jer će postati konkurentniji na tržištu rada. Tim aktivnostima će se utjecati na poboljšanje kvalitete života ciljane skupine i olakšati im svakodnevni život.

Operation_Name_English: Coastal cycling trails and promenades in the area of the City of Omiš - Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dužobalne biciklističke staze i šetnice na području Grada Omiša - faza II
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project represents an investment in the construction and equipping of three sections of cycling-pedestrian trails in the area of the City of Omiš, as the second phase of a long-term project of connecting the entire along-coastal belt of the City with cycling-pedestrian infrastructure, in order to strengthen green, clean, smart and sustainable urban traffic. In the total length of 1,671.71 m, sections Ribnjak (from the Municipality of Dugi Rat to the mouth of Cetina), Mančina-Vaga and Medići-Mimice will be built. The new cycling infrastructure that is the subject of this project, encourages sustainable mobility with zero emissions, reduces the impact of transport on the environment, increases the safety of cyclists and pedestrians, regulates public space and infrastructure, and increases the availability of suburban settlements of the City of Omiš.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt predstavlja ulaganje u izgradnju i opremanje triju dionica biciklističko-pješačkih staza na prostoru Grada Omiša, kao druge faze dugoročnog projekta povezivanja čitavog dužobalnog pojasa Grada biciklističko-pješačkom infrastrukturom, radi jačanja zelenog, čistog, pametnog i održivog gradskog prometa. U ukupnoj duljini od 1.671,71 m, izgradit će se dionice Ribnjak (od Općine Dugi Rat do ušća Cetine), Mančina-Vaga i Medići-Mimice. Novom biciklističkom infrastrukturom koja je predmet ovog projekta, potiče se održiva mobilnosti s nultom stopom emisije, utječe na smanjenje utjecaja prometa na okoliš, povećava sigurnost biciklista i pješaka, uređuje javni prostor I infrastruktura te povećava dostupnost prigradskih naselja Grada Omiša.

Operation_Name_English: In-In integration and inclusion
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: In-In integracija i inkluzija
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to ensure inclusive education of students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions. The specific objective is to support the inclusion of students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions in order to provide the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The project proposal implies the activity of providing support to the education of students with disabilities through the work of PUN/CPC, which includes the implementation of the selection procedure of candidates for PUN and CPC to students with TUR, , the work of PUN/CPC, communication and visibility, and project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je osiguranje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno obrazovnim ustanovama. Specifični cilj je pružiti potporu uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske i srednjoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Projektni prijedlog podrazumijeva aktivnost Pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad PUN/SKP, a koja uključuje provedbu postupka selekcije kandidata za PUN i SKP učenicima s TUR, , rad PUN/SKP, komunikaciju i vidljivost, te upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: My Five Minutes
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mojih pet minuta
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: Through many years of work, the Osijek Community Service Centre – ‘JA as well as TI’ and the partner Dom Lobor-grad take care of people with disabilities and have an excellent knowledge of the issues of both persons with disabilities and their families. Through this long-standing work, both institutions have adapted to the current requirements of the modern age in order to improve the services they provide. Through project activities, the Center and the Home will provide services of rest from care to parents caregivers/caregivers by providing care for a household member who is dependent on their support, but also by providing quality activities for parents caregivers/caregivers through psychological support, group and individual, professional education, etc.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Centar za pružanje usluga u zajednici Osijek – „JA kao i TI“ i partner Dom Lobor-grad kroz dugogodišnji rad brinu o osobama s invaliditetom te odlično poznaju problematiku kako osoba s invaliditetom tako i njihovih obitelji. Kroz taj dugogodišnji rad obje ustanove su se prilagođavale trenutnim zahtjevima modernog doba kako bi poboljšale usluge koje pružaju. Kroz projektne aktivnosti Centar i Dom će pružiti usluge odmor od skrbi roditeljima njegovateljima/njegovateljima osiguravanjem skrbi za člana kućanstva koji je ovisan o njihovoj podršci, ali i pružanjem kvalitetnih aktivnosti za roditelje njegovatelje/njegovatelje kroz psihološku podršku, grupnu i individualnu, stručne edukacije i dr.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading of the Kindergarten in the Municipality of Lobor
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja Dječjeg vrtića u Općini Lobor
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The Municipality of Lobor is applying the project Upgrading the kindergarten in the Municipality of Lobor in order to solve the problem of insufficient capacities and inappropriate conditions for the implementation of preschool education in the Municipality. The project will realise the result – an upgraded and equipped institution for pre-school education, which will contribute to the specific objective – to increase the availability of infrastructure and material capacity to increase the availability of pre-school education programmes in the Municipality of Lobor, i.e. the general objective of the project – to increase the participation rate in pre-school education. The target group of the project are children from the Municipality of Lobor.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Općina Lobor prijavljuje projekt Dogradnja Dječjeg vrtića u Općini Lobor kako bi riješila problem nedostatnih kapaciteta i neprimjerenih uvjeta za izvođenje predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja na području Općine. Projektom će se realizirati rezultat – dograđena i opremljena ustanova za predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje čime će se doprinijeti specifičnom cilju - povećati dostupnost infrastrukture i materijalnih kapaciteta za povećanje dostupnosti predškolskih programa za odgoj i obrazovanje na području Općine Lobor, odnosno općem cilju projekta - povećati stopu sudjelovanja u predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju. Ciljna skupina projekta su djeca s područja Općine Lobor.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening island fire resistance in the City of Vis and the Municipality of Šolta
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje otočne otpornosti na požare u Gradu Visu i Općini Šolta
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)|Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the investment is to strengthen the capacity of fire brigades for environmental and nature protection interventions on Vis and Šolta through the construction of a firehouse in the City of Vis, the purchase of a fire engine in the Municipality of Šolta. The aim of the project is to improve the operational readiness of the fire department of the town of Vis and the municipality of Šolta for fire risk. The project investment envisages the construction of a firehouse in the area of the town of Vis, and the purchase of a fire truck in the area of the municipality of Šolta, all with the aim of reducing the risk of fire and raising the preventive protection of people, property and the environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha investicijskog ulaganja je jačanje kapaciteta vatrogasnih postrojbi za intervencije u zaštiti okoliša i prirode na Visu i Šolti kroz izgradnju vatrogasnog doma u Gradu Visu, nabavu vatrogasnog vozila u Općini Šolta. Cilj projekta je poboljšanje operativne spremnosti vatrogastva grada Visa i općine Šolta radi rizika od požara. Projektnim ulaganjem je predviđena izgradnja vatrogasnog doma na području grada Visa, te nabava vatrogasnog vozila na području općine Šolta, a sve za cilj smanjenja rizika od požara i podizanja preventivne zaštite ljudi, imovine i okoliša.

Operation_Name_English: It's never too late - Stage IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nikad nije kasno - faza IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project is never too late - Phase IV is a continuation of the successfully completed third phase of the project. It is planned to employ 30 women who will provide home help and support services for 180 vulnerable people of the target group over 33 months. The total duration of the project will be 36 months, of which 3 months are foreseen for preparation and final activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Nikad nije kasno - faza IV nastavak je uspješno završene treće faza projekta. Predviđeno je zapošljavanje 30 žena koje će kroz 33 mjeseca pružiti uslugu pomoći i podrške u kući za 180 ranjivih osoba ciljane skupine. Ukupno trajanje projekta bit će 36 mjeseci od čega su 3 mjeseca predviđena za pripreme i završne aktivnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Development of titanium abutment quality control process
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj procesa kontrole kvalitete titanskih abutmenta
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project "Development of the titanium abutment quality control process" in cooperation with Neo Dens d.o.o. and the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture of the University of Zagreb is to apply professional and technical knowledge in order to develop an innovative titanium abutment quality control process, which will offer the market products that are new to the market in terms of characteristics and quality, will provide the basis for their commercialization with a contribution to the growth and competitiveness of applicants, and the application of project results in the S3 area Personalized health care related to the realization of the goals of improving the market readiness of research and development results and increasing the market reach of innovative products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha je projekta "Razvoj procesa kontrole kvalitete titanskih abutmenta" u suradnji Neo Dens d.o.o. s Fakultetom strojarstva i brodogradnje Sveučilišta u Zagrebu primijeniti stručna i tehnička znanja u svrhu razvoja inovativnog procesa kontrole kvalitete titanskih abutmenta čime će se tržištu ponuditi proizvodi koji su u pogledu karakteristika i kvalitete novost na tržištu, pružit će se temelj za njihovu komercijalizaciju uz doprinos rastu i konkurentnosti prijavitelja, te primjenu rezultata projekta u S3 području Personalizirana briga o zdravlju povezano s realizacijom ciljeva Poboljšanja tržišne spremnosti rezultata istraživanja i razvoja i Povećanja tržišnog dosega inovativnih proizvoda.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Karlovac County Social Plan 2024-2026
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada socijalnog plana Karlovačke županije 2024.-2026.
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project will provide support to the county in the comprehensive development of the Social Plan. The activities to be carried out are the analysis and processing of data in accordance with the Ordinance on a Uniform Methodology for Needs Assessment and the Empowerment of Members of the Social Welfare Council and County Employees. As part of the promotion and visibility activities, the beneficiary will organize a Social Services Fair and a round style on the topic of combating discrimination on all grounds.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta pružit će se podrška županiji u cjelovitoj izradi Socijalnog plana. Aktivnosti koje će se provoditi su analiza i obrada podataka sukladno Pravilniku o jedinstvenoj metodologiji za procjenu potreba te osnaživanje članova Savjeta za socijalnu skrb i djelatnika županije. U okviru aktivnosti promidžba i vidljivost, korisnik će organizirati Sajam socijalnih usluga te okrugli stil na temu suzbijanja diskriminacije po svim osnovama.

Operation_Name_English: ‘Upgrading and equipping the Children’s Garden of Sunshine – Nazareth, Zagreb branch’
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: „Nadogradnja i opremanje Dječjeg Vrtića Sunčev sjaj – Nazaret, podružnica Zagreb“
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: Upgrading and equipping DV Sunshine - Nazaret, Zagreb branch office, will contribute to solving the problem of a significant shortage of vacancies in kindergartens and thus achieve the expansion of the capacity of places available in DV and enable the enrolment of an additional number of children in preschool institutions. One of the specific objectives of the project is the creation of infrastructural and organizational preconditions, both spatial and educational, through the implementation of construction measures that will expand the DV with the aim of improving the quality of education of children of early and preschool age.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Nadogradnja i opremanje DV Sunčev sjaj - Nazaret, podružnica Zagreb, pridonijet će rješavanju problema značajnog manjka slobodnih mjesta u dječjim vrtićima te na takav način postići proširenje kapaciteta mjesta raspoloživih u DV te omogućiti upise dodatnog broja djece u predškolske ustanove. Jedan od specifičnih ciljeva projekta je stvaranje infrastrukturnih i organizacijskih preduvjeta, kako prostornih tako i odgojno – obrazovnih, kroz provođenje građevinskih mjera kojim će se proširiti DV sa ciljem što kvalitetniji odgoj i obrazovanje djece rane i predškolske dobi.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a management system according to ISO 14001:2015 standard that will make the company more competitive on the national and international market and thus enable it to further grow in accordance with strategic goals. The implementation of the management system and the acquisition of ISO certification will result in greater customer confidence, but also a more productive, efficient and secure business, which is the interest of the company, employees, clients and suppliers who are the target group of the project. By implementing the project, the company will be able to get new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards, and in which so far it has not been able to compete.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normi ISO 14001:2015 koji će tvrtku učiniti konkurentnijom na nacionalnom i internacionalnom tržištu te joj time omogućiti daljnji rast u skladu sa strateškim ciljevima. Implementacija sustava upravljanja i stjecanje ISO certifikata rezultirat će većim povjerenjem kupaca, ali i produktivnijim, efikasnijim i sigurnijim poslovanjem, što je interes tvrtke, djelatnika, klijenata i dobavljača koji su ciljana skupina projekta. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama, a u kojima do sada nije mogla konkurirati.

Operation_Name_English: Rugvica - Dugo Selo sewage and wastewater treatment system PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rugvica – Dugo Selo sustav odvodnje i pročišćavanja otpadnih voda FAZA 2
Category_Label: Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project consists of two phases. Phase 1 of the project includes investment investments within the financial period OPKK 2014-2020. Phase 2 of the project covers investment investments within the financial period of the PKK 2021-2027. The Rugvica – Dugo Selo agglomeration will be brought into line with the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive (91/271/EEC) by upgrading the level III waste water treatment plant, upgrading the drainage system, increasing the connection to the drainage system and reconstructing part of the existing drainage system. The target group of this project are residents currently connected to the public drainage system and those who will be connected to the new and/or reconstructed public drainage system through this project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se sastoji od dvije faze. 1.faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja OPKK 2014-2020. 2.faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja PKK 2021-2027.
