Aglomeracija Rugvica – Dugo Selo uskladiti će se sa Direktivom o pročišćavanju komunalnih otpadnih voda (91/271/EEZ) kroz nadogradnju uređaja za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda III. stupnja, dogradnju sustava odvodnje, povećanja priključenosti na sustav odvodnje te rekonstrukciju dijela postojećeg sustava odvodnje. Ciljna skupina ovog projekta su stanovnici trenutno priključeni na sustav javne odvodnje i oni koji će se putem ovog projekta priključiti na novi i/ili rekonstruirani sustav javne odvodnje.

Operation_Name_English: DEVELOPMENT OF INNOVATIVE ADDITIONS FROM THE USE OF NATURAL ORIGIN WATER
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: RAZVOJ INOVATIVNIH DODATAKA PREHRANI UPOTREBOM SIROVINA PRIRODNOG PODRIJETLA
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in large enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project led by PharmaS d.o.o. includes a partnership with the Faculty of Food Technology Osijek, Vinarija Trdenić, Wines Markota, Polyclinic Osijek and Polyclinic Labplus2 to explore the possibility of using grape tropics, waste from wine production, for the purpose of creating food supplements. The aim is to develop formulations that would help relieve the symptoms of allergies and the consequences of lack of sleep. During the project, it is planned to optimize the process of preparation and extraction of grape tropics for the maximum yield of phenolic compounds, which are known for their health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. It strengthens local innovation and production capacities, as well as the circular and food-saving economy.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt pod vodstvom PharmaS d.o.o. uključuje partnerstvo s Prehrambeno-tehnološkim fakultetom Osijek, Vinarijom Trdenić, Vinama Markota, Poliklinikom Osijek te Poliklinikom Labplus2 za istraživanje mogućnosti korištenja tropa grožđa, otpada iz proizvodnje vina, u svrhu stvaranja dodataka prehrani. Cilj je razviti formulacije koje bi pomogle u ublažavanju simptoma alergija i posljedica nedostatka sna. Tijekom projekta, planira se optimizacija procesa pripreme i ekstrakcije tropa grožđa za maksimalni prinos fenolnih spojeva, koji su poznati po svojim zdravstvenim benefitima, uključujući antioksidativna i antiupalna svojstva. Jačaju se lokalni kapaciteti za inovacije i proizvodnju te promične kružno gospodarsvo hrane.

Operation_Name_English: Paz(in)exclusive school 4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Paz(in)kluzivna škola 4
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Paz(IN)exclusive school 4" will continue the good practice of providing support to primary school students with developmental difficulties (target group) through PUN/CPC insurance in primary school institutions of the City of Pazin in order to ensure conditions for even better educational achievements, socialization and emotional functioning of students with TUR. The project will lay the foundations for ensuring equal opportunities for all children and will increase the social inclusion of children with TUR. The project holder is the City of Pazin, and the partner is Vladimir Nazor Pazin Elementary School.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Paz(IN)kluzivna škola 4" nastaviti će se dobra praksa pružanja podrške osnovnoškolskim učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju (ciljana skupina) kroz osiguranje PUN/SKP u osnovnoškolskim ustanovama Grada Pazina kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za još bolja obrazovna postignuća, socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje učenika s TUR. Projektom će se postaviti temelji za osiguranje jednakih mogućnosti za svu djecu te će se povećati socijalna uključivost djece s TUR. Nositelj projekta je Grad Pazin, a partner je Osnovna škola Vladimira Nazora Pazin.

Operation_Name_English: LAG STEaM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: LAG STEaM
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: LAG STEaM project strengthens the capacities and cooperation of the association with the educational sector with the mentorship of the Institute of Physics with the aim of improving human capital for the implementation of programs in the field of STEM promotion in the rural area of LAG Bosutski str. Achieving the goal of improving the applicant's capacity will be carried out through raising the level of knowledge of three persons from the applicant institution and forming cooperation with educational institutions within which they will partner with three primary schools and the Institute of Physics. The promotion of the learned and empowered will be shown through the implementation of 430 workshops in nine primary schools through which 670 students will be involved for a period of 34 months of project implementation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: LAG STEaM projekt jača kapacitete i suradnju udruge sa obrazovno odgojnim sektorom uz mentorstvo Instituta za fiziku s ciljem unapređenja ljudskog kapitala za provedbu programa u području promocije STEM-a na ruralnom području LAG-a Bosutski niz. Postizanje cilja unapređenja kapaciteta prijavitelja provest će se kroz podizanje razine znanja tri osobe iz institucije prijavitelja uz formiranje suradnje s obrazovnim institucijama u sklopu kojih će se partnerski povezati sa tri osnovne škole te Institutom za fiziku. Sama promocija naučenog i osnaženog prikazat će se kroz implementaciju 430 radionica na području devet osnovnih škola kroz koje će se uključiti 670 učenika na rok od 34 mjeseca provedbe projekta.

Operation_Name_English: National reference laboratory for emissions from internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery - Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nacionalni referentni laboratorij za emisije iz motora s unutarnjim izgaranjem za necestovne pokretne strojeve - Faza 2
Category_Label: Air quality and noise reduction measures
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to establish a laboratory for measuring emissions from non-road mobile machinery engines, with the reconstruction and equipping of the existing building of the Laboratory for Engines and Vehicles, the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture and the purchase of measuring equipment for laboratory and field tests, staff education and obtaining an accreditation certificate. A database of non-road mobile machinery will be set up alongside the laboratory, allowing for targeted measures to improve air quality. Laboratory and field testing will establish a control mechanism for non-road mobile machinery emissions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uspostava laboratorija za mjerenje emisija iz motora necestovnih pokretnih strojeva, uz rekonstrukciju i opremanje postojeće zgrade Laboratorija za motore i vozila, Fakulteta strojarstva i brodogradnje te nabava mjerne opreme za laboratorijska i terenska ispitivanja, edukacija osoblja i ishođenje potvrde o akreditaciji. Uz laboratorij uspostavit će se baza podataka necestovnih pokretnih strojeva što će omogućiti ciljane mjere za poboljšanje kvalitete zraka. Ispitivanjem u laboratoriju i na terenu uspostavit će se kontrolni mehanizam emisija iz necestovnih pokretnih strojeva.

Operation_Name_English: Landscaping of the Stoja beach
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uređenje kupališta Stoja
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures|Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Protection, development and promotion of public tourism assets and tourism services
Operation_Summary_English: The project of revitalization of the complex of the Stoja beach in Pula, which is a protected cultural property, is planning a complete renovation in order to restore its original function as a modern bathing area. Currently, the bathing area is in a dilapidated state, with limited functionality of many basic facilities. The renovation includes the reconstruction (upgrade) of one of the five existing buildings and the complete renovation and restoration to the original function of a superbly equipped bathing area with numerous accompanying facilities. The project also envisages the arrangement of outdoor areas, sunbathing areas and the realization of access for persons with reduced mobility. The aim is to preserve the historical value of the space, increase its aesthetic attractiveness and improve the tourist offer.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt revitalizacije kompleksa kupališta Stoja u Puli, koji je zaštićeno kulturno dobro, planira cjelovitu obnovu u cilju vraćanja njegove izvorne funkcije kao modernog kupališta. Trenutno se kupalište nalazi u derutnom stanju, uz ograničenu funkcionalnost mnogih osnovnih sadržaja. Obnova uključuje rekonstrukciju (dogradnju) jedne od pet postojećih građevina te cjelovitu obnovu i vraćanje u izvornu funkciju vrhunski opremljenog kupališta s brojnim pratećim sadržajima. Projektom je predviđeno i uređenje vanjskih površina, sunčališta i realizacija pristupa za osobe smanjene pokretljivosti. Cilj je očuvati povijesnu vrijednost prostora, povećati njegovu estetsku privlačnost i poboljšati turističku ponudu.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - work and accomplish in Valpovo IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi- radi i ostvari u Valpovu IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to mitigate the consequences of unemployment and contribute to reducing the risk of poverty for 35 people and to foster social inclusion and increase the level of quality of life for 210 final beneficiaries in the city of Valpovo and its settlements. The main activities are: employment of 35 service providers for 210 members of the target group for organizing food (assistance in preparing meals, obtaining food, etc.), performing household tasks (washing dishes, cleaning the living space, bringing water, heating, etc., organizing laundry washing and ironing, purchasing medicines and other necessities, etc.), maintaining personal hygiene (assistance in dressing and undressing, bathing and performing other hygiene needs, etc.), meeting other daily needs. Monitoring and control of performed services. Purchase and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies. Communication and visibility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je ublažavanje posljedica nezaposlenosti i doprinos smanjenju rizika od siromaštva za 35 osoba te poticanje socijalne uključenosti i povećanje razine kvalitete života za 210 krajnjih korisnika u gradu Valpovu i pripadajućim naseljima. Glavne aktivnosti su: zapošljavanje 35 osoba pružatelja usluga za 210 pripadnika ciljane skupine za organiziranje prehrane (pomoć u pripremi obroka, nabavi hrane i dr.), obavljanje kućanskih poslova (pranje posuđa, pospremanje stambenog prostora, donošenje vode, ogrijeva i slično, organiziranje pranja i glačanja rublja, nabava lijekova i drugih potrepština i dr.), održavanje osobne higijene (pomoć u oblačenju i svlačenju, u kupanju i obavljanju drugih higijenskih potreba i dr.), zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba. Praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga. Nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština. Komunikacija i vidljivost.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading of the kindergarten in Peteranac
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja dječjeg vrtića u Peterancu
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The main problem that this project aims to solve is the lack of infrastructure capacity for the implementation of educational activities for children in the early childhood education and care system in the municipality of Peteranec through the extension of the existing kindergarten. The overall objective of the project is to invest in the extension of the kindergarten for the needs of a group of nurseries in the municipality of Peteranec. The specific objective is to provide infrastructure and material capacity to increase the availability of early childhood education and care in the municipality of Peteranec. The target group are children of crèche age from the territory of the municipality of Peteranec, while the final beneficiaries are educators and parents from the area, including the entire local community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni problem koji se ovim projektom želi riješiti je otkloniti nedostatak infrastrukturnih kapaciteta za odvijanje odgojno-obrazovnih djelatnosti za djecu u sustavu ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja u općini Peteranec kroz dogradnju postojećeg dječjeg vrtića. Opći cilj projekta je ulaganje u dogradnju dječjeg vrtića za potrebe rada jedne skupine jasličke dobi u općini Peteranec. Specifični cilj je osigurati infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja u općini Peteranec. Ciljna skupina su djeca jasličke dobi s područja općine Peteranec dok su krajnji korisnici odgajatelji i roditelji s tog područja uključujući i cjelokupnu lokalnu zajednicu.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of SIDEAS d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva SIDEAS d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project is aimed at improving the international competitiveness of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) through the product certification process and the implementation of the ISO 14001:2015 standard. Product certification will enable compliance with international standards, while the implementation of ISO 14001:2015 will ensure systematic environmental management within the company. With these investments, the company will ensure greater recognition in the international market, increase customer confidence and open up opportunities for business expansion.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je usmjeren na poboljšanje međunarodne konkurentnosti malih i srednjih poduzeća (MSP) kroz proces certificiranja proizvoda i implementaciju norme ISO 14001:2015. Certifikacija proizvoda omogućit će usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima, dok će implementacija norme ISO 14001:2015 osigurati sustavno upravljanje okolišem unutar tvrtke. Ovim ulaganjima tvrtka će osigurati veću prepoznatljivost na međunarodnom tržištu, povećati povjerenje kupaca i otvoriti mogućnosti za širenje poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: "Reconstruction, upgrading and equipping of the Children's kindergarten Good Split, regional facility DV ABBA"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Rekonstrukcija, dogradnja i opremanje Dječjeg vrtića Dobri Split, područnog objekta DV ABBA"
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: Providing infrastructure conditions to increase access to early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osiguravanje infrastrukturnih uvjeta za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja

Operation_Name_English: Data centre certification according to EN 50600
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija podatkovnog centra prema normi EN 50600
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The certification project of the new data center according to EN 50600 standard will ensure the highest level of security, energy efficiency and availability, which will enable the center to meet international standards and become recognized in the international market. Certification will provide access to customers with high data security requirements. Increased operational efficiency will reduce operating costs and ensure the long-term viability of the centre.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt certifikacije novog podatkovnog centra prema normi EN 50600 osigurat će najvišu razinu sigurnosti, energetske učinkovitosti i dostupnosti, čime će centar ispuniti međunarodne standarde i postati prepoznat na međunarodnom tržištu. Certifikacija će omogućiti pristup klijentima s visokim zahtjevima za sigurnost podataka. Povećana operativna učinkovitost smanjit će troškove poslovanja i osigurati dugoročnu održivost centra.

Operation_Name_English: Promoting social dialogue and empowering trade unions for new challenges
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Promicanje socijalnog dijaloga i osnaživanje Sindikata za nove izazove
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: With the project Promoting Social Dialogue and Empowering the Union for New Challenges, 306 employees and commissioners of the two trade unions will strengthen the capacity for effective and successful negotiation and action in the business community. Twenty of them will be involved in study visits to foreign trade unions with the aim of exchanging knowledge, practice and experience. Conclusions and guidelines leading to training and networking activities will be communicated in the form of a roundtable and conference with social partners, interested stakeholders and the general public. The applicant will develop new communication, management and business models based on digital technologies, which will enhance these functions, in line with the objectives of the green and digital transitions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Promicanje socijalnog dijaloga i osnaživanje Sindikata za nove izazove 306 zaposlenika i povjerenika dva sindikata ojačat će kapacitete za učinkovito i uspješno pregovaranje i djelovanje u poslovnoj zajednici. Njih 20 bit će uključeno u studijske posjete inozemnim sindikatima s ciljem razmjene znanja, prakse i iskustva. Zaključci i smjernice kojima će rezultirati aktivnosti osposobljavanja i umrežavanja bit će komunicirani u formi okruglog stola i konferencije sa socijalnim partnerima, zainteresiranim dionicima i širom javnošću. Prijavitelj će razviti nove komunikacijske, upravljačke i poslovne modele rada temeljene na digitalnim tehnologijama što će unaprijediti te funkcije, a u skladu s ciljevima zelene i digitalne tranzicije.

Operation_Name_English: Preparation, introduction and certification of the management system according to ISO standards for the company NOTUS IT d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Priprema, uvođenje i certificiranje sustava upravljanja prema ISO normama za tvrtku NOTUS IT d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Preparation, implementation and certification of management systems according to ISO standards for NOTUS IT d.o.o.’ aims to strengthen the company’s market position through the introduction and certification of internationally recognised standards ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 20000-1:2018, which will ensure a high level of quality, security and management of IT services. By implementing the project, Notus IT will increase its competitiveness in the domestic and foreign markets, ensure the trust of clients and regulatory bodies and create the preconditions for increasing sales and export revenues in the coming period. The certification will enable expansion to new markets and the realization of sustainable growth of the company.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Priprema, uvođenje i certificiranje sustava upravljanja prema ISO normama za tvrtku NOTUS IT d.o.o.“ ima za cilj jačanje tržišne pozicije tvrtke kroz uvođenje i certifikaciju međunarodno priznatih standarda ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001:2022 i ISO 20000-1:2018, čime će se osigurati visoka razina kvalitete, sigurnosti i upravljanja IT uslugama. Provedbom projekta, Notus IT će povećati svoju konkurentnost na domaćem i inozemnom tržištu, osigurati povjerenje klijenata i regulatornih tijela te stvoriti preduvjete za povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza u narednom razdoblju. Certifikacijom će se omogućiti širenje na nova tržišta i ostvarenje održivog rasta tvrtke.

Operation_Name_English: Development of innovative green composite materials and prefabricated elements for passive/low-energy houses and modular construction
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inovativnih zelenih kompozitnih materijala i predgotovljenih elemenata za pasivne/niskoenergetske kuće i modularnu gradnju
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Development of innovative green composite materials and prefabricated elements for passive/low-energy houses and modular construction that will contribute to the NUTS2 region of Pannonian Croatia, RLV Green Growth, PN Clean and green technologies and eco-friendly products, the topic "Innovative solutions for energy efficiency" under the S3 thematic area "Adapted and innovative wood products" with the aim of developing products that have a negative Global Warming Potential - GWP, which is actually a positive impact on the environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Razvoj inovativnih zelenih kompozitnih materijala i predgotovljenih elemenata za pasivne/niskoenergetske kuće i modularnu gradnju koji će doprinijeti NUTS2 regiji Panonska Hrvatska, RLV Zeleni rast, PN Čiste i zelene tehnologije i ekološki proizvodi, temi "Inovativna rješenja za energetsku učinkovitost" u okviru S3 tematskog područja „Prilagođeni i inovativni drveni proizvodi“ s ciljem razvoja proizvoda koji imaju negativan Global Warming Potential - GWP što je zapravo pozitivan utjecaj na okoliš.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of new ISO standards for Inter Solutio d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje novih ISO standarda za tvrtku Inter Solutio d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to improve the quality of services and business processes of Inter Solutio d.o.o. through implementation and certification according to internationally recognized standards ISO 20000 (management of IT services) and ISO 22301 (management of business continuity). The purpose of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of enterprises by standardizing processes, ensuring resilience to business risks and adapting services to high client requirements. Expected results include certified management systems, increased trust of clients and partners, expansion to foreign markets and growth of revenues from international projects.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt ima za cilj unaprjeđenje kvalitete usluga i poslovnih procesa poduzeća Inter Solutio d.o.o. kroz implementaciju i certifikaciju prema međunarodno priznatim normama ISO 20000 (upravljanje IT uslugama) i ISO 22301 (upravljanje kontinuitetom poslovanja). Svrha projekta je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poduzeća putem standardizacije procesa, osiguravanja otpornosti na poslovne rizike te prilagodbe usluga visokim zahtjevima klijenata. Očekivani rezultati uključuju certificirane sustave upravljanja, povećano povjerenje klijenata i partnera, proširenje na inozemna tržišta te rast prihoda od međunarodnih projekata.

Operation_Name_English: QPORT
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: QPORT
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The qPort project includes the development of 3 innovative products for nautical tourism in order to develop the priority niche RLV Blue Growth of Adriatic Croatia. qPort is an innovative solution in the form of a mobile application consisting of 3 separately innovative modules designed to enable navigation and booking of berths, optimization of resource management and connecting supply and demand through the digital market with its integrated and comprehensive approach. This makes it a unique solution that covers a wide range of needs within the nautical tourism sector.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt qPort obuhvaća razvoj 3 inovativna proizvoda za nautički turizam u svrhu razvoja prioritetne niše RLV Plavi rast Jadranske Hrvatske. qPort inovativno je rješenje u vidu mobilne aplikacije koja se sastoji od 3 zasebno inovativna modula dizajnirana da svojim integriranim i sveobuhvatnim pristupom omoguće navigaciju i rezervaciju vezova, optimizaciju upravljanja resursima te povezivanje ponude i potražnje kroz digitalno tržište. To ga čini jedinstvenim rješenjem koje pokriva širok spektar potreba unutar sektora nautičkog turizma.

Operation_Name_English: CertiPro – The road to excellence of Marex Elektrostroj d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: CertiPro – Put do izvrsnosti tvrtke Marex Elektrostroj d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the competitiveness of the company through certification of welding procedures according to the HRN EN ISO 15614-1:2017/A1 :2019 standard. Certification ensures high quality of welded joints, increases product safety and enables access to new markets. The project will result in compliance with international standards, reducing the number of defective welds and increasing customer confidence. By integrating digital technologies and educating employees, the company will strengthen its market position and become a reliable partner.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća kroz certificiranje postupaka zavarivanja prema normi HRN EN ISO 15614-1:2017/A1 :2019. Certifikacijom se osigurava visoka kvaliteta zavarenih spojeva, povećava sigurnost proizvoda i omogućuje pristup novim tržištima. Projekt će rezultirati usklađenošću s međunarodnim standardima, smanjenjem broja neispravnih zavara i povećanjem povjerenja klijenata. Integracijom digitalnih tehnologija i edukacijom zaposlenika poduzeće će ojačati tržišnu poziciju te postati pouzdan partner.

Operation_Name_English: Repušnica Regional Kindergarten
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Područni vrtić Repušnica
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: INVESTOR: City of Kutina NAME OF THE PROJECT: Regional kindergarten Repušnica TOTAL VALUE OF THE PROJECT: 1.335.445,68 EUR PURPOSE (Objective) PROJECT: Providing infrastructure and material capacities to increase the availability of early childhood education and care in the Republic of Croatia by building and equipping the preschool institution Regional kindergarten Repušnica through the provision of 2 additional living rooms (1 day-room of the nursery group, 1 day-room of the kindergarten group) which includes the construction of 32 places for children.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: INVESTITOR: Grad Kutina NAZIV PROJEKTA: Područni vrtić Repušnica UKUPNA VRIJEDNOST PROJEKTA: 1.335.445,68 EUR SVRHA (CILJ) PROJEKTA: Osiguranje infrastrukturnih i materijalnih kapaciteta za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja u RH i to izgradnjom i opremanjem predškolske ustanove Područni vrtić Repušnica kroz osiguravanje 2 dodatna dnevna boravka (1 dnevni boravak jasličke skupine, 1 dnevni boravak vrtićke skupine) što obuhvaća izgradnju 32 mjesta za djecu.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of the management system in the company Nobilis d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija sustava upravljanja u poduzeću Nobilis d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: In order to become more competitive in the international market, Nobilis will, through the implementation of the project, certify management systems within the company. The specific objective of the project is to: Increased competitiveness of Nobilis through the introduction of a management system, and the expected results are: Certification of 4 management systems, which will achieve international competitiveness of the Applicant.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Kako bi postala konkurentnija na međunarodnom tržištu, tvrtka Nobilis će provedbom projekta certificirati sustave upravljanja unutar poduzeća. Specifični cilj projekta je: Povećana konkurentnost tvrtke Nobilis kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja, a očekivani rezultati su: certifikacija 4 sustava upravljanja, čime će se postići međunarodna konkurentnost Prijavitelja.

Operation_Name_English: Providing teaching assistants to students with disabilities in Vinkovci 2023/2024
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Osiguravanje pomoćnika u nastavi učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u Vinkovcima 2023/2024
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: SC.1 Support the inclusion of at least 48 pupils with disabilities in primary education institutions in order to ensure conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning in the city of Vinkovci. SC.2 Support 10 months of inclusion of at least 45 students with disabilities in primary education institutions, through activities: A1 - Selection procedure of candidates for PUN and CPC for students with developmental difficulties A2 - Organized implementation of the programme of introduction into the work of teaching assistants A3 - The work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators occurs in the year 2022/23 A4 - Communication and visibility in accordance with the guidelines on visibility A5 - Project management and administration - submitted 2 CIS
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SC.1. Pružiti potporu uključivanju najmanje 48 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje na području grada Vinkovaca. SC.2. Pružiti potporu 10 mjeseci uključivanju najmanje 45 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove, kroz aktivnosti: A1 - Proveden postupak selekcije kandidata za PUN i SKP učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju A2 - Organizirana provedba programa uvođenja u rad pomoćnika u nastavi A3 - Rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika nastane godina 2022/23 A4 - Komunikacija i vidljivost sukladno smjernicama o vidljivosti A5 - Upravljanje projektom i administracija - predana 2 ZNS-a

Operation_Name_English: HealthPath Simulator
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: HealthPath Simulator
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: HealthPath Simulator (HPS) is an innovative platform that integrates SmartHealth and SmartTech solution, and is intended for service providers from the health and tourism sector in the Adriatic Croatia. Innovation comprises two components: a personalised 360 simulation of the health service user experience and a system for providing tourism services through a concierge chatbot based on machine learning and generative artificial intelligence, both of which will be separately commercialised within the priority niches Personalised Medicine and Health and Wellness Tourism of RLV Health. The consortium consists of 5 SMEs and 1 OIŠZ, and the project addresses the social challenge of reducing the seasonality of tourism, in cooperation with the Zadar Tourist Board.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: HealthPath Simulator (HPS) predstavlja inovativnu platformu koja integrira SmartHealth i SmartTech rješenje, a namijenjena je pružateljima usluga iz zdravstvenog i turističkog sektora u jadranskoj Hrvatskoj. Inovacija obuhvaća dvije komponente: personaliziranu 360 simulaciju korisničkog iskustva zdravstvenih usluga te sustav za pružanje turističkih usluga putem concierge chatbota temeljenog na strojnom učenju i generativnoj umjetnoj inteligenciji, a obje će se moći zasebno komercijalizirati u okviru prioritetnih niša Personalizirana medicina i Zdravstveni i wellness turizam RLV-a Zdravlje. Konzorcij čini 5 MSP-ova i 1 OIŠZ, a projekt adresira društveni izazov smanjenja sezonalnosti turizma, u suradnji s Turističkom zajednicom Grada Zadra.

Operation_Name_English: Agronomic Linear Robotic System - AGROLIROS
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Agronomski linearni robotski sustav – AGROLIROS
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The research and development project for innovative products AGROLIROS – An agronomic linear robotic system and robotic tool for autonomously placing sensors in the soil, represents a radical innovation in the development of green technologies for the agricultural sector, responding to global challenges caused by climate change. The complex robotic system uses advanced AI algorithms to autonomously execute plant care sequences and maintain photovoltaic panels in a specific agri-photovoltaic environment. The implementation of the project directly addresses the weaknesses of the agricultural sector of Pannonian Croatia and strengthens cross-sectoral cooperation between entrepreneurs, the EISF and public law bodies, which, along with farmers, form the target groups of the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt istraživanja i razvoja inovativnih proizvoda AGROLIROS – Agronomski linearni robotski sustav i robotskog alata za autonomno postavljanje senzora u tlo, predstavlja radikalnu inovaciju u razvoju zelenih tehnologija za poljoprivredni sektor, odgovarajući na globalne izazove uzrokovane klimatskim promjenama. Kompleksan robotski sustav koristi napredne AI algoritme za autonomno izvršavanje sekvenci radnji skrbi za biljke i održavanje fotonaponskih panela u specifičnom okruženju agrofotonapona. Provedbom projekta izravno se adresiraju slabosti poljoprivrednog sektora Panonske Hrvatske te se jača međusektorska suradnja poduzetnika, OIŠZ i javnopravnih tijela koji, uz poljoprivrednike, čine ciljane skupine projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Teaching assistants - Grubišno polje - phase VII.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoćnici u nastavi - Grubišno polje - faza VII.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure inclusive education of students with disabilities in Primary School I. N. Jemeršić through the engagement and training of teaching assistants. Assistants will provide individualized support, which will enhance educational achievements, encourage socialization and improve the emotional functioning of students. The project will create an inclusive environment that facilitates the participation of students with disabilities in school life and supports their overall development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osigurati inkluzivno obrazovanje učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u Osnovnoj školi I. N. Jemeršića kroz angažiranje i obuku pomoćnika u nastavi. Pomoćnici će pružati individualiziranu podršku, što će unaprijediti obrazovna postignuća, potaknuti socijalizaciju i poboljšati emocionalno funkcioniranje učenika. Projekt će stvoriti inkluzivno okruženje koje olakšava sudjelovanje učenika s teškoćama u školskom životu i podržava njihov cjelokupni razvoj.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a bicycle-pedestrian path in the municipality of Drnje – Drnje, Ulica Stjepana Pašice i Botovo, Ulica kralja Zvonimira
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističko-pješačke staze u općini Drnje – Drnje, Ulica Stjepana Pašice i Botovo, Ulica kralja Zvonimira
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The municipality of Drnje is crossed by the state road DC41, a traffic road that connects the Republic of Croatia with Central and Eastern European countries. There are a large number of vehicles, personal, cargo and agricultural, and since there are no bicycle-pedestrian paths built, both cyclists and pedestrians move along the road. The aim of the project is to solve the problem of unsafe roads, which pose a danger to the most vulnerable road users, pedestrians and cyclists. The target group of the project is the inhabitants of the villages of Botovo and Drnje, who pass through the road on a daily basis, and who will use bicycles more as zero-carbon vehicles through the implementation of the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Općinom Drnje prolazi državna cesta DC41, prometna cesta koja RH povezuje sa srednjoeuropskim i istočnoeuropskim zemljama. Prometnicom svakodnevno prometuje velik broj vozila, osobnih, teretnih i poljoprivrednih, a kako nema izgrađene biciklističko-pješačke staze prometnicom se kreću i biciklisti i pješaci. Predmetnim projektom, izgradnjom biciklističko-pješačke staze želi se riješiti problem nesigurne prometnice, koja predstavlja opasnost za najranjivije sudionike u prometu, pješake i bicikliste. Ciljnu skupinu projekta čine stanovnici naselja Botovo i Drnje, koji svakodnevno prolaze predmetnom prometnicom, a koji će realizacijom projekta više upotrebljavati bicikle kao vozila s nultom stopom emisije ugljika.

Operation_Name_English: SPEAK UP III. The power of dialogue!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SPEAK UP III. - Moć dijaloga!
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: Within the project "SPEAK UP III. NCS in partnership with NHS plans to organize 5 trainings/interactive workshops on 5 topics: wage developments in the Republic of Croatia, artificial intelligence in practice, communication of commissioners with employers and members, communication in teams, collective bargaining in practice - workshops. The aim is to strengthen the knowledge and skills of Commissioners for competitiveness in the labour market. We will organise international networking: a conference in Zagreb, a study trip to France and a visit to a trade union in Slovenia to exchange experiences with other road trade unions. We will drive the digital transformation of work by improving 7 services for our members, which will facilitate access to information and the exercise of various rights.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: U sklopu Projekta "SPEAK UP III. - Moć dijaloga!" NCS u partnerstvu s NHS-om planira organizirati 5 edukacija/interaktivnih radionica na 5 tema: kretanje plaća u RH, umjetna inteligencija u praksi, komunikacija povjerenika s poslodavcima i članovima, komunikacija u timovima, kolektivno pregovaranje u praksi - radionica. Cilj je jačanje znanja i vještina povjerenika radi konkurentnosti na tržištu rada. Organizirat ćemo međunarodna umrežavanja: konferenciju u Zagrebu, studijsko putovanje u Francusku i posjetu sindikatu u Sloveniji radi razmjene iskustava s drugim cestarskim sindikatima. Pokrenuti ćemo digitalnu transformaciju rada unaprjeđenjem 7 usluga za naše članove što će olakšati pristup informacijama i ostvarivanje različitih prava.

Operation_Name_English: Social plan of Split-Dalmatia County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalni plan Splitsko-dalmatinske županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of the project are the development of a county social plan - the state of current services will be determined, the needs in the provision of services will be identified in the projection of future needs of social services for the residents of the county and the implementation of education for the members of the Council and employees of the county. Activities are analysis, data processing and preparation of the plan, data collection and implementation of education for members of the council and employees of the county.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta su izrada županijskog socijalnog plana- utvrdit će se stanje trenutnih usluga, identificirat će se potrebe u pružanju usluga u projicirat će se buduće potrebe socijalnih usluga za stanovnike županije te provedba edukacija za članove Savjeta i djelatnike županije. Aktivnosti su analiza, obrada podataka te izrada plana, prikupljanje podataka i provedba edukacija za članove savjeta i djelatnike županije.

Operation_Name_English: Development of new technology for reinforcement of masonry structures with certification of construction quality
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj nove tehnologije ojačanja zidanih konstrukcija uz certificiranje kvalitete gradnje
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: SPIN consortium within RLV Zeleni Rast consists of the holder SPEGRA d.o.o., partner OIŠZ Faculty of Civil Engineering, Architecture and Geodesy and entrepreneurs ART CORE d.o.o., NET MEDIA SISTEMI d.o.o., 312 ARHITEKTONSKA RADIONICA d.o.o. and BRODOMETALURGIJA d.o.o. 1 Structure reinforcement system using FRPC and NFRPC 2 Construction quality certificate The main objective (purpose) of the project is to ensure the strengthening of the competitiveness of RLV by investing in priority niches based on cooperation on the development of innovative solutions of high added value – the system of structural reinforcement using FRPC and NFRPC along with the Construction quality certificate.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SPIN konzorcij unutar RLV Zeleni Rast čine nositelj SPEGRA d.o.o., partner OIŠZ Fakultet Građevinarstva, Arhitekture i Geodezije i poduzetnici ART CORE d.o.o., NET MEDIA SISTEMI d.o.o., 312 ARHITEKTONSKA RADIONICA d.o.o. te BRODOMETALURGIJA d.o.o. Projektom SPIN konzorcij istražuje i razvija dva inovativna rješenja za tržište koji doprinose ciljevima zelene i pametne gradnje: 1 Sustav ojačanja konstrukcija korištenjem FRPC i NFRPC 2 Certifikat kvalitete gradnje Glavni cilj (svrha) projekta je osigurati jačanje konkurentnosti RLV-a ulaganjem u prioritetne niše temeljem suradnje na razvoju inovativnih rješenja visoke dodane vrijednosti – sustav ojačanja konstrukcija korištenjem FRPC i NFRPC uz Certifikat kvalitete gradnje.

Operation_Name_English: ISO-EXO: Introduction of ISO standards for business excellence and environmental sustainability
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ISO-EXO: Uvođenje ISO standarda za poslovnu izvrsnost i ekološku održivost
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The ISO-EXO project ensures standardization of business processes, increase of product quality and strengthening of environmental responsibility Creaticon d.o.o. By certification according to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 22716, the company will ensure strict safety, hygiene and environmental standards, increase customer confidence and open the door to new markets. The target groups of the project include consumers, distributors and partners, who will benefit from safer products and more sustainable business. This step will strengthen the position of the Skintegra and Skinlick brands in the global market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt ISO-EXO osigurava standardizaciju poslovnih procesa, povećanje kvalitete proizvoda i jačanje ekološke odgovornosti Creaticon d.o.o. Certifikacijom prema ISO 9001, ISO 14001 i ISO 22716, poduzeće će osigurati stroge sigurnosne, higijenske i ekološke standarde, povećati povjerenje kupaca te otvoriti vrata novim tržištima. Ciljne skupine projekta uključuju potrošače, distributere i partnere, koji će imati koristi od sigurnijih proizvoda i održivijeg poslovanja. Ovaj iskorak osnažit će poziciju brendova Skintegra i Skinlick na globalnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Revitalisation of Mayneri Park, Lopud Island
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Revitalizacija parka Mayneri, otok Lopud
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The Mayneri Park renovation project on the island of Lopud aims to revitalize this neglected historical park, preserving its cultural and natural heritage, while allowing better use of the space by local residents and visitors. The restoration includes the restoration of existing architectural elements, while preserving authentic garden elements. Special attention will be paid to the protection and restoration of indigenous plant species, creating a harmonious landscape that reflects the original character of this unique space. By creating a comfortable and functional space, the local community will get a place for socializing, recreation and cultural events, while tourists will have the opportunity to enjoy the authentic ambience that testifies to the rich history and tradition of Lopud.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obnove parka Mayneri na otoku Lopudu ima za cilj revitalizirati ovaj zapušteni povijesni park, čuvajući njegovu kulturnu i prirodnu baštinu, istovremeno omogućiti bolje korištenje prostora lokalnom stanovništvu i posjetiteljima. Obnova obuhvaća restauraciju postojećih arhitektonskih elemenata, uz očuvanje autentičnih vrtnih elemenata. Posebna pažnja bit će posvećena zaštiti i obnovi autohtonih biljnih vrsta, stvarajući pritom skladan pejzaž koji odražava izvorni karakter ovog jedinstvenog prostora. Stvaranjem ugodnog i funkcionalnog prostora, lokalna zajednica dobit će mjesto za druženje, rekreaciju i kulturne događaje, dok će turisti imati priliku uživati u autentičnom ambijentu koji svjedoči o bogatoj povijesti i tradiciji Lopud.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of cycling and hiking trails in the village of Donji Andrijevci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističkih i pješačkih staza u naselju Donji Andrijevci
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The municipality of Donji Andrijevci wants to contribute to the creation of a more sustainable, safer and connected urban environment by building bicycle and hiking trails in the village of Donji Andrijevci. The aim of the project is to improve the infrastructure for cyclists and pedestrians in the village of Donji Andrijevci in order to improve traffic safety, the connectivity of residents with key service facilities in the municipality (health, education, local self-government, shops, etc.) and further encourage the development of tourism services. In addition, the project aims to increase mobility in the urban area of Slavonski Brod through the use of built cycling infrastructure.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Općina Donji Andrijevci želi izgradnjom biciklističkih i pješačkih staza u naselju Donji Andrijevci doprinijet stvaranju održivijeg, sigurnijeg i povezanijeg urbanog okoliša. Cilj projekta je unaprjeđenje infrastrukture za bicikliste i pješake u naselju Donji Andrijevci kako bi se poboljšala sigurnost prometa, povezanost stanovnika s ključnim uslužnim sadržajima u općini (zdravstvo, obrazovanje, lokalna samouprava, trgovine itd.) te dodatno potaknuo razvoj turističkih usluga. Osim toga, projekt ima za cilj povećati mobilnost na urbanom području Slavonski Brod kroz korištenje izgrađene biciklističke infrastrukture.

Operation_Name_English: SPIN North - Innovation to Excellence
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SPIN sjever – inovacijom do izvrsnosti
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "SPIN North - Innovation to Excellence" brings together a consortium of leading metalworking companies and academic institutions from Northern Croatia: Elektroda Zagreb d.d., Strojopromet d.o.o., Šturman Bravarska Workshop and University North. The aim of the project is to develop innovative welding materials, including non-copper wire, double sheathed electrodes and TIG MO rods. The project will improve technological processes, increase product quality and reduce the CO2 footprint. All partners bring the specific capacities, experiences and knowledge needed for successful implementation. The result will be increased competitiveness of the region, new jobs and strengthening the link between the academic and economic spheres.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "SPIN sjever – inovacijom do izvrsnosti" okuplja konzorcij vodećih metaloprerađivačkih tvrtki i akademske institucije iz Sjeverne Hrvatske: Elektroda Zagreb d.d., Strojopromet d.o.o., Šturman Bravarska Radionica i Sveučilište Sjever. Cilj projekta je razvoj inovativnih zavarivačkih materijala, uključujući nepobakrenu žicu, dvostruko oplaštene elektrode i TIG MO šipke. Projekt će unaprijediti tehnološke procese, povećati kvalitetu proizvoda i smanjiti CO2 otisak. Svi partneri donose specifične kapacitete, iskustva i znanja potrebna za uspješnu provedbu. Rezultat će biti povećana konkurentnost regije, nova radna mjesta i jačanje veze između akademske i gospodarske sfere.

Operation_Name_English: Rest with support
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Predah uz podršku
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The "Supported Breath" project provides parents with caregivers, who care for family members with autism spectrum disorder, much-needed support and rest. Due to constant care and lack of time for themselves, parents often suffer from stress and exhaustion. The project will allow them to temporarily move away from care, while children will participate in various activities and with the support of experts. This will allow parents to take care of their health and well-being, reduce stress and prevent physical and emotional burnout, and children will have the opportunity to develop their skills in a stimulating environment. The project contributes to reducing the social exclusion of parents and children they care for, while strengthening families and enabling a dignified life in the community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Predah uz podršku" pruža roditeljima njegovateljima, koji skrbe za članove obitelji s poremećajem autističnog spektra, prijeko potrebnu podršku i odmor. Zbog neprekidne brige i nedostatka vremena za sebe, roditelji često pate od stresa i iscrpljenosti. Projekt će im omogućiti da se privremeno odmaknu od skrbi, dok će djeca sudjelovati u raznim aktivnostima i uz podršku stručnjaka. Time će roditelji moći brinuti o svom zdravlju i dobrobiti, smanjiti stres i spriječiti fizičko i emocionalno izgaranje, a djeca će imati priliku razvijati svoje vještine u poticajnom okruženju. Projekt doprinosi smanjenju socijalne isključenosti roditelja i djece o kojoj skrbe, istovremeno jačajući obitelji i omogućujući dostojanstven život u zajednici.

Operation_Name_English: SOKOL Certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija tvrtke SOKOL
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With this project, the company plans to implement and certify the management system ISO 27001:2022 - Information security management system with the aim of facilitating access to the international market and increasing the competitiveness of the company Sokol d.o.o. through reaching the applicable level of an internationally recognized management system that proves the level of quality and security in the exchange of goods and services and contributes to customer confidence. The total value of the project is EUR 27,384.40. The eligible costs are EUR 22,384.40. The expected grant is EUR 12,311.42. EUR.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Društvo predmetnim projektom planira implementaciju i certificiranje sustava upravljanja ISO 27001:2022 - Sustav upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću s ciljem olakšavanja pristupa međunarodnom tržištu i povećanjem konkurentnosti društva Sokol d.o.o. kroz dostizanje primjenjive razine međunarodno priznatog sustava upravljanja kojim se dokazuje razina kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni roba i usluga te pridonosi povjerenju kupaca. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 27.384,40 EUR. Prihatljivi troškovi iznose 22.384,40 EUR. Očekivana bespovratna sredstva iznose 12.311,42. EUR.

Operation_Name_English: RECONSTRUCTION AND BUILDING OF SOUTH LUXURY - 3rd CONSTRUCTION PHASE
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: REKONSTRUKCIJA I DOGRADNJA JUŽNOG LUKOBRANA - 3.FAZA IZGRADNJE
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘RECONSTRUCTION AND BUILDING OF SOUTH LUXURY - 3rd CONSTRUCTION PHASE’ concerns an investment in the reconstruction of existing facilities with the construction of breakwater facilities and new coastal walls and pontoon piers within the protected waters of the port of Novalja – South, with the provision of 101 berths for the reception of vessels between 8 and 70 metres in length and a safe mooring of vessels throughout the year. Total eligible costs are 13,126,901.93 EUR. The total grant amounts to 13,126,901.93 EUR, of which 85% from the European Regional Development Fund and 15% from the state budget of the Republic of Croatia. The planned duration of the project is 42 months (07/2024-12/2027).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „REKONSTRUKCIJA I DOGRADNJA JUŽNOG LUKOBRANA - 3.FAZA IZGRADNJE” odnosi se na ulaganje u rekonstrukciju postojećih sadržaja sa izgradnjom lukobranskih objekata te novih obalnih zidova i pontonskih gatova unutar zaštićenog akvatorija luke Novalja – jug, s osiguranjem 101 veza za prihvat plovila duljine od 8 do 70 metara te siguran privez plovila tijekom cijele godine. Ukupno prihvatljivi troškovi iznose 13.126.901,93 EUR. Ukupna bespovratna sredstva iznose 13.126.901,93 EUR, od čega 85% sredstava iz Europskog fonda za regionalni razvoj, te 15% sredstava iz državnog proračuna RH. Planirano trajanje projekta je 42 mjeseca (07./2024.-12./2027.).

Operation_Name_English: New attire of the New Courts
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Novo ruho Novih dvora
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to preserve and revitalize cultural heritage and encourage the development of sustainable tourism and increase the attractiveness of Zaprešić as a destination by reconstructing, renovating and equipping the public tourist infrastructure of the Novi Dvori complex. The ‘New attire of Novi Dvori’ project in Zaprešić envisages the renovation and tourist valorisation of 4 cultural heritage objects entered in the Register of Cultural Goods of the Republic of Croatia (Castle, Kukuružarnik, residential-commercial building and house Marof), part of the park adjacent to the Kukuružarnik facility, an access road on which a canopy with a solar power plant will be arranged for the purposes of the Castle facility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je rekonstrukcijom, obnovom i opremanjem javne turističke infrastrukture kompleksa Novi Dvori očuvati i revitalizirati kulturnu baštinu te potaknuti razvoj održivog turizma i povećati atraktivnost Zaprešića kao destinacije. Projektom „Novo ruho Novih dvora“ u Zaprešiću predviđena je obnova i turistička valorizacija 4 objekta kulturne baštine upisana u Registar kulturnih dobara RH (Dvorac, Kukuružarnik, stambeno-gospodarska zgrada i kuća Marof), dio pripadajućeg perivoja uz objekt Kukuružarnik, pristupnu prometnicu na kojoj će biti uređena nadstrešnica sa sunčanom elektranom za potrebe objekta Dvorca.

Operation_Name_English: STEM for a green blue world
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM za zeleno plavi svijet
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of STEM for a green blue world is to strengthen the capacities of the Association Slap for the popularization of STEM with students of 5 primary schools in OBŽ and VPŽ. With the support of FAZOS, work is being done to create a SLAP coaching team in popular STEM fields that support sustainable development and adaptation to new trends in STEM education with young people. Through 240 interactive workshops, 600 students will implement the practical application of individual STEM areas, teaching them problematic thinking and finding creative solutions, especially in areas that contribute to climate change mitigation. Through 35 public events in 15 locations, STEM is further popularized among students and young people and shows their contribution to Croatia's green and digital transition.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: STEM za zeleno plavi svijet ima za cilj jačanje kapaciteta Udruge Slap za popularizaciju STEM-a s učenicima 5 osnovnih škola u OBŽ i VPŽ. Uz podršku FAZOS-a radi se na stvaranju trenerskog tima SLAP-a u popularnim područjima STEM-a koja podržavaju održivi razvoj te prilagodbi novim trendovima u STEM edukacijama s mladima. Treneri će kroz 240 interaktivnih radionica 600 učenika provesti kroz praktičnu primjenu pojedinih STEM područja, učeći ih problemskom promišljanju i iznalaženju kreativnih rješenja posebice u područjima koja doprinose ublažavanju klimatskih promjena. Kroz 35 javna događanja na 15 lokacija STEM se dodatno popularizira među učenicima i mladima i prikazuje njihov doprinos zelenoj i digitalnoj tranziciji Hrvatske.

Operation_Name_English: Bilice Firehouse
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Vatrogasni dom Bilice
Category_Label: Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The main problem that this project addresses is insufficient level of fire protection and low level of resilience to natural disasters of the Urban area of Šibenik to current and future climate challenges faced by UP Šibenik. The main objective of the project is to improve the level of fire protection of the Urban Area of Šibenik and increase the level of resilience to natural disasters, which will directly affect the safety aspects of the quality of life of the inhabitants of the Urban Area of Šibenik as well as visitors to UP Šibenik as a tourist center. The target groups of the project are: Municipality of Bilice, residents of the Municipality of Bilice, users of the polyvalent part of the firehouse.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni problem koji ovaj projekt adresira je nedovoljna razina protupožarne zaštite te niska razina otpornosti na prirodne katastrofe Urbanog područja Šibenik trenutnim i budućim klimatskim izazovima s kojima se UP Šibenik susreće. Glavni cilj projekta je unapređenje razine protupožarne zaštite Urbanog područja Šibenik te povećati razinu otpornosti na prirodne katastrofe čime će se izravno utjecati na sigurnosne aspekte kvalitete života stanovnika Urbanog područja Šibenik kao i posjetitelja UP Šibenik kao turističkog središta. Ciljne skupine projekta su: Općina Bilice, stanovnici Općine Bilice, korisnici polivalentnog dijela vatrogasnog doma.

Operation_Name_English: Help, hire, make IV happy
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomozi, zaposli, usreći IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project HELP, ENTERTAINMENT, DEVELOPMENT IV is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The target group are people over 65 and adults with disabilities who will contribute to greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in their own home and ensuring the right to live in the community. Support and support will be provided by 10 providers 34 months for 60 users from the area of the city of Prelog in food organization, household chores, personal hygiene and other everyday needs. The activities of the project are: publication of a public call, identification of users, recruitment of service providers, project management, promotion and visibility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta POMOZI, ZAPOSLI, USREĆI IV je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Ciljana skupina su osobe starije od 65 godina i odrasle osobe s invaliditetom kojima će se pridonijeti većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguranju prava na život u zajednici. Potporu i podršku pružat će 10 pružatelja 34 mj. za 60 korisnika s područja grada Preloga na poslovima organizacije prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene te druge svakodnevne potrebe. Aktivnosti projekta su: objava javnog poziva, identifikacija korisnika, zapošljavanje pružatelja usluge, vođenje projekta, promidžba i vidljivost.

Operation_Name_English: Krijesnica Jankovci kindergarten upgrade
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja dječjeg vrtića Krijesnica Jankovci
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project of upgrading the kindergarten Krijesnica Jankovci refers to the expansion of capacities and improvement of existing facilities in the kindergarten. The aim is to enable a greater number of enrolled children, encourage local development and reduce parental care when enrolling children. We believe that this is also a good incentive for young families and for reducing emigration. During the last enrolment in Kindergarten Krijesnica there was a problem of lack of vacancies, that is, there were more candidates for enrolment than the kindergarten can receive. Current capacities do not meet the needs for enrollment of nursery or kindergarten children. It is planned to build an additional space that will contain two new living rooms with a capacity for an additional 32 children.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt nadogradnje dječjeg vrtića Krijesnica Jankovci odnosi se na proširenje kapaciteta i unaprjeđenje postojećih sadržaja u vrtiću. Cilj je omogućiti veći broj upisane djece, potaknuti lokalni razvoj i smanjiti brigu roditeljima prilikom upisa djece. Smatramo kako je ovo i dobra poticajna mjera za mlade obitelji i za smanjenje iseljavanja. Prilikom posljednjih upisa u Dječji vrtić Krijesnica pojavio se problem nedostatka slobodnih mjesta, odnosno, bilo je više kandidata za upis nego što vrtić može primiti. Trenutni kapaciteti ne zadovoljavaju potrebe za upis jasličke niti vrtićke djece. Planira se izgradnja dodatnog prostora koji će sadržavati dva nova dnevna boravka s kapacitetom za dodatnih 32 djece.

Operation_Name_English: Development of a computer-aided design service for technological processes in machining
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj usluge računalno podržanog projektiranja tehnoloških procesa u strojnoj obradi
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal directly intervenes in the central problem of metalworking industry stakeholders who, due to low levels of investment in sophisticated technological systems for production processes and generally insufficient levels of implementation of Industry 4.0, are not able to take technological leadership and increase the competitiveness of their own companies. By implementing the project, the Applicant and Partners will develop a service with a high level of technological readiness and added value, which will create the preconditions for the establishment of more efficient production and the transition of the SPIN Consortium to parts of global value chains with higher added value. The target groups of the project are the employees and management of the Applicant and Partner and the employees of the Elementary School.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni prijedlog izravno intervenira u središnji problem dionika metaloprerađivače industrije koji uslijed niskih razina ulaganja u sofisticirane tehnološke sustave za proizvodne procese te generalno nedostatnih razina implementacije industrije 4.0, nisu u mogućnosti preuzeti tehnološko vodstvo te povećati konkurentnost vlastitih poduzeća. Provedbom projekta Prijavitelj i Partneri razvit će uslugu visoke razine tehnološke spremnosti i dodane vrijednosti, čime će se stvoriti preduvjeti za uspostavu efikasnije proizvodnje te prelazak SPIN Konzorcija u dijelove globalnih lanaca vrijednosti s višom dodanom vrijednosti. Ciljne skupine projekta su zaposlenici i menadžment Prijavitelja i Partnera te zaposlenici OIŠZ-a.

Operation_Name_English: InnovateStay: Research and development of an innovative system of recommendations for advanced hospitality in tourism
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: InnovateStay: Istraživanje i razvoj inovativnog sustava preporuka za napredno gostoprimstvo u turizmu
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the InnovateStay project is to exchange knowledge and technologies and implement research and development activities, develop globally innovative digital solutions for the global tourism industry for revolutionary hospitality. GENERAL OBJECTIVE and significance of the project at a higher level is the contribution to strengthening the regional economy of Adriatic Croatia and solving key social challenges and thematic goals in accordance with the S3 thematic priority area Digital products and platforms, priority niche (PN) Luxury coastal tourism within the RLV Blue Growth.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SVRHA PROJEKTA InnovateStay je razmjenom znanja i tehnologija i provedbom istraživačko razvojnih aktivnosti, razviti globalno inovativna digitalna rješenja za globalnu industriju u turizmu za revolucionarno gostoprimstvo. OPĆI CILJ i značaj projekta na višoj razini je doprinos jačanju regionalnog gospodarstva Jadranske Hrvatske i rješavanju ključnih društvenih izazova i tematskih ciljeva sukladno S3 tematskom prioritetnom području Digitalni proizvodi i platforme, prioritetnom nišom (PN) Luksuzni obalni turizam unutar RLV Plavi rast.

Operation_Name_English: Innovative material based on natural polymers
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inovativni materijal na bazi prirodnih polimera
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop a special material based on renewable raw materials of natural origin that will enable the use of state-of-the-art 3D printing technology for the production of soles for footwear. This will enable the development and production of footwear with a low negative impact on the environment, accelerate the development of new products, enable rapid prototyping, reduce the time needed to market new products and enable the design and production of products that have not been possible so far by conventional methods.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je razvoj posebnog materijala temeljenog na obnovljivim sirovinama prirodnog podrijetla koji će omogućiti korištenje najsuvremenije tehnologije 3D printa za proizvodnju đonova za obuću. Ovo će omogućiti razvoj i proizvodnju obuće s niskim negativnim utjecajem na okoliš, ubrzati razvoj novih proizvoda, omogućiti brzu izradu prototipova, smanjiti vrijeme potrebno za plasman novih proizvoda na tržište i omogućiti dizajniranje i proizvodnju proizvoda koji do sada nisu bili mogući konvencionalnim metodama.

Operation_Name_English: Specialist training of doctors of medicine of the Health Center Zagreb-Zapad - S4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Specijalističko usavršavanje doktora medicine Doma zdravlja Zagreb-Zapad - S4
Category_Label: Measures to improve the accessibility, effectiveness and resilience of healthcare systems (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will enable the specialist training of 15 doctors of medicine at the primary level and the activities of specialist-consiliar health care, which contributes to the equal and sufficient occupancy of the Public Health Service Network, the availability of health care to all citizens, ensuring health resilience to changes in the environment, better accessibility and efficiency in relation to the challenges that the health system faces on a daily basis, and the equitable distribution of medical staff. The target group are specialists who will provide training in the branches of family medicine specialization, clinical radiology, gynecology and obstetrics, physical medicine and rehabilitation, and ophthalmology and optometry.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se omogućiti specijalističko usavršavanje 15 doktora medicine na primarnoj razini te djelatnostima specijalističko-konzilijarne zdravstvene zaštite čime se doprinosi ravnomjernoj i dostatnoj popunjenosti Mreže javne zdravstvene službe, dostupnosti zdrav. zaštite svim građanima, osiguravanju otpornosti zdravstva na promjene okruženja, boljoj pristupačnosti i učinkovitosti u odnosu na izazove s kojima se zdravstveni sustav svakodnevno suočava te ravnomjernoj distribuciji medicinskog osoblja. Ciljna skupina su specijalizanti kojima će se omogućiti usavršavanje u granama specijalizacije obiteljske medicine, klinička radiologije, ginekologije i opstetricije, fizikalna medicine i rehabilitacije te oftamologije i optometrije.

Operation_Name_English: They want equality.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi jednakost
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Project activities are related to finding older people and adults with disabilities and ensuring their participation as a target group in the project, employment of people who will provide support and support services to the target group, procurement and distribution of monthly packages of household and hygiene supplies.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektne aktivnosti odnose se na pronalazak starijih osoba i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom i osiguranje njihovog sudjelovanja kao ciljne skupine u projektu, zapošljavanje osoba koje će pružati usluge podrške i potpore ciljnoj skupini, nabava i podjela mjesečnih paketa kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština.

Operation_Name_English: STEAM creators combine science and art
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEAM kreatori spajaju znanost i umjetnost
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "STEAM creators combine science and art" implemented by the Creative Academy Association Labin in cooperation with partners from academic institutions and primary schools in the area of Labin area is designed to encourage the development of practical and theoretical skills in children and young people, combining elements of STEAM. Through a series of innovative and interactive workshops, participants will have the opportunity to develop technical and creative skills, increasing their digital and technical literacy.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "STEAM kreatori spajaju znanost i umjetnost" koje provodi udruga Udruga Kreativna akademija Labin u suradnji sa partnerima iz akademske ustanove i osnovnoškolskih ustanova na području Labinštine osmišljen je kako bi potaknuo razvoj praktičnih i teorijskih vještina kod djece i mladih, kombinirajući elemente STEAM-a. Kroz niz inovativnih i interaktivnih radionica, sudionici će imati priliku razviti tehničke i kreativne vještine, povećavajući svoju digitalnu i tehničku pismenost.

Operation_Name_English: Zaželi - prevention of institutionalization in the territory of the municipality of Bogdanovci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - prevencija institucionalizacije na području općine Bogdanovci
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing care in the territory of the municipality of Bogdanovci through the provision of support services in everyday life to the elderly and persons with disabilities, which will include: Recruitment of 16 service providers for at least 6 members of the target group for the organization of food and/or assistance in performing household tasks and/or assistance in maintaining personal hygiene and/or assistance in meeting other daily needs, monitoring and control of performed services, procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem skrbi na području općine Bogdanovci kroz pružanje usluge potpore u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom, a koje će uključivati: zapošljavanje 16 pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine za organiziranje prehrane i/ili pomoć u obavljanju kućanskih poslova i/ili pomoć u održavanju osobne higijene i/ili pomoć pri zadovoljavanju drugih svakodnevnih potreba, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: EcoBloom: Sustainable packaging innovation for the cosmetics industry
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: EcoBloom: Održiva inovacija u ambalaži za kozmetičku industriju
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The EcoBloom project brings innovation and sustainability to the cosmetics industry. Creaticon d.o.o. develops recyclable packaging made of monomaterial polypropylene (PP), which preserves the quality of the product and reduces the environmental footprint. In cooperation with the Teaching Institute of Public Health Dr Andrija Štampar, safety and compatibility tests of new packaging are being carried out. This project combines cutting-edge technology and environmental care, responding to the growing demands for sustainable solutions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt EcoBloom donosi inovaciju i održivost u kozmetičku industriju. Creaticon d.o.o. razvija reciklabilnu ambalažu od monomaterijalnog polipropilena (PP), koja čuva kvalitetu proizvoda i smanjuje ekološki otisak. U suradnji s Nastavnim zavodom za javno zdravstvo dr. Andrija Štampar provode se ispitivanja sigurnosti i kompatibilnosti nove ambalaže. Ovaj projekt spaja vrhunsku tehnologiju i brigu za okoliš, odgovarajući na rastuće zahtjeve za održivim rješenjima.

Operation_Name_English: All Together 4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Svi Zajedno 4
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The goal is manifested in improving the quality of life of members of the target group, i.e. people from disadvantaged backgrounds, through increasing the level of social inclusion and achieving institutionalization prevention in parallel. The main activity will employ 40 service providers with a duration of 25 months for the purpose of providing support and support services in daily life for a total of 240 target group members, i.e. older people and people with disabilities.
