A package of basic household and hygiene items will be distributed to each member of the target group on a monthly basis, and the project will cover visibility segments, project management and control of performed services over a total duration of 30 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj se manifestira u unaprjeđenju kvalitete života pripadnika ciljne skupine odnosno osoba u nepovoljnom položaju, kroz povećanje razine socijalne uključenosti te usporednim postizanjem prevencije institucionalizacije. Provedbom glavne aktivnosti zaposlit će se 40 pružatelja usluga u trajanju od 25 mjeseci za potrebe pružanja usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za ukupno 240 pripadnika ciljne skupine odnosno starije osobe i osobe s invaliditetom. Svakom pripadniku ciljane skupine na mjesečnoj razini će biti podijeljen paket osnovnih kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština, a projektom će se kroz ukupno trajanje od 30 mjeseci obuhvatiti segmenti vidljivost, upravljanje projektom te kontrola izvršenih usluga.

Operation_Name_English: Generations at the service of solidarity
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Generacije u službi solidarnosti
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective of the project entitled "Generations in the service of solidarity" is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care over a period of 33 months for a minimum of 120 beneficiaries. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. Activities in the project are employment of 20 service providers that include organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene of users and other everyday needs. Activities within the project include procurement and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies, monitoring and control of performed services, communication and conductivity, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta pod nazivom "Generacije u službi solidarnosti" je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz period od 33 mjeseca za minimalno 120 korisnika. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnosti u projektu su zapošljavanje 20 pružatelja usluge koji uključuju organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene korisnika te ostale svakodnevne potrebe. Aktivnosti u sklopu projekta su i nabava i podjela kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, komunikacija i vodljivost te upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Desire-strength of the community
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi-snaga zajednice
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will be implemented in the municipality of Okučani for a period of 36 months. The project includes a target group, i.e. over 65 years of age and people with disabilities over 18 years of age, 150 people from the Okučani municipality and the employment of 25 service providers who will provide support and support in the home for a period of 33 months during the project implementation period. The implementation of the project will contribute to increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt će se provoditi na području općine Okučani u razdoblju od 36 mjeseci. Projekt uključuje ciljanu skupinu odnosno starije od 65 godina i osobe s invaliditetom starije od 18 godina, 150 osoba s područja općine Okučani te zapošljavanje 25 osoba pružatelja usluge koje će tijekom razdoblja provedbe projekta pružati uslugu potpore i podrške u kući kroz razdoblje od 33 mjeseca. Provedbom projekta pridonijet će se povećanju socijalne uključenosti i prevenciji institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi.

Operation_Name_English: Developmental testing of DELTAsort sorting robots
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvojna ispitivanja robota za sortiranje DELTAsort
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes comprehensive testing of industrial robot for waste sorting by the company DELTAsort Robotics d.o.o. by the Končar Institute, as the leading Croatian center for research, testing and certification. Through testing in accredited laboratories, we want to validate that the robot meets EU standards (EN 61010-1, IEC 61000-6-4, IK08). Strategic partnership with the accredited institute will accelerate product placement on the European Union markets for DELTAsort Robotics d.o.o.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća sveobuhvatno testiranje industrijskog robota za sortiranje otpada tvrtke DELTAsort Robotics d.o.o. od strane Končar Instituta, kao vodećeg hrvatskog centra za istraživanje, ispitivanje i certifikaciju. Kroz ispitivanja u akreditiranim laboratorijima, želi se validirati da robot zadovoljava EU standarde (EN 61010-1, IEC 61000-6-4, IK08). Strateško partnerstvo s akreditiranim institutom će ubrzati plasman proizvoda na tržišta Europske Unije za DELTAsort Robotics d.o.o.

Operation_Name_English: No to gender-based violence
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: NE rodno utemeljenom nasilju
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to improve the system of prevention and protection of victims of gender-based violence. In order to achieve the specific objectives of strengthening the system of prevention and protection of victims of gender-based violence and raising the level of knowledge and dissemination of knowledge of professionals who work and/or come into contact with victims about gender-based violence, activities will be carried out to prepare and implement a media campaign, upgrade the MROSP website, print and disseminate strategic and informative materials, prepare a needs assessment and conditions necessary for the establishment of a network of specialized services, ensure further support to the work of the NPC, develop and implement trainings for professionals and persons working on gender-based violence and provide assistance to victims.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je unaprjeđenje sustava prevencije i zaštite žrtava rodno utemeljenog nasilja. Radi ostvarenja specifičnih ciljeva jačanja sustava prevencije i zaštite žrtava rodno utemeljenog nasilja te podizanje razine znanja i širenja spoznaja stručnjaka koji rade i/ili dolaze u kontakt sa žrtvama o rodno utemeljenom nasilju provest će se aktivnosti pripreme i provedbe medijske kampanje, nadogradnje web stranice MROSP-a, tiska i diseminacije strateških i informativnih materijala, izrade procjene potreba i uvjeta potrebnih za uspostavu mreže specijaliziranih servisa, osiguravanja daljnje potpore radu NPC-a, izrade i provedbe edukacija za stručnjake i osobe koje rade na pitanjima rodno utemeljenog nasilja i pružanja pomoći žrtvama.

Operation_Name_English: Marmoris Business System
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Poslovni sustav Marmoris
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The Clean'N'Green project of Marmoris d.o.o. is focused on the digitalisation of the cleaning sector through the development of the Marmoris Business System, an innovative ERP solution with integrated artificial intelligence. The system enables real-time monitoring of work orders, administration automation, AI analytics for resource optimization and environmentally friendly business. Target groups are companies specialized in cleaning business facilities, marinas and nautical vessels. The project contributes to digital transformation and sustainability, increasing the efficiency and competitiveness of users in the market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Clean'N'Green poduzeća Marmoris d.o.o. usmjeren je na digitalizaciju sektora čišćenja kroz razvoj Poslovnog sustava Marmoris, inovativnog ERP rješenja s integriranom umjetnom inteligencijom. Sustav omogućuje praćenje radnih naloga u stvarnom vremenu, automatizaciju administracije, AI analitiku za optimizaciju resursa i ekološki prihvatljivo poslovanje. Ciljne skupine su poduzeća specijalizirana za čišćenje poslovnih objekata, marina i nautičkih plovila. Projekt doprinosi digitalnoj transformaciji i održivosti, povećavajući učinkovitost i konkurentnost korisnika na tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Improving the business of SUPRA INFORMATIKA d.o.o. by introducing ISO 20000-1 certificate
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje poslovanja tvrtke SUPRA INFORMATIKA d.o.o. uvođenjem ISO 20000-1 certifikata
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The ISO 20000-1:2018 certification project for Supra Informatika d.o.o. aims to increase the international competitiveness of the company through standardization and improvement of IT service management. Certification according to this standard will ensure compliance with international standards, increase the quality and security of IT services and enable easier participation in the EU and global tenders. Expected results include optimizing operational processes, increasing export revenues by more than 30% and strengthening customer confidence. The implementation of the standard is crucial for the transition from product sales to the IT service delivery model (SaaS), ensuring long-term growth and business sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt certifikacije ISO 20000-1:2018 za Supra Informatiku d.o.o. ima za cilj povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke kroz standardizaciju i unaprjeđenje upravljanja IT uslugama. Certifikacijom prema ovoj normi osigurat će se sukladnost s međunarodnim standardima, povećati kvaliteta i sigurnost IT usluga te omogućiti lakše sudjelovanje na EU i globalnim natječajima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju optimizaciju operativnih procesa, povećanje prihoda od izvoza za više od 30% te jačanje povjerenja klijenata. Implementacija standarda ključna je za prijelaz s prodaje proizvoda na model pružanja IT usluga (SaaS), čime se osigurava dugoročni rast i održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Co-financing the development of the Gospić Urban Area Development Strategy for the period 2021-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sufinanciranje izrade Strategije razvoja Urbanog područja Gospić za razdoblje 2021.-2027. godine
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The territorial scope of the urban area refers to the City of Gospić as the center of the urban area and the Municipality of Perušić and Udbina. The preparation and implementation of the Gospić Urban Development Strategy for the period 2021-2027 is the basis for the use of funds from the ITU mechanism, which contains selected strategic projects whose identification and maturity is crucial for the award of grants through integrated territorial investments. By co-financing the development of SRUP, the urban area of Gospić has the prerequisites for successfully ensuring the implementation of the ITU mechanism and the use of funds for the implementation of strategic projects.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Teritorijalni obuhvat urbanog područja odnosi se na Grad Gospić kao središte urbanog područja te Općine Perušić i Udbina. Priprema i provedba Strategije razvoja Urbanog područja Gospić za razdoblje 2021.-2027. temelj je za korištenje sredstava iz ITU mehanizma u kojoj se nalaze odabrani strateški projekti čija identifikacija i zrelost je ključna za dodjelu bespovratnih sredstava putem integriranih teritorijalnih ulaganja. Sufinanciranjem izrade SRUP-a Urbano područje Gospić ima preduvjete za uspješno osiguravanje provedbe ITU mehanizma i korištenje sredstava za provedbu strateških projekata.

Operation_Name_English: "Together for the future"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: " Zajedno za budućnost"
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will support the inclusion of 43 students with disabilities in eight primary and four secondary schools founded by LSZ, by hiring 43 teaching assistants/professional communication mediators, in order to ensure the conditions for improving educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning of students with disabilities. The target group of the project is 43 students with developmental disabilities involved in primary or secondary school programs in primary and secondary educational institutions that LSZ is the founder of.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se pružiti potpora uključivanju 43 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju, u osam osnovnih i četiri srednje škole kojima je osnivač LSŽ, angažiranjem 43 pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika, kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje učenika s teškoćama. Ciljna skupina projekta su 43 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju uključenih u osnovnoškolske ili srednjoškolske programe u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama kojima je LSŽ osnivač.

Operation_Name_English: I want a good life II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Želim dobar život II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will provide support and support services in everyday life for OSI and elderly people from the Koprivnica-Križevci County. OSI and the elderly are members of vulnerable groups who need help from another person. The provision of this service will prevent institutionalisation, improve the quality of life and preserve the dignity of OSI and the elderly.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se pružiti usluga potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za OSI i starije osobe s područja Koprivničko-križevačke županije. OSI i starije osobe pripadnici su ranjivih skupina kojima je potrebna pomoć druge osobe. Pružanjem navedene usluge spriječit će se institucionalizacija, poboljšati kvaliteta života i očuvati dostojanstvo OSI i starijih osoba.

Operation_Name_English: Development and improvement of the firefighting system on the islands: Kaprije, Zlarin and Žirje
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj i unaprjeđenje sustava vatrogastva na otocima: Kapriju, Zlarinu i Žirju
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria|Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: With the aim of increasing the operational readiness of firefighters as the core operational force of the civil protection system, the project includes the following activities: completion of works on the construction of the building of the Volunteer Fire Brigade Žirje, equipping the building with the necessary furniture, installation of a photovoltaic power plant on the roof of the DVD Žirja building, construction of fire roads on the islands of Kaprije, Zlarin and Žirje, installation of information and education panels along fire roads, equipping the units of voluntary fire brigades with 2 fire trucks-tanks, implementation of promotion and visibility activities of the project and implementation of management activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Sa ciljem postizanja povećanja operativne spremnosti vatrogasaca kao temeljne operativne snage sustava civilne zaštite, projekt uključuje sljedeće aktivnosti: završetak radova na izgradnji zgrade Dobrovoljnog vatrogasnog društva Žirje, opremanje zgrade potrebnim namještajem, postavljanje fotonaponske elektrane na krovu zgrade DVD Žirja, izgradnju protupožarnih puteva na otocima Kapriju, Zlarinu i Žirju, postavljanje informativno-edukacijskih ploča uz protupožarne puteve, opremanje postrojbi dobrovoljnih vatrogasnih društava s 2 vatrogasna vozila-cisterne, provedbu aktivnosti promidžbe i vidljivosti projekta i provedbu aktivnosti upravljanja.

Operation_Name_English: Equal opportunities
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jednake mogućnosti
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal "Equal Opportunities" lasts 12 months and aims to increase the social inclusion and integration of 165 students with disabilities in primary and secondary educational institutions through providing support to the education of students with disabilities through 152 teaching assistants/professional communication mediators for the target group, students with disabilities, for the school year 2023/2024.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni prijedlog "Jednake mogućnosti" traje 12 mjeseci, a ima za cilj povećanje socijalne uključenosti i integracije 165 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama kroz pružanje podrške obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz 152 pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnog komunikacijskog posrednika za ciljanu skupinu, učenike s teškoćama u razvoju, za školsku godinu 2023./2024.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of Veridian Healthstream by certifying the management system according to ISO 30301:2019, ISO 42001:2023, ISO 20000-1:2018 and ISO 14001:2015
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti poduzeća Veridian Healthstream certifikacijom sustava upravljanja prema ISO 30301:2019, ISO 42001:2023, ISO 20000-1:2018 i ISO 14001:2015
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of Veridian Healthstream by certifying the management system according to ISO 14001:2015, ISO 20000-1:2018, ISO 30301:2019 and ISO 42001:2023. The purpose is to standardise business processes and establish an environmental management system, records, artificial intelligence and information technologies to ensure consistent service quality, competitive advantage and compliance with international standards. Expected results include increased customer confidence, easier access to foreign markets and increased export revenues. By implementing the certificate, Veridian Healthstream will optimize processes, reduce risks and ensure recognition as a reliable and safe partner in the international market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti Veridian Healthstreama certifikacijom sustava upravljanja prema ISO 14001:2015, ISO 20000-1:2018, ISO 30301:2019 i ISO 42001:2023. Svrha je standardizacija poslovnih procesa i uspostava sustava upravljanja okolišem, zapisima, umjetnom inteligencijom i informacijskim tehnologijama kako bi se osigurala dosljedna kvaliteta usluga, konkurentska prednost i usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje povjerenja klijenata, olakšan pristup inozemnim tržištima i rast prihoda od izvoza. Implementacijom certifikata Veridian Healthstream će optimizirati procese, smanjiti rizike i osigurati prepoznatljivost kao pouzdan i siguran partner na međunarodnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Innovation voucher Pinky-s d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inovacijski vaučer Pinky-s d.o.o.
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Pinky-s d.o.o. is a small company active in the concrete industry and is engaged in the production of concrete additives and additives, automation of concrete plants and automation of concrete production processes and concrete products. The aim of this project is the research and development of the innovative additive for concrete HYDROPHOBE E, in cooperation with the Faculty of Chemical Engineering and Technology. Currently, Pinky-s d.o.o. procures an emulsion of silane from the market, consisting of 50% water, which increases transport costs and limits the possibilities of adjusting the formulation of additives. By developing its own silane emulsion, the company plans to reduce procurement and transport costs and improve the properties of concrete additives. HYDROPHOBE E will be commercialised on the market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Pinky-s d.o.o. je malo poduzeće koje djeluje u industriji betona te se bavi proizvodnjom dodataka i aditiva za beton, automatizacijom betonara te automatizacijom proizvodnih procesa betona i betonskih proizvoda. Cilj predmetnog projekta je istraživanje i razvoj inovativnog aditiva za beton HYDROPHOBE E, u suradnji s Fakultetom kemijskog inženjerstva i tehnologije. Trenutno, Pinky-s d.o.o. nabavlja emulziju silana s tržišta, koja se sastoji od 50% vode, što povećava troškove transporta i ograničava mogućnosti prilagodbe formulacije aditiva. Razvojem vlastite emulzije silana, poduzeće planira smanjiti troškove nabave i transporta te poboljšati svojstva aditiva za beton. Proizvod HYDROPHOBE E će se komercijalizirati na tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Cycling and hiking trail in Božo Huzanića Street
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Biciklističko-pješačka staza u Ulici Bože Huzanića
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Bicycle-pedestrian path in Božo Huzanića Street’ will build and equip a total of 938 metres of pedestrian-cycling path in the part of Huzanićeva Street from the junction to the eastern overpass to house number 114. Successful implementation will ensure the spatially functional integration of pedestrian-cycling traffic and the upgrading of cycling infrastructure, as well as the connection with public transport sections. The project therefore contributes to better connectivity of routes used for daily migration, the extension of existing cycling routes, increasing the safety of cyclists, but also other road users, and reducing the negative impact on the environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Biciklističko-pješačka staza u Ulici Bože Huzanića“ će se izgraditi i opremiti ukupno 938 metra pješačko-biciklističke staze u dijelu Huzanićeve ulice od spoja na istočni nadvožnjak do kućnog broja 114. Uspješnom provedbom osigurat će se prostorno funkcionalna integracija pješačko-biciklističkog prometa i nadovezivanje biciklističke infrastrukture, kao i povezivanje s dionicama kojima prometuje javni prijevoz. Projekt, stoga doprinosi boljoj povezanosti linijama koje služe za dnevne migracije, proširenju postojećih biciklističkih ruta, povećanju sigurnosti biciklista, ali i ostalih sudionika u prometu, te smanjenju negativnog utjecaja na okoliš.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing competitiveness by implementing ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 - TRI M d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti implementacijom sustava ISO 9001 i ISO 27001 - TRI M d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Increasing competitiveness by implementing ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 - TRI M d.o.o." is aimed at introducing and certifying quality management systems (ISO 9001:2015) and information security management systems (ISO/IEC 27001:2022). By implementing these standards, TRI M will ensure a higher level of quality of IT and security solutions, increase data protection and strengthen market position and competitiveness, especially in the international market. With the implementation of the project, the company predicts an increase in sales revenue by 16% and an increase in exports by 35% by 2028.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Povećanje konkurentnosti implementacijom sustava ISO 9001 i ISO 27001 - TRI M d.o.o." usmjeren je na uvođenje i certificiranje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom (ISO 9001:2015) i sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću (ISO/IEC 27001:2022). Implementacijom ovih standarda, tvrtka TRI M osigurat će višu razinu kvalitete IT i sigurnosnih rješenja, povećati zaštitu podataka te ojačati tržišnu poziciju i konkurentnost, posebno na međunarodnom tržištu. Provedbom projekta tvrtka predviđa povećanje prihoda od prodaje za 16% i povećanje izvoza za 35% do 2028. godine.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - Municipality of Bilje
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - Općina Bilje
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective is to participate in increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care in the local community. The specific objective is to provide support and support services to older people and people with disabilities directly in their homes. Main activities – provision of support and support services for 33 months for at least 180 target group members, inclusion and recruitment of 30 service providers, procurement and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies packages, communication and visibility, project management and administration, and monitoring and control of services provided. Implementation is 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj je sudjelovanje u povećanju socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi u lokalnoj zajednici. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom neposredno u njihovim domovima. Glavne aktivnosti – pružanje usluge potpore i podrške na 33 mjeseca za najmanje 180 pripadnika ciljne skupine, uključivanje i zapošljavanje 30 osoba pružatelja usluge, nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija te praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga. Provedba je 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading the city port of Sali on Dugi otok - Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja gradske luke Sali na Dugom otoku - Faza II
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the project ‘Upgrading the city port of Sali on Dugi otok’ is to increase the safety of maritime traffic in the port of Sali, to provide a year-round transport service and to improve the connectivity of Dugi otok with the mainland. The implementation of the project has a positive impact on improving the accessibility of Dugi otok for its inhabitants. The total value of the project (phase I and II) is 10,094,656,72 EUR. The total value of phase II of the project is 484,865,53 EUR. The estimated duration of the project (phase I and II) is 45 months, of which phase II refers to 9 months needed to complete all planned activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta „Dogradnja gradske luke Sali na Dugom otoku“ je povećanje sigurnosti pomorskog prometa u luci Sali, osiguranje usluge prijevoza tijekom cijele godine te bolja povezanost Dugog otoka s kopnom. Provedba projekta pozitivno utječe na poboljšanje dostupnosti Dugog otoka za njegove stanovnike. Ukupna vrijednost projekta (faza I i II) iznosi 10.094.656,72 EUR. Ukupna vrijednost faze II projekta iznosi 484.865,53 EUR. Predviđeno trajanje projekta (faza I i II) je 45 mjeseci, od čega se na fazu II odnosi 9 mjeseci potrebnih za dovršenje svih planiranih aktivnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the capacity of the Accelerator for a Sustainable Society in STEM – Sports Lifestyle and Environmental Conservation
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje kapaciteta Akceleratora za održivo društvo u STEM području – sportski način života i očuvanje okoliša
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: In the Republic of Croatia, only 1% of the associations focus their activities on the popularization of science. The survey among 7,890 young people (10-18 years) showed an average level of bio-acceptance below 50%, low interest in ecology and sustainable development, and low interest in scientific and technological careers. The aim of this project is to strengthen the capacities of the Accelerator for a Sustainable Society in promoting STEM through a sports lifestyle and environmental preservation. Partners are the Polytechnic of Međimurje in Čakovec, Jabukovac - Zagreb Primary School, Petar Preradović Primary School and DV Sunčeko. The target group are members of the association and employees of partner schools and kindergartens that promote STEM areas. The project lasts for 24 months, during which the representatives of the partners will attend educations and then conduct workshops for children.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: U RH samo 1% udruga usmjerava aktivnosti na popularizaciju znanosti. Istraživanje među 7890 mladih (10-18 godina) pokazalo je prosječnu usvojenost bioloških znanja ispod 50%, slab interes za ekologiju i održivi razvoj te nizak interes za znanstvene i tehnološke karijere. Cilj ovog projekta je ojačati kapacitete Akceleratora za održivo društvo u promociji STEM-a kroz sportski način života i očuvanje okoliša. Partneri su Međimursko veleučilište u Čakovcu, OŠ Jabukovac - Zagreb, OŠ Petra Preradovića i DV Sunčeko. Ciljna skupina su članovi udruge i zaposlenici partnerskih škola i vrtića koji promoviraju STEM područja. Projekt traje 24 mjeseca prilikom kojeg će predstavnici partnera pohađat edukacije i zatim provoditi radionice za djecu.

Operation_Name_English: Valpovo - Belišće Water Supply and Drainage Project - PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Projekt vodoopskrbe i odvodnje Valpovo – Belišće - FAZA 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of this project application is the financing of the project from the funds of the PKK (2021-2027). The purpose of the project is to comply with the UWWTD for the agglomerations of Belišće, Petrijevci, Koška and Gat. Objectives of the project: The main objective of the project is to ensure the collection and treatment of wastewater in the area of the agglomerations of Belišće, Petrijevci, Koška and Gat and to ensure quality water supply while ensuring the conservation of water resources. Below is a list of settlements included in the public drainage system.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet ove projektne prijave je financiranje projekta iz sredstava PKK (2021-2027). Svrha projekta je usklađivanje s Direktivom o odvodnji i pročišćavanju komunalnih otpadnih voda za aglomeracije Belišće, Petrijevci, Koška i Gat. Ciljevi projekta: Osnovni cilj projekta je osigurati prikupljanje i pročišćavanje otpadnih voda na području aglomeracija Belišće, Petrijevci, Koška i Gat te osigurati kvalitetnu vodoopskrbu uz osiguranje očuvanja vodnih resursa. U nastavku se daje popis naselja uključenih u sustav javne odvodnje.

Operation_Name_English: Tales from STEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Priče iz STEM-a
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project Stories from STEM will improve the capacities of the associations Nansen Dialogue Center and STEAM Center for the popularization of STEM among children in partnership with the Faculty of Medicine in Osijek and kindergartens (Children's kindergarten Osijek, Kindergarten Zvončić Čepin, Kindergarten Radost Darda and Kindergarten Snjeguljica). During the 36 months of the project, 1170 STEM workshops will be conducted for a minimum of 900 children and 36 scientific-popular events in the Osijek-Baranja County. STEM workshops will be aimed at children from 4 to 10 years of age and will be based on the topic of human health. A better understanding of STEM concepts will be achieved by using the storytelling method.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Priče iz STEM-a unaprijedit će se kapaciteti udruga Nansen dijalog centar i STEAM centar za popularizaciju STEM-a među djecom u partnerstvu s Medicinskim fakultetom u Osijeku te dječjim vrtićima (Dječji vrtić Osijek, Dječji vrtić Zvončić Čepin, Dječji vrtić Radost Darda i Dječji vrtić Snjeguljica). Kroz 36 mjeseci trajanja projekta provesti će se 1170 STEM radionica za minimalno 900 djece te 36 znanstveno-popularnih događaja na području Osječko-baranjske županije. STEM radionice će biti namijenjene djeci od 4 do 10 godina, a temeljit će se na temi ljudskog zdravlja. Bolje razumijevanje STEM koncepata postići će se korištenjem metode pripovijedanja (storytelling).

Operation_Name_English: RailSenseX
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: RailSenseX
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to explore and develop 2 products intended for monitoring the condition and detection of failures of old track-side vehicles that form an essential part of rail freight transport, which is characterized by a low level of reliability, availability, maintenance capabilities and safety. Innovation has the disruptive potential to completely redefine how the process of maintenance, repair and overhaul of trackside vehicles is carried out and become an inevitable (mandatory) piece of equipment for their modernisation. The application of the product will enable the increase of reliability and exploitation and utilization rates of track-side vehicles in the transport of goods, thus adding value to the owners of goods, track-side vehicles, but also to the operators of infrastructure.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt za cilj ima istražiti i razviti 2 proizvoda namijenjena praćenju stanja i detekciji kvarova starih pružnih vozila koja čine bitan dio željezničkog transporta robe, koje karakterizira niska razina pouzdanosti, dostupnosti, mogućnosti održavanja i sigurnosti. Inovacije imaju disruptivan potencijal za cjelovito redefiniranje načina na koji se provodi proces održavanja, popravaka i remonta pružnih vozila te postati neizbježan (obvezan) komad opreme za njihovu modernizaciju. Primjenom proizvoda omogućit će se povećanje pouzdanosti te stopa eksploatacije i utilizacije pružnih vozila u transportu roba, tako dodati vrijednost vlasnicima robe, pružnih vozila, ali i operaterima infrastrukture.

Operation_Name_English: Wish for Vrpolje IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi za Vrpolje IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project Zaželi Vrpolje IV will provide support and support to 90 members of the target group, which will contribute to increasing social inclusion and quality of life of elderly and disadvantaged people in the territory of the municipality of Vrpolje. The activities to be carried out during the project are the provision of support and support services with the distribution of packages of supplies (out of a minimum of 5 mandatory products), the purchase of supplies, monitoring and control of the services performed, the implementation of communication and visibility measures, and project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Zaželi Vrpolje IV bit će pružena potpora i podrška za 90 pripadnika ciljane skupine što će doprinijeti povećanju socijalne uključenosti i kvalitete života starijih osoba i osoba u nepovoljnom položaju na području općine Vrpolje. Aktivnosti koje će se provoditi tijekom projekta su pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz podjelu paketa potrepština (od minimalno 5 obaveznih proizvoda), nabava potrepština, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, provedba mjera za komunikaciju i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Digital platform "eVisitBB"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Digitalna platforma "eVisitBB"
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Development of a joint digital platform eVisitBB for the purpose of tourism promotion of the Bilogora and Bjelovar region, which will produce a digital platform for the promotion of continental tourism of the Bjelovar-Bilogora region with the technological concept of the proposed solution, a prototype and testing of the final product, all with the support of local experts, developers and public authorities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Izrada zajedničke digitalne platforme eVisitBB za potrebe turističke promocije regije Bilogore i Bjelovara kojom će se uz tehnološki koncept predloženog rješenja, izrađen prototip i testiranje finalnog proizvoda, a sve uz podršku lokalnih stručnjaka, programera i javne vlasti, producirati digitalna platforma za promociju kontinentalnog turizma Bjelovarsko-bilogorske regije.

Operation_Name_English: Teaching assistants/professional communication mediators in support of inclusive education, phase VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoćnici u nastavi/stručni komunikacijski posrednici kao potpora inkluzivnom obrazovanju, faza VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the Project is to support the inclusion of students with developmental difficulties, with the support of teaching assistants and professional communication mediators, in appropriate education programs of primary and secondary school institutions of the City of Zagreb with the aim of achieving a more successful socialization of students with TUR and improving the quality and success of their emotional functioning and participation in the educational process. For the successful realization of the goal, the following main activities of the project will be carried out: • Implementation of the selection process for PUN/CPC candidates for students with disabilities, • Work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators, • Communication and visibility, and • Project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj Projekta jest pružiti podršku uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju, uz potporu pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika, u primjerene programe odgoja i obrazovanja osnovnoškolskih i srednjoškolskih ustanova Grada Zagreba s ciljem ostvarivanja uspješnije socijalizacije učenika s TUR te unapređenja kvalitete i uspješnosti njihovog emocionalnog funkcioniranja i sudjelovanja u odgojno-obrazovnom procesu. Za uspješnu realizaciju cilja, provest će se sljedeće glavne aktivnosti projekta: • provedba postupka selekcije kandidata za PUN/SKP-ove učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju, • rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika, • komunikacija i vidljivost te • upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: FAROF - interpretation of the cultural heritage of the pythomic region
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: FAROF - interpretacija kulturne baštine pitomačkog kraja
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will reconstruct and equip the old building of the parish court with the aim of interpreting the tangible and intangible cultural heritage of the tame area. In the envisaged period of 33 months, an Interpretation Centre will be created in accordance with the museological conception and the performance elaboration of interpretation contents and elements for the exhibition, in which visitors will be able to experience the material and intangible cultural heritage of the Pitomac region in a modern way. The purpose of the project is to preserve tradition, increase accessibility and participation of all inhabitants of the municipality of Pitomača and beyond in cultural life, especially members of vulnerable groups. The project will implement 4 activities, the total value of which is 3,093,582,72 euros.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se rekonstruirati i opremiti stara zgrada župnog dvora s ciljem interpretacije materijalne i nematerijalne kulturne baštine pitomačkog kraja. U predviđenom vremenskom periodu u trajanju od 33 mjeseca stvoriti će se Interpretacijski centar sukladno izrađenoj muzeološkoj koncepciji i izvedbenoj razradi interpretacijskih sadržaja i elemenata za postav u kojem će posjetitelji na moderan način moći doživjeti materijalnu i nematerijalnu kulturnu baštinu pitomačkog kraja. Svrha projekta je očuvanje tradicije, povećanje pristupačnosti i participacije svih stanovnika općine Pitomača i šire u kulturnom životu, a osobito pripadnika ranjivih skupina. Projektom će se provesti 4 aktivnosti, a čija ukupna vrijednost iznosi 3.093.582,72 eura.

Operation_Name_English: STEMpo - Community rhythm: Digital competences for human development
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEMpo – Ritam zajednice: Digitalne kompetencije za humani razvoj
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: STEMpo - Community Rhythm: Digital Competences for Human Development" is aimed at strengthening the capacity of applicants in order to increase interest in STEM fields, strengthen ICT, digital competences and encourage active participation of students and the community in STEM activities for community development, solidarity, inclusion and sustainable development, through an interdisciplinary approach and cooperation with academia and schools. The project includes 25 trainings/study visits/mentoring of DKolektiv employees, the organization of 120 workshops and the promotion of STEM through 12 events per year for 300 students, which will allow students to effectively use technology to solve problems and create digital content that promotes community development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "STEMpo – Ritam zajednice: Digitalne kompetencije za humani razvoj" usmjeren je na jačanje kapaciteta prijavitelja u svrhu povećanja interesa za STEM područja, osnaživanje IKT, digitalnih kompetencija te poticanja aktivnog sudjelovanja učenika i zajednice u STEM aktivnostima za razvoj zajednice, solidarnosti, inkluzije i održivog razvoja, a kroz interdisciplinarni pristup i suradnju s akademskom zajednicom i školama. Projekt uključuje 25 edukacija/studijskih posjeta/mentoriranja zaposlenika DKolektiva, organizaciju 120 radionica i promociju STEM-a kroz 12 događaja godišnje za 300 učenika, što će omogućiti učenicima da učinkovito koriste tehnologiju za rješavanje problema i stvaranje digitalnih sadržaja koji promiču razvoj zajednice.

Operation_Name_English: Digitization of the process of personal conditions of citizens
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Digitalizacija procesa osobnih stanja građana
Category_Label: Government ICT solutions, e-services, applications
NUTS3_Label: Krapinsko-zagorska županija|Brodsko-posavska županija|Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija|Virovitičko-podravska županija|Požeško-slavonska županija|Koprivničko-križevačka županija|Međimurska županija|Bjelovarsko-bilogorska županija|Šibensko-kninska županija|Karlovačka županija|Sisačko-moslavačka županija|Istarska županija|Zagrebačka županija|Varaždinska županija|Osječko-baranjska županija|Vukovarsko-srijemska županija|Zadarska županija|Primorsko-goranska županija|Grad Zagreb|Ličko-senjska županija|Split-Dalmatia County
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is data structuring and reengineering of the information system in which the state registers, life partnership register and citizenship records are currently kept in order to improve interoperability and the development of new e-services (e-Death registration, e-Change of name and return to surname before marriage, i.e. life partnership), with the purpose of modernizing the judicial system and administrative relief for citizens.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je strukturiranje podataka i reinženjering informacijskog sustava u kojem se trenutno vode državne matice, registar životnog partnerstva i evidencija o državljanstvu radi unapređenja interoperabilnosti i razvoja novih e-usluga (e-Prijava smrti, e-Promjena osobnog imena i vraćanje na prezime prije sklapanja braka, odnosno životnog partnerstva), a u svrhu modernizacije pravosudnog sustava i administrativnog rasterećenja građana.

Operation_Name_English: SOCIAL INTENTION BUILDING - CHILD'S GARDEN (RECONSTRUKATION)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: GRAĐEVINA DRUŠTVENE NAMJENE – DJEČJI VRTIĆ (REKONSTRUKCIJA)
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project will reconstruct and convert the business building into a social building. Preschool content is provided in the building, that is, the regional department of the kindergarten. The aim of the project is to increase the availability of early childhood education and care, in the area of the City of Imotski, and this will be achieved by providing new 40 places for kindergarten and preschool children. The infrastructure project will include the reconstruction and equipping of kindergarten units with accompanying rooms, wardrobe and sanitary facilities on two floors (ground floor and first floor) for two kindergarten groups. The planned services of 10-hour kindergarten and preschool education are in full scope, which will result in the recruitment of 6 new employees.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se izvršiti rekonstrukcija i prenamjena poslovne građevine u građevinu društvene namjene. U građevini je predviđen predškolski sadržaj, odnosno, područni odjel dječjeg vrtića. Cilj projekta je povećavanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja, na području Grada Imotskog, a to će se postići osiguravanjem novih 40 mjesta za djecu vrtićkog i predškolskog uzrasta. Infrastrukturni zahvat će uključivati rekonstrukciju i opremanje vrtićkih jedinica s pratećim prostorijama, garderobom i sanitarijama na dvije etaže (prizemlje i prvi kat) za dvije vrtićke skupine. Planirane su usluge 10-satnog vrtićkog i predškolskog odgoja u punom opsegu što će rezultirati zapošljavanjem 6 novih djelatnika.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of MAG Sistem d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti tvrtke MAG Sistem d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure access to new markets, increase exports and optimize business processes of MAG Sistem d.o.o. The project addresses, through certification, the need to increase competitiveness and align business with international standards.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osigurati pristup novim tržištima, povećati izvoz i optimizirati poslovne procese tvrtke MAG Sistem d.o.o. Projektom se, kroz certifikaciju, adresira potreba za povećanjem konkurentnosti i usklađivanjem poslovanja s međunarodnim standardima.

Operation_Name_English: Development and validation of new innovative analytical methods in the analysis of leading eye diseases
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj i validacija novih inovativnih analitičkih metoda u analizi vodećih očnih bolesti
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project is proposed to explore and develop innovative analytical methods for the detection, identification and quantification of metabolites in ocular water samples. This will enable early recognition and monitoring of leading eye diseases, and improve diagnostic capabilities. Target groups: patients, health institutions, polyclinics
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se predlaže kako bi se istražile i razvile inovativne analitičke metode za detekciju, identifikaciju i kvantifikaciju metabolita u uzorcima očne vodice. Navedeno će omogućiti rano prepoznavanje i praćenje vodećih očnih bolesti, te poboljšati dijagnostičke mogućnosti. Ciljane skupine: bolesnici, zdravstvene ustanove, poliklinike

Operation_Name_English: Closing the "cold chain" in the pharmaceutical industry - MINI PHARMA-BOX
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zatvaranje "hladnog lanca" u farmaceutskoj industriji - MINI PHARMA-BOX
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project develops MINI PHARMA-BOX, an innovative container for the safe transport of biological thermosensitive drugs. This project is the result of cooperation in a SPIN consortium involving ALIUS GRUPU, B.M. PLAST, RABBIT – SOFTWARE and LJEKARNE BANIĆ. The aim is to close the gap in the final transport of medicines and improve production processes and business models. The employment and income of SPIN consortium members is expected to increase, as well as the submission of applications for intellectual property protection.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmetnim projektom razvija se MINI PHARMA-BOX, inovativni spremnik za siguran transport bioloških termoosjetljivih lijekova. Ovaj projekt je rezultat suradnje u SPIN konzorciju koji uključuje ALIUS GRUPU, B.M. PLAST, RABBIT – SOFTWARE i LJEKARNE BANIĆ. Cilj je zatvoriti nedostatak u krajnjem transportu lijekova te unaprijediti proizvodne procese i poslovne modele. Očekuje se povećanje zaposlenosti i prihoda članova SPIN konzorcija, te podnošenje zahtjeva za zaštitu intelektualnog vlasništva.

Operation_Name_English: You are not alone - Stage IV.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Niste sami - faza IV.
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of the project are to increase social inclusion and prevent institutionalization of older people and adults with disabilities. We will ensure that the hygiene standard of users is raised through the division of monthly packages with household and basic hygiene supplies. As part of the project, we will organize nutrition (assistance in preparing meals in food procurement, etc.), perform household chores and maintain personal hygiene as well as satisfy other daily needs for at least 72 people, which will be cared for by 12 employees. Target users will be defined by the implementation of the public call and the application form.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta su povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije starijih osoba i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom. Osigurat ćemo podizanje higijenskog standarda korisnika putem podjele mjesečnih paketa s kućanskim i osnovnim higijenskim potrepštinama. U sklopu projekta organizirat ćemo prehranu (pomoć u pripremi obroka u nabavi hrane i dr.), obavljanje kućanskih poslova te održavanje osobne higijene kao i zadovoljenje drugih svakodnevnih potreba za minimalno 72 osobe o kojima će skrbiti 12 zaposlenika. Ciljane korisnike definirati ćemo provedbom javnog poziva i prijavnim obrascem.

Operation_Name_English: PUNa Knowledge School 2023/2024
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Škola PUNa znanja 2023./2024.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the PUNA Knowledge School 2023/2024 project is to support the education and socialization of students with disabilities in a regular education program through the work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators. The project will include 13 students of the elementary school Marija i Line and 6 students TOŠ Galileo Galilei who will, thanks to the help of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators, achieve better success in school, easier to socialize, emotionally empower and develop a range of skills that enable them to live independently.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta Škola PUNa znanja 2023./2024. je pružiti podršku obrazovanju i socijalizaciji učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u redovitom programu obrazovanja kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika. Projekt će uključiti 13 učenika OŠ Marije i Line i 6 učenika TOŠ Galileo Galilei koji će zahvaljujući pomoći pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika postići bolji uspjeh u školi, lakše se socijalizirati, emocionalno osnažiti i razviti niz vještina koje ih osposobljavaju za samostalni život.

Operation_Name_English: Center of Creative and Cultural Industries UPVŽ
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Centar kreativnih i kulturnih industrija UPVŽ
Category_Label: Rehabilitation of industrial sites and contaminated land|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to renovate the abandoned brownfield site of the former cinema "Home" - an abandoned public space in Varaždin and convert it into the Centre of Creative and Cultural Industries UP Varaždin. The Centre of Creative and Cultural Industries will focus on the development and implementation of activities related to industries based on artistic and creative creation. In addition, it is planned to equip the cooperation branches of the Centre in the City of Ludbreg, the City of Varaždinske Toplice and the municipalities of Maruševec, Trnovec Bartolovečki and Vinica as a multipurpose infrastructure that will enable the improvement of knowledge and skills in the field of cultural and creative industries, while providing a space for work, learning and cooperation in the local community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je obnova napuštene brownfield lokacije bivšeg kina „Dom“ - napuštenog javnog prostora u Varaždinu i njegova prenamjena u Centar kreativnih i kulturnih industrija UP Varaždin. Centar kreativnih i kulturnih industrija bit će usmjeren na razvoj i provedbu aktivnosti povezanih s industrijama temeljenim na umjetničkom i kreativnom stvaralaštvu. Uz navedeno, planirano je opremanje suradničkih podružnica Centra u Gradu Ludbregu, Gradu Varaždinskim Toplicama i općinama Maruševec, Trnovec Bartolovečki i Vinica kao višenamjenske infrastrukture kojom će se omogućiti usavršavanje znanja i vještina u području kulturnih i kreativnih industrija, pružajući pritom prostor za rad, učenje i suradnju u lokalnoj zajednici.

Operation_Name_English: Testing the impact of an integrated kinesiological exercise program - "Body Technique" on increasing the vitality and quality of life of women with the problem of incontinence in perimenopause and menopause
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Testiranje utjecaja integriranog kineziološkog programa vježbanja - "Body tehnika" na povećanje vitalnosti i kvalitete života žena s problemom inkontinencije u perimenopauzi i menopauzi
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is to examine the impact of specially designed deep body and pelvic musculature exercises through group intervention as a gold standard Pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT), a group holistic kinesiological approach of innovative Body Technique (BT) on the biological condition and vitality in women in perimenopause and menopause with a special emphasis on the impact of pelvic floor exercises on reducing incontinence and increasing the quality of life.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog projekta je ispitati utjecaj posebno dizajniranih vježbi duboke muskulature tijela i zdjelice putem grupne intervencije kao zlatnog standarda Pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT), grupnog holističnog kineziološkog pristupa inovativne Body tehnike (BT) na biološko stanje i vitalnost kod žena u perimenopauzi i menopauzi s posebnim naglaskom utjecaja vježbi zdjeličnog dna na smanjenje inkontinencije i povećanje kvalitete života.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment of a single e-system for the insurance of workers' claims and temporary maintenance and improvement of the quality of services of the Agency for the Insurance of Workers' Claims
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uspostava jedinstvenog e-sustava za osiguranje radničkih tražbina i privremenog uzdržavanja te unaprjeđenje kvalitete usluga Agencije za osiguranje radničkih tražbina
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: By implementing the project, AORT will establish an e-system for centralization, automation and digitalisation of business processes, implement and certify an integrated management system and develop a digital platform for monitoring the achievement of goals. Networking and exchange of good practices will strengthen the capacities of the AORT and promote the advantages of the new e-system and the realisation of substantive rights in the field of insurance of workers' claims and temporary maintenance. The project will improve and modernise the business processes and services of the AORT for the purpose of more efficient access to services, rapid and accurate data exchange with other public institutions and additional protection of sensitive data of minors in accordance with regulatory and security requirements.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta AORT će uspostaviti e-sustav za centralizaciju, automatizaciju i digitalizaciju poslovnih procesa, uvesti i certificirati integrirani sustav upravljanja te razviti digitalnu platformu za praćenje realizacije ciljeva. Umrežavanjem i razmjenom dobrih praksi ojačat će se kapaciteti AORT-a te promovirati prednosti novog e-sustava i ostvarivanje materijalnih prava u području osiguranja radničkih tražbina i privremenog uzdržavanja. Projektom će se unaprijediti i modernizirati poslovni procesi i usluge AORT-a u svrhu učinkovitijeg pristupa uslugama, brze i točne razmjene podataka s drugim javnim institucijama te dodatne zaštite osjetljivih podataka maloljetnika u skladu s regulatornim i sigurnosnim zahtjevima.

Operation_Name_English: Improving the business of the company SM diesel d.o.o. through the certification of processes, management systems and product compliance
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje poslovanja poduzeća SM dizel d.o.o. kroz certifikaciju procesa, sustava upravljanja i sukladnosti proizvoda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With the project investment "Improving the business of the company SM diesel d.o.o. through the certification of processes, management systems and product compliance" lasting 18 months, the company SM diesel d.o.o. will improve its business and increase its competitiveness by introducing and certifying processes, management systems and product compliance, all in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards. The project requires the introduction of a new management system, harmonization and certification of the welding business process and assessment of product compliance in order to adapt the company to the market and to ensure the sustainability of the business.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektnim ulaganjem "Unaprjeđenje poslovanja poduzeća SM dizel d.o.o. kroz certifikaciju procesa, sustava upravljanja i sukladnosti proizvoda" u trajanju 18 mjeseci, poduzeće SM dizel d.o.o. će unaprijediti svoje poslovanje te povećati svoju konkurentnost uvođenjem i certifikacijom procesa, sustava upravljanja i sukladnosti proizvoda, a sve u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi. Projektom je potrebno uvesti novi sustav upravljanja, uskladiti i certificirati poslovni proces zavarivanja te ocijeniti sukladnost proizvoda kako bi se tvrtka prilagodila tržištu i kako bi se osigurala održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Air quality monitoring in the Dubrovnik Port Authority area
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Praćenje kvalitete zraka u području Lučke uprave Dubrovnik
Category_Label: Air quality and noise reduction measures
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Monitoring of air quality in the area of the Port of Dubrovnik Authority’ envisages the installation of a fixed measuring station system for continuous monitoring of air quality in the area of the port of Dubrovnik, one of the six ports of international economic interest for the Republic of Croatia, with a strong focus on the traffic of cruise ships.The implementation of this system will enable monitoring of emissions of harmful substances including nitrogen oxide (NO2), sulphur dioxide (SO2) and PM10/PM2 particulate matter, while meteorological sensors will monitor the pressure, temperature and relative humidity of the air and wind direction and speed.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Praćenje kvalitete zraka u području Lučke uprave Dubrovnik“ predviđa se instalacije sustava fiksne mjerne postaje za kontinuirano praćenje kvalitete zraka na području luke Dubrovnik, jedne od šest luka od međunarodnog gospodarskog interesa za Republiku Hrvatsku, s izraženom orijentacijom na promet kruzerskih brodova.Implementacija ovog sustava omogućit će praćenje emisija štetnih tvari uključujući dušikove oksid (NO2), sumporov dioksid (SO2) te lebdeće čestice PM10/PM2, dok će meteorološki senzori pratiti tlak, temperaturu i relativnu vlažnost zraka te smjera i brzine vjetra.

Operation_Name_English: Development of new diagnostic and digital tools and applications in the field of ophthalmology
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj novih dijagnostičkih i digitalnih alata i aplikacija u području oftalmologije
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Development of new diagnostic and digital tools and applications in the field of ophthalmology will contribute to the development of NUTS2 region of Adriatic Croatia, RLV Health, PN Personalized Medicine within S3 TPP Personalized Health Care and TPP Digital products and platforms with the aim of developing new diagnostic and digital tools and applications in the field of ophthalmology.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Razvoj novih dijagnostičkih i digitalnih alata i aplikacija u području oftalmologije doprinijet će razvoju NUTS2 regije Jadranska Hrvatska, RLV Zdravlje, PN Personalizirana medicina u okviru S3 TPP Personalizirana briga o zdravlju i TPP Digitalni proizvodi i platforme s ciljem razvoja novih dijagnostičkih i digitalnih alata i aplikacija u području oftalmologije.

Operation_Name_English: Karlovac County for Inclusive Schools
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Karlovačka županija za inkluzivne škole
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Through the implementation of the project, students with developmental difficulties (N=75) will be provided with support for inclusion in primary and secondary educational institutions founded by Karlovac County in order to ensure the conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning, and which exercise and are recognized the right by the Decision on support and provision of PUN/CPC (73) based on the Personal Assistance Act (OG 71/2023) and the Ordinance on teaching assistants and professional communication mediators (OG 85/2024). Students with disabilities will be provided with conditions for quality inclusive education, social inclusion and training in an equal community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju (N=75) pružit će se potpora za uključivanje u osnovnoškolske i srednjoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove kojima je osnivač Karlovačka županija kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje, a koji ostvaruju i kojima je priznato pravo Rješenjem na potporu i osiguravanje PUN/SKP (73) temeljem Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji (NN 71/2023) i Pravilnika o pomoćnicima u nastavi i stručnim komunikacijskim posrednicima (NN 85/2024). Učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju osigurat će se uvjeti za kvalitetno inkluzivno obrazovanje, društvenu uključenost i osposobljavanje u jednakopravnoj zajednici.

Operation_Name_English: Development of a strategy for the development of the Urban Area of Krapina for the period 2021-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada strategije razvoja Urbanog područja Krapina za razdoblje 2021.-2027.
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The urban development strategy is the basis for the implementation of projects that will be financed through the ITU mechanism. The purpose of this project application is to co-finance the preparation of the document of the strategy for the development of the urban area of Krapina for the period 2021-2027. (SRUP) implementing the ITU mechanism. The City of Krapina, as the city centre of the Krapina Urban Area, is an eligible applicant, and the project activities for financing are the preparation of the SRUP and the implementation of the evaluation during the preparation of the SRUP (preliminary evaluation), i.e. the declaration of the incurred costs of the external service for the preparation of the SRUP and the external service for the implementation of the preliminary evaluation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Strategija razvoja urbanog područja predstavlja temelj za provedbu projekata koji će se financirati putem ITU mehanizma. Svrha prijave ovog projekta je sufinanciranje izrade dokumenta strategije razvoja urbanog područja Krapina za razdoblje 2021.-2027. (SRUP) u kojem se provodi ITU mehanizam. Grad Krapina je kao grad središte Urbanog područja Krapina prihvatljiv prijavitelj, a aktivnosti projekta za financiranje su izrada SRUP-a i provedba vrednovanja tijekom izrade SRUP-a (prethodno vrednovanje), odnosno prijava nastalih troškova vanjske usluge za izradu SRUP-a i vanjske usluge provedbe prethodnog vrednovanja.

Operation_Name_English: NAVIS MARIN DIGITAL PLATFORM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: NAVIS MARIN DIGITALNA PLATFORMA
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The result of the R&D project to be carried out by the members of the consortium will result in three (3) INNOVATED AND STRONGLY UNDERTAKED SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS "NAVIGIA 360" within RLV Blue Growth, PN Luxury Coastal Tourism, contributing to the transformational goals of TPP S3 Digital products and platforms, and contributing to addressing key societal challenges. The problem that the project solves at the GLOBALN level is the unsustainability of development and difficult cooperation between key stakeholders involved in nautical tourism, and includes categories of: charter companies and operators, marinas, ports and accompanying services, prof. and recreation. boaters and crews, nautical tourists, tourist. agencies and guides, hotel and hospitality. facilities, managers cult.-pov. attraction
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Rezultirat projekta istraživanja i razvoja koji će provoditi članovi konzorcija rezultirat će trima (3) INOVIRANA I ZNAČAJNO UNAPRJEĐENA SOFTVERSKA RJEŠENJA „NAVIGIA 360“ u okviru RLV Plavi rast, PN Luksuzni obalni turizam, čime se ostvaruje doprinos transformacijskim ciljevima TPP S3 Digitalni proizvodi i platforme, te se doprinosi rješavanju ključnih društvenih izazova. Problem koji projekt rješava na GLOBALNOJ razini je neodrživost razvoja i otežana suradnja između ključnih dionika koji sudjeluju u nautičkom turizmu, a obuhvaća kategorije: charter tvrtke i operateri, marine, luke i prateće usluge, prof. i rekreat. nautičari i posade, nautički turisti, turist. agencije i vodiči, hotelski i ugost. objekti, upravitelji kult.-pov. atrakcija

Operation_Name_English: Young scientists: discover AI and STEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mladi znanstvenici: otkrijmo AI i STEM
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to strengthen the capacities of the European Business Association to promote and popularize STEM, especially in the field of artificial intelligence, among children and students aged 6 to 14 through training and mentoring programs of coaches, teachers and professional associates who will work with them. The project also aims to improve the association's cooperation with educational and higher education institutions and to develop and implement workshops and public events based on new methods of working with children and students. The implementation of the project will be based on multidisciplinary approaches, will focus on inclusion and non-discrimination and will strive to achieve a balance between the use of technologies and care for the health of young people.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je ojačati kapacitete Europske poslovne udruge za promicanje i popularizaciju STEM-a, posebice na području umjetne inteligencije, među djecom i učenicima od 6 do 14 godina kroz obuku i program mentorstva trenera, učitelja i stručnih suradnika koji će raditi s njima. Projekt također ima za cilj unaprijediti suradnju udruge s odgojno-obrazovnim i visokoobrazovnim institucijama te razviti i provesti radionice i javne događaje temeljene na novim metodama rada s djecom i učenicima. Implementacija projekta temeljit će se na multidisciplinarnim pristupima, bit će usmjerena na inkluziju i nediskriminaciju te će težiti postići ravnotežu između korištenja tehnologija i brige za zdravlje mladih.

Operation_Name_English: Let's give them hope II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dajmo im nadu II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project "Give them Hope II" will influence the increase of social inclusion and the prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups through the provision of long-term care in their local community. The project will provide services in the area of Šibenik-Knin County, and will employ 15 service providers who will take care of 90 users. The public and the target group will be informed about the project through promotional tools (websites, media, posters, leaflets and conferences).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta "Dajmo im nadu II" utjecat će se na povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevenciju institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina kroz osiguravanje dugotrajne skrbi u njihovoj lokalnoj zajednici. Projektom će se pružiti usluge na području Šibensko-kninske županije, a bit će zaposleno 15 pružatelja usluga koji će se brinuti o 90 korisnika. Javnost i ciljana skupina će o projektu biti informirana putem promotivnih alata (web stranica, medija, plakata, letaka i konferencija).

Operation_Name_English: Mea Trade - Investment in management system and product certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mea Trade - Ulaganje u sustav upravljanja i certifikaciju proizvoda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the Mea Trade Project is to provide the preconditions for increasing sales on the domestic and foreign markets and to increase the overall competitiveness of the company through an investment aimed at obtaining certification for the newly developed WCU product and an integrated management system. The target groups whose interests the Project will directly contribute to are (1): the undertaking of the applicant; (2): buyers and suppliers; and (3): end-users/citizens. The project will solve the problem of the required compliance of the product with the normative requirements of the EU market and the uncertified management system according to international standards, which will enable the applicant to place the product on the market, that is, ultimately strengthen the trust of clients and its competitiveness.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha Projekta društva Mea Trade je kroz ulaganje usmjereno u stjecanje certifikata za novorazvijeni proizvod WCU i integrirani sustav upravljanja osigurati preduvjete za povećanje prodaje na domaćem i inozemnom tržištu te povećati ukupnu konkurentnost poduzeća. Ciljne skupine čijim će interesima Projekt izravno doprinijeti su (1): poduzeće Prijavitelja; (2): kupci i dobavljači; te (3): krajnji korisnici/građani. Projektom će Prijavitelj riješiti problem potrebnog usklađivanja proizvoda s normativnim zahtjevima tržišta EU-a te necertificiranog sustava upravljanja prema međunarodnim normama, što će mu omogućiti plasman proizvoda na tržište, odnosno u konačnici ojačati povjerenje klijenata i njegovu konkurentnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Scientific Educational and Entertainment Centre Zagorje (ZEZ)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Znanstveni edukativno-zabavni centar Zagorje (ZEZ)
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of public tourism assets and tourism services|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "ZEZ Centar Zagorje" in Phase II focuses on the reconstruction and extension of the Stubički Golubovec castle, which includes an overhead extension within the outline of the cadastral image of the former farm building and an underground connection with the castle building. This phase includes the arrangement of premises for educational workshops, laboratories, communication spaces, halls, classrooms and other facilities necessary for conducting scientific and educational activities. Environmental landscaping is planned, including vehicular and pedestrian access, parking and minimal walking trails around the castle. Phase II of the project also includes measures to increase energy efficiency and reduce negative environmental impact, as well as the implementation of waste management and noise reduction systems.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "ZEZ Centar Zagorje" u Fazi II fokusira se na rekonstrukciju i dogradnju dvorca Stubički Golubovec, što uključuje nadzemnu dogradnju unutar obrisa katastarskog snimka bivše gospodarske zgrade te podzemni spoj sa zgradom dvorca. Ova faza obuhvaća uređenje prostora za edukativne radionice, laboratorije, komunikacijske prostore, dvorane, učionice i druge sadržaje potrebne za provođenje znanstveno-edukativnih aktivnosti. Planirano je uređenje okoliša, uključujući kolni i pješački pristup, parkiralište te minimalne pješačke stazice oko dvorca. Faza II projekta također uključuje mjere za povećanje energetske učinkovitosti i smanjenje negativnog utjecaja na okoliš, kao i implementaciju sustava za upravljanje otpadom i smanjenje buke.

Operation_Name_English: Development of innovative green solutions for modular construction of low-energy self-sustainable buildings of different uses based on the basic principles of the European Bauhaus
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inovativnih zelenih rješenja za modularnu gradnju niskoenergetskih samoodrživih objekata različite namjene temeljenih na osnovnim principima europskog Bauhausa
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project is implemented for 36 months and implies the establishment of a SPIN consortium consisting of the Applicant, the company Prefabricated Houses DLB d.o.o. and Partners, the companies Zadol Group and Klara Gardening. In addition to these companies, the role of Partner in the consortium is also played by the research and knowledge dissemination organization, i.e. the University of North. The aim of the project is to implement development activities in order to create two innovative products: new insulation material for prefabricated buildings based on the application of sheep wool and the first low-energy self-sustaining modular building built on the principles of the European Bauhaus. The project is planned to employ 13 new employees with the Applicants and partner companies in the period of 3 years after the end of the project with an increase in revenue of more than 20%.
