Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se provodi 36 mjeseci i podrazumijeva uspostavu SPIN konzorcija kojeg čine Prijavitelj, tvrtka Montažne kuće DLB d.o.o. te Partneri, poduzeća Zadol Grupa i Klara Gardening. Uz navedena poduzeća, ulogu Partnera u konzorciju ima i organizacija za istraživanje i širenje znanja, odnosno Sveučilište sjever. Cilj projekta je provedba razvojnih aktivnosti radi stvaranja dva inovativna proizvoda: novi izolacijski materijal za montažne objekte temeljem na primjeni ovčje vune te prvi niskoenergetki samoodrživi modularni objekt izgrađen na principima Europskog Bauhausa. Projektom se planira kod Prijavitelja i partnerskih tvrtki zaposliti 13 novozaposenih u periodu od 3 godine nakon završetka projekta uz povećanje prihoda za više od 20%.

Operation_Name_English: Together we want a beautiful old age
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno želimo lijepu starost
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent premature institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care by providing support and support services to people over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities. In 33 months, 30 service providers will provide assistance to a total of 180 members of the target groups, all with the aim of enabling their social inclusion and raising the level of quality of life.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija prerane institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom. 30 pružatelja usluga će kroz 33 mjeseca pružati pomoć za ukupno 180 pripadnika ciljanih skupina, a sve s ciljem omogućavanja njihovog socijalnog uključivanja i podizanja razine kvalitete života.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading of the port of Prigradica, o. Korčula – I. Construction phase
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja luke Prigradica, o. Korčula – I. Faza izgradnje
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to upgrade the port of local importance Prigradica, which is used for regular and tourist and traffic, in order to improve the transport connections of the island of Korčula with the mainland, increase the level of safety of the port of Prigradica and reduce traffic jams, especially in the summer months. The project has a positive impact on improving the accessibility of islands and the mainland, and the implementation of this project and the fulfilment of the goal will improve the quality of life of the local population. The total value of the project is EUR 11 548 821.12 and the eligible costs EUR 11 371 473.79. The ineligible costs amount to EUR 177 347.33 and relate to ineligible activities (project and study documentation costs, management and administration costs).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je dogradnja luke lokalnog značaja Prigradica, koja služi za linijski i turistički i promet, u svrhu poboljšanja prometne povezanosti otoka Korčule s kopnom, povećanja razine sigurnosti luke Prigradica i smanjenja prometnih gužvi, posebice u ljetnim mjesecima. Projektom se pozitivno utječe na poboljšanje dostupnosti otoka i kopna, a provedbom ovog projekta i ispunjenjem cilja poboljšat će se kvaliteta života lokalnog stanovništva. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 11.548.821,12 EUR, a prihvatljivih troškova 11.371.473,79 EUR. Neprihvatljivi troškovi iznose 177.347,33 EUR, i odnose se na neprihvatljive aktivnosti (troškovi izrade projektne i studijske dokumentacije, troškovi upravljanja i administracije).

Operation_Name_English: "Knowledge for all VII"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Znanje za sve VII"
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The ‘Knowledge for All VII’ project provides support for the inclusion of students with disabilities in the next three school years in Vladimir Nazor Elementary School and Zvonko Car Elementary School in Crikvenica through the work of educated teaching assistants to ensure the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialisation and emotional functioning. After the implementation of the public tender and the programme for the introduction of teaching assistants in elementary schools in Crikvenica, teaching assistants will provide students with direct support during the educational process, in movement, in taking food and drinks, in performing hygiene needs and in teaching and extracurricular activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Znanje za sve VII“ osigurava se potpora uključivanju učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u sljedeće tri školske godine u OŠ Vladimira Nazora i OŠ Zvonka Cara u Crikvenici kroz rad educiranih pomoćnika u nastavi kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Nakon provedbe javnog natječaja i programa uvođenja u rad pomoćnika u nastavi, u crikveničkim osnovnim školama će pomoćnici u nastavi učenicima pružati neposrednu potporu tijekom odgojno-obrazovnog procesa, u kretanju, pri uzimanju hrane i pića, u obavljanju higijenskih potreba te u nastavnim i izvannastavnim aktivnostima.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening fire protection capacities in mountainous and assisted areas
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje kapaciteta za protupožarnu zaštitu na brdsko-planinskim i potpomognutim područjima
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
NUTS3_Label: Krapinsko-zagorska županija|Brodsko-posavska županija|Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija|Virovitičko-podravska županija|Požeško-slavonska županija|Koprivničko-križevačka županija|Međimurska županija|Bjelovarsko-bilogorska županija|Šibensko-kninska županija|Karlovačka županija|Sisačko-moslavačka županija|Istarska županija|Zagrebačka županija|Varaždinska županija|Osječko-baranjska županija|Vukovarsko-srijemska županija|Zadarska županija|Primorsko-goranska županija|Ličko-senjska županija|Split-Dalmatia County
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project Strengthening fire protection capacities in mountainous and assisted areas will significantly improve and strengthen the resilience of these areas to the increased risks of forest and outdoor fires due to strong climate change. Investments in the project relate to the purchase of firefighting vehicles, firefighting equipment, exercise areas and raising awareness about fire prevention. Therefore, the project represents an integrated approach to strengthening firefighting services' capabilities in response to the increasing risks of forest fires.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta Jačanje kapaciteta za protupožarnu zaštitu na brdsko-planinskim i potpomognutim područjima značajno će se unaprijediti i ojačati otpornost ovih područja na pojačane rizike od šumskih i požara na otvorenom koji su posljedica snažnih klimatskih promjena. Ulaganja u projektu odnose se na nabavu vatrogasnih vozila, vatrogasne opreme, vježbališta te podizanje svijesti o prevenciji požara. Stoga projekt predstavlja integrirani pristup jačanju sposobnosti vatrogasnih službi kao odgovor na sve značajnije rizike od pojave šumskih požara.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of EURO LIMBUS d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija tvrtke EURO LIMBUS d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The company EURO LIMBUS d.o.o. has identified problems of inability to prove quality due to the lack of procedures related to waste management and health and safety management of employees. The aim is to increase international competitiveness by strengthening its own capacities through the introduction of ISO 14001 and 45001 standards, which will facilitate access to the international market and increase the competitiveness of SMEs through the application of internationally recognised standards that demonstrate the level of quality and security in the exchange of goods and services and contribute to customer confidence. This creates the preconditions for the growth of sales revenues by 15.1% and exports by 15.1%.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka EURO LIMBUS d.o.o. je identificirala probleme nemogućnosti dokazivanja kvalitete zbog nepostojanja procedura vezanih uz upravljanje otpadom i upravljanja zdravljem i sigurnost na radu zaposlenika. Cilj je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti osnaživanjem vlastitih kapaciteta uvođenjem normi ISO 14001 i 45001 čime će se olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu i povećati konkurentnost MSP-ova primjenom međunarodno priznatih norma kojima se dokazuje razina kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni roba i usluga te pridonosi povjerenju kupaca. Navedenim se stvaraju preduvjeti za rast prihoda od prodaje za 15,1% i izvoza za 15,1%.

Operation_Name_English: Development of a continuous melting line for honeycomb
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj linije za kontinuirano taljenje pčelinjeg saća
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in micro enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop an innovative line for melting and sterilizing bee honeycombs by implementing a research and development project and investing in the technological infrastructure of Apital and its partners. This line will increase processing efficiency, reduce energy costs and ensure a high level of wax health safety. The project primarily targets beekeepers, beekeeping cooperatives and producers of beekeeping equipment. The wider beekeeping community and final consumers of bee products will also benefit through improved quality and safety of honey and other bee products. The project contributes to the sustainability of beekeeping, strengthens local food brands and supports the economic development of the region (new jobs and local initiatives).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je razvoj inovativne linije za taljenje i sterilizaciju pčelinjih saća implementacijom projekta istraživanja i razvoja te ulaganjem u tehnološku infrastrukturu društva Apital i njegovih partnera. Ova linija će povećati efikasnost obrade, smanjiti energetske troškove i osigurati visoku razinu zdravstvene ispravnosti voska. Projekt je prvenstveno usmjeren na pčelare, pčelarske zadruge i proizvođače pčelarske opreme. Koristi će imati i šira pčelarska zajednica te krajnji potrošači pčelinjih proizvoda kroz poboljšanu kvalitetu i sigurnost meda i drugih pčelinjih proizvoda. Projekt doprinosi održivosti pčelarstva, jača lokalne prehrambene brendove i podržava ekonomski razvoj regije (nova radna mjesta i lokalne inicijative).

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of ISO 9001:2015 standard in the production of laboratory consumables
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje norme ISO 9001:2015 u proizvodnju laboratorijskog potrošnog materijala
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: This project introduces the ISO 9001:2015 standard, which will greatly contribute to the company's market recognition on the foreign and domestic market. This international standard specifies the requirements for a quality management system and the company will be able to demonstrate its ability to consistently deliver products and provide services that meet customer requirements and the requirements of laws and regulations, as well as to increase customer satisfaction by effectively applying the system, including processes to continuously improve the system and ensure compliance with customer requirements and the corresponding requirements of laws and regulations. With the introduction of this standard, the company will increase its sales revenue by a minimum of 31% in the 2nd year after the implementation of the project, as well as export revenue by a minimum of 31%.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom uvodi se norma ISO 9001:2015 koja će poduzeću uvelike pridonijeti tržišnu prepoznatljivost na inozemnom, ali i domaćem tržištu. Ova međunarodna norma određuje zahtjeve za sustav upravljanja kvalitetom te će poduzeće moći dokazati svoju sposobnost dosljedne isporuke proizvoda i pružanja usluga koji ispunjavaju zahtjeve kupaca i zahtjeve zakona i propisa, kao i povećati zadovoljstvo kupaca djelotvornom primjenom sustava, uključujući procese za neprekidno poboljšavanje sustava i osiguravanje sukladnosti sa zahtjevima kupaca i odgovarajućim zahtjevima zakona i propisa. Uvođenjem ove norme poduzeće će povećati svoje prihode od prodaje za minimalno 31% u 2. godini nakon provedbe projekta kao i prihode od izvoza za minimalno 31%.

Operation_Name_English: RESPONSIBLE ARHIPELAG: Development and improvement of resilience of the island area of Zadar County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: OTPORAN ARHIPELAG: Razvoj i unaprjeđenje otpornosti otočnog prostora Zadarske županije
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)|Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project PROTECTED ARHIPELAG is the development of integrated social content and strengthening the response of security services for the islands of Zadar County to disasters caused by climate change through investments in infrastructure development and the application of new techniques and technologies, raising the capacity of security services and adapting and developing integrated social content. The project invests in the implementation of green infrastructure measures and the construction of a fire and community home in the municipality of Pašman, the arrangement of new and renovation of old fire roads of Dugi otok, the procurement of equipment for the needs of firefighting and civil protection of the island of Vrgada and a firefighting vessel for the needs of firefighting and civil protection for the entire island area of Zadar County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta OTPORAN ARHIPELAG je razvoj integriranih društvenih sadržaja i jačanje odgovora sigurnosnih službi za otoke Zadarske županije na katastrofe uzrokovane klimatskim promjenama kroz ulaganja u razvoj infrastrukture i primjenu novih tehnika i tehnologija, podizanjem kapaciteta sigurnosnih službi te prilagodbom i razvojem integriranih društvenih sadržaja. Projektom se ulaže u provedbu mjera zelene infrastrukture i izgradnju vatrogasnog i društvenog doma u općini Pašman, uređenje novih i obnovu starih protupožarnih prometnica Dugog otoka, nabavu opreme za potrebe vatrogastva i civilne zaštite otoka Vrgade i vatrogasnog plovila za potrebe vatrogastva i civilne zaštite za cjelokupno otočno područje Zadarske županije.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - Good for all 4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi – dobro svima 4
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve the quality of life of older people and people with disabilities, by increasing social inclusion, the quality of their health and the quality of housing and delaying institutionalization. The main activity of the project is the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies. The activity includes the recruitment of 12 service providers for at least 72 members of the target group, the procurement of monthly household and hygiene kits, communication and visibility, as well as project management and administration. The duration of the project is 36 months, while the provision of the service to the users will last 30 months. The project is implemented in the area of the city of Đakovo and suburban settlements.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je unaprijediti kvalitetu života osoba starije životne dobi i osoba s invaliditetom, kroz povećanje socijalne uključenosti, kvalitete njihovog zdravlja i kvalitete stanovanja te odgađanje institucionalizacije. Glavna aktivnost projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština. Aktivnost obuhvaća zapošljavanje 12 pružatelja usluga za najmanje 72 pripadnika ciljane skupine, nabavu paketa mjesečnih kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština, komunikaciju i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administraciju. Trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci, dok će pružanje usluge korisnicima trajati 30 mjeseci. Projekt se provodi na području grada Đakova i prigradskih naselja.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of the terminal for the transhipment of bulk cargo in the port of Osijek - Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja terminala za pretovar rasutih tereta u luci Osijek - II faza
Category_Label: Inland waterways and ports (TEN-T) excluding facilities dedicated to transport of fossil fuels
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to build a bulk cargo terminal in the port of Osijek. The total value of the project is EUR 34 413 522.61, ineligible costs amount to EUR 1 985 230.74, 32 428 291.87 eligible costs, of which the grant is EUR 29 930 459.29. The stated amount also covers the project phase after 31.12.2023, while until the stated date, i.e. for phase I of the project, the total value of the project is 7.090.792,81 eur, the total eligible costs are 5.105.562,07 eur, i.e. the grant amounts to 4.712.299,32 eur. The total value of the project and the eligible costs of phase II is 27.322.729,80 eur, while the grant amounts to 25.218,159.97 eur.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgraditi terminal za pretovar rasutih tereta u luci Osijek. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 34.413.522,61 eura, neprihvatljivi troškovi iznose 1.985.230,74 eur, 32.428.291,87 prihvatljivi troškovi, od čega bespovratna sredstva 29.930.459,29 eura. Navedeni iznos obuhvaća i fazu projekta nakon 31.12.2023., dok do navedenog datuma, odnosno za fazu I projekta, ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 7.090.792,81 eur, ukupni prihvatljivi troškovi iznose 5.105.562,07 eur, odnosno bespovratna sredstva iznose 4.712.299,32 eur. Ukupna vrijednost projekta ujedno i prihvatljivih troškova faze II iznosi 27.322.729,80 eur, dok bespovratna sredstva iznose 25.218.159,97 eur.

Operation_Name_English: Quantocian
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Quantocian
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the proposed project is to test the physico-chemical and microbiological characteristics of aronia polyphenol powder, in order to test an innovative product, which will then be placed on the market. It is an innovative product that, according to the results of its own research and development, is rich in polyphenols, vitamins and minerals to which numerous nutrition and health claims are linked. The implementation of the proposed project will strengthen the innovation capacity of Bioquante and cooperation will be achieved with the scientific research organization that will be the service provider on the project. The implementation of the project will result in an increase in the readiness of the company to develop new products and implement similar projects in the future.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha predloženog projekta je ispitivanje fizikalno-kemijskih i mikrobioloških karakteristika polifenolnog praha aronije, kako bi se ispitao inovativni proizvod, koji će se zatim staviti na tržište. Radi se o inovativnom proizvodu koji je prema rezultatima vlastitog istraživanja i razvoja bogat polifenolima, vitaminima i mineralima za koje se vežu brojne prehrambene i zdravstvene tvrdnje. Provedba predloženog projekta će ojačati inovacijski kapacitet Bioquante i ostvarit će se suradnja sa znanstveno-istraživačkom organizacijom koja će biti pružatelj usluge na projektu. Provedba projekta rezultirat će povećanjem spremnosti poduzeća za razvoj novih proizvoda i provedbu sličnih projekata u budućnosti.

Operation_Name_English: DINA-SOL: Development of innovative products and technologies of flexible powertrains with dynamic-inertial stabilization and monitoring of the position of the Sun for non-integrated solar power plants
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: DINA-SOL: Razvoj inovativnih proizvoda i tehnologija fleksibilnih pogonskih sklopova s dinamičko-inercijskom stabilizacijom i praćenjem položaja Sunca za neintegrirane solarne elektrane

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop innovative products and technologies of flexible powertrains with dynamic and inertial stabilization and monitoring of the position of the Sun for non-integrated solar power plants in niches of higher added value through the application of the expertise and experience of the consortium members and the support of the research organization. Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of NOSTRUM MEDICAL d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva NOSTRUM MEDICAL d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Objective of the project: Increase the international competitiveness of companies by certifying quality and safety management systems, ensuring compliance with internationally recognised standards and market requirements. Purpose of the project: Enable easier access to foreign markets, increase customer confidence and optimize business processes through the introduction of high quality and security standards. Expected results: Certification of 4 business process management systems, increasing export and sales revenues and strengthening the company's reputation in the international market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta: Povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća certificiranjem sustava upravljanja kvalitete i sigurnosti čime će se osigurati usklađenost s međunarodno priznatim normama i zahtjevima tržišta. Svrha projekta: Omogućiti lakši pristup inozemnim tržištima, povećati povjerenje klijenata i optimizirati poslovne procese kroz uvođenje visokih standarda kvalitete i sigurnosti. Očekivani rezultati: Certificiranje 4 sustava upravljanja poslovnim procesima, povećanje prihoda od izvoza i prodaje te jačanje reputacije poduzeća na međunarodnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Decoration of the coastal zone of the settlement of Baška – Etapa 2A
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uređenje obalnog pojasa naselja Baška – Etapa 2A
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The project addresses the problem of inadequate public infrastructure, partially neglected public spaces, lack of accessibility, inadequate stormwater solutions, lack of green infrastructure and lack of sustainable tourism. The aim of the project is to raise the quality of life of the local population through the revitalization of cultural and tourist locations, the improvement of social content and the development of green and blue infrastructure. Activities include the preparation of project documentation, infrastructure works, landscape design, publicity and visibility, and project management. Target groups include the local population , tourists, the Municipality of Baška, the Municipality of Lopar, the area of the island of Krk, the economic sector and the floor
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt adresira problem neadekvatne javne infrastrukture, djelomično zapuštenih javnih prostora, nedostatak pristupačnosti, neadekvatna rješenja oborinskih voda, nedostatak zelene infrastrukture i nedostatka održivog turizma. Cilj projekta je podizanje kvalitete života lokalnog stanovništva kroz revitalizaciju kulturno-turističkih lokacija, unapređenje društvenih sadržaja te razvoj zelene i plave infrastrukture. Aktivnosti uključuju izradu projektne dokumentacije, infrastrukturne radove, krajobrazno uređenje, promidžbu i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom. Ciljane skupine obuhvaćaju lokalno stanovništvo , turiste, Općinu Baška, Općinu Lopar, područje otoka Krka, gospodarski sektor i podu

Operation_Name_English: Strategy for the development of the smaller urban area of Koprivnica for the financial period from 2021 to 2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strategija razvoja manjeg urbanog područja Koprivnica za financijsko razdoblje od 2021. do 2027. godine
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: Strategy for the Development of the Smaller Urban Area of Koprivnica for the financial period 2021 -2027 is a planning document for regional development policy that sets out the objectives and priorities for the development of the Urban Area. The objective of developing an urban area development strategy is to define common directions for the development of the urban area, propose common lines of action, facilitate the implementation of joint projects – in other words, develop a "common strategic vision" that transcends administrative boundaries and creates synergies that benefit the urban area as a whole.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Strategija razvoja manjeg Urbanog područja Koprivnica za financijsko razdoblje 2021. - 2027. planski je dokument politike regionalnog razvoja kojim se utvrđuju ciljevi i prioriteti razvoja Urbanog područja. Cilj izrade strategije razvoja urbanoga područja je definiranje zajedničkih smjerova razvoja urbanoga područja, predlaganje zajedničkih pravaca djelovanja, olakšavanje provedbe zajedničkih projekata – drugim riječima razvoj „zajedničke strateške vizije“ koja nadilazi administrativne granice i stvara sinergije koje koriste urbanom području u cjelini.

Operation_Name_English: NeuroStem Talent Center
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: NeuroStem Talent Centar
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: By conducting trainings, study trips and participating in various conferences, we will strengthen the capacity to conduct STEM workshops for children and students. During the project, a minimum of seven employees/volunteers will be trained to run workshops, which will ensure quality education. The project will involve more than 900 children over a period of three years, during which more than 375 activities will be carried out. The project will be realized in Istria County, with the participation of partners from different cities and towns, which will contribute to the popularization of STEM in the wider area.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom izobrazbi, studijskih putovanja i sudjelovanjem na različitim konferencijama, ojačat ćemo kapacitete za provođenje STEM radionica za djecu i učenike. Tijekom projekta, minimalno sedam zaposlenika/volontera bit će osposobljeno za vođenje radionica, čime će se osigurati kvalitetna edukacija. Projekt će uključiti više od 900 djece u razdoblju od tri godine, tijekom kojih će se provesti više od 375 aktivnosti. Projekt će se realizirati u Istarskoj županiji, uz sudjelovanje partnera iz različitih gradova i mjesta, što će doprinijeti popularizaciji STEM-a u širem području.

Operation_Name_English: Zaželi - Institutionalization Prevention Program in Pučišća Municipality
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - program prevencije institucionalizacije u Općini Pučišća
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objectives of the project: reduce the need for institutionalisation of elderly users and/or persons with disabilities 2. increase the level of quality of life of end-users. This will be achieved by employing 6 service providers at 33 months. Each will take care of 6 people who are old and/or powerless. 36 users will receive quality home care, enabling them to have equal access to basic services compared to other, geographically less limited areas. Procurement activities and monthly distribution of supplies, control of services performed, promotion and project management will also be carried out.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta: 1. smanjiti potrebu za institucionalizacijom korisnika starije životne dobi i/ili osoba s invaliditetom 2. povećati razinu kvalitete života krajnjih korisnika. To će se ostvariti zapošljavanjem 6 pružatelja usluga na 33 mj. Svaki će brinuti o 6 osoba koje su stare i/ili nemoćne. 36 korisnika će dobiti kvalitetnu skrb u vlastitom domu čime će im se omogućiti ravnopravnost u pristupu temeljnim uslugama u odnosu na druga, geografski manje limitirana područja. Provest će se i aktivnosti nabave i mjesečne podjele potrepština, kontrole izvršenih usluga, promidžbe i upravljanja projektom.

Operation_Name_English: By certifying the growth of Geotehnika d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Cerificiranjem do rasta tvrtke Geotehnika d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The company conducted a business analysis and identified problems that will be solved by the implementation of the project, including reduced competitiveness, inability to prove quality, lack of traceability of documentation and unoptimized business processes. Objective of the project: strengthen the company's capacities through the introduction of ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 50001 standards, i.e. optimization and improvement of business processes, which will contribute to increasing its (international) competitiveness, facilitating access to the (international) market and increasing the competitiveness of SMEs by certifying management systems in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards = preconditions for the growth of sales revenues (15.1%) and export revenues (30.1%), by 2028.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka je provela analizu poslovanja i identificirala probleme koji će se riješiti implementacijom projekta, uključujući smanjenu konkurentnost, nemogućnost dokazivanja kvalitete, nepostojanje sljedivosti dokumentacije i neoptimizirane poslovne procese. Cilj projekta: osnažiti kapacitete tvrtke kroz uvođenje normi ISO/IEC 27001 i ISO 50001 tj. optimizaciju i unaprjeđenje poslovnih procesa, a što će doprinijeti povećanju njezine (međunarodne) konkurentnosti, olakšavanju pristupa (međunarodnom) tržištu i povećanju konkurentnosti MSP-ova certifikacijom sustava upravljanja u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi = preduvjeti za rast prihoda od prodaje (15,1%) i prihoda od izvoza (30,1%), do 2028. godine.

Operation_Name_English: Development of a modular solution for data center management and cyber resilience - POLARIS
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj modularnog rješenja za upravljanje i kibernetičku otpornost podatkovnih centara - POLARIS
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: This project is planned for the duration of 30 months to establish a SPIN consortium consisting of the applicant company Cratis d.o.o., Neyho informatika d.o.o., TEB automatika d.o.o. and Chaos d.o.o. and the Faculty of Organization and Informatics (FOI). The aim of the project is to implement activities with the aim of developing two innovative products of POLARIS AURORA and POLARIS NEXUS intended for users and managers of data centers of the highest level of cybersecurity.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom se u trajanju od 30. mjeseci planira uspostava SPIN konzorcija kojeg čine prijavitelj tvrtka Cratis d.o.o., te poduzeća Neyho informatika d.o.o., TEB automatika d.o.o. i Chaos d.o.o. te Fakulteta organizacije i informatike (FOI). Cilj projekta je provedba aktivnosti s ciljem razvoja dva inovativna proizvoda POLARIS AURORA i POLARIS NEXUS namjenjenih korisnicima i upraviteljima podatkovnih centara najviše razine kibernetičke sigurnosti.

Operation_Name_English: PONOS IV - Helper in Teaching - Let's support students with developmental difficulties IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PONOS IV - POmoćnika u Nastavi - OSigurajmo učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju IV
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support activities to students with disabilities in educational institutions in mastering educational and personal tasks, in order to ensure conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization, emotional functioning and a model of inclusion in the community in the city of Varaždin.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osigurati aktivnosti podrške učenicima s teškoćama u odgojno-obrazovnim institucijama u savladavanju obrazovnih i osobnih zadaća, kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za unaprjeđenje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju, emocionalno funkcioniranje te model inkluzije u zajednici na području grada Varaždina.

Operation_Name_English: Decorating and equipping the Trilj Cultural Home
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uređenje i opremanje Kulturnog doma Trilj
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve public cultural infrastructure through the renovation and equipping of the Trilj Cultural Home. The applicant is the City of Trilj and the project partner of cultural institutions is the City Library of Trilj. The implementation of the project will make it possible to increase the number of visitors, especially members of vulnerable groups, for which new services tailored specifically to their needs will be developed. The project will enable more active participation of residents and visitors in cultural life and will create preconditions for the development of innovative services in culture. The target groups that will benefit from the implementation of the project are all potential visitors, members of vulnerable groups, artists, cultural associations and the business community through spillover effects.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je unaprjeđenje javne kulturne infrastrukture kroz obnovu i opremanje Kulturnog doma Trilj. Prijavitelj je Grad Trilj a projektni partner ustanova u kulturi Gradska knjižnica Trilj. Provedba projekta omogućit će povećanje broja posjetitelja osobito pripadnika ranjivih skupina za koje će se razviti nove usluge posebno prilagođene njihovim potrebama. Projekt će omogućiti aktivniju participaciju stanovnika i posjetitelja u kulturnom životu te će stvoriti preduvjete za razvoj inovativnih usluga u kulturi. Ciljne skupine koje će imati koristi od provedbe projekta su svi potencijalni posjetitelji, pripadnici ranjivih skupina, umjetnici, udruge u kulturi i poslovna zajednica kroz spillover efekte.

Operation_Name_English: Testing and certification of plugs of the company Robotic d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ispitivanje i certificiranje utikača poduzeća Robotic d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: This design performs testing and certification of plugs for connecting an electric vehicle to a charger according to standards IEC62196-1 and IEC62196-2. The aim of the project is to certify the plugs of foreign cars and foreign charging stations, which is a necessary precondition for entering the market and increasing the business activity of the company.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmetnim projektom vrši se ispitivanje i certificiranje utikača za spajanje električnog vozila na punjač prema normama IEC62196-1 i IEC62196-2. Cilj projekta je certificiranje utikača strane auta i strane punionice koji je nužni preduvjet izlaska na tržište i povećanju poslovne aktivnosti poduzeća.

Operation_Name_English: Portfolio guarantees
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Portfeljna jamstva
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: max. 80% guaranteed amount up to EUR 300,000 for new loans for investments in tangible and intangible assets and working capital
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: max. 80% jamčeni iznos do 300.000 EUR za nove kredite za ulaganja u materijalnu i nematerijalnu imovinu te obrtna sredstva

Operation_Name_English: Northern breakwater on the island of St. Catherine within the port open to public traffic of county importance – the port of Rovinj
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sjeverni lukobran na otoku Sveta Katarina unutar luke otvorene za javni promet županijskog značaja – luke Rovinj
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the construction of a breakwater on the northern side of the islet of Sv. Katarina, increasing the safety of maritime traffic in the port of Rovinj and improving the transport connectivity and accessibility to the islet of St. Catherine. It's Catherine. The project has a positive impact on the safety of navigation in the port of Rovinj and the provision of conditions for the regular and safe maintenance of maritime traffic between Rovinj and the surrounding islands. The total value of the project is EUR 8,038,304.19 and the eligible costs EUR 7,909,817.14. The ineligible costs amount to EUR 128,487.05 and relate to ineligible activities (project and study documentation costs, management and administration costs). The estimated duration of the project is 24 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgradnja lukobrana na sjevernoj strani otočića sv. Katarina, povećanje sigurnosti pomorskog prometa u luci Rovinj i poboljšanje prometne povezanosti i pristupačnosti otočiću sv. Katarina. Projektom se pozitivno utječe na sigurnost plovidbe u luci Rovinj te osiguravanja uvjeta za redovito i sigurno održavanje pomorskog prometa između Rovinja i okolnih otoka. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 8.038.304,19 EUR, a prihvatljivih troškova 7.909.817,14 EUR. Neprihvatljivi troškovi iznose 128.487,05 EUR i odnose se na neprihvatljive aktivnosti (troškovi projektne i studijske dokumentacije, troškovi upravljanja i administracije). Predviđeno trajanje provedbe projekta je 24 mjeseca.

Operation_Name_English: Holidays in your day
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmor u vašem danu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: This project solves the problem of overload and exhaustion of people who care for a household member dependent on their support, through the provision of services of assistants, rehabilitators and physiotherapists. They take on care responsibilities and provide care and support to users, allowing caregivers time to rest. This approach improves the balance between family responsibilities and personal life, providing caregivers with much-needed rest from care and contributing to their recovery. These activities raise the quality of life of carers and beneficiaries and strengthen their social inclusion. The project will involve a minimum of 25 persons who have a recognised right to the status of parent caregiver/carer and will be provided with a rest service from care for a minimum of 320 days.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom rješava se problem preopterećenosti i iscrpljenosti osoba koje brinu o članu kućanstva ovisnom o njihovoj podršci, kroz pružanje usluga asistenta, rehabilitatora i fizioterapeuta. Oni preuzimaju skrbničke obaveze i pružaju njegu i podršku korisnicima, omogućujući skrbnicima vrijeme za odmor. Ovakav pristup poboljšava ravnotežu između obiteljskih obaveza i osobnog života, pružajući skrbnicima prijeko potreban odmor od skrbi i doprinoseći njihovom oporavku. Ovim se aktivnostima podiže kvaliteta života skrbnika i korisnika te jača njihova socijalna uključenost. U projektu će sudjelovati min.25 osoba koje imaju priznato pravo na status roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja te će im usluga odmora od skrbi biti pružena min. 320 dana.

Operation_Name_English: Active in the community - Phase IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Aktivne u zajednici - faza IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: 15 service providers will provide support and support in everyday life for 33 months for a total of 110 elderly people and people with disabilities from the area of the Municipality of Štitar. The main activities are the recruitment of project coordinators and 15 service providers who will provide support and support services for 33 months, the organization and holding of the initial and final conference, the procurement and distribution of household and basic hygiene packages, the writing of reports, requests for reimbursement of funds and other communication with the competent authorities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: 15 pružatelja usluge pružit će uslugu potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu kroz 33 mjeseca za ukupno 110 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom s područja Općine Štitar. Glavne aktivnosti su zapošljavanje koordinatora na projektu i 15 pružatelja usluga koji će usluge potpore i podrške pružati kroz 33 mjeseca, organiziranje i održavanje početne i završne konferencije, nabava i podjela kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih paketa, pisanje izvješća, zahtjeva za nadoknadom sredstava i druga komunikacija s nadležnim tijelima.

Operation_Name_English: Design of the Žnjan plateau
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uređenje Žnjanskog platoa
Category_Label: Rehabilitation of industrial sites and contaminated land|Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The renovation of the Žnjan plateau is a strategic project that will, through the revitalization of the neglected plateau into the largest green sports and recreation zone on the coastal part of the Urban Agglomeration of Split (UAS), improve the quality of life and identity of Split. The project will create the preconditions for a sustainable urban environment and a healthy environment that contribute to mitigating the effects of climate change, preserving biodiversity and integrating blue and green infrastructure. At the same time, a balanced spatial distribution of green and sports-recreational zones will be ensured, which will be available and accessible to all UAS residents and visitors throughout the year.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Uređenje Žnjanskog platoa strateški je projekt kojim će se, kroz revitalizaciju zapuštenog platoa u najveću zelenu sportsko-rekreacijsku zonu na obalnom dijelu Urbane aglomeracije Split (UAS), unaprijediti kvaliteta života i identitet Splita. Projektom će se stvoriti preduvjeti za održivi urbani okoliš i zdravo okruženje koji doprinose ublažavanju efekata klimatskih promjena, očuvanju bioraznolikosti te integraciji plave i zelene infrastrukture. Istovremeno će se osigurati ravnomjerna prostorna distribucija zelenih i sportsko-rekreativnih zona koje će biti dostupne i pristupačne za sve stanovnike i posjetitelje UAS-a tijekom cijele godine.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of Intelligent Transport Systems in the Functional Transport Area of the City of Split - Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje inteligentnih transportnih sustava na funkcionalnom prometnom području Grada Splita - II faza
Category_Label: Digitalisation of urban transport
Operation_Summary_English: Intelligent transport systems (ITS) represent the control and information and communication upgrade of the classical traffic system that will contribute to the creation of a more efficient transport system in the functional traffic area of the city of Split in the form of increasing safety, productivity, traffic efficiency and sustainability and reducing traffic congestion. The project is implemented in two phases with a total value of 12,757,241.01 euros. 1. The phase in the period from 27 April 2021 to 26 December 2023 and in that period 3,290,853.65 euros of eligible costs were spent, and in phase 2, in the period from 1 December 2023 to 31 December 2025, the total amount of eligible costs will be 9,466,387.31 euros.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Inteligentni transportni sustavi (ITS) predstavljaju upravljačku i informacijsko-komunikacijsku nadgradnju klasičnog sustava prometa koji će na funkcionalnom prometnom području grada Splita doprinijeti stvaranju učinkovitijeg prometnog sustava u vidu povećanja sigurnosti, produktivnosti, prometne efikasnosti i održivosti te smanjenju prometnih zagušenja. Provedba projekta se odvija u dvije faze ukupne vrijednosti 12.757.241,01 eura. 1. Faza u razdoblju od 27.04.2021.-26.12.2023. i u tom razdoblju je utrošeno 3.290.853,65 eura prihvatljivih troškova, a u 2. fazi, u razdoblju od 01.12.2023.-31.12.2025. ukupan iznos prihvatljivih troškova će iznositi 9.466.387,31 eura.

Operation_Name_English: I think of them IV.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mislimo na njih IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will focus on social inclusion and will contribute to the prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups including the elderly and people with disabilities in the Šibenik-Knin County by providing long-term care services. Project activities: -recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group (organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene, meeting long daily needs) -monitoring and control of performed services -procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene items -communication and visibility -project management and administration -finding members of the target group respecting the principles of equal treatment and non-discrimination
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt će se usmjeriti na socijalno uključivanje i doprinijeti će prevenciji institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina uključujući starije i osobe s invaliditetom na području Šibensko-kninske županije osiguravanjem usluge dugotrajne skrbi. Projektne aktivnosti: -zapošljavanje pružatelja usluge za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine (organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, zadovoljavanje dugih svakodnevnih potreba) -praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga -nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština -komunikacija i vidljivost -upravljanje projektom i administracija -pronalazak pripadnika ciljane skupine poštujući načela jednakog postupanja te zabrane diskriminacije

Operation_Name_English: SMART-HOTEL 360
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SMART-HOTEL 360
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The SMART-HOTEL 360 project addresses key problems in the hotel industry such as energy inefficiency, manual workflows, lack of system integration and low guest satisfaction. The aim of the project is to develop and implement innovative technological solutions that will improve resource management, automate work processes and improve user experience. Specific goals include increasing energy efficiency, automating work processes using large language models (LLMs), improving user experience and system integration. The same will be achieved in the consortium ADRIA-ELECTRONIC d.o.o. with Trillium d.o.o., RIS d.o.o. and RITEH.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt SMART-HOTEL 360 adresira ključne probleme u hotelskoj industriji kao što su energetska neučinkovitost, manualni radni procesi, nedostatak integracije sustava i nisko zadovoljstvo gostiju. Cilj projekta je razviti i implementirati inovativna tehnološka rješenja koja će unaprijediti upravljanje resursima, automatizirati radne procese i poboljšati korisničko iskustvo. Specifični ciljevi uključuju povećanje energetske učinkovitosti, automatizaciju radnih procesa korištenjem velikih jezičnih modela (LLM), unapređenje korisničkog iskustva i integraciju sustava. Isto će se ostvariti u konzorciju ADRIA-ELECTRONIC d.o.o. s Trillium-om d.o.o., RIS-om d.o.o. i RITEH-om.

Operation_Name_English: Construction and equipping of an institution for preschool education - regional kindergarten with kitchen in Totovec
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja i opremanje ustanove za predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje - područni vrtić s kuhinjom u Totovcu
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: In the area of LSGUs, the City of Čakovec's existing kindergarten capacities are not sufficient to provide preschool education services for all children of the crèche/kindergarten age. The need to build a completely new regional kindergarten building with a kitchen and 2 living rooms (1 nursery and 1 nursery) was identified. The aim of the project is to provide sufficient infrastructure and material capacity for 12 new nursery places and 20 new nursery places by building a new regional kindergarten. The target group are newly enrolled children of the nursery and kindergarten age who are users of early/pre-school education services of the kindergarten. With this investment, the City of Čakovec will increase the availability of early childhood education and care in the area of local self-government units.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Na području JLS-a Grad Čakovec postojeći vrtićki kapaciteti nisu dostatni za pružanje usluge predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja za svu djecu jasličkog/vrtićkog uzrasta. Detektirana je potreba za izgradnjom potpuno novog objekta područnog vrtića sa kuhinjom i 2 dnevna boravka (1 jaslički boravak i 1 vrtićki boravak ). Cilj projekta je izgradnjom novog područnog vrtića osigurati dostatne infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete za 12 novih jasličkih mjesta i 20 novih vrtićkih mjesta. Ciljna skupina su novo upisana djeca jasličkog i vrtićkog uzrasta korisnici usluga ranog/predškolskog odgoj i obrazovanja područnog vrtića. Navedenim ulaganjem povećati će dostupnost ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja na području JLS-a Grad Čakovec.

Operation_Name_English: We Help the Elders IV vol. I – MIPOS IV- vol. I
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mi Pomažemo starijima IV vol. I – MIPOS IV- vol. I
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project We Help the Elders IV vol I-MISOP IV vol will employ 30 service providers who will provide support and support services and deliver household and hygiene kits to 180 end-users. The aim of the project is to reduce the risk of poverty and social exclusion of people over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities and the project will contribute to greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in their own home and ensuring the right to live in the community for target groups from the cities of Zabok, Oroslavje, Krapina, Zlatar and Donja Stubica and the municipalities of Bedekovčina, Krapinske Toplice, Sveti Križ Začretje, Veliko Trgovišće, Marija Bistrica, Stubičke Toplice, Radoboj, Mihovljan and Mače.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Mi Pomažemo Starijima IV vol I-MISOP IV vol će se zaposliti 30 pružatelja usluge koji će pružiti uslugu potpore i podrške te isporučivati pakete kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština za 180 krajnjih korisnika. Cilj projekta je smanjenje rizika od siromaštva i socijalne isključenosti osoba starijih od 65 godina i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom te će projekt doprinijeti većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguranju prava na život u zajednici za ciljane skupine s područja gradova Zaboka, Oroslavja, Krapine, Zlatara i Donje Stubice te općina Bedekovčine, Krapinske Toplice, Sveti Križ Začretje, Veliko Trgovišće, Marije Bistrice, Stubičke Toplice, Radoboj, Mihovljan i Mače.

Operation_Name_English: Management system certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes the certification of information security management systems (ISO/IEC 27001:2022) and business continuity (ISO 22301:2019). By doing so, Demil Tech will improve data security, resilience against operational risks and competitiveness in the European market. Certification enables easier access to international tenders, increases the trust of business partners and ensures compliance with the highest security standards
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća certifikaciju sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću (ISO/IEC 27001:2022) i kontinuitetom poslovanja (ISO 22301:2019). Time će Demil Tech poboljšati sigurnost podataka, otpornost na operativne rizike i konkurentnost na europskom tržištu. Certifikacija omogućuje lakši pristup međunarodnim natječajima, povećava povjerenje poslovnih partnera i osigurava usklađenost s najvišim sigurnosnim standardima

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Social Plan of the City of Zagreb
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada Socijalnog plana Grada Zagreba
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of the project are the development of a Social Plan of the City of Zagreb based on the analysis of existing social services, availability and capacity of social service providers in the districts of the City of Zagreb; identification of needs, areas and priorities for the development of existing as well as new social services, in particular for user groups at higher risk of social exclusion, coordinated between different levels of government, public services, social service providers and other stakeholders from social welfare systems, but also other social policy systems, definition of cross-sectoral measures and activities of interest to the target groups; empowering experts for social planning, implementation and monitoring of the Social Plan of the City of Zagreb through the implementation of the educational program.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta su izrada Socijalnog plana Grada Zagreba temeljenog na analizi postojećih socijalnih usluga, dostupnosti i kapacitetu pružatelja socijalnih usluga po četvrtima grada Zagreba; utvrđivanje potreba, područja i prioriteta za razvoj postojećih, kao i novih socijalnih usluga, posebice za korisničke skupine u većem riziku od socijalne isključenosti, usklađenih između različitih razina vlasti, javnih službi, pružatelja socijalnih usluga i drugih dionika iz sustava socijalne skrbi, ali i drugih sustava socijalne politike, definiranje međusektorskih mjera i aktivnosti od interesa za ciljne skupine; osnaživanje stručnjaka za socijalno planiranje, provedbu i praćenje Socijalnog plana Grada Zagreba provedbom edukacijskog programa.

Operation_Name_English: You're not alone - and
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nisi sam - I
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the prevention of institutionalization, staying in one's own home, increasing social inclusion and the level of quality of life for people aged 65 and over and adults with disabilities through activities of providing daily assistance and support services, as an integral measure of long-term care in the rural area of Sisak-Moslavina County. Support and support services in addition to the purchase and distribution of packages of necessities also include assistance in organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene. The service will be provided for a minimum of 102 members of the target group over 34 months by 17 newly recruited service providers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je prevencija institucionalizacije, ostanak u vlastitom domu, povećanje socijalne uključenosti i razine kvalitete života osobama u dobi od 65 i više godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom kroz aktivnosti pružanja usluge svakodnevne pomoći i podrške, kao sastavne mjere dugotrajne skrbi na ruralnom području Sisačko-moslavačke županije. Usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština uključuju i pomoć u organiziranju prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene. Uslugu će se osigurati za minimalno 102 pripadnika ciljne skupine kroz 34 mjeseca od strane 17 novozaposlenih pružatelja usluga.

Operation_Name_English: Strategic Green Energy Partnership - OptiNERG
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strateško partnerstvo za zelenu energiju – OptiNERG
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The green transition of society poses technical challenges to ensure a stable supply of electricity in conditions of high demand and high dependence on renewable energy sources and is a response to better governance. The OptiNERG consortium is only one part of this ecosystem that aims to develop technologies that would enable the rapid adaptation of building and public energy infrastructure systems to new multi-tariff dynamic energy systems and achieve economic savings for end-users.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Zelena tranzicija društva postavlja tehničke izazove kako u uvjetima visoke potražnje i visoke ovisnosti o obnovljivim izvorima energije osigurati stabilnu isporuku električne energije i odgovor je u boljem upravljanju. OptiNERG konzorcij samo je jedan dio u tom ekosustavu koji za cilj ima razvoj tehnologija koje bi omogućile brzo prilagođavanje sustava u zgradarstvu i javne energetske infrastrukture novim vise-tarifnim dinamičkim energetskim sustavima i ostvarenju ekonomskih ušteda za krajnje korisnike.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of PROTON EE- ELEKTRONIKA by introducing ISO certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti tvrtke PROTON EE- ELEKTRONIKA uvođenjem ISO certifikata
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to strengthen the company's internal capacities and facilitate access to the international market by introducing a business process management system into the business. The implementation of the ISO 9001 system will contribute to the efficient management of business processes, and ISO 45 001 will enable reliable and resilient business through risk prevention and continuous adaptation of business organization. The implementation of the project will contribute to strengthening competitiveness in the domestic and international markets. The contribution of the project is measurable through an increase in sales revenue of 30% and the realization of export revenue of EUR 200,000 in 2028. The target groups are the company's employees and management, as well as the entire value chain of PROTON EE-ELEKTRONIKA.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osnažiti interne kapacitete tvrtke te olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu uvođenjem sustava upravljanja poslovnim procesima u poslovanje. Implementacija sustava ISO 9001 doprinijet će efikasnom upravljanju poslovnim procesima, a ISO 45 001 omogućit će pouzdano i otporno poslovanje kroz prevenciju rizika i kontinuiranu prilagodbu organizacije poslovanja. Provedba projekta doprinijet će jačanju konkurentnosti na domaćem i međunarodnom tržištu. Doprinos projekta mjerljiv je kroz povećanje prihoda od prodaje 30% i ostvarenje prihoda od izvoza 200.000 EUR u 2028. godini. Ciljane skupine su zaposlenici i menadžment tvrtke, kao i čitav lanac vrijednosti tvrtke PROTON EE-ELEKTRONIKA.

Operation_Name_English: "Wish Ludbreg - We help the elderly, we prevent institutionalization"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Zaželi Ludbreg - Pomažemo starijima, preveniramo institucionalizaciju"
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of 120 elderly people from the wider Ludbreg region by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life to people over the age of 65. Support and support service activities will be carried out in addition to the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies that include the recruitment of 20 service providers for at least 6 members of the target group, monitoring and control, procurement and distribution of packages, communication and visibility, project management and administration. The duration of the project is 36 months, of which the support and support service will be provided for 28 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije 120 starijih osoba s područja šire ludbreške regije osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu osobama starijim od 65 godina. Provodit će se aktivnosti pružanja usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje zapošljavanje 20 pružatelja usluge za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine, praćenje i kontrola, nabava i podjela paketa, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija. Trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci od čega će se usluga potpore i podrške pružati 28 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Wishes for Kastela
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi Kaštela
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care over 33 months for at least 120 participants. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. Activities – employing 20 service providers to organise food, perform household chores, maintain personal hygiene and meet other daily needs; monitoring and control of the services performed; procurement and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies; communication and visibility; project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz 33 mjeseca za min. 120 sudionika. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnosti – zapošljavanje 20 pružatelja usluga organiziranje prehrane, obavljanja kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene i zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba; praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga; nabava i podjela kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština; komunikacija i vidljivost; upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Touch Technology 2.0
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dodir tehnologije 2.0
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: By implementing the project Touch Technology 2.0, the Gradionica association will strengthen its own program, professional and technical capacities to popularize STEM among children and students. For this purpose, they will realize 6 different trainings, 1 study trip and a visit to 1 fair, they will acquire new equipment for the implementation of new educational programs and significantly increase human capacities by hiring new lecturers. Through the project, he will achieve mentoring cooperation with the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing through 10 mentoring sessions and 2 trainings, while with the Institute of Physics he will realize 8 trainings. With 3 partner schools, they will work together to organize public STEM events and spend 540 workshops in 6 education programs for a total of 699 participants.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta Dodir tehnologije 2.0 udruga Gradionica osnažit će vlastite programske, stručne i tehničke kapacitete za popularizaciju STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. U tu svrhu, realizirati će 6 različitih izobrazbi, 1 studijsko putovanje te posjet 1 sajmu, nabavit će novu opremu za provedbu novih edukacijskih programa te značajno uvećati ljudske kapacitete zapošljavanjem novih predavača. Kroz projekt će ostvariti mentorsku suradnju s Fakultetom elektrotehnike i računarstva kroz 10 mentorskih sesija i 2 izobrazbe dok će s Institutom za fiziku realizirati 8 izobrazbi. S 3 partnerske škole će zajednički surađivati na organizaciji javnih STEM događanja i za ukupno 699 polaznika provesti 540 radionica u 6 programa edukacije.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the water communal infrastructure of the Pleternica agglomeration – PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj vodnokomunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Pleternica – FAZA 2
Category_Label: Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes the construction of a class III device with a capacity of 15,300 ES, and the reconstruction and upgrading of the existing drainage system with the aim of increasing the connection rate of the population to 90%. It is aligned with the EU directives on water and wastewater treatment. The goals include the construction and reconstruction of the drainage system, increasing the efficiency and reliability of the system, connecting new users and introducing the economic price of water. The project is implemented in two phases over the 2014-2020 and 2021-2027 periods. The total value of the eligible costs of the project is €35.40 million, the value of the eligible costs of phase 2 is €21.36 million. EUR 15,60 million, Phase 2 grant amount EUR
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća Izgradnja uređaja III. stupnja pročišćavanja kapaciteta 15.300 ES, te rekonstrukcija i dogradnja postojećeg sustava odvodnje s ciljem povećanja stope priključenosti stanovništva na 90%. Usklađuje se s EU direktivama o vodama i pročišćavanju otpadnih voda. Ciljevi uključuju izgradnju i rekonstrukciju sustava odvodnje, povećanje učinkovitosti i pouzdanosti sustava, priključenje novih korisnika te uvođenje ekonomske cijene vode. Projekt se provodi u dvije faze kroz razdoblja 2014.–2020. i 2021.–2027. Ukupna vrijednost prihvatljivih troškova projekta iznosi 35.40 mil., vrijednost prihvatljivih troškova 2. faze iznosi EUR, 21,36 mil. EUR, iznos bespovratnih sredstava 2. faze 15,60 mil. EUR

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the capacity of EMBER KAMIN d.o.o. through the introduction of management systems (ISO 9001 and ISO 14001) and product certification according to standard EN 16510-1:2022
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje kapaciteta poduzeća EMBER KAMIN d.o.o. kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja (ISO 9001 i ISO 14001) i certifikaciju proizvoda prema standardnu EN 16510-1:2022
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of the company EMBER KAMIN d.o.o. is focused on the introduction and certification of management systems according to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 standards and product certification according to EN 16510-1:2022 standard. The goal of the management system certification is the standardisation and optimization of business processes, while product certification ensures their compliance with international standards of quality, safety and sustainability, allowing access to new markets and strengthening customer confidence. It is expected to reduce operational risks, increase efficiency and develop more energy-efficient and environmentally friendly products, which will ensure the long-term growth and competitiveness of companies in the domestic and international markets and thus increase sales and export revenues.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt poduzeća EMBER KAMIN d.o.o. usmjeren je na uvođenje i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO 9001 i ISO 14001 te certifikaciju proizvoda prema standardu EN 16510-1:2022. Cilj certifikacije sustava upravljanja je standardizacija i optimizacija poslovnih procesa, dok certifikacija proizvoda osigurava njihovu usklađenost s međunarodnim normama kvalitete, sigurnosti i održivosti, omogućujući pristup novim tržištima i jačanje povjerenja kupaca. Očekuje se smanjenje operativnih rizika, povećanje učinkovitosti te razvoj energetski učinkovitijih i ekološki prihvatljivijih proizvoda, čime će se osigurati dugoročni rast i konkurentnost poduzeća na domaćem i međunarodnom tržištu te time povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza.

Operation_Name_English: "Employed" phase IV - providing support in everyday life to elderly people from the area of Slavonski Brod
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Zaposlena" faza IV - pružanje podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama s područja grada Slavonskog Broda
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to reduce the risk of social exclusion and institutionalization for 180 elderly people and adults with disabilities from the area of Slavonski Brod through the provision of support and support services in everyday life. The project objective will be achieved by carrying out support and support service activities with the procurement and distribution of a package of supplies that includes: -recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group for: organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene, meeting long living needs; -monitoring and control of performed services; -procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies; -communication and visibility; -Project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je smanjiti rizik od socijalne isključenosti i institucionalizacije za 180 starijih osoba i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom s područja Slavonskog Broda kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu. Projektni cilj ostvarit će se provođenjem aktivnosti usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje: -zapošljavanje pružatelja usluge za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine za: organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, zadovoljavanje dugih životnih potreba; -praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga; -nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština; -komunikaciju i vidljivost; -upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Renovation of family houses owned by the Republic of Croatia in earthquake-affected areas – Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obnova obiteljskih kuća u vlasništvu RH na potresom pogođenim područjima – faza II
Category_Label: Housing infrastructure (other than for migrants, refugees and persons under or applying for international protection)
Operation_Summary_English: The project envisages the renovation of at least 300 family houses damaged in the December 2020 earthquake in the Sisak-Moslavina and Karlovac counties, managed by the Ministry of Physical Planning, Construction and State Assets (hereinafter: MPUGDI) by assigning them to residential care in assisted areas. The project is a continuation or phase II of the project whose financing was approved under the OP Competitiveness and Cohesion 2014-2020. The estimated total value of the project (Phase II) is EUR 44,899,000, of which EUR 10,000,000 is provided from EU funds.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se previđa obnova najmanje 300 obiteljskih kuća oštećenih u potresu u prosincu 2020. na području Sisačko-moslavačke i Karlovačke županije, a kojima upravlja Ministarstvo prostornoga uređenja, graditeljstva i državne imovine (dalje u tekstu: MPUGDI) na način da ih dodjeljuje za potrebe stambenog zbrinjavanja na potpomognutim područjima. Projekt predstavlja nastavak odnosno fazu II projekta čije je financiranje odobreno u sklopu OP Konkurentnost i kohezija 2014-2020. Procijenjena ukupna vrijednost projekta (faze II) iznosi 44.899.000 eura, od čega se iz sredstava EU fondova osigurava 10.000.000 eura.

Operation_Name_English: Lynx Street and Lynx Snow
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Lynx Street i Lynx Snow
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The RASCO LYNX STREET and LYNX SNOW project aims to explore and develop 2 radical innovations whose application will allow the complete replacement of all compact utility vehicles available today with technologically, cost-effective and environmentally superior alternatives. Research at the level of battery, powertrain and controller, construction and materials, and optimisation of work processes will address the key shortcoming of today’s electric vehicles – the low range, thus enabling the full benefits of electric propulsion to be harnessed in maintaining public spaces. This will be achieved through intensive collaborative research and then development and demonstration in an operational environment. Target groups include SPIN consortium members, researchers and utilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt RASCO LYNX STREET i LYNX SNOW za cilj ima istražiti i razviti 2 radikalne inovacije čija će primjena omogućiti potpunu zamjenu svih danas dostupnih kompaktnih komunalnih vozila tehnološki, troškovno i ekološki superiornim alternativama. Istraživanjima na razini baterije, pogonskog i upravljačkog sklopa, konstrukcije i materijala te optimizacije radnih procesa adresirat će ključan nedostatak današnjih električnih vozila – nizak domet i tako omogućiti iskorištavanje svih prednosti električnog pogona u održavanju javnih površina. Ovo će se postići intenzivnim kolaborativnim istraživanjem, a zatim i razvojem te demonstracijom u operativnom okruženju. Ciljne skupine uključuju članove SPIN konzorcija, istraživače i komunalna poduzeća.

Operation_Name_English: P.U.K. - HOUSE "Wolf"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: P.U.K. - UOSI "Vuka"
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective: Increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care and support and support services for older people and persons with disabilities in their daily lives. The main activities relate to the provision of support and support services in everyday life as well as the provision of long-term care. Activities: recruitment of support and support service providers, procurement of hygiene kits, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj: Povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi te pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Glavne aktivnosti se odnose na pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu kao i osiguranje dugotrajne skrbi. Aktivnosti: zapošljavanje pružatelja usluge potpore i podrške, nabava paketa higijenskih potrepština, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a management system according to ISO 9001 and ISO 3834 standards that will make the company more competitive on the national and international market and thus enable its further growth in accordance with strategic goals. The implementation of the management system and the acquisition of ISO certification will result in greater customer confidence, but also a more productive, efficient and secure business, which is the interest of the company, employees, clients and suppliers who are the target group of the project. By implementing the project, the company will be able to get new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards, and in which so far it has not been able to compete.
