Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normi ISO 9001 i ISO 3834 koji će tvrtku učiniti konkurentnijom na nacionalnom i internacionalnom tržištu te joj time omogućiti daljnji rast u skladu sa strateškim ciljevima. Implementacija sustava upravljanja i stjecanje ISO certifikata rezultirat će većim povjerenjem kupaca, ali i produktivnijim, efikasnijim i sigurnijim poslovanjem, što je interes tvrtke, djelatnika, klijenata i dobavljača koji su ciljana skupina projekta. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama, a u kojima do sada nije mogla konkurirati.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - help is there
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - pomoć je tu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will contribute to the prevention of institutionalization and increase the social inclusion of vulnerable groups in the area of the city of Mursko Središće, the municipality of Selnica and the municipality of Mala Subotica by providing support and support services in everyday life to the elderly and people with disabilities. 11 service providers will be employed, covering 66 persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities over a period of 34 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt će doprinijeti prevenciji institucionalizacije i povećanju socijalne uključenosti ranjivih skupina na području grada Mursko Središće, općine Selnica i općine Mala Subotica pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Zaposlit će se 11 pružatelja usluge te obuhvatiti 66 osoba starijih od 65 godina i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom u periodu od 34 mjeseca.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a bicycle-pedestrian path in Josipa bana Jelačića Street in Čepin
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističko-pješačke staze u ulici Josipa bana Jelačića u Čepinu
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the construction of more than a kilometre long cycling trail and related infrastructure intended for the use of environmentally friendly means of transport and better transport connections in the Municipality of Čepin. The track will be integrated with already realized transport projects (Osijek -Antunovac-Ernestinovo-Laslovo) and planned cycling infrastructure projects (Osijek-Livana-Čepin-Vladislavci and Osijek-Antunovac-Ivanovac-Čepin). The target group of the project are residents of the Municipality of Čepin, as well as all cyclists who will use the cycling infrastructure in the area of cycling-related UA Osijek in the future.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgradnja više od kilometra duge biciklističke staze i s njom povezane infrastrukture namijenjene korištenju ekološki prihvatljivih sredstava prijevoza i boljoj prometnoj povezanosti u Općini Čepin. Predmetna staza biti će integrirana s već realiziranim prometnim projektima (Osijek -Antunovac-Ernestinovo-Laslovo) te planiranim projektima biciklističke infrastrukture (Osijek-Livana-Čepin-Vladislavci te Osijek-Antunovac-Ivanovac-Čepin). Ciljna skupina projekta su stanovnici Općine Čepin, kao i svi biciklisti koji će u budućnosti koristiti biciklističku infrastrukturu na području biciklistički povezane UA Osijek.

Operation_Name_English: Integrated Water Supply and Drainage System Project of Cetinska Krajina - Trilj, Otok and Dicmo - PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Projekt integralnog sustava vodoopskrbe i odvodnje Cetinske krajine – Trilj, Otok i Dicmo - FAZA 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project envisages the reconstruction, rehabilitation and upgrading of the public water supply and sewage system in the area of the agglomerations of Trilj and Otok and the Municipality of Dicmo, as well as the extension and upgrading of the UPOV 2 treatment level of the existing capacity of 3 500 p.e. to a capacity of 6 000 p.e. The project envisages the connection of 5 662 new inhabitants to the sewage system and 135 new inhabitants to the water supply system. Approximately 32,000 flats in the wider area are expected to have an improved public water supply service.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt predviđa rekonstrukciju, sanaciju i dogradnju sustava javne vodoopskrbe i odvodnje otpadnih voda na području aglomeracija Trilj i Otok te Općina Dicmo kao i proširenje i dogradnju UPOV-a 2. stupnja pročišćavanja postojećeg kapaciteta 3 500 ES na kapacitet od 6 000 ES. Projektom je predviđeno priključenje 5 662 novih stanovnika na sustav odvodnje otpadnih voda i 135 novih stanovnika na sustav vodoopskrbe. Predviđeno je da će oko 32 000 stan. šireg područja imati poboljšanu uslugu javne vodoopskrbe.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of ISO 22301:2019 and ISO 20000-1:2018
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje ISO 22301:2019 i ISO 20000-1:2018
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Support for companies to certify products and implement management systems
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Potpora poduzećima za certifikaciju proizvoda i uvođenje sustava upravljanja

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of the exhibition space and creation of the permanent exhibition of the Sisak City Museum
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obnova izložbenog prostora i izrada stalnog postava Gradskog muzeja Sisak
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The City Museum of Sisak as the Applicant and the City of Sisak as a Partner in the project "Renovation of the exhibition space and creation of the permanent exhibition of the City Museum of Sisak" ensure an increase in accessibility and participation in the cultural life of all citizens, especially members of vulnerable groups and the creation of preconditions for the development of innovative services in culture. The project will renew and equip the museum space for the purpose of organizing new and improving existing services in culture, and the implementation of technological innovations, educational activities and new services and programs of the museum will enable greater involvement of all visitors to the museum. The target groups are the Museum and the City of Sisak, while the end users are persons belonging to vulnerable groups and all visitors and the wider community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Gradski muzej Sisak kao Prijavitelj i Grad Sisak kao Partner na projektu „Obnova izložbenog prostora i izrada stalnog postava Gradskog muzeja Sisak“ osiguravaju povećanje pristupačnosti i sudjelovanja u kulturnom životu svih građana, osobito pripadnika ranjivih skupina i stvaranje preduvjet za razvoj inovativnih usluga u kulturi. Projektom će se obnoviti i opremiti prostor muzeja u svrhu organizacije novih i poboljšanja postojećih usluga u kulturi, a implementacijom tehnoloških inovacija, edukativnih aktivnosti i novih usluga i programa muzeja, omogućit će se veća uključenost svim posjetiteljima Muzeja. Ciljne skupine su Muzej i Grad Sisak, dok su krajnji korisnici osobe pripadnici ranjivih skupina te svi posjetitelji i šira zajednica.

Operation_Name_English: I teach, I work, I help Slavonia IV.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Učim, radim, pomažem Slavoniji IV.
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support in everyday life for 186 elderly people and people with disabilities. The service will be provided by 31 providers who will be employed on the project for 32 months, each providing a service for at least 6 users of the target group. In addition to the service, 186 users of the target group will receive a package of basic household and hygiene supplies per month. Persons will be employed who will control the services performed and work on project management and administration. Communication and visibility activities will be carried out and promotional materials will be procured.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružiti uslugu potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 186 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom. Uslugu će pružati 31 pružatelj koji će biti zaposlen na projektu kroz 32 mjeseca, a svaki će pružati uslugu za min 6 korisnika pripadnika ciljane skupine. 186 korisnika pripadnika ciljane skupine mjesečno će uz uslugu primati i paket osnovnih kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština. Zaposlit će se osobe koje će vršiti kontrolu izvršenih usluga te raditi na upravljanju projektom i administriranju. Provodit će se aktivnosti komunikacije i vidljivosti te će se nabaviti promotivni materijali.

Operation_Name_English: Development and testing of Fischertechnik TXT robots for WRO competitions
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj i testiranje Fischertechnik TXT robota za WRO natjecanja
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal "Development and testing of Fischertechnik TXT robots for WRO competitions" addresses the challenges in the development of educational robotics, with an emphasis on the integration of advanced technologies such as computer vision, artificial intelligence and programming in Python. The aim of the project is to develop and test innovative robot models adapted to World Robot Olympiad (WRO) competitions, ensuring their practical application in educational institutions and STEM associations. Target groups include schools, mentors and students preparing for competitions, enabling them to use advanced technologies and improve STEM competences.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni prijedlog "Razvoj i testiranje Fischertechnik TXT robota za WRO natjecanja" adresira izazove u razvoju edukacijske robotike, s naglaskom na integraciju naprednih tehnologija poput računalnog vida, umjetne inteligencije i programiranja u Pythonu. Cilj projekta je razvoj i testiranje inovativnih robotskih modela prilagođenih World Robot Olympiad (WRO) natjecanjima, čime se osigurava njihova praktična primjena u obrazovnim institucijama i STEM udrugama. Ciljne skupine uključuju škole, mentore i učenike koji se pripremaju za natjecanja, omogućujući im korištenje naprednih tehnologija i unaprjeđenje STEM kompetencija.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of the management system of Vanado d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija sustava upravljanja poduzeća Vanado d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of the Applicant through certification according to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 standards. Certification enables the standardisation of IT service management and information security, increasing customer trust and facilitating access to international markets. Expected results include increased sales and export revenues, optimization of business processes and compliance with EU regulations. The project ensures long-term sustainability and strengthens the competitive advantage through the certification of key management systems.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti Prijavitelja kroz certifikaciju prema normama ISO/IEC 27001:2022 i ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018. Certifikacija omogućuje standardizaciju upravljanja IT uslugama i informacijskom sigurnošću, povećavajući povjerenje klijenata i olakšavajući pristup međunarodnim tržištima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza, optimizaciju poslovnih procesa te usklađenost s EU regulativama. Projekt osigurava dugoročnu održivost i jačanje konkurentske prednosti kroz certifikaciju ključnih sustava upravljanja.

Operation_Name_English: KOMOD - DEVELOPMENT OF COMPENSERS/MODERATORS BY APPLICATION OF 3D ADITIVE TECHNOLOGY
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: KOMOD - RAZVOJ NAPREDNIH KOMPENZATORA/MODERATORA PRIMJENOM 3D ADITIVNIH TEHNOLOGIJA
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project KOMOD - DEVELOPMENT OF NEXT COMPANY/MODERATORS by applying 3D ADITIVE TECHNOLOGIES is the development of new innovative products of high added value through the implementation of the collaborative research and development project Topomatika doo, IZIT doo, TEHNOPROGRES doo, and METAL LANGUAGE ČAKOVEC within the RLV PAMETNE INDUSTRIA, a priority niche of PRODUCT TECHNOLOGIES AND MODELS FOR INDUSTRIAN 4.0, and DUAL USE - PRODUCTS OF DUBLE PURPOSE, within TPP SECURITY AND DOUBLE PURPOSE (S3). The project contributes to encouraging structural changes in the economy of Northern Croatia through the development of new products and services in niches of higher added value, and encouraging the resolution of key social challenges of the North Croatia region.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta KOMOD - RAZVOJ NAPREDNIH KOMPENZATORA/MODERATORA PRIMJENOM 3D ADITIVNIH TEHNOLOGIJA je razvoj novih inovativnih proizvoda visoke dodane vrijednosti provedbom suradničkog projekta istraživanja i razvoja Topomatika doo, IZIT doo, TEHNOPROGRES doo, te METALSKA JEZGRA ČAKOVEC u okviru RLV PAMETNE INDUSTRIJE, prioritetne niše PROIZVODNE TEHNOLOGIJE I MODELI ZA INDUSTRIJU 4.0, te DUAL USE – PROIZVODI DVOJNE NAMJENE, u okviru TPP SIGURNOST I DVOJNA NAMJENA (S3). Projekt doprinosi poticanju strukturnih promjena u gospodarstvu Sjeverne Hrvatske kroz razvoj novih proizvoda i usluga u nišama više dodane vrijednosti, te poticanje rješavanja ključnih društvenih izazova regije Sjeverna Hrvatska.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of management systems according to international ISO standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija sustava upravljanja prema međunarodnim ISO standardima
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to implement and certify management systems according to ISO 27001, ISO 22301, ISO 9001 and ISO 14001. Certification will increase the company's competitiveness, reduce operational risks and improve service quality and business stability. Expected results include strengthening international competitiveness, which will directly affect the growth of sales and export revenues in the post-project period. The total duration of the project is 4 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt ima cilj implementirati i certificirati sustave upravljanja prema ISO 27001, ISO 22301, ISO 9001 i ISO 14001. Certifikacija će povećati konkurentnost tvrtke, smanjiti operativne rizike te poboljšati kvalitetu usluga i stabilnost poslovanja. Očekivani rezultati uključuju jačanje međunarodne konkurentnosti, što će direktno utjecati na rast prihoda od prodaje i izvoza u periodu nakon projekta. Ukupno trajanje projekta je 4 mjeseca.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - help for a better life
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - pomoć za bolji život
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups from the Imotski region by providing support and support services in everyday life for at least 72 elderly people and OSI in order to ensure their stay in their own home and the right to live in the community. Activities include the recruitment of 12 service providers for at least 6 members of the target group who will organize nutrition, perform household chores, maintain personal hygiene and meet other daily needs useful, monitoring and control of performed services procurement and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and visibility as well as project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina s područja Imotske krajine osiguravanjem pružanja usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za minimalno 72 starije osobe i OSI kako bi se osigurao njihov ostanak u vlastitom domu i pravo na život u zajednici. Aktivnosti uključuju zapošljavanje 12 pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine koji će organizirati prehranu, obavljati kućanske poslove, održavati osobnu higijenu i zadovoljavati druge svakodnevne potrebe korisna, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih uslugama nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikaciju i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of the DINGO platform in the conditions of insufficient, missing or low-quality data
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unapređenje platforme DINGO u uvjetima nedostatnih, nepostojećih ili niskokvalitetnih podataka
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Innovation DINGO (Distribution Grid Optimization) is an advanced system for monitoring electrical quantities and managing technical and non-technical losses in the low-voltage distribution network. The aim of the project is to upgrade the system by integrating an algorithm to work with incomplete and inaccurate data, which will enable more efficient management of distribution networks. Project activities are intended for distribution system operators (DSOs), as well as the local economic, social and scientific community, and the company's management, business partners and employees.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Inovacija DINGO (Distribution grid optimization) je napredni sustav za praćenje električnih veličina i upravljanje tehničkim i netehničkim gubicima u niskonaponskoj distribucijskoj mreži. Cilj projekta je nadogradnja sustava integracijom algoritma za rad s nepotpunim i netočnim podacima, čime će se omogućiti učinkovitije upravljanje distribucijskim mrežama. Projektne aktivnosti namijenjene su operatorima distribucijskih sustava (ODS), kao i lokalnoj gospodarskoj, društvenoj i znanstvenoj zajednici, te upravi društva, poslovnim partnerima i zaposlenicima.

Operation_Name_English: Adaptation and equipping of the space on the 1st floor in the Drniš Kindergarten
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Adaptacija i opremanje prostora na 1. katu u Dječjem vrtiću Drniš
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide infrastructural and material capacities to increase the availability of early childhood education and care in the City of Drniš through the adaptation and equipping of an additional room for kindergarten stay in the Drniš Kindergarten in the City of Drniš.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osigurati infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja na području Grada Drniša kroz adaptaciju i opremanje dodatne prostorije za vrtićki boravak u Dječjem vrtiću Drniš u Gradu Drnišu.

Operation_Name_English: PUŠĆA BIKE VOL2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PUŠĆA BIKE VOL2
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the construction of a section of a pedestrian-bike trail with the equipping of a length of 1.120 m at the part of the Kumrovec road in the Municipality of Pušća. This route is a continuation of the pedestrian-bike trail along the Lužnica stream, which connected the town of Zaprešić and the Municipality of Pušće. This route is part of the Zaprešička cyclotourism routes, which include the route of the Municipality of Marija Gorica – Brdovec – Pušća and the route Kupljenvo – Luka – Dubravica – Marija Gorica – Pušća. The route is the capillary road of the cycling Zagorje highway D6. The target group of the project are residents of the Municipality of Pušća, as well as all cyclists who will use the cycling infrastructure in the area of the bicycle-connected UA Zagreb in the future.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgradnja dionice pješačko- biciklističke staze sa opremanjem duljine 1.120 m na djelu Kumrovečke ceste u Općini Pušća. Navedena trasa je nastavak pješačko-biciklističke staze uz potok Lužnicu koja je spojila grad Zaprešić i Općinu Pušću. Navedena trasa je dio Zaprešičkih cikloturističkih ruta koja obuhvaća rutu Općine Marija Gorica – Brdovec – Pušća i rutu Kupljenovo – Luka – Dubravica – Marija Gorica – Pušća. Trase je kapilarna cesta biciklističke Zagorske magistrale D6. Ciljna skupina projekta su stanovnici Općine Pušća, kao i svi biciklisti koji će u budućnosti koristiti biciklističku infrastrukturu na području biciklistički povezane UA Zagreb.

Operation_Name_English: Wish and get involved
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi i uključi se
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. 25 people will be employed to provide support and support services to a vulnerable group, at least 150 people, in their daily lives in their homes in the city of Metković. The project will provide monthly parcel deliveries to a vulnerable group. Through promotional activities and materials, we will regularly inform the public about project activities. The total duration of the project is 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Bit će zaposleno 25 osoba koje će ranjivoj skupini, minimalno 150 osoba, pružati usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu u njihovim domovima na području grada Metkovića. Kroz projekt će biti osigurane mjesečne isporuke paketa ranjivoj skupini. Kroz promidžbene aktivnosti i materijale ćemo javnost redovno informirati o projektnim aktivnostima. Ukupno trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading the Bubamara Kindergarten in Donja Stubica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja Dječjeg vrtića Bubamara u Donjoj Stubici
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The City of Donja Stubica, in cooperation with its partners Bubamara Kindergarten and the Municipality of Bedekovčina, is upgrading and reconstructing the existing Kindergarten with the project ‘Upgrading the Bubamara Kindergarten in Donja Stubica’, increasing its spatial and technical capacity and providing 5 living rooms (2 nursery and 3 kindergarten groups). As a result, the project will provide a kindergarten with an additional capacity for 84 children from the area of the City of Donja Stubica and the Municipality of Bedekovčina.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: S ciljem osiguranja dostatnih kapaciteta za potrebe smještaja djece rane i predškolske dobi, Grad Donja Stubica u suradnji s partnerima Dječjim vrtićem Bubamara i Općinom Bedekovčina, projektom „Dogradnja Dječjeg vrtića Bubamara u Donjoj Stubici“ dograđuje i rekonstruira postojeći dječji vrtić, povećava njegove prostorne i tehničke kapacitete te osigurava 5 dnevnih boravaka (2 jasličke i 3 vrtićke skupine). Kao rezultat, projektom će se osigurati boravak u vrtiću dodatnog kapaciteta za 84 djece s područja Grada Donja Stubica i Općine Bedekovčina.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening competitiveness through certification of management systems according to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO 22301:2019
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti certifikacijom sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO/IEC 27001:2022 i ISO 22301:2019
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve the international competitiveness of Expert i4next by certifying the management system according to ISO 22301:2019 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022. The purpose is to standardise business processes and establish a business continuity management system and an information security management system to ensure consistent service quality, data protection and compliance with international standards. Expected results include increased customer confidence, easier access to foreign markets and increased export revenues. By implementing the certificate, Expert i4next will optimize processes, reduce risks and ensure recognition as a reliable and safe partner in the international market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je unaprijediti međunarodnu konkurentnosti Expert i4next certifikacijom sustava upravljanja prema ISO 22301:2019 i ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Svrha je standardizacija poslovnih procesa i uspostava sustava upravljanja kontinuiteta poslovanja i sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću kako bi se osigurala dosljedna kvaliteta usluga, zaštita podataka i usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje povjerenja klijenata, olakšan pristup inozemnim tržištima i rast prihoda od izvoza. Implementacijom certifikata Expert i4next će optimizirati procese, smanjiti rizike i osigurati prepoznatljivost kao pouzdan i siguran partner na međunarodnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Opportunity for all 6
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Prilika za sve 6
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the social inclusion and integration of students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions founded by Koprivnica-Križevci County. The purpose of the project is to support the inclusion of 59 students with disabilities in 12 primary and 5 secondary schools through the employment of 54 PUN over 10 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta povećanje socijalne uključenosti i integracije učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim obrazovnim ustanovama kojima je Koprivničko-križevačka županija osnivač. Svrha projekta je pružiti potporu uključivanju 59 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u 12 osnovnih i 5 srednjih škola kroz zapošljavanje 54 PUN tijekom 10 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: The Power of Unity IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Snaga zajedništva IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to achieve long-term care and increase social inclusion through the provision of support and support services to target groups and to ensure that they remain in their own home and have the right to live in the community. 26 service providers will be recruited for 156 targeted groups.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se želi postići dugotrajna skrb te povećanje socijalne uključenosti kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške ciljanim skupinama te osigurati ostanak u vlastitom domu i pravo na život u zajednici. Zaposlit će se 26 pružatelja usluga za 156 pripadnika ciljanih skupina.

Operation_Name_English: Step into a Life of Equal Opportunities - Phase VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Korak u život jednakih mogućnosti - faza VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project will improve educational achievements, achieve more successful socialization and emotional functioning of students with developmental difficulties in primary schools in the area of the city of Virovitica, through the provision of support and professional support of trained teaching assistants. Students with disabilities who are included in the regular primary education system will be provided with assistance and support to enable them to participate in the educational process on an equal basis and to prevent discrimination against them. The project implementation period is 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta poboljšat će se obrazovna postignuća, postići uspješnija socijalizacija i emocionalno funkcioniranje učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnim školama s područja grada Virovitice, kroz pružanje potpore i stručne podrške osposobljenih pomoćnika u nastavi. Učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju koji su uključeni u redovan sustav osnovnoškolskog obrazovanja pružit će se pomoć i podrška kako bi im se omogućilo ravnopravno sudjelovanje u odgojno obrazovnom procesu i spriječila njihova diskriminacija. Razdoblje provedbe projekta je 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of the fire station DVD Slatina and purchase of a new fire truck for the needs of the Public Fire Brigade of the City of Trogir
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija vatrogasnog doma DVD Slatine i nabava novog vatrogasnog vozila za potrebe Javne vatrogasne postrojbe Grada Trogira
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria|Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)|Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes the reconstruction and equipping of the firehouse in Slatine, where the Volunteer Fire Brigade Slatine operates, with the aim of providing adequate space for three fire trucks, firefighters' rooms, and a tower for training and drying equipment. In addition, it is planned to purchase a fire truck for the needs of the Public Fire Brigade of the City of Trogir. Also, information to the public will be carried out through demonstration firefighting exercises with the aim of raising awareness of the inhabitants of the island of Čiovo about the importance of firefighting in the community and the impact of individual actions on the safety of the community. The project will contribute to strengthening the capacity of fire brigades for environmental and nature protection interventions on the island of Čiovo.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća rekonstrukciju i opremanje vatrogasnog doma u Slatinama u kojem djeluje Dobrovoljno vatrogasno društvo Slatine, s ciljem osiguranja adekvatnog prostora za tri vatrogasna vozila, prostorija za vatrogasce, te toranj za vježbanje i sušenje opreme. Uz to, planirana je nabava vatrogasnog vozila za potrebe Javne vatrogasne postrojbe Grada Trogira. Također, provest će se informiranje javnosti kroz pokazne vatrogasne vježbe s ciljem podizanja svijest stanovnika otoka Čiova o važnosti vatrogastva u zajednici i utjecaju postupaka pojedinaca na sigurnost zajednice. Projekt će doprinijeti jačanju kapaciteta vatrogasnih postrojbi za intervencije u zaštiti okoliša i prirode na otoku Čiovu.

Operation_Name_English: Wish a job, give me some help! Phase III.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi posao, pruži pomoć! - faza III.
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project plans the employment of 30 women from the area of Velika and Kaptol municipalities who would provide assistance and support services to users. The target group is 210 users who live in the territory of the municipalities of Velika and Kaptol and meet all the prescribed conditions. The duration of the project is 36 months, of which 33 months will be provided with support and support services to beneficiaries, and 3 months for preparatory and final activities. The project will increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care, which is also the overall objective of the project. The specific objective is to provide a service of support and support in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities living in the territory of the municipality of Velika and Kaptol.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se planira zapošljavanje 30 žena s područja općina Velika i Kaptol koje bi pružale usluge pomoći i podrške korisnicima. Ciljana skupina je 210 korisnika koji žive na području općina Velika i Kaptol i udovoljavaju svim propisanim uvjetima. Predviđeno je trajanje projekta 36 mjeseci od čega će se 33 mjeseca pružati usluga potpore i podrške korisnicima, a 3 mjeseca je za pripremne i završne aktivnosti. Projektom će se povećati socijalna uključenost i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi što je ujedno i opći cilj projekta. Specifični cilj je pružiti uslugu potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za starije osobe i osobe s invaliditetom koje žive na području općine Velika i Kaptol.

Operation_Name_English: Rest from care - support for strength!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmor od skrbi - podrška za snagu!
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The main objective of the project "Care breaks - support for strength!" is to enable the provision of innovative social rest services from care for 17 parents of carers and families caring for members with disabilities for 250 days. This project aims to prevent the institutionalization of persons with disabilities and improve their inclusion in the community. Through the organization of replacement care and stay for persons with disabilities as well as workshops for parents caregivers, the target group will be allowed a break and time to take care of their own health and needs as soon as the emotional and physical burden of parents is reduced, and the quality of life improves, as well as the care of the most vulnerable members of the community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni cilj projekta "Odmor od skrbi – podrška za snagu!" je omogućiti pružanje inovativnih socijalnih usluga odmora od skrbi za 17 roditelja njegovatelja i obitelji koje skrbe o članovima s invaliditetom tijekom 250 dana. Ovim projektom želi se prevenirati institucionalizacija osoba s invaliditetom te unaprijediti njihova uključenost u zajednicu. Kroz organiziranje zamjenske skrbi i boravaka za osobe s invaliditetom kao i radionica za roditelje njegovatelje, ciljnoj skupini će se omogućiti predah i vrijeme za brigu o vlastitom zdravlju i potrebama čim se smanjuje emocionalno i fizičko opterećenje roditelja, te poboljšava kvaliteta života ali i sama skrb o najranjiivijim pripadnicima zajednice.

Operation_Name_English: Supporting the community: Overcoming challenges through innovative social services
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podrška zajednici: prevladavanje izazova kroz inovativne socijalne usluge
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: Persons with the most severe forms of disability require continuous care (parents) of caregivers,which causes them physical and emoc.efforts.In order to strengthen personal capacities in overcoming the stress associated with the provision of care, get the opportunity for personal development,it is necessary to provide them with the opportunity to rest from care.BPŽ has a below-average number of licensed service providers OA and social.care institutions that provide social. services to children with disabilities and OSI.The key solution is to ensurerest from care and better access to social activities and social services.The project aims to provide an innovative social. rest service from care for 40 people who care for household members dependent on their support from BPŽ, and contribute to deinstitutionalization.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osobe s najtežim oblicima invaliditeta zahtijevaju neprekidnu skrb (roditelja) njegovatelja,što kod njih uzrokuje fizičke i emoc.napore.Kako bi ojačali osobne kapacitete u prevladavanju stresa povezanog s pružanjem skrbi, dobili priliku za osobni razvoj,nužno je pružiti im priliku za odmor od skrbi.BPŽ ima ispodprosječan broj licenciranih pružatelja usluga OA i ustanova soc.skrbi koje pružaju soc. usluge djeci s teškoćama u razvoju i OSI.Ključno rješenje je osiguratiodmor od skrbi te bolji pristup društvenim aktivnostim i socijalnim uslugama.Projekt ima za cilj pružiti inovativnu soc. uslugu odmor od skrbi za 40 osoba koje skrbe o članovima kućanstva ovisnima o njihovoj podršci iz BPŽ, i doprinijeti deinstitucionalizaciji.

Operation_Name_English: Growing up in equality, Koprivnica - SECTION VI
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odrastanje u jednakosti, Koprivnica - ODJEK VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support in education through the inclusion of 46 PUN/CPC for 52 pupils with developmental disabilities included in primary school institutions in the area of the city of Koprivnica in order to provide them with better educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning in teaching. For the academic year 2023/2024, for 49 pupils with disabilities, decisions have been made on the recognition of the right to PUN/CPC support based on a proposal by the County Expert Commission, while for three more students an opinion of the competent county authority is pending. Selection and education of PUN/CPC, development of individual programs according to individual characteristics and difficulties of students and monitoring the work of PUN/CPC will be the main project activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osigurati potporu u odgoju i obrazovanju kroz uključivanje 46 PUN/SKP za 52 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju uključenih u osnovnoškolske ustanove na području grada Koprivnice kako bi im se u nastavi osigurala bolja obrazovna postignuća, uspješnija socijalizacija i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Za šk. god. 2023./2024. za 49 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju donesene su odluke o priznavanju prava na potporu PUN/SKP temeljem prijedloga od strane Stručnog povjerenstva županije, dok se za još 3 učenika čeka mišljenje nadležnog županijskog tijela. Selekcija i edukacija PUN/SKP, izrada individualnih programa prema individualnim karakteristikama i poteškoćama učenika te praćenje rada PUN/SKP bit će glavne projektne aktivnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Development of educational materials for VIDI X for the programming language Python
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj edukacijskih materijala za VIDI X za programski jezik Python
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Development of educational materials for VIDI X for the Python programming language’ is the development of innovative educational materials for the educational microcomputer platform and the associated VIDI X platform, which will be developed for the applicant Vidi-to d.o.o. by the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing in Zagreb. This service (activity) of FER is "professional and technical knowledge for the purpose of developing products, services and processes", as required by the public call. The material will have 9 modules for students over 12, and 3 for teachers. The Phyton programming language was chosen for its popularity, which resulted from its high flexibility, logic and application, including for AI programming. It is a great programming language to enter the world of programming.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Razvoj edukacijskih materijala za VIDI X za programski jezik Python“ je izrada inovativnih edukacijskih materijala za platformu edukacijskog mikroračunala i pripadajuće platforme VIDI X, koje će za prijavitelja Vidi-to d.o.o. razviti Fakultet elektrotehnike i računarstva iz Zagreba. Ta usluga (aktivnost) FER-a je "stručna i tehnička znanja u svrhu razvoja proizvoda, usluga i procesa", kako je propisano javnom pozivom. Materijal će imati 9 modula za učenike starije od 12, te 3 za nastavnike. Programski jezik Phyton odabran je radi popularnosti, koja je proizašla iz njegove visoke fleksibilnosti, logike i primjene, između ostalog i za programiranje umjetne inteligencije. Odličan je programski jezik za ulazak u svijet programiranja.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of ISO 27001
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje standarda ISO 27001
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the proposed project is to increase the overall competitiveness of Ergai by introducing and applying the globally recognized standard ISO 27001 for information security and risk management to enable market expansion in Croatia and the world. By implementing the project, the company will be able to obtain new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha predloženog projekta je uvođenjem i primjenom globalno priznate norme ISO 27001 za upravljanje sigurnošću informacija i rizicima povećati ukupnu konkurentnost tvrtke Ergai omogućiti tržišnu ekspanziju u Hrvatskoj i svijetu. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama.

Operation_Name_English: PUN knowledge backpack
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PUN ruksak znanja
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide inclusive education for 7 students with disabilities in primary education in Primary School Čazma, founded by the City of Čazma. In order to ensure inclusive education and encourage the social inclusion of children with disabilities, 7 teaching assistants/professional communication mediators will be provided. Providing teaching assistants and professional communication mediators will contribute to respecting the right to equal education, increasing social and emotional inclusion and improving educational achievements. The project contributes to raising awareness of the importance of social inclusion and reducing discrimination on any grounds.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osigurati inkluzivno obrazovanje za 7 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskom obrazovanju u Osnovnoj školi Čazma čiji je osnivač Grad Čazma. Za osiguranje inkluzivnog obrazovanja te poticanja socijalne uključenosti djece s teškoćama u razvoju osigurati će se 7 pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika. Osiguranjem pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika doprinijeti će se poštivanju prava na jednak odgoj i obrazovanje, povećanju socijalne i emocionalne uključenosti i poboljšanju obrazovnih postignuća. Projektom se doprinosi podizanju svijesti o važnosti socijalne uključenosti i smanjenju diskriminacije po bilo kojoj osnovi.

Operation_Name_English: Digital union - DIGISIND
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Digitalni sindikat - DIGISIND
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project is aimed at developing and strengthening the capacity to implement digitalization and digital transformation of applicants, which will be achieved by introducing new digital solutions, purchasing equipment and training employees. By improving the digital skills of employees, the applicant will optimize the business, and by developing new innovative digital services, he will improve the user experience of membership. Getting acquainted with European standards, cooperation with European organisations and their experiences will contribute to improving services and accessibility for the new membership. By strengthening their digital competences, trade union employees indirectly influence the digital transformation of the entire trade union, thus ensuring the revitalization and work of applicants in the digital era.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je usmjeren ka razvoju i jačanju kapaciteta za provedbu digitalizacije i digitalne transformacije prijavitelja, što će se postići, uvođenjem novih digitalnih rješenja, nabavom opreme i edukacijom zaposlenika. Unapređenjem digitalnih vještina zaposlenika prijavitelj će optimizirati poslovanje, a razvojem novih inovativnih digitalnih usluga poboljšati će korisničko iskustvo članstva. Upoznavanje s europskim standardima, suradnja s europskim organizacijama i njihova iskustva doprinijeti će unapređenju usluga i pristupačnosti za novo članstvo. Jačajući svoje digitalne kompetencije zaposlenici sindikata indirektno utječu na digitalnu transformaciju cijelog sindikata, čime osiguravaju revitalizaciju i rad prijavitelja u digitalnoj eri.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of Neyho informatika
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti tvrtke Neyho informatika
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of implementation and certification of quality management system according to ISO 9001:2015 and information security management system according to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 in the company NEHYO INFORMATIKA d.o.o. lasts 12 months and is aimed at establishing a quality and information security management system. Through ISO 9001, the company will develop quality policies and procedures for monitoring and improving services, with the aim of ensuring high quality and continuous improvement of business processes. In parallel, the implementation of ISO 27001 will ensure data protection through the development of security measures and employee training. The project will increase competitiveness and provide reliable, secure services to clients.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt implementacije i certifikacije sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema ISO 9001:2015 i sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema ISO/IEC 27001:2022 u tvrtki NEHYO INFORMATIKA d.o.o. traje 12 mjeseci i usmjeren je na uspostavu sustava upravljanja kvalitetom i sigurnošću informacija. Kroz ISO 9001, tvrtka će razviti politike kvalitete i procedure za praćenje i poboljšanje usluga, s ciljem osiguravanja visoke kvalitete i kontinuiranog poboljšanja poslovnih procesa. Paralelno, implementacija ISO 27001 osigurat će zaštitu podataka kroz razvoj sigurnosnih mjera i obuku zaposlenika. Projekt će povećati konkurentnost i pružiti pouzdane, sigurne usluge klijentima.

Operation_Name_English: Knowledge to all
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Znanje svima
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the Knowledge project is to ensure inclusive education for 36 primary school pupils with disabilities in the process of education with the support of professionally trained teaching assistants in order to contribute to the improvement of students' educational achievements, their successful socialization and emotional functioning. Students with developmental disabilities as the target group of this project form a vulnerable group of children and young people and they need to be provided with quality education and the acquisition of knowledge, skills and competences necessary for employment, social inclusion, active citizenship and personal creation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta Znanje svima je osigurati inkluzivno obrazovanje za 36 osnovnoškolskih učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u procesu odgoja i obrazovanja uz potporu stručno osposobljenih pomoćnika u nastavi kako bi se pridonijelo poboljšanju obrazovnih postignuća učenika, njihovoj uspješnoj socijalizaciji i emocionalnom funkcioniranju. Učenici s teškoćama u razvoju kao ciljana skupina ovog projekta čine ranjivu skupinu djece i mladih ljudi te im je potrebno omogućiti kvalitetno obrazovanje i stjecanje znanja, vještina i kompetencija potrebnih za zapošljavanje, društvenu uključenost, aktivno građanstvo te osobno stvaranje.

Operation_Name_English: WAINN (Wireless AI Neural Network) – Artificial Intelligence-enabled wireless neural network for traffic management
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: WAINN (Wireless AI Neural Network) – Bežićna neuralna mreža temeljena na umjetnoj inteligenciji za upravljanje prometom
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The Applicant, with the support of partners, is developing an innovative model of smart management of transport infrastructure and cities based on artificial intelligence through research development activities that will result in the application of data-driven solutions to expand their business in the global market and increase the multiplier effect of all stakeholders in the value chain contributing to addressing key challenges. The project consortium consists of Reflecta Intelligent Sistemi d.o.o., Vektra d.o.o., ArhivPRO d.o.o., Sector2 d.o.o. and OIŠZ University North, which everyone in their field of activity offers and complements an innovative complementary service and product that will represent novelty/innovation in the targeted markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Društvo Prijavitelj uz potporu partnera razvija inovativan model pametnog upravljanja prometnom infrastrukturom i gradovima temeljen na umjetnoj inteligenciji kroz istraživačko razvojne aktivnosti koje će rezultirati primjenom rješenja temeljenih na prikupljenim podacima kako bi proširili svoje poslovanje na globalnom tržištu i povećali multiplikativni učinak svih dionika u lancu vrijednosti doprinoseći rješavanju ključnih izazova. Projektni konzorcij čine Reflecta Inteligentni Sistemi d.o.o., Vektra d.o.o., ArhivPRO d.o.o., Sector2 d.o.o. i OIŠZ Sveučilište Sjever koji svatko u svom području djelovanja nude i dopunjuju inovativnu komplementarnu uslugu i proizvod koji će predstavljati novost/inovaciju na ciljanim tržištima.

Operation_Name_English: Carrying out the second laboratory testing of the control component of the autonomous forklift
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Provedba drugog laboratorijskog testiranja upravljačke komponente autonomnog viličara
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The company Gideon Brothers d.o.o. develops a product called "Trey - Medium Duty (MD)" which represents a forklift for autonomous loading and unloading of goods in and out of trucks. The aim of this project, in cooperation with Končar Institute of Electrical Engineering Ltd., is to conduct additional tests on the key component of the overall solution in order to confirm the correctness of the design and compliance with the necessary standards that will ensure long-term operation of the system in demanding operating conditions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka Gideon Brothers d.o.o. razvija proizvod naziva "Trey - Medium Duty (MD)" koji predstavlja viličara za autonomni utovar i istovar robe u i iz kamiona. Cilj ovog projekta je u suradnji s Končar institutom za elektrotehniku d.o.o. provesti dodatna ispitivanja na ključnoj komponenti ukupnog rješenja kako bi se potvrdila ispravnost dizajna i sukladnost potrebnim normama koja će osigurati dugotrajan rad sustava u zahtjevnim uvjetima rada.

Operation_Name_English: Want 4 - for a better life in the municipality of Garčin
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi 4 - za ljepši život u općini Garčin
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization from the territory of the municipality through the provision of long-term care. This will be achieved by providing support and support services in everyday life to the elderly and persons with disabilities through prevention, promotion of change, assistance in meeting basic living needs and support to the individual, the family, in order to improve the quality of life. During the duration of the project, beneficiaries will be provided with day-to-day assistance in the home, enable social contact and social connections, and increase their sense of value and belonging. The project will last 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije s područja općine kroz osiguravanje dugotrajne skrbi. Navedeno će se postići pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom kroz prevenciju, promicanje promjena, pomoć u zadovoljavanju osnovnih životnih potreba i podrška pojedincu, obitelji, a u svrhu unapređenja kvalitete života. Korisnicima će se tijekom trajanja projekta pružati svakodnevna pomoć u kući, omogućiti im socijalni kontakt i društvene veze te povećati osjećaj vrijednosti i pripadnosti. Predmetni projekt trajat će 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of quality management system ISO 13485
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom ISO 13485
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With the project, the applicant wants to implement the implementation of the quality management system of medical devices ISO 13485, to conduct the education of employees necessary for the implementation of the quality management system, to obtain accreditation of the certification company, and to carry out the promotion of the project with the aim of its visibility. The aim of the project is to reach the applicable standard level of internationally recognized quality level through the use of the recognized ISO 13485 standard, in order to facilitate access to the international market and increase competitiveness. By implementing the project, the applicant will take their business to a higher level. Target groups are company employees, clients, suppliers and the general public.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavitelj projektom želi provesti pripremu implementacije sustava upravljanja kvalitetom medicinskih uređaja ISO 13485, provesti edukaciju djelatnika neophodnu za uvođenje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom, ishoditi akreditaciju certifikacijske kuće, te izvršiti promidžbu projekta sa ciljem njegove vidljivosti. Cilj projekta je dostizanje primjenjive razine standarda međunarodno priznate razine kvalitete kroz upotrebu priznate norme ISO 13485, u svrhu olakšanog pristupa međunarodnom tržištu i povećanju konkurentnosti. Provedbom projekta Prijavitelj će podići svoje poslovanje na na višu razinu. Ciljane skupine su djelatnici tvrtke, klijenti, dobavljači te šira javnost.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of HVAR, d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva HVAR, d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes a certification activity for 12 road asphalt products and is implemented with the aim of increasing international market competitiveness and facilitating access to new applicant markets. Activities include the process of drafting technical documentation of product testing, analysis of compliance with standards, and certification by authorized bodies. The aim of the project is to confirm the quality and safety of the product, enable wider application and strengthen the market position of the applicant. The results include increased visibility of certified products, market share growth and strengthening the innovation capacity and commercial viability of the business. Implementation contributes to the realisation of the smart specialisation strategy and adaptation to the requirements of sustainable development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća aktivnost certificiranja 12 proizvoda cestovnog asfalta i provodi se s ciljem povećanja međunarodne tržišne konkurentnosti i olakšanja pristupa novim tržištima prijavitelja. Aktivnosti uključuju proces izrade tehničke dokumentacije ispitivanja proizvoda, analizu sukladnosti sa standardima, te certificiranje kod ovlaštenih tijela. Cilj projekta je potvrditi kvalitetu i sigurnost proizvoda, omogućiti širu primjenu i osnažiti tržišnu poziciju prijavitelja. Rezultati uključuju povećanu vidljivost certificiranih proizvoda, rast tržišnog udjela te jačanje inovacijskog kapaciteta i komercijalne održivosti poslovanja. Provedba doprinosi ostvarivanju strategije pametne specijalizacije i prilagodbi zahtjevima održivog razvoja.

Operation_Name_English: Social plan of Krapina-Zagorje County for the period 2024-2026
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalni plan Krapinsko-zagorske županije za razdoblje 2024.-2026.
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to create a Social Plan of Krapina-Zagorje County for the period 2024-2026. During the implementation of the project, external experts will be engaged to provide support services at all stages of the preparation of the county social plan, which will include capacity analysis, the availability of social service providers and specific goals of the development of institutional and non-institutional social services, as well as the implementation of education for 15 members of the Social Welfare Council of the KZŽ and 4 employees of the KZŽ.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izraditi Socijalni plan Krapinsko-zagorske županije za razdoblje od 2024.-2026. Tijekom provedbe projekta angažirat će se vanjski stručnjaci za pružanje usluga podrške u svim fazama izrade socijalnog plana županije koji će obuhvaćati analizu kapaciteta, dostupnost pružatelja socijalnih usluga i specifične ciljeve razvoja institucionalnih i izvaninstitucijskih socijalnih usluga te provođenje edukacije za 15 članova Savjeta za socijalnu skrb KZŽ te 4 djelatnika KZŽ.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a kindergarten and nursery in Vrlika
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja dječjeg vrtića i jaslica u Vrlici
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: By implementing the construction of a kindergarten and crèche in Vrlika, the goal is to solve the issue of organized care of preschool children in the area of the City of Vrlika. The construction of a building for the implementation of preschool education would achieve a capacity of 52 children in three groups, two of which are kindergartens and one is nursery. The building will also contain accompanying facilities such as an outdoor courtyard and a play area, which will ensure a better implementation of the education programme for children. The construction of a kindergarten will also improve the quality of life and retention of young families in the area of the City of Vrlika, which is one of the main problems in rural areas.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom građenja dječjeg vrtića i jaslica u Vrlici, želi se riješiti pitanje organizirane skrbi o djeci u predškolskoj dobi na području Grada Vrlike. Izgradnjom zgrade za provođenje predškolskog odgoja i naobrazbe postigao bi se kapacitet od 52 djece u tri skupine od čega su dvije vrtićke, a jedna jaslička. Zgrada će sadržavati i popratne sadržaje poput vanjskog dvorišta i prostora za predstave što će djeci osigurati kvalitetnije provođenje programa odgoja i obrazovanja. Izgradnja dječjeg vrtića će i unaprijediti kvalitetu života i zadržavanje mladih obitelji na području Grada Vrlike, što je jedan od glavih problema u ruralnim područjima.

Operation_Name_English: SeaMate - Virtual agent based on AI, LLM and IoT analytics for smart nautical management
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SeaMate - Virtualni agent baziran na AI, LLM i IoT analitici za pametno upravljanje u nautici
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The SeaMate project will advance industry segments in the nautical industry, using innovative technologies such as LLM, AI and IoT. The project aims to develop two services - 1) a virtual guide based on intelligent agents and 2) IoT sensors and related analytics for installation in vessels. Both tools are aimed at technological innovations to contribute to improving the level of service that nautical tourism wants to offer to target clients on a global level.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom SeaMate unaprijed će se segmenti industrije u industriji nautike, korištenjem inovativnih tehnologija kao što su LLM, AI i IoT. Operation_Summary_English: The EU and all major economies are working to further expand broadband to develop relevant digital infrastructure. In doing so, there is a need for support from a scientific institution in the form of providing professional and technical knowledge for the development of sophisticated algorithms for building optimal routes that analyze geographical infrastructure and enable the smart positioning of network points and routes to which the points are connected.

Jedna od važnih funkcionalnosti je planiranje telekomunikacijskih mreža temeljem ulaznih podataka kao što su geografska ograničenja i prepreke te postojeća infrastruktura. Pri tome, postoji potreba za podrškom od strane znanstvene institucije u obliku pružanja stručnih i tehničkih znanja za izradu sofisticiranih algoritama izgradnje optimalnih trasa koji analiziraju geografsku infrastrukturu i omogućuju pametno pozicioniranje mrežnih točaka i ruta kojima su točke povezane.
