The project is implemented in cooperation with partners – members of SPIN consortium consisting of GALKO d.o.o. (as holder), Odjeca d.o.o., Servisni obrt Elektroterm, vl. Drago Premec and University of Zagreb Faculty of Textile Technology, Department of Clothing Technology. Since Galko has conducted fundamental research on innovative products, further investments related to research and development and investment in the acquisition of assets with the aim of developing them are necessary. The target groups covered by the project activities are primarily company directors, employees, customers and the wider global community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni cilj projekta je istraživanje i razvoj multifunkcionalne povezanosti osobne zaštitne opreme u svrhu zaštite zdravlja i povećanja funkcionalnosti. Projekt se provodi u suradnji s partnerima – članovima SPIN konzorcija koji čine GALKO d.o.o. (kao nositelj), Odjeća d.o.o., Servisni obrt Elektroterm, vl. Drago Premec i Sveučilište u Zagrebu Tekstilno-tehnološki fakultet, odnosno Zavod za odjevnu tehnologiju. Obzirom da je Galko proveo temeljno istraživanje inovativnih proizvoda, nužna su daljnja ulaganja koja se odnose na istraživanje i razvoj te ulaganje u nabavu imovine s ciljem razvoja istih. Ciljane skupine obuhvaćene projektnim aktivnostima su u prvom redu direktori društava, zaposlenici, kupci te šira globalna zajednica.

Operation_Name_English: Improving the market competitiveness of the Šporčić electrical installation through the implementation of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 for information security and ISO 45001:2018 for occupational safety
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje tržišne konkurentnosti Elektroinstalacije Šporčić kroz implementaciju ISO/IEC 27001:2022 za informacijsku sigurnost i ISO 45001:2018 za sigurnost na radu
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the market competitiveness of the company Elektroinstalacija Šporčić through the implementation and certification of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 for information security and ISO 45001:2018 for occupational safety. The project will enable the establishment of a systematic approach to managing security risks, increase data protection and employee labour security, ensure compliance with international standards and support long-term sustainability and business growth. By implementing these standards, the company will increase the trust of clients and partners, ensure access to the international market and improve operational efficiency and safety of work processes.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećati tržišnu konkurentnost poduzeća Elektroinstalacije Šporčić kroz implementaciju i certifikaciju ISO/IEC 27001:2022 za informacijsku sigurnost i ISO 45001:2018 za sigurnost na radu. Projekt će omogućiti uspostavu sustavnog pristupa upravljanju sigurnosnim rizicima, povećati zaštitu podataka i radnu sigurnost zaposlenika, osigurati usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima te poduprijeti dugoročnu održivost i rast poslovanja. Implementacijom ovih standarda poduzeće će povećati povjerenje klijenata i partnera, osigurati pristup međunarodnom tržištu te unaprijediti operativnu učinkovitost i sigurnost radnih procesa.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthen your work potential IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ojačaj svoj radni potencijal IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will support 90 people over the age of 65 and adults with disabilities for 36 months. The service will include support and a package of basic necessities. Promotional material will be created: leaflet 400 pcs, posters 30 pcs, roll-up 2 pcs, T-shirts 60 pcs, pens 260 pcs, diaries 30 pcs, publication of 3 articles to local/regional media, the initial and final conference will be held. 15 service providers will be employed to organize food, perform household chores, maintain personal hygiene and meet other needs for at least 6 members of the target group for a contract of 34 months. One project manager will be hired for quality implementation and administrative work.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se pružati podrška za 90 osoba starijih od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom u trajanju od 36 mjeseci. Usluga će uključivati podršku i paket osnovnih potrepština. Izraditi će se promotivni materijal: letak 400 kom, plakati 30 kom, roll-up 2 kom, majice 60 kom, kemijske olovke 260 kom, rokovnici 30 kom, objava 3 članka lokalnim/regionalnim medijima, održati će se početna i završna konferencija. Zaposliti će se 15 pružatelja usluga za organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene i zadovoljavanje drugih potreba za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine na ugovor od 34 mjeseca. Zaposlit će se jedan voditelj projekta radi kvalitetne provedbe i administrativnih poslova.

Operation_Name_English: VerSkinO - Natural cosmetics for the future
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: VerSkinO - Prirodna kozmetika za budućnost
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the ‘VerSkinO - Natural Cosmetics for the Future’ project, in cooperation with Lively Roasters d.o.o. and NZJZ "Dr. Andrija Štampar", is to carry out laboratory tests and tests in order to prove the health safety and quality of 18 innovative cosmetic products, in cooperation with the NZJZ "Dr. Andrija Štampar", which will enable further product improvement and development, preparation for the production of the first batches that will be a novelty on the market and provide the basis for commercialisation, contributing to the growth and competitiveness of applicants, and application of the project results in the S3 area Personalised health care related to the realisation of the objectives of improving the market readiness of research and development results and increasing the market reach of innovative products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta “VerSkinO - Prirodna kozmetika za budućnost” je, u suradnji Lively Roasters d.o.o. s NZJZ "Dr. Andrija Štampar" kao znan.-istr. organizacijom provesti laboratorijska testiranja i ispitivanja u svrhu dokazivanja zdravstvene ispravnosti i kvalitete 18 inovativnih proizvoda kozmetičke linije, a koja će omogućiti daljnje unapređenje i razvoj proizvoda, pripremu za proizvodnju prvih serija koji će biti novost na tržištu te pružiti temelj za komercijalizaciju uz doprinos rastu i konkurentnosti prijavitelja te primjenu rezultata projekta u S3 području Personalizirana briga o zdravlju povezano s realizacijom ciljeva Poboljšanja tržišne spremnosti rezultata istraživanja i razvoja i Povećanja tržišnog dosega inovativnih proizvoda.

Operation_Name_English: Wish for IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for older people and adults with disabilities in the area of Sv. Ivan Zelina and the municipality of Bedenica. Activities are aimed at increasing the quality of life of older people and adults with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći je cilj povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični je cilj pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom na području grada Sv. Ivan Zelina i općine Bedenica. Aktivnosti su usmjerene na povećanje kvalitete života starijih osoba i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom.

Operation_Name_English: Development of dehydrated food supplement Powerbiotic and organic pelleted fertilizer
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj dehidriranog dodatka prehrani Powerbiotic i organskog peletiranog gnojiva
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Capra Domestica d.o.o. with this project launches the development of two innovative products. The development of the new generation of the registered food supplement "Powerbiotic" with dehydration/lyophilization technology, which will keep the product its characteristics and functionality with an extension of the shelf life, increased safety and savings in transport in view of reducing the weight of the product. Development of a new product, organic pellets from goat manure and harvest residue with the addition of ash from biomass certified Croatian forests (FSC 100%). This type of natural fertilizer is sought after by eco farmers, and the company will effectively dispose of fertilizer from the farm. Newly developed eco products will certainly improve the company's business and further development of eco novelties.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Capra Domestica d.o.o. ovim projektom pokreće razvoj dva inovativna proizvoda. Razvoj nove generacije registriranog dodatka prehrani "Powerbiotic" tehnologijom dehidracije/liofilizacije čime će proizvod zadržati svoje karakteristike i funkcionalnost uz produljenje roka trajanja, povećanu sigurnost i uštede u transportu s obzirom na smanjenje težine proizvoda. Razvoj novog proizvoda, organskih peleta od kozjeg stajnjaka i žetvenog ostatka sa dodatkom pepela iz biomase certificiranih drveća hrvatskih šuma (FSC 100%). Ovakav tip prirodnog gnojiva je tražen kod eko poljoprivrednika, a tvrtka će na učinkovit način zbrinjavati gnojivo sa farme. Novo razvijeni eko proizvodi će zasigurno unaprijediti poslovanje tvrtke i daljnji razvoj eko noviteta.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Urban Development Strategy of Čakovec for the financial period 2021 - 2027.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada Strategije razvoja urbanog područja Čakovec za financijsko razdoblje 2021. - 2027.
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: Project for the development of the Urban Area Development Strategy Čakovec for the financial period 2021 - 2027 (SRUP Čakovec) is implemented for the implementation of integrated territorial investments on UP Čakovec, as a precondition prescribed by the Regional Development Act of the Republic of Croatia. The project is based on EU regulations for the programming and financial period 2021. - 2027 and the objectives of cohesion policy and will result in a planning document of the integrated territorial development policy that sets out the objectives and priorities for the development of the urban area of Čakovec. The institutional framework for the elaboration and implementation of the EWS is divided into three levels: Developer, Coordinating Council for UP Čakovec and Partnership Council for UP Čakovec.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt izrade Strategije razvoja urbanog područja Čakovec za financijsko razdoblje 2021. - 2027.g. (SRUP Čakovec) provodi se radi provedbe integriranih teritorijalnih ulaganja na UP Čakovec, a kao preduvjet propisan Zakonom o regionalnom razvoju RH. Projekt se temelji na regulativi EU za programsko-financijsko razdoblje 2021. - 2027.g. i ciljevima kohezijske politike te će rezultirati planskim dokumentom politike integriranog teritorijalnog razvoja kojim se utvrđuju ciljevi i prioriteti razvoja urbanog područja Čakovec. Institucionalni okvir izrade i provedbe SRUP-a podijeljen je u tri razine: nositelj izrade, Koordinacijsko vijeće za UP Čakovec i Partnersko vijeće za UP Čakovec.

Operation_Name_English: WE WANT TO HAVE TOGETHER IN LIMIT
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELIMO ZAJEDNO U POJEZERJU
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project would increase the social inclusion of the target group and thus prevent their institutionalisation through the provision of long-term care, including support in daily life for 90 people. As part of the project, assistance will be organized in preparing meals, performing household chores, purchasing groceries, medicines and other necessities. The care will be provided by 15 employees.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt bi doveo do povećanja socijalne uključenosti ciljne skupine te se tako prevenirala njihova institucionalizacija putem osiguravanja dugotrajne skrbi, uključujući i pružanje potpore u svakodnevnom životu za 90 osoba. U okviru projekta organizirat će se pomoć u pripremi obroka, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, nabava namirnica, lijekova i drugih potrepština. Skrb će pružati 15 zaposlenika.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of the port of Murter
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija luke Murter
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the project ‘Reconstruction of the port of Murter’ is to improve maritime infrastructure by reconstructing the operational coast of a port of local significance open to public transport - Murter in Hramina Bay on the island of Murter and to ensure the necessary infrastructure preconditions for the further development of the island’s economy and employment. The target groups of the project are the local population of the municipality of Murter-Kornati and the Šibenik-Knin County, civil services, businessmen, visitors and the general public. The project will raise the level of quality of life of the island population, safety of life and property, as well as encourage the demographic revitalization of the island.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta “Rekonstrukcija luke Murter” je unaprjeđenje pomorske infrastrukture rekonstrukcijom operativne obale luke lokalnog značaja otvorene za javni promet - Murter u uvali Hramina na otoku Murteru te osiguranje nužnih infrastrukturnih preduvjeta za daljnji razvoj otočkog gospodarstva i zapošljavanje. Ciljne skupine projekta su lokalno stanovništvo općine Murter-Kornati i Šibensko-kninske županije, civilne službe, gospodarstvenici, posjetitelji te šira javnost. Projektom će se podići razina kvalitete života otočnog stanovništva, sigurnost života i imovine, kao i potaknuti demografska revitalizacija otoka.

Operation_Name_English: Predictive analytics for industry to optimise and improve production processes - "Industrial Oracle"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Prediktivna analitika za industriju u svrhu optimizacije i unapređenja proizvodnih procesa - „Industrijska proročica“
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: This project launches a strategic innovation partnership concluded between leading technology companies and major manufacturers from Northern Croatia, focused on the application of Industry 4.0 principles in the digitization and automation of production chains. The aim is to optimise production processes by introducing advanced solutions, including AI algorithms and digital twin technology. By implementing centralised systems for production monitoring and planning, and by automating quality control, the project will achieve cost reduction, productivity increase and product quality improvement. In addition, the project contributes to reducing CO2 emissions, strengthening competitiveness and sustainability, confirming the leading role of partners in innovation and technological progress.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovaj projekt pokreće strateško partnerstvo za inovacije sklopljeno između vodećih tehnoloških tvrtki i velikih proizvođača iz Sjeverne Hrvatske, usmjereno na primjenu principa Industrije 4.0 u digitalizaciji i automatizaciji proizvodnih lanaca. Cilj je optimizirati proizvodne procese uvođenjem naprednih rješenja, uključujući AI algoritme i tehnologiju digitalnog blizanca. Implementacijom centraliziranih sustava za praćenje i planiranje proizvodnje, te automatizacijom kontrole kvalitete, projekt će postići smanjenje troškova, povećanje produktivnosti i poboljšanje kvalitete proizvoda. Dodatno, projekt pridonosi smanjenju emisija CO2, jačanju konkurentnosti i održivosti, potvrđujući vodeću ulogu partnera u inovacijama i tehnološkom napretku.

Operation_Name_English: Zaželi - prevention of institutionalization - Municipality of Drenovci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - prevencija institucionalizacije - Općina Drenovci
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to contribute to greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in one's own home and ensuring the right to live in the community of the target groups in the municipality of Drenovci, which is also the general objective of the PDP. The implementation of the project will provide support and support in the daily life of the target groups, which is also the main activity of the project, but also the specific objective of the PDP. For the implementation of the main project, service providers (35 providers for 28 months) will be hired to organize nutrition for the target groups (min. 210), perform household tasks, take care of maintaining personal hygiene and satisfying other daily needs with the purchase and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene items.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se želi doprinijeti većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguravanju prava na život u zajednici ciljanim skupinama u općini Drenovci, što je ujedno i opći cilj PDP-a. Provedbom projekta pružiti će se potpora i podrška u svakodnevnom životu ciljanim skupinama, što je ujedno i glavna aktivnost projekta, ali i specifični cilj PDP-a. Za provedbu glavnog projekta zaposlit će se pružatelji usluge (35 pružatelja na 28 mjeseci) koji će za ciljane skupine (min. 210) organizirati prehranu, obavljati kućanske poslove, voditi brigu o održavanju osobne higijene i zadovoljavanju drugih svakodnevnih potreba uz nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština.

Operation_Name_English: Trail of the Future - STEM and Alumni For Children of the Future
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Staza Budućnosti - STEM i Alumni Za Djecu Budućnosti
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve the capacities of CSOs and in cooperation with the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing (FER) and educational institutions, increase interest in STEM among children and students. The capacities of CSOs will be strengthened through study trips, conferences and fairs, by gathering knowledge on state-of-the-art teaching methods. CSO members will acquire competences to implement innovative programmes. Together with school teachers and professors, they will be educated and mentored by FER. The project will ensure that children participate in STEM workshops and increase public interest in STEM . The purpose of the project is to ensure professional and contemporary promotion of STEM, which is the key to the development of critical thinking and skills needed for the future.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je unaprijediti kapacitete OCD-a te u suradnji s Fakultetom elektrotehnike i računarstva (FER) i obrazovnim ustanovama, povećati interes za STEM među djecom i učenicima. Kapaciteti OCD-a ojačat će se kroz studijska putovanja, konferencije i sajmove, prikupljanjem znanja o najsuvremenijim metodama poučavanja. Članovi OCD-a steći će kompetencije za provođenje inovativnih programa. Zajedno sa školskim učiteljima i profesorima bit će educirani i mentorirani od strane FER-a. Projekt će djeci osigurati sudjelovanje u STEM radionicama i povećati interes javnosti za STEM . Svrha projekta je osigurati stručnu i suvremenu promociju STEM-a, što je ključ za razvoj kritičkog razmišljanja i vještina potrebnih za budućnost.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a bicycle-pedestrian path in the settlement of Sigetec
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističko-pješačke staze u naselju Sigetec
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Construction of a bicycle-pedestrian path in the settlement of Sigetec’ will build a bicycle-pedestrian path along the section of the local road that passes through the very centre of the settlement (kindergarten, school, bus stop, shop) and further along the county road through the settlement towards the neighbouring municipality of Hlebine. The sections in question are very busy and unsafe for all road users, especially for the most vulnerable pedestrians and cyclists. The target group of the project is the residents of the settlement of Sigetec who walk or cycle on the roads in question on a daily basis. The realisation of the project, in addition to increasing transport safety, will encourage the local population to make greater use of bicycles as a zero-carbon means of transport.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmetnim projektom „Izgradnja biciklističko-pješačke staze u naselju Sigetec“ izgradit će se biciklističko-pješačka staza uz dionicu lokalne ceste koja prolazi samim središtem naselja (vrtić, škola, autobusno stajalište, trgovina) i dalje županijskom cestom kroz naselje prema susjednoj općini Hlebine. Predmetne dionice su vrlo prometne i nesigurne za sve sudionike u promet, posebice za najranjivije pješake i bicikliste. Ciljnu skupinu projekta čine stanovnici naselja Sigetec koji pješice ili biciklima svakodnevno prolaze predmetnim prometnicama. Realizacijom projekta, osim što će se povećati sigurnost prometa, potaknut će se lokalno stanovništvo na veću upotrebi bicikli kao prijevoznog sredstva s nultom razinom emisija ugljika.

Operation_Name_English: Construction and equipping of the Fire Home Malinska-Dubašnica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja i opremanje Vatrogasnog doma Malinska-Dubašnica
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria|Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)|Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: others, e.g. storms and drought (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
Operation_Summary_English: The project of building and equipping the Firehouse in Malinska aims to raise the level of safety of citizens and property in the area of the municipality of Malinska-Dubašnica on the island of Krk. The project plans the construction and equipping of a fire station in Barušići in the area of the Malinska-Dubašnica municipality, the installation of 3 video cameras for early fire detection that will cover an area of 2,616 ha (60% of the area of the Malinska-Dubašnica municipality), the education of members of the DVD and firefighting community and a joint exercise on the island of Susak. The target groups are members of the Volunteer Fire Brigade Malinska-Dubašnica and other DVDs on the island of Krk, the Public Fire Brigade of the town of Krk, the entire fire brigade of PGC and the Republic of Croatia and the entire population of the municipality of Malinska-Dubašnica.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt izgradnje i opremanje Vatrogasnog doma u Malinskoj ima za cilj podizane razine sigurnosti građana i imovine na području općine Malinska-Dubašnica na otoku Krku. Projektom je planirana izgradnja i opremanje Vatrogasnog doma u mjestu Barušići na području općine Malinska-Dubašnica, postavljanje 3 video kamere za rano otkrivanje požara koje će pokrivati područje od 2.616 ha (60% površine Općine Malinska-Dubašnica), edukacija članova DVD-a i vatrogasne zajednice te zajednička vježba na otoku Susku. Ciljane skupine su članovi Dobrovoljnog vatrogasnog društva Malinska-Dubašnica i ostalih DVD-a na otoku Krku, Javna vatrogasna postrojba grada Krka, cjelokupna vatrogasna zajednica PGŽ i RH te cjelokupno stanovništvo općine Malinska-Dubašnica.

Operation_Name_English: New formulation platform for hard-to-soluble API with dry eye application potential - DEAP (Dry Eye API Platform)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nova formulacijska platforma za teško topive API s potencijalom primjene za suho oko - DEAP (Dry Eye API Platform)
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop a technological platform using two model hard-to-soluble molecules, with the potential to develop two innovative products and one service, which have the potential to innovate in the EU and global market, with its improved safety and efficacy profile in relation to existing therapies for dry eye disease. The project includes development from TRL 2 to TRL 8. The project is implemented at NUTS 2 region level, Adriatic Croatia, contributing to objective RSO 1.1.Development and strengthening of research capacities. It is part of the RLV Health and Priority Niche FutureFarma-Pharmaceutical of the Future and contributes to the Smart Specialisation Strategy, the thematic priority area Personalised Health Care and all mandatory Call indicators.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je razvoj tehnološke platforme koristeći dvije modelne teško topive molekule, s potencijalom razvoja za dva inovativna proizvoda i jednu uslugu, koji imaju potencijal za inovaciju na EU i globalnom tržištu, sa svojim poboljšanim sigurnosnim profilom i profilom djelotvornosti u odnosu na postojeće terapije za bolest suhog oka. Projekta uključuje razvoj od TRL 2 do TRL 8. Projekt se provodi na razini NUTS 2 regije, Jadranska Hrvatska, doprinosi cilju RSO 1.1.Razvoj i jačanje istraživačkih kapaciteta. Dio je RLV Zdravlje i prioritetne niše FutureFarma-faremaceutika budućnosti te doprinosi Strategiji pametne specijalizacije, tematskom prioritetnom području Personalizirana briga o zdravlju i svim obveznim pokazateljima Poziva.

Operation_Name_English: EcoFishBox - Development of eco-friendly packaging for fish with a high content of recycled material
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: EcoFishBox - Razvoj ekološke ambalaže za ribu s visokim udjelom recikliranog materijala
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The EcoFishBox project addresses the environmental footprint of the fishing industry caused by the use of expanded polystyrene (EPS) for fish packaging. The aim of the project is to develop innovative EPS boxes with a high content of recycled material, which will maintain insulating properties and reduce the amount of plastic waste. The project will contribute to preserving the marine environment, increasing recycling rates and promoting sustainable practices in the fishing industry. In addition, the project will stimulate job creation, investment in research and development and cooperation between entrepreneurs and faculties, thus achieving long-term environmental and economic sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt EcoFishBox rješava problem ekološkog otiska ribarske industrije uzrokovanog upotrebom ekspandiranog polistirena (EPS) za pakiranje ribe. Cilj projekta je razviti inovativne EPS kašete s visokim udjelom recikliranog materijala, koje će zadržati izolacijska svojstva i smanjiti količinu plastičnog otpada. Projekt će doprinijeti očuvanju morskog okoliša, povećanju stope recikliranja i promociji održivih praksi u ribarskoj industriji. Dodatno, projekt će potaknuti otvaranje novih radnih mjesta, ulaganja u istraživanje i razvoj te suradnju između poduzetnika i fakulteta, čime će se postići dugoročna ekološka i ekonomska održivost.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international competitiveness of Diversitas IT Systems d.o.o. by introducing a quality management system and information security
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke Diversitas IT sustavi d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kvalitetom te informacijskom sigurnošću
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project "Increasing the international competitiveness of Diversitas IT Systems Ltd. by introducing a quality management system and information security" is to increase the international competitiveness of the company through the introduction of a management system according to international standards ISO 27001 (information security management) and ISO 9001 (quality management). The purpose of the project is to ensure high standards of safety and quality of products and services, increase customer confidence and facilitate entry to new international markets with their own software products. The total investment is EUR 20 631, the amount of aid requested is EUR 12 379 and the own co-financing is EUR 8 252.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta ''Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke Diversitas IT sustavi d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kvalitetom te informacijskom sigurnošću'' je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema međunarodnim standardima ISO 27001 (upravljanje informacijskom sigurnošću) i ISO 9001 (upravljanje kvalitetom). Svrha projekta je osigurati visoke standarde sigurnosti i kvalitete proizvoda i usluga, povećati povjerenje klijenata te olakšati ulazak na nova međunarodna tržišta vlastitim softverskim produktima. Ukupno ulaganje iznosi 20.631 EUR, iznos tražene potpore 12.379 EUR, a vlastito sufinanciranje 8.252 EUR.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of Duplico through the certification of products based on DXL technology
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti tvrtke Duplico kroz certifikaciju proizvoda baziranih na DXL tehnologiji
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Duplico d.o.o. has patented innovative technology for automated assembly and disassembly of laminated electrical circuits, and plans to start the commercialization of technology by producing low-voltage electrical cabinets based on new technology. In order to ensure the complete safety, quality and market acceptability of its products, with this project the company plans to certify the first five products (low voltage blocks of electrical cabinets and substations) in accordance with international standards and standards IEC 61439, IEC 61000, IEC 61326 and HRN EN 61439.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka Duplico d.o.o. patentirala je inovativnu tehnologiju za automatizirano sastavljanje i rastavljanje laminiranih električnih sklopova, te planira započeti komercijalizaciju tehnologije proizvodnjom niskonaponskih električnih ormara baziranih na novoj tehnologiji. Kako bi osigurala potpunu sigurnost, kvalitetu i tržišnu prihvatljivost svojih proizvoda, tvrtka ovim projektom planira certificirati prvih pet proizvoda (niskonaponski blokovi elektro-ormara i trafostanica) u skladu s međunarodnim standardima i normama IEC 61439, IEC 61000, IEC 61326 i HRN EN 61439.

Operation_Name_English: Development of a new heavy duty palletizer
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj novog paletizatora za teške terete
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Development of a new heavy duty palletizer" addresses the problem of inefficient palletization and depalletization of loads up to 200 kg in industrial companies, especially in the production of food and beverages, which causes high operating costs and reduced productivity. The aim of the project is to develop an innovative system that will increase capacity, reduce costs and enable process automation. Target groups include industrial companies that regularly receive or ship goods on pallets, production managers looking for process optimization, and machine operators that will make the system easier to operate and increase safety.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Razvoj novog paletizatora za teške terete" adresira problem neučinkovite paletizacije i depaletizacije tereta do 200 kg u industrijskim tvrtkama, naročito u proizvodnji hrane i pića, što uzrokuje visoke operativne troškove i smanjenu produktivnost. Cilj projekta je razvoj inovativnog sustava koji će povećati kapacitet, smanjiti troškove i omogućiti automatizaciju procesa. Ciljne skupine uključuju industrijske tvrtke koje redovito primaju ili šalju robu na paletama, proizvodne menadžere koji traže optimizaciju procesa te operatere strojeva kojima će sustav olakšati rad i povećati sigurnost.

Operation_Name_English: You're not alone in Phase IV.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Niste sami Faza IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective of this project proposal will contribute to increasing social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care in the Virovitica-Podravina County. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for 150 members of the target group in the Virovitica-Podravina County. The main activity includes the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies to persons over 65 years of age and persons with disabilities. With this project proposal, the association plans to hire 25 service providers for 150 members of the target group.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj ovog projektnog prijedloga doprinijet će povećanju socijalne uključenosti i prevenciji institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi na području Virovitičko-podravske županije. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 150 pripadnika ciljane skupine na području Virovitičko-podravske županije. Glavna aktivnost uključuje pružanje usluga potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština osobama starijim od 65 godina i osobama s invaliditetom. Ovim projektnim prijedlogom udruga planira zaposliti 25 pružatelja usluga za 150 pripadnika ciljne skupine.

Operation_Name_English: Providing assistants to students with disabilities in the elementary school of the City of Čakovec - VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Osiguravanje pomoćnika učenicima s teškoćama u OŠ Grada Čakovca - VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to employ 49 unemployed persons as PUN/CPC and through the implementation of the introduction program to provide better integration into the regular classroom department of a total of 59 students with developmental difficulties. Activities include the selection of candidates for employment, the PUN/CPC deployment programme and PUN/CPC operations.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta zaposliti 49 nezaposlenih osoba kao PUN/SKP te kroz provođenje programa uvođenja u rad pružiti kvalitetniju integraciju u redovni razredni odjel ukupno 59 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju. Aktivnosti uključuju selekciju kandidata za zapošljavanje, program uvođenja u rad PUN/SKP te rad PUN/SKP.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of Infoscope d.o.o. through the implementation and certification of management systems
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti tvrtke Infoscope d.o.o. kroz implementaciju i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project lasts 12 months and aims to implement and certify the ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 (IT service management) and ISO 22301:2019 (Business Continuity Management) standards. It improves business processes, increases the security of IT systems and ensures crisis resilience. Through analysis, documentation, education and internal verification, Infoscope d.o.o. will align its business with international standards, which will reduce operational risks and increase efficiency. Certification will make it possible to strengthen competitiveness, expand to new markets and increase customer confidence, thus ensuring stable growth and business sustainability in the long term.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt traje 12 mjeseci i ima za cilj implementaciju i certifikaciju standarda ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 (upravljanje IT uslugama) i ISO 22301:2019 (upravljanje kontinuitetom poslovanja). Njime se unaprjeđuju poslovni procesi, povećava sigurnost IT sustava i osigurava otpornost na krizne situacije. Kroz analizu, dokumentaciju, edukaciju i internu provjeru, Infoscope d.o.o. će uskladiti svoje poslovanje s međunarodnim standardima, čime će smanjiti operativne rizike i povećati učinkovitost. Certifikacija će omogućiti jačanje konkurentnosti, širenje na nova tržišta i veće povjerenje klijenata, čime će tvrtka dugoročno osigurati stabilan rast i održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Wish, turn on, stand still
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI, UKLJUČI SE, OSTVARI SE
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to provide support and support services in everyday life to vulnerable groups of society, people over 65 and adults with disabilities, thereby increasing their social inclusion and preventing institutionalisation by providing long-term care in the form of community-based services.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu ranjivim skupinama društva, osobama starijim od 65 g. i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom čime se povećava njihova socijalna uključenost i prevenira institucionalizacija osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi u vidu usluga u zajednici.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening sustainable growth and competitiveness of B.I.D. GRUPA d.o.o. through investment in certification and implementation of management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje održivog rasta i konkurentnosti tvrtke B.I.D. GRUPA d.o.o. kroz ulaganje u certifikaciju i uvođenje sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to strengthen the sustainable growth and competitiveness of the company B.I.D. GRUPA d.o.o. through the introduction and certification of management systems based on internationally recognized standards ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and ISO 9001. Expected results include the implementation of 3 key standards that will: - Improve the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information. - Ensure high standards of personal data protection. - Improve process efficiency and customer satisfaction. The project includes consulting services for standard implementation, employee education and certification by an accredited body. The implementation of these activities will enable the company to strengthen its competitiveness on the domestic and international markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je jačanje održivog rasta i konkurentnosti poduzeća B.I.D. GRUPA d.o.o. kroz uvođenje i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja temeljenih na međunarodno priznatim normama ISO 27001, ISO 27701 i ISO 9001. Očekivani rezultati uključuju implementaciju 3 ključna standarda koji će: - Poboljšati povjerljivost, cjelovitost i dostupnost informacija. - Osigurati visoke standarde zaštite osobnih podataka. - Unaprijediti učinkovitost procesa i zadovoljstvo klijenata. Projekt uključuje savjetodavne usluge za implementaciju standarda, edukaciju djelatnika te certifikaciju od strane akreditiranog tijela. Provedba ovih aktivnosti omogućit će poduzeću jačanje konkurentnosti na domaćem i međunarodnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Construction and equipping of the athletic stadium in Požega
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja i opremanje atletskog stadiona u Požegi
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of public tourism assets and tourism services|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes the construction and equipping of an athletics stadium in the area of the city of Požega, which will enable the further development of athletics in the urban area of Požega, where there is a long tradition of practicing athletics in the area of the city itself, but there are no conditions for its further development. It will promote and enable recreational sports with a special focus on the younger population. Also, the stadium will play a tourist role due to the possibility of holding sports competitions, as well as other tourist events. The target group is the entire population with special emphasis on young people whether they are engaged in athletics recreationally or are members of an athletic club from the area of urban area, but also the entire county.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća izgradnju i opremanje atletskog stadiona na području grada Požege koji će omogućiti daljnji razvoj atletike na urbanom području Požega gdje na području samog grada postoji duga tradicija bavljenje atletikom, ali ne postoje uvjeti za njen daljnji razvoj. Promicat će i omogućiti rekreativno bavljenje sportom s posebnim naglaskom na mlađu populaciju. Također, predmetni stadion će imati i turističku ulogu zbog mogućnosti održavanja sportskih natjecanja, ali i drugih turistički događanja. Ciljna skupina je cjelokupno stanovništvo s posebnim naglaskom na mlade bilo da se atletikom bave rekreativno ili su članovi atletskog kluba s područja urbanog područja, ali i cijele županije.

Operation_Name_English: Wishes IV – prevention of institutionalisation
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi IV – prevencija institucionalizacije
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide long-term care by providing support and support services in everyday life for at least 132 members of the target group, which contributes to increasing social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta osigurati dugotrajnu skrb pružanjem usluga potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za minimalno 132 pripadnika ciljne skupine što doprinosi povećanju socijalne uključenosti i prevenciji institucionalizacije.

Operation_Name_English: InnovativeRobotSistemNovotexBOTDSA
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: InovativniRobotskiSistemNovotexBOTDSA
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The InnovativeRobotSistemNovotexBOTDSA project solves the problem of inefficient palletization and depalletization in industrial companies, increasing productivity and reducing labor costs. The aim of the project is to develop an advanced robotic system for automation of these processes, which will use innovative technologies such as digital twin and optimization of the ferry industry. Target groups include industrial companies that regularly receive goods on pallets with packages under 18 kg, production managers and machine operators. The project will improve production efficiency, enable faster adaptation to changes and reduce the need for specialized technical knowledge.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt InovativniRobotskiSistemNovotexBOTDSA rješava problem neučinkovite paletizacije i depaletizacije u industrijskim tvrtkama, povećavajući produktivnost i smanjujući troškove rada. Cilj projekta je razviti napredni robotski sustav za automatizaciju ovih procesa, koji će koristiti inovativne tehnologije poput digitalnog blizanca i optimizacije trajektorije. Ciljne skupine uključuju industrijske tvrtke koje redovito primaju robu na paletama s paketima ispod 18 kg, proizvodne menadžere i operatere strojeva. Projekt će poboljšati efikasnost proizvodnje, omogućiti brže prilagodbe promjenama i smanjiti potrebu za specijaliziranim tehničkim znanjem.

Operation_Name_English: Waste Management Centre Babina Gora - Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Centar za gospodarenje otpadom Babina gora - Faza 2
Category_Label: Household waste management: landfill
Operation_Summary_English: The construction of the Babina Gora waste management centre with all its components (transfer stations and associated infrastructure) will improve the waste management system in Karlovac County, the western part of Sisak-Moslavina County (City of Glina, Municipality of Gvozd and Topusko) and the northeastern part of Lika-Senj County (City of Otočac, Municipality of Plitvice Lakes, Vrhovine and Brinje). The implementation of the project will contribute to the state of the environment in the wider area of the project site and ensure numerous socio-economic benefits and achieve the protection of soil, water, human health, air and a positive impact on climate change.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Izgradnjom centra za gospodarenje otpadom Babina gora sa svim sastavnim dijelovima (pretovarne stanice i pripadajuća infrastruktura) unaprijedit će se sustav gospodarenja otpadom u Karlovačkoj županiji, zapadnom dijelu Sisačko-moslavačke županije (Grad Glina, Općine Gvozd i Topusko) i sjeveroistočnom dijelu Ličko-senjske županije (Grad Otočac, Općine Plitvička jezera, Vrhovine i Brinje). Provedbom projekta doprinijet će se stanju okoliša na širem području lokacije zahvata i osigurati brojne društveno-ekonomske koristi i postići zaštita tla, voda, zdravlja ljudi, zraka i pozitivan utjecaj na klimatske promjene.

Operation_Name_English: Project for the improvement of the water and communal infrastructure of the agglomeration of Zadar - Petrčane - Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Projekt poboljšanja vodno-komunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Zadar - Petrčane - faza 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project consists of two phases. Phase 1 of the project includes investment investments within the financial period OPKK 2014-2020. Phase 2 of the project covers investment investments within the financial period of the PKK 2021-2027. The project includes investments in the drainage and waste water treatment system of the Zadar-Pekrne agglomeration in order to meet the requirements of Directive 91/271/EEC.The project consists of the construction, rehabilitation and reconstruction of the drainage system, the parallel reconstruction of the water supply system, and investments in the technological water project at the existing UPOV Centar (grade II, 100.000 ES).Total whole project (stage 1 and phase 2): Total value of the project with VAT: €101,701,133.93 total eligible costs, €81,360,915.15
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se sastoji od dvije faze. 1.faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja OPKK 2014-2020. 2.faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja PKK 2021-2027. Projekt obuhvaća ulaganja u sustav odvodnje i pročišćavanja otpadnih voda aglomeracije Zadar-Petrčane u svrhu ispunjavanja uvjeta Direktive 91/271/EEC.Projekt se sastoji od izgradnje, sanacije te rekonstrukcije sustava odvodnje, usporedne rekonstrukcije sustava vodoopskrbe, te investicije na zahvatu tehnološke vode na postojećem UPOV-u Centar (II. stupanj, 100.000 ES).Ukupno cijeli projekt (faza 1 i faza 2): ukupna vrijednost projekta s PDV-om: 101.701.143,93 Eura ukupno prihvatljivi troškovi, 81.360.915,15 Eur

Operation_Name_English: "With the support of all things possible, phase VII"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Uz potporu sve je moguće, faza VII"
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure inclusive education that leaves the center of attention to the needs of 57 students with developmental disabilities in primary and secondary educational institutions founded by the Bjelovar-Bilogora County. By providing direct support in accordance with the individual needs of students, the project will involve 57 teaching assistants/professional communication mediators in order to contribute to the improvement of students' achievements, their successful socialization with a tendency to independence of students in the school environment and emotional functioning, which indirectly affects the reduction of child poverty. The project contributes to already started processes and initiatives at regional and local level.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja koji ostavlja središte stavlja potrebe 57 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno - obrazovnim ustanovama kojima je osnivač Bjelovarsko - bilogorska županija. Pružanjem neposredne podrške u skladu s individualnim potrebama učenika kroz projekt uključit će se 57 pomoćnika u nastavi / stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika kako bi se pridonijelo poboljšanju postignuća učenika, njihovoj uspješnoj socijalizaciji s tendencijom osamostaljivanja učenika u školskoj sredini i emocionalnom funkcioniranju što posredno utječe i na smanjenje dječjeg siromaštva. Projektom se pridonosi već započetim procesima i inicijativama na regionalnoj i lokalnoj razini.

Operation_Name_English: Teaching assistants VII - Elementary school Garešnica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoćnici u nastavi VII - OŠ Garešnica
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is to provide students of Primary School Garešnica and Primary School Trnovitička Popovac with developmental difficulties with teaching assistants/professional communication mediators in order to successfully engage in the regular educational system, which would lead to easier emotional functioning and socialization of students. Main activities of the project: • Selection of candidates for teaching assistants/professional communication mediators • Introducing teaching assistants/professional communication mediators • Work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators • Communication and visibility (public information, posters) • Project management and administration
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog projekta je učenicima Osnovne škole Garešnica i Osnovne škole Trnovitički Popovac s teškoćama u razvoju osigurati pomoćnike u nastavi/stručne komunikacijske posrednike kako bi se što uspješnije uključili u redovni odgojno - obrazovni sustav, što bi dovelo do olakšanog emocionalnog funkcioniranja i socijalizacije učenika. Glavne aktivnosti projekta: • selekcija kandidata za pomoćnike u nastavi/stručne komunikacijske posrednike • uvođenje u rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika • rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika • komunikacija i vidljivost (informiranje javnosti, plakati) • upravljanje projektom i administracija

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international competitiveness of Kodilion d.o.o. by introducing a business continuity, environmental and IT services management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke Kodilion d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kontinuitetom poslovanja, okolišem te IT uslugama
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of the project "Increasing the international competitiveness of Kodilion d.o.o. by introducing a business continuity, environmental and IT services management system" is to increase the international competitiveness of the company through the introduction of a management system according to international standards ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 (IT services management), ISO 22301:2019 (business continuity management) and ISO 14001:2015 (environmental management). The purpose of the project is to ensure high standards of quality of IT services, resilience of business processes and responsible environmental management, which will increase client confidence and facilitate entry into new international markets with their own software products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta "Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke Kodilion d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kontinuitetom poslovanja, okolišem te IT uslugama'' je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema međunarodnim standardima ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 (upravljanje IT uslugama), ISO 22301:2019 (upravljanje kontinuitetom poslovanja) i ISO 14001:2015 (upravljanje okolišem). Svrha projekta je osigurati visoke standarde kvalitete IT usluga, otpornosti poslovnih procesa i odgovornog upravljanja okolišem, čime će se povećati povjerenje klijenata i olakšati ulazak na nova međunarodna tržišta s vlastitim softverskim proizvodima.

Operation_Name_English: JAKOB promo STEM – Strengthening capacities for STEM education and promotion
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: JAKOB promo STEM – Jačanje kapaciteta za obrazovanje i promociju STEM-a
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: JAKOB promo STEM - Strengthening capacities for education and promotion of STEM is implemented by civil society organization Croatian Institute for Education Development (HIR) with six partners: two kindergartens, three primary schools and a higher education institution, in the area of Zagreb and Sisak. The aim is to increase the capacity and encourage cooperation between organisations for the implementation of innovative and entertaining STEM programmes for children and students, as well as the promotion and popularisation of STEM. 240 workshops will be carried out for 610 children and students, a series of promotional events and several trainings for employees of the association and educational institutions in the implementation of the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: JAKOB promo STEM - Jačanje kapaciteta za obrazovanje i promociju STEM-a provodi organizacija civilnog društva Hrvatski institut za razvoj obrazovanja (HIR) sa šest partnera: dva dječja vrtića, tri osnovne škole i visokoškolskom ustanovom, na području Zagreba i Siska. Cilj je povećati kapacitet i potaknuti suradnje između organizacija za provedbu inovativnih i zabavnih programa iz područja STEM-a za djecu i učenike, kao i promociju i popularizaciju STEM-a. Provest će se 240 radionica za 610 djece i učenika, niz promotivnih događanja i nekoliko izobrazbi za zaposlenike udruge i odgojno-obrazovnih institucija u provedbi projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Green Digital Park Papuk - Sports and recreation center with digital-educational content
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zeleno digitalni park Papuk - Sportsko-rekreacijski centar s digitalno-edukacijskim sadržajem
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Protection, development and promotion of public tourism assets and tourism services|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to contribute to the promotion of integrated and inclusive social and economic development, by building and equipping multifunctional sports and recreational infrastructure. The project will build and equip a sports and recreation zone, a social sports zone for children and young people with sports playgrounds, urban equipment and multimedia display, a training ground, hiking trails, parking and sanitary facilities. The project achieves multifunctionality of the public space by using innovative solutions, contributing to urban regeneration, building green infrastructure, health and well-being of citizens, improving social, educational, sports and recreational facilities as well as expanding the tourist offer of UP Vinkovci.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je doprinijeti poticanju integriranog i uključivog društvenog i gospodarskog razvoja, izgradnjom i opremanjem višenamjenske sportsko-rekreacijske infrastrukture. Projektom će se izgraditi i opremiti sportsko-rekreacijska zona, društveno sportska zona za djecu i mlade sa sportskim igralištima, urbanom opremom i multimedijalnom postavom, vježbalištem, pješačke staze, parkiralište te sanitarni čvor. Projektom se postiže multifunkcionalnost javnog prostora korištenjem inovativnih rješenja, uz doprinos urbanoj regeneraciji, izgradnji zelene infrastrukture, zdravlju i dobrobiti građana, unapređenju društvenih, edukativnih, sportsko-rekreacijskih sadržaja kao i proširenju turističke ponude UP Vinkovci.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of bicycle paths in the municipality of Privlaka
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističkih staza na području općine Privlaka
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to promote sustainable mobility and better connectivity of public transport infrastructure through the construction of cycling infrastructure in the municipality of Privlaka, which will contribute to better connectivity on daily migration lines in the urban area, reduction of pollutant emissions and increased safety of cyclists and other road users. Project activities: 1. Project-technical documentation of bicycle paths and the document "Analysis of the state of cycling traffic" 2. Public procurement procedure, construction and expert supervision of bicycle paths 3. Project management and administration 4. Promotion and visibility
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je promicanje održive mobilnosti i bolja povezanost javne prometne infrastrukture kroz izgradnju biciklističke infrastrukture na području općine Privlaka, koja će doprinijeti boljoj povezanosti na linijama dnevnih migracija na urbanom području, smanjenju emisija onečišćujućih tvari te povećanoj sigurnosti biciklista, ali i ostalih sudionika u prometu. Aktivnosti projekta: 1. Projektno-tehnička dokumentacija biciklističkih staza i dokument "Analiza stanja biciklističkog prometa“ 2. Postupak javne nabave, izgradnja i stručni nadzor biciklističkih staza 3. Upravljanje projektom i administracija 4. Promidžba i vidljivost

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of service management systems according to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018

Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of the project Implementation of the service management system according to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 is to increase the competitiveness and compliance of Micro-Link d.o.o. business operations. Sales revenues are expected to increase by 15.5% and exports by 5.5%. The project contributes to the Smart Specialization Strategy by developing secure digital solutions and strengthening the company's position in international markets. The duration of the project is 18 months, with a total value of EUR 36,432.00, of which EUR 22,149.00 is a grant.

Implementacija i certifikacija omogućit će optimizaciju poslovnih procesa, povećanje sigurnosti informacija i kvalitetu usluga, smanjenje rizika od kibernetičkih prijetnji te jačanje povjerenja klijenata i partnera. Očekuje se porast prihoda od prodaje za 15,5% i povećanje izvoza za 5,5%. Projekt doprinosi Strategiji pametne specijalizacije kroz razvoj sigurnih digitalnih rješenja i jačanje pozicije tvrtke na međunarodnim tržištima. Trajanje projekta je 18 mjeseci, uz ukupnu vrijednost od 36.432,00 EUR, od čega 22.149,00 EUR čine bespovratna sredstva.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a management system according to the FSC standard that will make the company more competitive on the national and international market and thus enable it to further grow in accordance with strategic goals. By implementing the project, the company will be able to get new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards, and in which so far it has not been able to compete.

Implementacija sustava upravljanja i stjecanje certifikata rezultirat će većim povjerenjem kupaca, ali i produktivnijim, efikasnijim i sigurnijim poslovanjem, što je interes tvrtke, djelatnika, klijenata i dobavljača koji su ciljana skupina projekta. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama, a u kojima do sada nije mogla konkurirati.

Operation_Name_English: PUNa Knowledge School 2024/2025
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Škola PUNa znanja 2024./2025.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the PUNa Knowledge School 2024/2025 project is to support the education and socialization of students with disabilities in a regular education program through the work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators. The project will involve a total of 18 students of TOŠ Galileo Galilei and elementary school Marija i Line, who will, thanks to the help of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators, achieve better success in school, will be easier to socialize, emotionally empower and develop a range of skills that enable them to live independently.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta Škola PUNa znanja 2024./2025. je pružiti podršku obrazovanju i socijalizaciji učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u redovitom programu obrazovanja kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika. Projekt će uključiti ukupno 18 učenika TOŠ Galileo Galilei i OŠ Marije i Line koji će zahvaljujući pomoći pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika postići bolji uspjeh u školi, lakše će se socijalizirati, emocionalno osnažiti i razviti niz vještina koje ih osposobljavaju za samostalni život.

Operation_Name_English: Zaželi - prevention of institutionalization - Municipality of Trpinja 4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - prevencija institucionalizacije - Općina Trpinja 4
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will provide care and care for at least 132 end-users - older people and people with disabilities - with the delivery of a monthly package of household and hygiene supplies. Project activities (assistance in preparing meals, performing household chores, assistance in maintaining personal hygiene and other daily needs) will enable a better and more fulfilling life for vulnerable groups of society by facilitating life in their own household and their greater inclusion. These activities directly promote the prevention of institutionalization by providing adequate care by providing a service of support and support in everyday life.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se omogućiti briga i skrb za najmanje 132 krajnja korisnika- osobe starije životne dobi i osobe s invaliditetom- uz isporuku mjesečnog paketa kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština. Projektne aktivnosti (pomoć u pripremi obroka, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, pomoć u održavaju osobne higijene i ostalih svakodnevnih potreba), omogućit će se kvalitetniji i ispunjeniji život ranjivim skupinama društva olakšavajući život u vlastitom domaćinstvu te njihovoj većoj uključenosti. Navedene aktivnosti direktno promiču prevenciju institucionalizacije osiguravanjem adekvatne skrbi pružajući uslugu potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu.

Operation_Name_English: "We are with you" - help for the elderly and people with disabilities

Project activities of providing support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies which includes the recruitment of 30 service providers for 180 members of the target group, monitoring and control, procurement and distribution of packages, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom na području grada Drniša. Kroz veću socijalnu uključenost i duži ostanak u vlastitom domu povećava se kvaliteta života i dostojanstvenije starenje. Projektne aktivnosti pružanja usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje zapošljavanje 30 pružatelja usluga za 180 pripadnika ciljane skupine, praćenje i kontrola, nabava i podjela paketa, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project is planned to invest in the reconstruction of the institution in culture, the Hum Na Sutli National Library, in order to increase accessibility and participation in the cultural life of all citizens, especially members of vulnerable groups. Reconstruction and equipping and applying technological solutions through new multimedia content improves cultural infrastructure accessible to everyone in the same way.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom je planirano ulaganje u rekonstrukciju ustanove u kulturi, Narodne knjižnice Hum na Sutli, u svrhu povećanja pristupačnosti i sudjelovanja u kulturnom životu svih građana, osobito pripadnika ranjivih skupina. Time će knjižnica dobiti funkcionalni, suvremeni i sadržajni oblik središnje narodne knjižnice, koja će razvojem i provedbom inovativnih kulturnih usluga i programa stvarati dodanu vrijednosti za Hum na Sutli te razvijati ulogu knjižnice kao centra kulture, čitanja, društvenosti, kreativnosti te kvalitetnog slobodnog vremena za sve pripadnike lokalne zajednice. Rekonstrukcijom i opremanjem te primjenom tehnoloških rješenja kroz nove multimedijske sadržaje unapređuje se kulturna infrastruktura dostupna svima na jednak način.

Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SPAS U ZADNJI ČAS - ZAŽELI FAZA IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The goals are to provide support and support in everyday life to the elderly and people with disabilities through the provision of services of procurement and distribution of packages of supplies for min. 6 members of the target group per each of the 12 employed service providers. That's at least 72 members of the target group. The service contains activities of organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and meeting other everyday needs. It will be held for 33 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi su pružanje podrške i potpore u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom i to kroz pružanje usluge nabave i podjele paketa potrepština za min. 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine po svakom od 12 zaposlenih pružatelja usluge. To je min. 72 pripadnika ciljne skupine. Usluga sadrži aktivnosti organiziranja prehrane, obavljanja kućanskih poslova, održavanja osobne higijene i zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba. Provodit će se 33 mjeseca.

Operation_Name_English: Potentials of AI in analytics and development of new models (Use of AI in the field of analytics)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Potencijali umjetne inteligencije u analitici i razvoj novih modela (Upotreba AI na području Analitike)
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project addresses the problem of the untapped potential of artificial intelligence (AI) in data analytics, which represents a significant obstacle to the optimization of business processes. The project aims to thoroughly explore existing AI applications in the metal industry, identify key strengths, challenges and future trends, and develop new data analysis models that enable deeper insights, improving informed decision-making. Target groups include a company that uses data analytics to improve its operations, AI researchers, and decision makers interested in innovative solutions that can significantly increase productivity and optimise resources within the organisation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt adresira problem neiskorištenih potencijala umjetne inteligencije (UI) u analitici podataka, što predstavlja značajnu prepreku za optimizaciju poslovnih procesa. Cilj projekta je temeljito istražiti postojeće primjene UI u metalni industriji, identificirati ključne prednosti, izazove i buduće trendove, te razviti nove modele analize podataka koji omogućuju dublje uvide, poboljšavajući donošenje informiranih odluka. Ciljne skupine uključuju poduzeće koje koristi analitiku podataka za unapređenje svojih operacija, istraživače u području umjetne inteligencije te donositelje odluka koji su zainteresirani za inovativna rješenja koja mogu značajno povećati produktivnost i optimizirati resurse unutar organizacije.

Operation_Name_English: Business improvement through certification of wastewater treatment products
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje poslovanja kroz certificiranje proizvoda za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project Business improvement through certification of wastewater treatment products is carried out by the company BP GROUP d.o.o. specialized in mediation, design, consulting and research in the field of (waste) water and air treatment. The project will certify 2 plants of the company (biological plant and DAF flotation) according to the European standard EN 12566-3:2005+A2:2013, which refers to small wastewater treatment plants with a capacity of up to 50 users. The result of the project will be 2 certified devices, an increase in total revenues of 30% and exports of 30% and expansion to new EU markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Unaprjeđenje poslovanja kroz certificiranje proizvoda za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda provodi poduzeće BP GROUP d.o.o. specijalizirano za posredovanje, projektiranje, savjetovanje i istraživanje u području pročišćavanja (otpadnih) voda i zraka. Projektom će se certificirati 2 uređaja poduzeća (biološki uređaj i DAF flotacija) prema europskom standardu EN 12566-3:2005+A2:2013, koji se odnosi na male uređaje za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda s kapacitetom do 50 korisnika. Rezultat projekta će biti 2 certificirana uređaja, porast ukupnih prihoda od 30% i izvoza od 30% te širenje na nova tržišta EU.

Operation_Name_English: Wish a job - take the challenge! - prevention of institutionalization in the Municipality of Slavonski Šamac
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi posao - prihvati izazov! - prevencija institucionalizacije u Općini Slavonski Šamac
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care through the implementation of the project by providing support and support services in everyday life to older persons with disabilities. The project will employ 20 service providers for at least 120 members of the target group for organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and meeting other daily needs with the purchase and monthly delivery of packages with at least 5 prescribed products. Through the project, monitoring and control of the services performed will be carried out and communication and visibility activities, as well as project management and administration will be actively implemented.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi tako što će kroz provedbu projekta biti pružane usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama s invaliditetom. Kroz projekt će biti zaposleno 20 pružatelja usluga za najmanje 120 pripadnika ciljane skupine za organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene te zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba uz nabavu i mjesečnu isporuku paketa s potrepštinama s minimalno 5 propisanih proizvoda. Kroz projekt će se vršiti praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga te će se aktivno provoditi aktivnosti komunikacije i vidljivosti te upravljanje i administracija projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of trades AMK STROJARSTVO by introducing a management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti obrta AMK STROJARSTVO uvođenjem sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of AMK STROJARSTVO by introducing a management system with the help of grants and own resources. This project will implement 3 standards: ISO 9001:2015 (quality management system), EN 1090-2 EXC2 (technical requirements for steel structures) and 3834-3 (international standard in welding) . The purpose of the project is to enable the introduction of a management system facilitated access to the domestic market and the targeted foreign market, increase competitiveness, prove the level of quality and safety in the exchange of their products on the market and contribute to customer confidence. Expected results of the project are increased sales revenue and sales revenue in foreign markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta jest uz pomoć bespovratnih sredstava i vlastitih izvora povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost obrta AMK STROJARSTVO uvođenjem sustava upravljanja. Predmetnim će se projektom implementirati 3 norme: ISO 9001:2015 (sustav upravljanja kvalitetom), EN 1090-2 EXC2 (tehnički zahtjevi za čelične konstrukcije) i 3834-3 (međunarodni standard u zavarivanju) . Svrha projekta je omogućiti uvođenjem sustava upravljanja olakšani pristup domaćem tržištu i ciljanom inozemnom tržištu, povećati konkurentnost, dokazati razinu kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni svojih proizvoda na tržištu te pridonijeti povjerenju kupaca. Očekivani rezultati projekta su povećani prihod od prodaje, te prihod od prodaje na inozemnim tržištima.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a management system according to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 3834 standards that will make the company more competitive on the national and international market and thus enable its further growth in accordance with strategic goals. The implementation of the management system and the acquisition of ISO certification will result in greater customer confidence, but also a more productive, efficient and secure business, which is the interest of the company, employees, clients and suppliers who are the target group of the project. By implementing the project, the company will be able to get new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards, and in which so far it has not been able to compete.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normi ISO 9001:2015 i ISO 3834 koji će tvrtku učiniti konkurentnijom na nacionalnom i internacionalnom tržištu te joj time omogućiti daljnji rast u skladu sa strateškim ciljevima. Implementacija sustava upravljanja i stjecanje ISO certifikata rezultirat će većim povjerenjem kupaca, ali i produktivnijim, efikasnijim i sigurnijim poslovanjem, što je interes tvrtke, djelatnika, klijenata i dobavljača koji su ciljana skupina projekta. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama, a u kojima do sada nije mogla konkurirati.

Operation_Name_English: BusCARD 4.0 IoT
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: BusCARD 4.0 IoT
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The Driver Control Computer (DCC) project led by PENTA, in cooperation with partners DS&S, EINEL, Superius and the University of Istria, is aimed at creating an innovative device that will be integrated into public transport vehicles for passengers and goods. This device is a revolutionary all-in-one system that integrates functionalities traditionally divided into multiple separate devices (computer, map validator and printer) into one unique solution.
