Through the phases of industrial research and experimental development, the project plans to develop 'proof-of-concept' solutions, integrate certified components and implement functional and technical innovations, thus contributing to increased efficiency and sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt razvoja vozačkog računala (DCC – Driver Control Computer) koji predvodi PENTA, u suradnji s partnerima DS&S, EINEL, Superius i Istarskim veleučilištem, usmjeren je na stvaranje inovativnog uređaja koji će se integrirati u vozila javnog prijevoza putnika i robe. Ovaj uređaj predstavlja revolucionarni "all-in-one" sustav koji integrira funkcionalnosti koje su tradicionalno podijeljene na više odvojenih uređaja (računalo, validator karte i printer), u jedno jedinstveno rješenje. Kroz faze industrijskog istraživanja i eksperimentalnog razvoja, projekt planira razviti 'proof-of-concept' rješenja, integrirati certificirane komponente i implementirati funkcionalne i tehničke inovacije, čime se doprinosi povećanju efikasnosti te održivosti.

Operation_Name_English: Conformity assessment and product certification of Industrooprema d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ocjenjivanje sukladnosti i certifikacija proizvoda poduzeća Industrooprema d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: This project is aimed at increasing the international competitiveness of enterprises through the certification of key products for electricity overhead networks. Certification according to European standards (EN 61284, EN 1461, EN 50483) will enable access to new markets, increase sales and export revenues and participation in international projects and procurements. The project will test and certify 344 products, ensuring their safety, reliability and compliance with regulatory requirements. Sales revenues are expected to grow by 30% and exports by 30-40%. Through standardization of business processes and proven certificates, Industrooprema will strengthen its market position and increase competitiveness in the long run.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovaj projekt usmjeren je na povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poduzeća kroz certificiranje ključnih proizvoda za elektroenergetske nadzemne mreže. Certifikacija prema europskim normama (EN 61284, EN 1461, EN 50483) omogućit će pristup novim tržištima, povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza te sudjelovanje u međunarodnim projektima i javnim nabavama. Projektom će se ispitati i certificirati 344 proizvoda, što će osigurati njihovu sigurnost, pouzdanost i usklađenost s regulatornim zahtjevima. Očekuje se rast prihoda od prodaje za 30% te povećanje izvoza za 30-40%. Kroz standardizaciju poslovnih procesa i dokazane certifikate, Industrooprema će osnažiti svoju tržišnu poziciju i dugoročno povećati konkurentnost.

Operation_Name_English: Development of advanced metal machining services using innovative production methods and technologies
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj naprednih usluga strojne obrade metala primjenom inovativnih proizvodnih metoda i tehnologija
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in large enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project is implemented for 36 months and implies the establishment of a SPIN consortium consisting of the Applicant, the company HS product d.o.o. and Partners, the companies Niteh d.o.o., SAB d.o.o. and Craft Wine Juraj Tools. In addition to these companies, the role of Partner in the consortium is also played by the organization for research and dissemination of knowledge, i.e. the Polytechnic of Karlovac. The aim of the project is to implement the set activities with the aim of developing an innovative service of advanced integrated metal processing by multifunctional and parallel execution of operations and an innovative service of creating special tools for injection molding and MIM (Metal Injection Molding).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se provodi 36 mjeseci i podrazumijeva uspostavu SPIN konzorcija kojeg čine Prijavitelj, poduzeće HS produkt d.o.o. te Partneri, poduzeća Niteh d.o.o., SAB d.o.o te Obrt Vinski Juraj alati. Uz navedena poduzeća, ulogu Partnera u konzorciju ima i organizacija za istraživanje i širenje znanja, odnosno Veleučilište u Karlovcu. Cilj projekta je provedba zadanih aktivnosti s ciljem razvoja inovativne usluge napredne integrirane obrade metala multifunkcijskim i paralelnim izvođenjem operacija i inovativne usluge izrade specijalnih alata za injekcijsko brizganje i MIM (Metal Injection Molding).

Operation_Name_English: Support to Community III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podrškom do zajedništva III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The realization of the project activities of the project "Support to Unity III" aims to ensure the prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups of the Šibenik-Knin County through the provision of assistance in the house and in carrying out everyday activities to the elderly and people with disabilities (cleaning, preparation of simple meals, payment of bills, purchase of groceries and medicines). Service providers will also socialise, talk to and support users. The service will be provided in the area of Šibenik-Knin County. The project will employ 22 service providers who will take care of 132 users.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Realizacijom projektnih aktivnosti projekta "Podrškom do zajedništva III" nastoji se osigurati prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina Šibensko-kninske županije kroz pružanje pomoći u kući i pri obavljanju svakodnevnih aktivnosti starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom (čišćenje, pripravak jednostavnih obroka, plaćanje računa, nabavka namirnica i lijekova). Također pružatelji usluga će se družiti i razgovarati s korisnicima te im pružati potporu. Usluga će biti pružena na području Šibensko-kninske županije. Na projektu će biti zaposleno 22 pružatelja usluga koji će skrbiti o 132 korisnika.

Operation_Name_English: Teaching Assistants - Grubišno Polje
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoćnici u nastavi - Grubišno Polje
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to enable inclusive education of students with disabilities in elementary school I.N. Jemeršić through the engagement of teaching assistants. Through this project, the aim will be to improve the educational achievements of students, encourage their socialization and emotional functioning. The main activities of the projects include the recruitment and training of teaching assistants and their work in supporting students with disabilities. Assistants will provide targeted support to students throughout the teaching process, adapting to their individual needs. Through these activities, the project team will create an inclusive environment that encourages the development of students with disabilities, facilitates their participation in school life and contributes to their overall development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je omogućiti inkluzivno obrazovanje učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u OŠ I.N. Jemeršića putem angažiranja pomoćnika u nastavi. Kroz ovaj projekt, nastojat će se unaprijediti obrazovna postignuća učenika, potaknuti njihovu socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Glavne aktivnosti projekata obuhvaćanju zapošljavanje i osposobljavanje pomoćnika u nastavi te njihov rad u podržavanju učenika s teškoćama. Pomoćnici će pružiti ciljanu potporu učenicima tijekom nastavnog procesa, prilagođavajući se njihovim individualnim potrebama. Kroz ove aktivnosti, projektni tim će stvoriti inkluzivno okruženje koje potiče razvoj učenika s teškoćama, olakšava njihovo sudjelovanje u školskom životu te doprinosi njihovom sveukupnom razvoju.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading of the port Prvić Šepurine - spatial unit 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja luke Prvić Šepurine - prostorna cjelina 2
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Upgrade of the port of Prvić Šepurine-spatial unit 2’ is intended to upgrade the port by building an additional port basin, building on the existing port and forming a new area for the depreciation of waves and breakwaters. The goal of the reconstruction of the port is to reduce the impact of waves on part of the coastal belt and land facilities and to provide a new protected sea area with accommodation capacity for 32 vessels. The investment in the extension of the port in Prvić Šepurine will improve the port infrastructure and equipment of the port on the island of Prvić in terms of receiving coastal liner passenger ships and boats, but also increase the safety and capacity of maritime transport and improve the economic potential of the island.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Dogradnja luke Prvić Šepurine-prostorna cjelina 2“ planira se dogradnja luke izgradnjom dodatnog lučkog bazena nastavno na postojeću luku te formiranje nove površine za amortizaciju valova i valobrana. Cilj rekonstrukcije luke je umanjiti utjecaj valova na dio obalnog pojasa i kopnene objekte te osiguravanje nove zaštićene morske površine sa smještajnim kapacitetom za 32 plovila. Ulaganje u dogradnju luke u mjestu Prvić Šepurine unaprijediti će lučku infrastrukturu i opremljenost luke na otoku Prviću u smislu prihvata obalnih linijskih putničkih brodova i brodica, ali će ujedno i povećati sigurnost i kapacitet pomorskog prijevoza te unaprijediti gospodarski potencijal otoka.

Operation_Name_English: Individual guarantees
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pojedinačna jamstva
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: max. 80% guaranteed amount from 300.001 to 10 m EUR for new loans for investments in tangible and intangible assets and related working capital
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: max. 80% jamčeni iznos od 300.001 do 10 m EUR za nove kredite za ulaganja u materijalnu i nematerijalnu imovinu te povezani obrtni kapital

Operation_Name_English: MOZAIK 6
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: MOZAIK 6
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the MOZAIK 6 project is to support the inclusion of students with disabilities in primary and secondary educational institutions in Istria County by engaging PUN/CPC to ensure the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The main activity of the project is to support the education of students with disabilities through the work of 100 PUN/CPC in 32 primary and secondary schools in the Istrian County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta MOZAIK 6 pružiti je potporu uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske i srednjoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove u Istarskoj županiji angažiranjem PUN/SKP kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Glavna aktivnost projekta je pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad 100 PUN/SKP u 32 osnovne i srednje škole u Istarskoj županiji.

Operation_Name_English: Communication, autonomy and immersive interface technologies on dual-use land unmanned vehicles adapted to unstructured terrains and changing conditions.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Tehnologije komunikacije, autonomije i imerzivnog sučelja na kopnenim bespilotnim vozilima dvojne namjene prilagođene nestrukturiranim terenima i promjenjivim uvjetima.
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project plans research and development with the aim of setting new concepts and paradigms in the development of unmanned vehicles for various applications. Technological advances in various fields open up opportunities to adapt and apply various technologies in improving the experience of using unmanned vehicles. New technologies have the potential to improve the experience of machine users by integrating sensory contributions of the machine with the video system in real time remote control technology.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se planira istraživanje i razvoj s ciljem postavljanja novih koncepata i paradigmi u razvoju bespilotnih vozila za različite primjene. Tehnološkim napredcima u različitim područjima otvaraju se mogućnosti prilagodbe i primjene raznih tehnologija u poboljšanju iskustva korištenja bespilotnih vozila. Nove tehnologije imaju potencijal unaprijediti iskustvo korisnika stroja integracijom senzornih doprinosa stroja sa video sustavom u realnom vremenu tehnologije daljinskog upravljanja.

Operation_Name_English: Development tests and conformity assessment of Orqa products with relevant standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvojna ispitivanja i ocjena sukladnosti Orqa proizvoda s odgovarajućim normama
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is to conduct development tests on the products FPV.Ctrl controller, Uberlite radiotransmitter, Orqa Microdron with radiotransmitter, Orqa SoccerDrone with radiotransmitter and Caged FPV Drone with radiotransmitter for conformity assessment with the relevant prescribed standards for the purpose of product marking CE marking, by an accredited body.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog projekta je provesti razvojna ispitivanja na proizvodima FPV.Ctrl kontroler, Uberlite radiotransmiter, Orqa Microdron s radiotransmiterom, Orqa SoccerDrone s radiotransmiterom i Caged FPV Drone s radiotransmiterom za ocjenu sukladnosti s odgovarajućim propisanim normama za potrebe označavanja proizvoda CE oznakom, a od strane akreditiranog tijela.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the international competitiveness of ARTRONIC d.o.o. by product certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke ARTRONIC d.o.o. certifikacijom proizvoda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of Artronic through product certification in accordance with internationally recognized standards to create preconditions for further growth and business development. Project activities will enable the elimination of the central problem of the company - the risk of a decline in the competitiveness of the company on the international market, and due to the inability to meet the continuous increase in the requirements of quality, safety and reliability of the product. Certification of 4 products will enable the exit to new international markets and the growth of sales and export revenues.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta jest povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost tvrtke Artronic kroz certifikaciju proizvoda u skladu s međunarodno priznatim normama stvoriti preduvjete za daljnji rast i razvoj poslovanja. Projektne aktivnosti omogućit će otklanjanje središnjeg problema tvrtke - opasnost od pada konkurentnosti tvrtke na međunarodnom tržištu, a uslijed nemogućnosti zadovoljavanja kontinuiranog povećanja zahtjeva kvalitete, sigurnosti i pouzdanosti proizvoda. Certifikacijom 4 proizvoda će se omogućiti izlazak na nova međunarodna tržišta te rast prihoda od prodaje i izvoza.

Operation_Name_English: Lemax Multi Day Tours
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Lemax Multi Day Tours
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of Lemax Multi Day Tours solution is to enable an extremely high level of integration of key business processes within the segment of multi-day tourist trips with a radical change in the concepts of creating complex business processes in the segment of multi-day tourist trips. This is planned with the use of artificial intelligence and the development of new predictive algorithms by establishing the cooperation of Lemax, the partner of the University of Applied Sciences in Virovitica and the SME partner, NOTCH SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS and KONTRA DIGITAL. The application of the solution is global and the target groups are inbound and outbound tour operators, DMC companies and domestic tour operators.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj Lemax Multi Day Tours rješenja je omogućavanje iznimno visoke razine integracije ključnih poslovnih procesa unutar segmenta višednevnih turističkih putovanja uz radikalnu izmjenu koncepata kreiranja kompleksnih poslovnih procesa u segmentu višednevnih turističkih putovanja. Navedeno se planira uz upotrebu umjetne inteligencije te razvoj novih prediktivnih algoritama uspostavom suradnje tvrtke Lemax, partnera OIŠZ Velučilišta u Virovitici te MSP-ova partnera, NOTCH SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS i KONTRA DIGITAL. primjena rješenja je globalna a ciljane skupine su inbound i outbound touroperateri, DMC tvrtke te domaći touroperateri.

Operation_Name_English: ITU-Development of the Development Strategy of the Greater Urban Area Karlovac for the period 2021-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ITU-Izrada Strategije razvoja Većeg urbanog područja Karlovac za razdoblje 2021.-2027.
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to support the Greater Urban Area of Karlovac in the development of the Development Strategy of the Greater Urban Area of Karlovac for the period 2021-2027. The beneficiary of the project is the City of Karlovac, while the target group of the project are the City of Karlovac, the City of Duga Resa, the City of Ozalj, the City of Slunj, the Municipality of Krnjak, the Municipality of Rakovica and the Municipality of Cetingrad.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je pružanje podrške Većem urbanom području Karlovac u izradi Strategije razvoja Većeg urbanog područja Karlovac za razdoblje 2021.-2027. godina. Korisnik projekta je Grad Karlovac, dok ciljanu skupinu projekta čine Grad Karlovac, Grad Duga Resa, Grad Ozalj, Grad Slunj, Općina Krnjak, Općina Rakovica i Općina Cetingrad.

Operation_Name_English: Decoration of the coastal zone Brigi - Lokvice - Usage unit 1 - promenade and bicycle path from the breakwaters of the Primorje-Gorski Kotar County to the western edge of the Pastoral Center
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uređenje obalnog pojasa Brigi - Lokvice - Uporabna cjelina 1 - šetnica i biciklistička staza od lukobrana PŠU Brigi Lokvice do zapadnog ruba Pastoralnog centra
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Development of the Brigi-Lokvice coastal zone - Utility unit 1 - promenades and bicycle paths from the breakwater of the Brigi Lokvice Forest Park to the western edge of the Pastoral Centre’ relates to the arrangement of part of the Brigi-Lokvice coastal zone in Trogir, namely Utility unit 1 with a length of 310 m. The overall objective of the project is to contribute to the investment in the development of the cycling infrastructure of the Split Urban Agglomeration in order to strengthen green, clean, smart and sustainable urban transport in order to strengthen integrated territorial development in the UAS. The specific objective of the project is to increase the number of users of cycling infrastructure and the number of users of new/modernised public transport and to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Uređenje obalnog pojasa Brigi-Lokvice - Uporabna cjelina 1 - šetnice i biciklističke staze od lukobrana PŠU Brigi Lokvice do zapadnog ruba Pastoralnog centra“ odnosi se na uređenje dijela obalnog pojasa Brigi-Lokvice u Trogiru i to uporabna cjelina 1 u duljini od 310 m. Opći cilj projekta je doprinijeti ulaganju u razvoj biciklističke infrastrukture Urbane aglomeracije Split radi jačanja zelenog, čistog, pametnog i održivog gradskog prometa u svrhu jačanja integriranog teritorijalnog razvoja u UAS. Specifični cilj projekta je povećanje broja korisnika biciklističke infrastrukture i broja korisnika novog/moderniziranog javnog prijevoza te smanjenje emisija stakleničkih plinova.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - want to stay in Vrlica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - poželi ostati u Vrlici
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: This project will provide assistance and support for 144 disadvantaged elderly people through organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and meeting other daily needs. They will participate more in the life of the community and will remain in their own home for support and help.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Kroz ovaj projekt tijekom 33 mj. pružat će se pomoć i podrška za 144 starije osobe u nepovoljnom položaju kroz organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene i zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba. Oni će više sudjelovati u životu zajednice te će zbog podrške i pomoći ostati u vlastitom domu.

Operation_Name_English: DESIRING for a dignified life in Petrinja
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI za dostojan život u Petrinji
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life to the elderly and people with disabilities in the area of the city of Petrinja, Sisak and its villages and city districts. Activity providing support and support services with procurement and distribution of packages of necessities that must include: 1. Recruitment of 15 service providers for at least 90 members of the target group 2. Monitoring and control of performed services 3. Procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies whose content is prescribed in the Instructions for Applicants 4. Communication and visibility 5. Project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom na području grada Petrinje, Siska i pripadajućih sela i gradskih četvrti. Aktivnost pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja obavezno uključuje: 1. zapošljavanje 15 pružatelja usluga za minimalno 90 pripadnika ciljane skupine 2. praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga 3. nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština čiji je sadržaj propisan u Uputama za prijavitelje 4. komunikacija i vidljivost 5. upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: I'm sure I'm working - I'm sure I'm building
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sigurno radim - sigurno gradim
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: In the construction sector, the number of injuries and deaths has been increasing in recent years, partly due to the high proportion of foreign workers who are not sufficiently familiar with occupational safety rules, as well as their labour rights in general. The project will strengthen the capacities of the SGH for social dialogue and attracting new members among all groups of workers, through training activities, networking with trade unions in the Republic of Croatia and the EU, and informing workers and increasing awareness of the importance of occupational safety and health. The project will also contribute to strengthening the ability of trade unions to monitor the payment of wages contracted by the Construction Collective Agreement, which, due to the extension of its application to all employers and workers in the sector, have the legal force of a minimum wage.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: U sektoru graditeljstva broj ozljeda i smrtnih slučajeva posljednjih godina raste, što je djelomično povezano s visokim udjelom stranih radnika koji su nedovoljno upoznati s pravilima zaštite na radu, kao i općenito sa svojim radničkim pravima. Projekt će ojačati kapacitete SGH za socijalni dijalog i privlačenje novih članova među svim skupinama radnika, kroz aktivnosti osposobljavanja, umrežavanja sa sindikatima u RH i EU, te informiranja radnika i povećanja svijesti o važnosti zaštite na radu. Projekt će pridonijeti i jačanju sposobnosti sindikata za nadzor isplate plaća ugovorenih Kolektivnim ugovorom graditeljstva, koje uslijed proširenja njegove primjene na sve poslodavce i radnike u sektoru imaju zakonsku snagu minimalne plaće.

Operation_Name_English: Let's create a better quality of life together IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kreirajmo kvalitetniji život zajedno IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care in order to address the risk of further social exclusion of older persons and persons with disabilities and provide them with daily assistance and support, and the specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life to older persons and persons with disabilities. The activity of the project is the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of a package of supplies that includes: recruitment of service providers for 180 target group members, monitoring and control of services performed, procurement and division of packages, communication and visibility, and project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi kako bi se adresirao rizik od daljnje socijalnih isključivanja starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom te im se omogućila svakodnevna pomoć i podrška, a specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnost projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje: zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za 180 pripadnika ciljane skupine, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, nabava i podjela paketa, komunikacija i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Feasibility study of revitalization and upgrade of CNC machining center with module for additive manufacturing
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada studije izvodljivosti revitalizacije i nadogradnje CNC obradnog centra modulom za aditivnu proizvodnju
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The innovation voucher for the implementation of the proposed project is based on the cooperation of the applicant Domitran Novitas d.o.o. with the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture of the University of Zagreb for the purpose of testing the possibility of integrating additive manufacturing modules and 3D printing into the CNC composite processing machine's machining system. The implementation of the proposed innovation voucher is intended for the application of technical and professional knowledge for the development of an innovative hybrid machining system that is adapted to the specifics of the production program for the processing of composites of a wider purpose.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Inovacijski vaučer za provedbu predloženog projekta temelji se na suradnji prijavitelja Domitran Novitas d.o.o. s Fakultetom strojarstva i brodogradnje Sveučilišta u Zagrebu u svrhu ispitivanja mogućnosti integracije modula za aditivnu proizvodnju i 3D ispisa u obradni sustav CNC strojeva za obradu kompozita. Realizacija predloženog inovacijskog vaučera namijenjena je primjeni tehničkih i stručnih znanja za razvoj inovativnog hibridnog obradnog sustava koji je prilagođen specifičnostima proizvodnog programa za obradu kompozita šire namjene.

Operation_Name_English: Renewal of the HŽ passenger transport fleet with new electric motor trains - Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obnova voznog parka HŽ putničkog prijevoza novim elektromotornim vlakovima - II faza
Category_Label: Clean urban transport rolling stock
NUTS3_Label: Krapinsko-zagorska županija|Brodsko-posavska županija|Koprivničko-križevačka županija|Karlovačka županija|Sisačko-moslavačka županija|Zagrebačka županija|Vukovarsko-srijemska županija|Primorsko-goranska županija|Grad Zagreb
Operation_Summary_English: With this project, HŽPP intends to modernize its electric fleet with 21 new electric motor trains. The total value of the project is estimated at EUR 171 725 103.72, of which the eligible costs are EUR 137 459 369.56 and the ineligible EUR 34 265 734.15. The project consists of the purchase of 21 EMU and is divided into two phases. The first stage consists of the delivery of 17 EMUs by the end of 2023, and the second stage of the remaining 4 EMUs, expected by 30 June 2024. Although the amended MPA approved phase I of EUR 117 568 670 and phase II of EUR 22 768 406, this phase shows the actual paid out realised costs, while the rest will be realised in phase II.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: HŽPP ovim projektom namjerava modernizirati svoj električni vozni park s 21 novim elektromotornim vlakom. Ukupna vrijednost projekta procjenjuje se na 171.725.103,72 EUR od čega prihvatljivi troškovi iznose 137.459.369,56 EUR, a neprihvatljivi 34.265.734,15 EUR. Projekt se sastoji od kupnje 21 EMU-a i podijeljen je u dvije faze. Prva faza sastoji se od isporuke 17 EMU-a do kraja 2023. godine, a druga faza preostala 4 EMU-a, koja se očekuje do 30.06.2024. Iako je izmijenjenim MPA odobreno faziranje u iznosu I. faza 117.568.670 EUR i II. faza 22.768.406 EUR, ovdje su u prvoj fazi prikazani stvarno isplaćeni realizirani troškovi dok će ostatak biti realiziran u fazi II.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of the company PADOVAN d.o.o. through product certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća PADOVAN d.o.o. kroz certifikaciju proizvoda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase the competitiveness of the company PADOVAN d.o.o. through reaching the applicable level of internationally recognized standards that ensure the quality, safety and sustainability of products. By certifying 12 models of chairs with internationally recognized standards HRN EN 1335-1, HRN EN 1335-2 and HRN EN 16139 (L1 level), the company will be facilitated access to the international market, which will result in an increase in sales and export revenues by 30%. The target group are existing employees of the company PADOVAN d.o.o. (24) who will retain jobs and all newly employed, existing and future customers and suppliers. The total value of the project is EUR 17,178.30 and will last 12 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta jest povećati konkurentnost poduzeća PADOVAN d.o.o. kroz dostizanje primjenjive razine međunarodno priznatih normi koje osiguravaju kvalitetu, sigurnost i održivost proizvoda. Certifikacijom 12 modela stolica sa međunarodno priznatim normama HRN EN 1335-1, HRN EN 1335-2 i HRN EN 16139 (L1 razina), poduzeću će biti olakšan pristup međunarodnom tržištu što će za posljedicu imati povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza za 30%. Ciljna skupina su postojeći zaposlenici/ice poduzeća PADOVAN d.o.o. (24) koji će zadržati radna mjesta te svi novozaposleni, postojeći i budući kupci te dobavljači. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 17.178,30 EUR, a trajat će 12 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Keeping up with STEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: U korak sa STEM-om
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Step up with STEM’ is submitted by the Sisak-Moslavina County Technical Culture Community with partners FER, SIMORA Development Agency, HU-IZ-VI Association, Kutina School, Sisak School, Novska School and Zorka Sever Popovača Elementary School, and the aim of the project is to strengthen the capacities of Applicants and Partners in promoting STEM among children and students, which will be achieved through training activities for the implementation of STEM programmes and attending fairs and conferences related to new methods of learning and presenting STEM areas to children and students. STEM will also be promoted through the activity of holding workshops with children and students and through the organization of fairs and competitions in the field of STEM. The project will last for 24 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „U korak sa STEM-om“ prijavljuje Zajednica tehničke kulture Sisačko-moslavačke županije s partnerima FER-om, Razvojnom agencijom SIMORA, Udrugom HU-IZ-VI, TŠ Kutina, TŠ Sisak, SŠ Novska i OŠ Zorke Sever Popovača, a cilj projekt je ojačati kapacitete Prijavitelja i Partnera u promociji STEM-a među djecom i učenicima što će se postići kroz aktivnosti pohađanja izobrazbi za provedbu programa u području STEM-a te pohađanja sajmova i konferencija vezanih uz nove metode učenja i prezentiranja STEM područja djeci i učenicima. Također, STEM će se promovirati i kroz aktivnost održavanja radionica s djecom i učenicima te kroz organizaciju sajmova i natjecanja u području STEM-a. Projekt će trajati 24 mjeseca.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing competitiveness by implementing ISO 27001 - ALIUS GRUPA d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti implementacijom sustava ISO 27001 - ALIUS GRUPA d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The ISO/IEC 27001:2022 implementation project at ALIUS GRUPA d.o.o. is focused on increasing data security, optimizing business processes and strengthening competitiveness. Certification will ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, increase customer confidence and enable access to new markets. By implementing the project, the company will standardize the information security management system, improve the protection of confidential data and improve internal processes. Expected results include increased international market recognition, increased operational efficiency and long-term sustainable growth. Sales revenues are planned to grow by 16.00% and export revenues by 20% in the year m+2.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt implementacije ISO/IEC 27001:2022 u tvrtki ALIUS GRUPA d.o.o. usmjeren je na povećanje sigurnosti podataka, optimizaciju poslovnih procesa i jačanje konkurentnosti. Certifikacija će osigurati usklađenost s regulatornim zahtjevima, povećati povjerenje klijenata i omogućiti pristup novim tržištima. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će standardizirati sustav upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću, poboljšati zaštitu povjerljivih podataka te unaprijediti interne procese. Očekivani rezultati uključuju veću prepoznatljivost na međunarodnom tržištu, povećanje operativne učinkovitosti i dugoročni održivi rast. Planiran je rast prihoda od prodaje za 16,00% i prihoda od izvoza za 20% u godini m+2.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - in the area of Kolan and Povljana
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - na području Kolana i Povljane
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Wish in the House" will ensure the provision of long-term support and support services in everyday life to people over 65 years of age and people with disabilities with the aim of increasing their social inclusion and preventing institutionalization. Six service providers will be hired to provide food organization, household chores, personal hygiene and other needs for 36 members of the target group over a period of 32 months. One package of household and basic hygiene supplies will be provided monthly for each member of the target group.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Zaželi u kući" osigurat će se pružanje dugotrajne usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu osobama starijim od 65 godina i osobama s invaliditetom s ciljem povećanja njihove socijalne uključenosti i prevenciji institucionalizacije. Zaposliti će se 6 pružatelja usluge koji će tijekom 32 mjeseca osigurati organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene i drugih potreba za 36 pripadnika ciljane skupine. Mjesečno će biti osiguran jedan paket kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština za svakog pripadnika ciljane skupine.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a management system according to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:201, which will make the company more competitive on the national and international market and thus enable its further growth in accordance with strategic goals. The implementation of the management system and the acquisition of ISO certification will result in greater customer confidence, but also a more productive, efficient and secure business, which is the interest of the company, employees, clients and suppliers who are the target group of the project. By implementing the project, the company will be able to get new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards, and in which so far it has not been able to compete.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normi ISO 9001:2015 i ISO 14001:201 koji će tvrtku učiniti konkurentnijom na nacionalnom i internacionalnom tržištu te joj time omogućiti daljnji rast u skladu sa strateškim ciljevima. Implementacija sustava upravljanja i stjecanje ISO certifikata rezultirat će većim povjerenjem kupaca, ali i produktivnijim, efikasnijim i sigurnijim poslovanjem, što je interes tvrtke, djelatnika, klijenata i dobavljača koji su ciljana skupina projekta. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama, a u kojima do sada nije mogla konkurirati.

Operation_Name_English: Small satellites and rocket modeling (Cansat rocketry)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mali sateliti i raketno modelarstvo (Cansat rocketry)
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Education and production of small satellites (cansat) and testing communication with them by launching rocket carriers. The purpose of rocket modeling is the education and production of rockets that will be applied as carriers of small satellites. With this project we will establish a model of education that will be self-sustaining and we believe soon a part of the curriculum in this area. After the training, we will establish measurable results by organising a national competition in the production of small satellites and rocket modelling – which is also one of the projects implemented by ESA and A3 as a partner to the World Organisation of the cansat rocketry competition, thus eliminating the lack of education and preparation of Croatian students in the jobs of the future. The project involves 4 primary schools and a university.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Obrazovanje i izrada malih satelita (cansat) te testiranje komunikacije s njima lansiranjem raketnim nosačima. Svrha raketnog modelarstva je obrazovanje i izrada raketa koji će se primijeniti kao nosači malih satelita. Ovim projektom uspostavit ćemo model edukacije koji će biti samoodrživ i vjerujemo uskoro i dio kurikuluma u ovom području. Nakon provedbe edukacije, uspostavit ćemo mjerljivost rezultata organizirajući nacionalno natjecanje u izradi malih satelita i raketnog modelarstva – što je i jedan od projekata kojeg provodi ESA, a i A3 kao partner Svjetskoj organizaciji natjecanja cansat rocketry i time ukloniti nedostatak školstva i pripreme hrvatskih učenika u poslovima budućnosti. U projektu sudjeluju 4 osnovne škole i sveučilište.

Operation_Name_English: In Ludbreg raSTEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: U Ludbregu raSTEM
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "U Ludbreg raSTEM" connects civil society organisation with educational institutions in the Ludbreg area and a higher education institution with the aim of strengthening capacity, acquiring new knowledge and skills through the training of activity implementers who will transfer the upgraded knowledge to children and students. The project will involve preschool, primary and secondary school children. Organising STEM workshops and promoting STEM in public spaces gives them the opportunity to develop skills and familiarise themselves with innovative learning methods in STEM. Students will be encouraged to take an interest in STEM subjects through fun and challenging activities, expand their knowledge and develop skills that will be useful in their further education and career.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „U Ludbregu raSTEM“ povezuje organizaciju civilnog društva sa odgojno-obrazovnim institucijama na području Ludbrega i visokim učilištem s ciljem jačanja kapaciteta, stjecanja novih znanja i vještina izobrazbom provoditelja aktivnosti koji će nadograđeno znanje prenijeti na djecu i učenike. U projekt će biti uključena djeca predškolske, osnovnoškolske i srednjoškolske dobi. Organizacijom STEM radionica i promocijom STEM-a na javnim mjestima pruža im se prilika za razvoj vještina i upoznavanje s inovativnim metodama učenja u STEM-u. Učenike će se potaknuti da se kroz zabavne i izazovne aktivnosti zainteresiraju za STEM predmete, proširuju svoje znanje i razvijaju vještine koje će im biti korisne u daljnjem obrazovanju i karijeri.

Operation_Name_English: Wish for Great Gorica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi za Veliku Goricu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of elderly people and people with disabilities by providing long-term care through the provision of support and support services in everyday life for 60 elderly people and people with disabilities in the area of Velika Gorica. The project will be implemented for 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 60 starijih osoba i osobama s invaliditetom na području Velike Gorice. Projekt će se provoditi 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the social plan of the Istrian County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada socijalnog plana Istarske županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of the project are: - to contribute to the availability of social services in the Istrian County by providing support in the preparation of the county social plan and strengthening the capacity of experts for social planning, implementation and monitoring of the county social plan, - to contribute to a more functional and efficient connection and cooperation of the competent social services at the local, county and national level, which will be enabled by the application of a uniform methodology for determining needs. The activities of the project are: - data collection for the development of the social plan of the Istrian County - data analysis and processing and the development of the social plan of the Istrian County - implementation of education for members of the Social Welfare Council and employees of the County
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta su: - doprinijeti dostupnosti socijalnih usluga u Istarskoj županiji kroz pružanje podrške u izradi županijskog socijalnog plana i jačanje kapaciteta stručnjaka za socijalno planiranje, provedbu i praćenje županijskog socijalnog plana, - doprinijeti funkcionalnijem i učinkovitijem povezivanju i suradnji nadležnih socijalnih službi na lokalnoj, županijskoj i nacionalnoj razini, a što će biti omogućeno primjenom jedinstvene metodologije utvrđivanja potreba. Aktivnosti projekta su: - prikupljanje podataka za izradu socijalnog plana Istarske županije - analiza i obrada podataka te izrada socijalnog plana Istarske županije - provedba edukacija za članove Savjeta za socijalnu skrb i djelatnike županije

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of Databox by introducing ISO certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti tvrtke Databox uvođenjem ISO certifikata
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of implementation of ISO 20000-1:2018 and ISO 27701:2019 in DataBox represents a strategic step towards strengthening the competitiveness, security and quality of IT services. Certification will enable standardized IT service management, process optimization and greater business efficiency. ISO 27701:2019 will ensure compliance with international privacy regulations, thus strengthening the trust of users and business partners. With existing certifications and new standards, DataBox positions itself as an industry leader, ensuring access to new markets, better internal control and long-term business sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt implementacije ISO 20000-1:2018 i ISO 27701:2019 u DataBox predstavlja strateški korak ka jačanju konkurentnosti, sigurnosti i kvalitete IT usluga. Certifikacija će omogućiti standardizirano upravljanje IT uslugama, optimizaciju procesa te veću učinkovitost poslovanja. ISO 27701:2019 osigurat će usklađenost s međunarodnim propisima zaštite privatnosti, čime se jača povjerenje korisnika i poslovnih partnera. S postojećim certifikatima i novim standardima, DataBox se pozicionira kao lider u industriji, osiguravajući pristup novim tržištima, bolju internu kontrolu i dugoročnu održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Home is the best
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Doma je najbolje
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim is to provide day-to-day support and support services to 198 people over 65 and/or with disabilities. This will contribute to their greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalisation, staying at home and active participation in community life. The provision of support and support services includes assistance in everyday life through the performance of household chores in agreement with the user, assistance in maintaining the user's personal hygiene. The monthly support and support service provided also includes the allocation of 1 package of household and basic hygiene supplies to the user. Proofs of service achievements are signed monthly summary of service provision and confirmation of receipt of monthly packages.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 198 osoba starijih od 65 i/ili osoba s invaliditetom. Time će se pridonijeti njihovoj većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu i aktivnom sudjelovanju u životu u zajednici. Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uključuje pomoć u svakodnevnom životu kroz obavljanje kućanskih poslova u dogovoru s korisnikom, pomoć u održavanju osobne higijene korisnika. Pružena mjesečna usluga potpore i podrške podrazumijeva i dodjelu 1 paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština korisniku. Dokazi postignuća usluge su potpisani mjesečni sažetak pružanja usluga te potvrde primitka mjesečnih paketa.

Operation_Name_English: CS2 - Construction Sustainable System
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: CS2 - Construction Sustainable System
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The CS2-Construction Sustainable System project was approached with the aim of elaborating 2 innovative products – software solutions – by applying the expertise and experience of consortium members in carrying out construction works, managing construction projects, cooperating with design offices and companies of various profiles and branches of activity: CS2 PORTAL and CS2 ESG PORTAL. The results of the project will represent innovation on a global level in the form of a unique solution that will mark a central place for construction and project-oriented companies, which will undetectably contribute to the digitalisation of the construction and design sectors, reducing the carbon footprint during the construction and use of buildings, and solving social and environmental challenges.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektu CS2-Construction Sustainable System primjenom stručnih znanja i iskustava članova konzorcija u izvođenju građevinskih radova, upravljanju projektima gradnje, suradnji s projektantskim uredima i tvrtkama različitih profila i grana djelatnosti pristupilo se s ciljem razrade 2 inovativna proizvoda – softverska rješenja: CS2 PORTAL i CS2 ESG PORTAL. Rezultati projekta predstavljat će inovaciju na globalnoj razini u obliku jedinstvenog rješenja koje će označavati centralno mjesto za građevinske i projektno orijentirane tvrtke a koji će nemjerljivo doprinijeti digitalizaciji građevinskog i projektantskog sektora, smanjenju ugljičnog otiska tijekom gradnje i korištenja građevina, te rješavanju društvenih i okolišnih izazova.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of H5 d.o.o. by introducing ISO system (9001 2015, 14001 2015, 27001 2022)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti tvrtke H5 d.o.o. uvođenjem ISO sustava (9001 2015, 14001 2015, 27001 2022)
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The main objective of the project is to invest in the preparation, implementation and certification of management systems through internationally recognized standards: ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management System), ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management Systems - Requirements with Instructions for Use) and ISO 27001:2022 (Information Technology - Security Techniques - Information Security Management Systems). The project addresses the key problem of recognizability of service and product quality on the market, confirmation of environmental acceptability of processes within the company and protection of confidentiality, integrity and availability of information and data. The implementation of the project will lead to increased competitiveness and business expansion.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni cilj projekta je ulaganje u pripremu, uvođenje i certificiranje sustava upravljanja putem međunarodno priznatih normi: ISO 9001:2015 (Sustav upravljanja kvalitetom), ISO 14001:2015 (Sustavi upravljanja okolišem - zahtjevi s uputama za upotrebu) i ISO 27001:2022 (Informacijska tehnologija - Sigurnosne tehnike - Sustavi upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću). Projektom se adresira ključni problem prepoznatljivosti kvalitete usluge i proizvoda na tržištu, potvrde ekološke prihvatljivosti postupaka unutar poduzeća i zaštitu povjerljivosti, cjelovitosti i raspoloživosti informacija i podataka. Provedbom projekta dovesti će se do povećanja konkurentnosti i širenja poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of the water communal infrastructure of the Kutina agglomeration – PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Poboljšanje vodno-komunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Kutina – FAZA 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes investments in the system of public water supply, public sewage and wastewater treatment primarily in the area of the agglomeration Kutina and secondary in the area of the agglomeration Popovača and Velika Ludine. The project will build 49,588 m of new and 28,814 m of reconstruction of water supply pipelines, and 38,268 m of new and 13,339 m of reconstruction of sewage collectors. The project also includes the construction of drinking water conditioning devices, 17 CS, 2 wells, 7 rain overflows as well as the reconstruction of 7 rain overflows, and the upgrade of UPOV 23.000 ES. The project is implemented in 2 phases: Phase 1 was carried out from 2018 to 2023, while the second phase refers to the period from 01.01.2024 to 31.12.2026.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća ulaganja u sustav javne vodoopskrbe, javne odvodnje i pročišćavanja otpadnih voda primarno na području aglomeracije Kutina i sekundarno na području aglomeracije Popovače i Velike Ludine. Projektom će se izgraditi 49.588 m novih i 28.814 m rekonstrukcije vodoopskrbnih cjevovoda, te 38.268 m novih i 13.339 m rekonstrukcije kanalizacijskih kolektora. Projekt obuhvaća i izgradnju uređaja za kondicioniranje pitke vode, 17 CS, 2 bunara, 7 kišnih preljeva kao i rekonstrukciju 7 kišnih preljeva, te nadogradnju UPOV-a 23.000 ES. Projekt se provodi u 2 faze: 1. faza je provođena od 2018. do 2023. godine, dok se druga faza odnosi se na period od 01.01.2024. do 31.12.2026. godine.

Operation_Name_English: They want unity
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi jedinstvo
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to employ 10 service providers from the area of the municipality of Donji Andrijevci for the care of elderly people and people with disabilities by providing them with support and support in everyday life (organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene, socializing the delivery of medicines, packages of household and hygiene supplies, etc.) which will prevent institutionalization and improve the quality of life of end users. The planned duration of the project is 36 months and during the implementation the following activities will be carried out: 1. Recruitment of 10 service providers for 32 months, 2. Monitoring and control of performed services, 3. Supply and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies, 4. Communication and visibility and 5. Project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt ima za cilj zapošljavanje 10 pružatelja usluge s područja općine Donji Andrijevci za skrb o osobama u starijoj životnoj dobi i osobama s invaliditetom pružajući im potporu i podršku u svakodnevnom životu (organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, druženje dostava lijekova, paketa kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština i sl.) čime će se spriječiti institucionalizacija i poboljšati kvaliteta života krajnjih korisnika. Planirano trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci a tijekom provedbe provoditi će se slijedeće aktivnosti: 1. Zapošljavanje 10 pružatelja usluge u trajanju od 32 mjeseca, 2. Praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, 3. Nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, 4. Komunikacija i vidljivost te 5. Upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Improving the competitiveness of Marana d.o.o. by introducing top quality certificates
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje konkurentnosti tvrtke Marana d.o.o. uvođenjem vrhunskih certifikata kvalitete
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project will increase the international competitiveness of the applicant through the assessment of the compliance of three types of concrete products with internationally recognized standards and certification of the management system. By certifying concrete curbs, concrete paving blocks and concrete wall elements, the applicant will receive an internationally recognized certificate of quality, durability, technical characteristics and compliance of the product with market requirements. The implementation of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certificates will ensure the standardisation of business processes, increase operational efficiency and confirm the commitment to sustainable development. The implementation of the project will facilitate access to international markets, increase competitiveness and contribute to the growth of sales and export revenues.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedba projekta povećat će međunarodnu konkurentnost prijavitelja kroz ocjenu sukladnosti tri vrste betonskih proizvoda s međunarodno priznatim normama te certificiranje sustava upravljanja. Certificiranjem betonskih rubnjaka, betonskih blokova za popločavanje i betonskih zidnih elemenata, prijavitelj će dobiti međunarodno priznatu potvrdu o kvaliteti, trajnosti, tehničkim svojstvima i usklađenosti proizvoda sa zahtjevima tržišta. Implementacija certifikata ISO 9001 i ISO 14001 osigurat će standardizaciju poslovnih procesa, povećati operativnu učinkovitost i potvrditi predanost održivom razvoju. Provedba projekta olakšat će pristup međunarodnim tržištima, povećati konkurentnost te pridonijeti rastu prihoda od prodaje i izvoza.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a port open to public traffic, Perna - ferry port
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja luke otvorene za javni promet, Perna - trajektno pristanište
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to build the port of Perna open to public traffic at the location of Kućište, which will serve as a ferry port, improve transport connections and accessibility of the Peljesac peninsula and the island of Korčula, increase the level of safety of the port of Orebić and reduce traffic jams, especially in the summer months. The implementation of the project will improve the quality of life of the local population. The total value of the project is EUR 19 897 823.27 and the eligible costs EUR 19 542.129.96. The ineligible costs amount to EUR 355 693.31 and relate to ineligible activities and costs (documentation, administration, building management, one-year maintenance of greenery, professional building supervision above the allowed 5% of eligible works costs).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgradnja luke Perna otvorene za javni promet na lokaciji Kućište koja će služiti kao trajektno pristanište, poboljšanje prometne povezanosti i dostupnosti poluotoka Pelješca i otoka Korčule, povećanje razine sigurnosti luke Orebić i smanjenju prometnih gužvi, posebice u ljetnim mjesecima. Provedbom projekta poboljšat će se kvaliteta života lokalnog stanovništva. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 19.897.823,27 EUR, a prihvatljivih troškova 19.542.129,96 EUR. Neprihvatljivi troškovi iznose 355.693,31 EUR i odnose se na neprihvatljive aktivnosti i troškove (dokumentacija, administracija, ug. objekt, jednogodišnje održavanje zelenila, stručni nadzor građenja iznad dopuštenih 5% prihvatljivih troškova radova).

Operation_Name_English: Improving the business of Maven Mule d.o.o. through the certification of services and management systems
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje poslovanja poduzeća Maven Mule d.o.o. kroz certifikaciju usluga i sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With the project investment "Improving the business of Maven Mule d.o.o. through the certification of services and management systems" lasting 18 months, the company Maven Mule d.o.o. will improve its business and increase its competitiveness by certification of management systems and certification of its services, all in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards. The project aims to harmonise and certify business services to adapt to the Digital Single Market and EU directives, and to harmonise and certify management systems to ensure business sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektnim ulaganjem "Unaprjeđenje poslovanja poduzeća Maven Mule d.o.o. kroz certifikaciju usluga i sustava upravljanja" u trajanju 18 mjeseci, poduzeće Maven Mule d.o.o. će unaprijediti svoje poslovanje te povećati svoju konkurentnost certifikacijom sustava upravljanja i certifikacijom svojih usluga, a sve u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi. Projektom je cilj uskladiti i certificirati poslovne usluge kako bi se prilagodili jedinstvenom digitalnom tržištu i EU direktivama te uskladiti i certificirati sustave upravljanja kako bi se osigurala održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: STEM Without Barriers
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM bez barijera
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Through the implementation of various trainings, study trips and participation in fairs, we will strengthen the capacities of civil society organizations (CSOs) to implement and expand STEM education. The aim is to empower CSOs to actively promote science, technology, engineering and mathematics among young people. Through this project, we will involve over 1000 children to bring them closer to the STEM field, encourage their curiosity and develop key skills for the future. In this way, we create the foundations for the education of future professionals in these important areas and contribute to the development of society as a whole. In particular, we will enable children with disabilities to participate in the project using assistive technology, which will enable them to engage in society and socialize with their peers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Kroz provedbu različitih izobrazbi, studijskih putovanja i sudjelovanja na sajmovima, ojačat ćemo kapacitete organizacija civilnog društva (OCD) za provedbu i širenje STEM obrazovanja. Cilj je osnažiti OCD-ove da aktivno promiču znanost, tehnologiju, inženjerstvo i matematiku među mladima. Kroz ovaj projekt, uključit ćemo preko 1000 djece kako bismo im približili STEM područje, potaknuli njihovu znatiželju i razvili ključne vještine za budućnost. Na taj način stvaramo temelje za obrazovanje budućih stručnjaka u ovim važnim područjima i doprinosimo razvoju društva u cjelini. Posebno omogući ćemo djeci s poteškoćama sudjelovanje u projektu korištenjem assistive tehnologije što će im omogućiti inkluziju u društvu i druženje sa svojim vršnjacima.

Operation_Name_English: Strategic partnership for research and development of eco products for washing and care of laundry containing mosquito repellent - NOmosqitOS
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strateško partnerstvo za istraživanje i razvoj eko proizvoda za pranje i njegu rublja koje sadrži sredstvo za odbijanje komaraca- NOmosqitOS
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in large enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Through the implementation of this project, the SPIN consortium strives to develop an innovative, environmentally friendly laundry care product with additional repellent properties. This product has the potential for significant market success thanks to its unique formulation, environmental acceptability and the use of advanced technologies. The innovation potential of this project lies in its ability to meet the growing demand for sustainable and functional products, providing consumers with added value through mosquito protection.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Kroz provedbu ovog projekta, SPIN konzorcij nastoji razviti inovativan, ekološki prihvatljiv proizvod za njegu rublja s dodatnim repelentnim svojstvima. Ovaj proizvod ima potencijal za značajan tržišni uspjeh zahvaljujući svojoj jedinstvenoj formulaciji, ekološkoj prihvatljivosti i upotrebi naprednih tehnologija. Inovacijski potencijal ovog projekta leži u njegovoj sposobnosti da zadovolji rastuću potražnju za održivim i funkcionalnim proizvodima, pružajući potrošačima dodatnu vrijednost kroz zaštitu od komaraca.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a management system according to ISO 9001:2015 standard that will make the company more competitive on the national and international market and thus enable it to further grow in accordance with strategic goals. The implementation of the management system and the acquisition of ISO certification will result in greater customer confidence, but also a more productive, efficient and secure business, which is the interest of the company, employees, clients and suppliers who are the target group of the project. By implementing the project, the company will be able to get new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards, and in which so far it has not been able to compete.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normi ISO 9001:2015 koji će tvrtku učiniti konkurentnijom na nacionalnom i internacionalnom tržištu te joj time omogućiti daljnji rast u skladu sa strateškim ciljevima. Implementacija sustava upravljanja i stjecanje ISO certifikata rezultirat će većim povjerenjem kupaca, ali i produktivnijim, efikasnijim i sigurnijim poslovanjem, što je interes tvrtke, djelatnika, klijenata i dobavljača koji su ciljana skupina projekta. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama, a u kojima do sada nije mogla konkurirati.

Operation_Name_English: Micro loan for growth and inclusion
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mikro zajam za rast i uključenost
Category_Label: Support for social economy and social enterprises
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the Programme is the creation of new enterprises, the creation of new jobs (especially for disadvantaged groups in the labour market), the encouragement of investments and the maintenance and/or expansion of business by increasing the availability of loans, more favourable financing conditions and the possibility of writing off part of the loan principal. Under this Programme, micro and small entities of a small economy are granted loans with more favourable financing conditions and the possibility of writing off part of the loan. In addition to the reduction of the interest rate and the reduction of the level of funds needed, the aim is to strengthen the sustainable growth and competitiveness of SMEs and the creation of new jobs, in particular for disadvantaged groups in the labour market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj Programa je otvaranje novih poduzeća, stvaranje novih radnih mjesta (osobito za skupine u nepovoljnijem položaju na tržištu rada), poticanje investicija i održavanje i/ili proširenje poslovanja kroz povećanje dostupnosti zajmova, povoljnije uvjete financiranja te mogućnost otpisa dijela glavnice zajma. U okviru ovog Programa kreditiraju se mikro i mali subjekti malog gospodarstva uz povoljnije uvjete financiranja i mogućnost otpisa dijela zajma. Uz smanjenje kamatne stope i smanjenje razine potrebnih sredstava osiguranja cilj je jačanje održivog rasta i konkurentnosti MSP-ova i stvaranje novih radnih mjesta, osobito za skupine u nepovoljnijem položaju na tržištu rada.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of PEJO d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija tvrtke PEJO d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: PEJO d.o.o. has identified problems that will be solved by the project of inability to prove quality due to the lack of procedures related to quality assurance during the process of managing health and safety at work, production processes by welding and the system of performance of steel and aluminum structures. Operation_Summary_English: Helicopter Emergency Medical Service (hereinafter referred to as HHMS; Eng. Helicopter emergency medical services (HEMS) is a multi-year operation conducted by the Ministry of Health (MIZ) with civil operators based on concluded Public Procurement Agreements. The aim of the project is to establish HHMS in order to ensure timely access to emergency medical care for life-threatening patients throughout the territory of the Republic of Croatia. This is achieved by procuring the HHMS service, which should be operational 24 hours a day, 7 days a week in the bases of Split and Rijeka and in the period of daily visibility 7 days a week in the bases of Zagreb and Osijek. (m+2).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka EUROART 93 d.o.o. je provela analizu vlastitog poslovanja i identificirala probleme koji će se riješiti implementacijom projekta, uključujući smanjenu konkurentnost, nemogućnost dokazivanja kvalitete, nepostojanje sljedivosti dokumentacije i neoptimizirane poslovne procese. Cilj projekta: osnažiti kapacitete tvrtke kroz uvođenje norme ISO/IEC 27001 tj. optimizaciju i unaprjeđenje 9 poslovnih procesa, a što će doprinijeti povećanju njezine međunarodne konkurentnosti, olakšavanju pristupa međunarodnom tržištu i povećanju konkurentnosti MSP-ova certifikacijom sustava upravljanja u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi = preduvjeti za rast prihoda od prodaje (30,1%) i prihoda od izvoza (30,1%), do 2028. (m+2).

Operation_Name_English: STEM Generation
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM Generacija
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "STEM Generation" aims to stimulate interest and development in STEM among children and students. Through various activities, such as workshops, lectures, competitions and mentoring programs, the target group will have the opportunity to explore, learn and develop their skills in STEM fields. The main focus of the project is empowering children and students for future careers in STEM, encouraging innovation and creativity, and promoting STEM education as a key part of the education system. Through partnership cooperation with educational institutions, academic institutions and non-governmental organizations, the project will provide a comprehensive approach to STEM education and support to children and students in their development and achievement of career goals.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "STEM Generacija" ima za cilj poticanje interesa i razvoja u području STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. Kroz različite aktivnosti, poput radionica, predavanja, natjecanja i mentorskih programa, ciljana skupina imati će priliku istraživati, učiti i razvijati svoje vještine u STEM područjima. Glavni fokus projekta je osnaživanje djece i učenika za buduće karijere u STEM-u, poticanje inovativnosti i kreativnosti te promicanje STEM obrazovanja kao ključnog dijela obrazovnog sustava. Kroz partnerske suradnje s obrazovnim ustanovama, akademskim institucijama i nevladinim organizacijama, projekt će pružiti sveobuhvatan pristup obrazovanju u STEM području i podršku djeci i učenicima u njihovom razvoju i ostvarivanju karijernih ciljeva.

Operation_Name_English: Modernization of tram infrastructure in the city of Osijek - Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Modernizacija tramvajske infrastrukture na području grada Osijeka - II faza
Category_Label: Clean urban transport infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the number of users of urban transport, which will contribute to the further development of the city and the improvement of the standard of living of the citizens of Osijek. It is planned to continue the modernization of 9.5 km of the railway line and 9.5 km of the contact line, as well as the modernization of two and the construction of one rectifier station, the construction of an underground cable network and the modernization of 23 tram stops.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje broja korisnika gradskog prijevoza što će doprinijeti daljnjem razvoju grada te poboljšanju standarda života građana Osijeka. Planira se nastavak modernizacije 9.5 km pruge i 9.5 km kontaktnog voda te modernizacija dvije i izgradnja jedne ispravljačke stanice, izgradnja podzemne kablovske mreže i modernizacija 23 tramvajska stajališta.

Operation_Name_English: Regional Center for Pre-Incubation in Smart Industry
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Regionalni centar za predinkubaciju u pametnoj industriji
Category_Label: Business infrastructure for SMEs (including industrial parks and sites)
Operation_Summary_English: Project holder University of Zagreb Faculty of Organization and Informatics with partners - City of Varaždin, City of Novi Marof, City of Ludbreg, Municipality of Sveti Ilija, Municipality of Gornji Kneginec and Municipality of Vidovec is implementing the project "Regional Center for Pre-Incubation in Smart Industry" with a total value of 6.131.000 EUR. The aim of the project is to build and equip the Regional Center for Pre-Incubation in Smart Industry in Varaždin, develop pre-incubation and incubation programs for education and mentoring and establish 5 local development points. The purpose of the project is to institutionally strengthen the activities of early recognition and development of innovative entrepreneurial ideas and raising the level of digital, entrepreneurial and technological knowledge in the field of smart industry.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Nositelj projekta Sveučilište u Zagrebu Fakultet organizacije i informatike s partnerima - Grad Varaždin, Grad Novi Marof, Grad Ludbreg, Općina Sveti Ilija, Općina Gornji Kneginec i Općina Vidovec provodi projekt „Regionalni centar za predinkubaciju u pametnoj industriji" ukupne vrijednosti 6.131.000 EUR. Cilj projekta je izgraditi i opremiti Regionalni centar za predinkubaciju u pametnoj industriji u Varaždinu, izraditi predinkubacijske i inkubacijske programe za edukaciju i mentoriranje te uspostaviti 5 lokalnih točaka razvoja. Svrha projekta je institucionalno ojačati aktivnosti ranog prepoznavanja i razvoja inovativnih poduzetničkih ideja te podizanje razine digitalnih, poduzetničkih i tehnoloških znanja u području pametne industrije.

Operation_Name_English: BIKE CONNECT - Route of mobility and community - Construction of cycling infrastructure MARIJA GORICA - PUŠĆA - ZAPREŠIĆ - BRDOVEC
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: BIKE CONNECT – ruta mobilnosti i zajedništva - izgradnja biciklističke infrastrukture MARIJA GORICA – PUŠĆA – ZAPREŠIĆ – BRDOVEC
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The BIKE CONNECT project – route of mobility and community – construction of the cycling infrastructure MARIJA GORICA – PUŠĆA – ZAPREŠIĆ – BRDOVEC will build and equip the cycling infrastructure connecting 4 four local self-government units from the Zagreb Urban Agglomeration. It is a project that integrates a network of existing bicycle-pedestrian paths with an additional 3.1 km and encourages different ways of using public transport and bicycles as a means of transport in daily migrations, in order to enable the continuity of cycling travel in the agglomeration of Zagreb.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom BIKE CONNECT – ruta mobilnosti i zajedništva - izgradnja biciklističke infrastrukture MARIJA GORICA – PUŠĆA – ZAPREŠIĆ – BRDOVEC će se izgraditi i opremiti biciklistička infrastruktura koja povezuje 4 četiri jedinice lokalne samouprave iz Urbane aglomeracije Zagreb. Riječ je o projektu koji integrira mrežu postojećih biciklističko-pješačkih staza sa dodatnih 3,1 km te potiče različite načine korištenja javnog prijevoza i bicikala kao prijevoznog sredstva u dnevnim migracijama, a kako bi se omogućio kontinuitet biciklističkog putovanja u aglomeraciji Zagreb.

Operation_Name_English: ForSTEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ForSTEM
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "ForSTEM" lasts 24 months and is implemented by the FSAA Association with the aim of strengthening its own capacities to promote STEM through an innovative approach that allows the practical application of theoretical knowledge in the field of science, technology, engineering and mathematics.
