Partnership with primary and secondary education institutions enables successful implementation of continuous STEM activities in Velika Gorica, Samobor, Varaždin and Zagreb. Partners bring their experience, expertise and cooperation with the local community, while the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture provides scientific support and mentoring. The project will significantly improve the capacities of the association for future initiatives, popularize the STEM area and develop innovative approaches in education.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "ForSTEM" traje 24 mjeseca i provodi ga Udruga FSAA s ciljem jačanja vlastitih kapaciteta za promicanje STEM-a kroz inovativni pristup koji omogućuje praktičnu primjenu teorijskog znanja u području znanosti, tehnologije, inženjerstva i matematike. Partnerstvo s osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim obrazovnim institucijama omogućava uspješnu provedbu kontinuiranih STEM aktivnosti u Velikoj Gorici, Samoboru, Varaždinu i Zagrebu. Partneri donose svoje iskustvo, stručnost i suradnju s lokalnom zajednicom, dok Fakultet strojarstva i brodogradnje pruža znanstvenu podršku i mentorstvo. Projekt će značajno unaprijediti kapacitete udruge za buduće inicijative, popularizirati STEM područje te razvijati inovativne pristupe u edukaciji.

Operation_Name_English: Hand in hand - Phase VI
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rukom pod ruku - faza VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to support the inclusion of 80 students with disabilities in primary education institutions in order to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning by employing 77 teaching assistants in 9 primary schools in the city of Sisak. The above indirectly affects the reduction of child poverty and contributes to the inclusion of students with disabilities in community life and the elimination of prejudice. All of the above helps to combat discrimination and social exclusion of children, and ensures inclusive education. The partner schools will, in cooperation with the city of Sisak, carry out the candidate selection procedure and the programme of introduction into the work of teaching assistants. The City of Sisak will carry out activities related to the management and implementation of the project and promotion and visibility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružiti potporu uključivanju 80 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje zapošljavanjem 77 pomoćnika u nastavi u 9 osnovnih škola na području grada Siska. Gore navedeno posredno utječe na smanjenje dječjeg siromaštva i doprinosi uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u život u zajednici i eliminiranju predrasuda. Sve spomenuto pomaže u suzbijanju diskriminacije i socijalne isključenosti djece, te osigurava inkluzivan odgoj i obrazovanje. Škole partneri će u suradnji s gradom Siskom provesti postupak selekcije kandidata i program uvođenja u rad pomoćnika u nastavi. Grad Sisak će provesti aktivnosti povezane s upravljanjem i provedbom projekta te promidžbom i vidljivošću.

Operation_Name_English: Home Help - Phase IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoć u kući - IV. faza
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups; elderly people and people with disabilities, by providing them with long-term care through the service of providing assistance and support in everyday life. The main activities of the project are: 1. Recruitment of service providers, who will perform household chores for at least 6 members of the target group, will help organize nutrition and maintain personal hygiene and other daily needs. 2. Monitoring and control of performed services 3. Acquisition and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies to target group members 4. Communication and visibility 5. Project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećati socijalnu uključenost i prevenciju institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina; osoba starije životne dobi i osoba s invaliditetom, na način da im se osigura dugotrajna skrb kroz uslugu pružanja pomoći i podrške u svakodnevnom životu. Glavne aktivnosti projekta su: 1. Zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga, koji će za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine obavljati kućanske poslove, pomoći u organizaciji prehrane i održavanju osobne higijene i drugih svakodnevnih potreba. 2. Praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga 3. Nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština pripadnicima ciljane skupine 4. Komunikacija i vidljivost 5. Upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Want help for a more equal and better quality of life
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi pomoć za ravnopravniji i kvalitetniji život
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to the prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups in the City of Zagreb through the improvement of their quality of life. The specific objective is to empower, strengthen social contacts and support and support in everyday activities for the elderly and people with disabilities in the city of Zagreb. The mandatory activity of providing support and support services in addition to the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies includes: a) employment of 6 service providers, b) regular controls of service provision, c) procurement and parcel distribution, d) communication and visibility, e) project management and administration - project manager and coordinator.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je doprinos prevenciji institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina na području grada Zagreba kroz unapređenje kvalitete njihovog života. Specifični cilj je osnaživanje, jačanje socijalnih kontakata te potpora i podrška u svakodnevnim aktivnostima starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom na području grada Zagreba. Obavezna aktivnost pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština uključuje: a) zapošljavanje 6 pružatelja usluge, b) redovite kontrole pružanja usluge, c) nabavu i podjelu paketa, d) komunikacija i vidljivost, e) upravljanje projektom i administracija - voditelj projekta i koordinator.

Operation_Name_English: E-ticketing PHASE II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: E-ticketing FAZA II
Category_Label: Digitalisation of transport when dedicated in part to greenhouse gas emissions reduction: urban transport
Operation_Summary_English: The project applicant is Promet d.o.o. Split, and the area to which it relates is an investment in improving the public transport service, i.e. increasing the quality of service and improving the public transport experience for residents of the city of Split and UAS, through the integration of new elements and functionalities into the already existing e-ticketing system. The project will be implemented in 2024, 2025, 2026 and 2027, and the total value of the project is EUR 2,306,250,00 (eligible and ineligible costs). The target group of the project are users of public transport from the area of the Urban agglomeration of Split, as well as employees of the company, making them key stakeholders of the realization of this project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavitelj projekta je Promet d.o.o. Split, a područje na koje se odnosi je ulaganje u poboljšanje usluge javnog prijevoza, odnosno povećanje kvalitete usluge i unaprjeđenje iskustva javnog prijevoza za stanovnike grada Splita i UAS i to kroz integraciju novih elemenata i funkcionalnosti u već postojeći e-ticketing sustav. Projekt će se provesti tijekom 2024., 2025., 2026. i 2027. godine, a ukupna vrijednost projekta je 2.306.250,00 EUR (prihvatljivi i neprihvatljivi troškovi). Ciljna skupina projekta su korisnici javnog prijevoza s područja Urbane aglomeracije Split, kao i zaposlenici tvrtke, čineći ih ključnim dionicima realizacije ovog projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Kutina - city of inclusive education III.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kutina - grad inkluzivnog obrazovanja III.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide inclusive education and support to 34 students with disabilities in 5 primary education institutions of the city of Kutina in order to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. Activity: 1. Providing support to the education of students with disabilities through the work of teaching assistants Description of the activities: The activity covers the implementation of the selection procedure for candidates for teaching assistants to pupils with disabilities; implementing the programme by introducing teaching assistants; the work of teaching assistants; communication and visibility; project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguranje inkluzivnog obrazovanja i pružanje potpore za 34 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u 5 osnovnoškolskih odgojno-obrazovnih ustanova grada Kutine kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Aktivnost: 1. Pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi Opis aktivnosti: Aktivnost obuhvaća provedbu postupka selekcije kandidata za pomoćnike u nastavi učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju; provedbu programa uvođenjem u rad pomoćnika u nastavi; rad pomoćnika u nastavi; komunikacija i vidljivost; upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Convergent IT-OT energy management system (EMS) for the transition of port communities to smart low-carbon energy hubs
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Konvergentni IT-OT sustav upravljanja energijom (EMS) za tranziciju lučkih zajednica u pametna niskougljična energetska čvorišta
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: PortEMS is a multidisciplinary project that combines excellence in energy system management and information technologies to achieve optimal operation of multiple correlated energy systems of port communities in order to transition to low-carbon energy hubs, through key objectives: - Development of smart centralised optimal management of multiple horizontally connected energy systems - EMS.Integrator - Integration of advanced information functionalities into traditional control platforms - Observability and manoeuvrability of multiple energy systems based on advanced methods, data collection and processing with secure infrastructure of their sharing - Development of strategies for optimal management of multiple energy systems
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: PortEMS je multidisciplinarni projekt koji kombinira izvrsnost u upravljanju energetskih sustava i informacijskim tehnologijama kako bi se ostvario optimalan pogon više korelirajućih energetskih sustava lučkih zajednica u cilju tranzicije prema niskougljičnim energetskim čvorištima, kroz ključne ciljeve: - Razvoj pametnog centraliziranog optimalnog upravljanja više horizontalno povezanih energetskih sustava - EMS.Integrator - Integracija naprednih informacijskih funkcionalnosti u tradicionalne upravljačke platforme - Osmotrivost i upravljivost više energetskih sustava na osnovi naprednih metoda, prikupljanja i obrade podataka uz sigurnu infrastrukturu njihovog dijeljenja - Razvoj strategija za optimalno upravljanje više energetskih sustava

Operation_Name_English: "Together for a better tomorrow III"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: „Zajedno u bolje sutra III“
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Together in a Better Tomorrow III" will encourage social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups of the Šibenik area by providing assistance in the home and during everyday activities to the elderly and people with disabilities. The project will employ a total of 20 service providers, and services will be provided to a total of 120 users. The service includes performing small household chores (cleaning, preparing simple meals), buying groceries and medicines, paying bills, helping to maintain users' personal hygiene, and socializing and talking with users. The project team will coordinate the management and administration of the project. The public and the target group will be informed about the project through the website, social networks of applicants, media, posters, leaflets and conferences.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Zajedno u bolje sutra III" potaknut će se socijalna uključenost te prevenirati institucionalizacija ranjivih skupina područja grada Šibenika pružanjem pomoći u kući i prilikom obavljanja svakodnevnih aktivnosti osobama starije životne dobi i osobama s invaliditetom. Na projektu će biti zaposleno ukupno 20 pružatelja/ca usluga, a usluge će biti pružene ukupno 120 korisnika. Usluga obuhvaća obavljanje sitnih kućanskih poslova (čišćenje, priprema jednostavnih obroka), kupnja namirnica i lijekova, plaćanje računa, pomoć pri održavanju osobne higijene korisnika te druženje i razgovor s korisnicima. Projektni tim će koordinirati upravljanje i administraciju projekta. Javnost i ciljana skupina o projektu će biti informirana putem web stranice, društvenih mreža prijavitelja, medija, plakata, letaka i konferencija.

Operation_Name_English: Let's include them in the community.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uključimo ih u zajednicu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The realization of the project "Let's include them in the community", will influence the increase of social inclusion and the prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups through the provision of long-term care in their local community. The project will employ a total of 6 service providers who will take care of 36 users. The service will be provided in the area of Šibenik-Knin County (municipality of Rogoznica), while the public and the target group will be informed about the project through promotional tools (websites, media, posters, leaflets and conferences).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Realizacijom projekta "Uključimo ih u zajednicu", utjecat će se na povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevenciju institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina kroz osiguranje dugotrajne skrbi u njihovoj lokalnoj zajednici. Na projektu će biti zaposleno ukupno 6 pružatelja usluge koji će brinuti o 36 korisnika. Usluga će biti pružena na području Šibensko-kninske županije (općina Rogoznica) dok će javnost i ciljana skupina o projektu biti informirana putem promotivnih alata (web stranice, medija, plakata, letaka i konferencija).

Operation_Name_English: DESIRING AND STAYING ON YOUR OWN
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI I OSTANI NA SVOM
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of the project are to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups in the municipality of Tompojevci. The realisation of the objectives will be made possible by the provision of support and support services in everyday life as well as by the provision of long-term care. Activities of the project proposal relate to the provision of support and support services to persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities, related to the organization of food, the performance of household chores, the maintenance of personal hygiene and the satisfaction of other daily needs with the distribution of packages of necessities on a monthly basis.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta su povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina na području općine Tompojevci. Realizacija ciljeva omogućit će se pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu kao i osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi. Aktivnosti projektnog prijedloga se odnose na pružanje usluge potpore i podrške osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom, a koje se odnose na organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene te zadovoljenje drugih svakodnevnih potreba uz podjelu paketa potrepština na mjesečnoj razini.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the international competitiveness of MARIN EXPERT d.o.o. through product certification and the introduction of a business process and quality management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke MARIN EXPERT d.o.o. certifikacijom proizvoda i uvođenjem sustava upravljanja poslovnim procesima i kvalitetom
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of Marin Expert through product certification in accordance with internationally recognized standards and the introduction of a business process and quality management system to create the prerequisites for further growth and business development. Project activities will enable the elimination of the central problem of the company - the risk of a decline in the competitiveness of the company on the market, and due to the inability to meet the continuous increase in the requirements of quality, safety and reliability of the product. The certification of 5 products and the introduction of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 will enable you to enter the international market, thus achieving a 100% export growth and a 5% increase in sales revenue in the m+2 period.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta jest povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost tvrtke Marin Expert kroz certifikaciju proizvoda u skladu s međunarodno priznatim normama te uvođenjem sustava upravljanja poslovnim procesima i kvalitetom stvoriti pretpostavke za daljnji rast i razvoj poslovanja. Projektne aktivnosti omogućit će otklanjanje središnjeg problema tvrtke - opasnost od pada konkurentnosti tvrtke na tržištu, a uslijed nemogućnosti zadovoljavanja kontinuiranog povećanja zahtjeva kvalitete, sigurnosti i pouzdanosti proizvoda. Certifikacijom 5 proizvoda i uvođenjem ISO 9001 I ISO 14001 će se omogućiti izlazak na međunarodno tržište čime će se ostvariti rast izvoza za 100% i povećanje prihoda od prodaje za 5% u razdoblju m+2.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the social plan of the Osijek-Baranja County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada socijalnog plana Osječko-baranjske županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the development of a social plan of the county as a carrier of social policy development at the regional level and the empowerment of members of the Social Welfare Council of OBŽ and employees of OBŽ for the planning and development of a network of social services in order to reduce inequalities in the provision of services, meet the needs of socially vulnerable groups and prevent social exclusion.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izrada socijalnog plana županije kao nositelja razvoja socijalne politike na regionalnoj razini te osnaživanje članova Savjeta za socijalnu skrb OBŽ i službenika OBŽ za planiranje i razvoj mreže socijalnih usluga radi smanjenja nejednakosti u pružanju usluga, ispunjenja potreba socijalno osjetljivih skupina i prevencije socijalne isključenosti.

Operation_Name_English: 1s Charger Device Development Tests
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvojna ispitivanja uređaja 1s Charger-a
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The applicant is engaged in the development of a very complex technology of a wide range of applications (industry, public safety, unmanned systems), and is based on low latency video signal transmission. Such systems consist of a large number of components that are subject to different regulatory rules, which vary from one country to another. The aim of this project is to carry out tests and measurements for the purpose of obtaining the necessary certificates as one of the prerequisites for the placing on the market of a new product - 1s Charger, i.e. chargers for lithium-polymer batteries, which are used for the flight of unmanned aircraft.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavitelj se bavi razvojem vrlo kompleksne tehnologije širokog spektra primjene (industrija, javna sigurnost, bespilotni sustavi), a bazirana je na prijenosu video signala niske latencije. Takvi sustavi se sastoje od velikog broja komponenata koje podliježu različitim regulatornim pravilima koja se razlikuju ovisno o državi. Cilj ovog projekta je provesti ispitivanja i mjerenja za potrebe ishodovanja potrebnih certifikata kao jedan od preduvjeta za plasiranje na tržište novog proizvoda - 1s Charger-a, odnosno punjača za litij-polimer baterije, a koje se koriste za let besposadnih letjelica.

Operation_Name_English: WANT TO SPEED 4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI PROVEDI 4
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups in the territory of the Municipality of Virje. Mandatory activity on the project is the provision of support and support services in everyday life with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina na području općine Virje. Obvezna aktivnost na projektu je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština.

Operation_Name_English: MUSEUM STEM Academies - STEMA
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: MUZZA STEM akademija - STEMA
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project MUZZA STEM academies - STEMA is intended to strengthen the capacities of civil society organizations in promoting STEM among children and young people. The organisation of workshops in schools and kindergartens, science events and festivals, various events and the creation of podcasts will increase the number of activities aimed at popularising STEM. Cooperation between the education sector, science and civil society will be enhanced. The project will serve as a complementary supplement to the education of children at all educational levels. All of the above will popularize STEM in kindergartens and schools and will realize the transfer of knowledge between experts, members of civil society organizations, teachers and educators with the aim of encouraging the interest of children and young people in STEM fields and careers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt MUZZA STEM akademija - STEMA namijenjen je jačanju kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva u promociji STEM-a među djecom i mladima. Organizacijom radionica u školama i vrtićima, manifestacija i festivala znanosti, različitih događanja i stvaranjem podcasta, povećati će se broj aktivnosti s ciljem popularizacije STEM-a. Unaprijediti će se suradnja između obrazovnog sektora, znanosti i civilnog društva. Projekt će poslužiti kao komplementarni dodatak edukaciji djece na svim obrazovnim razinama. Sve navedeno popularizirat će STEM u vrtićima i školama te će ostvariti prijenos znanja između stručnjaka, članova organizacije civilnog društva, nastavnika i edukatora s ciljem poticanja interesa djece i mladih za STEM područja i karijere.

Operation_Name_English: 3P - Accompanying women, Assistants, Friends III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: 3P – Pratiteljice, Pomoćnice, Prijateljice III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project contributes to increasing social inclusion and preventing institutionalization of older people and people with disabilities by providing long-term care. Providing support and support services in everyday life with monthly delivery of packages and supplies to 90 elderly and/or disabled people from the areas of Split, Kaštela, Solin, Omiš and the island of Vis allows them to stay in their own home and ensures the right to live in the community and relieves family members who care for them and allows them time for personal growth and development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se doprinosi povećanju socijalne uključenosti i prevenciji institucionalizacije stariji osoba i osoba s invaliditetom osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu uz mjesečnu dostavu paketa i potrepština 90 starijih i/ili osoba s invaliditetom s područja Splita, Kaštela, Solina, Omiša i otoka Visa omogućuje im se ostanak u vlastitom domu i osigurava pravo na život u zajednici te rasterećuje članove obitelji koji o njima skrbe i omogućuje im se vrijeme za osobni rast i razvoj.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Urban Development Strategy of Šibenik
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada Strategije razvoja urbanog područja Šibenik
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: In 2019, the City of Šibenik received a Decision identifying the City of Šibenik with the surrounding area as an area for a possible extension of the implementation of the integrated territorial investment mechanism in the financial period 2021-2027. In accordance with the Guidelines for drawing up the strategy for the development of urban areas, monitoring their implementation and evaluation, the City of Šibenik proposed the coverage of the urban area of Šibenik, which includes the city of Šibenik, the city of Skradin and the municipality of Bilice. They concluded a Cooperation Agreement, and the City Council of the City of Šibenik adopted a Decision on initiating the process of drafting the Strategy. In addition to the Strategy, a strategic environmental assessment document and an ex-ante evaluation of the strategy have been prepared.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Grad Šibenik je 2019. godine primio Odluku kojom se Grad Šibenik s okolnim područjem utvrđuje područjem za moguće proširenje provedbe mehanizma integriranih teritorijalnih ulaganja u financijskom razdoblju 2021-2027. godina. Sukladno Smjernicama za izradu strategije razvoja urbanih područja, praćenja njihove provedbe i vrednovanja, Grad Šibenik je predložio obuhvat urbanog područja Šibenik koje obuhvaća – grad Šibenik, grad Skradin te općinu Bilice. Navedeni su sklopili Sporazum o suradnji, a Gradsko vijeće Grada Šibenika donijelo je Odluku o pokretanju postupka izrade Strategije. Osim Strategije, izrađen je i dokument strateške procjene utjecaja na okoliš te ex-ante vrednovanje strategije.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - For the third age
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi- ZA treću dob
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care, which enables beneficiaries to receive support and support services and stay longer in their homes.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći je cilj projekta povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencije institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi čime korisnici dobivaju uslugu potpore i podrške te duže ostaju u svojim domovima.

Operation_Name_English: BCS implements a business continuity management system in accordance with ISO 22301:2019
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: BCS implementira sustav upravljanja kontinuitetom poslovanja u skladu s normom ISO 22301:2019
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Business Computer Systems d.o.o. introduces ISO 22301:2019 certificate for business continuity management system to ensure greater resilience to crisis situations and service interruptions. This certificate represents an upgrade of the existing ISO certificates 9001, 14001 and 27001, which further improves the company's security and business excellence. By aligning with international standards, BCS strengthens its position in the global market. Expected results include expanding business opportunities, increasing customer confidence and increasing sales and export revenues by more than 30%.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Business Computer Systems d.o.o. uvodi ISO 22301:2019 certifikat za sustav upravljanja kontinuitetom poslovanja kako bi osigurao veću otpornost na krizne situacije i prekide u uslugama. Ovaj certifikat predstavlja nadogradnju postojećih ISO certifikata 9001, 14001 i 27001, čime poduzeće dodatno unapređuje sigurnost i poslovnu izvrsnost. Usklađivanjem s međunarodnim standardima, BCS jača svoju poziciju na globalnom tržištu. Očekivani rezultati uključuju širenje poslovnih prilika, povećanje povjerenja klijenata te rast prihoda od prodaje i izvoza za više od 30%.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the capacity of the social partners affiliated to the URSH – Phase I
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje kapaciteta socijalnih partnera udruženih u URSH – faza I
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: As part of the project activities, the trade union headquarters of the URSH, with the support of the partner organization, carries out capacity building activities for social dialogue through trainings, networking activities and the development of new services and improvement of existing ones for the members of the social partners. By focusing on this type of activity, the URSH aims to contribute to increasing trade union density and strengthen workers' trust in trade union organizations as key actors in the protection of their rights and interests. Strengthening the capacities of trade union organizations directly contributes to the quality and stability of social dialogue and social partnership at bipartite and tripartite level in the Republic of Croatia.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: U sklopu projektnih aktivnosti sindikalna središnjica URSH uz podršku organizacije partnera provodi aktivnosti jačanja kapaciteta za socijalni dijalog kroz osposobljavanja, aktivnosti umrežavanja te razvoj novih usluga i unaprjeđenje postojećih za članove socijalnih partnera. Stavljanjem fokusa na ovaj tip aktivnosti, URSH cilja doprinijeti povećanju sindikalne gustoće i osnažiti povjerenje radnika u sindikalne organizacije kao ključne aktere u zaštiti njihovih prava i interesa. Jačanjem kapaciteta sindikalnih organizacija doprinosi se izravno kvaliteti i stabilnosti socijalnog dijaloga i socijalnog partnerstva na bipartitnoj i tripartitnoj razini u Republici Hrvatskoj.

Operation_Name_English: InnoAktiv
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: InnoAktiv
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: As part of the InnoAktiv project, an innovative social rest service from care will be provided for 25 users, while persons with developmental disabilities or disabilities they care for will be allowed to participate in various implementation workshops for a minimum of 311 days. Through group and individual work and experiential learning, people with developmental disabilities or disabilities will be enabled to develop and strengthen cognitive, social and physical skills and thus help them prevent institutionalization and enable greater inclusion in the community. At the same time, parents will be able to relax and rest from care.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: U sklopu projekta InnoAktiv pružit će se inovativna socijalna usluga odmora od skrbi za 25 korisnika, dok će se osobama s teškoćama u razvoju ili invaliditetom o kojima oni skrbe biti omogućeno uključivanje u razne provedbene radionice u trajanju od minimalno 311 dana. Kroz grupni i individualni rad te iskustveno učenje, osobama s teškoćama u razvoju ili invaliditetom omogućit će se razvoj i jačanje kognitivnih, socijalnih i fizičkih vještina i na taj način im se pomoći u prevenciji institucionalizacije i omogućavanju veće uključenosti u zajednicu. Istovremeno će se roditeljima njegovateljima omogućiti relaksacija i odmor od skrbi.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of the company TERRAWATT d.o.o. by introducing certificates
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća TERRAWATT d.o.o. uvođenjem certifikata
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective of the project is the implementation and certification of the management system according to international standards ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 27001 and ISO 45001 in order to increase the competitiveness of TerraWatt d.o.o. on the domestic and international market. The target group is TerraWatt d.o.o., which will increase competitiveness through the implementation of the project, which will result in an increase in export revenues, an increase in sales revenues, the implementation of four business process management systems introduced into the business (certified).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je implementacija i certificiranje sustava upravljanja prema međunarodnim normama ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 27001 i ISO 45001 kako bi se povećala konkurentnost poduzeća TerraWatt d.o.o. na domaćem i međunarodnom tržištu. Ciljana skupina je poduzeće TerraWatt d.o.o. koji će provedbom projekta povećati konkurentnost što će rezultirati povećanjem prihoda od izvoza, povećanjem prihoda od prodaje, implementacijom četiri sustava upravljanja poslovnim procesima uveden u poslovanje (certificirana).

Operation_Name_English: Short break - big difference!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kratki predah - velika razlika!
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The ‘Short break - Big difference!’ project develops innovative social services that will support caregiver parents through the night, half-day and living room, reducing their pressure and exhaustion. It will provide children and persons with disabilities with a safe and supportive environment in which they can develop and adapt socially. The aim of the project is to improve the quality of life of beneficiaries and their families through the provision of customized services, creative workshops and physical activities, with long-term social inclusion and support.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Kratki predah - velika razlika!“ razvija inovativne socijalne usluge koje će kroz noćni, poludnevni i dnevni boravak pružiti podršku roditeljima njegovateljima, smanjujući njihov pritisak i iscrpljenost. Djeci i osobama s invaliditetom omogućit će sigurno i podržavajuće okruženje u kojem se mogu socijalno razvijati i prilagoditi. Cilj projekta je poboljšanje kvalitete života korisnika i njihovih obitelji kroz pružanje prilagođenih usluga, kreativnih radionica i fizičkih aktivnosti, uz dugoročnu socijalnu inkluziju i podršku.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing competitiveness through certification of aggregate production according to HRN EN 13242:2013- DINOCOP d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti kroz certifikaciju proizvodnje agregata prema HRN EN 13242:2013- DINOCOP d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Increasing competitiveness through the certification of aggregate production according to HRN EN 13242:2013- DINOCOP d.o.o." is aimed at the certification of aggregates in order to ensure compliance with European standards, increase the competitiveness of the company and enable the exit to new markets, especially in Slovenia. The implementation of HRN EN 13242:2013 will ensure the standardisation of production processes, the improvement of quality control and the strengthening of the trust of customers and business partners. Certification enables greater competitiveness, access to infrastructure projects financed from EU funds, increased revenues and long-term business stability. By doing so, DINOCOP d.o.o. will achieve sustainable growth and strengthen its market position in the construction industry.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Povećanje konkurentnosti kroz certifikaciju proizvodnje agregata prema HRN EN 13242:2013- DINOCOP d.o.o." usmjeren je na certificiranje agregata kako bi se osigurala usklađenost s europskim standardima, povećala konkurentnost tvrtke i omogućio izlazak na nova tržišta, posebice u Sloveniju. Implementacija HRN EN 13242:2013 osigurat će standardizaciju proizvodnih postupaka, poboljšanje kontrole kvalitete te jačanje povjerenja kupaca i poslovnih partnera. Certifikacija omogućuje veću konkurentnost, pristup infrastrukturnim projektima financiranim iz EU fondova, povećanje prihoda i dugoročnu stabilnost poslovanja. Time će tvrtka DINOCOP d.o.o. ostvariti održiv rast i osnažiti svoju tržišnu poziciju u građevinskoj industriji.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - Achieve II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - ostvari II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is to provide support and support services in everyday life to older people and people with disabilities with the purpose of increasing their social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization by providing long-term care. The objectives of the project will be achieved by implementing the following project activities: 1. Recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group for household chores, assistance in organizing food and maintaining personal hygiene, meeting other daily needs 2. Monitoring and control of performed services 3. Supply and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies 4. Communication and visibility 5. Project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom sa svrhom povećanja njihove socijalnu uključenost i prevencije institucionalizacije osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Ciljevi projekta ostvarit će se provedbom slijedećih projektnih aktivnosti: 1. Zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine za obavljanje kućanskih poslova, pomoći u organizaciji prehrane i održavanju osobne higijene, zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba 2. Praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga 3. Nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština 4. Komunikacija i vidljivost 5. Upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Baranja for seniors
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Baranja za seniore
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives are to increase the social inclusion of third-aged people and adults with disabilities and to prevent institutionalisation by providing social services. The goal of the project will be achieved by employing 30 women who will care for at least 180 members of the target group by providing them with services: organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and meeting other daily needs with a monthly distribution of household and basic hygienic necessities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi su povećanje socijalne uključenosti osoba treće životne dobi i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom i prevencija institucionalizacije osiguravanjem socijalnih usluga. Cilj projekta postići će se provedbom zapošljavanja 30 žena koje će skrbiti za minimalno 180 pripadnika ciljane skupine pružajući im usluge: organiziranja prehrane, obavljanja kućanskih poslova, održavanja osobne higijene i zadovoljavanja drugih svakodnevnih potreba uz mjesečnu podjelu kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština.

Operation_Name_English: Purchase of additional low-floor trams for the purpose of modernization of the tram fleet in Osijek
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nabava dodatnih niskopodnih tramvaja za potrebe modernizacije tramvajskog voznog parka u Osijeku
Category_Label: Clean urban transport rolling stock
Operation_Summary_English: The project applicant is Gradski prijevoz passenger d.o.o. The aim of the project is to modernize and improve the quality of public transport of citizens in the administrative area of the City of Osijek, which means to ensure a sustainable and quality public transport service to citizens by procuring 10 new trams that will allow to increase the capacity, speed and quality of the service provided and reduce the negative impact on the environment. The target group is the general population. The total value of the project is 25.212.545,50 €, ineligible costs relate to VAT in the amount of 5.042.509,10 €.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavitelj projekta je Gradski prijevoz putnika d.o.o.. Cilj projekta je modernizirati i unaprijediti kvalitetu javnog prijevoza građana na administrativnom području Grada Osijeka, što znači osigurati održivu i kvalitetnu uslugu javnog prijevoza građanima nabavom 10 novih tramvaja koji će omogućiti povećanje kapaciteta, brzine i kvalitete pružene usluge te smanjenje negativnog utjecaja na okoliš. Ciljana skupina je opća populacija. Ukupna vrijednost projekta je 25.212.545,50 €, neprihvatljivi troškovi se odnose na PDV u iznosu od 5.042.509,10 €.

Operation_Name_English: AI STEM EDUCators
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: AI STEM EDUKATORI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "AI STEM Educators" aims to improve the capacities of the IPZ association for the promotion of STEM among children and students through the organization of 40 promotions per year throughout Croatia. IPZ educators will undergo 10 one-day trainings organized by Algebra University, focused on artificial intelligence and advanced technologies. The project involves cooperation with primary schools and scientific institutes such as the RBI, which will provide additional support and participate in the organisation of public events. Krapina-Zagorje County will provide infrastructure support and assistance in the organization of the Scientific Picnic. The aim of the project is to increase children's and young people's interest in STEM fields and create a sustainable network of science educators and popularizers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "AI STEM Edukatori" ima za cilj unaprijediti kapacitete udruge IPZ za promociju STEM-a među djecom i učenicima kroz organizaciju 40 promocija godišnje diljem Hrvatske. Edukatori iz IPZ-a proći će 10 jednodnevnih edukacija organiziranih od strane Sveučilišta Algebra, usmjerenih na umjetnu inteligenciju i napredne tehnologije. Projekt uključuje suradnju s osnovnim školama i znanstvenim institutima poput IRB-a, koji će pružiti dodatnu podršku i sudjelovati u organizaciji javnih događanja. Krapinsko-zagorska županija će osigurati infrastrukturnu podršku i pomoći u organizaciji Znanstvenog piknika. Cilj projekta je povećati zainteresiranost djece i mladih za STEM područja te stvoriti održivu mrežu edukatora i popularizatora znanosti.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of a public building for the purposes of the Interpretation Centre for Mining Energy Heritage (IC REB)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija zgrade javne namjene za potrebe interpretacijskog centra rudarsko energetske baštine (IC REB)
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The Municipality of Konjščina as the Applicant for the project "Reconstruction of a public building for the purposes of the Interpretation Centre for Mining Energy Heritage (IC REB)" ensures an increase in accessibility and participation in the cultural life of all citizens, especially members of vulnerable groups and the creation of preconditions for the development of innovative services in culture. The project will renovate and equip the public building for the purpose of organizing new and improving existing services in culture, and the implementation of technological innovations, educational activities and new services and programs will enable greater involvement of all visitors to the Municipality. The target group is the Municipality of Konjščina, while the end users are persons belonging to vulnerable groups and all visitors and the wider community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Općina Konjščina kao Prijavitelj na projektu "Rekonstrukcija zgrade javne namjene za potrebe interpretacijskog centra rudarsko energetske baštine (IC REB)" osigurava povećanje pristupačnosti i sudjelovanja u kulturnom životu svih građana, osobito pripadnika ranjivih skupina i stvaranje preduvjeta za razvoj inovativnih usluga u kulturi. Projektom će se obnoviti i opremiti zgrada javne namjene u svrhu organizacije novih i poboljšanja postojećih usluga u kulturi, a implementacijom tehnoloških inovacija, edukativnih aktivnosti te novih usluga i programa, omogućit će se veća uključenost svim posjetiteljima Općine. Ciljna skupina je Općina Konjščina, dok su krajnji korisnici osobe pripadnici ranjivih skupina te svi posjetitelji i šira zajednica.

Operation_Name_English: SystE-mobility: Encouraging smart industrial development by innovating advanced training systems for electric vehicles
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SystE-mobility: Poticanje pametnog industrijskog razvoja kroz inoviranje naprednih sustava obuke za električna vozila
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The PURPOSE of the project is the development of two innovative devices used for training personnel in the automotive industry with an emphasis on electric vehicles, where through real cooperation with partners, the capacities of consortia to commercialize the results of R&D&I activities will be strengthened, while contributing to solving social problems related to the lack of personnel for the jobs of the future. RESULTS: Validated technological concept for two devices in a laboratory environment, prototyped devices that are ready for commercial exemplary, research results presented and tested in public through collaboration with local associates.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SVRHA projekta je razvoj dva inovativna uređaja koji se koriste za obuku kadrova u automobilskoj industriji s naglaskom na električna vozila, gdje će se kroz stvarnu suradnju s partnerima ojačati kapaciteti konzorcija za komercijalizaciju rezultata IRI aktivnosti uz doprinos rješavanju društvenih problema povezanih s nedostatkom kadrova za poslove budućnosti. REZULTATI: Validiran tehnološki koncept za dva uređaja u laboratorijskom okruženju, prototipizirani uređaji koji su spremni za komercijalnu primjernu, rezultati istraživanja predstavljeni i testirani u javnosti kroz suradnju s lokalnim suradnicima.

Operation_Name_English: The Gate of the Island
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Vrata otoka
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The integrated project includes sectoral, content-related and thematically related investments that will contribute to the preservation and use of island space for the purpose of regenerating previously neglected areas on the islands into places of new programs and content. The project will valorize cultural heritage and will contribute to the development of new cultural tourism services on the island and sustainable management in order to revive these areas. The project will reconstruct the former ‘Magazina Ilić’ building, better known as the ‘Brač plastic’ building, equip the ‘Kuća Hrapoćuše’ Interpretation Centre and introduce a public bicycle system.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Integrirani projekt obuhvaća sektorski, sadržajno i tematski povezana ulaganja koja će doprinijeti očuvanju i korištenju otočnog prostora u svrhu regeneriranja dosada zapuštenih prostori na otocima u mjesta novih programa i sadržaja. Projektom će se valorizirati kulturna baštine te će doprinijeti razvoju novih kulturno turističkih usluga na otoku te održivom upravljanju kako bi ovi prostori ponovo oživjeli. Projektom će se izvršiti rekonstrukcija nekadašnje zgrade „Magazina Ilić“, poznatije kao zgrada „Brač plastika“ opremiti Interpretacijski centar „Kuća Hrapoćuše“, te uvesti sustav javnih bicikala.

Operation_Name_English: Step towards equality 4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Korak prema jednakosti 4
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure inclusive education, strengthen social inclusion and integration into educational processes for 22 students with disabilities from the city of Gospić. The main activities of the project are to support the education of students with disabilities through the work of PUN.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja, jačanje socijalne uključenosti i integracije u odgojno-obrazovne procese za 22 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju s područja grada Gospića. Glavna aktivnosti projekta je pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad PUN.

Operation_Name_English: Inclusion one step closer to a barrier-free society for the school year 2023/2024
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inkluzija korak bliže društvu bez prepreka za školsku godinu 2023./2024.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will provide 10-month PUN/CPC for 93 students with disabilities during the 12 months of implementation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se tijekom 12 mjeseci provedbe za 93 učenika s teškoćama osigurati PUN/SKP u trajanju od 10 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: "Wish - prevention of institutionalization in the area of the City of Vinkovci"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Zaželi - prevencija institucionalizacije na području Grada Vinkovci"
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective of the project: is an increase in social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization for 198 members of the target group by providing support and support services in everyday life for 30 months in the area of the city of Vinkovci. Mandatory project activity: A1. Providing support and support services in addition to the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies that include elements of: A1.1 Recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of target group A1.2. Monitoring and control of performed services A1.3. Supply and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies A1.4. Communication and visibility A1.5. Project management and administration
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta: je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije za 198 pripadnika ciljane skupine pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu kroz 30 mjeseci na području grada Vinkovci. Obavezna aktivnost projekta: A1. pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje elemente: A1.1. Zapošljavanje pružatelja usluge za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine A1.2. Praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga A1.3. Nabava i podjela kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština A1.4. Komunikacija i vidljivost A1.5. Upravljanje projektom i administracija

Operation_Name_English: Helping hands through support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ruke pomoći kroz usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support services in everyday life to older people over 65 and adults with disabilities, thus contributing to their greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in their own home and ensuring the right to live in the community. During the project, 30 employees will provide support and services to 180 users, selected on a public call, for 30 months (organization of food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene, meeting other daily needs) with the allocation of household and hygiene supplies. Service control will be performed. Promotion of the project: banner, posters (30), leaflets (300), conferences (6). The project team manages the project and manages the administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom čime se doprinosi njihovoj većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguravanju prava na život u zajednici. Tijekom projekta 30 zaposlenika pružat će potporu i usluge za 180 korisnika, izabranih na javnom pozivu, 30 mjeseci (organizacija prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba) uz dodjelu kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština. Vršit će se kontrola usluga. Promocija projekta: baner, plakati (30), letci (300), konferencije (6). Projektni tim upravlja projektom i vodi administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Capacity building and equipping of the Croatian Earthquake Engineering Centre – Intervention services
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Osnaživanje kapaciteta i opremanje Hrvatskog centra za potresno inženjerstvo – Interventne službe
Category_Label: Risk prevention and management of non-climate related natural risks (for example earthquakes) and risks linked to human activities (for example technological accidents), including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches
NUTS3_Label: Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija|Sisačko-moslavačka županija|Osječko-baranjska županija|Primorsko-goranska županija|Grad Zagreb|Split-Dalmatia County
Operation_Summary_English: The project addresses the problem of lack of capacity and coordination for intervention engineering actions in the event of earthquakes and other crisis situations in Croatia. The purpose is to contribute to disaster risk reduction and strengthen the civil protection system of the Republic of Croatia. Activities include establishing and equipping HCPI-IS headquarters and regional bodies for performing engineering activities, and training all project participants for emergency response. In addition, training of internal resources and other civil protection stakeholders will be carried out, as well as informing citizens about the engineering activities of the HCPI-IS. The target groups are engineers, emergency services and citizens.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt adresira problem nedostatka kapaciteta i koordinacije za interventna inženjerska djelovanja u slučaju potresa i drugih kriznih situacija u Hrvatskoj. Svrha je doprinos smanjenju rizika od katastrofa i osnaživanje sustava civilne zaštite Republike Hrvatske. Aktivnosti uključuju uspostavljanje i opremanje središnjice i područnih tijela HCPI-IS za obavljanje inženjerskih aktivnosti, te osposobljavanje svih sudionika projekta za reagiranje u izvanrednim situacijama. Uz to, provodit će se edukacije internih resursa i ostalih dionika civilne zaštite, kao i informiranje građana o inženjerskim aktivnostima HCPI-IS. Ciljne skupine su inženjeri, hitne službe i građani.

Operation_Name_English: Social, cultural and tourist information centre "Vitezićev dom"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Društveno-kulturni i turističko-informativni centar „Vitezićev dom“
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project Socio-cultural and tourist information centre ‘Vitezićev dom’ is implemented mainly in the Municipality of Vrbnik on the island of Krk and, to a lesser extent, in the municipalities of Dobrinj and Lopar (island of Rab). The project contributes to the social and economic development of the local community through the sustainable management of cultural heritage in island areas. The opening of the Glagolitic socio-cultural and tourist-information centre in the Municipality of Vrbnik contributes to the wider socio-economic environment, improves the quality of life, has a positive impact on the expansion of cultural and other services for tourists and the local community, and directly and indirectly improves the economic activity of the area.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Društveno-kulturni i turističko-informativni centar „Vitezićev dom“ većinskim dijelom se provodi u Općini Vrbnik na otoku Krku te manjim dijelom u Općinama Dobrinj i Lopar (otok Rab). Projekt doprinosi društvenom i gospodarskom razvoju lokalne zajednice kroz održivo upravljanje kulturnom baštinom na otočnim područjima. Otvaranjem društveno-kulturnog i turističko-informativnog centra glagoljice u Općini Vrbnik, doprinosi se širem socioekonomskom okruženju, poboljšanju kvalitete života, pozitivnim utjecajem na širenje kulturnih i ostalih usluga za turiste i lokalnu zajednicu te se izravnim i neizravnim putem unaprjeđuje ekonomska aktivnost područja.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of business continuity management system and IT service management system - ISO 22301 and ISO 20000-1
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja kontinuitetom poslovanja i sustava upravljanja IT uslugama - ISO 22301 i ISO 20000-1
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of implementation and certification of management systems according to ISO 22301:2019 and ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 standards aims to increase the operational resilience and quality of IT services of the company GOinfoZG d.o.o. and ensure international competitiveness. The purpose of the project is to align business processes with the highest standards of business continuity management and IT services, which will increase the security and reliability of solutions for manufacturing companies, the company's main clients. Expected results include reducing operational risks, optimising IT services and strengthening customer confidence, which will give GOinfoZG an advantage in international markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt implementacije i certifikacije sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO 22301:2019 i ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018 ima za cilj povećati operativnu otpornost i kvalitetu IT usluga poduzeća GOinfoZG d.o.o. te osigurati međunarodnu konkurentnost. Svrha projekta je usklađivanje poslovnih procesa s najvišim standardima upravljanja kontinuitetom poslovanja i IT uslugama, čime će se povećati sigurnost i pouzdanost rješenja za proizvodna poduzeća, glavne klijente poduzeća. Očekivani rezultati uključuju smanjenje operativnih rizika, optimizaciju IT usluga i jačanje povjerenja klijenata, čime će GOinfoZG steći prednost na međunarodnim tržištima.

Operation_Name_English: Always together
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvijek zajedno
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The main objectives of the project are the prevention of institutionalization and the reduction of the risk of social exclusion of people over 65 and adults with disabilities by providing them with support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages and supplies necessary in everyday life, which would enable these vulnerable groups to participate fully and effectively in society on an equal basis with others. As the right to life is one of the fundamental human rights, the activities to be carried out by the service providers will improve the quality of life of persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities and will keep the target group living in their homes and contribute to the deinstitutionalisation of the target group.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni ciljevi projekta su prevencija institucionalizacije te smanjenje rizika od socijalne isključenosti osoba starijih od 65 g. i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom pružajući im usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavku i podjelu paketa i potrepština potrebnih u svakodnevnom životu čime bismo spomenutim osjetljivim skupinama omogućili puno i učinkovito sudjelovanje u društvu na ravnopravnoj osnovi s drugima. Budući da pravo na život predstavlja jedno od temeljnih ljudskih prava, aktivnostima koje će pružatelji usluge obavljati unaprijedit će kvalitetu života osoba starijih od 65 g. i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom te će osobe iz ciljne skupine ostati živjeti u svojim domovima te pridonijeti deinstitucionalizaciji ciljne skupine.

Operation_Name_English: Expanding the network of veteran centers
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Širenje mreže veteranskih centara
Category_Label: Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community
NUTS3_Label: Krapinsko-zagorska županija|Virovitičko-podravska županija|Osječko-baranjska županija|Zadarska županija|Ličko-senjska županija
Operation_Summary_English: The Veterans Center is a public institution for providing support and services to the veterans-stradally population. The founder of veteran centers is the Republic of Croatia, and on behalf of the founder, the founding rights are performed by the Ministry of Croatian Veterans' Affairs. The implementation of the project activities will affect the equitable availability of social services to the population through integrated actions for the socio-economic inclusion of marginalised communities, low-income households and disadvantaged groups through the establishment of five veteran centres. The results of the project will be ensured in cooperation with the LGUs and in synergy with the project under the ‘Efficient Human Resources 2021’ programme. "2027" relating to the implementation of programmes in veteran centres.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Veteranski centar je javna ustanova za pružanje podrške i usluga braniteljsko-stradalničkoj populaciji. Osnivač veteranskih centara je RH, a u ime osnivača, osnivačka prava obavlja Ministarstvo hrvatskih branitelja. Provedbom projektnih aktivnosti utjecat će se na ravnomjernu dostupnost socijalnih usluga stanovništvu u okviru integriranih djelovanja za socioekonomsku uključenost marginaliziranih zajednica, kućanstava s niskim dohotkom i skupina u nepovoljnom položaju kroz uspostavu pet veteranskih centara. Rezultati projekta osigurat će se u suradnji s JLS-ima i u sinergiji s projektom iz Programa „Učinkoviti ljudski potencijali 2021. - 2027.“ koji se odnose na provedbu programa u veteranskim centrima.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of Information Security Management System (ISMS) according to ISO/IEC 27001
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću (ISMS) prema normi ISO/IEC 27001
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the competitiveness of Genesis block in the international market by introducing an information security management system according to ISO/IEC 27001 standard. The purpose of the project is to ensure business compliance with international standards and legal regulations, which will increase the trust of clients, improve the quality and safety of their services and enable business expansion to new markets. Certification will enable better placement of services on the international market and increase revenues, which will result in greater competitiveness and a stronger market position in the long term. By implementing the standard, the company will differentiate itself from competition, attract new customers and ensure long-term growth and business stability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje konkurentnosti tvrtke Genesis block na međunarodnom tržištu uvođenjem sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema normi ISO/IEC 27001. Svrha projekta je osigurati usklađenost poslovanja s međunarodnim standardima i zakonskim regulativama, čime će tvrtka povećati povjerenje klijenata, unaprijediti kvalitetu i sigurnost svojih usluga te omogućiti širenje poslovanja na nova tržišta. Certifikacija će omogućiti bolji plasman usluga na međunarodnom tržištu i povećanje prihoda, što će rezultirati većom konkurentnošću i dugoročno jačim tržišnim položajem. Implementacijom norme, poduzeće će se diferencirati od konkurencije, privući nove kupce te osigurati dugoročni rast i stabilnost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Adaptation and equipping of the preschool education building
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Adaptacija i opremanje zgrade predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project of renovation of the building for the maintenance of preschool activities will provide infrastructure capacities to increase the availability of early childhood education and care in the area of the Municipality of Rešetari. The project will enable the availability of quality preschool education to all children from the area of the Municipality of Rešetari regardless of socioeconomic status since the accommodation capacities do not meet the needs in the area of the Municipality of Rešetari. The realization of the project will adapt the old building, which will increase the number of seats compared to the existing ones. The target groups of the project are children from the area of Adžamovci and the entire Municipality of Rešetari.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom adaptacije zgrade za održavanje predškolske djelatnosti osigurati će se infrastrukturni kapaciteti za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja na području Općine Rešetari. Projektom će se omogućiti dostupnost kvalitetnog predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja svoj djeci s područja Općine Rešetari bez obzira na socioekonomski status budući da smještajni kapaciteti ne udovoljavaju potrebama na području Općine Rešetari. Realizacijom projekta adaptirati će se stara zgrada čime će se povećati broj mjesta u odnosu na postojeće. Ciljane skupine projekta su djeca s područja naselja Adžamovci i cijele Općine Rešetari.

Operation_Name_English: Kutina - city of inclusive education IV.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kutina - grad inkluzivnog obrazovanja IV.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure inclusive education and provide support to 36 students with disabilities in 5 primary-educational institutions of the City of Kutina in order to provide the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The project is implemented in the area of the City of Kutina, and includes the implementation of the process of selection of candidates for teaching assistants to students with disabilities, implementation of the program of introduction into the work of teaching assistants, providing support to education to students with disabilities through the work of teaching assistants, communication and visibility, project management and administration. The project leader is the City of Kutina, and the partners are 5 primary schools, whose City is the founder.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja i pružanje potpore za 36 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u 5 osnovnoškolskih odgojno – obrazovnih ustanova Grada Kutine kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Projekt se provodi na području Grada Kutine, a uključuje provedbu postupka selekcije kandidata za pomoćnike u nastavi učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju, provedbu programa uvođenja u rad pomoćnika u nastavi, pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenicima s teškoćama kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju. Nositelj projekta je Grad Kutina, a partneri 5 osnovnih škola, čiji je Grad osnivač.

Operation_Name_English: Teaching assistants 5
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoćnici u nastavi 5
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Objectives of the project: Specific objective 1. - Provide support for the inclusion of 53 pupils with disabilities in primary education institutions in order to ensure the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialisation and emotional functioning. Specific objective 2 - Provide support for 40 pupils with disabilities with targeted professional support, teaching assistants for at least one school year. Main activity of the project: Providing support to the education of students with disabilities through the work of teaching assistants.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta: Specifični cilj 1. - Pružiti potporu uključivanju 53 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Specifični cilj 2. - Pružiti potporu za 40 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju s osiguranom ciljanom stručnom podrškom, pomoćnika u nastavi u trajanju minimalno jedne školske godine. Glavna aktivnost projekta: Pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi.

Operation_Name_English: SOS holiday
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SOS odmor
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "SOS holiday" provides much-needed support to parents and caregivers of children with developmental disabilities and people with disabilities. Through an innovative social service of rest from care, they are able to take a break from everyday physical and emotional demands, and actively participate in the life of the community. The aim of the project is to reduce the risk of institutionalization of the people they care for, providing them with the opportunity for short-term independence. The project also encourages social inclusion and strengthening the network of non-institutional services, thus contributing to the quality of life of all involved.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "SOS odmor" pruža prijeko potrebnu podršku roditeljima i njegovateljima djece s teškoćama u razvoju i osoba s invaliditetom. Kroz inovativnu socijalnu uslugu odmora od skrbi, omogućuje im se predah od svakodnevnih fizičkih i emocionalnih zahtjeva, te aktivno sudjelovanje u životu zajednice. Cilj projekta je smanjiti rizik od institucionalizacije osoba o kojima skrbe, pružajući im priliku za kratkotrajno osamostaljenje. Projekt također potiče socijalnu inkluziju i jačanje mreže izvaninstitucionalnih usluga, čime doprinosi kvaliteti života svih uključenih.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction and certification of an integrated management system in accordance with international standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje i certificiranje integriranog sustava upravljanja sukladno međunarodnim normama
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation and certification project ISO 22301:2019, ISO 20000-1:2018 and ISO 14001:2015 aims to strengthen the international competitiveness of enterprises through the implementation of standards that ensure business continuity, quality of IT services and environmental sustainability. The purpose of the project is to optimize business processes, increase risk resilience and improve compliance with global standards. Expected results include increased customer confidence, easier access to international markets and the long-term strengthening of the company's market position. By implementing the certificate, the company will standardize key processes, reduce operating costs and increase sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt implementacije i certifikacije ISO 22301:2019, ISO 20000-1:2018 i ISO 14001:2015 ima za cilj jačanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poduzeća kroz implementaciju standarda koji osiguravaju kontinuitet poslovanja, kvalitetu IT usluga i ekološku održivost. Svrha projekta je optimizacija poslovnih procesa, povećanje otpornosti na rizike te unaprjeđenje usklađenosti s globalnim standardima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje povjerenja klijenata, olakšan pristup međunarodnim tržištima i dugoročno jačanje tržišne pozicije poduzeća. Implementacijom certifikata poduzeće će standardizirati ključne procese, smanjiti operativne troškove i povećati održivost.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of the international standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje međunarodne norme ISO/IEC 27001:2022
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: By certification according to the internationally recognized standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Promet i prostor d.o.o. will ensure compliance with global safety standards, increase customer confidence and facilitate and increase access to international markets. The implementation of the project will have an impact on strengthening the security of information systems, protecting confidential data and reducing the risk of cyber threats. Expected results include reducing security risks, increasing sales and export revenues, and strengthening competitiveness through improved internal processes and digital security.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Certifikacijom prema međunarodno priznatom standardu ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Promet i prostor d.o.o. osigurat će usklađenost s globalnim sigurnosnim normama, povećati povjerenje klijenata i olakšati i povećati pristup međunarodnim tržištima. Provedba projekta utjecati će na jačanja sigurnosti informacijskih sustava, zaštite povjerljivih podataka i smanjenja rizika od kibernetičkih prijetnji. Očekivani rezultati uključuju smanjenje sigurnosnih rizika, povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza te jačanje konkurentnosti kroz poboljšane interne procese i digitalnu sigurnost.

Operation_Name_English: Tehnet Smart Control - development of an intelligent mobile system for infrastructure management and monitoring
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Tehnet Smart Control - razvoj inteligentnog mobilnog sustava za upravljanje i nadzor infrastrukturama
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The holder of the SPIN consortium Tehnet, in cooperation with Statim, Codeasy (Loop), Trina and Prnjak Engineering and Split FESB, is developing an intelligent system for monitoring large ports, marinas and anchorages, based on computer vision (CV), machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies. SPIN consortium will contribute to strengthening regional competitiveness in Regional value chains primarily Blue Growth and smart industries.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Nositelj SPIN konzorcija Tehnet u suradnji s tvrtkama Statim, Codeasy (Loop), Trinom i Prnjak Inženjering te splitskim FESB-om razvija inteligentni sustav za nadzor velikih luka, marina i sidrišta, temeljen na tehnologijama računalnog vida (CV), strojnog učenja (ML) i umjetne inteligencije (AI). SPIN konzorcij doprinijet će jačanju regionalne konurentnosti u Regionalnim lancima vrijednosti primarno Plavi Rast i pametne industrije.

Operation_Name_English: NanoSTEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: nanoSTEM
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The nanoSTEM project strengthens the capacities of civil society in the field of nanoscience and its application in nanotechnology with the aim of raising awareness of the importance of this area in everyday life.
