By integrating reconnaissance and extracurricular activities with the field of nanoscience and technology, we encourage interdisciplinary education and natural science development of children and youth in Croatia. The project not only emphasizes the acquisition of knowledge and skills in the STEM field, but also the development of critical thinking, innovation and teamwork among participants, creating the foundations for their personal and professional development in the 21st century.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt nanoSTEM ojačava kapacitete civilnog društva u području nano znanosti i njezine primjene u nano tehnologiji s ciljem osvještavanja važnosti navedenog područja u svakodnevnom životu. Integriranjem izviđačkih i izvanškolskih aktivnosti s područjem nano znanosti i tehnologije potičemo interdisciplinarno obrazovanje i prirodoznanstveni razvoj djece i mladih u Hrvatskoj. Projektom ne stavljamo naglasak samo na stjecanje znanja i vještina iz STEM područja već i na razvoj kritičkog mišljenja, inovativnosti i timskog rada među sudionicima, stvarajući temelje za njihov osobni i profesionalni razvoj u 21. stoljeću.

Operation_Name_English: We help in your home
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomažemo u vašem domu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective: the provision of support and support services in the daily life of the elderly and persons with disabilities. Once eligible persons have responded to the selection criteria laid down in the PDP in question, they will start recruiting service providers for at least 6 members of the target group. Employees on the project will help members of the target group to organize food, perform household chores, maintain personal hygiene, packages with household and hygiene supplies will be purchased and distributed, and the applicant together with the partner will maintain project visibility and project management and administration. 60 members of the target group are planned to be included, with a total of 10 home helpers employed.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj: pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Nakon što se po kriteriju odabira propisanim predmetnim PDP-om odazovu osobe koje zadovoljavaju uvjete krenut će se sa zapošljavanjem pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine. Zaposlene osobe na projektu pripadnicima ciljane skupine pomoći će u organizaciji prehrane, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, održavanju osobne higijene, nabavit će se i podijeliti paketi s kućanskim i higijenskim potrepštinama te će prijavitelj zajedno s partnerom održavati vidljivost projekta te upravljanje projektom i administracijom. Planira se uključiti 60 pripadnika ciljane skupine što ukupno broji 10 zaposlenih pružatelja usluge pomoći u kući.

Operation_Name_English: DIGITAL COMMUNITY OF THE UNION - DIGITAS
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: DIGITalna trAnzicija Sindikata - DIGITAS
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project is aimed at achieving digital maturity. Given the current low level of digitalisation of the applicant, the project proposal includes an analysis of the situation and the development of a digital transition strategy, along with the development of new innovative services that will ensure greater and better digital accessibility for 4,600 trade union members. Education will strengthen digital capacities, which will affect digitalisation and increase the quality of services, and through networking at national and EU level, through the exchange of experiences and good practices on digital social dialogue, this project proposal will successfully ensure the transition to a new business model, ensure digital trade unionism and new services for membership.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je usmjeren ka postizanju digitalne zrelosti. S obzirom na trenutnu nisku razinu digitalizacije prijavitelja projektni prijedlog uključuje analizu stanja i izradu strategije digitalne tranzicije, uz razvoj novih inovativnih usluga kojima će prijavitelj osigurati veću i bolju digitalnu pristupačnost za 4.600 članova sindikata. Edukacijama će postići jačanje digitalnih kapaciteta, što će utjecati na digitalizaciju i povećati kvalitetu usluga, a umrežavanjima na nacionalnoj i EU razini, kroz razmjenu iskustava i dobre prakse o digitalnom socijalnom dijalogu, ovaj projektni prijedlog uspješno će osigurati prelazak na novi poslovni model, osigurati digitalni sindikalizam i nove usluge za članstvo.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of TEP Ex d.o.o. through product certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti poduzeća TEP Ex d.o.o. kroz certifikaciju proizvoda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Strengthening the competitiveness of the company TEP Ex d.o.o. through product certification" is implemented with the aim of ensuring a more stable competitive position of the applicant company on the international and domestic market through the certification of key products with explosion protection according to ATEX and IECEx standards. The project will have a number of positive effects on the applicant’s business, including access to new markets in industries with high security requirements, and the optimisation of the applicant’s key business processes . As a result, sales and export revenues are expected to grow by 5.5% and the distribution network is expected to expand to strategic markets two years after the completion of the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Jačanje konkurentnosti poduzeća TEP Ex d.o.o. kroz certifikaciju proizvoda" provodi se s ciljem osiguranja stabilnije konkurentske pozicije poduzeća Prijavitelja na međunarodnom i domaćem tržištu i to kroz certifikaciju ključnih proizvoda s protueksplozijskom zaštitom prema ATEX i IECEx standardima. Projekt će polučiti niz pozitivnih efekata na poslovanje Prijavitelja, uključujući i pristup novim tržištima u industrijama s visokim sigurnosnim zahtjevima, te optimizaciju ključnih poslovnih procesa Prijavitelja . Posljedično, očekuje se rast prihoda od prodaje i izvoza za 5,5% te širenje distribucijske mreže na strateška tržišta dvije godine po završetku provedbe projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Bridges of solidarity
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mostovi solidarnosti
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. Providing support and support services for the elderly and persons with disabilities in their daily lives.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom.

Operation_Name_English: Step towards equality 5
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Korak prema jednakosti 5
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure inclusive education for 22 students with disabilities from the Gospić area, by providing the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning, through the engagement of teaching assistants. The target group is 22 students with disabilities who are included in primary school programs in educational institutions in the Gospić area. The main activity of the project is to support the education of students with disabilities through the work of teaching assistants, which contributes to the achievement of the goal, and thus the integration of the target group into society as functional members of the community. Communication and visibility activities are aimed at disseminating information about the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja za 22 učenika s teškoćama s područja Gospića, osiguravanjem uvjeta za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje, kroz angažiranje pomoćnika u nastavi. Ciljna skupina je 22 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju koji su uključeni u osnovnoškolske programe u odgojno obrazovnim ustanovama s područja Gospića. Glavna aktivnost projekta je pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi, koja doprinosi ostvarenju cilja, a time i integraciji ciljne skupine u društvo kao funkcionalnih članova zajednice. Aktivnosti komunikacije i vidljivosti su usmjerene na diseminaciju informacija o projektu.

Operation_Name_English: Punat Cultural Centre
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kulturni centar Punat
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria|Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the reconstruction (upgrade and upgrade) of a social building in the Punat Cultural Centre, which will provide Punat with a representative library space, exhibition space and space for the Cultural and Artistic Society and numerous other associations from the Municipality area, as well as a place for meetings, smaller conferences and events. The existing one-storey house will be reconstructed into a modern building for social purposes of ground floor and first floor height. Reconstruction is planned to increase energy efficiency in accordance with the project of rational use of energy and thermal protection of the building. The project will green and horticulturally landscape 335 m2 of environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je rekonstrukcija (dogradnja i nadogradnja) zgrade društvene namjene u Kulturni centar Punat kojom će naselje Punat dobiti reprezentativni prostor knjižnice, izložbeni prostor te prostor za Kulturo-umjetničko društvo te brojne druge udruge s područja Općine kao i mjesto za održavanje sastanaka, manjih konferencija i događanja. Postojeća prizemnica rekonstruirat će se u modernu zgradu društvene namjene visine prizemlje i kata. Rekonstrukcijom se planira povećanje energetske učinkovitosti sukladno projektu racionalne uporabe energije i toplinske zaštite zgrade. Projektom će biti zazelenjeno i hortikulturno uređeno 335 m2 okoliša.

Operation_Name_English: Infobip Global Communication Platform
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Infobip globalna komunikacijska platforma
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the investment is a development and research project with the aim of developing the Infobip Global Communication Platform - a state-of-the-art, human-centric, open, secure and data-oriented communication platform that stands out in terms of efficiency, adaptability and customer satisfaction and will contribute to economic growth and competitiveness of Europe by opening new opportunities for companies and users on a global level. The availability and easy use of digital tools in the cloud directly supports the democratisation of services, the expansion of existing businesses and the stimulation of the growth of new tools by making their development phase much faster, paving the way for more unicorns in the EU.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet investicije je razvojno-istraživački projekt s ciljem razvoja Infobip Globalne Komunikacijske Platforme - najsuvremenije, antropocentrične, otvorene, sigurne i podatkovno usmjerene komunikacijske platforme koja se ističe u učinkovitosti, prilagodljivosti i zadovoljstvu korisnika te će pridonijeti gospodarskom rastu i konkurentnosti Europe otvaranjem novih mogućnosti za poduzeća i korisnike na globalnoj razini. Dostupnošću i jednostavnom uporabom digitalnih alata u oblaku izravno se podupire demokratizacija usluga, širenje postojećih poduzeća i poticanje rasta novih alata tako što će njihova faza razvoja biti mnogo brža, čime se stvara put za više jednoroga u EU-u.

Operation_Name_English: The Power of Women 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Snaga žene 2
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of visually impaired people and the elderly through the provision of long-term support and support services in everyday life. The specific objectives of the project are: 1. employment of persons for the provision of support and support services in the area of 5 targeted counties 2. provision of support and support services in everyday life to persons with visual impairments. Activities: 1. Recruitment of service providers in the area of 5 targeted counties 2.Selection of users who will use the service 3.Procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies to users of the service 4.Project management and administration (monitoring and control of services performed, communication and visibility).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije osoba s oštećenjem vida i starijih osoba kroz osiguravanje dugotrajne usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu. Specifični ciljevi projekta su: 1. zapošljavanje osoba za pružanje usluge potpore i podrške na području 5 ciljanih županija 2. pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu osobama s oštećenjem vida. Aktivnosti: 1. zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga na području 5 ciljanih županija 2.odabir korisnika koji će koristiti uslugu 3. nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština korisnicima usluge 4. upravljanje projektom i administraciju (praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, komunikacija i vidljivost).

Operation_Name_English: 1st PHASE OF THE TRADE INFRASTRUKTURE MODERNISATION IN ZAGREB CITY - Phase II of the project
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: 1.FAZA MODERNIZACIJE TRAMVAJSKE INFRASTRUKTURE U GRADU ZAGREBU – II. faza projekta
Category_Label: Clean urban transport infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the number of passengers in public transport, which contributes to the development of the city and the improvement of living standards, and this is planned to be achieved by modernizing 11 sections of the tram line with a total length of 8,1935 km (16,387 km of track) and 3 rectifying stations. The target group is the general population.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje broja putnika u javnom prijevozu što pridonosi razvoju grada i poboljšanju životnog standarda, a to se planira postići modernizacijom 11 dionica tramvajske pruge ukupne dužine 8,1935 km (16,387 km kolosijeka) i 3 ispravljačke stanice. Ciljna skupina je opća populacija.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of management system according to international ISO standards for BARREK d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Implementacija sustava upravljanja prema međunarodnim ISO standardima za BARREK d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Barrek d.o.o. introduces ISO 27001:2022, ISO 22301:2019, ISO 37001:2016 and ISO 50001:2018 certificates in order to improve information security, business continuity, anti-corruption management and energy efficiency. The new certificates are naturally complemented with the existing ISO certificates 9001, 14001 and 45001, which further improves the company's safety, energy efficiency and business excellence. By aligning with international standards, Barrek d.o.o. strengthens its position in the international market. Expected results include expanding business opportunities, increasing customer confidence and increasing sales and export revenues by more than 30%.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Barrek d.o.o. uvodi ISO 27001:2022, ISO 22301:2019, ISO 37001:2016 i ISO 50001:2018 certifikate kako bi unaprijedio sigurnost informacija, kontinuitet poslovanja, upravljanje anti-korupcijom i energetsku učinkovitost. Novi certifikati prirodno se nadopunjuju s postojećim ISO certifikatima 9001, 14001 i 45001, čime poduzeće dodatno unapređuje sigurnost, energetsku učinkovitost i poslovnu izvrsnost. Usklađivanjem s međunarodnim standardima, Barrek d.o.o. jača svoju poziciju na međunarodnom tržištu. Očekivani rezultati uključuju širenje poslovnih prilika, povećanje povjerenja klijenata te rast prihoda od prodaje i izvoza za više od 30%.

Operation_Name_English: Development of an intelligent system to support the production and sale of olive oil – Smart Olive Oil System (SOOSy)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inteligentnog sustava za podršku proizvodnji i prodaji maslinovog ulja – Smart Olive Oil System (SOOSy)

Operation_Summary_English: CONSORTION: TRI M d.o.o., AGROLAGUNA d.d., LASER LINE d.o.o., IPŠA d.o.o., PZ CRES; FACILITY: Faculty of Informatics and Digital Technologies, University of Rijeka and Associate-Center for Agriculture and Rural Development of Primorje-Gorski Kotar County NAME OF THE PROJECT: Development of an intelligent system to support the production and sale of olive oil – Smart Olive Oil System (SOOSy) PROJECT OBJECTIVE: development of a system to support the production and sale of olive oil aimed at improving the process of growing and processing olives and the sale of olives and olive oil, which will contribute to the Adriatic Croatia niche "IT solutions and production technologies and models for Industry 4.0 and smart agriculture" under the S3 thematic area "Digital products and platforms"
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: KONZORCIJ: Poduzeća TRI M d.o.o., AGROLAGUNA d.d. , LASER LINE d.o.o., IPŠA d.o.o., PZ CRES; OIŠZ: Fakultet informatike i digitalnih tehnologija, Sveučilište u Rijeci i suradnik-Centar za poljoprivredu i ruralni razvoj Primorsko-goranske županije NAZIV PROJEKTA: Razvoj inteligentnog sustava za podršku proizvodnji i prodaji maslinovog ulja – Smart Olive Oil System (SOOSy) CILJ PROJEKTA: razvoj sustava za podršku proizvodnji i prodaji maslinovog ulja kojim se želi unaprijediti proces uzgoja i prerade maslina te prodaje maslina i maslinovog ulja koji će doprinijeti niši Jadranske Hrvatske „IT rješenja i proizvodne tehnologije i modeli za Industriju 4.0 i pametnu poljoprivredu“ u okviru S3 tematskog područja „Digitalni proizvodi i platforme“

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading of the kindergarten in Koprivnica Ivanec
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja dječjeg vrtića u Koprivničkom Ivancu
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of the project Upgrading the kindergarten in Koprivnica Ivanec is to provide infrastructural and material capacities to increase the availability of early childhood education and care in the municipality of Koprivnica Ivanec. The project plans to invest in the upgrade of the existing facility of the preschool institution Kindergarten "Ivančica" Koprivnički Ivanec, which operates as a branch of the kindergarten "Vrapčić" at Vinogradska 28a. The project is planned to upgrade one additional living room, which aims to solve the problem of the lack of infrastructure capacity for the implementation of educational activities for children in the early childhood education and care system in the municipality.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta Dogradnja dječjeg vrtića u Koprivničkom Ivancu je osigurati infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja na području općine Koprivnički Ivanec. Projektom je planirano ulaganje u dogradnju postojećeg objekta predškolske ustanove Dječji vrtić „Ivančica“ Koprivnički Ivanec koja djeluje kao podružnica Dječjeg vrtića „Vrapčić“ na adresi Vinogradska 28a. Projektom je planirana dogradnja jednog dodatnog dnevnog boravka čime se želi riješiti problem nedostatka infrastrukturnih kapaciteta za odvijanje odgojno-obrazovnih djelatnosti za djecu u sustavu ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja u općini.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of Probotica through the implementation and certification of management systems
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti tvrtke Probotica kroz implementaciju i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of Probotica d.o.o. focuses on the implementation of two key systems, ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 22301:2019, to ensure the company's ability to provide services in the defence sector and the nuclear industry, and to raise the quality of services for the existing industries for which the company works. The project lasts 12 months during which the company will implement and certify these systems, and the employees of the company will undergo training for an internal auditor.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt tvrtke Probotica d.o.o. usmjeren je na implementaciju dva ključna sustava, ISO 27001:2022 i ISO 22301:2019, kako bi se osigurala sposobnost tvrtke da pruži usluge u sektoru obrane i nuklearnoj industriji, te kako bi se podigla kvaliteta usluga za postojeće industrije za koje tvrtka radi. Projekt traje 12 mjeseci tijekom kojih će tvrtka implementirati i certificirati navedene sustave, te će zaposlenici tvrtke proći naobrazbu za internog auditora.

Operation_Name_English: I want a dignified age III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Želim dostojanstvenu starost III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: It is precisely this project that aims to provide support and support services to people over 65 and adults with disabilities (18 and over), thus contributing to their greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in their own home and ensuring the right to live in the community. At the same time, service providers from the area of the municipality of Hrašćina are employed, which will greatly increase self-confidence and thus encourage social inclusion and increase the quality of life of service providers and their families.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Upravo ovim projektom želi se pružiti usluge potpore i podrške osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom (18 i više godina) čime se pridonosi njihovoj većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguravanju prava na život u zajednici. Ujedno se zapošljavaju pružatelji usluga s područja općine Hrašćina kojima je poznato područje što će uvelike podići samopouzdanje i na taj način potaknuti socijalnu uključenost i povećati kvalitetu života pružatelja usluga i njihovih obitelji.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of the company GEOPREM PROJEKT d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva GEOPREM PROJEKT d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the implementation and certification of quality management system according to ISO 9001 standard and information security management system according to ISO 27001 standard in the company Geoprem projekt d.o.o. The certification will increase the efficiency of business processes, ensure higher data protection standards and improve the international competitiveness of the company. The project will facilitate access to new markets, increase customer and partner confidence and reduce operational risks. Certification according to internationally recognized standards will ensure the long-term viability of the business and strengthen the market position.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je implementacija i certifikacija sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema normi ISO 9001 i sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema normi ISO 27001 u poduzeću Geoprem projekt d.o.o. Certifikacijom će se povećati učinkovitost poslovnih procesa, osigurati viši standardi zaštite podataka te poboljšati međunarodna konkurentnost poduzeća. Projekt će omogućiti lakši pristup novim tržištima, povećanje povjerenja klijenata i partnera te smanjenje operativnih rizika. Certifikacija prema međunarodno priznatim normama osigurat će dugoročnu održivost poslovanja i jačanje tržišne pozicije.

Operation_Name_English: STEMBOOST: Strengthening skills and equal opportunities in STEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEMBOOST: Jačanje vještina i jednakih prilika u STEM-u
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to create a sustainable system in which CSOs and educational institutions collaborate to popularize STEM among high school students with a focus on high school students, in order to increase the number of those who choose STEM careers. Overall objective: Strengthen the capacity of CSOs to promote STEM among high school students Specific objectives: - Increasing the professional competence of CSO members from the STEM approach - Development and implementation of inclusive informal STEM workshops for secondary school students - Promotion of STEM through organized public events Activities: - Implementation of 10 STEM trainings for representatives of CSOs and educational institutions, - Implementation of 360 workshops with students based on the STEM approach - Organisation of 36 public STEM events
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je stvoriti održiv sustav u kojem OCD-i i obrazovne ustanove surađuju na popularizaciji STEM-a među srednjoškolcima s naglaskom na srednjoškolke, kako bi se povećao broj onih koji biraju STEM karijere. Opći cilj: osnažiti kapacitete OCD-a za promociju STEM-a među srednjoškolcima Specifični ciljevi: - Povećanje stručne osposobljenosti članova OCD-a iz STEM pristupa - Razvoj i implementacija inkluzivnih neformalnih STEM radionica za srednjoškolce - Promocija STEM-a kroz organizirane javne događaje Aktivnosti: - Provedba 10 izobrazbi iz područja STEM-a za predstavnika OCD-a i odgojno-obrazovnih ustanova, - Provedba 360 radionica s učenicima temeljenog na STEM pristupu - Organizacija 36 javnih događaja iz područja STEM-a

Operation_Name_English: Purchase of fully equipped road medical vehicles
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nabava potpuno opremljenih cestovnih medicinskih vozila
Category_Label: Health mobile assets
NUTS3_Label: Krapinsko-zagorska županija|Brodsko-posavska županija|Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija|Virovitičko-podravska županija|Požeško-slavonska županija|Koprivničko-križevačka županija|Međimurska županija|Bjelovarsko-bilogorska županija|Šibensko-kninska županija|Karlovačka županija|Sisačko-moslavačka županija|Istarska županija|Zagrebačka županija|Varaždinska županija|Osječko-baranjska županija|Vukovarsko-srijemska županija|Zadarska županija|Primorsko-goranska županija|Grad Zagreb|Ličko-senjska županija|Split-Dalmatia County
Operation_Summary_English: The project consists of the procurement of 80 new equipped road medical vehicles for the daily provision of emergency medical care. The vehicles are intended for HMS teams of county institutes of emergency medicine as a target group, and the end users are patients in the entire territory of the Republic of Croatia. The acquired new medical and communication equipment for vehicles will at the same time be such as to enable the transfer of vital parameters of patients from the vehicle remotely and video and audio connection, which is a prerequisite for future investments in the emergency medical service in the form of enabling teleconsultations between nurses/technicians and young doctors in the vehicle with emergency medicine doctors via telemedicine.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se sadrži od nabave 80 novih opremljenih cestovnih medicinskih vozila za potrebe svakodnevnog pružanja hitne medicinske skrbi. Vozila su namijenjena timovima HMS-a županijskih zavoda za hitnu medicinu kao ciljnoj skupini, a krajnji korisnici su pacijenti na cjelokupnom području RH. Nabavljena nova medicinska i komunikacijska oprema za vozila istodobno će biti takvih karakteristika da će omogućavati prijenos vitalnih parametara pacijenata iz vozila na daljinu te video i audio vezu, što je preduvjet za buduća ulaganja u hitnu medicinsku službu u vidu omogućavanja telekonzultacija između medicinskih sestara/tehničara te mladih liječnika u vozilu s liječnicima specijalistima hitne medicine putem telemedicine.

Operation_Name_English: Development of glass door systems and partitioning systems
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj sustava staklenih vrata i pregradnih sistema
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Bokrat is developing an innovative system of glass partitions that allows sound insulation of up to 42 dB. The new system of glass walls with special properties solves the problem of sound insulation, and since it is a glass, at the same time meet the requirements of modern architecture for visual openness of space. This project provides professional support to the company in the development of innovations by ZIO (Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture) in the form of contractual provision of services in the form of designing individual parts of the system and their computer testing.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: U tvrtci Bokrat se razvija inovativni sistem staklenih pregrada koji omogućava zvučnu izolaciju do 42 dB. Novim sistemom staklenih stijena sa posebnim svojstvima se rješava problem zvučne izolacije, a budući da se radi o staklu, istovremeno se zadovoljavaju zahtjevi moderne arhitekture za vizualnoj otvorenosti prostora. Ovim projektom se pruža stručna podrška poduzeću u razvoju inovacije od strane ZIO (Fakultet strojarstva i brodogradnje) u vidu ugovornog pružanja usluge u vidu osmišljavanja pojedinih dijelova sistema i njihovom računalnom testiranju.

Operation_Name_English: It's never too late III.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nikad nije kasno III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim is to provide services and support in everyday life to the elderly and people with disabilities in the area of the city of Vukovar. Providing support in the daily life of target groups is manifested through: organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and other daily needs. The introduction of this support directly contributes to the prevention of institutionalization and affects the better life of older people and people with disabilities. The main activities are: employing 20 people to provide support, providing support to at least 120 older people and people with disabilities over 32 months, sharing supplies every month over 32 months, promoting the project to the public, and managing and managing the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je pružanje usluge i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom na području grada Vukovara. Pružanje podrške u svakodnevnom životu ciljnih skupina očituje se kroz: organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene te drugih svakodnevnih potreba. Uvođenjem ove podrške direktno se doprinosi prevenciji institucionalizacije te utječe na bolji život starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom. Glavne aktivnosti su: zapošljavanje 20 osoba za pružanje podrške, pružanje podrške min 120 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom kroz 32 mjeseca, podjela potrepština svaki mjesec kroz 32 mjeseca, promocija projekta u javnosti, te vođenje i upravljanje projektom.

Operation_Name_English: Social plan of Dubrovnik-Neretva County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalni plan Dubrovačko-neretvanske županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to the increase of accessibility and balanced regional development of social services in NWD. Specific objective 1 is to draw up a Social Plan for the DNC 2024-2026, proposed for adoption by the County Assembly. Specific objective 2 is to empower experts in social planning, implementation and monitoring of the Social Plan DNC 2024-2026. Main activities: A1.Collection of data necessary for the development of the social plan of NWD; A2. Analysis, data processing and development of the social plan of DNC, in accordance with the Ordinance on a unified methodology for needs assessment (OG 90/23); A3.Implementation of education for members of social welfare councils and NWW employees; Project management and administration; and Promotion and visibility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je doprinijeti povećanju dostupnosti i ravnomjernom regionalnom razvoju socijalnih usluga u DNŽ. Specifični cilj 1 je izraditi Socijalni plan DNŽ 2024.-2026. predložen na usvajanje na Županijskoj skupštini. Specifični cilj 2 je osnažiti stručnjake za socijalno planiranje, provedbu i praćenje Socijalnog plana DNŽ 2024.-2026. Glavne aktivnosti: A1.Prikupljanje podataka potrebnih za izradu socijalnog plana DNŽ; A2. Analiza, obrada podataka te izrada socijalnog plana DNŽ, u skladu s Pravilnikom o jedinstvenoj metodologiji za procjenu potreba (NN, br. 90/23); A3.Provedba edukacija za članove savjeta za socijalnu skrb i djelatnike DNŽ; Upravljanje projektom i administraciji; te Promidžba i vidljivost.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading and equipping of the kindergarten "Roda" Ruščica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nadogradnja i opremanje dječjeg vrtića "Roda" Ruščica
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Upgrade and equipping of the kindergarten "Roda" Ruščica" will provide space for a living room for additional 20 children of the kindergarten group and one additional living room in the area of the Municipality of Klakar and the purchase of additional equipment for the operation of the kindergarten. The main goal of this project is to increase the availability of early education in the Municipality of Klakar and to provide infrastructural and material capacities and preconditions for the inclusion of additional children in the RPOO through the upgrade and equipping of the Kindergarten. The project lasts 18 months and the total value of the project is 243,844.88 EUR.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Nadogradnja i opremanje dječjeg vrtića "Roda" Ruščica" osigurati će se prostor za dnevni boravak za dodatno 20 djece vrtićke skupine i jednog dodatnog dnevnog boravka području Općine Klakar te nabava dodatne opreme za rad dječjeg vrtića. Glavni cilj ovoga projekta je povećati dostupnost ranog odgoja i obrazovanja na područja Općine Klakar te osigurati infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete i preduvjete za uključivanje dodatne djece u RPOO kroz nadogradnju i opremanje Dječjeg vrtića. Projekt traje 18 mjeseci te ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 243.844,88 EUR.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction and certification of trust services according to the EU eIDAS Regulation in Identyum business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje i certificiranje usluga povjerenja po EU eIDAS Uredbi u Identyum poslovanje
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Implementation and certification of trust services under the EU eIDAS Regulation in Identyum Business’ is aimed at certifying the services of Identity Consortium d.o.o. under the eIDAS Regulation and achieving the status of qualified trust service provider (QTSP). This will enable the company to securely and legally validly sign electronically, e-seal and timestamp. The aim of the project is to increase competitiveness and strengthen the market position by enabling the provision of qualified trust services. The target group of the project are employees, as well as small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and large corporations , who will be able to operate digitally in a safer and legally compliant way. The project contributes to the digital transformation of HR and the EU.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Uvođenje i certificiranje usluga povjerenja po EU eIDAS Uredbi u Identyum poslovanje“ usmjeren je na certifikaciju usluga Identity Consortium d.o.o. prema eIDAS regulativi i postizanje statusa kvalificiranog pružatelja usluga povjerenja (QTSP). Time će poduzeće omogućiti sigurno i pravno valjano elektroničko potpisivanje, e-pečat i vremenski žig. Cilj projekta je povećanje konkurentnosti i jačanje tržišne pozicije omogućavanjem pružanja kvalificiranih usluga povjerenja. Ciljna skupina projekta su djelatnici, te mala i srednja poduzeća (MSP-ovi) i velike korporacije , kojima će biti omogućeno sigurnije i pravno usklađeno digitalno poslovanje. Projekt doprinosi digitalnoj transformaciji HR i EU.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of water – municipal infrastructure of the Sinj PHASE 2 agglomeration
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Poboljšanje vodno – komunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Sinj FAZA 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: Project Sinj includes investments in the reconstruction and upgrading of the water supply and sewage system in the area of the Sinj agglomeration, located in the County of Split-Dalmatia, in the area of the City of Sinj and in a very small part of the Municipality of Otok. The project envisages the connection of 8 827 new inhabitants to the sewage system and 18,094 inhabitants to the improved water supply system. In FAZI 2, it is planned to: • Works on the improvement of the existing public water supply system, reconstruction, upgrading and rehabilitation of existing facilities • on the public drainage system to build an additional 40,522m of pipelines, 14 pumping stations with the rehabilitation of 8 534 m of water supply pipelines. • Upgrading UPOV to treatment level 3 with a capacity of 26 000 p.e.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Sinj uključuje ulaganja u rekonstrukciju i dogradnju sustava vodoopskrbe i odvodnje otpadnih voda na području aglomeracije Sinj, koja se nalazi u županiji Splitsko-dalmatinskoj, na području Grada Sinja i na vrlo malom dijelu Općine Otok. Projektom je predviđeno priključenje 8 827 novih stanovnika na sustav odvodnje otpadnih voda i 18.094 stanovnika na poboljšani sustav vodoopskrbe. U FAZI 2 planirano je: • Radovi na poboljšanju postojećeg sustava javne vodoopskrbe, rekonstrukcijom, dogradnjom i sanacijom postojećih objekata • na sustavu javne odvodnje izgraditi dodatnih 40.522m cjevovoda, 14 crpnih stanica uz sanaciju 8 534 m vodoopskrbnih cjevovoda. • dogradnja UPOV-a na 3. stupanj pročišćavanja kapaciteta 26 000 ES

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of the Port of Krk
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija luke Krk
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The project of reconstruction of the port of Krk aims to increase the safety of navigation and reception of vessels in the port, protect the property of the port and users and increase the capacity of utility berths. The total value of the project is EUR 19 373 001.39, of which EUR 18 965 572.64 relates to eligible costs and EUR 407 428.75 to ineligible costs. Of the total eligible costs, EUR 17 036 858.75 relates to State aid and EUR 1 928 713.89 does not relate to State aid. Of the total eligible costs of the project, EUR 16,120.736.74 relates to the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) and EUR 2,844,835.90 to the State Budget (DP).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt rekonstrukcije luke Krk ima za cilj povećanje sigurnost plovidbe i prihvata plovila u luci, zaštite imovine luke i korisnika te povećanje kapaciteta komunalnih vezova. Ukupan vrijednost projekta je 19.373.001,39 eura od čega se 18.965.572,64 eura odnosi na prihvatljive, a 407.428,75 eura na neprihvatljive troškove. Od ukupnih prihvatljivih troškova 17.036.858,75 eura se odnosi na državne potpore, a 1.928.713,89 eura se ne odnosi na državne potpore. Od ukupnih prihvatljivih troškova projekta 16.120.736,74 eura se odnosi na sredstva Europskog fonda za regionalni razvoj (EFRR), a 2.844.835,90 eura na sredstva Državnog proračuna (DP).

Operation_Name_English: Certification of the management system in the company cWebSpace d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranje sustava upravljanja u tvrtki cWebSpace d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 22301 certificates to ensure international competitiveness and increase the market presence of cWebSpace d.o.o. The purpose of the project is to improve the quality, security and business continuity, which will enable participation in a larger number of public and private tenders in Croatia and the EU. Expected results include increasing the number of contracts, entering foreign markets and strengthening customer confidence. Certification will ensure compliance with international standards and differentiation from competition.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje certifikata ISO 9001, ISO 27001 i ISO 22301 kako bi se osigurala međunarodna konkurentnost i povećala tržišna prisutnost tvrtke cWebSpace d.o.o.. Svrha projekta je unaprjeđenje kvalitete, sigurnosti i kontinuiteta poslovanja, čime će se omogućiti sudjelovanje u većem broju javnih i privatnih natječaja u Hrvatskoj i EU. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje broja ugovora, ulazak na strana tržišta te jačanje povjerenja klijenata. Certifikacijom će se osigurati usklađenost s međunarodnim normama i diferencijacija od konkurencije.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of pedestrian-cycling trails in the Municipality of Vođinci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja pješačko-biciklističkih staza na području općine Vođinci
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project of building pedestrian-cycling trails in the area of the Municipality of Vođinci aims to promote sustainable mobility and better connectivity of public transport infrastructure. The main purpose is to improve the safety of cyclists and pedestrians by creating safe pathways and to encourage the use of public transport to reduce CO2 emissions. This initiative is a step towards a more sustainable and healthy lifestyle and a transport policy aimed at protecting the environment and improving the quality of life of citizens. The activities of the project are: 1. Preparation of project and technical documentation and document "Analysis of the state of cycling traffic" 2. Public procurement procedure, construction and expert supervision of pedestrian-cycling trails 3. Project management 4. Promotion and visibility
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt izgradnje pješačko-biciklističkih staza na području općine Vođinci ima za cilj promociju održive mobilnosti i bolju povezanost javne prometne infrastrukture. Glavna svrha poboljšanje je sigurnosti biciklista i pješaka stvaranjem sigurnih staza te poticanje korištenja javnog prijevoza radi smanjenja emisija CO2. Ova inicijativa predstavlja korak prema održivijem i zdravijem načinu života i prometnoj politici usmjerenoj prema zaštiti okoliša i poboljšanju kvalitete života građana. Aktivnosti projekta su: 1. Izrada projektno-tehničke dokumentacije i dokument "Analiza stanja biciklističkog prometa" 2. Postupak javne nabave, izgradnja i stručni nadzor pješačko-biciklističkih staza 3. Upravljanje projektom 4. Promidžba i vidljivost

Operation_Name_English: PBMSense - Research and development of innovative products for sustainable and competitive shipping
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PBMSense - istraživanje i razvoj inovativnih proizvoda za održivo i konkurentno brodarstvo
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop two globally innovative products ready for commercialization for shipping companies through the cooperation of the SPIN consortium. Project activities include research and development activities (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies), investment in testing and experimentation infrastructure, project management, and promotion and visibility activities. The project will lead to collaboration between SPIN consortia (2 micro, 1 small enterprises and 2 research and knowledge-dissemination organisations (R&DOs) and develop two globally innovative products ready for commercialization. The project has a position primarily in the RLV vessels of the future and contributes to the transformational goal of TPP green and smart transport.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je kroz suradnju SPIN konzorcija razviti dva globalno inovativna proizvoda spremna za komercijalizaciju za brodarske kompanije. Aktivnosti projekta uključuju aktivnosti istraživanja i razvoja (industrijsko istraživanje, eksperimentalni razvoj, studije izvedivosti), ulaganje u infrastrukturu za testiranje i eksperimentiranje, upravljanje projektom te aktivnosti promidžbe i vidljivosti. Projektom će se ostvariti suradnja SPIN konzorcija (2 mikro, 1 malo poduzeća i 2 organizacije za istraživanje i širenje znanja (OIŠZ) te razviti dva globalno inovativna proizvoda spremna za komercijalizaciju. Projekt ima poziciju primarno u RLV plovila budućnosti i doprinosi transformacijskom cilju TPP zeleni i pametni promet.

Operation_Name_English: Interpretation Centre Segestica - Siscia
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Interpretacijski centar Segestica - Siscia
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures|Rehabilitation of industrial sites and contaminated land|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The City of Sisak is applying the project ‘Segestica - Siscia Interpretation Centre’ with a value of €10,036,085.85. The implementation of the project will increase the integrated and inclusive social and economic development of the city of Sisak in the field of culture and sustainable tourism. Reconstruction, decoration, equipping and presentation of archaeological heritage will increase the number of visitors to the interpretation center by 100%. The energy efficiency of the currently unusable public building and the area of rehabilitated industrial facilities will be increased by 2,181.57 m2 through the revitalization of the neglected location of the former factory. The project will contribute to the diversity of the cultural offer and provide residents and the interested public with a new experience of archaeological heritage. The project will last 45 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Grad Sisak prijavljuje projekt „Interpretacijski centar Segestica - Siscia“ vrijednosti 10.036.085,85 €. Provedbom projekta povećat će se integrirani i uključiv društveni i gospodarski razvoj grada Siska u području kulture i održivog turizma. Rekonstrukcijom, uređenjem, opremanjem i prezentacijom arheološke baštine povećat će se broj posjetitelja interpretacijskog centra za 100%. Povećat će se i energetska učinkovitost trenutno neupotrebljive javne zgrade, te površina saniranih industrijskih objekata za 2.181,57 m2 kroz revitalizaciju zapuštene lokacije bivše tvornice. Projekt će doprinijeti raznolikosti kulturne ponude i pružiti stanovnicima i zainteresiranoj javnosti novi doživljaj arheološke baštine. Projekt će trajati 45 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Synergies for a more successful community
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sinergijom do uspješnije zajednice
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project will achieve the objectives of supporting the inclusive education of 33 students with disabilities in primary school partner institutions by providing support and support in mastering the curriculum of the school by employing 33 teaching assistants, without separating the students from the rest of the class. This will allow children with disabilities to strengthen their sense of belonging and self-esteem, equality, decent education, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. Project activities include the implementation of the process of selection of candidates for teaching assistants, the introduction into the work of teaching assistants, the work of teaching assistants, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta ostvarit će se ciljevi pružanja potpore inkluzivnom obrazovanju 33 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim partnerskim ustanovama omogućavanjem podrške i potpore u svladavanju nastavnog plana i programa škole zapošljavanjem 33 pomoćnika u nastavi, bez izdvajanja učenika od ostatka razrednog odjela. To će djeci s teškoćama u razvoju omogućiti jačanje osjećaja pripadnosti i samopoštovanja, ravnopravnosti, dostojanstvenog obrazovanja, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Aktivnosti projekta obuhvaćaju provedbu postupka selekcije kandidata za pomoćnike u nastavi, uvođenje u rad pomoćnika u nastavi, rad pomoćnika u nastavi, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: INFOBIP Conversation Order Management
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: INFOBIP Konverzacijski order management
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Within the respective SPIN Consortium operating in the morning RLV Smart Industries operate jointly the Consortium Holder: INFOBIP, partners, Aestus, Lloyds digital, Innvatio Proficit, EUpolis and OIŠZ 1 Faculty of Informatics in Pula. The final solution developed by the IRI project is a revolutionary conversion system for managing webshopobim orders and ordering and booking systems, designed to transform the way users interact with the product catalog and manage orders. This solution uses advanced technologies in the field of artificial intelligence and natural language processing to provide a seamless user experience and optimize the order process.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Unutar predmetnog SPIN konzorcija koji djeluje ujutrar RLV Pametne industrije djeluju zajedno nositelj konzorcija: INFOBIP, partneri, Aestus, Lloyds digital, Innovatio Proficit, EUpolis te OIŠZ 1 Fakultet informatike u Puli. Konačno rješenje koje se razvija IRI projektom predstavlja revolucionarni konverzacijski sustav za upravljanje narudžbama webshopobima i sustavima za naručivanje i rezerviranje, osmišljen da transformira način na koji korisnici interagiraju s katalogom proizvoda i upravljaju narudžbama. Ovo rješenje koristi napredne tehnologije u području umjetne inteligencije i obrade prirodnog jezika kako bi pružilo besprijekorno korisničko iskustvo i optimiziralo proces narudžbi.

Operation_Name_English: Phase2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Phase2
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the Phase2 project is to research and develop an advanced software solution for demand prediction (demand forecasting) of high-seasonal products, based on an innovative technological architecture that, by combining traditional statistical methods and artificial intelligence algorithms and machine learning, provides timely, high-precision and reliable predictions about the movement of demand for certain products on the market. The project will explore, identify and validate various contextual data, not yet utilized, that have a significant impact on demand and on the basis of which it will be possible to train an AI reasoning model.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha Phase2 projekta je istraživanje i razvoj naprednog softverskog rješenja za predikciju potražnje (demand forecasting) visoko sezonalnih proizvoda, baziranog na inovativnoj tehnološkoj arhitekturi koja kombinacijom tradicionalnih statističkih metoda te algoritama umjetne inteligencije i strojnog učenja pruža pravovremene, visoko precizne i pouzdane predikcije o kretanju potražnje određenih proizvoda na tržištu. Projektom će se istražiti, identificirati i validirati različiti kontekstualni podatci, do sada ne utilizirani, koji imaju značajan utjecaj na potražnju i na temelju kojih će biti moguće trenirati AI model zaključivanja.

Operation_Name_English: Together for them IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno za njih IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care through the provision of support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. 10 service providers will be employed to care for 60 users. The project focuses on services: organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and communicating and socializing with users. The target group and the general public will find out all information about the project through posters and leaflets, the official website of the applicant, media announcements and conferences. The project team will be in charge of the implementation of the activities and administration of the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Bit će zaposleno 10 pružatelja/ica usluga koje će skrbiti o 60 korisnika/ca. Projekt je usmjeren na usluge: organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene te komunikaciju i druženje s korisnicima. Ciljana skupina te šira javnost će sve informacije o projektu doznati putem plakata i letaka, službene web stranice prijavitelja, medijskih objava te konferencija. Za provedbu aktivnosti i administracije projekta bit će zadužen projektni tim.

Operation_Name_English: MOST SUPPORT - Development of innovative services for rest from care and inclusion in the community
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: MOST PODRŠKE - Razvoj inovativne usluge za odmor od skrbi i uključivanje u zajednicu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to relieve the burden of parents caregivers who care for children with disabilities and people with disabilities from Solin and the surrounding area, offering them the opportunity to rest, while users are provided with specialized therapies such as neurofeedback, physiotherapy, speech therapy and educational treatments. The project also includes groups of psychosocial support, recreational and educational activities, which ensures the emotional stability of parents and the improvement of the quality of life of the family. With the active participation of the association My Child Solin, which contributes to therapeutic services and the involvement of users, and the coordinating role of the applicant of the Monastery of Sv. Rafaela, the project strengthens the capacities of both organizations and contributes to the development of social services.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je rasteretiti roditelje njegovatelje/njegovatelje koji brinu o djeci s teškoćama u razvoju i osobama s invaliditetom iz Solina i okolice, nudeći im priliku za odmor, dok se korisnicima pružaju specijalizirane terapije poput neurofeedbacka, fizioterapije, logopedskih i edukacijskih tretmana. Projekt obuhvaća i grupe psihosocijalne podrške, rekreativne i edukativne aktivnosti, čime se osigurava emocionalna stabilnost roditelja i unaprjeđenje kvalitete života obitelji. Uz aktivno sudjelovanje udruge Moje dijete Solin, koja doprinosi terapijskim uslugama i uključivanju korisnika, te koordinacijsku ulogu prijavitelja Samostana sv. Rafaela, projekt jača kapacitete obje organizacije i doprinosi razvoju socijalnih usluga.

Operation_Name_English: AI supported smart platform for alternative SME financing
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: UI podržana pametna platforma za alternativno financiranje MSP
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project addresses the limited access of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to alternative sources of financing, which reduces their innovation potential and competitiveness. The aim is to test the development of a smart digital platform that, with the help of artificial intelligence, connects SMEs with non-bank investors ready to support promising projects, allowing for more efficient financing of innovation. The platform will improve access to finance, boost innovation and contribute to economic growth. With an innovation voucher, we will provide external support for the development of ideas that we would not be able to realize ourselves, enabling technologically advanced platform design and faster realization.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt rješava problem ograničenog pristupa mikro, malih i srednjih poduzeća (MSP) alternativnim izvorima financiranja, što smanjuje njihov inovacijski potencijal i konkurentnost. Cilj je ispitivanje razvoja pametne digitalne platforme koja uz pomoć umjetne inteligencije povezuje MSP-ove s ne-bankarskim investitorima spremnima podržati perspektivne projekte, omogućujući učinkovitije financiranje inovacija. Platforma će poboljšati pristup financiranju, potaknuti inovacije i pridonijeti gospodarskom rastu. Uz inovacijski vaučer osigurati ćemo vanjsku podršku za razvoj ideja koje sami ne bismo mogli realizirati, omogućujući tehnološki napredan dizajn platforme i bržu realizaciju.

Operation_Name_English: pharomatique neurocosmetic line 'mind-body beauty'
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: pharomatique neurokozmetička linija 'mind-body beauty'
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Pharomatique "mind-body beauty" is a research project dedicated to the development of a natural (neuro) cosmetic line for facial and body skin care. This innovative cosmetic line uses adaptogenic plants and scientifically proven active substances that affect the activation of natural healing processes, regeneration and self-protection of the skin by stimulating endogenous neurotransmitters. In addition, through sensory stimulation, the products act on the mental well-being of the user, with the aim of improving not only the physical appearance of the skin, but also the overall feeling of satisfaction of the user. The project will be carried out in cooperation with the Croatian Institute of Public Health in Zagreb.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Pharomatique "mind-body beauty" istraživački je projekt posvećen razvoju prirodne (neuro)kozmetičke linije za njegu kože lica i tijela. Ova inovativna kozmetička linija koristi adaptogene biljke i znanstveno dokazane aktivne tvari koje utječu na aktivaciju prirodnih procesa zacjeljivanja, regeneracije i samo-zaštite kože stimulacijom endogenih neuroprijenosnika. Osim toga, kroz osjetilnu stimulaciju, proizvodi djeluju na mentalno blagostanje korisnika, s ciljem poboljšanja ne samo fizičkog izgleda kože, već i cjelokupnog osjećaja zadovoljstva korisnika. Projekt će se odvijati u suradnji sa Hrvatskim zavodom za javno zdravstvo u Zagrebu.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of PRIMAT LOGISTIKA d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva PRIMAT LOGISTIKA d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to certify products according to international standards to ensure their quality, safety and compliance with market requirements. The purpose of the project is to increase the market reach of certified products, facilitate access to international markets and reduce regulatory barriers, thus enabling sales and export revenues to grow. Expected results include product certification in accordance with internationally recognised standards, ensuring market competitiveness and long-term business sustainability. The project contributes to the international competitiveness of the company through conformity assessment and product certification, which increases the recognition on the European market
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je certificiranje proizvoda prema međunarodnim normama kako bi se osigurala njihova kvaliteta, sigurnost i usklađenost s tržišnim zahtjevima. Svrha projekta je povećanje tržišnog dosega certificiranih proizvoda, olakšan pristup međunarodnim tržištima i smanjenje regulatornih prepreka, čime se omogućuje rast prihoda od prodaje i izvoza. Očekivani rezultati uključuju certificiranje proizvoda u skladu s međunarodno priznatim normama, osiguravanje tržišne konkurentnosti te dugoročnu održivost poslovanja. Projekt doprinosi međunarodnoj konkurentnosti poduzeća kroz ocjenjivanje sukladnosti i certifikaciju proizvoda, čime se povećava prepoznatljivost na europskom tržištu

Operation_Name_English: Together for a better and happier future 3
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno za bolju i sretniju budućnost 3
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Together for a better and happier future 3" will provide support and support services to 198 elderly and/or disabled people from the area of Beli Manastir. In this way, their social inclusion and quality of life will be increased and the prevention of their institutionalization will be directly affected.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Zajedno za bolju i sretniju budućnost 3" pružat će se usluge potpore i podrške svakodnevnom životu za 198 starijih osoba i/ili osoba s invaliditetom s područja grada Belog Manastira. Te će se na taj način povećati njihova socijalna uključenost i razina kvalitete života te će se direktno utjecati na prevenciju institucionalizacije istih.

Operation_Name_English: The Golden Hands
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zlatne ruke
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care for 33 months for at least 180 participants. 36 months will be spent, the first three months will be spent publishing the tender for the service provider and informing the target group members. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. The objectives shall be pursued through the following activities: employing 30 providers of catering, household chores, personal hygiene and other daily needs; monitoring and control of the services performed; procurement and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies; communication and visibility; project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi na 33 mjeseca za min 180 sudionika. Provodit će se 36 mjeseci, prva tri mjeseca će trajati objava natječaja za pružatelja/ica usluge i informiranje pripadnika ciljne skupine. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Ciljevi se ispunjavaju sljedećim aktivnostima: zapošljavanje 30 pružatelja/ica usluga organiziranja prehrane, obavljanja kućanskih poslova, održavanja osobne higijene i zadovoljavanja drugih svakodnevnih potreba; praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga; nabava i podjela kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština; komunikacija i vidljivost; upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: By certification to the international markets of steel works d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacijom do međunarodnih tržišta tvrtke steel works d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Certification to international markets of steel works d.o.o.’ aims to increase competitiveness through certification according to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 3834:2021 and ISO 1090:2019. The aim is to ensure compliance with international standards, optimise business processes and increase access to foreign markets. Activities include certification of management systems, improvement of logistics and procurement and strengthening of market position. Expected results are increased efficiency, cost reduction and long-term business sustainability, with greater visibility and access to new business opportunities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Certifikacijom do međunarodnih tržišta tvrtke steel works d.o.o.“ usmjeren je na povećanje konkurentnosti kroz certifikaciju prema ISO 9001:2015, ISO 3834:2021 i ISO 1090:2019. Cilj je osigurati usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima, optimizirati poslovne procese i povećati pristup inozemnim tržištima. Aktivnosti uključuju certifikaciju sustava upravljanja, unaprjeđenje logistike i nabave te jačanje tržišne pozicije. Očekivani rezultati su povećana učinkovitost, smanjenje troškova i dugoročna održivost poslovanja, uz veću prepoznatljivost i pristup novim poslovnim prilikama.

Operation_Name_English: Research and Development of the Intuitive Robot Industrial System - I.R.I.S.: Intuitive Robotic Industrial System
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Istraživanje i razvoj Intuitivnog Robotskog Industrijskog Sustava - I.R.I.S.: Intuitive Robotic Industrial System
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop an Intuitive Robot Industrial System I.R.I.S which, with the virtual production assistant TIPU and DAZy - Digital Assistant of Occupational Safety and Health, will completely transform the current processes of individual production of high value-added parts on a global level. The project addresses the key problem of limiting automation and flexibility of production processes of companies engaged in the production of parts for automated systems of high-series and small-series production, for large players in the automotive industry. The construction solution of this type represents the culmination of industrial robotics by integrating 5 key functionalities into 1 system, enabling automation and optimization of individual production.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je razviti Intuitivni Robotski Industrijski Sustav I.R.I.S koji će uz virtualnog asistenta proizvodnje TIPU i DAZy - Digitalnog asistenta zaštite na radu kompletno transformirati trenutačne procese pojedinačne proizvodnje dijelova visoke dodane vrijednosti na globalnoj razini. Projekt adresira ključni problem ograničavajuće automatizacije i fleksibilnosti proizvodnih procesa tvrtki koje se bave proizvodnjom dijelova za automatizirane sustave visokoserijske i maloserijske proizvodnje, za velike igrače u automobilskoj industriji. Konstrukcijsko rješenje ovog tipa predstavlja vrhunac industrijske robotike integracijom 5 ključnih funkcionalnosti u 1 sustav, omogućavajući automatizaciju i optimizaciju pojedinačne proizvodnje.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of the management system for Holobit d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja za Holobit d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of introducing the management system into Holobit's business according to ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 standards is aimed at strengthening the market position and international competitiveness of the company. Certification will ensure compliance of business processes and data security within the HoloERP system, a specialized ERP solution for hospitality, construction and trade. ISO 9001 will confirm the quality of management, while ISO 27001 will guarantee high data protection standards, essential for working with financial institutions and organizations that handle sensitive information. By doing so, Holobit will increase customer confidence and open up access to new markets. Expected results of the project: • Acquisition of ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certificates.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt uvođenja sustava upravljanja u Holobitovo poslovanje prema normama ISO 9001 i ISO 27001 usmjeren je na jačanje tržišne pozicije i međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke. Certifikacija će osigurati usklađenost poslovnih procesa i sigurnost podataka u okviru HoloERP sustava, specijaliziranog ERP rješenja za ugostiteljstvo, građevinu i trgovinu. ISO 9001 potvrdit će kvalitetu upravljanja, dok će ISO 27001 jamčiti visoke standarde zaštite podataka, ključne za rad s financijskim institucijama i organizacijama koje rukuju osjetljivim informacijama. Time će Holobit povećati povjerenje klijenata i otvoriti pristup novim tržištima. Očekivani rezultati projekta: • Stjecanje certifikata ISO 9001 i ISO 27001.

Operation_Name_English: Innovative concept for the development of new materials for hard-to-flammable absorbers - Acoustic RecyTech Innovations (ARTI)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inovativni koncept razvoja novih materijala za teško zapaljive apsorbere - Acoustic RecyTech Innovations (ARTI)
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to carry out research and development of new (eco) materials applied in products and processes that surround man with the aim of cheaper production, facilitating work and monitoring the health condition. In addition to increasing comfort and safety, the materials will be hard to flammable and will respond to modern recycling challenges, and with advanced technical performance will reduce multiple sound reflections, which impair the auditoryness, comprehensibility and focus of users. By connecting and encouraging cooperation between stakeholders from the business, scientific research and public sector in the area of SH, the project also aims to introduce a more environmentally friendly production process of clean technologies, emission reduction. CO2 and green functional construction.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se želi provesti istraživanje i razvoj novih (eko) materijala koji se primjenjuju u proizvodima i procesima koji okružuju čovjeka s ciljem jeftinije proizvodnje, olakšavanja rada te praćenja zdravstvenog stanja. Pored povećanja ugode i sigurnosti, materijali će biti teško zapaljivi i odgovoriti će na suvremene izazove recikliranja te će uz napredne tehničke performanse smanjivati višestruke refleksije zvuka, a što narušavaju slušnost, razumljivost i fokusiranost korisnika. Povezivanjem i poticanjem suradnje dionika iz poslovnog, znanstveno-istraživačkog i javnog sektora na području SH, projektom se želi i uvesti ekološki prihvatljiviji proizvodni proces čistih tehnologija, smanjenje emis. CO2 i zelena funkcionkcionalna gradnja.

Operation_Name_English: Certification for the purpose of increasing competitiveness in the metal processing industry
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija sa svrhom povećanja konkurentnosti u industriji obrade metala
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The company Bluelink d.o.o., through the implementation of this project, tries to solve the problem of lack of certificates for the needs of business in the sector of production and assembly of metal structures. By introducing more types of certificates in the business process, security and control of the production process, long-term business sustainability will be achieved, and business risks will be reduced. By holding a certificate, the company will be able to do business with partners who require the possession of a certificate as a prerequisite for the start of business, which will consequently result in an increase in the applicant's market share, and an increase in sales and export revenues. The target groups of the project are customers, suppliers, partners, employees and the public.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Poduzeće Bluelink d.o.o. provedbom ovog projekta nastoji riješiti problem nedostatka certifikata za potrebe poslovanja u sektoru proizvodnje i montaže metalnih konstrukcija. Uvođenjem više vrsta certifikata u poslovni proces postići će se sigurnost i kontrola proizvodnog procesa, dugoročna održivost poslovanja, te će se smanjiti rizici u poslovanju. Posjedovanjem certifikata poduzeće će moći poslovati s partnerima koji zahtijevaju posjedovanje certifikata kao preduvjet za početak poslovanja, što će posljedično rezultirati povećanju tržišnog udjela prijavitelja, te povećanju prihoda od prodaje i izvoza. Ciljne skupine projekta su kupci, dobavljači, partneri, zaposlenici i javnost.

Operation_Name_English: Construction and equipping of the central building of the Kindergarten Omiš
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja i opremanje centralne zgrade Dječjeg vrtića Omiš
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Construction and equipping of the central building of the Kindergarten Omiš" stems from the need for additional capacities of kindergartens in Omiš and aims to provide infrastructural and material conditions for increasing the availability of early and preschool education in the City of Omiš. The project includes the construction and equipping of the kindergarten according to the modern standards of the green transition and solves the problem of the lack of a central building of the Kindergarten Omiš, which significantly improves the conditions of early and preschool education in Omiš. The realization of the project in question ensures high-quality conditions for the upbringing and education of 160 children in 10 living rooms, of which 5 stays will be intended for kindergarten children, and 5 stays for children of crèche age.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Izgradnja i opremanje centralne zgrade Dječjeg vrtića Omiš" proizlazi iz potrebe za dodatnim kapacitetima dječjih vrtića u Omišu te ima za cilj osigurati infrastrukturne i materijalne uvjete za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja u Gradu Omišu. Projekt uključuje izgradnju i opremanje matičnog vrtića prema suvremenim standardima zelene tranzicije te rješava problem nedostatka centralne zgrade Dječjeg vrtića Omiš, čime se značajno unapređuju uvjeti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja u Omišu. Realizacijom predmetnog projekta, osiguravaju se visokokvalitetni uvjeti za odgoj i obrazovanje 160 djece u 10 dnevnih boravaka, od čega će 5 boravaka biti namijenjeno djeci vrtićke dobi, a 5 boravaka djeci jasličke dobi.

Operation_Name_English: Smartnet AI solution for integrated Smart city e-infrastructure management
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Smartnet AI rješenje za integrirani Smart city e-infrastructure management
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
