Operation_Summary_English: The project "Smartnet AI solution for integrated Smart city e-infrastructure management" develops an advanced solution that integrates smart management and autonomy technologies in order to respond to the challenges of public e-infrastructure security The project develops in parallel and leads to the technological readiness level of 8 two innovative solutions of high added value: Solution 1- System for managing IT standards and certification for larger cities, municipalities and public institutions Solution 2- System for automation management and documentation of JLP(R)S IT system in the scope of NIS2
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Unutar predmetnog SPIN konzorcija djeluju nositelj Smartnet d.o.o. te partneri Telenorm, Izvorni kod, Bios ICT, Istracom i Sveučilišni odjel za stručne studije Projektom "Smartnet AI rješenje za integrirani Smart city e-infrastructure management" razvija se napredno rješenje koje integrira tehnologije pametnog upravljanja i autonomnosti kako bi se odgovorilo na izazove sigurnost javne e-infrastrukture Projektom se paralelno razvijaju i dovode do razine tehnološke spremnosti 8 dva inovativna rješenja visoke dodane vrijednosti: Rješenje 1- Sustav za upravljanje IT standardima i certifikacijom za veće gradove, općine i javne ustanove Rješenje 2- Sustav za automatizaciju upravljanjem i dokumentacijom IT sustava JLP(R)S na području primjene NIS2

Operation_Name_English: Wind in the back - phase VI
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Vjetar u leđa - faza VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure inclusive education of students with disabilities through providing support to the inclusion of students with disabilities in the Primary Schools of the City of Samobor in order to ensure conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. Students with developmental disabilities should be given special attention and, through the provision of support, they are additionally prepared for independent living. Activities that will be implemented through the project are providing support to the education of students with disabilities through the work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators, and through the implementation of the candidate selection procedure, the introduction into operation, the work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators, communication and visibility, and project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguranje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz pružanje potpore uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u Osnovne škole grada Samobora kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju potrebno je pružiti posebnu pažnju te ih se kroz pružanje podrške dodatno priprema za samostalni život. Aktivnosti koja će se provoditi kroz projekt su pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika, a kroz provedbu postupka selekcije kandidata, uvođenje u rad, rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika, komunikaciju i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Helping, phase VII – a project to provide teaching assistance to pupils with disabilities in primary schools in Slavonski Brod
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Helping, faza VII – projekt pružanja pomoći u nastavi učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnim školama u Slavonskom Brodu
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The Helping project, phase VII - the project of providing teaching assistance to pupils with disabilities in primary schools in Slavonski Brod through the engagement of teaching assistants and professional communication mediators, provides the conditions for improving educational achievements, socialization and emotional functioning for 103 pupils with disabilities during their education in primary schools in Slavonski Brod in the school years 2024/2025, 2025/2026 and 2026/2027.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Helping, faza VII - projekt pružanja pomoći u nastavi učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnim školama u Slavonskom Brodu kroz angažman pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika osiguravaju se uvjeti za poboljšanje obrazovnih postignuća, socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje za 103 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju za vrijeme njihovog obrazovanja u osnovnim školama u Slavonskom Brodu u školskim godinama 2024./2025., 2025./2026. i 2026./2027.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of the management system for sustainable business operations of TEHNODIV SERVIS d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja za održivo poslovanje poduzeća TEHNODIV SERVIS d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project is focused on the introduction and certification of management systems according to the requirements of 5 internationally recognized standards: ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, ISO 3834 and EN 1090. This will facilitate access to international markets and increase competitiveness by demonstrating high standards of quality, safety and sustainability. Implementation and certification will ensure compliance with European standards and increase the trust of customers and partners. The realization of the project will contribute to the competitiveness and sustainability of the company by optimizing processes and better resource management, while ensuring high standards of environmental protection and safety at work. Expected results include growth in sales and export revenues and business opportunities in the international market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je usmjeren na uvođenje i certificiranje sustava upravljanja prema zahtjevima 5 međunarodno priznatih normi: ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 50001, ISO 3834 i EN 1090. Navedeno će omogućiti lakši pristup međunarodnim tržištima te povećati konkurentnost dokazivanjem visokih standarda kvalitete, sigurnosti i održivosti. Implementacija i certificiranje osigurat će usklađenost s europskim standardima te povećati povjerenje kupaca i partnera. Realizacija projekta doprinijet će konkurentnosti i održivosti poduzeća optimizacijom procesa i boljim upravljanjem resursima, uz osiguranje visokih standarda zaštite okoliša i sigurnosti na radu. Očekivani rezultati uključuju rast prihoda od prodaje i izvoza te poslovnih prilika na međunarodnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Creative code: Primary School Students in the STEM World
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kreativni kod: Osnovnoškolci u STEM svijetu
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to strengthen the capacity of the association Renova in the promotion of STEM among children and students while improving the capacity to implement programs in the field of STEM promotion. The project will achieve cooperation between Renova and Algebra University with four primary schools through the implementation of activities aimed at promoting STEM among students. This will be achieved through training of project employees and their mentoring by experts from Algebra University; participation of employees and volunteers in conferences and study visits to other organisations active in STEM; a minimum of 240 workshops to promote STEMA among primary school students in cooperation with four primary schools; organization of 24 public events with the aim of promoting STEMA.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je jačanje kapaciteta udruge Obnova u promociji STEM-a među djecom i učenicima uz unapređenje kapaciteta za provedbu programa u području promocije STEM-a. Projektom će se ostvariti suradnja Obnove i Sveučilišta Algebra s četiri osnovne škole kroz provedbu aktivnosti s ciljem promocije STEM-a među učenicima. To će se ostvariti kroz izobrazbe osoba zaposlenih na projektu i njihovo mentoriranje od strane stručnjaka sa Sveučilišta Algebra; sudjelovanje zaposlenika i volontera na konferencijama i studijskim posjetama drugim organizacijama koje djeluju u STEMu; održavanje minimalno 240 radionica s ciljem promocije STEMA među osnovnoškolcima u suradnji s četiri osnovne škole; organizaciju 24 javnih događaja s ciljem promocije STEMA.

Operation_Name_English: Certification in service of increasing competitiveness in the printing industry
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija u službi povećanja konkurentnosti u tiskarskoj industriji
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With the implementation of this project, the company Cerovski is trying to solve the problem of lack of certificates for the purpose of business expansion and a higher level of competitiveness. This issue is addressed through the introduction of a PSD certificate, which relates to the certification of 2 management systems : - processes - quality By using PSD certificates, the service provider can prove its approach to quality verification and a complete understanding of digital printing on the world market. The implementation of the certificate will standardize the production process, increase revenues, exports and competitiveness of enterprises in the domestic, but also in the foreign market, given the ambitions of product placement in EU countries. Target groups are customers, suppliers, employees and the local community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Poduzeće Cerovski provedbom ovog projekta nastoji riješiti problem nedostatka certifikata za potrebe proširenja poslovanja i veće razine konkurentnosti. Taj problem se nastoji riješiti uvođenjem PSD certifikata, koji se odnosi na certificiranje 2 sustava upravljanja : - procesima - kvalitetom Korištenjem PSD certifikata, pružatelj usluge može na svjetskom tržištu dokazati svoj pristup provjeri kvalitete i cjelovito razumijevanje digitalnog tiska. Implementacijom certifikata će se standardizirati proces proizvodnje, povećati prihodi, izvoz te konkurentnost poduzeća na domaćem, ali isto tako i na inozemnom tržištu, s obzirom na ambicije plasmana proizvoda u zemlje EU. Ciljne skupine su kupci, dobavljači, zaposlenici i lokalna zajednica.

Operation_Name_English: Knowing it's cool III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Znati je fora III
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to ensure inclusive education for at least 35 students with disabilities in primary education institutions in the City of Vukovar. The specific objective of this project is to support the inclusion of at least 35 students with disabilities in primary education institutions in the area of the city of Vukovar in order to ensure the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The main activity of the project is to support the education of students with disabilities through the work of PUN/CPC. Project activities include the selection of candidates for PUN/CPC, PUN/CPC work, communication and visibility, and project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja za najmanje 35 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim odgojno obrazovnim ustanovama na području Grada Vukovara. Specifični cilj ovog projekta je pružiti potporu uključivanju najmanje 35 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove na području grada Vukovara kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješnije socijalizacije i emocionalnog funkcioniranja. Glavna aktivnost projekta je pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad PUN/SKP. Aktivnosti projekta uključuju selekciju kandidata za PUN/SKP, rad PUN/SKP, komunikaciju i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Improving the business of the company Muzika i to d.o.o. through the introduction and certification of the management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje poslovanja poduzeća Muzika i to d.o.o. kroz uvođenje i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With the project investment "Improving the business of Muzika i to d.o.o. through the introduction and certification of management systems" lasting 18 months, Muzika i to d.o.o. will improve its business and increase its competitiveness by introducing and certification of management systems, all in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards. The project goal is to introduce, harmonise and certify management systems in order to adapt the company to the market and to ensure the sustainability of the business.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektnim ulaganjem "Unaprjeđenje poslovanja poduzeća Muzika i to d.o.o. kroz uvođenje i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja" u trajanju 18 mjeseci, poduzeće Muzika i to d.o.o. će unaprijediti svoje poslovanje te povećati svoju konkurentnost uvođenjem i certifikacijom sustava upravljanja , a sve u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi. Projektni je cilj uvesti, uskladiti i certificirati sustave upravljanja kako bi se tvrtka prilagodila tržištu i kako bi se osigurala održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: "Accept the hand of support"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Prihvati ruku podrške"
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care is the overall objective of this project. Providing support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities is a specific objective of this project. The activities of this project are the provision of support and support services in everyday life to the elderly and persons with disabilities with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies, which include the employment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group, monitoring and control of the services performed, the procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi je opći cilj ovog projekta. Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom je specifičan cilj ovog projekta. Aktivnosti ovog projekta su pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština, koje uključuju zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Construction and equipping of a kindergarten in Komletinci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja i opremanje dječjeg vrtića u Komletincima
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The main goal of the project is to increase the capacity of the institution to provide education services in preschool age, and to improve the quality of preschool education in the area of the City of Otok by building a kindergarten with a kitchen in the village of Komletinci, which would solve the problem of capacity insufficiency. The target groups of the project are children of nursery and kindergarten age, the age from the age of the first year of life to the start of primary school, and their parents, families from the local area. The final beneficiaries are the residents of the City of Otok (island settlement and Komletinci) on whom the implementation of this project will have an indirect impact on individual life decisions that will contribute to the demographic revitalization and sustainable development of the City of Otok.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni cilj projekta je povećati kapaciteta ustanove za pružanje usluga odgoja i obrazovanja u predškolskoj dobi, te unaprjeđenje kvalitete predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja na području Grada Otoka izgradnjom područnog objekta dječjeg vrtića s kuhinjom u naselju Komletinci čime bi se riješio problem nedostatnosti kapaciteta. Ciljne skupine projekta su djeca jasličke i vrtićke dobi, starosti od navršene prve godine života do polaska u osnovnu školu te njihovi roditelji, obitelji s lokalnog područja. Krajnji korisnici su stanovnici Grada Otoka (naselje Otok i Komletinci) na koje će provedba ovog projekta imati posredan utjecaj na pojedine životne odluke koje će doprinijeti demografskoj revitalizaciji i održivom razvoju Grada Otoka.

Operation_Name_English: We are with you 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mi smo s vama 2
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to increasing social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objectives are: 1. Providing support and support in everyday life to older people and people with disabilities. 2. Social inclusion and increasing the quality of life of older people and people with disabilities. The activities of the project are providing support and support in everyday life to the elderly and people with disabilities in the territory of the municipality of Hrvatska Dubica in a way to help organize and prepare food, maintain personal hygiene, purchase medicines, go to the doctor, etc. In addition, the project activities are project management, promotion and visibility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je pridonijeti povećanju socijalne uključenosti i prevenciji institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični ciljevi su: 1. Pružanje podrške i potpore u svakodnevnim životu osobama starije životne dobi i osobama s invaliditetom. 2. Socijalno uključivanje i povećanje kvalitete života starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom. Aktivnosti projekta su pružanje potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu osobama starije životne dobi i osobama s invaliditetom na području općine Hrvatska Dubica na način da se pomogne pri organiziranju i pripremi hrane, pri održavanju osobne higijene, nabavi lijekova, pri odlasku liječniku i sl. Osim toga, aktivnosti projekta su i upravljanje projektom, promidžba i vidljivost.

Operation_Name_English: Testing new protein bars with different matrices and flavours
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ispitivanje novih proteinskih pločica s različitim matriksima i okusima
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project is carried out for 4 months and implies the purchase of the service of testing the properties of raw materials, defining the necessary matrix of new protein bars, as well as the production of specimens of energy bars necessary for testing. The aim of the project is to successfully conduct testing and testing of new types of protein bars in order to complete the phase of technological development 5 (TRL 5) and create the preconditions for further development of new products and future commercialization.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se provodi 4 mjeseca i podrazumijeva nabavku usluge ispitivanja svojstava sirovina, definiranje potrebnog matriksa novih proteinskih pločica, kao i proizvodnju primjeraka energetskih pločica potrebnih za testiranje. Cilj projekta je uspješno provođenje istpitivanja i testiranja novih tipova proteinskih pločica kako bi se završila faza tehnološkog razvoja 5 (TRL 5) te stvorile pretpostavke za nastavak daljnjeg razvoja novih proizvoda i buduću komercijalizaciju.

Operation_Name_English: And I want a nicer tomorrow...
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: I ja želim ljepše sutra…
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide assistance to socially vulnerable people. The provision of assistance includes prevention, promotion of change, assistance in basic living needs and support to individuals, families and groups whose purpose is to improve the quality of life and empower users.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta pružanje pomoći socijalno ugroženim osobama. Pružanje pomoći uključuje prevenciju, primicanje promjena, pomoć u osnovnim životnim potrebama i podršku pojedincu, obitelji i skupinama čija je svrha unaprjeđenje kvalitete života i osnaživanje korisnika.

Operation_Name_English: PRSTEN AID VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PRSTEN POTPORE VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The Grant Ring VII project enables the inclusion of students with disabilities in the regular educational system of Zagreb County through the support of teaching assistants and professional communication mediators, in order to meet the special educational needs of students and equalize opportunities in education on an equal basis with other students. Direct work of teaching assistants and professional communication mediators with students will provide conditions for improving students' educational achievements, more successful socialization and better emotional functioning, equal participation in all aspects of the educational process and long-term development of their full potential and independence in adulthood.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Prsten potpore VII omogućava inkluziju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u redoviti odgojno-obrazovni sustav Zagrebačke županije kroz potporu pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika, a radi ispunjavanja posebnih odgojno-obrazovnih potreba učenika i izjednačavanja mogućnosti u obrazovanju na ravnopravnoj osnovi s drugim učenicima. Neposrednim radom pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika s učenicima, osigurat će se uvjeti za poboljšanje obrazovnih postignuća učenika, uspješnija socijalizacija i bolje emocionalno funkcioniranje, ravnopravno sudjelovanje u svim aspektima odgojno-obrazovnog procesa te dugoročno razvoj njihovog punog potencijala i neovisnosti u odrasloj dobi.

Operation_Name_English: Experiment
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pokus
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Project activities of the STEM playroom project are mostly related to the implementation of continuous STEM workshops with kindergarten children and other children. Other project activities are promotion of STEM areas in public places, implementation of training and mentoring of employees/volunteers of project partners by the University and attendance of trainings, fairs/conferences related to new methods of learning and presenting STEM areas to children and students.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektne aktivnosti projekta STEM igraonice odnose se većinski na provedbu kontinuiranih STEM radionica s djecom vrtićke dobi i ostalom djecom. Ostale projektne aktivnosti su promocija STEM područja na javnim mjestima, provedba izobrazbe i mentoriranja zaposlenika/volontera partnera u projektu od strane Sveučilišta te pohađanje izobrazbi, sajmova/konferencija vezanih uz nove metode učenja i prezentiranja STEM područja djeci i učenicima.

Operation_Name_English: Green colors of knowledge: Promotion of STEM in agriculture
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zelene boje znanja: Promocija STEM-a u poljoprivredi
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Project "Green Colors of Knowledge: Promotion of STEM in agriculture" is aimed at strengthening the capacity of SUMA - Association for Sustainable Development to promote STEM in agriculture among children and students. Activities include study visits to organizations, attendance at STEM fairs and conferences, trainings, mentoring, implementation of science-popular events in kindergartens, primary and secondary schools, and organization of STEM promotion events in agriculture in public places for children and students. Project partners are Polytechnic of Križevci, two kindergartens and seven primary schools from Požega-Slavonia, Koprivnica-Križevci, Virovitica-Podravina, Zagreb, Bjelovar-Bilogora and Sisak-Moslavina counties.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Zelene boje znanja: Promocija STEM-a u poljoprivredi" je usmjeren na jačanje kapaciteta SUMA - Udruga za održivi razvoj za promicanje STEM-a u poljoprivredi među djecom i učenicima. Aktivnosti obuhvaćaju studijske posjete organizacijama, pohađanja STEM sajmova i konferencija, izobrazbe, mentoriranje, provedbu znanstveno-popularnih događanja u dječjim vrtićima, osnovnim i srednjim školama te organizaciju manifestacija promocije STEM-a u poljoprivredi na javnim mjestima za djecu i učenike. Projektni partneri su Veleučilište u Križevcima, dva dječja vrtića i sedam osnovnih škola iz Požeško-slavonske, Koprivničko-križevačke, Virovitičko-podravske, Zagrebačke, Bjelovarsko-bilogorske i Sisačko-moslavačke županije.

Operation_Name_English: Selca - the cultural heart of Brač
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Selca - kulturno srce Brača
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to renovate and revitalise the ‘Didolića dvori’ cultural heritage facility, which was built in the middle of the 19th century. The project will reconstruct and equip the ‘Didolića dvori’ cultural heritage facility, arrange an environmentally neglected space and install solar power plants on the roof. The new cultural centre will also provide space for civil society organisations to operate. The target groups that will benefit from the implementation of the project are the local community, all potential visitors, artists and civil society organisations. This will be achieved through the implementation of 3 project activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je obnova i revitalizacija objekta kulturne baštine - zgrada „Didolića dvori“, izgrađena sredinom 19. st. Kroz projekt rekonstruirat će se i opremiti objekt kulturne baštine „Didolića dvori“, uredit će se okolišni zapušteni prostor a na krov će se montirat sunčane elektrane. U novom kulturnom centru bit će osigurani i prostori za djelovanje organizacija civilnog društva. Ciljne skupine koje će imati koristi od provedbe projekta su lokalna zajednica, svi potencijalni posjetitelji, umjetnici i organizacije civilnog društva. Navedeno će se postići kroz provedbu 3 projektne aktivnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Supporting excellence, innovation and visibility in vocational education and training
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podrška izvrsnosti, inovativnosti i vidljivosti strukovnog obrazovanja i osposobljavanja
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective is to promote the excellence and attractiveness of VET. The specific objective is to promote vocational professions, strengthen the competences of students and school staff through implementation and participation in competitions and reviews. The main activities are the organization and implementation of state competitions and reviews of vocational school students, support for ASOO participation in WorldSkills Europe and International associations, raising the quality of national competitions through the transfer of innovations and strengthening the capacity of ASOO.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj je promicanje izvrsnosti i privlačnosti SOO. Specifični cilj je promocija strukovnih zanimanja, jačanje kompetencija učenika i djelatnika škola kroz provedbu i sudjelovanje na natjecanjima i smotrama. Glavne aktivnosti su organizacija i provedba državnih natjecanja te smotri učenika strukovnih škola, potpora sudjelovanju ASOO-a u udruženjima WorldSkills Europe i International, podizanje kvalitete nacionalnih natjecanja kroz prijenos inovacija te jačanje kapaciteta ASOO.

Operation_Name_English: Together we can do anything! - 8
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno možemo sve! - 8
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Together we can do everything! - 8" continues good practice from the previous seven implemented projects that provided teaching assistants/professional communication mediators in teaching for students with disabilities in the Dubrovnik-Neretva County. The implementation of this project will enable students with disabilities to successfully participate in the education system in the environment in which they live. With an individual approach, in accordance with their abilities and interests, a more successful adoption of the curriculum will be ensured, the relationship with peers will be improved and the conditions for improving their educational achievements will be provided. It is estimated to include 139 students with disabilities and to engage 134 PUN.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Zajedno možemo sve! - 8" nastavlja se dobra praksa iz prethodnih sedam provedenih projekata kojima su se osigurali pomoćnici u nastavi/stručni komunikacijski posrednici u nastavi za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju na području Dubrovačko-neretvanske županije. Provedbom ovog projekta učenicima s teškoćama omogućit će se uspješno uključivanje u sustav odgoja i obrazovanja u sredini u kojoj žive. Uz individualan pristup, u skladu s njihovim mogućnostima i interesima osigurat će se uspješnije usvajanje nastavnog programa, poboljšati odnos s vršnjacima te osigurati uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća. Procjenjuje se uključivanje 139 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju te angažiranje 134 PUN.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of Sample Control d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva Sample Control d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Objective of the project: Increase the international competitiveness of Sample Control by certifying quality and safety management systems (ISO 27001, GMP+, ), ensuring compliance with internationally recognised standards and market requirements. Purpose of the project: Enable easier access to foreign markets, increase customer confidence and optimize business processes through the introduction of high quality and security standards. Expected results: Certification of three business process management systems, increasing export and sales revenues and strengthening the company's reputation in the international market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta: Povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća Sample Control certificiranjem sustava upravljanja kvalitete i sigurnosti (ISO 27001, GMP+, ), čime će se osigurati usklađenost s međunarodno priznatim normama i zahtjevima tržišta. Svrha projekta: Omogućiti lakši pristup inozemnim tržištima, povećati povjerenje klijenata i optimizirati poslovne procese kroz uvođenje visokih standarda kvalitete i sigurnosti. Očekivani rezultati: Certificiranje tri sustava upravljanja poslovnim procesima, povećanje prihoda od izvoza i prodaje te jačanje reputacije poduzeća na međunarodnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Let's make it possible to live in our own home
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Omogućimo život u vlastitom domu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support services in everyday life to persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities in the Varaždin County, thus contributing to social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of the target group. As part of the project, support and support services will be provided (organization of food for household chores, maintenance of personal hygiene, meeting other daily needs) for 180 members of the target group, along with the procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies, for which 30 service providers will be employed. The project also includes the monitoring and control activity of the services performed, communication and visibility and project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom na području Varaždinske županije, čime se pridonosi socijalnoj uključenosti i prevenciji institucionalizacije ciljane skupine. U sklopu projekta pružat će se usluga potpore i podrške (organizacija prehrane obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba) za 180 pripadnika ciljane skupine, uz nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, za što će biti zaposleno 30 pružatelja usluga. Projekt uključuje i aktivnost praćenja i kontrole izvršenih usluga, komunikaciju i vidljivost i upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Let's give our hands II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pružimo ruke II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project would contribute to increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of elderly and disabled people and adults with disabilities by ensuring long-term care and increasing their quality of life. Express the dispersion of the settlement and the distance with the absence of bus lines connecting them to the functional part of the city, leaving them to themselves. The implementation of the project ultimately leads to a reduction in the number of users of institutional care and improves living conditions in the community, which is one of the fundamental human rights. In addition to meeting the needs of the target group, this project will greatly contribute to employment growth and strengthening social cohesion and reducing unemployment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta pridonijelo bi se povećanju socijalne uključenosti i prevenciji institucionalizacije starijih i ili nemoćnih osoba te odraslih osoba s invaliditetom osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi i povećanjem njihove kvalitete života. Izrazite disperziranost naselja i udaljenost uz nepostojanje autobusnih linija koje ih povezuju s funkcionalnim dijelom grada, ostavlja ih prepuštene samima sebi. Provedba projekta u konačnici dovodi do smanjenja broja korisnika institucijskog oblika skrbi te poboljšava uvjete života u zajednici što predstavlja jedno do temeljnih ljudskih prava. Osim zadovoljavanja potreba ciljane skupine ovaj projekt uvelike će pridonijeti rastu zapošljavanja i jačanju socijalne kohezije i smanjenju nezaposlenosti.

Operation_Name_English: Innovation of digital relief models to reduce measured gravity acceleration
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inovacija digitalnih modela reljefa za redukciju mjerenog ubrzanja sile teže
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project addresses the problem of the influence of topography on the measured acceleration of gravity. The aim of the project is to develop an innovation process, i.e. to implement high precision digital relief models (DMR) in the gravity acceleration processing algorithm, which will significantly increase the accuracy of measurements and data analysis and processing. Target groups include a wider scientific and expert community, which will benefit from more precise data to analyse geological structures and optimise the use of renewable energy sources. A significant contribution to the development of smart and clean energy is expected.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt adresira problem utjecaja topografije na mjereno ubrzanje sile teže. Cilj projekta je razviti inovacijski proces, odnosno implementirati visoko precizne digitalne modele reljefa (DMR) u algoritam za obradu ubrzanja sile teže, čime će se znatno povećati točnost mjerenja te analiza i obrada podataka. Ciljne skupine uključuju širu znanstvenu i stručnu zajednicu, koja će imati koristi od preciznijih podataka za analizu geoloških struktura i optimizaciju korištenja obnovljivih izvora energije. Očekuje se značajan doprinos razvoju pametne i čiste energije.

Operation_Name_English: Innovation of analytical method for BPO pharmaceuticals
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inovacija analitičke metode za BPO farmaceutske proizvode
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The name of the project is ‘Development of the HPLC method for the determination of BPO and benzene in pharmaceutical products’. With this project, the Applicant wishes to develop and validate a reliable HPLC method for routine determination of benzene in BPO-based pharmaceutical products (benzoyl peroxide), and to commercialise this method to pharmaceutical quality control laboratories. The aim of the project is to develop a fast, sensitive and validated analytical method for simultaneous determination of BPO and benzene in cosmetic products. The applicant will implement the project in cooperation with the Faculty of Chemical Engineering and Technology of the University of Zagreb.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Naziv projekta je „Razvoj HPLC metode za određivanje BPO i benzena u farmaceutskim proizvodima“. Predmetnim projektom Prijavitelj želi razviti i validirati pouzdanu HPLC metodu za rutinsko određivanje benzena u farmaceutskim proizvodima na bazi BPOa (benzoil peroksida), te komercijalizirati navedenu metodu laboratorijima za kontrolu kvalitete farmaceutskih proizvoda. Cilj projekta je razviti brzu, osjetljivu i validiranu analitičku metodu za simultano određivanje BPO i benzena u kozmetičkim proizvodima. Prijavitelj će navedeni projekt provesti u suradnji s Fakultetom kemijskog inženjerstva i tehnologije Sveučilišta u Zagrebu.

Operation_Name_English: Teaching assistants 6
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoćnici u nastavi 6
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The "Teaching Assistants 6" project will contribute to solving the problem of one target group, students with disabilities. The aim of this project is to provide support to students with disabilities for quality inclusion in the regular educational system through the introduction of educated PUN/CPC. The project includes 9 primary schools in the area of the City of Šibenik. The duration of the project is 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Pomoćnici u nastavi 6“ doprinijeti će se rješavanju problema jedne ciljne skupine, učenika s teškoćama u razvoju. Cilj ovog projekta je osigurati podršku učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju za kvalitetno uključivanje u redovni odgojno-obrazovni sustav kroz uvođenje educiranih PUN/SKP. Projektom je obuhvaćeno 9 osnovnih škola na području Grada Šibenika. Trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Wastewater drainage system of the agglomerations of Novi Vinodolski, Crikvenica and Selce
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sustav odvodnje otpadnih voda aglomeracije Novi Vinodolski, Crikvenica i Selce
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project is implemented in the area of Primorje-Gorski Kotar County, in the area of the Towns of Novi Vinodolski and Crikvenica. The project consists of two phases. • Phase 1 of the project includes investment investments within the OPKK 2014-2020 financial period. • Phase 2 of the project covers investment investments within the financial period of the PKK 2021-2027. The second phase concerns the construction of 3,703 m and the reconstruction of 2,291 m of the public drainage network, the construction of 5 and the reconstruction of 4 pumping stations of the public drainage system and the reconstruction of 2,665 m of the public water supply network. UPOV Novi Vinodolski will also be built with a capacity of 12,000 ES and UPOV Crikvenica with a capacity of 31,500 ES, both 2nd degree of purification, a solar sludge drying plant, an underwater discharge and a pumping station.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se provodi na području PGŽ, na području Gradova Novi Vinodolski i Crikvenica. Projekt se sastoji od dvije faze. • 1.faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja OPKK 2014-2020. • 2.faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja PKK 2021-2027. Druga faza se odnosi na izgradnju 3.703 m i rekonstrukciju 2.291 m sustava mreže javne odvodnje, izgradnju 5 i rekonstrukciju 4 crpne stanice sustava javne odvodnje te rekonstrukciju 2.665 m mreže javne vodoopskrbe. Izgradit će se i UPOV Novi Vinodolski kapaciteta 12.000 ES-a te UPOV Crikvenica kapaciteta 31.500 ES-a, oba II. stupnja pročišćavanja, postrojenje za solarno sušenje mulja, podmorski ispust te crpna stanica.

Operation_Name_English: STEM SPAJALICA
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM SPAJALICA
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "STEM Spajalica" aims to strengthen the capacities of the association Spajalica and partner organizations for the implementation of programs in the field of STEM among children and students of primary and secondary education. The project will strengthen cooperation between CSOs, educational institutions and higher education institutions in the popularization of science. By promoting STEM in public places and through various media channels, the project will increase the visibility and attractiveness of STEM areas among young people. Through various educations, exchange of knowledge and experience and various promotional activities, the project will contribute to increasing the number of students enrolling in STEM study programs and increasing their success in the study through the acquisition of additional competences in STEM.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "STEM Spajalica" ima za cilj ojačati kapacitete udruge Spajalica i partnerskih organizacija za provedbu programa u području STEM-a među djecom i učenicima osnovnoškolskog i srednjoškolskog obrazovanja. Projekt će ojačati suradnju između OCD-a, odgojno-obrazovnih institucija i visokih učilišta u popularizaciji znanosti. Promocijom STEM-a na javnim mjestima i putem različitih medijskih kanala, projekt će povećati vidljivost i atraktivnost STEM područja među mladima. Kroz različite edukacije, razmjenu znanja i iskustva te razne promotivne aktivnosti, projekt će pridonijeti povećanju broja učenika koji upisuju STEM studijske programe i povećanju njihovog uspjeha na studiju kroz stjecanje dodatnih kompetencija iz STEM-a.

Operation_Name_English: Social plan of Sisak-Moslavina County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalni plan Sisačko-moslavačke županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The development of the county social plan will have an impact on increasing the availability and equity of social services in the SMC area. With the help of an external expert, the SMŽ will collect data, carry out data analysis and processing, and will draw up a county social plan. Members of the Social Welfare Council and JRS employees will be appointed to participate in trainings for social planning, implementation and monitoring of the county social plan. In order to promote the project, an initial and final conference will be held and promotional materials will be created.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Izradom županijskog socijalnog plana utjecat će se na povećanje dostupnosti i ravnomjernosti socijalnih usluga na području SMŽ. SMŽ će uz pomoć vanjskog stručnjaka prikupiti podatke, provesti analizu i obradu podataka te će izraditi županijski socijalni plan. Imenovat će se članovi Savjeta za socijalnu skrb i djelatnici JRS koji će sudjelovati na edukacijama za socijalno planiranje, provedbu i praćenje županijskog socijalnog plana. U svrhu promocije projekta održat će se početna i završna konferencija te će se izraditi promotivni materijali.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of the international standard ISO/IEC 27001:2022
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje međunarodne norme ISO/IEC 27001:2022
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the introduction and certification of an information security management system according to the international standard ISO 27001 in order to ensure a high level of data and business process security and increase LabSense's competitiveness in the international market. The purpose of the project is to achieve internationally recognized norms and standards in information security management in order to align with best practices for data protection, reduce the risks of cyber threats and increase the trust of international clients. Certification will facilitate access to EU and regional markets, with a particular focus on the pharmaceutical and health sectors.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje i certifikacija sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema međunarodnom standardu ISO 27001 kako bi se osigurala visoka razina sigurnosti podataka i poslovnih procesa te povećala konkurentnost LabSense na međunarodnom tržištu. Svrha projekta je dostizanje međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda u upravljanju informacijskom sigurnošću kako bi se uskladili s najboljim praksama za zaštitu podataka, smanjiti rizike od cyber prijetnji i povećati povjerenje međunarodnih klijenata. Certifikacija će omogućiti lakši pristup tržištima EU i regije, s posebnim naglaskom na farmaceutske i zdravstvene sektore.

Operation_Name_English: Island Hands Help
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Otočke ruke pomoći
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Island Hands of Aid" will increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups in the Municipality of Preko. The quality of life of 48 older people and people with disabilities will be improved through the provision of support and support services in everyday life. The main activity is the employment of 8 service providers who will during 32 months ensure the organization of food, the performance of household chores, the maintenance of personal hygiene and the satisfaction of other daily needs. Once a month, one package of household and basic hygiene supplies will be provided for each member of the target group. The total duration of the project is 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom " Otočke ruke pomoći" povećat će se socijalne uključenosti te će se prevenirati institucionalizacija ranjivih skupina u Općini Preko. Unaprijediti će se kvaliteta života 48 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu. Glavna aktivnost je zapošljavanje 8 pružatelja usluga koji će tijekom 32 mjeseca osigurati organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene i zadovoljenje drugih svakodnevnih potreba. Jednom mjesečno će biti osiguran jedan paket kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština za svakog pripadnika ciljane skupine. Ukupno trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: STEM(AJMO!)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM(AJMO!)
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The STEM(AJMO!) project aims to empower associations and institutions to implement interdisciplinary STEM activities. Children and students show a high level of motivation and engagement when the activities in which they participate are gay, have a competitive or collaborative character, and have an application to the real world. Therefore, with the support of higher education institutions, we will strengthen our capacities and the capacities of educational institutions in the production of such content, and by implementing 150 workshops and 12 events, we will promote STEM among children and students.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt STEM(AJMO!) ima za cilj osnažiti udruge i ustanove za provedbu interdisciplinarnih STEM aktivnosti. Djeca i učenici pokazuju visoku razinu motivacije i angažiranosti kada su aktivnosti u kojima sudjeluju gejmificirane, imaju natjecateljski ili kolaborativni karakter, i imaju primjenu na stvarni svijet. Stoga ćemo uz podršku visokoobrazovnih ustanova ojačati svoje kapacitete i kapacitete odgojno-obrazovnih ustanova u produkciji takvih sadržaja, te provedbom 150 radionica i 12 manifestacija promovirati STEM među djecom i učenicima.

Operation_Name_English: The Power of Good for the Elderly and the Infirm
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Snagom dobra za starije i nemoćne
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective of the project: increasing social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization by providing support and support services in everyday life for 132 persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities from the area of Garad Valpovo and Belišće, the municipalities of Bizovac and Petrijevci. In order to achieve the objective of the project, a mandatory support and support service in everyday life will be implemented for 132 older people and persons with disabilities during the 32 months within which the activities will be carried out: Recruitment of 22 service providers for at least 6 members of the target group, monitoring and control of services performed, procurement and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta: povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 132 osobe starije od 65 godina i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom s područja garada Valpova i Belišća, općine Bizovac i Petrijevci. Kako bi se ostvario cilj projekta provest će se obavezna aktivnost pružanja usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 132 starije osobe i osobe s invaliditetom tijekom 32 mjeseca u okviru koje se provede aktivnosti: zapošljavanja 22 pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: St. Philip and St. James
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI - Sveti Filip i Jakov
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The reason for the high degree of institutionalization is the lack of individual services, programs and activities aimed at the social inclusion of older people and people with disabilities. The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care, daily assistance and support. The project will employ 20 service providers for at least 120 older people (65 years and over) and people with disabilities. The support and support activity with the procurement and distribution of the supplies package includes: Recruitment, monitoring and control of services performed, procurement and division of packages, communication and visibility, management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Uzrok visokog stupnja institucionalizacije je nedostatak pojedinih usluga, programa i aktivnosti usmjerenih na socijalno uključivanje starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom. Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi, svakodnevne pomoći i podrške. Projektom će se zaposliti 20 pružatelja usluge za minimalno 120 starijih osoba (65 godina i više) i osoba s invaliditetom. Aktivnost potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština uključuje: zapošljavanje, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, nabavu i podjelu paketa, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Together we can do more! – Phase IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno možemo više! – faza IV.
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project envisions the employment of 30 women who will provide assistance and support in the house for 210 vulnerable people over 33 months. The project lasts 36 months, of which 3 months will be for preparatory and final activities. The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities, which will be achieved by carrying out these project activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom predviđeno zapošljavanje 30 žena koje će kroz 33 mjeseca pružati uslugu pomoći i podrške u kući za 210 ranjivih osoba. Projekt traje 36 mjeseci od čega će 3 mjeseca biti za pripremne i završne aktivnosti. Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i preveniranje institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom koji će se ostvariti provođenjem navedenih projektnih aktivnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Cycling routes of the City of Osijek - 2021-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Biciklističke staze Grada Osijeka - 2021.-2027.
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project of the Bicycle Trail of the City of Osijek envisages the construction of 3 pj.-bic. trails and 1st bic. trails in the city of Osijek and related infrastructure intended for the use of environmentally friendly means of transport and better transport connections within the Urban agglomeration of Osijek on 4 sections: pj.-bic. trail through Višnjevac and Josipovac village, pj.-bic. trail along Matije Gupca Street and Vukovarska Street, bull. trail in Huttlerova Street and pj.-bic. trail in Osječka Street and Svete Ana Street in Tenja village, total length 9,121m. The construction of cycling and related infrastructure also creates conditions for the uniform development of LGUs and the availability of cycling infrastructure throughout the Osijek Urban Agglomeration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Biciklističke staze Grada Osijeka predviđena je izgradnja 3 pj.-bic. staze i 1. bic. staze u gradu Osijeku i s njima povezane infrastrukture namijenjene korištenju ekološki prihvatljivih sredstava prijevoza i boljoj prometnoj povezanosti unutar Urbane aglomeracije Osijek na 4 dionice: pj.-bic. staza kroz naselje Višnjevac i Josipovac, pj.-bic. staza duž Ulice Matije Gupca i Vukovarske ulice, bic. staza u Huttlerovoj ulici te pj.-bic. staza u Osječkoj ulici i Ulici Svete Ane u naselju Tenja, ukupne dužine 9.121m. Izgradnjom biciklističke i srodne infrastrukture stvaraju se i uvjeti za ujednačen razvoj JLS-ova i dostupnost biciklističke infrastrukture u cijeloj Urbanoj aglomeraciji Osijek.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of PEDOM ASFALTTI d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva PEDOM ASFALTI d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project covers the certification activity of 29 road asphalt products and is implemented with the aim of increasing international market competitiveness and facilitating access to new applicant markets. Activities include the process of drafting technical documentation of product testing, analysis of compliance with standards, and certification by authorized bodies. The aim of the project is to confirm the quality and safety of the product, enable wider application and strengthen the market position of the applicant. The results include increased visibility of certified products, market share growth and strengthening the innovation capacity and commercial viability of the business. Implementation contributes to the realisation of the smart specialisation strategy and adaptation to the requirements of sustainable development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća aktivnost certificiranja 29 proizvoda cestovnog asfalta i provodi se s ciljem povećanja međunarodne tržišne konkurentnosti i olakšanja pristupa novim tržištima prijavitelja. Aktivnosti uključuju proces izrade tehničke dokumentacije ispitivanja proizvoda, analizu sukladnosti sa standardima, te certificiranje kod ovlaštenih tijela. Cilj projekta je potvrditi kvalitetu i sigurnost proizvoda, omogućiti širu primjenu i osnažiti tržišnu poziciju prijavitelja. Rezultati uključuju povećanu vidljivost certificiranih proizvoda, rast tržišnog udjela te jačanje inovacijskog kapaciteta i komercijalne održivosti poslovanja. Provedba doprinosi ostvarivanju strategije pametne specijalizacije i prilagodbi zahtjevima održivog razvoja.

Operation_Name_English: Assistance packages for Northern Croatia
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Paketi pomoći za sjevernu Hrvatsku
Category_Label: Addressing material deprivation through food and/or material assistance to the most deprived, including accompanying measures
Operation_Summary_English: Through the implementation of the project ‘Assistance packages for northern Croatia’ in five counties in northern Croatia, the Koprivnica Red Cross City Society, in partnership with 21 Red Cross City Societies, will actively address the material deprivation of beneficiaries by providing continuous assistance in the form of food and basic material assistance, as well as accompanying measures aimed at supporting people at the highest risk of poverty and social exclusion, which will significantly increase the level of their social exclusion and poverty over three years.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta „Paketi pomoći za sjevernu Hrvatsku“ na području pet županija sjeverne Hrvatske Gradsko društvo Crvenog križa Koprivnica, u partnerstvu s 21 gradskim društvom Crvenog križa, aktivno će djelovati na suzbijanju materijalne oskudice korisnika pružanjem kontinuirane pomoći u obliku hrane i osnovne materijalne pomoći, kao i popratnih mjera usmjerenih na podršku osobama suočenim s najvećim rizikom od siromaštva i socijalne isključenosti čime ćemo kroz tri godine značajno povećati razinu njihove socijalne isključenosti i siromaštva.

Operation_Name_English: For the life I want - Want 4 in the municipality of Gorjani
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Za život kakav želim - Zaželi 4 u općini Gorjani
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups from the territory of the municipality through the provision of long-term care. This will be achieved by providing support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina s područja općine kroz osiguravanje dugotrajne skrbi. Navedeno će se postići pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom.

Operation_Name_English: Society of Equal Opportunities
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Društvo jednakih mogućnosti
Category_Label: Addressing material deprivation through food and/or material assistance to the most deprived, including accompanying measures
Operation_Summary_English: The procurement and continued distribution of food and material assistance packages to people in or at risk of poverty and social exclusion will contribute to addressing the material deprivation of vulnerable groups, while accompanying measures will contribute to their empowerment and social inclusion. Collected food donations will ensure the inclusion in the project of a larger number of people in need, and implemented campaigns will raise awareness of the importance of donating and preventing food waste. The project will cover a minimum of 10,593 persons receiving guaranteed minimum benefits and national benefits, as well as pensioners and persons below the at-risk-of-poverty threshold in the NUTS 2 region of Pannonian Croatia.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Nabavom i kontinuiranom podjelom paketa hrane i materijalne pomoći osobama u siromaštvu ili riziku od siromaštva i socijalne isključenosti doprinijet će se suzbijanju materijalne oskudice ranjivih skupina, dok će se pružanjem popratnih mjera pridonijeti njihovom osnaživanju i socijalnoj uključenosti. Prikupljenim donacijama u hrani osigurat će se uključivanje u projekt većeg broja osoba u potrebi, a provedenim kampanjama podići svijest o važnosti doniranja i sprječavanja bacanja hrane. Projekt će obuhvatiti minimalno 10.593 osoba primatelja zajamčene minimalne naknade i nacionalne naknade te umirovljenike i osobe ispod praga rizika od siromaštva na području NUTS 2 Regije Panonska Hrvatska.

Operation_Name_English: SMALT IT - Management System Certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SMALT IT - certifikacija sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to increase the competitiveness of SMALT IT through the implementation of the ISO 27001 standard. The issue of uncertified management system will be solved by aligning business processes with the standard for information security management, which will ensure greater data protection, business resilience and customer trust. The project will provide greater service security and improve the perception of reliability among existing and new clients. The goal is to attract new customers, increase revenues and exports and improve business processes in the long term, which will strengthen the Company's market position and competitive advantage. The implementation of the project will have a positive impact on SMALT IT, its employees and clients, who will receive safer and more reliable digital services.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je povećati konkurentnost društva SMALT IT kroz implementaciju norme ISO 27001. Problem necertificiranog sustava upravljanja riješit će se usklađivanjem poslovnih procesa s normom za upravljanje informacijskom sigurnošću, čime će se osigurati veća zaštita podataka, otpornost poslovanja i povjerenje klijenata. Projekt će omogućiti veću sigurnost usluga te poboljšati percepciju pouzdanosti kod postojećih i novih klijenata. Cilj je privući nove kupce, povećati prihode i izvoz te dugoročno unaprijediti poslovne procese, čime će Društvo ojačati tržišnu poziciju i konkurentsku prednost. Provedba projekta imat će pozitivan utjecaj na SMALT IT, njegove zaposlenike te klijente, koji će dobiti sigurnije i pouzdanije digitalne usluge.

Operation_Name_English: Strategic partnership for research and development of smart products and services to increase the efficiency of production, operation and use of resources through the use of advanced digital technologies - GrafIT
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strateško partnerstvo za istraživanje i razvoj pametnih proizvoda i usluga za povećanje učinkovitosti proizvodnje, rada i korištenja resursa upotrebom naprednih digitalnih tehnologija - GrafIT
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to research and develop more innovative smart products and services to increase the efficiency of production, operation and use of high value-added resources based on advanced KET and digital technologies. By establishing a strategic innovation partnership and launching this research and development project in the regional value chains of smart industry and green growth of Northern Croatia, the goal is to contribute to the transformation of manufacturing industries towards smart, connected and sustainable production and demonstrate an innovative production management model for Industries 4.0 and 5.0, as well as to develop high value-added products and services and contribute to solving key social challenges of the region of Northern Croatia.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je istraživanje i razvoj više inovativnih pametnih proizvoda i usluga za povećanje učinkovitosti proizvodnje, rada i korištenja resursa visoke dodane vrijednosti baziranih na naprednim KET i digitalnim tehnologijama. Uspostavom strateškog partnerstva za inovacije i pokretanjem ovog istraživačko-razvojnog projekta u regionalnim lancima vrijednosti pametne industrije i zelenog rasta Sjeverne Hrvatske cilj je doprinijeti transformaciji proizvodnih industrija prema pametnoj, povezanoj i održivoj proizvodnji te demonstrirati inovativan model upravljanja proizvodnjom za Industrije 4.0 i 5.0., kao i razviti proizvode i usluge visoke dodane vrijednosti i doprinijeti rješavanju ključnih društvenih izazova regije Sjeverne Hrvatske.

Operation_Name_English: A balanced society
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uravnoteženo društvo
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services for the daily life of the elderly and persons with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični je cilj pružanje usluge potpore i podrške svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom.

Operation_Name_English: Product testing DN GEO
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ispitivanje proizvoda DN GEO
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project of the company DN INŽENJERING d.o.o. solves the technical and market problem of the lack of a compact, autonomous and certified displacement monitoring device in construction pits and infrastructure facilities. The aim of the project is to test the sensor for the DN-GEO geo-monitoring device in an accredited laboratory in order to confirm its electromagnetic compatibility and safety and ensure its market readiness. The project will result in an innovative Croatian product ready for commercialization. Target groups include DN INŽENJERING, its employees, engineering and construction companies, designers, contractors and end-users – infrastructure and civil protection system managers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt društva DN INŽENJERING d.o.o. rješava tehnički i tržišni problem nedostatka kompaktnog, autonomnog i certificiranog uređaja za nadzor pomaka u građevinskim jamama i infrastrukturnim objektima. Cilj projekta je ispitati senzor za geo-monitoring uređaj DN-GEO u akreditiranom laboratoriju kako bi se potvrdila njegova elektromagnetska kompatibilnost i sigurnost te osigurala njegova tržišna spremnost. Projekt će rezultirati inovativnim hrvatskim proizvodom spremnim za komercijalizaciju. Ciljne skupine uključuju poduzeće DN INŽENJERING, njegove zaposlenike, inženjerske i građevinske tvrtke, projektante, izvođače radova te krajnje korisnike – upravitelje infrastrukture i sustava civilne zaštite.

Operation_Name_English: COLLECTION AND NETWORKING TO COLLECTION CONTRACTS - COURT
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ŠKOLOVANJEM I UMREŽAVANJEM DO KOLEKTIVNIH UGOVORA - SUDOKU
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: Through planned trainings, we will educate our and partner employees, trade union commissioners and members about trade union activity in the current conditions, and in parallel we will receive feedback on the needs of workers in their companies. In this way, we will strengthen our and their capacity to collectively bargain and improve legislation. Creating a digital member base will make it easier to communicate and work with membership. The capacities will be further strengthened through participation in global trade union trainings and study trips. In addition to joint cooperation, we will work on networking through the organization of conferences, round tables, etc. on relevant topics, and we will expand our knowledge and experience by making educational video films.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Kroz planirane edukacije obrazovat ćemo naše i partnerske zaposlenike, sindikalne povjerenike i članove o sindikalnom djelovanju u trenutnim uvjetima, a paralelno ćemo dobivati povratne informacije o potrebama radnika u njihovim firmama. Na taj način jačat ćemo naše i njihove kapacitete za kolektivno pregovaranje i unapređenje zakonodavstva. Izrada digitalne baze članova omogućit će lakšu komunikaciju i rad s članstvom. Kapaciteti će biti dodatno ojačani sudjelovanjem na edukacijama globalnih sindikalnih središnjica i studijskim putovanjima. Osim kroz zajedničku suradnju, radit ćemo na umrežavanju kroz organiziranje konferencija, okruglih stolova i sl. o relevantnim temama, a znanje i iskustvo širit ćemo izradom edukativnih video filmova.

Operation_Name_English: Further implementation of curricular reform of vocational education
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Daljnja provedba kurikularne reforme strukovnog obrazovanja
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective is to continue the process of vocational education and training reform, which is attractive, innovative, relevant, labour market-related and will enable learners to acquire competences for personal and professional development, as well as continuing education and lifelong learning. The specific objective is to support all VET system stakeholders to introduce, implement and revise curricular documents.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj je nastaviti proces reforme strukovnog obrazovanja i osposobljavanja koje je privlačno, inovativno, relevantno, povezano s tržištem rada te koje će omogućiti polaznicima stjecanje kompetencija za osobni i profesionalni razvoj te nastavak obrazovanja i cjeloživotno učenje. Specifični cilj usmjeren je na pružanje podrške svim dionicima sustava strukovnog obrazovanja i osposobljavanja za uvođenje, provedbu i reviziju kurikulumskih dokumenata.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of the Strahinjčica cycle path in the Municipality of Jesenje, (Art. 4663; k.o. Autumn)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističke staze Strahinjčica u Općini Jesenje, (k.č. 4663; k.o. Jesenje)
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project task includes the construction of the Strahinjčica cycling trail in the Municipality of Jesenje, which is also a specific objective of the project, which will encourage public use and integrate sustainable forms of transport in the Urban Area of Krapina in the Municipality of Jesenje. While the overall goal through the construction of a bicycle path in the Municipality of Jesenje is to connect important social and cultural points in the Urban area of Krapina to promote sustainable mobility and accessibility. The result of the project will be the construction of 1,542 meters of cycling track, which will be used by an estimated 250 users per year.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni zadatak uključuje izgradnju biciklističke staze Strahinjčica u Općini Jesenje što je ujedno i specifični cilj projekta čime će se potaknuti javnu uporabu i integrirati održive oblike prijevoza na Urbanom području Krapina u Općini Jesenje. Dok je opći cilj kroz izgradnju biciklističke staze u Općini Jesenje povezati važne društvene i kulturne točke na Urbanom području Krapina promicati održivu mobilnost i dostupnost. Rezultat projekta će biti izgrađeno 1.542 metra biciklističke staze koju će prema procjenama godišnje upotrebljavati oko 250 korisnika.

Operation_Name_English: Caring for your neighbors 3
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Briga za bližnje 3
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups and to foster their social integration. The specific objective is to provide daily support to the elderly and people with disabilities. The goal will be achieved by employing 8 service providers who will perform household chores, personal hygiene and other needs for 30 months, and 6 months are preparatory and final actions. Activities include the supervision of the services provided, the procurement and distribution of household and hygiene kits, and project management and communication to ensure the quality and visibility of the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je spriječiti institucionalizaciju ranjivih skupina i poticati njihovu socijalnu integraciju. Konkretni cilj je pružiti svakodnevnu podršku starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Cilj će se ostvariti zapošljavanjem 8 pružatelja usluga koji će obavljati kućanske poslove, osobnu higijenu i druge potrebe kroz 30 mjeseci, a 6 mjeseci su pripremne i završne radnje. Aktivnosti uključuju nadzor nad pruženim uslugama, nabavu i distribuciju paketa kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština te upravljanje projektom i komunikaciju kako bi se osigurala kvaliteta i prepoznatljivost projekta.

Operation_Name_English: "Providing assistants to students with disabilities in the elementary school of the City of Čakovec - VIII"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Osiguravanje pomoćnika učenicima s teškoćama u OŠ Grada Čakovca - VIII"
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to employ 49 unemployed persons as PUN/CPC and to provide better integration into the regular classroom of a total of 59 students with developmental disabilities through the introduction programme. This will ensure equal participation of students with disabilities in accordance with their abilities in the regular educational process. During the implementation of the project, a mandatory activity will be implemented: Supporting the education of pupils with disabilities through the work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators: selection of candidates for employment in accordance with the applicable Rules, the programme of introduction into the work of PUN, the work of PUN/CPC with students with developmental difficulties, communication and visibility and project management.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je 49 nezaposlenih osoba zaposliti kao PUN/SKP te kroz program uvođenja u rad pružiti kvalitetniju integraciju u redovni razredni odjel ukupno 59 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju. Time ćemo osigurati ravnopravno sudjelovanje učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u skladu s njihovim mogućnostima u redovnom odgojno-obrazovnom procesu. Tijekom provedbe projekta provodit će se obvezna aktivnost Pružanja potpore obrazovanju učenika u s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika: selekcije kandidata za zapošljavanje sukladno važećem Pravilniku, program uvođenja u rad PUN, rad PUN/SKP s učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju, komunikacija i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of ISO 27001 in Agenor automatika d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje ISO 27001 u poduzeće Agenor automatika d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: To the applicant, the project of introducing the ISO 27001 standard ensures a top level of information security, protecting sensitive data and critical business processes. By implementing rigorous security measures, the Reporter not only reduces the risks of cyber threats, but also increases the trust of clients and partners. This transformation significantly strengthens the applicant's competitiveness on the domestic and foreign markets, positioning it as a reliable and secure partner that offers secure technological solutions. In addition, the project includes energy-efficient technologies and remote access, which further increases operational efficiency and sustainability.
