This makes the applicant a key player in providing innovative and secure solutions, opening up new market opportunities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavitelju projekt uvođenja ISO 27001 standarda osigurava vrhunsku razinu sigurnosti informacija, štiteći osjetljive podatke i kritične poslovne procese. Implementacijom rigoroznih sigurnosnih mjera, Prijavitelj ne samo što smanjuje rizike od cyber prijetnji, već i povećava povjerenje klijenata i partnera. Ova transformacija značajno jača konkurentnost Prijavitelja na domaćem i stranom tržištu, pozicionirajući je kao pouzdanog i sigurnog partnera koji nudi sigurna tehnološka rješenja. Uz to, projekt uključuje energetski učinkovite tehnologije i daljinski pristup, čime se dodatno povećava operativna efikasnost i održivost. Time Prijavitelj postaje ključni igrač u pružanju inovativnih i sigurnih rješenja, otvarajući nove tržišne prilike.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of the management system of the company SMD Micro elektronika d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranje sustava upravljanja poduzeća SMD Micro elektronika d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of Applicants through certification according to ISO 14001:2015, ensuring compliance with global environmental standards and facilitating access to foreign markets. The purpose of the project is to optimize business processes by introducing an environmental management system, which will improve environmental efficiency, reduce operating costs and increase the attractiveness of the company as a supplier in regulated industries. Expected results include obtaining ISO 14001:2015 certification, increasing market recognition, strengthening exports and long-term business sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost Prijavitelja kroz certifikaciju prema ISO 14001:2015, osiguravajući usklađenost s globalnim ekološkim standardima i olakšavajući pristup inozemnim tržištima. Svrha projekta je optimizacija poslovnih procesa uvođenjem sustava upravljanja okolišem, čime će se poboljšati ekološka učinkovitost, smanjiti operativni troškovi i povećati atraktivnost tvrtke kao dobavljača u reguliranim industrijama. Očekivani rezultati uključuju stjecanje certifikata ISO 14001:2015, povećanje tržišne prepoznatljivosti, jačanje izvoza i dugoročnu održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: FAUST - Fpv Academy in SpliT
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: FAUST- Fpv Akademija U SpliTu
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the FAUST project is to strengthen the capacity of the association to promote STEM among children and students through cooperation with the Department of Information Sciences FFOS, CARNET and several educational institutions operating in the Split-Dalmatia County. The project will in two years raise the competencies of 10 employees and volunteers of the Association who will transfer their enthusiasm to a large number of students in SDŽ through the maintenance of designed continuous workshops with a pre-developed program in one relatively new segment of STEM - the application of drones in the function of smart agriculture, ecology, safety, tourism and e-sports. The project will also result in the creation of the first Croatian school FPV drone league in which the partner schools will be involved as a pilot.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta FAUST jest jačanje kapaciteta udruge u promociji STEM-a među djecom i učenicima kroz suradnju s Odjelom za informacijske znanosti FFOS, CARNET-om te više odgojno-obrazovnih institucija koje djeluju na području Splitsko-dalmatinske županije. Projektom će se kroz dvije godine podići kompetencije 10 djelatnika i volontera Udruge koji će svoj entuzijazam prenijeti na veliki broj učenika u SDŽ kroz održavanje osmišljenih kontinuiranih radionica s unaprijed razrađenim programom u jednom relativno novom segmentu STEM-a – primjeni dronova u funkciji pametne poljoprivrede, ekologije, sigurnosti, turizma i e- sporta. Projekt će rezultirati i stvaranjem prve hrvatske školske FPV dron lige u koju će se kao pilot uključiti škole partneri.

Operation_Name_English: SPACE STEM - Space TEchnology towards innovative education
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SPACE STEM - Svemirskim TEhnologijaMa prema inovativnom obrazovanju
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "SPACE STEM" will strengthen the capacities of civil society organizations in the Split-Dalmatia County with the aim of implementing systematic and continuous popularization and promotion of GIS and remote sensing among primary school students, through cooperation with higher education institutions and educational institutions. The popularization and promotion of GIS and remote sensing among primary school students will be carried out continuously over three years through educational workshops and through the organization of SPACE STEM exhibitions in public places in order to motivate children and students from Split-Dalmatia County to develop careers in the geoinformatics economic sector.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "SPACE STEM" ojačat će se kapaciteti organizacija civilnog društva na području Splitsko-dalmatinske županije s ciljem provedbe sustavne i kontinuirane popularizacije i promocije GIS-a i daljinskih istraživanja među učenicima osnovnih škola, kroz suradnju s visokim učilištima i odgojno-obrazovnim institucijama. Popularizacija i promocija GIS-a i daljinskih istraživanja među učenicima osnovnih škola provodit će se kontinuirano tijekom tri godine kroz edukativne radionice i kroz organizaciju SPACE STEM postava na javnim mjestima kako bi se motiviralo djecu i učenike iz Splitsko-dalmatinske županije za razvojem karijera u geoinformatičkom gospodarskom sektoru.

Operation_Name_English: Social plan of Bjelovar-Bilogora County for the period 2024-2026
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalni plan Bjelovarsko - bilogorske županije za razdoblje 2024.-2026.
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The preparation of the county social plan aims to contribute to increasing the availability and balanced regional development of social services in the Republic of Croatia. The purpose of drawing up the social plan is to plan the network for the development of social services in the area of BBŽ. Through education, experts in social planning, implementation and monitoring of county social plans will be strengthened. The project will provide support to the capacity and knowledge development of county employees and members of the social welfare council.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Izrada županijskog socijalnog plana ima za cilj doprinijeti povećanju dostupnosti i ravnomjernom regionalnom razvoju socijalnih usluga u RH. Svrha izrade socijalnog plana je planiranje mreže razvoja socijalnih usluga na području BBŽ. Kroz edukacije osnažit će se stručnjaci za socijalno planiranje, provedbu i praćenje županijskih socijalnih planova. Projektom će se pružiti potpora razvoju kapaciteta i znanja zaposlenika županije i članova savjeta za socijalnu skrb.

Operation_Name_English: "Rest you deserve it"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Odmori se zaslužuješ to"
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: Providing innovative social service rest from care to people caring for a household member who is dependent on their support.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Pružanje inovativne socijalne usluge odmor od skrbi osobama koje skrbe o članu kućanstva koji je ovisan o njihovoj podršci.

Operation_Name_English: Drainage and wastewater treatment system of the Varaždin agglomeration - PHASE II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sustav odvodnje i pročišćavanja otpadnih voda aglomeracije Varaždin - FAZA II
Category_Label: Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the project ‘System of sewage and waste water treatment of the Agglomeration of Varaždin’ is to comply with the Water Framework Directive (2000/60/EC) and the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive (91/271/EEC) for the purpose of achieving and preserving good water status in order to protect human life and health, protect their property, protect water and water-dependent ecosystems. The project is implemented through two phases: Phase 1 of the project included investment investments within the OPKK 2014-2020 financial period. Phase 2 of the project covers investment investments within the financial period of the PKK 2021-2027.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj Projekta „Sustav odvodnje i pročišćavanja otpadnih voda Aglomeracije Varaždin“ je usklađivanje s Okvirnom direktivom o vodama (2000/60/EC) i Direktivom o pročišćavanju komunalnih otpadnih voda (91/271/EEZ) u svrhu postizanja i očuvanje dobrog stanja voda radi zaštite života i zdravlja ljudi, zaštite njihove imovine, zaštite vodnih i o vodi ovisnih ekosustava. Projekt se realizira kroz dvije faze: 1. faza projekta obuhvaćala je investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja OPKK 2014-2020. 2. faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja PKK 2021-2027.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the Capacities of the Police Union of Croatia and Partners
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje kapaciteta Sindikata policije Hrvatske i partnera
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Strengthening the Capacities of the Police Union of Croatia and Partners" will strengthen the capacities of the social partners, the Police Union of Croatia as Applicant and the Professional Firefighters Union of Split as Partner, to operate in the labour market through: 1. Training of social partner employees by organising and participating in a series of educational programmes that will enable participants to acquire new knowledge and skills in relevant topics 2. Networking of social partners through the organisation and implementation of study trips and participation in congresses and round table 3. Development of new services and/or improvement of existing ones intended for members of the social partners through the development and improvement of software
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Jačanje kapaciteta Sindikata policije Hrvatske i partnera“ ojačat će se kapaciteti socijalnih partnera, Sindikata policije Hrvatske kao Prijavitelja i Sindikata profesionalnih vatrogasaca Split kao Partnera, za djelovanje na tržištu rada kroz: 1. Osposobljavanje zaposlenika socijalnih partnera organizacijom i sudjelovanjem u nizu edukativnih programa koji će sudionicima omogućiti stjecanje novih znanja i vještina u relevantnim temama 2. Umrežavanje socijalnih partnera organizacijom i provedbom studijskih putovanja te sudjelovanje na kongresima i okruglom stolu 3. Razvoj novih usluga i/ili unaprjeđenje postojećih namijenjenih članovima socijalnih partnera izradom i unapređenjem softvera

Operation_Name_English: The best is yet to come
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Najbolje tek dolazi
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. Project activities include: the provision of support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and persons with disabilities, with the procurement and distribution of a package of necessities that includes: Recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group, monitoring and control of services performed, procurement and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnosti projekta uključuju: pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje: zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of the port open to public traffic Ubli, island of Lastovo – Phase II of the project
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija luke otvorene za javni promet Ubli, otok Lastovo – II. faza projekta
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the project ‘Reconstruction of a port open to public traffic in Ubli, the island of Lastovo’ is to expand and increase capacity in the port of Ubli, increase maritime traffic safety and improve the connectivity of the island of Lastovo with the mainland and the surrounding islands. The implementation of the project has a positive impact on improving the accessibility of the island of Lastovo for its inhabitants. The total value of the project is EUR 7,862,601.32, of which the eligible costs are EUR 7,838,727.80. The total value of the project in phase II is EUR 6,03,794.72, where the total amount relates to the eligible costs. The estimated duration of the project in phase II is 22 months, from 01/01/2024 to 31/10/2025.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta „Rekonstrukcija luke otvorene za javni promet Ubli, otok Lastovo“ je proširenje i povećanje kapaciteta u luci Ubli, povećanje sigurnosti pomorskog prometa te bolja povezanost otoka Lastova s kopnom i okolnim otocima. Provedba projekta pozitivno utječe na poboljšanje dostupnosti otoka Lastova za njegove stanovnike. Ukupna vrijednost projekta je 7.862.601,32 EUR, od čega su prihvatljivi troškovi u iznosu od 7.838.727,80 EUR. Ukupna vrijednost projekta u II fazi je 6.003.794,72 EUR, gdje se cjelokupan iznos odnosi na prihvatljive troškove. Predviđeno trajanje projekta u II fazi je 22 mjeseca, od 01.01.2024. do 31.10.2025.

Operation_Name_English: Research and development of innovative laboratory methods for detection of N-nitrosamines in meat products: INSPECTO NitroSAFE
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Istraživanje i razvoj inovativnih laboratorijskih metoda za detekciju N-nitrozamina u mesnim proizvodima: INSPECTO NitroSAFE
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the Inspecto NitroSAFE project is to exchange knowledge and technologies and implement research and development activities, to develop an internationally innovative nitrozimine analysis service for monitoring food quality and safety, and to develop new recipes and methods of processing meat durable and semi-durable products as products of higher added value of the industrial partners of Pannonian Croatia with international potential and reach of commercialization. The general objective and significance of the project at a higher level is to contribute to strengthening the regional economy of Pannonian Croatia and addressing key societal challenges and thematic objectives in accordance with the S3 thematic priority area Sustainable and Circular Food.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SVRHA PROJEKTA Inspecto NitroSAFE je razmjenom znanja i tehnologija i provedbom istraživačko razvojnih aktivnosti, razviti međunarodno inovativnu uslugu analize nitrozimina za praćenje kvalitete i sigurnosti hrane te razviti nove recepture i metode prerade mesnih trajnih i polutrajnih proizvoda kao proizvoda više dodane vrijednosti industrijskih partnera Panonske Hrvatske s međunarodnim potencijalom i dosegom komercijalizacije. OPĆI CILJ i značaj projekta na višoj razini je doprinos jačanju regionalnog gospodarstva Panonske Hrvatske i rješavanju ključnih društvenih izazova i tematskih ciljeva sukladno S3 tematskom prioritetnom području Održiva i kružna hrana.

Operation_Name_English: The key to success in tourism
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Čovjek je ključ uspjeha u turizmu
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The conditions of work and business in tourism in recent years are marked by a pronounced shortage of workers. Although foreign workers already make up more than 40% of all employees, lack of knowledge of languages and a low level of qualifications cannot fully solve this problem. As a result, the workload of domestic workers, who have to take on more responsible jobs, is also increasing, as well as seconding and mentoring foreign workers. The project will enhance STUH's capacity for dialogue by addressing precisely these issues, including the ability to organise trade unions and protect the rights of foreign workers, to support members in vocational training, and to modernise and digitalise trade union communications and services.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Uvjete rada i poslovanja u turizmu posljednjih godina obilježava izraziti nedostatak radnika. Iako strani radnici već čine više od 40% svih zaposlenih, uslijed nepoznavanja jezika i niske razine kvalifikacija ne mogu u potpunosti riješiti taj problem. Posljedično raste i radno opterećenje domaćih radnika, koji moraju preuzeti odgovornije poslove, te pritom upućivati u posao i mentorirati strane radnike. Projekt će unaprijediti kapacitete STUH-a za dijalog adresirajući upravo ova pitanja, uključujući sposobnost sindikalnog organiziranja i zaštite prava stranih radnika, pružanje podrške članovima u strukovnom osposobljavanju, te modernizaciju i digitalizaciju sindikalnih komunikacija i usluga.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of quality and information security management system in Inpro d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Implementacija sustava upravljanja kvalitetom i informacijskom sigurnošću u Inpro d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of Inpro d.o.o. by certifying the management system according to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022. The purpose is to standardise business processes and establish an information security management system to ensure consistent service quality, data protection and compliance with international standards. Expected results include increased customer confidence, easier access to foreign markets and increased export revenues. Certification will enable Inpro d.o.o. process optimization, risk reduction and positioning as a reliable and safe partner in the global market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti Inpro d.o.o. certifikacijom sustava upravljanja prema ISO 9001:2015 i ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Svrha je standardizacija poslovnih procesa i uspostava sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću kako bi se osigurala dosljedna kvaliteta usluga, zaštita podataka i usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje povjerenja klijenata, olakšan pristup inozemnim tržištima i rast prihoda od izvoza. Certifikacija će omogućiti Inpro d.o.o. optimizaciju procesa, smanjenje rizika te pozicioniranje kao pouzdanog i sigurnog partnera na globalnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: InnovativeRobotSistemNovotexBOTDSA
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: InovativniRobotskiSistemNovotexBOTDSA
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The InnovativeRobotSistemNovotexBOTDSA project solves the problem of inefficient palletization and depalletization in industrial companies, increasing productivity and reducing labor costs. The aim of the project is to develop an advanced robotic system for automation of these processes, which will use innovative technologies such as digital twin and optimization of the ferry industry. Target groups include industrial companies that regularly receive goods on pallets with packages under 18 kg, production managers and machine operators. The project will improve production efficiency, enable faster adaptation to changes and reduce the need for specialized technical knowledge.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt InovativniRobotskiSistemNovotexBOTDSA rješava problem neučinkovite paletizacije i depaletizacije u industrijskim tvrtkama, povećavajući produktivnost i smanjujući troškove rada. Cilj projekta je razviti napredni robotski sustav za automatizaciju ovih procesa, koji će koristiti inovativne tehnologije poput digitalnog blizanca i optimizacije trajektorije. Ciljne skupine uključuju industrijske tvrtke koje redovito primaju robu na paletama s paketima ispod 18 kg, proizvodne menadžere i operatere strojeva. Projekt će poboljšati efikasnost proizvodnje, omogućiti brže prilagodbe promjenama i smanjiti potrebu za specijaliziranim tehničkim znanjem.

Operation_Name_English: SafeStride
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SafeStride
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The central problem that the project aims to address is the impossibility of immediate, precise and reliable monitoring of the biomedical condition of the participants of various military, police, rescue, search, firefighting and similar operations in real time, which consequently results in a lower level of safety of the participants of the operation and a low level of situational awareness of the command staff, which obstructs the adequate management of various missions. The project consortium proposes a research and development project for two innovative products – a smart protective suit designed to detect critical injuries and smart tactical T-shirts designed to monitor the biomedical condition of participants in different missions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Središnji problem koji se predmetnim projektom nastoji adresirati je nemogućnost neposrednog, preciznog i pouzdanog praćenja biomedicinskog stanja sudionika različitih vojnih, policijskih, spasilačkih, potražnih, vatrogasnih i sl. operacija u realnom vremenu, što, posljedično rezultira nižom razinom sigurnosti sudionika operacije te niskom razinom situacijske svjesnosti zapovjednog osoblja, što opstruira adekvatno upravljanje različitim misijama. Projektni konzorcij predlaže projekt istraživanja i razvoja dva inovativna proizvoda – pametnog zaštitnog odijela namijenjenog detekciji kritičnih ozljeda te pametne taktičke majice namijenjene praćenju biomedicinskog stanja sudionika različitih misija.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of LUCIS DUBROVNIK j.d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva LUCIS DUBROVNIK j.d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a V-Label certificate, which ensures the compliance of products with international standards for vegan and cruelty-free products. Certification will facilitate access to foreign markets, increase brand recognition and ensure transparency and product safety for consumers. The purpose of the project is to strengthen the competitiveness of the company through the certification of two space fresheners according to the V-Label standard. This reduces regulatory barriers to exports, opens up possibilities for distribution on international markets and encourages sustainable and environmentally friendly production. Expected results include certification of two products, sales revenue growth and export revenue growth.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje V-Label certifikata čime se osigurava usklađenost proizvoda s međunarodnim standardima za veganske i cruelty-free proizvode. Certifikacija će omogućiti lakši pristup stranim tržištima, povećati prepoznatljivost brenda te osigurati transparentnost i sigurnost proizvoda za potrošače. Svrha projekta je jačanje konkurentnosti poduzeća kroz certificiranje dvaju osvježivača prostora prema V-Label standardu. Time se smanjuju regulatorne prepreke za izvoz, otvaraju se mogućnosti distribucije na međunarodnim tržištima te se potiče održiva i ekološki prihvatljiva proizvodnja. Očekivani rezultati uključuju certifikaciju dva proizvoda, rast prihoda od prodaje i rast prihoda od izvoza.

Operation_Name_English: EcoCube - Certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: EcoCube – Certifikacija
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The EcoCube Eco-island certification project ensures internationally recognised quality and safety standards, allowing access to new markets. Certification confirms the technical and environmental compliance of the product, strengthening the competitiveness of the Applicant. Expected results include increasing sales, participating in international tenders and empowering the brand as a leader in environmental solutions. Compliance with standards and international regulations will enable the expansion to the global market and the long-term sustainability and development of innovative products in the nautical industry.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt certifikacije EcoCube ekološkog otoka osigurava međunarodno priznate standarde kvalitete i sigurnosti, omogućujući pristup novim tržištima. Certifikacija potvrđuje tehničku i ekološku usklađenost proizvoda, jačajući konkurentnost Prijavitelja. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje prodaje, sudjelovanje na međunarodnim natječajima i osnaživanje brenda kao lidera u ekološkim rješenjima. Usklađenost s normama i međunarodnim regulativama omogućit će širenje na globalno tržište te dugoročnu održivost i razvoj inovativnih proizvoda u nautičkoj industriji.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of cycling and hiking trails in the settlements Brodski Stupnik and Stari Slatinik
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističko-pješačkih staza u naseljima Brodski Stupnik i Stari Slatinik
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Construction of bicycle-pedestrian trails in the settlements Brodski Stupnik and Stari Slatinik" aims to build a 3881 m bicycle-pedestrian trail with the possibility of using public bicycles contributing to improved connectivity of rural areas. The project also aims to reduce emissions of harmful substances that affect atmospheric and environmental pollution. Increasing the safety of cyclists, pedestrians and other road users is achieved by building separate bicycle-pedestrian paths and traffic solutions that encourage the coexistence of bicycles, vehicles and pedestrians. The project represents a comprehensive approach to improving rural mobility by encouraging environmentally conscious modes of transport and creating a safer environment for all road users.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Izgradnja biciklističko-pješačkih staza u naseljima Brodski Stupnik i Stari Slatinik" ima za cilj izgradnju 3881 m biciklističko-pješačke staze s mogućnošću korištenja javnih bicikala pridonoseći poboljšanoj povezanosti ruralnih područja. Projekt također ima za cilj smanjenje emisija štetnih tvari koje utječu na zagađenje atmosfere i okoliša. Povećanje sigurnosti biciklista, pješaka i drugih sudionika u prometu postiže se izgradnjom odvojenih biciklističko-pješačkih staza i prometnih rješenja koja potiču suživot bicikala, vozila i pješaka. Projekt predstavlja sveobuhvatan pristup unaprjeđenju ruralne mobilnosti potičući ekološki osviještene načine prijevoza te stvaranje sigurnijeg okruženja za sve sudionike u prometu.

Operation_Name_English: Kutjevo Cultural Centre
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dom kulture Kutjevo
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will renovate and equip the building of public cultural infrastructure at Trg graševine 2, Kutjevo with the aim of increasing accessibility and participation in the cultural life of all citizens, especially members of vulnerable groups and creating preconditions for the development of innovative services in culture. After the renovation, cultural activities will continue to be carried out in the Kutjevo Cultural Centre, services will be provided to vulnerable groups, the number of visitors to the infrastructure will be increased and the spillover effect will be enabled, i.e. the wider impact of the project on the local environment, society and economy through the spillover of concepts, ideas, knowledge and other types of capital. In addition, it will contribute to the principles of sustainable development and other principles.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta obnovit će se i opremiti zgrada javne kulturne infrastrukture na adresi Trg graševine 2, Kutjevo s ciljem povećanja pristupačnosti i sudjelovanja u kulturnom životu svih građana, osobito pripadnika ranjivih skupina i stvaranje preduvjeta za razvoj inovativnih usluga u kulturi. Nakon obnove, u Domu kulture Kutjevo nastavit će se obavljati kulturne djelatnosti, pružat će se usluge za ranjive skupine, povećat će se broj posjetitelja predmetne infrastrukture te će se omogućiti učinak prelijevanja, odnosno posljedično širi utjecaj projekta na lokalnu sredinu, društvo i gospodarstvo kroz prelijevanje koncepta, ideja, znanja i ostalih vrsta kapitala. Dodatno, doprinijet će se načelima održivog razvoja te drugim načelima.

Operation_Name_English: Specialist training of medical doctors in the Department of Emergency Medicine of Međimurje County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Specijalističko usavršavanje doktora medicine u Zavodu za hitnu medicinu Međimurske županije
Category_Label: Measures to improve the accessibility, effectiveness and resilience of healthcare systems (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Specialist training of doctors of medicine in the Institute of Emergency Medicine of Međimurje County’ will enable the specialisation of one doctor in the field of emergency medicine in order to acquire advanced knowledge and skills to provide high-quality assistance. It includes diagnostics, therapeutic procedures and interventions in crisis situations, which increases the efficiency and quality of the Institute's services. The project contributes to professional development of personnel, faster response in emergencies and greater treatment success. In this way, the professional capacities of the Institute for Effective Operation in Complex and Emergency Medical Situations are strengthened. The aim is to improve the quality of care and patient safety and raise the standards of health care in Međimurje County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Specijalističko usavršavanje doktora medicine u Zavodu za hitnu medicinu Međimurske županije“ omogućit će specijalizaciju jednog doktora iz područja hitne medicine radi stjecanja naprednih znanja i vještina za pružanje visokokvalitetne pomoći. Obuhvaća dijagnostiku, terapijske postupke i intervencije u kriznim situacijama, čime se povećava učinkovitost i kvaliteta usluga Zavoda. Projekt doprinosi stručnom razvoju kadra, bržoj reakciji u hitnim slučajevima i većoj uspješnosti liječenja. Na taj način se jačaju stručni kapaciteti Zavoda za učinkovito djelovanje u složenim i hitnim medicinskim situacijama. Cilj je unaprijediti kvalitetu skrbi i sigurnost pacijenata te podići standarde zdravstvene zaštite u Međimurskoj županiji.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading of the district kindergarten CVITAK in Raštane Gornji
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja područnog dječjeg vrtića CVITAK u Raštanima Gornjim
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project Upgrading the CVITAK kindergarten in Raštane Gornji is to provide adequate infrastructure and material capacity that will contribute to increasing the availability of early childhood education and care in the Municipality of Sveti Filip i Jakov. At the end of the project, the coverage rate of early childhood education and care in the Municipality is expected to increase from 73.90 % to 86.75 %, i.e. an increase in capacity for 32 children is planned (1 day-room for the nursery group with a capacity of 12 children and 1 day-room for the kindergarten group with a capacity of 20 children).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta Dogradnja područnog vrtića CVITAK u Raštanima Gornjim je osigurati adekvatnu infrastrukturu i materijalne kapacitete koji će doprinijeti povećanju dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja na području Općine Sveti Filip i Jakov. Po završetku projekta očekivano je povećanje stope obuhvaćenosti stanovništva ranim i predškolskim odgojem i obrazovanjem na području Općine sa 73,90 % na 86,75 %, odnosno planirano je povećanje kapaciteta za 32 djece (1 dnevni boravak za jasličku skupinu kapaciteta 12 djece i 1 dnevni boravak za vrtićku skupinu kapaciteta 20 djece).

Operation_Name_English: Desires - Phase IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - faza IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Our project will lead to an increase in the social inclusion of target groups and thus prevent their institutionalization through the provision of long-term care through the provision of support and support in everyday life. Packages with household and basic hygiene items for the elderly and people with disabilities would raise the hygiene standard itself. Within the project, we would organize nutrition (assistance in preparing meals, food procurement, etc.), performing household tasks (dishwashing, cleaning, purchasing medicines and other necessities, etc.), maintaining personal hygiene as well as helping to meet other daily needs of the target group of the project (minimum 150 people) that will be cared for by 25 employees for 32 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Naš projekt će dovesti do povećanja socijalne uključenosti ciljanih skupina te time prevenciji njihove institucionalizacije putem osiguranja dugotrajne skrbi kroz pružanje potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu. Paketima s kućanskim i osnovnom higijenskim potrepštinama starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom podigli bismo i sam higijenski standard. U okviru projekta organizirali bismo prehranu (pomoć u pripremi obroka, nabavu hrane i sl.), obavljanje kućanskih poslova (pranje posuđa, pospremanje, nabava lijekova i drugih potrepština i dr.), održavanje osobne higijene kao i pomoć pri zadovoljavanju ostalih svakodnevnih potreba ciljane skupine projekta (minimalno 150 osoba) o kojima će skrb provoditi 25 zaposlenika na 32 mjeseca.

Operation_Name_English: Equality rates
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Stopama jednakosti
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Overall objective of the project – to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups through the provision of long-term care. Specific objective – the provision of support and support services in the daily life of older persons and persons with disabilities. Activities - providing support and support services with procurement and distribution of packages of supplies for at least 6 members of the target group. It will employ service providers, monitoring and control of services performed, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta – povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj – pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnosti - pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština za min 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine. Zapošljavat će pružatelje usluga, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation and development of the system around the propeller for energy regeneration
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Implementacija i razvoj sustava oko propelera za regeneraciju energije
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: SPIN Consortium consists of the Consortium Holder: Adriatic Propeleri, Krešimir line d.o.o., Marina Kremik d.o.o., KW nautik servis d.o.o., MCI d.o.o. and OIŠZFESB The consortium is developing a system for optimization of ship propellers in order to regenerate energy and improve propulsion efficiency. This system includes the design and installation of a "wake nozzle" and pre-swirl fins that reduce cavitation and vibration while increasing propeller efficiency. The main goal (purpose) of the project is to ensure the strengthening of the competitiveness of the RLV by investing in priority niches based on cooperation on the development of innovative solutions of high added value for improving the propulsion efficiency of vessel propulsion systems.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SPIN konzorcij čine nositelj konzorcija: Adriatic Propeleri, Krešimir line d.o.o., Marina Kremik d.o.o., KW nautik servis d.o.o., MCI d.o.o. te OIŠZFESB Projektom konzorcij razvija sustav za optimizaciju propelera brodova s ciljem regeneracije energije i poboljšanja propulzivne efikasnosti. Ovaj sustav uključuje dizajniranje i ugradnju "wake nozzle" i predvrtložnih peraja ("pre-swirl fins") koje smanjuju kavitaciju i vibracije, dok istovremeno povećavaju efikasnost propelera. Glavni cilj (svrha) projekta je osigurati jačanje konkurentnosti RLV-a ulaganjem u prioritetne niše temeljem suradnje na razvoju inovativnih rješenja visoke dodane vrijednosti za poboljšanje propulzivne efikasnosti pogonskih sustava plovila.

Operation_Name_English: "Wish and stay home"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Zaželi i ostani kod kuće"
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for elderly people with disabilities in the municipality of German. Activity: Providing support and support services in addition to the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies that include: -recruitment of 29 service providers for 33 months for at least 6 members of the target group per service provider -monitoring and control of performed services -procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies -communication and visibility -project management and administration. The total duration of the project will be 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama s invaliditetom u općini Nijemci. Aktivnost: Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje: -zapošljavanje 29 pružatelja usluga na 33 mjeseca za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine po jednom pružatelju usluge -praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga -nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština -komunikacija i vidljivost -upravljanje projektom i administracija. Projekt će ukupno trajati 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Growing up in equality, Koprivnica – SECTION VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odrastanje u jednakosti, Koprivnica – ODJEK VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to respond to the problem of unequal opportunities faced by students with disabilities and they need support in the form of PUN/CPC, which contributes to better educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The number of students with disabilities with the need to provide PUN/CPC support is defined according to the actual needs in the system, taking into account the constant indicator of the growth in the number of students compared to previous years. Selection and education of PUN/CPC, development of an ind. program of work according to the ind. characteristics and difficulties of students, monitoring the work of PUN/CPC and exchange of information necessary for monitoring and improvement of work with students, will be the main project activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se želi odgovoriti na problem nejednakih mogućnosti s kojim se suočavaju učenici s teškoćama u razvoju te im je potrebna podrška u vidu PUN/SKP čime se pridonosi boljim obrazovnim postignućima, uspješnijoj socijalizaciji i emocionalnom funkcioniranju. Broj učenika s teškoćama s potrebom osiguravanja potpore PUN/SKP definiran je u skladu sa stvarnim potrebama u sustavu, uzimajući u obzir konstantni pokazatelj rasta broja učenika uspoređujući s prethodnim godinama. Selekcija i edukacija PUN/SKP, izrada ind. programa rada prema ind. karakteristikama i teškoćama učenika, praćenje rada PUN/SKP i razmjena informacija potrebnih za praćenje te unapređivanje rada s učenicima, bit će glavne projektne aktivnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Prevention of the institutionalisation of care for vulnerable groups and their social inclusion
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Prevencija institucionalizacije skrbi ranjivih skupina i njihovo socijalno uključivanje
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective: Increasing the social inclusion of older people and people with disabilities in the Split-Dalmatia and Šibenik-Knin counties through the provision of support and support. Target group: -Persons over 65 -Adults with disabilities 30 persons will be employed who will provide support and support services for 30 months (organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene, meeting other daily needs) for 180 users, selected on a public call, with the allocation of packages of household and hygiene supplies. Service control will be performed. Promotion of the project: banner, posters-40, leaflets-400, conferences-6. The project team manages the project and manages the administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj: Povećanje socijalne uključenosti starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom na području Splitsko-dalmatinske i Šibensko-kninske županije kroz pružanje potpore i podrške. Ciljana skupina: -Osobe starije od 65 godina -Odrasle osobe s invaliditetom Zaposliti će se 30 osoba koje će 30 mjeseci pružati usluge potpore i podrške (organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba) za 180 korisnika, odabranih na javnom pozivu, uz dodjelu paketa kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština. Vršit će se kontrola usluga. Promocija projekta: baner, plakati-40, letci-400, konferencije-6. Projektni tim upravlja projektom i vodi administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Conceptual development and design of the VX4 unmanned system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Konceptualni razvoj i dizajn bespilotnog sustava VX4
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: In the global market, including Croatia, the use of small unmanned aerial vehicles in various sectors is growing. The problem that the VX4 system solves is the need for a spacecraft that can adjust different missions and the load capacity of different sensors and loads. The new modular unmanned system provides high adaptability to various payloads, increased wind resistance and longer flight autonomy. The aim of the project is to develop a conceptual project VX4 with the involvement of the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture in Zagreb. Target groups include security services, emergency services and industrial users that require innovative and reliable solutions for surveillance and operations.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Na globalnom tržištu, uključujući RH, raste primjena malih bespilotnih letjelica u raznim sektorima. Problem koji VX4 sustav rješava je potreba za letjelicom koja može prilagoditi različite misije i nosivost različitih senzora i tereta. Novi modularni bespilotni sustav pruža visoku prilagodljivost različitim korisnim teretima, povećanu otpornost na vjetar i dužu autonomiju leta. Cilj projekta je izrada konceptualnog projekta VX4 s angažmanom Fakulteta strojarstva i brodogradnje u Zagrebu. Ciljne skupine uključuju sigurnosne službe, hitne službe i industrijske korisnike koji zahtijevaju inovativna i pouzdana rješenja za nadzor i operacije.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing international competitiveness through certification of intelligent transport systems products
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti certifikacijom proizvoda inteligentnih prometnih sustava
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The certification of light traffic signs, the executive element of intelligent traffic control systems, according to the standards EN-12966-1:2005 and NEMA-TS-4:2023, will eliminate the challenges of difficult proof of product quality in the markets of Europe, the USA, the countries of the Middle East, Australia, Canada and South. America. Consequently, it will facilitate confidence building with international customers, increase the company's recognition in international value chains and improve market relevance through compliance with global quality, safety and sustainability standards. Activities will contribute to strengthening the market position, ensuring sustainable revenue and export growth and will support the achievement of the S3 targets by 2029 under the Smart and Green Transport TPP.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Certifikacijom svjetlosnih prometnih znakova, izvršnog elementa inteligentnih sust. za kontrolu prometa, prema standardima EN-12966-1:2005 i NEMA-TS-4:2023, uklonit će se izazovi otežanog dokazivanja kvalitete proizvoda na tržištima Europe, SAD-a, zemalja Bliskog istoka, Australije, Kanade i Juž. Amerike. Posljedično, olakšat će se izgradnja povjerenja kod međunarodnih kupaca, povećati prepoznatljivost tvrtke u međunarodnim lancima vrijednosti te unaprijediti tržišna relevantnost kroz usklađivanje s globalnim standardima kvalitete, sigurnosti i održivosti. Aktivnosti će doprinijeti jačanju trž. pozicije, osiguravanju održivog rasta prihoda i izvoza te će podržati ostvarenje ciljeva S3 do 2029. godine u okviru TPP-a Pametan i zeleni promet.

Operation_Name_English: Together we can do more
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno možemo više
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will provide 96 students with disabilities with teaching support in accordance with their individual needs for inclusion 95 PUN/CPC, which will facilitate their participation in educational processes, contribute to the quantity and quality of acquired knowledge, the progress of their skills and abilities, the development of social skills through interaction, acceptance and respect of individual differences, and thus readiness to work independently and participate equally in the community and prevent their discrimination.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će za 96 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju biti osigurano pružanje potpore u nastavi u skladu s njihovim individualnim potrebama za uključivanjem 95 PUN/SKP, a što će im olakšati sudjelovanje u odgojno-obrazovnim procesima, doprinijeti kvantiteti i kvaliteti usvojenog znanja, napretku njihovih vještina i sposobnosti, razvoju socijalnih vještina kroz interakciju, prihvaćanje i poštivanje individualnih razlika, a time i spremnost na samostalni rad i ravnopravno sudjelovanje u zajednici te sprečavanje njihove diskriminacije.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the social plan of the Šibenik-Knin County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada socijalnog plana Šibensko - kninske županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The specific objective of the project is the development of a social plan and the empowerment of social planning experts in order to implement and monitor the social plan of the county as well as possible, which will have an impact on increasing the availability of social services. Activities are data collection for the preparation of the plan, analysis, data processing and preparation of the plan, education for members of the council and officials of the county and horizontal activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Specifični cilj projekta je izrada socijalnog plana te osnaživanje stručnjaka za socijalno planiranje kako bi što kvalitetnije provodili i pratili socijalni plan županije, a što će utjecati na povećanje dostupnosti socijalnih usluga. Aktivnosti su prikupljanje podataka za izradu plana, analiza, obrada podataka te izrada plana, edukacija za članove savjeta i službenike županije te horizontalne aktivnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Rest
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmori se
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: Providing the service of taking care through mobile teams for persons with disabilities and children with disabilities in the user's home, association premises or third location as agreed, allows parents/carers and caregivers time to take a break from the daily and developmental challenges of the person they care for and allows them time for personal growth and development. In addition, the inclusion of caregivers in psychosocial support groups led by psychologists will further empower caregivers to cope with the daily challenges of care for people with disabilities and children with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osiguravanjem usluge preuzimanja skrbi putem mobilnih timova za osobe s invaliditetom i djecu s teškoćama u razvoju u domu korisnika, prostorijama udruge ili trećoj lokaciji prema dogovoru, omogućava se roditeljima/njegovateljima i njegovateljima vrijeme za predah od svakodnevnih i razvojnih izazova osoba o kojoj skrbi te im se omogućuje vrijeme za osobni rast i razvoj. Uz navedeno, uključivanjem njegovatelja u grupe psihosocijalne podrške vođene od strane psihologa dodatno će se osnažiti njegovatelji za lakše nošenje sa svakodnevnim izazovima koje nosi njega osoba s invaliditetom i djece s teškoćama u razvoju.

Operation_Name_English: Support to Inter Recycling for the implementation of the management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Potpora poduzeću Inter Recycling za uvođenje sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The company INTER RECYCLING d.o.o. registered to perform activities (E38210) is applying for support for product certification and implementation of management system according to ISO 9001, quality management system and ISO 14001, environmental management system. The aim of the project is to strengthen the sustainable growth and competitiveness of enterprises through the implementation of high quality standards and environmental responsibility. The project envisages increasing productivity, reducing environmental impact, creating new jobs and productive investments in equipment and technology. Certification will allow the company better access to the market, increase customer confidence and ensure the long-term viability of the business.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Poduzeće INTER RECYCLING d.o.o. registrirano za obavljanje djelatnosti (E38210) oporaba materijala prijavljuje se na potporu za certifikaciju proizvoda i uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO 9001, sustava upravljanja kvalitetom i ISO 14001, sustava upravljanja zaštitom okoliša. Cilj projekta je jačanje održivog rasta i konkurentnosti poduzeća kroz implementaciju visokih standarda kvalitete i ekološke odgovornosti. Projektom se predviđa povećanje produktivnosti, smanjenje utjecaja na okoliš, otvaranje novih radnih mjesta te produktivna ulaganja u opremu i tehnologiju. Certifikacija će omogućiti poduzeću bolji pristup tržištu, povećati povjerenje kupaca i osigurati dugoročnu održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Advanced wood-based insulating panels
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Napredne izolacijske ploče na bazi drva
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in large enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop, through the Strategic Partnership (SPIN), i.e. through research and development activities, advanced insulating materials of higher added value that combine key characteristics, depending on the specific purpose and set new standards in the field of production and application of wood-based insulating materials. This will give Fragmat H d.o.o. and partners an important incentive for the development of new materials and solutions in the field of green, environmentally friendly construction and energy efficiency as some of the key challenges of the future, and create conditions for business diversification and the development of new products within the priority niches of RLVs of Northern Croatia and encourage the resolution of key social challenges of the region.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je kroz srateško partnerstvo (SPIN), odnosno kroz aktivnosti istraživanja i razvoja, razviti napredne izolacijske materijale više dodane vrijednosti koji u sebi objedinjuje ključne karakteristike, ovisno o specifičnoj namjeni te postaviti nove standarde na području proizvodnje i primjene izolacijskih materijala na bazi drva. Time će Fragmat H d.o.o. i partneri dati važan poticaj razvoju novih materijala i rješenja na području zelene, okolišno prihvatljive gradnje te energetske učinkovitosti kao nekima od ključnih izazova budućnosti, te stvoriti uvjete za diversifikaciju poslovanja i razvoj novih proizvoda u okviru prioritetnih niša RLV-ova Sjeverne Hrvatske te poticanje rješavanja ključnih društvenih izazova te regije.

Operation_Name_English: AxisTech: Strategic partnership for the development of innovative machining centers
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: AxisTech: Strateško partnerstvo za razvoj inovativnih obradnih centara
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The main problem that this project aims to solve is insufficient cooperation between entrepreneurs, scientific research organizations and public law bodies in the Adriatic Croatia with the purpose of developing innovative products. The project with its activities significantly affects the increase of competitiveness of SPIN consortium in the mechanical and mechanical engineering industry in the global market. The target groups of the project are: Applicant and partners with their employees, FESB who will acquire new knowledge for the production of publications through the project, a collaborative public law body that solves the social challenge, and manufacturers of parts for industries such as automotive and aerospace that will be able to produce better quality products using innovative products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni problem koji se ovim projektom želi riješiti je nedovoljna suradnja poduzetnika, znanstveno istraživačkih organizacija i javnopravnih tijela u Jadranskoj Hrvatskoj sa svrhom razvoja inovativnih proizvoda. Projekt sa svojim aktivnostima značajno utječe na povećanje konkurentnosti SPIN konzorcija u industriji strojarstva i mehaničkog inženjeringa na globalnom tržištu. Ciljne skupine projekta su: Prijavitelj i partneri sa svojim zaposlenicima, FESB koji će projektom steći nova znanja za izradu publikacija, suradničko javnopravno tijelo koje rješava društveni izazov te proizvođači dijelova za industrije poput automobilske i zrakoplovne koji će primjenom inovativnih proizvoda moći proizvoditi kvalitetnije proizvode.

Operation_Name_English: For the life they deserve 4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Za život kakav zaslužuju 4
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care in the field of activities of the applicant. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for 162 end-users over the age of 65 and persons with disabilities in the field of activity of the applicant through the employment of 27 persons. The main activity of the project proposal includes the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies to persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje soc. uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi na području djelovanja prijavitelja. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 162 krajnja korisnika starija od 65 godina i osobama s invaliditetom na području djelovanja prijavitelja kroz zaposlenje 27 osoba. Glavna aktivnost projektnog prijedloga uključuje pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom.

Operation_Name_English: Completion and reconstruction of a public and social building – kindergarten and civic association spaces with a children’s playground
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Završetak i rekonstrukcija građevine javne i društvene namjene – dječji vrtić i prostori građanskih udruga s dječjim igralištem
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures|Rehabilitation of industrial sites and contaminated land|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The project relates to the reconstruction and completion of the existing building, which will have a multiple purpose in the form of social activities for the purpose of preschool education and serve for the activities of civic associations. The purpose of the project is to increase the quality of life and reduce the rate of depopulation of the population of the municipality of Dubrovačko primorje by establishing a multifunctional infrastructure and public area in the function of a public and social building - a kindergarten and spaces of civic associations with a children's playground. The target groups of the project are the local population of the municipality of Dubrovačko primorje and civil sector associations. The initial duration of implementation is 75 months. The total value of the project is 3,588,820,88 EUR.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se odnosi se rekonstrukciju i završetak postojeće zgrade, koja će imati višestruku namjenu u vidu društvenih djelatnosti u svrhu predškolskog odgoja i naobrazbe te služiti za djelovanje građanskih udruga. Svrha projekta je povećanje kvalitete života i smanjenje stope depopulacije stanovništva općine Dubrovačko primorje uspostavom višenamjenske infrastrukture i javne površine u funkciji građevine javne i društvene namjene - dječji vrtić i prostori građanskih udruga s dječjim igralištem. Ciljne skupine projekta su lokalno stanovništvo općine Dubrovačko primorje te udruge civilnog sektora. Inicijalno trajanje provedbe iznosi 75 mjeseci. Ukupna vrijednost projekta je 3.588.820,88 EUR.

Operation_Name_English: Let's give them a JEWOST VIII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: OSigurajmo im JEdnaKost VIII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: With this project, the City of Osijek solves the inclusion of students with disabilities through professional support for a minimum of 157 students with disabilities in 21 regular educational institutions in the City of Osijek through the implementation period of the project by introducing 150 PUN/CPC. Such support enables the improvement of their educational achievements and a more successful social and emotional functioning in the classroom community and school environment. The project also sensitizes the local community and develops empathy and awareness of the needs and rights of students with disabilities, as well as the horizontal principles of equal opportunities, non-discrimination and equality.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom Grad Osijek rješava uključivanje učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz stručnu potporu za minimalno 157 učenika s teškoćama u 21 redovnih odgojno-obrazovnih ustanova na području grada Osijeka kroz razdoblje provedbe projekta uvođenjem 150 PUN/SKP. Takva potpora omogućava poboljšanje njihovih odgojno-obrazovnih postignuća te uspješnije socijalno i emocionalno funkcioniranje u razrednoj zajednici i školskom okruženju. Projektom se i senzibilizira lokalna zajednica te se razvija empatija i svijest o potrebama i pravima učenika s teškoćama u razvoju, a i životvore se horizontalna načela jednakih mogućnosti, nediskriminacije i jednakopravnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of Pecto d.o.o. by introducing ISO 9001:2015,ISO 14001:2015,ISO 45001:2018, EN16636
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti tvrtke Pecto d.o.o. uvođenjem ISO 9001:2015,ISO 14001:2015,ISO 45001:2018, EN16636
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to achieve international competitiveness of the company in the services of deratization, disinfection and disinfection through certification. The purpose is to increase the quality of services with ISO 9001, reduce environmental impact with ISO 14001, improve occupational safety according to ISO 45001, and comply with European standards through EN 16636. Expected results include higher quality of services, expansion to international markets, increasing customer confidence, reducing costs and strengthening the brand as a leader in the DDD industry. The plan for achieving competitiveness includes the implementation of quality, environmental and safety management systems, regular audits, employee education, and marketing campaigns that emphasize certification.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je postići međunarodnu konkurentnost tvrtke u uslugama deratizacije, dezinsekcije i dezinfekcije kroz certificiranje. Svrha je povećati kvalitetu usluga uz ISO 9001, smanjiti ekološki utjecaj s ISO 14001, poboljšati sigurnost na radu prema ISO 45001, i uskladiti se s europskim standardima putem EN 16636. Očekivani rezultati uključuju višu kvalitetu usluga, širenje na međunarodna tržišta, povećanje povjerenja klijenata, smanjenje troškova i jačanje brenda kao lidera u industriji DDD. Plan za postizanje konkurentnosti obuhvaća implementaciju sistema za upravljanje kvalitetom, okolišem i sigurnošću, redovne audite, edukaciju zaposlenika, i marketing kampanje koje ističu certificiranje.

Operation_Name_English: Helicopter support to the civil protection system - Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Helikopterska potpora sustavu civilne zaštite - faza II
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: floods and landslides (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)

Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the readiness and capacity of the civil protection system in the Republic of Croatia (hereinafter: Croatia), i.e. the development of a management system in the event of emergencies, major accidents and disasters, to which the Republic of Croatia is exposed based on the Disaster Risk Assessment for the Republic of Croatia. The project envisages strengthening the operational capacities of the civil protection system and includes the procurement of 2 multipurpose equipped helicopters for the needs of the civil protection system as well as training of the operational forces and civil protection system participants on multipurpose equipped helicopters to act in the event of emergencies, major accidents and disasters.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje spremnosti i kapaciteta sustava civilne zaštite u Republici Hrvatskoj (dalje u tekstu: RH), odnosno razvoj sustava upravljanja u slučaju izvanrednih događaja, velikih nesreća i katastrofa, kojima je izložena RH temeljem Procjene rizika od katastrofa za Republiku Hrvatsku. Projekt predviđa jačanje operativnih kapaciteta sustava civilne zaštite te uključuje nabavu 2 višenamjenski opremljena helikoptera za potrebe sustava civilne zaštite kao i obuku operativnih snaga i sudionika sustava civilne zaštite na višenamjenski opremljenim helikopterima za djelovanje u slučaju izvanrednih događaja, velikih nesreća i katastrofa.

Operation_Name_English: Promotion of STEM technologies with a multidisciplinary approach - MULTI-STEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Promocija STEM tehnologija multidisciplinarnim pristupom - MULTI-STEM
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Promotion of STEM technologies with a multidisciplinary approach - MULTI-STEM" is implemented by MIPRO, for a period of 24 months, with partners HATZ, primary schools Središće and Granešina, secondary schools Tituša Brezovački High School and Electrical Engineering and Transport School Osijek, and IRB as a scientific partner. The aim of the project is to develop sustainable programs that increase interest in STEM fields among students in Rijeka, Osijek and Zagreb, with an emphasis on discovering, monitoring and guiding talents, as well as on increasing gender equality through the active involvement of students in the promotion of natural sciences (physics, mathematics, chemistry, biology, ecology) with the support of ICT in STEM applications through a multidisciplinary approach.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Promocija STEM tehnologija multidisciplinarnim pristupom - MULTI-STEM" provodi udruga MIPRO, u trajanju od 24 mjeseca, s partnerima HATZ, osnovnim školama Središće i Granešina, srednjim školama Gimnazija Tituša Brezovačkog i Elektrotehnička i prometna škola Osijek, te IRB-om kao znanstvenim partnerom. Cilj projekta je razviti održive programe koji povećavaju interes za STEM područja među učenicima u Rijeci, Osijeku i Zagrebu, s naglaskom na otkrivanje, praćenje i usmjeravanje talenata, kao i na povećanje rodne ravnopravnosti kroz aktivno uključivanje učenika u promociju prirodoslovnih znanosti (fizike, matematike, kemije, biologije, ekologije) uz podršku ICT-a u STEM aplikacijama kroz multidisciplinarni pristup.

Operation_Name_English: Development of NETRONIX warning lamps for aircraft
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj NETRONIX lampi upozorenja za zrakoplove
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: By implementing this project, the company Netronix d.o.o. will perform testing services for aircraft warning signal lamps, which represent the first step towards a new generation of warning lights, and aim to increase the visibility of high objects/obstacles and at the same time reduce light pollution emitted into the atmosphere. The project will result in the development of new products that represent a novelty in the company's offer, as well as a novelty in the market and at the same time comply with the new safety regulations.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom ovog projekta poduzeće Netronix d.o.o. izvršit će usluge ispitivanja signalnih lampi upozorenja za zrakoplove, koje predstavljaju prvi korak prema novoj generaciji svjetala upozorenja, a imaju za cilj povećati uočljivost visokih objekata/prepreka te u isto vrijeme smanjiti svjetlosno zagađenje koje se emitira u atmosferu. Projekt će rezultirati razvojem novih proizvoda koji predstavljaju novost u ponudi poduzeća, kao i novost na tržištu te su istovremeno u skladu s novim sigurnosnim propisima.

Operation_Name_English: MOZAIK 7
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: MOZAIK 7

Operation_Summary_English: The MOZAIK 7 project continues good practice and support to students with disabilities by providing 100 teaching assistants in primary and secondary educational institutions founded by the Istrian Region, in order to ensure the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialisation and emotional functioning, during the school years 2024/2025, 2025/2026 and 2026/2027.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom MOZAIK 7 nastavlja se dobra praksa i podrška učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju osiguravanjem 100 pomoćnika u nastavi u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama čiji je osnivač Istarska županija, kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje, tijekom školskih godina 2024./2025., 2025./2026. i 2026./2027.

Operation_Name_English: Rehabilitation centre for children and young people with the most severe disabilities and children and young people with disabilities "Škverska ambulanta"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rehabilitacijski centar za djecu i mlade s najtežim oblicima invaliditeta te djecu i mlade s teškoćama u razvoju „Škverska ambulanta“
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures|Rehabilitation of industrial sites and contaminated land|Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: By revitalising the abandoned brownfield site ‘Škverska ambulanta’ in Split, the project envisages the establishment of a rehabilitation centre for children and young people with disabilities and developmental difficulties. The project includes the reconstruction of the former Brodosplit Health Center's derelict building on an area of 1,432 m2, with energy-efficient measures and adaptation of the space to the needs of users. The Škverska Ambulance provides therapeutic services such as physiotherapy, speech therapy, rehabilitation pool and early interventions in one location. The project provides conditions for improving the quality of life of vulnerable groups, strengthening their inclusion in the community and supports the deinstitutionalization of social services in the Urban agglomeration of Split.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Revitalizacijom napuštene brownfield lokacije „Škverska ambulanta“ u Splitu projekt predviđa uspostavu rehabilitacijskog centra za djecu i mlade s invaliditetom te teškoćama u razvoju. Projekt uključuje rekonstrukciju derutne zgrade bivšeg Doma zdravlja Brodosplit na površini od 1.432 m², uz energetski učinkovite mjere i prilagodbu prostora potrebama korisnika. U Škverskoj ambulanti predviđa se pružanje terapijskih usluga poput fizioterapije, logopedije, rehabilitacijskog bazena i ranih intervencija na jednoj lokaciji. Projektom se osiguravaju uvjeti za unaprjeđenje kvalitete života ranjivih skupina, jačanje njihove uključenosti u zajednici te se podržava deinstitucionalizacija socijalnih usluga u Urbanoj aglomeraciji Split.

Operation_Name_English: NEW NADA
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: NOVA NADA
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objectives: increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of 65+ elderly people living in single or multi-member families and persons with disabilities 18+ through the provision of support and support services in everyday life and their inclusion in the life of the community. Activities: assistance in preparing meals, obtaining food, etc., performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene, maintaining premises, etc. The project will last 36 months: 2 months for the preparation, publication of the Public Call for Expression of Interest and signing the application forms, procurement of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies for 60 users, employment of 10 employees for support and support tasks for end users. Over the course of 33 months, support and support will be provided to end-users. 1 month - final reports.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi: povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije starijih osoba 65+, koje žive u samačkim ili višečlanim obiteljima i osobe s invaliditetom 18+ kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu i njihovo uključivanje u život zajednice. Aktivnosti: pomoć u pripremi obroka, nabavi hrane i sl., obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, održavanje prostora i sl. Projekt će trajati 36 mjeseci: 2 mj. za pripremu, objavu Javnog poziva na iskaz interesa i potpisivanje pristupnica, nabavu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština za 60 korisnika, zapošljavanje 10 djelatnika/ca za poslove potpore i podrške krajnjim korisnicima. Kroz 33 mjeseca pružat će se potpora i podrška krajnjim korisnicima. 1 mjesec - završna izvješća.

Operation_Name_English: Construction and equipping of a kindergarten in Bistrinci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja i opremanje dječjeg vrtića u Bistrincima
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the capacity and availability of early childhood education and care. Kindergarten is free for children from the area of the City of Belišće, and the current capacities, with 2 new daily stays provided through the NPOO, are still not enough because for the new pedagogical year there are children who are "on hold" for a place in the kindergarten. The construction and equipping of a new regional kindergarten (4 new daily stays) will ensure better childcare in accordance with modern standards, greater availability of early and preschool education and will contribute to a better work-life balance of parents.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje kapaciteta i dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja. Dječji vrtić je besplatan za djecu s područja Grada Belišća, a sadašnji kapaciteti, uz 2 nova dnevna boravka koja su osigurana kroz NPOO, i dalje nisu dovoljni jer i za novu pedagošku godinu postoje djeca koja su "na čekanju" za mjesto u dječjem vrtiću. Izgradnjom i opremanjem novog područnog dječjeg vrtića (4 nova dnevna boravka) osigurat će se kvalitetnija briga o djeci sukladno suvremenim standardima, veća dostupnost ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja te će se doprinijeti kvalitetnijoj ravnoteži poslovnog i privatnog života roditelja.

Operation_Name_English: Knowing it's cool II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Znati je fora II
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to ensure inclusive education for 38 students with disabilities in primary education institutions in the city of Vukovar. The main project activity is to support the education of students with disabilities through the monthly work of PUN/CPC. Activities include the selection of candidates for PUN/CPC, the implementation of the deployment programme and the work of PUN/CPC.
