Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći je cilj projekta osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja za 38 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim odgojno- obrazovnim ustanovama na području grada Vukovara. Glavna projektna aktivnost je pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz mjesečni rad PUN/SKP. Aktivnosti uključuju selekciju kandidata za PUN/SKP, provedbu programa uvođenja u rad te rad PUN/SKP.

Operation_Name_English: Europan Connect - a new generation of building
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Europan Connect - nova generacija gradnje objekata
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Within RLV Green Growth SPIN consortium consists of Maran, company M.L. project, Ground Zero, Neutrum and Atelier Šverko & Šverko and Faculty of Civil Engineering, Geodesy and Architecture in Split. The main objective (purpose) of the project is to ensure the strengthening of the competitiveness of the RLV by investing in priority niches based on cooperation on the development of innovative solutions of high added value - the system of building objects using the Europan Connect panel technology. The project develops an innovative prefabricated wall panel system that aims to significantly reduce the use of concrete in constructions. The proposed solution includes key functionalities that enable faster, more environmentally friendly and more economical construction of residential and commercial buildings.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Unutar RLV-a Zeleni rast SPIN konzorcij čine nositelj Marana, tvrtke M.L. projekt, Ground Zero, Neutrum i Atelier Šverko & Šverko te Fakultet građevinarstva, geodezije i arhitekture u Splitu. Glavni cilj (svrha) projekta je osigurati jačanje konkurentnosti RLV-a ulaganjem u prioritetne niše temeljem suradnje na razvoju inovativnih rješenja visoke dodane vrijednosti – sustava građenja objekata tehnologijom Europan Connect panela. Projektom se razvija inovativni montažni sustav zidnih panela koji ima za cilj značajno smanjiti upotrebu betona u građevinskim konstrukcijama. Predloženo rješenje uključuje ključne funkcionalnosti koje omogućuju bržu, ekološki prihvatljiviju i ekonomičniju izgradnju stambenih i poslovnih objekata.

Operation_Name_English: ADRIROSA - New topical preparations based on Adriatic microalgae complexes for the treatment of rosacea-affected skin
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ADRIROSA - Novi topikalni pripravci na bazi kompleksa jadranskih mikroalgi za tretman kože zahvaćene rozacejom
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project, through joint action of SPIN consortium members, is to explore the possibilities of applying different microalgae, i.e. their preparations, in the re-establishment of skin homeostasis, the alleviation of symptoms and signs of inflammatory skin conditions, and to develop the product up to phase TRL 8, which will be at a high level of technological readiness for global commercialization. An additional market value is the planned use of over-the-counter products and medical supervision, which will reduce the financial burden on healthcare systems and improve patients' access to effective solutions to their problems.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta zajedničkim djelovanjem članova SPIN konzorcija istražiti mogućnosti primjene različitih mikroalgi, tj. njihovih pripravaka, u ponovnoj uspostavi homeostaze kože, ublažavanju simptoma i znakova upalnih stanja kože te razviti proizvod do faze TRL 8, čime će isti biti na visokoj razini tehnološke spremnosti za globalnu komercijalizaciju. Dodatnu tržišnu vrijednost predstavlja i planirano korištenje proizvoda bez recepta i nadzora liječnika čime će se smanjiti financijsko opterećenje zdravstvenih sustava i poboljšati pristup pacijenata učinkovitim rješenjima za njihove tegobe.

Operation_Name_English: With an assistant I can do better VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: S pomoćnikom mogu bolje VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project "With an Assistant I Can Better VII" is to provide support to 336 pupils with disabilities in 29 primary school institutions of the City of Split in order to contribute to the improvement of educational achievements of students with disabilities, their greater socialization, social inclusion and emotional functioning, which will be achieved through the engagement of 272 assistants in teaching and 2 professional communication mediators. The project has an indirect impact on reducing child poverty and achieving the right to education on equal terms and is in line with the Convention on the Rights of the Child, the European Pillar of Social Rights Action Plan 2030 and the Strategy for the Rights of Persons with Disabilities 2021-2030.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta „S pomoćnikom mogu bolje VII“ je pružiti potporu za 336 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u 29 osnovnoškolskih ustanova Grada Splita kako bi se doprinijelo poboljšanju obrazovnih postignuća učenika s teškoćama u razvoju, njihovoj većoj socijalizaciji, socijalnoj uključenosti i emocionalnom funkcioniranju, što će se postići kroz angažman 272 pomoćnika u nastavi i 2 stručna komunikacijska posrednika. Projekt posredno utječe na smanjenje dječjeg siromaštva i postizanje prava na obrazovanje pod jednakim uvjetima te je u skladu s Konvencijom o pravima djeteta, Akcijskim planom za provedbu europskog stupa socijalnih prava za 2030. i Strategijom o pravima osoba s invaliditetom 2021.-2030.

Operation_Name_English: Community Assistance - Phase IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoć zajednici - faza IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support to socially vulnerable people with special emphasis on the elderly and people with disabilities through organized assistance in meeting basic living needs with the purpose of improving the quality of life and preventing institutionalization. The goals are achieved through the care of 186 elderly people and people with disabilities during the 30 months of the project implementation, through providing the service of organizing food in the beneficiary's household, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and meeting everyday other needs with the distribution of hygiene packages on a monthly level. The activity will be carried out in the municipality of Biskupija, Kistanje, Ervenik and the city of Knin for a period of 30 months, with the project lasting 33 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške socijalno ugroženim osobama s posebnim naglaskom na starije i osobe s invaliditetom putem organizirane pomoći pri zadovoljenju osnovnih životnih potreba sa svrhom unapređenja kvalitete života i sprečavanja institucionalizacije. Ciljevi se ostvaruju kroz skrb o 186 starije osobe i osobe s invaliditetom tijekom 30 mjeseci provedbe projekta, putem pružanja usluge organiziranja prehrane u domaćinstvu korisnika, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, održavanja osobne higijene te zadovoljenje svakodnevnih drugih potreba uz podjelu higijenskih paketa na mjesečnoj razini. Aktivnost će se provoditi na području općine Biskupija, Kistanje, Ervenik i grada Knina u trajanju od 30 mj., s tim da će projekt trajati 33 mjeseca.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international competitiveness of TOMSOFT d.o.o. by introducing a quality management system and information security
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke TOMSOFT d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kvalitetom te informacijskom sigurnošću
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of the project "Increasing the international competitiveness of TOMSOFT d.o.o. by introducing a quality management system and information security" is to increase the international competitiveness of the company through the introduction of an information security management system according to the requirements of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and a quality management system according to the requirements of ISO 9001:2015. The purpose of the project is to ensure high standards of safety and quality of products and services, increase customer confidence and facilitate entry to new international markets with their own software products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta "Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke TOMSOFT d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kvalitetom te informacijskom sigurnošću'' je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema zahtjevima norme ISO/IEC 27001:2022 i sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema zahtjevima norme ISO 9001:2015. Svrha projekta je osigurati visoke standarde sigurnosti i kvalitete proizvoda i usluga, povećati povjerenje klijenata te olakšati ulazak na nova međunarodna tržišta vlastitim softverskim produktima.

Operation_Name_English: Innovative concept for the development of new ecological building materials Green Construct Solution (GCS)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inovativni koncept razvoja novih ekološki gradbenih materijala Green Construct Solution (GCS)
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of this project aims to explore and develop new ecological building materials with the primary aim of using them for the remediation of old buildings, especially cultural heritage, and with a special emphasis on solving the problem of resistance to moisture and earthquakes and light concrete. The new materials will combine recycled components and natural fibres to achieve the optimal combination of strength, durability and environmental friendliness. The use of new methods of recycling waste materials from the production of these natural fibres will reduce the use of cement, resulting in a lower carbon (CO2) footprint.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom ovog projekta žele se istražiti i razviti novi ekološki građevinski materijali s primarnim ciljem korištenja za sanaciju starih objekata, posebno kulturne baštine i s posebnim naglaskom na rješavanje problema otpornosti na vlagu i potrese te lake betone. Novi materijali će kombinirati reciklirane komponente i prirodna vlakna kako bi se postigla optimalna kombinacija čvrstoće, izdržljivosti i ekološke prihvatljivosti. Korištenjem novih metoda recikliranja otpadnog materijala iz proizvodnje te prirodnih vlakana smanjiti će se upotreba cementa, a što će rezultirati i nižim ugljičnim (CO2) otiskom.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading and equipping the kindergarten in Vrpolje
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja i opremanje dječjeg vrtića u Vrpolju
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The existing building – a kindergarten for which a use permit has been issued – consists of 3 educational groups and accompanying facilities. Of the three educational groups, one is a nursery group, while the other two are kindergarten groups. Given the increase in standards, there was a need to increase another educational group, a kindergarten group to accommodate up to 20 children of gardening age. The investment is also planned to access and procure additional equipment for the operation of the kindergarten. The main goal of this project is to increase the availability of early education in the area of the Municipality of Vrpolj and to provide infrastructural and material capacities and preconditions for the inclusion of additional children in the RPOO through upgrading and equipping.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Postojeća građevina – dječji vrtić za koju je izdana uporabna dozvola sastoji se od 3 odgojno- obrazovne skupine, te pratećih sadržaja uz isto. Od tri odgojno-obrazovne skupine, jedna je jaslička skupina, dok su ostale dvije skupine vrtićke skupine. S obzirom na povećanje standarda, došlo je do potrebe za povećanjem još jedne odgojno-obrazovne skupine, vrtićke skupine za smještaj do 20 djece vrtičke dobi. Predmetnom investicijom također se planira pristupiti i nabavi dodatne opreme za rad dječjeg vrtića. Glavni cilj ovoga projekta je povećati dostupnost ranog odgoja i obrazovanja na područja Općine Vrpolj te osigurati infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete i preduvjete za uključivanje dodatne djece u RPOO kroz dogradnju i opremanje.

Operation_Name_English: Complete computerization of the education system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Cjelovita informatizacija sustava odgoja i obrazovanja
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes the further development of an information system for the computerization of processes and the establishment of a complete electronic enrolment service in educational institutions that will enable the improvement of complex electronic services to users of educational institutions. Also, a digital record of issued final documents of higher, secondary and primary education and other forms of education will be created, including a software interface for data entry. During the duration of the project, the provision of customer support for all project activities will be ensured and the training of module users will be carried out with the aim of getting acquainted with the improved and newly developed functionalities, included and user instructions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća daljnji razvoj informacijskog sustava za informatizaciju procesa i uspostavu cjelovite elektroničke usluge upisa u odgojne i obrazovne ustanove koji će omogućiti unapređenje kompleksnih elektroničkih usluga prema korisnicima odgojno- obrazovnih institucija. Također, izradit će se digitalna evidencija izdanih završnih isprava visokog, srednjoškolskog i osnovnoškolskog obrazovanja te drugih oblika obrazovanja, uključujući i programsko sučelje za unos podataka. Tijekom trajanja projekta osigurat će se pružanje korisničke podrške za sve projektne aktivnosti te će se provesti edukacija korisnika modula s ciljem upoznavanja s unaprijeđenim i novo razvijenim funkcionalnostima, obuhvaćenim i uputama za korisnike.

Operation_Name_English: Hands That Can All III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ruke koje mogu sve III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life to people over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities in the area of the LAG "Green Triangle" (120 people). Mandatory activity: Providing support and support services with the purchase and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies, which must include: -recruitment of 20 service providers for 120 members of the target group -monitoring and control of performed services -procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies -communication and visibility -project management and administration
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom na području LAG-a "Zeleni trokut" (120 osoba). Obavezna aktivnost: Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština koja obavezno uključuje: -zapošljavanje 20 pružatelja usluga za 120 pripadnika ciljane skupine -praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga -nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština -komunikacija i vidljivost -upravljanje projektom i administracija

Operation_Name_English: Let's help each other.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomozimo jedni drugima VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of the project proposal include constant support to students with developmental difficulties, with the aim of improving their educational achievements, social and emotional functioning, and will contribute to increasing the social inclusion of students with developmental difficulties in primary schools in the city of Križevci. Children with disabilities who will benefit from PUN/CPC assistance will be able to use more efficiently the knowledge and skills they acquired during their education and thus socialize and integrate into society, all thanks to the activities and an inclusive approach that this project promotes.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projektnog prijedloga uključuju konstantnu podršku učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju, a s ciljem poboljšanja njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, socijalnog i emocionalnog funkcioniranja te će pridonijeti povećanju socijalne uključenosti učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim ustanovama na području grada Križevaca. Djeca s teškoćama u razvoju koja će koristiti pomoć PUN/SKP moći će efikasnije koristiti znanja i vještine koje su stekli tijekom obrazovanja te se na taj način socijalizirati i integrirati u društvo, a sve zahvaljujući aktivnostima i inkluzivnom pristupu koje ovaj projekt promiče.

Operation_Name_English: Landings 5
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Iskrice 5
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project will provide support to 17 children with PUN/CPC which will contribute to the improvement of students' educational achievements, socialization and emotional functioning of children and the execution of school, extracurricular and extracurricular activities through inclusive teaching. Children with disabilities acquire new knowledge and skills and personal and social achievement. PUN/CPC will improve skills and become more competitive on the market by employing in elementary school and educating for work with children. Mandatory elements of publicity and visibility will familiarize the public with the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta će se za 17 djece osigurati potpora PUN/SKP koji će inkluzivnim podučavanjem doprinijeti poboljšanju obrazovnih postignuća učenika, socijalizaciji i emocionalnom funkcioniranju djece te izvršavanju školskih, izvanškolskih i izvannastavnih aktivnosti. Djeca s teškoćama steći nova znanja i vještine te osobno i društveno ostvarenje. PUN/SKP će zapošljavanjem u OŠ i educiranjem za rad s djecom unaprijediti vještine i postati konkurentniji na tržištu. Obaveznim elemenata promidžbe i vidljivosti javnost će se upoznati s projektom.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of OFIR d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva OFIR d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the implementation and certification of the information security management system according to the ISO 27001 standard, which ensures the compliance of business processes with internationally recognized standards. The purpose is to increase the international competitiveness of enterprises by raising the level of data security and customer confidence, especially in sectors with high security requirements. The project includes analysis of the existing situation, employee education, policy development, implementation and certification of the system. Expected results include reducing the risk of security incidents, increasing sales revenue by 6% and exports by 56%, and strengthening the market position in the domestic and international markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je implementacija i certifikacija sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema normi ISO 27001, čime se osigurava usklađenost poslovnih procesa s međunarodno priznatim standardima. Svrha je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća kroz podizanje razine sigurnosti podataka i povjerenja klijenata, posebno u sektorima s visokim zahtjevima sigurnosti. Projekt uključuje analizu postojećeg stanja, edukaciju zaposlenika, razvoj politika, implementaciju i certifikaciju sustava. Očekivani rezultati uključuju smanjenje rizika od sigurnosnih incidenata, povećanje prihoda od prodaje za 6% i izvoza 56%, te jačanje tržišne pozicije na domaćem i međunarodnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Strategy for the Development of the Urban Area of Zadar for the period 2021-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada Strategije razvoja urbanog područja Zadar za razdoblje 2021.-2027.
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: SRUP Zadar 2021-2027 is an act of strategic planning within the policy of regional development that serves as a multi-sectoral strategic framework that plans the development of UP Zadar with the aim of defining common directions for the development of UP, proposing common lines of action and facilitating the implementation of joint projects and is a prerequisite for the use of the ITU mechanism for the seven-year period in accordance with the multiannual financial framework of cohesion policy. The project of developing SRUP is aimed at creating a framework for sustainable and innovative development of UP Zadar and achieving key development priorities, such as encouraging innovation, sustainability, digital transformation, demographic renewal and creating a safe environment for stable development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SRUP Zadar 2021-2027 je akt strateškog planiranja u okviru politike regionalnog razvoja koji služi kao multi-sektorski strateški okvir kojim se planira razvoj UP Zadar s ciljem definiranja zajedničkih smjerova razvoja UP-a, predlaganje zajedničkih pravaca djelovanja i olakšavanje provedbe zajedničkih projekata te predstavlja preduvjet za korištenje ITU mehanizma za sedmogodišnje razdoblje u skladu s višegodišnjim financijskim okvirom kohezijske politike. Projekt izrade SRUP-a je usmjeren na stvaranje okvira za održivi i inovativan razvoj UP Zadar i ostvarivanje ključnih prioriteta razvoja, poput poticanja inovacija, održivosti, digitalne transformacije, demografske obnove te stvaranja sigurnog okruženja za stabilan razvoj.

Operation_Name_English: ACTIVE - Construction and arrangement of sports and recreational infrastructure
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ACTIVE - Izgradnja i uređenje sportsko-rekreacijske infrastrukture
Category_Label: Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the modernization, decoration and construction and equipping of 11 sports fields in 7 island municipalities of Dubrovnik-Neretva County, as well as the construction of a sports hall in the municipality of Ston, which will make maximum use of all the possibilities of outdoor playgrounds and halls for individual training, recreation of young and elderly people as well as for the needs of the school. In addition to infrastructure works, the project also includes promotional activities and the organization of various sports events in the island municipalities of DNC. The project leader is the Dubrovnik-Neretva County, and partners are the Regional Agency DUNEA and the Sports Community of DNC. The total value of the project is € 5,894,283.21, and it was contracted under the Integrated Territorial Programme 2021-2027.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je modernizacija, uređenje te izgradnja i opremanje 11 sportskih igrališta u 7 otočnih općina Dubrovačko-neretvanske županije kao i izgradnja sportske dvorane u općini Ston čime će se maksimalno iskoristiti sve mogućnosti vanjskih igrališta i dvorane kako za individualne treninge, rekreaciju mladih i starijih osoba tako i za potrebe škole. Uz infrastrukturne radove, projekt uključuje i promotivne aktivnosti te organizaciju raznih sportskih događanja u otočnim općinama DNŽ. Nositelj projekta je Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija, a partneri su Regionalna agencija DUNEA i Sportska zajednica DNŽ. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 5.894.283,21 €, a ugovoren je u okviru Integriranog teritorijalnog programa 2021.-2027.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Development Strategy of the Urban Agglomeration of Split for the period until the end of 2027.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada Strategije razvoja Urbane aglomeracije Split za razdoblje do kraja 2027.g.
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The development of the Development Strategy of the Urban Agglomeration of Split for the period until the end of 2027 is a prerequisite for the continued use of the ITU mechanism in the Urban Agglomeration of Split and in the financial period of 2021. - 2027. The Strategy defines the vision, goals, priorities and measures with the aim of improving the quality of life of all residents of 13 cities and municipalities that are in the scope of the Urban Agglomeration of Split.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Izrada Strategije razvoja Urbane agloemracije Split za razdoblje do kraja 2027.g. je preduvijet za nastavak korištenja ITU mehanizma u Urbanoj aglomeraciji Split i u financisjkom razdoblju 2021. - 2027. Strategijom je definirana vizija, ciljevi, prioriteti i mjere s ciljem poboljšanja kvalitete života svih stanovnika 13 gradova i općina koji se nalaze u obuhvatu Urbane aglomeracije Split.

Operation_Name_English: TourismIQ - Tourism data synergy and revenue maximization platform
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: TuristIQ - Sinergija podataka u turizmu i platforma za maksimizaciju prihoda
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the development of new products for the purpose of developing the priority niche Luxury coastal tourism of RLV Blue growth of Adriatic Croatia and encouraging the resolution of the key social challenge of the region, which refers to an insufficiently effective and efficient system of managing tourist destinations. At the heart of the development are 2 products: SmartDestination-Business intelligence and destination digital analytics and RevenueMaxIQ-Intelligent revenue management. OBJECTIVES: tourist boards, JL(R)S, other public and private stakeholders in the hotel industry and destination management. CONSORTION: RINELS d.o.o.,Best Solutions d.o.o.,Intuit d.o.o.,Aras Digital Products d.o.o., IT Works d.o.o.,Faculty for Tourism and Hospitality Management
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta jest razvoj novih proizvoda u svrhu razvoja prioritetne niše Luksuzni obalni turizam RLV-a Plavi rast Jadranske Hrvatske te poticanje rješavanja ključnog društvenog izazova te regije, a koji se odnosi na nedovoljno djelotvoran i učinkovit sustav upravljanja turističkim destinacijama. U središtu razvoja nalaze se 2 proizvoda: SmartDestination-Poslovna inteligencija i digitalna analitika destinacije te RevenueMaxIQ-Inteligentno upravljanje prihodima. CILJNE SKUPINE: turističke zajednice, JL(R)S-ovi,ostali javni i privatni dionici u hotelijerstvu i upravljanju destinacijama. KONZORCIJ: RINELS d.o.o.,Best Solutions d.o.o.,Intuit d.o.o.,Aras Digital Products d.o.o., IT Works d.o.o.,Fakultet za menadžment u turizmu i ugostiteljstvu

Operation_Name_English: Science, knowledge, work and gift for society - ZNADDAR
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Znanost, znanje, rad i dar za društvo - ZNADDAR
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to strengthen the capacities of the Croatian Mathematical Society and the Croatian Astronomical Society for the implementation of STEM promotion programmes among students and cooperation with faculties, primary and secondary schools through the design and implementation of STEM activities (workshops related to mathematical and financial literacy, data literacy and artificial intelligence, physics, astronomy, electronics, mechatronics, RES, climate change, etc., and combined). In the Republic of Croatia, the interest of students for science (PISA research) has weakened in recent years, so it is necessary to popularize all STEM fields, to which HMD and HAD can significantly contribute through more informal teaching methods, creating a solid network of cooperation between CSOs, schools, faculties, scientists and educational workers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je jačanje kapaciteta udruga Hrvatsko matematičko društvo i Hrvatsko astronomsko društvo za provedbu programa promocije STEM-a među učenicima te suradnja s fakultetima, osnovnim i srednjim školama kroz osmišljavanje i provedbu STEM aktivnosti (radionice vezane uz matematičku i financijsku pismenost, podatkovnu pismenost i umjetnu inteligenciju, fiziku, astronomiju, elektroniku, mehatroniku, OIE, klimatske promjene i sl. te kombinirane). U RH zadnjih godina slabi interes učenika za znanost (PISA istraživanja) pa je nužno popularizirati sva STEM područja, čemu HMD i HAD mogu znatno doprinijeti kroz neformalnije metode poučavanja, stvarajući čvrstu mrežu suradnje OCDa, škola, fakulteta, znanstvenika i obrazovnih djelatnika.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a bicycle path in the municipality of Andrijaševci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističke staze u općini Andrijaševci
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project for the construction of cycling trails in the municipality of Andrijaševci aims to build 9.13 km of walking and cycling trails in the territory of the municipality of Andrijaševci in order to achieve better connectivity of the existing infrastructure and increase the safety of both its users and other road users at UP Vinkovci. This initiative is a step towards a more sustainable way of life and a transport policy aimed at protecting the environment and improving the quality of life of citizens. The activities of the project are: 1. Preparation of project and technical documentation 2. Works on the construction of bicycle paths in the municipality of Andrijaševci 3. Project management 4. Promotion and visibility
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt izgradnje biciklističkih staza u općini Andrijaševci ima za cilj izgraditi 9,13 km pješačko-biciklističkih staza na području općine Andrijaševci kako bi se ostvarila bolja povezanost postojeće infrastrukture te povećala sigurnost, kako njezinih korisnika tako i ostalih sudionika cestovnog prometa na UP Vinkovci. Ova inicijativa predstavlja korak prema održivijem načinu života i prometnoj politici usmjerenoj prema zaštiti okoliša i poboljšanju kvalitete života građana. Aktivnosti projekta su: 1. Izrada projektno-tehničke dokumentacije 2. Radovi na izgradnji biciklističkih staza na području općine Andrijaševci 3. Upravljanje projektom 4. Promidžba i vidljivost

Operation_Name_English: Care holiday of GDCK Virovitica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmor od skrbi GDCK-a Virovitica
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: Through the implementation of the project, the partner institutions will ensure the continuous provision of innovative social services of rest from care for at least 25 persons from the target group of the project - persons who have a recognised right to the status of parents of caregivers and/or caregivers. This will be achieved by employing people who will care for and spend time with dependent household members in order to provide the target group with a short break from physical and emotional demands that are an indispensable part of everyday care and care for a child with developmental disabilities and/or a person with disabilities. The project will be implemented in the Virovitica-Podravina County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta partnerske institucije će tijekom 16 mjeseci osigurati kointinuirano pružanje inovativne socijalne usluge odmor od skrbi za minimalno 25 osoba iz ciljane skupine projekta - osoba koje imaju priznato pravo na status roditelja njegovatelja i/ili njegovatelja. Navedeno će se ostvariti zapošljavanjem osoba koje će skrbiti i provoditi vrijeme s ovisnim članovima kućanstva kako bi se ciljanoj skupini omogućio kratkotrajni predah od fizičkih i emocionalnih zahtjeva koji su neizostavan dio svakodnevne brige i skrbi o djetetu s teškoćama u razvoju i/ili osobi s invaliditetom. Projekt će se provoditi na području Virovitičko-podravske županije.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a joint disaster and fire risk management centre on the island of Hvar
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja zajedničkog centra za upravljanje rizicima od katastrofa i požara na otoku Hvaru
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria|Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community
Operation_Summary_English: The project will build a common centre for disaster and fire risk management on the island of Hvar, which will improve the system of monitoring and surveillance of the entire area of the island of Hvar in order to reduce the risk of disasters and fires, with a special emphasis on strengthening the capacity and operational readiness of firefighting and the civil protection system. A special part of the purpose of the center refers to the Croatian Mountain Rescue Service - Station Split (Establishment of Hvar) which in the new space would have its own office for the area of the entire island of Hvar and its archipelago. The project leader is the City of Stari Grad, while the project partners are: 1. DVD Stari Grad, 2. Municipality of Jelsa, 3. Municipality of Sućuraj, 4. DVD Bol and 5.Croatian Mountain Rescue Service - Split Station.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se izgraditi zajednički centar za upravljanje rizicima od katastrofa i požara na otoku Hvaru kojim će se unaprijediti sustav nadzora i praćenja cijelog područja otoka Hvara radi smanjenja rizika od katastrofa i požara s posebnim naglaskom na jačanje kapaciteta i operativne spremnosti vatrogastva te sustava civilne zaštite. Poseban dio namjene centra odnosi se na Hrvatsku gorsku službu za spašavanje - Stanica Split (Ispostava Hvar) koja bi u novom prostoru imala svoj ured za područje cijelog otoka Hvara i pripadajućeg arhipelaga. Nositelj projekta je Grad Stari Grad, dok su projektni partneri redom: 1. DVD Stari Grad, 2. Općina Jelsa, 3. Općina Sućuraj, 4. DVD Bol i 5.Hrvatska gorska služba za spašavanje - Stanica Split.

Operation_Name_English: LightX testing and testing
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ispitivanje i testiranje sustava LightX
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project focuses on the development of an innovative system called LIGHT X for the performance of a light show with a swarm of drones. The system consists of drones, a communication system, a drone management system, and software packages for managing and positioning drones, real-time monitoring. The system provides advanced functionalities such as collision detection and recalculation of drone trajectories, safe landing of drones inside the swarm, automatic deployment. It is environmentally sustainable because it uses electricity instead of fossil fuels, does not generate light pollution or noise. The system is in the demonstration phase (TRL 8) and the Končar Institute of Electrical Engineering is required to test parts of the system and assess compliance with EU standards.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se fokusira na razvoj inovativnog sustava pod nazivom LIGHT X za izvedbu svjetlosnog show rojem dronova. Sustav se sastoji od dronova, komunikacijskog sustava, sustava upravljanja dronovima, te softverskih paketa za upravljanjem i pozicioniranjem dronova, nadzor u stvarnom vremenu. Sustav pruža napredne funkcionalnosti kao što su detekcija mogućih sudara i rekalkulacija putanja dronova, sigurno slijetanje dronova unutar roja, automatsko raspoređivanje. Ekološki je održiv jer koristi električnu energiju umjesto fosilnih goriva, ne stvara svjetlosno onečišćenje niti buku. Ssustav u fazi demonstracije (TRL 8) i potreban je angažman Končar Instituta za elektrotehniku za ispitivanje dijelova sustava i ocjenu sukladnosti s EU normama.

Operation_Name_English: Strategic partnership for the next generation of wood products - WOOD(R)EVOLUTION
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strateško partnerstvo za novu generaciju proizvoda od drva - WOOD(R)EVOLUTION
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in large enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will explore the possibilities of developing glued wood panels with cavities significantly lighter than classic real wood panels with the aim of developing innovations within the priority niche Wooden interiors and production of furniture tailored to the RLV Green Growth of Pannonian Croatia. The objective is to carry out R&D&I investment in the development of 2 innovative products with high internationalisation potential up to level TRL 8 : 1) innovative wood-aluminum interior Liteboard doors and 2) a table and chest of drawers with a click connection for Threespine technology. The project is implemented by the SPIN consortium of BJELIN SPAČVA d.o.o., 3 SME partners and OIŠZ. Target groups: employees of the Applicant and Partner, the academic community, customers of the Applicant and Partner, the company as a whole.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se istražiti mogućnosti razvoja lijepljene drvene ploče sa šupljinama značajno laganije u odnosu na klasične ploče od pravog drva s ciljem razvoja inovacija unutar prioritetne niše Drvni interijeri i proizvodnja namještaja po mjeri RLV-a Zeleni rast Panonske Hrvatske. Cilj je provesti IRI ulaganje u razvoj 2 inovativna proizvoda s visokim potencijalom internacionalizacije do razine TRL 8 : 1) inovativna drvo-aluminij unutarnja Liteboard vrata te 2) stol i komoda s klik spojem za Threespine tehnologiju. Projekt provodi SPIN konzorcij tvrtke BJELIN SPAČVA d.o.o., 3 partnera poduzetnika MSP-a i OIŠZ. Ciljne skupine: zaposlenici Prijavitelja i Partnera, akademska zajednica, kupci Prijavitelja i Partnera, društvo u cjelini.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a management system according to ISO 14001:2015 standard that will make the company more competitive on the national and international market and thus enable it to further grow in accordance with strategic goals. The implementation of the management system and the acquisition of ISO certification will result in greater customer confidence, but also a more productive, efficient and secure business, which is the interest of the company, employees, clients and suppliers who are the target group of the project. By implementing the project, the company will be able to get new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards, and in which so far it has not been able to compete.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normi ISO 14001:2015 koji će tvrtku učiniti konkurentnijom na nacionalnom i internacionalnom tržištu te joj time omogućiti daljnji rast u skladu sa strateškim ciljevima. Implementacija sustava upravljanja i stjecanje ISO certifikata rezultirat će većim povjerenjem kupaca, ali i produktivnijim, efikasnijim i sigurnijim poslovanjem, što je interes tvrtke, djelatnika, klijenata i dobavljača koji su ciljana skupina projekta. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama, a u kojima do sada nije mogla konkurirati.

Operation_Name_English: InterACT Green
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: InterACT Green
Operation_Summary_English: Green infrastructure management is a serious interdisciplinary task that needs to take into account complex needs and services. The project targets the underexploited River Drafe Forest park that has a high strategic interest for the agglomeration’s attractiveness. It aims to tackle the park management difficulties by creating the PLATFORM - a framework of digital services that will carry out data management and provide analysis for governing decisions, environmental monitoring, communication, facilities management among all relevant stakeholders and users. The proposed innovative solution will thus connect digital infrastructure to physical infrastructure regeneration within a full NEB spirit. The Urban Monitoring will rely on quantitative and qualitative metrics, overviewing the urban, environmental and social aspects of the project. A list of indicators will be co-created and monitored, thus enabling a strong, shared and accessible strategic analysis of the project impact with the stakeholders and the local population, particularly about social and functional diversity, energy consumption, heat issues, urban noises, commercial dynamization, participation and qualitative perception of the residents.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Upravljanje zelenom infrastrukturom ozbiljan je interdisciplinarni zadatak koji treba uzeti u obzir složene potrebe i usluge. Projekt je usmjeren na nedovoljno iskorišten park šuma rijeke Drafe koji je od velikog strateškog interesa za privlačnost aglomeracije. Cilj mu je rješavanje poteškoća u upravljanju parkovima stvaranjem PLATFORME - okvira digitalnih usluga koji će provoditi upravljanje podacima i pružiti analizu za upravljanje odlukama, praćenjem okoliša, komunikacijom, upravljanjem objektima među svim relevantnim dionicima i korisnicima. Predloženim inovativnim rješenjem stoga će se digitalna infrastruktura povezati s fizičkom obnovom infrastrukture u duhu novog europskog Bauhausa. Praćenje gradova oslanjat će se na kvantitativne i kvalitativne parametre kojima će se analizirati urbani, okolišni i socijalni aspekti projekta. Zajednički će se izraditi i pratiti popis pokazatelja, čime će se omogućiti snažna, zajednička i dostupna strateška analiza učinka projekta s dionicima i lokalnim stanovništvom, posebno u pogledu društvene i funkcionalne raznolikosti, potrošnje energije, problema s toplinom, gradske buke, komercijalne dinamike, sudjelovanja i kvalitativne percepcije stanovnika.

Operation_Name_English: Aduro Care
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Aduro skrb
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the "Aduro Care" project is to provide support and support services in everyday life for 150 elderly people and people with disabilities living in the area of the town of Knin and the municipality of Biskupija, Targetane and Kiev. The provision of support and support services, in addition to the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies, will be achieved by fulfilling the activities of: Recruitment of 25 service providers for 150 people - which will help organize food, perform household chores, maintain personal hygiene and meet other daily needs. The services performed, the entire procurement process and the division of packages will be continuously monitored and controlled. Communication and visibility and quality management of the project team and administration will improve the implementation of the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta "Aduro skrb" je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 150 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom koje žive na području grada Knina te općine Biskupija, Ciljane i Kijevo. Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške, uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština ostvarit će se ispunjavanjem aktivnosti: zapošljavanje 25 pružatelja usluga za 150 osoba - koji će pomoći u organizaciji prehrane, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, održavanju osobne higijene i zadovoljavanju ostalih svakodnevnih potreba. Kontinuirano će se pratiti i kontrolirati izvršene usluge, cjelokupni proces nabave i podjele paketa. Komunikacijom i vidljivošću te kvalitetnim upravljanjem projektnim timom i administracijom poboljšat će se provedba projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction and upgrading of the port open to public traffic in the village of Martinšćica on the island of Cres
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija i dogradnja luke otvorene za javni promet u naselju Martinšćica na otoku Cresu
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The project of reconstruction and extension of the port open to public traffic in the village of Martinšćica on the island of Cres aims to increase the safety of navigation and reception of vessels in the port and the capacity of utility berths. The total value of the project is 11,603,496.00 euro, of which 11,572,246,00 euro relates to eligible costs and 31,250,00 euro to ineligible costs. Of the total eligible costs, EUR 9 803 038.75 relates to State aid and EUR 1 769 207.25 does not relate to State aid. Of the total eligible costs of the project, which are also grants, EUR 9 836 409.10 relates to the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF), EUR 1 735 836.90 to the State Budget (DP).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt rekonstrukcije i dogradnje luke otvorene za javni promet u naselju Martinšćica na otoku Cresu ima za cilj povećanje sigurnost plovidbe i prihvata plovila u luci te kapaciteta komunalnih vezova. Ukupan vrijednost projekta je 11.603.496,00 eura od čega se 11.572.246,00 eura odnosi na prihvatljive, a 31.250,00 eura na neprihvatljive troškove. Od ukupnih prihvatljivih troškova 9.803.038,75 eura se odnosi na državne potpore, a 1.769.207,25 eura se ne odnosi na državne potpore. Od ukupnih prihvatljivih troškova projekta koji ujedno čine i bespovratna sredstva, 9.836.409,10 eura se odnosi na sredstva Europskog fonda za regionalni razvoj (EFRR), 1.735.836,90 eura na sredstva Državnog proračuna (DP).

Operation_Name_English: Aid to promote the employment and self-employment of unemployed persons
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Potpore za poticanje zapošljavanja i samozapošljavanja nezaposlenih osoba
Category_Label: Measures to improve access to employment
Operation_Summary_English: This project covers the implementation of active employment policy measures that encourage employment and/or the start-up of the unemployed's own business. The project primarily covers the granting of employment aid, support for self-employment and support for traineeships, however, it also covers the granting of other types of support that co-finance employment. The target groups are all unemployed people aged 30 and over, with a particular focus on disadvantaged groups in the labour market. The project contributes to reducing long-term unemployment, increasing the employment rate and strengthening the workforce. The project is implemented through a financing model not linked to costs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom obuhvaćena je provedba mjera aktivne politike zapošljavanja kojima se potiče zapošljavanje i/ili pokretanje vlastitog poslovanja nezaposlenih osoba. Projekt primarno obuhvaća dodjelu potpora za zapošljavanje, potpora za samozapošljavanje i potpora za pripravništvo, međutim, obuhvaćena je i dodjela drugih vrsta potpora kojima se sufinancira zapošljavanje. Ciljane skupine su sve nezaposlene osobe starosti 30 godina i više, s posebnim naglaskom na skupine u nepovoljnom položaju na tržištu rada. Projekt doprinosi smanjenju dugotrajne nezaposlenosti, povećanju stope zapošljavanja i osnaživanju radne snage. Projekt se provodi putem modela financiranja koje nije povezano s troškovima.

Operation_Name_English: MI - For those in need
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: MI – za potrebite
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to encourage social inclusion and increase the quality of life of 186 beneficiaries of the target group in the area of project implementation in the Osijek-Baranja County. This brings together the very core of the ESF+ because, in addition to raising the quality of life of people in dire need, it also works to prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups. Activities in the project are the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of a package of supplies that includes: recruitment of 31 service providers for 186 members of the target group, monitoring and controlling the execution of services through the recruitment of controllers, ensuring their own visibility of the project by procuring promotional materials and project management and administration through the recruitment of project managers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je potaknuti socijalnu uključenost i povećati razinu kvalitete života 186 korisnika pripadnika ciljane skupine na području provedbe projekta u dijelu Osječko-baranjske županije. Time spajamo samu srž ESF+ jer osim što podižemo kvalitetu života osobama kojim je pomoć prijeko potrebna ujedno se i radi na prevenciji institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina. Aktivnosti u projektu su pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje: zapošljavanje 31 pružatelja usluga za 186 pripadnika ciljane skupine, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenja usluga zapošljavanjem kontrolora, osiguranje vlastite vidljivosti projekta nabavkom promotivnih materijala i upravljanje projektom i administracija kroz zapošljavanje voditelja projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Regional platform for industrial transition in functional and healthy food based on green nut shell extract - JUGLANS REGIA
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Regionalna platforma za industrijsku tranziciju u području funkcionalne i zdrave hrane temeljene na ekstraktu zelene ljuske oraha - JUGLANS REGIA
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in micro enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The JUGLANS REGIA project will create a regional value chain whose purpose is to obtain a high-value extract from green shell and walnut septum using scientific-research activities that will be applied in high-added-value products. The cooperation of three micro and small enterprises and two research organizations in the rounded development process from raw material production, extraction, analysis and testing of extract properties, application in food supplements, development of innovative packaging and planning of the production process will contribute to the industrial transition of Pannonian Croatia, increase income, number of employees and respond to recognized regional challenges.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom JUGLANS REGIA stvorit će se regionalni lanac vrijednosti čija je svrha primjenom znanstveno - istraživačkih aktivnosti zelenih ekstrakcijskih tehnika iz zelene ljuske i septuma oraha dobiti visokovrijedan ekstrakt koji će se primijeniti u proizvodima visoke dodane vrijednosti. Suradnjom triju mikro i malih poduzeća i dviju istraživačkih organizacija u zaokruženom razvojnom procesu od proizvodnje sirovine, ekstrakcije, analiza i testiranja svojstava ekstrakta, primjeni u dodacima prehrani, razvoju inovativne ambalaže i planiranju proizvodnog procesa doprinijet će se industrijskoj tranziciji Panonske Hrvatske, povećati prihode, broj zaposlenih i odgovoriti na prepoznate regionalne izazove.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment of the Academy of Social Welfare and Human Resources Development in the Social Welfare System
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uspostava Akademije socijalne skrbi i razvoj ljudskih potencijala u sustavu socijalne skrbi
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: Within the implementation of the project, activities aimed at the establishment, promotion, development and improvement of the capacities of the Social Welfare Academy for the implementation of training and supervision activities for professionals in the social welfare system will be realized. Also, during the implementation of the project, a total of 1,500 experts from the social welfare system will be organized professional training activities and supervision for 1,000 experts from the social welfare system.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: U okviru provedbe projekta realizirati će se aktivnosti usmjerene na uspostavu, promociju, razvoj i unapređenja kapaciteta Akademije socijalne skrbi za provođenje djelatnosti usavršavanja i supervizije za stručnjake u sustavu socijalne skrbi. Također tijekom provedbe projekta ukupno će se organizirati aktivnosti stručnog usavršavanja za ukupno 1.500 stručnjaka iz sustava socijalne skrbi te supervizije za 1.000 stručnjaka iz sustava socijalne skrbi.

Operation_Name_English: New Cinema Europe – improving public cultural infrastructure
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Novo Kino Europa – unaprjeđenje javne kulturne infrastrukture
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "New Cinema Europe - Improving Public Cultural Infrastructure" aims at revitalising and relaunching China Europe in order to increase accessibility and participation in the cultural life of all citizens. With the revitalization, the iconic Cinema Europa returns to the area of public cultural life of the City of Zagreb with new programs and a richer cultural offer for a diverse audience, which directly contributes to the preservation of the cultural heritage and the identity of the City. The duration of the project is 30 months, the Applicant is the City of Zagreb, and the Partner is an institution in culture, Cultural Information Center. The total value of the project is 11.616.161,00 €, of which the European Regional Development Fund is required to provide co-financing in the amount of 6.000.000,00 €.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Novo Kino Europa- unaprjeđenje javne kulturne infrastrukture“ usmjeren je na revitalizaciju i ponovno stavljanje u funkciju Kina Europa u cilju povećanja pristupačnosti i sudjelovanja u kulturnom životu svih građana. Revitalizacijom se kultno Kino Europa vraća u prostor javnog kulturnog života Grada Zagreba s novim programima i bogatijom kulturnom ponudom za raznoliku publiku čime se izravno doprinosi očuvanju kulturne baštine i identitetu Grada. Trajanje provedbe projekta je 30 mjeseci, Prijavitelj je Grad Zagreb, a Partner je ustanova u kulturi, Kulturno informativni centar. Ukupna vrijednost Projekta iznosi 11.616.161,00 €, od čega se od Europskog fonda za regionalni razvoj potražuje sufinanciranje u iznosu od 6.000.000,00 €.

Operation_Name_English: Turn me on, too!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uključi i mene!
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective: the provision of support and support services in the daily life of the elderly and persons with disabilities. Once eligible persons have responded to the selection criteria laid down in the PDP in question, they will start recruiting service providers for at least 6 members of the target group. Employees on the project will help members of the target group to organize food, perform household chores, maintain personal hygiene, packages with household and hygiene supplies will be purchased and distributed, and the applicants will work together with their partner on project visibility, project management and administration. 180 members of the target group are planned to be included, with a total of 30 domestic helpers employed.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj: pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Nakon što se po kriteriju odabira propisanim predmetnim PDP-om odazovu osobe koje zadovoljavaju uvjete krenut će se sa zapošljavanjem pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine. Zaposlene osobe na projektu pripadnicima ciljane skupine pomoći će u organizaciji prehrane, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, održavanju osobne higijene, nabavit će se i podijeliti paketi s kućanskim i higijenskim potrepštinama te će prijavitelji zajedno s partnerom odrađivati vidljivost projekta te upravljanje projektom i administracijom. Planira se uključiti 180 pripadnika ciljane skupine što ukupno broji 30 zaposlenih pružatelja usluge pomoći u kući.

Operation_Name_English: UltraxFV Product Certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija proizvoda UltraxFV
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With the project, the company wants to carry out the preparation of the prescribed technical documentation, then CE and EMC testing plus obtaining positive test reports in order to obtain declarations of conformity / CE and EMC certification by an accredited body for the developed UltraxFV device, in order to facilitate and speed up its placement on the EU market. The goals of the company are internationalization of products, expansion into the EU market, growth of sales and export revenues and increase of competitiveness.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka projektom želi provesti pripremu propisane tehničke dokumentacije, potom CE i EMC ispitivanje plus ishođenje pozitivnih ispitnih izvještaja u cilju dobivanja izjava o sukladnosti /certifikacije CE i EMC od strane akreditiranog tijela za razvijeni uređaj UltraxFV, u svrhu lakšeg i bržeg plasiranja istog na EU tržište. Ciljevi tvrtke su internacionalizacija proizvoda, širenje na EU tržište, rast prihoda od prodaje i izvoza te povećanje konkurentnosti.

Operation_Name_English: PUNa community bag I.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PUNa torba zajedništva I.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure inclusive education, increase social inclusion and integration of 47 students with disabilities into regular and special programs in primary education institutions in the area of the towns of the founders of Poreč and Rovinj by providing support to 47 teaching assistants for the school year 2023/2024. Project activities are Project Management and Administration, PUN Selection Process, PUN Record, Providing Support to Students with Disabilities through Monthly PUN Work and Communication and Visibility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguranje inkluzivnog obrazovanja, povećanje socijalne uključenosti i integracije 47 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u redovne i posebne programe u osnovnoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama na području gradova osnivača Poreča i Rovinja kroz osiguranje podrške 47 pomoćnika u nastavi za školsku godinu 2023/2024. Aktivnosti projekta su Upravljanje projektom i administracija, postupak selekcije PUN, Evidencija PUN, Pružanje potpore učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju kroz mjesečni rad PUN te Komunikacija i vidljivost.

Operation_Name_English: SCIENTIFIC AVANTURA
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZNANSTVENA AVANTURA
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project improves the capacities of EDUKA and partner educational organizations for the development and implementation of STEM activities through study trips, conferences, STEM fairs and training with mentoring during which 18 employees and volunteers will develop new knowledge and working methods. STEM workshops will be organized and conducted in the field of physics, brain science, astronomy, environment and environmental protection, chemistry, biology, biomedicine, GLOBE program, agronomy, meteorology, virtual reality for elementary school and kindergarten students, in order to popularize and increase the opportunities and availability of quality STEM programs. 120 workshops per year will include 700 students per year with 12 public presentations of STEM activities per year
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se unaprjeđuju kapaciteti EDUKE te partnerskih obrazovnih organizacija za razvoj i implementaciju STEM aktivnosti kroz studijska putovanja, konferencije, STEM sajmove te izobrazbom sa mentorstvom tijekom koji će 18 zaposlenika i volontera razvijati nova znanja i metode rada. Organizirati će se i provesti STEM radionice iz područja fizike, znanosti o mozgu, astronomije, okolišu i zaštiti okoliša, kemije, biologije, biomedicina, GLOBE programa, agronomije, meteorologije, virtualne stvarnosti za učenike osnovnih škola i vrtića, a u svrhu popularizacije te povećanja prilika i dostupnosti kvalitetnih STEM programa. U 120 radionica godišnje biti će uključeno 700 učenika godišnje uz 12 javnih predstavljanje STEM aktivnosti godišnje

Operation_Name_English: "Want to stay in your home"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Zaželi - ostani u domu svom"
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support in everyday life to persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities 18 and over) in the area of the towns of Vrbovec and Rab and the municipalities of Dubrava, Gradec, Farkaševac, Rakovec, Preska and Lapor, thus contributing to social inclusion and the prevention or postponement of institutional care. The project will employ 25 service providers for at least 150 members of the target group, of which 22 service providers for the area under the competence of the applicant, and 3 for the area of the Partner, for monitoring and control of the services performed, procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies with the prescribed mandatory content, communication and visibility, and project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom 18 i više godina) na području gradova Vrbovca i Raba te općina Dubrava, Gradec, Farkaševac, Rakovec, Preska i Lapor čime se pridonosi socijalnoj uključenosti i prevenciji ili odgađanju institucionalnog zbrinjavanja. Projektom će se zaposliti 25 pružatelja usluge za najmanje 150 pripadnika ciljane skupine, od toga 22 pružatelja usluge za područje iz nadležnosti prijavitelja, a 3 za područje Partnera, za praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština s propisanim obaveznim sadržajem, komunikaciju i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of JetOS d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva JetOS d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the implementation and certification of quality management system according to ISO 9001 standard and information security management system according to ISO 27001 standard in the company JetOS d.o.o. The certification will increase the efficiency of business processes, ensure higher data protection standards and improve the international competitiveness of the company. The project will facilitate access to new markets, increase customer and partner confidence and reduce operational risks. Certification according to internationally recognized standards will ensure the long-term viability of the business and strengthen the market position.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je implementacija i certifikacija sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema normi ISO 9001 i sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema normi ISO 27001 u poduzeću JetOS d.o.o. Certifikacijom će se povećati učinkovitost poslovnih procesa, osigurati viši standardi zaštite podataka te poboljšati međunarodna konkurentnost poduzeća. Projekt će omogućiti lakši pristup novim tržištima, povećanje povjerenja klijenata i partnera te smanjenje operativnih rizika. Certifikacija prema međunarodno priznatim normama osigurat će dugoročnu održivost poslovanja i jačanje tržišne pozicije.

Operation_Name_English: Social dialogue for change: Strengthening the capacity of social partners in the media through training and cooperation
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalni dijalog za promjene: Jačanje kapaciteta socijalnih partnera u medijima kroz osposobljavanje i suradnju
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Social Dialogue for Change: Strengthening the capacity of social partners in the media through training and cooperation" aims to strengthen the capacity of social partners in the media sector to operate in the labour market through their training and networking and the development of services intended for membership. Trade union commissioners will strengthen their capacities through education, workshops and a series of networking activities in Croatia and abroad, and the project will develop 5 digital services for membership, including the AI Trade Union Commissioner application, podcast series and the online Trade Union School.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Socijalni dijalog za promjene: Jačanje kapaciteta socijalnih partnera u medijima kroz osposobljavanje i suradnju“ za cilj ima ojačati kapacitete socijalnih partnera iz sektora medija za djelovanje na tržištu rada kroz njihovo osposobljavanje i umrežavanje te razvoj usluga namijenjenih članstvu. Sindikalni povjerenici će jačati svoje kapacitete kroz edukacije, radionice i niz aktivnosti umrežavanja u Hrvatskoj i inozemstvu, a projektom će razviti 5 digitalnih usluga za članstvo, uključujući aplikaciju AI Sindikalni Povjerenik, serijal podcasta te online Sindikalnu školu.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading and equipping an existing institution for pre-school education
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja i opremanje postojeće ustanove za predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: A key problem addressed by this project is the low participation rate of preschool children in early childhood education and care. There are also significant regional differences in the coverage of preschool children. It is therefore necessary to create infrastructural conditions that will make it possible to increase the availability of early childhood education and care for all children. The aim of the project is to provide infrastructural and material capacities in order to increase the availability and efficiency of early childhood education and care for all children from the earliest age. Target groups: Children from the area of the City of Senj aged 3 to 7 years, as well as future generations who will attend the Kindergarten "Travica".
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ključni problem koji adresira ovaj projekt je niska stopa sudjelovanja djece predškolske dobi u ranom i predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju. Također postoje i izrazite regionalne razlike u obuhvatu djece predškolskim programom. Stoga je nužno stvoriti infrastrukturne uvjete koji će omogućiti povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja svoj djeci. Cilj projekta je osigurati infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete u svrhu povećanja dostupnosti i učinkovitosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja za svu djecu od najranije dobi. Ciljne skupine: Djeca sa područja Grada Senja u dobi od 3 do 7 godina kao i budući naraštaji koji će pohađati Dječji vrtić "Travica".

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of the port of Rab (stage 1 - part 2) and access road
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija luke Rab (faza 1 - dio 2) i pristupne ceste
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The project of reconstruction of the port of Rab (stage 1 - part 2) and the access road aims to ensure the safety of navigation and the reception of vessels in the port, the protection of the property of the port and users, the provision of functional access to the port and sufficient capacity of utility berths. The total value of the project is EUR 14,394,199.50, of which EUR 14,362,859.50 relates to eligible costs and EUR 31,250 to ineligible costs. Of the total eligible costs, EUR 9,165,255.12 relates to State aid and EUR 5,197,654.38 does not relate to State aid.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt rekonstrukcije luke Rab (faza 1 - dio 2) i pristupne ceste ima za cilj osiguravanje sigurnosti plovidbe i prihvata plovila u luci, zaštite imovine luke i korisnika, osiguravanje funkcionalnog pristupa luci te dostatnog kapaciteta komunalnih vezova. Ukupna vrijednost projekta je 14.394.109,50 eura od čega se 14.362.859,50 eura odnosi na prihvatljive, a 31.250,00 eura na neprihvatljive troškove. Od ukupnih prihvatljivih troškova 9.165.205,12 eura se odnosi na državne potpore, a 5.197.654,38 eura se ne odnosi na državne potpore.

Operation_Name_English: the Caritas of the Diocese of Sisak
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi u Caritasu Sisačke biskupije
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of older people and people with disabilities by providing long-term care through the provision of support and support services in everyday life for 18 older people and people with disabilities. The project will be implemented for 36 months. The first 2 months are foreseen for the formation of a project team, the publication of a public call for expression of interest, the selection of a target group, the procurement of packages and the recruitment of service providers. The next 33 months are foreseen for the provision of support and support services, their monitoring and control as well as the distribution of packages. A final report will be prepared in the last month. Communication and visibility (publications and 2 round tables) and project management will be carried out continuously during the implementation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećati socijalnu uključenost i prevenciju institucionalizacije starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 18 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom. Projekt će se provoditi 36 mjeseci. Prva 2 mjeseca su predviđena za formiranje projektnog tima, objavu javnog poziva za iskaz interesa, odabir ciljane skupine, nabavu paketa i zapošljavanje pružatelja usluge. Naredna 33 mjeseca predviđena su za pružanje usluge potpore i podrške, praćenje i kontrolu istih te podjelu paketa. Zadnji mjesec će se pripremati završni izvještaj. Kontinuirano tijekom provedbe će se provoditi komunikacija i vidljivost (objave i 2 okrugla stola), te upravljanje projektom.

Operation_Name_English: Rest from caring for the quality of family life
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmor od skrbi za kvalitetu obiteljskog života
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project Rest from care for the quality of family life is planned to provide a service of rest from care for 21 parents of caregivers/carers in the area of the City of Zagreb and Sisak-Moslavina County. The Center for Rehabilitation Zagreb, as the applicant and partner of the Association for Persons with Disabilities of Sisak-Moslavina County, will employ three workers who will directly provide the service of rest from care. The service will be provided at the home of the parent caregiver/carer, at the service provider and in the community and will be created according to the needs of the family. In doing so, the applicant and partner will use their professional capacities to provide the service on a regular basis. During the 18 months of the project, at least 315 days of providing the service of rest from care are planned.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Odmor od skrbi za kvalitetu obiteljskog života planira se pružiti usluga odmor od skrbi za 21 roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja na području Grada Zagreba i Sisačko- moslavačke županije. Centar za rehabilitaciju Zagreb, kao prijavitelj i partner Udruga za osobe s invaliditetom Sisačko-moslavačke županije zaposlit će tri radnika koji će direktno pružati uslugu odmor od skrbi. Usluga će se pružati u domu roditelja njegovatelja/ njegovatelja, kod pružatelja usluge i u zajednici te će biti kreirana prema potrebama obitelji. Pri tome će prijavitelj i partner koristiti svoje stručne kapacitete kako bi se usluga redovito pružala. Tijekom 18 mjeseci trajanja projekta planira se najmanje 315 dana pružanja usluge odmor od skrbi.

Operation_Name_English: Croatian safe steps - CROSS II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Croatian safe steps - CROSS II
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims at demining a total of 48,720,648 m2 (4,872.06 ha) of forest and forest land from mine-explosives (MES) and unexploded ordnance (UXO), in the area of 4 counties (Karlovačka, Ličko-senjska, Sisak-Moslavačka and Splitsko-dalmatinska). Demining activities will be carried out at 76 demining sites and the implementation of the project will enable the effective reduction of mine suspected areas (MIA), improving the safety of citizens and tourists in the Republic of Croatia, protecting the health and life of people, protecting the environment and preserving property. Of the 76 demining sites, 43 are located in a protected area of the Natura 2000 ecological network. The applicant is the Ministry of the Interior .
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je razminiranje ukupno 48.720.648 m2 (4.872,06 ha) šuma i šumskog zemljišta od minsko-eksplozivnih sredstava (MES) i neeksplodiranih ubojnih sredstava (NUS), na području 4 županije (Karlovačka, Ličko-senjska, Sisačko-moslavačka i Splitsko-dalmatinska). Aktivnosti razminiranja provodit će se na 76 radilišta razminiranja te će se provedbom projekta omogućiti učinkovito smanjenje minski sumnjivog područja (MSP), poboljšanje sigurnosti građana i turista u RH, zaštita zdravlja i života ljudi, zaštita okoliša i očuvanje imovine. Od 76 radilišta razminiranja, 43 radilišta se nalaze na zaštićenom području ekološke mreže Natura 2000. Prijavitelj je Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova .

Operation_Name_English: Design of the port of Omiš – Phase II of construction – Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uređenje luke Omiš – II. faza izgradnje – faza 2
Category_Label: Other seaports
