Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the project ‘Development of the Port of Omiš – Phase II of construction’ is the reconstruction and upgrading of the Port of Omiš, which will ensure optimal conditions for the provision of public passenger maritime transport throughout the year and establish a new regular shipping line with Postira on the island of Brač. The new port will consist of land and sea waters, will be increased to a total of 745 m of coastline for mooring within the protected waters and to another 280 m of coastline for mooring on the outer breakwater. The total value of the project is 10,766,080,93 EUR of which 6,747,145,92 EUR are eligible costs and the remaining 4,018,935.01 EUR are non-eligible costs. The total value of Phase 2 of the project is EUR 2,705,927.02, of which EUR 1,064,794.93 and EUR 1,064,794.93 respectively. EUR 1.641.132,09.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta „Uređenje luke Omiš – II. faza izgradnje“ je rekonstrukcija i dogradnja luke Omiš čime će se osigurati optimalni uvjeti za obavljanje javnog putničkog pomorskog prometa tokom cijele godine i uspostaviti nova redovna brodska linija s Postirama na otoku Braču. Nova luka sastojat će se od kopnenog dijela i morskog akvatorija, povećat će se na ukupno 745 m obale za privez unutar zaštićenog akvatorija te na još 280 m obale za privez na vanjskom lukobranu. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 10.766.080,93 EUR od čega je 6.747.145,92 EUR prihv. troškova, a preostalih 4.018.935,01 EUR su neprihv. troškovi. Ukupna vrijednost 2. faze projekta iznosi 2.705.927,02 EUR, od čega prihv. tr. iznose 1.064.794,93 EUR, a neprihv. 1.641.132,09 EUR.

Operation_Name_English: Golden Hands for the Golden Age
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zlatne ruke za zlatnu dob
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is to provide support and support to everyday life of people over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities, increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups in the area of the city of Popovača. The project will provide a service for at least 180 members of the target group who will be able to improve the quality of life through project activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je ovog projekta pružanje usluge potpore i podrške svakodnevnom životu osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom, povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina na području grada Popovače. Projektom će se usluga pružati za najmanje 180 osoba pripadnika ciljne skupine kojima će se kroz projektne aktivnosti omogućiti unaprjeđenje kvalitete života.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction and renovation - Kaptol Old Town
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija i obnova - Stari grad Kaptol
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The reconstruction and reconstruction of the Old Town in Kaptol will create a unique cultural centre, which will contribute to the development of cultural content in the rural area and create the preconditions for the participation of the local population in the cultural life of the community. The presented content, as well as the building itself, its decoration, equipping and the surrounding area around the building, enables target groups of a very wide range, from kindergarten, primary school age, secondary education as well as faculties and high science, and foreign and domestic visitors of different age groups and levels of knowledge. By implementing innovative technological solutions, heritage wealth will be presented and made available to the entire community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcijom i obnovom Starog grada u Kaptolu, stvorit će se jedinstvena kulturni centar, koji će svojim uslugama doprinijeti razvoju kulturnih sadržaja u ruralnom području kao i stvoriti preduvjete za sudjelovanjem lokalnog stanovništva u kulturnom životu zajednice. Prezentirani sadržaj, kao i sama zgrada, njeno uređenje, opremanje i okolno područje oko zgrade, omogućuje ciljane skupine vrlo širokog raspona, od vrtićke, osnovnoškolske dobi, srednjoškolskog obrazovanja kao i fakulteta i visoku znanost, te inozemne i domaće posjetitelje različitih dobnih skupina i razina znanja. Implementacijom inovativnih tehnoloških rješenja, baštinsko bogatstvo biti će prezentirano i stavljeno na raspolaganje cijeloj zajednici.

Operation_Name_English: "PIR - Watch, Explore, Grow"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "PIR - promatraj, istražuj, rasti"
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The central problem that this project aims to solve is the lack of capacity of CSOs to implement STEM programs in kindergartens, elementary schools and elementary schools in the field of GDCK Vrbovec. This problem will be solved by strengthening the capacity of GDCK Vrbovec employees through education and mentoring, procurement of IT and other equipment and partnering for the implementation of STEM popularization activities, through a detailed plan of activities and implementation of workshops ensure quality, value-oriented, sustainable and applicable education of children and young people in the STEM field with an emphasis on astronomy, renewable energy and climate change activities, programming and robotics.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Centralni problem koji se želi riješiti ovim projektom je nedostatak kapaciteta OCD-a za provedu programa STEM-a u dječjim vrtićima, OŠ i SŠ na području djelovanja GDCK Vrbovec. Navedeni problem će se riješiti osnaživanjem kapaciteta zaposlenika GDCK Vrbovec edukacijom i mentorstvom, nabavom IT i dr. opreme te partnerskim povezivanjem za provedbu aktivnosti popularizacije STEM-a, kroz detaljno razrađen plan aktivnosti te provedbom radionica osigurati na području lokalne zajednice kvalitetno, vrijednosno usmjereno, održivo i primjenjivo obrazovanje djece i mladih u STEM području s naglaskom na aktivnosti astronomije, obnovljivih izvora energije i klimatskih promjena, programiranja i robotike.

Operation_Name_English: SPORT and STEM: Learning through movement
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SPORT i STEM: učenje kroz pokret
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: SPORTS RECREATION SOCIETY "Small SPORTS" in partnership with the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing in ZG, Remete Primary School, Lotrščak Primary School and Ružičnjak Primary School is implementing a project called "SPORT and STEM: Learning through movement" to respond to the multiple needs of school-age children and provide added value to their education and development through the integration of STEM into sports activities. This project aims to encourage children's curiosity, critical thinking and practical skills through a series of interactive workshops.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: DRUŠTVO SPORTSKE REKREACIJE "MALI SPORTAŠI" u partnerstvu s Fakultetom elektrotehnike i računarstva u ZG, Osnovnom školom Remete, Osnovnom školom Lotrščak i Osnovnom školom Ružičnjak provodi projekt pod nazivom "SPORT i STEM: učenje kroz pokret" kako bi odgovorilo na višestruke potrebe djece u školskoj dobi te pružilo dodanu vrijednost njihovom obrazovanju i razvoju kroz integraciju STEM-a u sportske aktivnosti. Ovaj projekt nastoji potaknuti dječju znatiželju, kritičko razmišljanje i praktične vještine kroz seriju interaktivnih radionica.

Operation_Name_English: And they're part of us III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: I oni su dio nas III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The realization of the activities of the project "And they are part of us III", aims to ensure the prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups through the provision of assistance in the home and in the performance of daily activities to the elderly and persons with disabilities. The service will be provided in the area of Virovitica-Podravina County. The project will employ 20 service providers to care for 120 beneficiaries.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Realizacijom aktivnosti projekta "I oni su dio nas III", nastoji se osigurati prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina kroz pružanje pomoći u kući i pri obavljanju svakodnevnih aktivnosti starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Usluga će biti pružena na području Virovitičko-podravske županije. U okviru projekta bit će zaposleno 20 pružatelja usluga koji će skrbiti o 120 korisnika.

Operation_Name_English: ‘Wish – Bjelovar’
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: „Zaželi – Bjelovar“
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of the project are to provide support and support services in everyday life to older people and people with disabilities by increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care through the employment of 33 service providers. Project activities provide support and support services with the procurement of packages and supplies that include the recruitment of service providers for 198 members of the target group.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta su pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom povećanjem socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi zapošljavanjem 33 pružatelja usluge. Aktivnosti projekta pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu paketa i potrepština koje uključuju zapošljavanje pružatelja usluge za 198 pripadnika ciljne skupine.

Operation_Name_English: Wish for Eagle
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi za Orle
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The specific objective of the project Zaželi za Orle is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and adults with disabilities. The main activities include the recruitment of 10 service providers for a duration of 33 months for a minimum of 60 members of the target group (min 6 users per employee), monitoring and control of service execution, procurement and distribution of packages of household supplies and basic hygiene supplies, IPV, UA.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Specifični cilj projekta Zaželi za Orle je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i punoljetnim osobama s invaliditetom. Glavne aktivnosti uključuju zapošljavanje 10 pružatelja usluge u trajanju 33 mjeseca za minimalno 60 pripadnika ciljane skupine (min 6 korisnika po zaposlenom), praćenje i kontrolu izvršenja usluga, nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih potrepština i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, IPV, UA.

Operation_Name_English: Digitalization and automation of the new gear making process
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Digitalizacija i automatizacija novog procesa izrade zupčanika
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project Digitization and automation of the new gear making process is aimed at optimizing the production process through digitization and automation of key steps. The aim is to develop a system for collecting, preparing and monitoring production parameters, which will allow for greater precision, reduced manual work and increased efficiency. The project will use advanced algorithms for data analysis and production optimization. Target groups include engineers, who will use a tool to automate the collection of dimensions and preparation of data, and production operators who will benefit from more precise input data for more efficient operation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Digitalizacija i automatizacija novog procesa izrade zupčanika usmjeren je na optimizaciju proizvodnog procesa kroz digitalizaciju i automatizaciju ključnih koraka. Cilj je razviti sustav za prikupljanje, pripremu i nadzor parametara proizvodnje, što će omogućiti veću preciznost, smanjenje ručnog rada i povećanje učinkovitosti. Projekt će koristiti napredne algoritme za analizu podataka i optimizaciju proizvodnje. Ciljne skupine uključuju inženjere, koji će koristiti alat za automatizaciju prikupljanja dimenzija i pripreme podataka, te proizvodne operatere koji će imati koristi od preciznijih ulaznih podataka za učinkovitiji rad.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of MDM-INDUSTRY SERVICE d.o.o. by introducing a management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća MDM-INDUSTRY SERVICE d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The main objective of this project is the introduction (certification) of a quality, professional and occupational health and safety management system (ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, EN 1090-2, EN ISO 3834-3) in the company MDM-INDUSTRY SERVICE d.o.o. The purpose of this project is to increase the competitiveness of the company. The results of the project are increased sales revenues, increased export revenues and a total of 4 certified management systems. The introduction of certificates increases international competitiveness by ensuring compliance with global standards, facilitates access to new markets, strengthens customer confidence and enables participation in larger projects. The target groups covered by the project are the owner of the company (director), employees, customers and business partners.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osnovni cilj predmetnog projekta je uvođenje (certificiranje) sustava upravljanja kvalitetom, stručnošću te zdravljem i sigurnošću na radu (ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, EN 1090-2, EN ISO 3834-3) u poduzeću MDM-INDUSTRY SERVICE d.o.o. Svrha predmetnog je povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća. Rezultati projekta su povećani prihodi od prodaje, povećani prihodi od izvoza te ukupno 4 certificirana sustava upravljanja. Uvođenje certifikata povećava međunarodnu konkurentnost osiguravanjem usklađenosti s globalnim standardima, olakšava pristup novim tržištima, jača povjerenje klijenata i omogućuje sudjelovanje na većim projektima. Ciljne skupine obuhvaćene projektom su vlasnik poduzeća (direktor), zaposlenici, kupci te poslovni partneri.

Operation_Name_English: It's best to stay at home - so be it.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kod kuće je najbolje - neka tako i ostane
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: General objective – to contribute to social inclusion through employment and social integration of vulnerable disadvantaged groups in areas with fewer opportunities, in particular in the sector of social support and support services in everyday life for older persons and persons with disabilities. Specific objective – to strengthen the labour and personal potential of 14 unemployed persons from the Municipality of Dvor. Activities – employment of 14 people to provide services to 84 elderly and disabled people. Monthly monitoring and control.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj – doprinos socijalnom uključivanju kroz zapošljavanje i socijalnu integraciju ranjive skupine osoba u nepovoljnom položaju u području s manje mogućnosti, posebno u sektoru socijalnih usluga potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Posebni cilj – osnažiti radne i osobne potencijale 14 nezaposlenih osoba s područja Općine Dvor. Aktivnosti – zapošljavanje 14 osoba koje će pružati usluge za 84 starije osobe te osobe s invaliditetom. Praćenje i kontrola na mjesečnoj razini.

Operation_Name_English: Transition from institutional to community-based care for children, young people and people with disabilities
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Prijelaz s institucionalne skrbi na skrb u zajednici za djecu, mlade i osobe s invaliditetom
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to continue and improve the implementation of the process of deinstitutionalization and transformation by ensuring the right of users to live in the community. In order to achieve the specific objectives related to providing support to the MROSP in the implementation of the process of deinstitutionalization and transformation of social service providers founded by the Republic of Croatia, support activities will be carried out: identification of key stakeholders in the process and development of recommendations for the purpose of cooperation, development of draft guidelines for preparation and support in the development of individual plans of service providers, support for the development of a transition monitoring mechanism, development of a work plan and support for the development of tools for the purpose of monitoring the transition from institutional to community-based care and support.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je nastavak i unapređenje provedbe procesa deinstitucionalizacije i transformacije osiguravanjem prava korisnika na život u zajednici. Radi ostvarenja specifičnih ciljeva koji se odnose na osiguravanje podršku MROSP-u u provedbi procesa deinstitucionalizacije i transformacije pružatelja socijalnih usluga čiji je osnivač Republika Hrvatska, provest će se aktivnosti podrške: identifikacija ključnih dionika u procesu i izrada preporuka u svrhu suradnje, izrada nacrta smjernica za pripremu i podrška u izradi individualnih planova pružatelja usluga, podrška razvoju mehanizma za praćenje prijelaza, razvoju plana rada te podrška razvoju alata u svrhu praćenja prijelaza s institucionalne skrbi na skrb i podršku u zajednici.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - you're not alone
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - nisi sam
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups, and the specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life to people over 65 years of age and OSI in the territory of the municipalities of Vela Luka, Blato and Smokvica. The project activities will enable the employment of 11 people who will provide support and support services and the procurement and distribution of household and hygiene supplies for at least 66 members of the target groups.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina, a specifični cilj je pružanje usluga potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu osobama starijim od 65 godina te OSI na području općina Vela Luka, Blato i Smokvica. Projektne aktivnosti omogućit će zapošljavanje 11 osoba koje će pružiti uslugu podrške i potpore te nabavu i podjelu kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština za najmanje 66 pripadnika ciljanih skupina.

Operation_Name_English: Cycling trail Bršadin - Vukovar and Trpinja-Vukovar
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Biciklistička staza Bršadin - Vukovar i Trpinja-Vukovar
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project of cycling trails of the Municipality of Trpinja will build sections from the settlements of Bršadin and Trpinja to the city of Vukovar, and connect a network of cycling trails intended for public use and connecting various forms of environmentally friendly public transport in order to increase the number of passengers in public transport. Cycling infrastructure of the Municipality of Trpinja will contribute to better connectivity on routes that serve for daily migration in the urban area, safety of cyclists, greater use of public means of transport. Using this infrastructure will reduce the use of passenger cars and other motor vehicles, thus reducing CO2 emissions into the environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom biciklističkih staza Općine Trpinja izgraditi će se dionice od naselja Bršadin i naselja Trpinja do grada Vukovara, te spojiti mreža biciklističkih staza namijenjenih javnoj uporabi i povezivanju raznih oblika javnog prijevoza prihvatljivih za okoliš radi povećanja broja putnika u javnom prijevozu. Biciklistička infrastruktura Općine Trpinja će doprinijeti boljoj povezanosti na linijama koje služe za dnevne migracije na području urbanog područja, sigurnosti biciklista, većem korištenju javnih sredstava prijevoza. Korištenjem ove infrastrukture smanjiti će se korištenje osobnih automobila i drugih motornih vozila, te time smanjiti emisije CO2 u okoliš.

Operation_Name_English: Breathing - rest from care
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Predah - odmor od skrbi
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The Predah project will provide rest from care to persons who have a recognised right to the status of parent caregiver or caregiver with the aim of improving the quality of life of the parent caregiver/caregiver and the person they care for, improving family dynamics and preventing institutionalization. The target group of this project is 20 parents of caregivers/carers from the area of Šibenik-Knin County
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Predah omogućiti će se odmor od skrbi osobama koje imaju priznato pravo na status roditelja njegovatelja ili njegovatelja ciljem poboljšanja kvalitete života roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja te osobe o kojoj skrbe, unaprjeđenja obiteljske dinamike i sprječavanja institucionalizacije. Ciljna skupina ovog projekta je 20 roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja s područja Šibensko-kninske županije

Operation_Name_English: Equal social and educational inclusion of students with disabilities III - RAST III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ravnomjerna socijalna i obrazovna inkluzija učenika s teškoćama u razvoju III - RAST III
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to support the inclusion of students with disabilities in primary school educational institutions, founded by the city of Labin, in order to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The main activity of the project is to support the education of students with disabilities through the work of teaching assistants.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružiti potporu uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove, čiji je osnivač grad Labin, kako bi se osigurati uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Glavna aktivnost projekta je pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi.

Operation_Name_English: Horizontal Transformation Project for Strengthening the Regional Ecosystem for Industrial Transition - HIT Project
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Horizontalni transformacijski projekt za jačanje regionalnog eko sustava za industrijsku tranziciju - HIT projekt
Category_Label: Advanced support services for SMEs and groups of SMEs (including management, marketing and design services)
NUTS3_Label: Krapinsko-zagorska županija|Brodsko-posavska županija|Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija|Virovitičko-podravska županija|Požeško-slavonska županija|Koprivničko-križevačka županija|Međimurska županija|Bjelovarsko-bilogorska županija|Šibensko-kninska županija|Karlovačka županija|Sisačko-moslavačka županija|Istarska županija|Zagrebačka županija|Varaždinska županija|Osječko-baranjska županija|Vukovarsko-srijemska županija|Zadarska županija|Primorsko-goranska županija|Ličko-senjska županija|Split-Dalmatia County
Operation_Summary_English: One of the implementation mechanisms that will drive the industrial transition of Adriatic, Pannonian and Northern Croatia refers to a horizontal transformation project that will support the establishment of efficient regional ecosystems for industrial transition in Adriatic, Pannonian and Northern Croatia, which is also one of the investment priorities under the Industrial Transition Plans of Adriatic, Pannonian and Northern Croatia contributing to the fulfilment of S3 objective "Industrial transition of Croatian regions" and NRS 2030 Strategic objective "Strengthening regional competitiveness". The overall objective of the project is to: Building an effective regional eco-system for the industrial transition of Croatian regions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Jedan od provedbenih mehanizama koji će potaknuti industrijsku tranziciju Jadranske, Panonske i Sjeverne Hrvatske odnosi se na horizontalni transformacijski projekt kojim će se dati podrška u uspostavi učinkovitih regionalnih ekosustava za industrijsku tranziciju u Jadranskoj, Panonskoj i Sjevernoj Hrvatskoj, što je ujedno i jedan od prioriteta ulaganja u okviru Planova za industrijsku tranziciju Jadranske, Panonske i Sjeverne Hrvatske kojim se doprinosi ispunjenju S3 cilja „Industrijska tranzicija hrvatskih regija“ te NRS 2030 Strateškom cilju „Jačanje regionalne konkurentnosti“. Opći cilj projekta je: Izgradnja učinkovitog regionalnog eko sustava za industrijsku tranziciju hrvatskih regija.

Operation_Name_English: TOGETHER TO KNOW YOU
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAJEDNO DO ZNANJA VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The JOINT TO KNOW VI project provides the necessary support to participate in the programmes of educational institutions for pupils with disabilities, by providing PUN/CPC professional assistance, during the three teaching years 2024/2025, 2025/2026 and 2026/2027. The aim of the project is to support the inclusion of students with disabilities in the educational institutions of the founder of the City of Pula, in order to provide conditions for the improvement of educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The target group is 154 students supported by 114 PUN/CPC. The total value of the project is 4,157,352.00 EUR for a duration of 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom ZAJEDNO DO ZNANJA VI omogućava se potrebna podrška za sudjelovanje u programima odgojno-obrazovnih ustanova učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju, osiguravanjem stručne pomoći PUN/SKP, tijekom tri nastavne godine 2024./2025., 2025./2026. i 2026./2027. Cilj projekta je pružiti potporu uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u odgojno-obrazovne ustanove osnivača Grada Pule, kako bi osigurali uvjete za poboljšanje obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Ciljna skupina je 154 učenika kojima je osigurana podrška 114 PUN/SKP. Ukupna vrijednost projekta je 4.157.352,00 EUR u trajanju od 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: KNOWLEDGE FOR ALL YOU
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZNANJE ZA SVE VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project provides support for the inclusion of 10 students with disabilities in Vladimir Nazor Elementary School and Zvonko Car Elementary School in the school year 2023/2024 through the work of educated PUN/CPC. Upon completion of the public tender, 10 PUN/CPC will be recruited.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se osigurava potpora uključivanju 10 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u OŠ Vladimira Nazora i OŠ Zvonka Cara u školskoj godini 2023./2024. kroz rad educiranih PUN/SKP. Po provedbi javnog natječaja zaposlit će se 10 PUN/SKP.

Operation_Name_English: Electrification and digitalisation of public bus transport
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Elektrifikacija i digitalizacija javnog autobusnog prijevoza
Category_Label: Clean urban transport rolling stock|Digitalisation of transport when dedicated in part to greenhouse gas emissions reduction: urban transport
Operation_Summary_English: The project applicant is Libertas - Dubrovnik d.o.o., and the aim of the project is to provide a sustainable and quality transport service to citizens by procuring new electric buses and supporting infrastructure that will ensure the electrification and digitalisation of public bus transport. The new buses will make it possible to increase the quality of public transport services and reduce the negative environmental impact. The estimated duration of the project is 36 months, and the target groups of the project are the employees of the Applicant and the users of the public transport service, and the end users refer to the general population.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavitelj projekta je Libertas - Dubrovnik d.o.o., a cilj projekta je osigurati održivu i kvalitetnu uslugu prijevoza građanima nabavom novih električnih autobusa i popratne infrastrukture kojima će se osigurati elektrifikacija i digitalizacija javnog autobusnog prijevoza. Novi autobusi omogućit će povećanje kvalitete pružanja usluge javnog prijevoza i smanjenje negativnog utjecaja na okoliš. Predviđeno trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci, a ciljne skupine projekta su djelatnici Prijavitelja te korisnici usluge javnog prijevoza, a krajnji korisnici odnose se na opću populaciju.

Operation_Name_English: Wish better 3
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi bolje 3
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Providing quality social services to vulnerable groups, disadvantaged people in rural areas of Osijek-Baranja County and prevention of institutionalization and increase of social inclusion through providing support in everyday life.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Pružanje kvalitetne socijalne usluge ranjivim skupinama, osobama u nepovoljnom položaju u ruralnim područjima Osječko-baranjske županije te prevencija institucionalizacije i povećanje socijalne uključenosti kroz pružanje potpore u svakodnevnom životu.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - prevention of institutionalization in Podbablje
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - prevencija institucionalizacije u Podbablju
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: PROJECT OBJECTIVES: The main objective of the project is to: strengthening the quality of life of vulnerable groups in the municipality of Podbablje, and the specific objectives are 1. Development of a non-institutional model of long-term and quality care for the elderly and infirm and persons with disabilities; and 2. Creation of new jobs in the municipality of Podbablje. PROJECT ACTIVITIES: 1. Providing support and support services; 2. Monitoring and control of performed services; 3. Acquisition and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies; 4. Communication and visibility; 5. Project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: CILJEVI PROJEKTA: Glavni cilj projekta je: jačanje kvalitete života osjetljivih skupina u općini Podbablje, a specifični ciljevi su 1. Razvoj izvaninstitucionalnog modela dugotrajne i kvalitetne skrbi o starijim i nemoćnim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom te 2. Stvaranje novih radnih mjesta u općini Podbablje. AKTIVNOSTI PROJEKTA: 1. Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške; 2. Praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga; 3. Nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština; 4. Komunikacija i vidljivost; 5. Upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of production certificates
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje proizvodnih certifikata
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to facilitate access to the international market and increase the competitiveness of the company Incite code d.o.o. through the implementation of internationally recognized norms and standards as well as management systems (introduction of BRC CP quality management system and introduction of ISO 13485 quality management system), which prove the level of quality and safety and contribute to customer confidence. This is fully in line with the purpose of the call in question.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha, odnosno cilj projekta jest olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu i povećati konkurentnost poduzeća Incite code d.o.o. kroz implementaciju međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda kao i sustava upravljanja(uvođenje BRC CP sustava upravljanja kvalitetom i uvođenje ISO 13485 sustava upravljanja kvalitetom), kojima se dokazuje razina kvalitete i sigurnosti te pridonosi povjerenju kupaca. Navedeno je u potpunosti usklađeno .sa svrhom predmetnog Poziva

Operation_Name_English: An overview of tourist attractions through augmented reality
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pregled turističkih atrakcija putem proširene stvarnosti
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in micro enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The problem faced by tourism stakeholders is the lack of digital solutions that would increase the experience during a tourist visit, and increase the satisfaction of tourists, especially people with disabilities. The aim is to develop an environmentally friendly digital tourism product for the purpose of developing priority niches through connecting entrepreneurs in the tourism value chain, increasing the resilience and productivity of the company and better positioning itself on the tourism market. The target groups are hotels and other accommodation facilities, tourist boards and other providers that will enable their guests to see additional local attractions through virtual reality.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Problem s kojim se susreću akteri turizma jest nedostatak digitalnih rješenja kojima bi se povećao iskustveni doživljaj prilikom turističkog posjeta, te povećalo zadovoljstvo turista, posebice osoba s invaliditetom. Cilj razviti digitalni turistički proizvod prihvatljiv za okoliš u svrhu razvoja prioritetnih niša putem povezivanja poduzetnika u lancu vrijednosti turizma, povećati otpornost i produktivnost tvrtke te se bolje pozicionirati na turističkom tržištu. Ciljne skupine su hoteli i drugi smještajni objekti, turističke zajednice i drugi ponuditelji koji će omogućiti svojim gostima uvid u dodatne lokalne atrakcije putem virtualne stvarnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of the management system of the company Sistemaš d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija sustava upravljanja poduzeća Sistemaš d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of the Applicant through the certification of the management system according to the standards ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018. Certification enables the standardisation of quality and information security management, increasing customer confidence and facilitating access to international markets. Expected results include increased sales and export revenues, optimization of business processes and compliance with EU regulations. The project ensures long-term sustainability and strengthens the competitive advantage through the certification of key management systems.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti Prijavitelja kroz certifikaciju sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO/IEC 27001:2022 i ISO/IEC 20000-1:2018. Certifikacija omogućuje standardizaciju upravljanja kvalitetom i informacijskom sigurnošću, povećavajući povjerenje klijenata i olakšavajući pristup međunarodnim tržištima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza, optimizaciju poslovnih procesa te usklađenost s EU regulativama. Projekt osigurava dugoročnu održivost i jačanje konkurentske prednosti kroz certifikaciju ključnih sustava upravljanja.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of the quality management system into the business of Soldered Electronics d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom u poslovanje poduzeća Soldered Electronics d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With the project Soldered Electronics d.o.o. plans to implement and certify four internationally recognized standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 27001, IATF 16949) with the aim of improving key business processes and increasing competitiveness in the global market. These standards will enable standardization, optimization and sustainability of all aspects of business, including production, development and data protection. By introducing these standards will increase mO efficiency, reduce costs and ensure consistent product quality, while strengthening the trust of clients and partners. Certification will facilitate access to international tenders, open new markets and position us as a reliable partner. Through the project, we will achieve long-term savings and increase revenue.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Soldered Electronics d.o.o. planira implementirati i certificirati četiri međunarodno priznate norme (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 27001, IATF 16949) s ciljem unapređenja ključnih poslovnih procesa i povećanja konkurentnosti na globalnom tržištu. Ove norme omogućit će standardizaciju, optimizaciju i održivost svih aspekata poslovanja, uključujući proizvodnju, razvoj i zaštitu podataka. Uvođenjem ovih standarda povećat ćemO učinkovitost, smanjiti troškove i osigurati dosljednu kvalitetu proizvoda, uz istovremeno jačanje povjerenja klijenata i partnera. Certifikacija će olakšati pristup međunarodnim natječajima, otvoriti nova tržišta i pozicionirati nas kao pouzdanog partnera. Kroz projekt ćemo postići dugoročne uštede i povećat prihod.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction and renovation of the "Lenije" swimming pool with additional sports and recreational facilities
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija i obnova plivališta „Lenije“ s dodatnim sportsko rekreacijskim sadržajem
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Protection, development and promotion of public tourism assets and tourism services
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to improve the quality of the sports and recreational infrastructure of the Vinkovci indoor swimming pool Lenije and increase the diversity of the tourist offer through the reconstruction, renovation and equipping of the swimming pool Lenije, which will result in increasing the diversity of the tourist offer of the city of Vinkovci and encourage the sustainable development of tourism throughout the year. This project solves the problem of insufficient capacities of Applicants for further development of sports and recreational and tourist facilities in the urban area of Vinkovci. Target groups are the City of Vinkovci, employees of the Lenije swimming pool and existing and future visitors of the swimming pool and multipurpose playground.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je unaprijediti kvalitetu sportsko-rekreacijske infrastrukture vinkovačkog dvoranskog plivališta Lenije i povećat raznovrsnost turističke ponude kroz rekonstrukciju, obnovi i opremanje plivališta Lenije što će rezultirati povećanjem raznovrsnosti turističke ponude grada Vinkovaca i potaknuti održivi razvoj turizma tijekom cijele godine. Ovim projektom rješava se problem nedostatnih kapaciteta Prijavitelja za daljnji razvoj sportsko-rekreacijskih i turističkih sadržaja na urbanom području Vinkovci. Ciljane skupine su Grad Vinkovci, zaposlenici plivališta Lenije i postojeći i budući posjetitelji plivališta i višenamjenskog igrališta.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of management system and product certification for Romb Technologies
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja i certifikacija proizvoda za Romb Technologies
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The Romb Technologies project is aimed at strengthening international competitiveness through the implementation of management systems according to ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 and compliance testing for forklift automation systems according to EMC Directive (EN 12895) and LVD Directive (EN 61010-1). Activities include the establishment of quality and information security systems and electromagnetic compatibility and electrical security tests in accredited laboratories. The results will ensure compliance with international standards, increase product safety, provide easier access to the European market for autonomous logistics vehicles, one of the fastest growing markets in the EU and globally, and directly contribute to the growth of revenues and exports of the company.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Romb Technologies usmjeren je na jačanje međunarodne konkurentnosti kroz implementaciju sustava upravljanja prema ISO 9001 i ISO 27001 te ispitivanja sukladnosti za sustav za automatizaciju viličara prema EMC direktivi (EN 12895) i LVD direktivi (EN 61010-1). Aktivnosti obuhvaćaju uspostavu sustava kvalitete i informacijske sigurnosti te ispitivanja elektromagnetske kompatibilnosti i električne sigurnosti u akreditiranim laboratorijima. Rezultati će osigurati usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima, povećati sigurnost proizvoda, omogućiti lakši pristup europskom tržištu autonomnih logističkih vozila, jednom od najbrže rastućih tržišta u EU i globalno, te izravno doprinijeti rastu prihoda i izvoza tvrtke.

Operation_Name_English: Research and development of innovative insulating components for transformers in line with manufacturing technologies of Industry 4.0
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Istraživanje i razvoj inovativnih izolacijskih komponenti za transformatore u skladu s proizvodnim tehnologijama industrije 4.0
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in large enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project addresses the problem of energy efficiency needs in the transformer industry and adaptation to Industry 4.0. By implementing the SPIN project, the consortium will develop two innovative products - innovative insulation components that will meet the needs for energy efficiency in the transformer industry, and commercialization will fill the market space, which will result in the growth of sales and export revenues and an increase in the number of employees. The project will also develop a high-security digital platform in line with the needs of Industry 4.0 and test equipment for testing insulating components. The target groups of the project are employees of the company within the SPIN consortium who will benefit in disseminating knowledge through the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt adresira problem potreba za energetskom učinkovitosti u industriji transformatora i prilagodbe industriji 4.0. Provedbom projekta SPIN konzorcij će razviti dva inovativna proizvoda - inovativne izolacijske komponente koje će zadovoljiti potrebe za energetskom učinkovitosti u industriji transformatora, te komercijalizacijom ispuniti prostor na tržištu što će rezultirati rastom prihoda od prodaje i izvoza te povećanjem broja zaposlenih. U sklopu projekta će također biti razvijena visokosigurna digitalna platforma u skladu s potrebama industrije 4.0 te ispitna oprema za testiranje izolacijskih komponenti. Ciljne skupine projekta su zaposlenici poduzeća u sklopu SPIN konzorcija koji će imati koristi u širenju znanja putem projekta.

Operation_Name_English: With teaching assistants to inclusive education in Primorje-Gorski Kotar County VIII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uz pomoćnike u nastavi do inkluzivnog obrazovanja u Primorsko-goranskoj županiji VIII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Primorje-Gorski Kotar County, as the project holder, is in partnership with 41 primary and secondary schools and one Music School, founded by Primorje-Gorski Kotar County. The aim of the project is to create conditions for the undisturbed acquisition of knowledge, skills and competences of students with developmental difficulties, in primary and secondary schools and in the Music School, in the area of Primorje-Gorski Kotar County, and to provide support for their more successful socialization and emotional functioning in everyday life and work environment. As part of this project, it is planned to provide professional support to 88 teaching assistants/professional communication mediators for at least 100 students with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Primorsko-goranska županija kao nositelj projekta, u partnerstvu je s 41 osnovnom i srednjom školom te jednom Glazbenom školom, kojih je osnivač Primorsko-goranska županija. Cilj projekta je stvoriti uvjete za nesmetano stjecanje znanja, vještina i kompetencija učenika s teškoćama u razvoju, u osnovnim i srednjim školama te u Glazbenoj školi, na području Primorsko-goranske županije, te pružiti podršku za njihovu uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje u svakodnevnom životu i radnoj okolini. U okviru ovoga Projekta planira se osigurati stručna podrška 88 pomoćnika u nastavi/stručna komunikacijska posrednika za minimalno 100 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju.

Operation_Name_English: RAIL RIDE II: Expansion of the cycling network of the Municipality of Brdovec - Construction of a cycling road to Slovenia and Zaprešić
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: RAIL RIDE II: Širenje biciklističke mreže Općine Brdovec - Izgradnja biciklističke prometnice prema Sloveniji i Zaprešiću
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: RAIL RIDE II project: The expansion of the cycling network of the Municipality of Brdovec - Construction of a cycling road to Slovenia and Zaprešić will build and equip a cycling infrastructure that integrates different modes of transport (train-bus-bike) and creates a network of new upgraded paths with a total length of 1.8 km, continuing to the western and eastern part of the built cycling road as part of the RAIL RIDE project, in order to enable the continuity of the cycling journey to Zaprešić and Zagreb, as well as Slovenia, and to establish a sustainable and inclusive cycling system of 8.9 km, as part of the intermodal public transport of the Municipality of Brdovec.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom RAIL RIDE II: Širenje biciklističke mreže Općine Brdovec - Izgradnja biciklističke prometnice prema Sloveniji i Zaprešiću će se izgraditi i opremiti biciklistička infrastruktura koja integrira različite načine prijevoza (vlak-bus-bicikl) i stvara mrežu novih nadograđenih staza ukupne duljine 1,8 km, nastavljajući se na zapadni i istočni dio izgrađene biciklističke ceste u okviru projekta RAIL RIDE, kako bi se omogućio kontinuitet biciklističkog putovanja prema Zaprešiću i Zagrebu, kao i Sloveniji te uspostavio održivi i uključivi biciklistički sustav od 8,9 km, kao dio intermodalnog javnog prijevoza Općine Brdovec.

Operation_Name_English: My 5 Minutes
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mojih 5 minuta
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide innovative social service rest from care to parents caregivers who take care of family members with developmental difficulties and disabilities on a daily basis. This project provides temporary replacement care for children and people dependent on their support, allowing parents caregivers to take a break, perform personal obligations, health care and improve the quality of life. Through the provision of this service, the project contributes to increasing the social inclusion of parents, improving their physical and mental well-being and improving the overall quality of life, which directly improves the long-term quality of care provided to their family members and thus has a positive effect on the whole family and community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružiti inovativnu socijalnu uslugu odmor od skrbi roditeljima njegovateljima koji svakodnevno brinu o članovima obitelji s teškoćama u razvoju i invaliditetom. Kroz ovaj projekt osigurava se privremena zamjenska skrb za djecu i osobe ovisne o njihovoj podršci, omogućujući roditeljima njegovateljima predah, obavljanje osobnih obveza, zdravstvenu skrb i poboljšanje kvalitete života. Kroz pružanje ove usluge, projekt doprinosi povećanju socijalne uključenosti roditelja, unaprjeđenju njihove fizičke i mentalne dobrobiti te poboljšanju cjelokupne kvalitete života, što izravno poboljšava i dugoročnu kvalitetu skrbi koju pružaju svojim članovima obitelji te na taj način ima pozitivan učinak na cijelu obitelj i zajednicu.

Operation_Name_English: Mental health for the future: Quality Assurance through Collaboration and Innovation in the Propedeutics of Psychotherapy Programme
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mentalno zdravlje za budućnost: Osiguravanje kvalitete kroz suradnju i inovacije u programu Propedeutike psihoterapije
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project “Mental Health for the Future: Quality assurance through cooperation and innovation in the Propedeutics of Psychotherapy programme’, in cooperation with the Faculty of Philosophy and Religious Sciences of the University of Zagreb, Amigdala centar d.o.o., to apply professional and technical knowledge for the purpose of innovative development and quality assurance in the education of Propedeutics of Psychotherapy. The developed service will be a novelty in the market, provide the basis for commercialization with a contribution to the growth and competitiveness of applicants, and the application of project results in the S3 area Personalized health care related to the realization of the goals of Improving the market readiness of R&D results and Increasing the market reach of innovative products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha je projekta “Mentalno zdravlje za budućnost: Osiguravanje kvalitete kroz suradnju i inovacije u programu Propedeutike psihoterapije” u suradnji Amigdala centra d.o.o. s Fakultetom filozofije i religijskih znanosti Sveučilišta u Zagrebu primijeniti stručna i tehnička znanja u svrhu inovativnog razvoja i osiguravanja kvalitete edukacije Propedeutike psihoterapije. Razvijena usluga bit će novost na tržištu, pružiti temelj za komercijalizaciju uz doprinos rastu i konkurentnosti prijavitelja, te primjenu rezultata projekta u S3 području Personalizirana briga o zdravlju povezano s realizacijom ciljeva Poboljšanja tržišne spremnosti rezultata istraživanja i razvoja i Povećanja tržišnog dosega inovativnih proizvoda.

Operation_Name_English: "Always with you"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: „Uvijek uz Vas“
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to improve the quality of life of elderly, disabled and disabled people who have difficulties taking care of themselves and their households. The main activities include recruiting staff to carry out various activities, such as household chores, personal hygiene, preparing meals, and purchasing and distributing basic necessities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt ima za cilj poboljšati kvalitetu života starijim i nemoćnim osobama te osobama s invaliditetom koje imaju teškoće brinuti se o sebi i svojem domaćinstvu. Glavne aktivnosti uključuju zapošljavanje osoblja za obavljanje raznih aktivnosti, kao što su kućanski poslovi, briga o osobnoj higijeni, priprema obroka te nabavu i distribuciju osnovnih potrepština.

Operation_Name_English: Zaželi - prevention of institutionalization in the Municipality of Kravarsko
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - prevencija institucionalizacije u Općini Kravarsko
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent institutionalization of older people and people with disabilities by providing long-term care through the provision of support and support services in everyday life for 84 older people and people with disabilities. The project will be implemented for 36 months. The first 2 months are planned for the formation of a project team, the publication of a public call for expression of interest, the procurement of packages, the recruitment of service providers. The next 34 months are planned for the provision of support and support services (food organization, household chores, personal hygiene maintenance and meeting other everyday needs) and their control. Communication, visibility and project management will be carried out continuously during implementation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 84 starije osobe i osobe s invaliditetom. Projekt će se provoditi 36 mjeseci. Prva 2 mjeseca su predviđena su za formiranje projektnog tima, objavu javnog poziva za iskaz interesa, nabavu paketa, zapošljavanje pružatelja usluge. Naredna 34 mjeseca predviđena su za pružanje usluge potpore i podrške (organizacija prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene i zadovoljavanje dr. svakodnevnih potreba) i kontrolu istih. Kontinuirano tijekom provedbe će se provoditi komunikacija i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom.

Operation_Name_English: You are not alone
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Niste sami
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services for the daily life of the elderly and persons with disabilities. 9 people will be employed to provide support and support services to a vulnerable group of at least 54 elderly people in their daily lives.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći je cilj projekta povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični je cilj pružanje usluge potpore i podrške svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Bit će zaposleno 9 osoba koje će ranjivoj skupini, minimalno 54 osobe starije životne dobi pružiti usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu.

Operation_Name_English: Prevention of institutionalisation for the most deprived
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Prevencija institucionalizacije za najpotrebitije
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Recruitment of service providers for min 6 members of the target group for: organising food and/or performing household tasks and/or maintaining personal hygiene and/or meeting other daily needs. Monitoring and control of performed services. Purchase and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies. Communication and visibility will be carried out through informing the public about the project on the website of the applicant / partner and the distribution of leaflets and posters. Project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za min 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine za: organiziranje prehrane i/ili obavljanje kućanskih poslova i/ili održavanje osobne higijene i/ili zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba. Praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga. Nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština. Komunikacija i vidljivost će se provesti kroz informiranje javnosti o projektu na stranicama prijavitelja / partnera te podjeli letaka i plakata. Upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Valorization of innovative products - food supplement in NADES solvent
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Valorizacija inovativnih proizvoda - dodatak prehrani u NADES otapalu
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Valorization of innovative products - food supplement in NADES solvent" aims to develop food supplements using environmentally friendly NADES solvents for insulation of polyphenolic compounds. With this approach, the project seeks to replace harmful industrial solvents, reduce emissions and promote sustainable production. The financing of the project will cover the characterization of extracts and the improvement of the market readiness of new products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Valorizacija inovativnih proizvoda - dodatak prehrani u NADES otapalu" cilja na razvoj dodataka prehrani koristeći ekološki prihvatljiva NADES otapala za izolaciju polifenolnih spojeva. Ovim pristupom, projekt nastoji zamijeniti štetna industrijska otapala, smanjiti emisije i promovirati održivu proizvodnju. Financiranje projekta obuhvatit će karakterizaciju ekstrakata i unaprjeđenje tržišne spremnosti novih proizvoda.

Operation_Name_English: STRENGTH OF SUPPORT - RED CHRISTMAS VALPOVO
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SNAGA PODRŠKE - CRVENI KRIŽ VALPOVO
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: GDCK Valpovo will employ persons who will provide the service of rest from care to persons who have a recognised right to the status of parent caregiver/carer by providing care for a household member who is dependent on their support with the aim of enabling a break from care, i.e. from the daily physical and emotional requirements associated with it. This service will be provided for fifteen months in the households of the parents of the caregiver/carer. The project is planned to provide a service to twelve members of the target group during this period. The project will be implemented in partnership with the Zvono Inclusive House.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "SNAGA PODRŠKE - CRVENI KRIŽ VALPOVO" GDCK Valpovo će zaposliti osobe koje će pružati uslugu odmor od skrbi osobama koje imaju priznato pravo na status roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja osiguravanjem skrbi za člana kućanstva koji je ovisan o njihovoj podršci s ciljem omogućavanja predaha od skrbi, odnosno od svakodnevnih fizičkih i emocionalnih zahtjeva povezanih s istim. Navedena usluga pružat će se tijekom petnaest mjeseci u kućanstvima roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja. Projektom je planirano u navedenom razdoblju uslugu pružati za dvanaest pripadnika ciljne skupine. Projekt će se provoditi u partnerstvu s Inkluzivnom kućom Zvono.

Operation_Name_English: EcoCruise9
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: EcoCruise9
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The ‘EcoCruise9’ project focuses on the development of an innovative 9-metre long passenger boat designed for cruising and renting made of electrically powered bio-composite materials and photovoltaic panels. The purpose of this project is the research and development of an innovative boat through the establishment of the Adriatic Croatia RLV consortium. The central goal is to develop an innovative boat that is energy efficient, environmentally friendly and economically viable. The target groups are environmentally conscious users, tourist agencies and operators, legal entities in tourism and the local community. The project will result in two innovations (ship and specific photovoltaic system), an increase in the number of employees, revenues and competitiveness of all members of the consortium.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „EcoCruise9“ fokusira se na razvoj inovativne putničke brodice duljine 9 metara namijenjene za krstarenje i iznajmljivanje izrađene od bio-kompozitnih materijala na električni pogon i fotonaponske panele. Svrha predmetnog projekta je istraživanje i razvoj inovativne brodice kroz uspostavu konzorcija RLV Jadranske Hrvatske. Središnji cilj jest razviti inovativnu brodicu koja je energetski učinkovita, ekološki prihvatljiva i ekonomski isplativa. Ciljne skupine su ekološki osviješteni korisnici, turističke agencije i operatori, pravne osobe u turizmu i lokalna zajednica. Projekt će rezultirati s dvije inovacije (brodica i specifični fotonaponski sustav), povećanjem broja zaposlenika, prihoda i konkurentnosti svih članova konzorcija.

Operation_Name_English: Support for OSI, respite for caregivers
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podrška za OSI, predah za njegovatelje
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Support for OSI, respite for caregivers" provides rest from care and professional support to parents caregivers/caregivers, by providing group support activities at the Working Centre of the Association for Promoting Inclusion or individual assistance and support in the user's home and the local community. The beneficiaries of the project are 20 parents of caregivers/carers, who will be provided with a rest from care in a way that the persons in whom they care will receive help and support in group activities that will be organized in the UPI or individually in their own home and/or local community, twice a week. In total, all beneficiaries of the project will take 384 days off from care during the duration of the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Podrška za OSI, predah za njegovatelje" osigurava se odmor od skrbi i stručna podrška roditeljima njegovateljima/njegovateljima, osiguravanjem aktivnosti grupne podrške u Radnom centru Udruge za promicanje inkluzije ili individualne pomoći i podrške u domu korisnika i lokalnoj zajednici. Korisnici projekta su 20 roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja, kojima će biti osiguran odmor od skrbi na način da će osobe u kojima skrbe dobiti pomoć i podršku u grupnim aktivnostima koje će se organizirati u UPI ili individualno u vlastitom domu i/ili lokalnoj zajednici, dva puta tjedno. Ukupno će svi korisnici u projektu odmor od skrbi koristiti 384 dana tijekom trajanja projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Let's walk together III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Koračajmo skupa III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: With the realization of the project "Let's step forward together III", the prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups will be achieved through the provision of assistance in the home in carrying out everyday activities for the elderly and people with disabilities. Customers will be provided with assistance in the home through cleaning activities, preparation of simple meals, procurement of medicines and groceries, conversation and socializing. The service will be provided in the area of Šibenik-Knin County. The project will employ a total of 12 service providers, who will take care of 72 users. The activities of informing the public and the target groups about the project will take place through a website, media, posters, leaflets and conferences.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Realizacijom projekta "Koračajmo skupa III", ostvarit će se prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina kroz osiguranje pomoći u kući u obavljanju svakodnevnih aktivnosti starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Korisnicima će biti pružena usluga pomoći u kući kroz aktivnosti čišćenja, pripreme jednostavnih obroka, nabave lijekova i namirnica, razgovor i druženje. Usluga će biti pružena na području Šibensko-kninske županije. Na projektu će biti zaposleno ukupno 12 pružatelja usluga, koji će skrbiti o 72 korisnika. Aktivnosti informiranja javnosti i ciljane skupine o projektu odvijat će se putem web stranice, medija, plakata, letaka i konferencija.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of the quality management system of the Public Open University Brod
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom Pučkog otvorenog učilišta Brod
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure sustainable growth and facilitate access to the international market of the Public Open University Brod through the introduction and certification of quality management systems and business processes according to ISO 21001:2018 and ISO 9001:2015 standards. Certification will improve the quality of educational services, optimize business processes and increase the trust of participants and partners. Alignment with international standards will increase the competitiveness, recognition and reliability of the College and better adapt educational programmes to the needs of the labour market, thus directly contributing to an increase in turnover and sales revenue, as well as exports. This will strengthen the College's position as a leading adult education institution.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osigurati održivi rast i olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu Pučkog otvorenog učilišta Brod kroz uvođenje i certificiranje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom i poslovnim procesima prema normama ISO 21001:2018 i ISO 9001:2015. Certifikacija će unaprijediti kvalitetu obrazovnih usluga, optimizirati poslovne procese te povećati povjerenje polaznika i partnera. Usklađivanje s međunarodnim standardima povećat će konkurentnost, prepoznatljivost i pouzdanost Učilišta te bolje prilagoditi obrazovne programe potrebama tržišta rada, čime se izravno doprinosi povećanju prometa i prihoda od prodaje, te izvoza. Time će Učilište ojačati svoju poziciju kao vodeća institucija za obrazovanje odraslih.

Operation_Name_English: Renovation and equipping of the Interpretation Centre "Slightly submerged ship" building
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obnova i opremanje zgrade Interpretacijskog centra "Blago potopljenog broda"
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will renovate the building of the Interpretation Center "Slightly submerged ship" within the historical site, which will be a place of presentation to the general public regardless of their physical and psychological limitations, rich history, cultural heritage and urban life of the city. By using innovative technology to create experiences, one segment of history will be brought closer and through the protection and valorization of cultural goods will increase accessibility to the cultural life of all citizens.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se obnoviti zgrada Interpretacijskog centra "Blago potopljenog broda" u okviru povijesnog lokaliteta, koja će biti mjesto predstavljanja široj javnosti bez obzira na njihova fizička i psihička ograničenja, bogate povijesti, kulturne baštine i urbanog života grada. Upotrebom inovativne tehnologije za kreiranje doživljaja približit će se jedan segment povijesti te će kroz zaštitu i valorizaciju kulturnog dobra povećati pristupačnost kulturnom životu svih građana.

Operation_Name_English: Renovation of the House of Culture Pajo Kanižaj in Đelekovac
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obnova Doma kulture Pajo Kanižaj u Đelekovcu
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: Activities of this project are Preparation of study and project-technical documentation, Renovation and equipping of the building of public cultural infrastructure, Culture House in Đelekovac, Project management and administration, and Promotion and visibility. After the Cultural Center is renovated, it will be equipped with the most modern ICT equipment and facilities to become a central place for promoting the cultural heritage of the municipality of Đelekovec and its surroundings, a gathering place for vulnerable groups, members of associations and other residents, but also an attractive place of cultural upliftment that will attract visitors from the surrounding places and counties with its innovative facilities. The main objective of the project is to establish services for strengthening personal competences and social skills of members of vulnerable groups.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Aktivnosti predmetnog projekta su Priprema studijske i projektno-tehničke dokumentacije, Obnova i opremanje zgrade javne kulturne infrastrukture, Doma kulture u Đelekovcu, Upravljanje projektom i administracija te Promidžba i vidljivost. Nakon što se Dom kulture obnovi, opremiti će se najmodernijom IKT opremom i sadržajima kako bi postao središnje mjesto za promicanje kulturne baštine općine Đelekovec i okolice, mjesto okupljanja ranjivih skupina, članova udruga i ostalih stanovnika, ali i atraktivno mjesto kulturnog uzdizanja koje će svojim inovativnom sadržajima privući i posjetitelje iz okolnih mjesta i županija. Glavni cilj projekta je uspostava usluga za jačanje osobnih kompetencija i socijalnih vještina pripadnika ranjivih skupina.

Operation_Name_English: Development Tests NB-IoT Zhaga Book 18 Smart Lighting Controller
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvojna ispitivanja NB-IoT Zhaga Book 18 Smart Lighting Controller
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project of the company X-LOGIC in cooperation with KONČAR - Electrical Engineering Institute d.d. is to provide tests of the NB-IoT Zhaga Smart Lighting Controller on electromagnetic compatibility, on electrical safety and to perform tests of the interdependence of the radio frequencies of the device, all with the aim of ensuring the preconditions for the commercialization of the developed product and the growth of sales on the domestic and foreign markets. Cooperation with ZIO and obtaining non-repayable support will enable the company to conduct development tests and facilitate product placement on the market and strengthen the competitiveness of the society. The target groups of the project are: 1. Applicant's company, 2. Customers and suppliers, 3. Final consumers/citizens.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta društva X-LOGIC je u suradnji s KONČAR - Institut za elektrotehniku d.d. osigurati ispitivanja uređaja NB-IoT Zhaga Smart Lighting Controller na elektromagnetsku kompatibilnost, na električku sigurnost te izvršiti ispitivanja međuovisnosti radijskih frekvencija uređaja, a sve s ciljem osiguranja preduvjeta za komercijalizaciju razvijenog proizvoda i rast prodaje na domaćem i inozemnom tržištu. Suradnja s ZIO-om i dobivanje bespovratne potpore, omogućit će društvu provođenje razvojnih ispitivanja i olakšati plasman proizvoda na tržište te ojačati konkurentnost društva. Ciljne skupine projekta su: 1. poduzeće Prijavitelja, 2. kupci i dobavljači, 3. krajnji potrošači/građani.

Operation_Name_English: RInclusion - Rijeka Model of Support for Students with Disabilities
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: RInkluzija – Riječki model podrške učenicima s teškoćama
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The RInclusion project directly contributes to the social inclusion and integration of students with TUR by employing 120 teaching assistants (PUN) in 23 regular schools and two special educational institutions founded by the City of Rijeka. PUNs will support students with TUR in the educational process, which will provide the conditions for improving their educational achievements, successful socialization and emotional functioning.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt RInkluzija izravno doprinosi socijalnoj uključenosti i integraciji učenika s TUR zapošljavanjem 120 pomoćnika u nastavi (PUN) u 23 redovne škole i dvije posebne odgojno-obrazovne ustanove kojima je osnivač Grad Rijeka. PUN-ovi će pružati podršku učenicima s TUR u odgojno-obrazovnom procesu čime će se osigurati uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješnu socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje.

Operation_Name_English: I take care of others, I take care of myself IV.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Skrbim za druge, brinem za sebe IV.
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: During 36 months, the project will encourage social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, ensuring the right to live in the community through the provision of support and support services to the target group, i.e. over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities. Project activities: Provision of support and support services in addition to procurement and distribution of packages of supplies (recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group for 32 months, monitoring, control of services performed, procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and visibility, project management and administration).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se tijekom 36 mjeseci potaknuti socijalna uključenost, prevencija institucionalizacije, osiguravanje prava na život u zajednici kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške ciljanoj skupini, odnosno starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnosti projekta: Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština (zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine na 32 mjeseca, praćenje, kontrola izvršenih usluga, nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija).

Operation_Name_English: Let's be supportive of them
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Budimo im podrška
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups (persons over 65 and persons with disabilities) by providing long-term care, which enables beneficiaries to receive support and support services and stay longer in their homes.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći je cilj projekta povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencije institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina (osobe starije od 65 godina i osobe s invaliditetom) osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi čime korisnici dobivaju uslugu potpore i podrške i duže ostaju u svojim domovima.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of management systems according to ISO 27001 and ISO 22301
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranje sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO 27001 i ISO 22301
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to increase the competitiveness of Ascalia through the implementation of ISO 27001 and ISO 22301. The issue of uncertified management system will be solved by harmonizing processes according to the requirements of the standards for information security and business continuity management. The project will ensure greater service security, compliance with international standards and client confidence. The goal is to attract new customers, increase revenues and exports, and ensure the long-term improvement of business processes, thereby strengthening Ascalia's market position and competitive advantage. The implementation of the Project will have a direct impact on Ascalia, its employees and clients, who will receive safer and more reliable services in accordance with global standards.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je povećati konkurentnost društva Ascalia kroz implementaciju normi ISO 27001 i ISO 22301. Problem necertificiranog sustava upravljanja riješit će se usklađivanjem procesa prema zahtjevima normi za upravljanje informacijskom sigurnošću i kontinuitetom poslovanja. Projekt će osigurati veću sigurnost usluga, usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima i povjerenje klijenata. Cilj je privući nove kupce, povećati prihode i izvoz te osigurati dugoročno poboljšanje poslovnih procesa, čime će Ascalia ojačati tržišnu poziciju i konkurentsku prednost. Provedba Projekta izravno će utjecati na društvo Ascalia, njene zaposlenike i klijente, koji će dobiti sigurnije i pouzdanije usluge u skladu s globalnim normama.

Operation_Name_English: Kindergarten Račići II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dječji vrtić Račići II
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Children's kindergarten Račići II" will be implemented for 24 months, and its goal is to increase the infrastructural availability of preschool education by increasing the capacity of preschool education through the reconstruction and equipping of existing buildings for other purposes. Through the project, two additional daily stays will be realized, which will provide additional places for 32 children.
