Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Dječji vrtić Račići II" će se provoditi 24 mjeseca, a za cilj ima povećati infrastrukturnu dostupnost predškolskog obrazovanja povećanjem kapaciteta predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja kroz rekonstrukciju i opremanje postojeće građevine druge namjene. Kroz projekt će se ostvariti dodatna dva dnevna boravka čime će se osigurati dodatna mjesta za 32 djece.

Operation_Name_English: Better Bread For All - automation of sourdough production in artisan bakery
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Better Bread For All - automatizacija sourdough proizvodnje u artisan pekarstvu
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the BB4ALL project is to carry out research and development activities in order to develop an automated system for the production of sourdough products in artisan bakery that will make a technological breakthrough in the sector concerned. The target groups of the project are project partners and their employees who will develop innovation capacities and acquire new knowledge and skills. Secondary school Biograd na Moru whose students will have the opportunity to test new technological equipment, as well as all interested artisan bakeries, hotels and restaurants that will have the opportunity to offer their guests healthy and nutritious bread.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta BB4ALL je provedba istraživačko-razvojnih aktivnosti u svrhu razvoja automatiziranog sustava za proizvodnju sourdough proizvoda u artisan pekarstvu koji će napraviti tehnološki iskorak u predmetnom sektoru. Ciljne skupine projekta su projektni partneri i njihovi zaposlenici koji će razviti inovacijske kapacitete i usvojite nova znanja i vještine. Zatim, Srednja škola Biograd na Moru čiji učenici će imati priliku testirati novu tehnološku opremu, kao i sve zainteresirane artisan pekare, hoteli i restorani koji će imati priliku svojim gostima ponuditi zdrav i nutritivno bogat kruh.

Operation_Name_English: School PUNa Possibilities 8
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Škola PUNa mogućnosti 8
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: This project will provide assistance for students with disabilities during the next three school years in primary schools in the City of Zadar. Teaching assistants will provide learning and education assistance to students with disabilities, thus directly contributing to their better functioning in the form of their more successful socialization and emotional stability. The professional services of the schools will provide all the necessary assistance in the work of teaching assistants as well as professional monitoring of students with developmental difficulties during the school year. Teaching assistants will be engaged through employment contracts throughout the school year.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom osigurat će se pomoć za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju tijekom sljedeće tri školske godine u osnovnim školama na području Grada Zadra. Pomoćnici u nastavi učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju pružit će pomoć pri učenju i obrazovanju čime će izravno doprinijeti njihovom boljem funkcioniranju u vidu njihove uspješnije socijalizacije i emocionalne stabilnosti. Stručne službe škola pružit će svu potrebnu pomoć u radu pomoćnicima u nastavi kao i stručno praćenje učenika s teškoćama u razvoju tijekom školske godine. Pomoćnici u nastavi bit će angažirani putem ugovora o radu za vrijeme čitave školske godine.

Operation_Name_English: Togetherness Paths Prvić Luka - Prvić Šepurina
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Putevima zajedništva Prvić Luka – Prvić Šepurina
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The project plans to build a path - a promenade from Prvić Luka to Šepurine on the island of Prvić. The promenade, an open type of neglected space, which would pass through the island and connect the towns of Luka and Šepurina, is an idea that has long been present on the island of Prvić. The project will arrange a promenade with a total length of approximately 2,200 m, by strengthening the retaining walls, concreting a certain part of the promenade as well as performing gravel parts, rehabilitating the existing mules and waterfront, installing seating benches and installing a sunny stone clock. Investment in the construction of the promenade will improve the infrastructure of the island, create preconditions for strengthening social unity, and at the same time affect the promotion of cultural and natural beauties.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se planira izgradnja staze - šetnice od mjesta Prvić Luka do mjesta Šepurine na otoku Prviću. Šetnica, otvoreni tip zapuštenog prostora, koja bi prolazila otokom i povezivala mjesta Luku i Šepurinu, ideja je koja je već dugo prisutna na otoku Prviću. Projektom će se urediti šetnica ukupne duljine cca 2.200 m, i to jačanjem potpornih zidova, betoniranjem određenog dijela šetnice kao i izvođenjem šljunčanih dijelova, sanacijom postojećih mula i rive, postavljanjem klupa za sjedenje te ugradnjom sunčanog kamenog sata. Ulaganje u izgradnju šetnice unaprijedit će infrastrukturu otoka, stvoriti preduvjete jačanja društvenog zajedništva, a ujedno će utjecati i na promociju kulturnih i prirodnih ljepota.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of JELEN PROFESSIONAL d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva JELEN PROFESSIONAL d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of the company JELEN PROFESSIONAL d.o.o. by certifying work and safety footwear according to the norms HRN EN ISO 20347:2022 and HRN EN ISO 20345:2022. The purpose of the project is to ensure the compliance of products with international standards, enable access to new markets and increase exports. Expected results include certification of 30 footwear models, a 12% increase in revenue and a 9% increase in exports. Certification confirms the quality and safety of the product, enables the expansion of sales in the EU and strengthens the market position of the company, thus ensuring long-term sustainability and competitive advantage.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća JELEN PROFESSIONAL d.o.o. certificiranjem radne i sigurnosne obuće prema normama HRN EN ISO 20347:2022 i HRN EN ISO 20345:2022. Svrha projekta je osigurati sukladnost proizvoda s međunarodnim standardima, omogućiti pristup novim tržištima i povećati izvoz. Očekivani rezultati uključuju certificiranje 30 modela obuće, povećanje prihoda za 12% i rast izvoza za 9%. Certifikacija potvrđuje kvalitetu i sigurnost proizvoda, omogućava širenje prodaje u EU i jača tržišnu poziciju poduzeća, čime se osigurava dugoročna održivost i konkurentska prednost.

Operation_Name_English: Confirmation of compliance of innovative valve coil units with EU guidelines and relevant European standards referred to by the guidelines
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Potvrđivanje sukladnost inovativnih ventilokonvektora sa smjernicama EU i odgovarajućim Europskim normama na koje se pozivaju smjernice
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The applicant has developed an innovative valve convector in 12 different variants (models/sizes) and started its own production of them. The aim of the project is to carry out electromagnetic compatibility tests and Low Voltage Directive Test and to confirm the conformity of the valve-convectors concerned with EU guidelines and relevant European standards. Through detailed testing, the project will provide scientifically based results that are crucial for further commercialization and growth of recognition of this product in the heating and cooling industry. The examinations in question will be entrusted to the company KONČAR - Institut za elektrotehniku d.o.o., which possesses, professional staff, knowledge and equipment necessary for carrying out the required examinations.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavitelj je razvio inovativni ventilo-konvektor u 12 različitih varijanti (modela/veličina) te pokrenuo vlastitu proizvodnju istih. Cilj projekta je provesti testiranja elektromagnetske kompatibilnosti te Low Voltage Directive Test te potvrditi sukladnost predmetnih ventilo-konvektora sa smjernicama EU i odgovarajućim Europskim normama. Kroz detaljna ispitivanja, projekt će pružiti znanstveno utemeljene rezultate koji su ključni za daljnju komercijalizaciju i rast prepoznatljivosti ovog proizvoda u industriji grijanja i hlađenja. Predmetna Ispitivanja povjerit će se društvu KONČAR - Institut za elektrotehniku d.o.o. koji posjeduje, stručno osoblje, znanja i opremu potrebnu za provedbu traženih ispitivanja.

Operation_Name_English: Wish- "I'll give you support"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi- "Pružit ću ti potporu"
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of this project are to contribute to social inclusion, reduce social isolation, prevent premature institutionalization, reduce poverty and improve the quality of life of the target group, project participants and final beneficiaries in the Šibenik-Knin County. Insufficient care in the elderly and OSI results in a worsening of their state of health and feelings of rejection from society. Activities under this project proposal are services for the provision of non-institutional support and care for persons over the age of 65 in adults with disabilities (18 and over) with the delivery of monthly packages of household and basic hygiene supplies, which is in line with the specific objective of this Call, thus improving the life of the target group.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi ovog projekta su doprinos socijalnoj uključenosti, smanjenju socijalne izolacije, sprečavanje prerane institucionalizacije, smanjenju siromaštva i poboljšanju kvalitete života ciljane skupine, sudionika projekta te krajnjih korisnika na području Šibensko-kninske županije. Nedovoljna skrb kod osoba starije životne dobi i OSI rezultira pogoršanjem njihovog zdravstvenog stanja i osjećaja odbačenosti iz društva. Aktivnosti iz ovog projektnog prijedloga su usluge pružanja oblika izvaninstitucionalne podrške i skrbi o osobama starijim od 65 god. u odraslim osobama s invaliditetom (18 i više g.) uz isporuku mjesečnih paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, a što je u skladu sa specifičnim ciljem ovog Poziva čime se unaprjeđuje život ciljane skupine.

Operation_Name_English: JOINT TO KNOWING 5.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAJEDNO DO ZNANJA 5.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project JOINT TO KNOWN 5 provides the necessary support for participation in the programs of educational institutions to students with disabilities, by providing professional assistance PUN/CPC, during the 2023/2024 learning year. The aim of the project is to support the inclusion of students with disabilities in the educational institutions of the founders of the city of Pula, in order to provide conditions for the improvement of educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The target group is 138 students supported by 111 PUN/CPC. The total value of the project is 789,476.40 EUR for a duration of 12 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom ZAJEDNO DO ZNANJA 5 omogućava se potrebna podrška za sudjelovanje u programima odgojno-obrazovnih ustanova učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju, osiguranjem stručne pomoći PUN/SKP, tijekom nastavne godine 2023./2024. Cilj projekta je pružiti potporu uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u odgojno-obrazovne ustanove osnivača grada Pule, kako bi osigurali uvjete za poboljšanje obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Ciljana skupina je 138 učenika kojima je osigurana podrška 111 PUN/SKP. Ukupna vrijednost projekta je 789.476,40 EUR u trajanju od 12 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Wants to Give Your Hands
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi Dati ruke
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Providing support and support services in everyday life for at least 72 elderly people and OSI for a period of 34 months in the Istria County. By providing support and support services, we will enable people over the age of 65 and adult PWD to have greater social inclusion and prevent or delay institutionalization.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za najmanje 72 starije osobe i OSI kroz razdoblje od 34 mjeseca na području Istarske županije. Pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške omogućit ćemo osobama starijim od 65 godina i punoljetnim OSI veću socijalnu uključenost i prevenirati ili odgoditi institucionalizaciju.

Operation_Name_English: Innovative multifunctional light building partition panel
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inovativni multifunkcionalni pregradni panel lake gradnje
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in large enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The main objective of the project is the development of a new product - an innovative multifunctional light building partition panel as a result of research, development and innovation activities. The project includes investment in testing and experimentation infrastructure and research, development and feasibility study activities aimed at a new product that does not exist on the global market. The project aims to reduce the amount of carbon footprint present within the rail traffic, which is a key problem addressed by the project. The target groups to be covered by the project activities are rolling stock manufacturers, rolling stock operators, institutions and governments.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni cilj projekta je razvoj novog proizvoda - inovativnog multifunkcionalnog pregradnog panela lake gradnje kao rezultat djelovanja istraživanja, razvoja i inovacija. Projekt uključuje ulaganje u infrastrukturu za testiranje i eksperimentiranje te aktivnosti istraživanja, razvoja i izrade studije izvedivosti gdje je cilj novi proizvod koji ne postoji na globalnom tržištu. Projekt ima za cilj smanjiti količinu ugljičnog otiska koji je prisutan unutar tračnog prometa što je ključan problem koji projekt adresira. Ciljne skupine koje će biti obuhvaćene projektnim aktivnostima jesu proizvođači tračnih vozila, operateri tračnih vozila, institucije i vlade.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of the water and communal infrastructure of the Kaštela-Trogir agglomeration - Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Poboljšanje vodno-komunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Kaštela-Trogir - faza 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes: - the construction and reconstruction of the public water supply system; - the construction and reconstruction of the public drainage system; - upgrading the existing CUPOV in Divulje from the 1st to the 2nd degree of purification (from mechanical to biological treatment) with an increase in capacity from 40,000 p.e. to 100,000 p.e.; - construction of UPOV Čiovo 2nd degree of purification (biological purification) with a capacity of 25000 ES; in the area of the towns of Kaštela, Trogir, the municipalities of Seget and Okrug and the settlement of Slatine (City of Split) with the aim of increasing the population's connection to public water supply and drainage systems and ensuring adequate wastewater treatment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća: - izgradnju i rekonstrukciju sustava javne vodoopskrbe; - izgradnju i rekonstrukciju sustava javne odvodnje; - dogradnju postojećeg CUPOV-a u Divuljama s 1. na 2. stupanj pročišćavanja (od mehaničkog na biološku obradu) uz povećanje kapaciteta sa 40.000 ES-a na 100.000 ES-a; - izgradnju UPOV-a Čiovo 2. stupnja pročišćavanja (biološkog pročišćavanja) kapaciteta 25.000 ES-a; na području gradova Kaštela, Trogira, općina Seget i Okrug te naselja Slatine (Grad Split) s ciljem povećanja priključenosti stanovništva na javne sustave vodoopskrbe i odvodnje te osiguravanje odgovarajućeg pročišćavanja otpadnih voda.

Operation_Name_English: Pro(b)LONG: Increasing the competitiveness of Marina Lab by extending the shelf life of probiotic beverages
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pro(b)LONG: Povećanje konkurentnosti tvrtke Marina Lab produljenjem roka trajnosti probiotičkih napitaka
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The Marina Lab Opus project focuses on the innovation of Pro(b)LONG probiotics by extending the shelf life and researching the folic acid content. The aim is to increase the competitiveness of products on the domestic and international market, in cooperation with the Ruđer Bošković Institute for Precision Testing and Analysis. Expected results include extended shelf life of the product, increased stability, additional health benefits and expanded market presence, which will contribute to the further development and sustainable business of the company.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Marina Lab Opus usmjeren je na inovaciju probiotika Pro(b)LONG kroz produljenje roka trajnosti i istraživanje sadržaja folne kiseline. Cilj je povećati konkurentnost proizvoda na domaćem i međunarodnom tržištu, uz suradnju s Institutom Ruđer Bošković za precizna ispitivanja i analize. Očekivani rezultati uključuju produžen rok trajnosti proizvoda, povećanu stabilnost, dodatne zdravstvene beneficije i proširenu tržišnu prisutnost, što će doprinijeti daljnjem razvoju i održivom poslovanju poduzeća.

Operation_Name_English: Knowledge + Creativity = STEM Inspiration
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Znanje + Kreativnost = STEM Inspiracija
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Under the leadership of HDKI, the STEM project, which includes preschoolers, schoolchildren and high school students, will be implemented in cooperation with partners, the HDZV association, the FKIT faculty, the Girice kindergarten, the Gvozd elementary school, the Nikola Tesla Technical School in Vukovar and the Ruđer Bošković Technical and Natural Sciences Gymnasium in Osijek. The project will implement various workshops, mentoring and trainings for employees and volunteers, with the aim of stimulating interest in the STEM field among young people. Workshops will focus on experimental learning, digital skills development and creative problem solving. Mentoring will support the development of STEM competences and pedagogical approaches to students, improving their understanding and skills in science, chemistry and engineering.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Pod vodstvom HDKI, STEM projekt koji obuhvaća predškolarce, školarce i srednjoškolarce provodit će se u suradnji s partnerima, udrugom HDZV, fakultetom FKIT, dječjim vrtićem Girice, OŠ Gvozd, Tehničkom školom Nikole Tesla u Vukovaru te Tehničkom i prirodoslovnom gimnazijom Ruđera Boškovića u Osijeku. Projekt će implementirati različite radionice, mentoriranje i obuke za djelatnike i volontere, s ciljem poticanja interesa za STEM područje među mladima. Fokus radionica bit će na eksperimentalnom učenju, razvoju digitalnih vještina i kreativnom rješavanju problema. Mentoriranje će pružati podršku u razvoju STEM kompetencija i pedagoških pristupa učenicima, unaprjeđujući njihovo razumijevanje i vještine u znanosti, kemiji i inženjerstvu.

Operation_Name_English: When ODRASTEM – Reflection of science for the STEM future
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kad ODRASTEM – Odraz znanosti za STEM budućnosti
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will improve the capacities and competences of associations for action in the STEM field, establish long-term cooperation with academic institutions and encourage students' interest in scientific professions and popularization of science among the wider population. The project will carry out 120 workshops for more than 1,500 students and organize 12 public events dedicated to the promotion of STEM. The project will indirectly include over 10,000 representatives of the general population who will follow our activities through the websites and social networks of the project partners. As part of the project, innovative equipment for modern student teaching and practical exercises will be procured to ensure the best possible education of students and prepare them for the challenges in the labour market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se unaprijediti kapaciteti i kompetencije udruga za djelovanje u STEM području, uspostaviti dugoročna suradnja s akademskim institucijama te potaknuti interes učenika za znanstvena zanimanja i popularizaciju znanosti među širom populacijom. Projektom će se provesti 120 radionica za više od 1.500 učenika te organizirati 12 javnih događanja posvećenih promociji STEM-a. Projekt će indirektno obuhvatiti preko 10.000 predstavnika opće populacije koji će pratiti naše aktivnosti putem web stranica i društvenih mreža projektnih partnera. U sklopu projekta nabavit će se inovativna oprema za suvremeno podučavanje učenika i praktične vježbe kako bi se osigurala što bolja edukacija učenika te ih se pripremilo za izazove na tržištu rada.

Operation_Name_English: Apricum Meteo - development of a smart metering station for infrastructure management
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Apricum Meteo - razvoj pametne meterološke stanice za upravljanje infrastrukturom
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: SPIN Consortium consists of the holder Apricum d.o.o., partners Nabla d.o.o, D&J, d.o.o. Luka d.d., Litrić.d.o.o. and the University of Split, Department of Professional Studies. The project develops an innovative advanced weather station that combines advanced sensor technologies with resistant materials to provide accurate and reliable measurements of weather conditions even in extreme weather conditions, and which technology can be applied for fixed and mobile infrastructure (ships). The main objective of the project is to ensure the strengthening of the competitiveness of the RLV by investing in priority niches based on cooperation on the development of innovative solutions of high added value smart advanced weather station.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SPIN Konzorcij čine nositelj Apricum d.o.o., partneri Nabla d.o.o, D&J, d.o.o. Luka d.d., Litrić.d.o.o. te Sveučilište u Splitu, Odjel za stručni studij. Projektom se razvija inovativna napredna meteorološka stanica koja kombinira napredne senzorske tehnologije s otpornim materijalima kako bi pružila precizna i pouzdana mjerenja vremenskih uvjeta čak i u ekstremnim vremenskim uvjetima, a koja tehnologija se može primijeniti za fiksnu i za mobilnu infrastrukturu (brodove) Glavni cilj (svrha) projekta je osigurati jačanje konkurentnosti RLV-a ulaganjem u prioritetne niše temeljem suradnje na razvoju inovativnih rješenja visoke dodane vrijednosti pametne napredne meteorološke stanice.

Operation_Name_English: Wishes - support for living in your own home
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - podrška za život u vlastitom domu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Project objective – to increase the quality of life of older people in the wider Trogir area by providing household support and day-to-day activities. Activities – assistance with food organisation, grocery procurement, assistance in maintaining personal and residential hygiene, delivery of medicines, etc. The project will contribute to reducing the rate of institutionalisation of older people and enable them to live in a dignified way in their own home. It also aims to improve the social integration of older people into the community, ensure that they feel involved, raise awareness of the importance of helping older people.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta – povećati kvalitetu života starijih osoba na širem trogirskom području pružanjem podrške u kućanstvu i svakodnevnim aktivnostima. Aktivnosti – pomoć kod organiziranja prehrane, nabava namirnica, pomoć u održavanju osobne higijene i higijene stambenog prostora, dostava lijekova i dr. Projekt će doprinijeti smanjenju stope institucionalizacije starijih osoba i omogućiti im dostojanstven život u vlastitom domu. Cilj je i poboljšati socijalnu integraciju starijih osoba u zajednicu, osigurati da se osjećaju uključeno, podići svijest o važnosti pomoći starijim osobama.

Operation_Name_English: Well-being in your home - home support for mature years
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dobrobit u vašem domu - kućna podrška za zrele godine
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project has the fundamental objective of preventing the institutionalization of older people by providing comprehensive and tailored assistance in their own homes. The main objectives include assessing the individual needs of older people, recruiting workers to provide home help services, organising visits to foster social interaction and prevent feelings of loneliness, and ensuring that older citizens retain their dignity and autonomy in a familiar environment. The project creates an inclusive environment that fosters intergenerational solidarity and promotes understanding of the needs of older citizens.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt ima temeljni cilj spriječiti institucionalizaciju starijih osoba pružanjem sveobuhvatne i prilagođene pomoći u njihovim vlastitim domovima. Glavni ciljevi uključuju procjenu individualnih potreba starijih osoba, zapošljavanje djelatnika za pružanje usluga pomoći u kući, organizaciju posjeta za poticanje socijalne interakcije i prevenciju osjećaja usamljenosti te osiguranje da stariji građani zadrže svoje dostojanstvo i autonomiju u poznatom okruženju. Projekt stvara inkluzivno okruženje koje potiče međugeneracijsku solidarnost i promiče razumijevanje potreba starijih građana.

Operation_Name_English: AND WE NEED A DISCLAIMER
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: I NAMA JE POTREBAN ODMOR
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide innovative social service Care vacation to parents carers/carers who care for a member or family members who are completely dependent on their support in the area of Međimurje and Krapina-Zagorje County. This will provide users, with difficult access to social services, involved in project activities with the necessary support through the realization of quality rest from everyday physical and emotional requirements and care obligations, and enable persons with disabilities to participate more in the life of the community independently of family members.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osigurati inovativnu socijalnu uslugu Odmor od skrbi roditeljima njegovateljima/njegovateljima koji skrbe o članu ili članovima obitelji koji je/su u potpunosti ovisni o njihovoj podršci na području međimurske I krapinsko-zagorske županije. Time će se korisnicima, s otežanim pristupom socijalnim uslugama, uključenima u projektne aktivnosti pružiti potrebna podrška kroz ostvarivanje kvalitetnog odmora od svakodnevnih fizičkih I emocionalnih zahtjeva i obaveza pružanja skrbi te osobama sa invaliditetom omogućiti veća participacija u životu zajednice neovisno od članova obitelji.

Operation_Name_English: Development of an intelligent system to support the production and sale of planting material - Smart Nursery Garden System
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inteligentnog sustava za podršku proizvodnji i prodaji sadnog materijala – Smart Nursery Garden System
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: CONSORTION: MSP-PROAXIS d.o.o., SKINK d.o.o., LONGO, vl.Dino Babić, NIVAGO D.O.O.; FACILITY: Faculty of Informatics and Digital Technologies, University of Rijeka and Associate-Center for Agriculture and Rural Development of Primorje-Gorski Kotar County NAME OF THE PROJECT: Development of an intelligent system to support the production and sale of planting material-Smart Nursery Garden System OBJECTIVE OF THE PROJECT: development of a system to support the production of planting material and a system to monitor the specific needs of consumers for planting material that will contribute to the Adriatic Croatia niche "IT solutions and production technologies and models for Industry 4.0 and smart agriculture" under the S3 thematic area "Digital products and platforms". TOTAL VALUE OF THE PROJECT: 2.179.990,42 €
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: KONZORCIJ: MSP-PROAXIS d.o.o., SKINK d.o.o., LONGO, vl.Dino Babić, NIVAGO D.O.O.; OIŠZ: Fakultet informatike i digitalnih tehnologija, Sveučilište u Rijeci i suradnik-Centar za poljoprivredu i ruralni razvoj Primorsko-goranske županije NAZIV PROJEKTA: Razvoj inteligentnog sustava za podršku proizvodnji i prodaji sadnog materijala-Smart Nursery Garden System CILJ PROJEKTA: razvoj sustava za podršku proizvodnji sadnog materijala te sustava za praćenje specifičnih potreba potrošača za sadnim materijalom koji će doprinijeti niši Jadranske Hrvatske „IT rješenja i proizvodne tehnologije i modeli za Industriju 4.0 i pametnu poljoprivredu“ u okviru S3 tematskog područja „Digitalni proizvodi i platforme“. UKUPNA VRIJEDNOST PROJEKTA: 2.179.990,42 €

Operation_Name_English: Development of the County Social Plan of Vukovar-Srijem County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada županijskog socijalnog plana Vukovarsko-srijemske županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to enable the improvement of the social welfare system and greater availability of social services in the county through the development of the Social Plan of the Social Welfare Council for a three-year period and the improvement of the expertise of the employees of the Social Welfare Council and members of the Social Welfare Council of the Social Welfare Council of the Social Welfare Council. The activities of the project are: 1. Collection, analysis and processing of data for the development of the social plan 2. Development of a social plan 3. Implementation of trainings for members of the Council and employees of applicants 4. Promotion and visibility 5. Project management and administration
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je omogućiti unaprjeđenje sustava socijalne skrbi i veću dostupnost socijalnih usluga na području županije kroz izradu Socijalnog plana VSŽ za trogodišnje razdoblje i unaprjeđenje stručnosti djelatnika VSŽ i članova Savjeta za socijalnu skrb VSŽ. Aktivnosti projekta su: 1. Prikupljanje, analiza i obrada podataka za izradu socijalnog plana 2. Izrada socijalnog plana 3. Provedba edukacija za članove Savjeta i djelatnike prijavitelja 4. Promidžba i vidljivost 5. Upravljanje projektom i administracija

Operation_Name_English: Wish good to your community
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi dobro svojoj zajednici
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve the quality of life of older people and people with disabilities, by increasing social inclusion, the quality of their health and the quality of housing and delaying institutionalization. The main activity of the project is the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies. The activity includes the recruitment of 25 service providers for at least 150 target group members, the procurement of monthly household and hygiene kits, communication and visibility, and project management and administration. The duration of the project is 36 months, while the provision of the service to the users will last 30 months. The project is being implemented in the territory of the municipality of Cerna.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je unaprijediti kvalitetu života osoba starije životne dobi i osoba s invaliditetom, kroz povećanje socijalne uključenosti, kvalitete njihovog zdravlja i kvalitete stanovanja te odgađanje institucionalizacije. Glavna aktivnost projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština. Aktivnost obuhvaća zapošljavanje 25 pružatelja usluge za najmanje 150 pripadnika ciljane skupine, nabavu paketa mjesečnih kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština, komunikaciju i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administraciju. Trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci, dok će pružanje usluge korisnicima trajati 30 mjeseci. Projekt se provodi na području općine Cerna.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of occupational safety management system according to ISO 45001
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija sustava upravljanja zaštitom na radu prema ISO 45001
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The ISO 45001:2018 implementation project aims to improve the occupational health and safety management system in Premifab, which will increase employee safety, reduce operational risks and ensure compliance with international standards. The purpose of the project is to ensure greater competitiveness of companies on the domestic and foreign markets through certification. Expected results include improvement of working conditions, optimization of business processes and strengthening of market position of Premifab through confirmation of compliance with internationally recognized standards.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt implementacije ISO 45001:2018 ima za cilj unaprijediti sustav upravljanja zaštitom zdravlja i sigurnosti na radu u Premifabu, čime će se povećati sigurnost zaposlenika, smanjiti operativni rizici i osigurati usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima. Svrha projekta je certifikacijom osigurati veću konkurentnost poduzeća na domaćem i inozemnom tržištu. Očekivani rezultati uključuju poboljšanje radnih uvjeta, optimizaciju poslovnih procesa i jačanje tržišne pozicije Premifaba kroz potvrdu usklađenosti s međunarodno priznatim normama.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment of management systems according to ISO 9001 and ISO 27001
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uspostava sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO 9001 i ISO 27001
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Support for companies to certify products and implement management systems
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Potpora poduzećima za certifikaciju proizvoda i uvođenje sustava upravljanja

Operation_Name_English: Expanding the network of personal assistance services
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Širenje mreže usluge osobne asistencije
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase the social inclusion of persons with disabilities by ensuring a higher degree of autonomy and inclusion in the community for persons with disabilities by providing personal assistance services. The implementation of this project over 50 months will provide personal assistance services to persons with disabilities through a personal assistance service provider that employs a natural person who provides personal assistance services. This provides support to a person with a disability in activities that he/she cannot perform on his/her own due to the type and degree of disability, which he/she needs on a daily basis in the home and outside the home, as well as assistance and support in communication and receiving information, for the purpose of greater independence and inclusion in the community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti osoba s invaliditetom kroz osiguranje većeg stupnja samostalnosti i uključenosti u zajednicu osobama s invaliditetom pružanjem usluge osobne asistencije. Provedbom ovog projekta kroz 50 mjeseci pružat će se usluge osobne asistencije osobama s invaliditetom putem pružatelja usluga osobne asistencije koji zapošljava fizičku osobu koja pruža uslugu osobne asistencije. Time pruža podrška osobi s invaliditetom u aktivnostima koje ne može izvoditi sama radi vrste i stupnja invaliditeta, a koje su joj svakodnevno potrebne u kući i izvan kuće, te pomoć i podrška u komunikaciji i primanju informacija, a u svrhu većeg stupnja samostalnosti i uključenosti u zajednicu.

Operation_Name_English: Development of joints of glued laminated girders made of hard leaf - hornbeam
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj spojeva lijepljenih lameliranih nosača od tvrdih listača - graba
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: Three companies and OIŠZ, gathered in a consortium, plan to bring 5 innovative products from TRL -2 to the TRL-8 technology readiness level, so that after the end of the project they can commercialize and thus increase their business revenues, the number of employees and become more competitive on the market. The specific objective of the project is to: Developed products under the S3 priority area: Green construction The target group of the project are employees of the consortium members who will improve their skills and knowledge through the research and development process, as well as customers who will use new products developed during the project in the future. The total value of the project is 2.679.559,96 €.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tri tvrtke i OIŠZ okupljene u konzorcij, projektom planiraju 5 inovativnih proizvoda dovesti od TRL -2 do razine tehnološke spremnosti TRL-8, kako bi iste nakon završetka projekta komercijalizirali te si tvrtke na taj način povećale poslovne prihode, broj zaposlenih i postale konkurentnije na tržištu. Specifični cilj projekta je: Razvijeni proizvodi u okviru S3 prioritetnog područja: Zelena gradnja Ciljna skupina projekta su djelatnici članova konzorcija koji će kroz istraživačko-razvojni proces unaprijediti svoje vještine i znanja, kao i kupci koji će u budućnosti koristiti nove proizvode razvijene tijekom projekta. Ukupna vrijednost projekta je 2.679.559,96 €.

Operation_Name_English: Regional Waste Management Centre of North-West Croatia Piškornica - Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Regionalni centar za gospodarenje otpadom sjeverozapadne Hrvatske Piškornica – Faza 2
Category_Label: Household waste management: landfill
NUTS3_Label: Krapinsko-zagorska županija|Koprivničko-križevačka županija|Međimurska županija|Bjelovarsko-bilogorska županija|Varaždinska županija
Operation_Summary_English: Regional Waste Management Centre of North-West Croatia ‘Piškornica’ (hereinafter: RCGO Piškornica) is one of 11 waste management centres that represent projects of special interest for the Republic of Croatia. The construction of RCGO Piškornica with its transhipment stations and associated infrastructure will improve the management system of primarily mixed municipal waste in Koprivnica-Križevci, Varaždin, Međimurje and Krapina-Zagorje counties, and in the second phase in Bjelovar-Bilogora County, and will provide numerous socio-economic benefits and achieve greater protection of soil, water, air.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Regionalni centar za gospodarenje otpadom sjeverozapadne Hrvatske „Piškornica (u daljem tekstu: RCGO Piškornica) jedan je od 11 centara za gospodarenje otpadom koji predstavljaju projekte od posebnog interesa za Republiku Hrvatsku. Izgradnjom RCGO Piškornica s pripadajućim pretovarnim stanicama i pripadajućom infrastrukturom unaprijedit će se sustav gospodarenja poglavito miješanim komunalnim otpadom u Koprivničko-križevačkoj, Varaždinskoj, Međimurskoj i Krapinsko-zagorskoj županiji, te u drugoj fazi u Bjelovarsko-bilogorskoj županiji te će se osigurati brojne društveno-ekonomske koristi i postići veća zaštita tla, voda, zraka.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of social infrastructure in the area of the City of Novalja
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje društvene infrastrukture na području Grada Novalje
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community
Operation_Summary_English: The subject and purpose of the implementation of the project in question is the creation of additional social facilities and publicly accessible social infrastructure for leisure activities and recreation in the area of the City of Novalja in order to improve the quality of life of the population through the construction and equipping of the building of the Zubovići Social Home and the Red Cross building, and the arrangement of new green areas and outdoor children's playgrounds in the area of the City of Novalja. This project, through the construction of a new social infrastructure, will solve the problem of lack of social and recreational facilities for public purposes outdoors and indoors, for the benefit of the local population and visitors, and horticultural landscaping will contribute to climate change mitigation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet i svrha provedbe predmetnog projekta jest stvaranje dodatnih društvenih sadržaja i javno dostupne društvene infrastrukture za slobodne aktivnosti i rekreaciju na području Grada Novalje kako bi se poboljšala kvaliteta života stanovništva kroz izgradnju i opremanje zgrade Društvenog doma Zubovići i zgrade Crvenog križa, te uređenje novih zelenih površina i dječjih igrališta na otvorenom na području Grada Novalje. Predmetnim projektom kroz izgradnju nove društvene infrastrukture, riješit će se problem nedostatka društvenih i rekreativnih sadržaja javne namjene na otvorenom i zatvorenom, u korist lokalnog stanovništva i posjetitelja, a hortikulturnim uređenjem zelenih površina dati će se doprinos ublažavanju klimatskih promjena.

Operation_Name_English: Zaželi - prevention of institutionalization Municipality of Bošnjaci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - prevencija institucionalizacije Općina Bošnjaci
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to contribute to greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in one's own home and ensuring the right to live in the community of the target groups (persons over 65 and adults with disabilities) in the territory of the municipality, which is also the general objective of the project. The implementation will provide support and support in everyday life to the target groups, which is both the main activity of the project, but also a specific objective. Service providers will be recruited for its implementation and will: organize food, perform household chores, take care of maintaining personal hygiene and meeting other everyday needs with the purchase and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se želi doprinijeti većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguravanju prava na život u zajednici ciljnim skupinama (osobe starije od 65 i odrasle osobe s invaliditetom) na području općine, što je i opći cilj projekta. Provedbom će se pružati potpora i podrška u svakodnevnom životu ciljnim skupinama što je i glavna aktivnost projekta, ali i specifični cilj. Za njegovu provedbu će se zaposliti pružatelji usluge koji će za ciljne skupine: organizirati prehranu, obavljati kućanske poslove, voditi brigu o održavaju osobne higijene i zadovoljavanju drugih svakodnevnih potreba uz nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština.

Operation_Name_English: Still strong
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: I dalje jaki
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Overall objective of the project – to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups through the provision of long-term care. Specific objective – the provision of support and support services in the daily life of older persons and persons with disabilities. Main activities - providing support and support services with procurement and distribution of packages of supplies for at least 6 members of the target group. It will employ service providers, monitoring and control of services performed, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta – povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj – pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Glavne aktivnosti - pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština za min 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine. Zapošljavat će pružatelje usluga, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: The Krapina Neanderthal Museum
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nadogradnja Muzeja krapinskih neandertalaca
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project Upgrade of the Krapina Neanderthal Museum will establish a visitor center on the topic of the Krapina prehistoric man as a place for the implementation of cultural and educational programs with the creation of preconditions for the development of innovative services in culture. The purpose of the project is to increase accessibility and participation in the cultural life of all citizens and visitors of the Museum, especially members of vulnerable groups. The newly built part of the Museum, the visitor center, will complement and in a different and innovative way present the existing contents of the Museum, especially to children, young people and members of vulnerable groups, and enable year-round cultural events and events within the Museum.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Nadogradnja Muzeja krapinskih neandertalaca uspostavit će se posjetiteljski centar na temu krapinskog pračovjeka kao mjesto za provedbu kulturnih i edukativnih programa uz stvaranje preduvjeta za razvoj inovativnih usluga u kulturi. Svrha projekta je povećanje pristupačnosti i sudjelovanja u kulturnom životu svih građana i posjetitelja Muzeja, osobito pripadnika ranjivih skupina. Novodograđeni dio Muzeja, posjetiteljski centar, svojim će sadržajima nadopunjavati i na drugačiji i inovativan način prezentirati postojeći sadržaj Muzeja, osobito djeci, mladima i pripadnicima ranjivih skupina, te omogućiti odvijanje cjelogodišnjih kulturnih manifestacija i događanja u okviru Muzeja.

Operation_Name_English: Investment in the establishment of CONSCIUS’ management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ulaganje u uspostavu sustava upravljanja društva CONSCIUS
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to increase the competitiveness of CONSCIUS through the implementation of ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001 and ISO27001 standards. By certifying business processes, the company will increase the quality of services, business resilience, data security and compliance with international standards. The project will enable the improvement of the perception of reliability and expertise of existing and new clients, which will result in expansion to foreign markets, increasing revenues and strengthening the competitive advantage. Certified management systems will contribute to more efficient operations, better organization and optimization of work processes. The implementation of the project will have a positive impact on society, its employees and clients, who will receive safer and more reliable digital solutions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je povećati konkurentnost društva CONSCIUS kroz implementaciju normi ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001 i ISO27001. Certifikacijom poslovnih procesa društvo će povećati kvalitetu usluga, otpornost poslovanja, sigurnost podataka te usklađenost s međunarodnim normama. Projekt će omogućiti poboljšanje percepcije pouzdanosti i stručnosti kod postojećih i novih klijenata, što će rezultirati širenjem na strana tržišta, povećanjem prihoda i jačanjem konkurentske prednosti. Certificirani sustavi upravljanja doprinijet će učinkovitijem poslovanju, boljoj organizaciji i optimizaciji radnih procesa. Provedba projekta imat će pozitivan utjecaj na društvo, njegove zaposlenike i klijente, koji će dobiti sigurnija i pouzdanija digitalna rješenja.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of the cycling trail Donja Vrba - Slavonski Brod
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističke staze Donja Vrba - Slavonski Brod
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The construction of a bicycle path between the villages of Donja Vrba and Slavonski Brod, with a total length of 3,804 m, will connect the village of Donja Vrba with the seat of the Municipality, the settlement of Gornja Vrba and with the urban seat of the area, the city of Slavonski Brod, all with the purpose of increasing the use of bicycles as a means of transport with zero emission of harmful gases for the purpose of going to work, school, university, recreation, informal gatherings and the like. The construction of this cycling trail implies raising the quality of life of the local population, the growth of economic activity and the increase of socio-economic progress in the area of the Municipality of Gornja Vrba, the urban area of the City of Slavonski Brod and Brod-Posavina County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Izgradnjom biciklističke staze između naselja Donja Vrba i Slavonski Brod, ukupne duljine 3.804 m, povezat će se naselje Donja Vrba sa sjedištem Općine, naseljem Gornja Vrba i sa urbanim sjedištem područja, gradom Slavonskim Brodom, a sve sa svrhom povećanja korištenja bicikla kao sredstva prijevoza s nultom emisijom štetnih plinova za potrebe odlaska na posao, u školu, na fakultet, za rekreaciju, neformalna druženja i slično. Izgradnja ove biciklističke staze podrazumijeva podizanje kvalitete života lokalnog stanovništva, rasta gospodarske aktivnosti i povećanja socio-ekonomskog napretka područja Općine Gornja Vrba, urbanog područja Grada Slavonskog Broda i Brodsko-posavske županije.

Operation_Name_English: Social inclusion of older people and people with disabilities
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalno uključivanje starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective of the project: Providing support and support services in the daily life of older persons with disabilities in order to prevent their institutionalisation and increase social inclusion. Target group: persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities. 20 people will be employed who will provide support and support services for 30 months (organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene, meeting other daily needs) for 120 users, selected on a public call, with the allocation of packages of household and hygiene supplies. Service control will be performed. Promotion of the project: banner, posters-20, leaflets-200, conferences-6. The project team manages the project and manages the administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta: Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama s invaliditetom kako bi se prevenirala njihova institucionalizacija i povećala socijalna uključenost. Ciljana skupina: osobe starije od 65 godina i odrasle osobe s invaliditetom. Zaposlit će se 20 osoba koje će 30 mjeseci pružati usluge potpore i podrške (organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba) za 120 korisnika, odabranih na javnom pozivu, uz dodjelu paketa kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština. Vršit će se kontrola usluga. Promocija projekta: baner, plakati-20, letci-200, konferencije-6. Projektni tim upravlja projektom i vodi administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Providing infrastructural conditions for increasing the availability of early childhood education and care in "Kindergarten Varaždin" - facility Dravska
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Osiguravanje infrastrukturnih uvjeta za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja u "Dječjem vrtiću Varaždin" - objekt Dravska
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project is intended to upgrade the existing building of the Dravska kindergarten in Varaždin. The aim of the project is to provide infrastructural and material capacities to increase the availability of early childhood education and care in the City of Varaždin, thus contributing to the strengthening of demographic growth and stability of the city, county and the Republic of Croatia. The project is part of a wider picture of continuous investments and activities that the City of Varaždin makes in order to increase the availability of early childhood education, improve the working conditions of employees and raise the quality of educational institutions as one of the key conditions for strengthening the demographic image of the city and improving the quality of life of citizens.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se namjerava dograditi postojeći objekt dječjeg vrtića Dravska u Varaždinu. Cilj projekta je osigurati infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja u Gradu Varaždinu, te tako doprinijeti jačanju demografskog rasta i stabilnosti grada, županije i Republike Hrvatske. Projekt je dio šire slike kontinuiranih ulaganja i aktivnosti koje Grad Varaždin čini kako bi povećao dostupnost ranog i predškolskog odgoja, poboljšao uvjete rada zaposlenika te digao kvalitetu odgojno-obrazovnih institucija kao jednog od ključnih uvjeta jačanja demografske slike grada te poboljšanja kvalitete života građana.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of KOLNOA VRATA d.o.o. products
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranje proizvoda Društva KOLNOA VRATA d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose (objective) of the Kolnoa vrata project is to provide the preconditions for increasing sales on the domestic and foreign markets, increase the overall competitiveness of the company and ensure sustainable growth through an investment aimed at obtaining fire protection door certificates. The project will solve the problem of the necessary harmonization of products with the normative requirements of the EU, which will enable the applicant to place the product on the market, and ultimately strengthen its competitiveness. The target groups whose interests the project will directly contribute to are (1): the undertaking of the applicant; (2): buyers and suppliers; and (3): final consumers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha (cilj) Projekta poduzeća Kolnoa vrata je kroz ulaganje usmjereno u stjecanje certifikata za protupožarna vrata osigurati preduvjete za povećanje prodaje na domaćem i inozemnom tržištu, povećati ukupnu konkurentnost poduzeća te osigurati održivi rast. Projektom će Prijavitelj riješiti problem potrebnog usklađivanja proizvoda normativnim zahtjevima EU-a, što će mu omogućiti plasman proizvoda na tržište, odnosno u konačnici ojačati njegovu konkurentnost. Ciljne skupine čijim će interesima projekt izravno doprinijeti su (1): poduzeće Prijavitelja; (2): kupci i dobavljači; te (3): krajnji potrošači.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of the Bambi Kindergarten in Podravlje
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja Dječjeg vrtića Bambi u Podravlju
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The newly designed building at Ul. Prince E. Savojskog 4, k.č.br. 967, k.o. Tvrđavica - Podravlje will be a public and social building, i.e. a preschool building - kindergarten. The garden is a regional facility. Upon construction, it will have four educational groups – two kindergartens and two nurseries, and the necessary accompanying facilities. It is planned that there will be a total of 40 children in kindergarten groups, and a total of 24 children in nursery groups. The main goal of this project is to provide additional capacities for preschool education in Osijek, improve the quality of education and provide better conditions for the youngest members of the community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Novoprojektirana zgrada na adresi Ul. princa E. Savojskog 4, k.č.br. 967, k.o. Tvrđavica - Podravlje biti će zgrada javne i društvene namjene, odnosno zgrade predškolske namjene – vrtić. Vrtić je područni objekt. Po izgradnji, imati će četiri odgojno-obrazovne skupine – dvije vrtićke i dvije jasličke, te potrebne prateće sadržaje. Planira se da će u vrtićkim skupinama boraviti ukupno 40 djece, a u jasličkim skupinama ukupno 24 djece. Glavni cilj ovog projekta je osigurati dodatne kapacitete za predškolski odgoj u Osijeku, unaprijediti kvalitetu obrazovanja i omogućiti bolje uvjete za najmlađe članove zajednice.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international competitiveness of Leapwise d.o.o. by introducing a quality management system and information security
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke Leapwise d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kvalitetom te informacijskom sigurnošću
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project "Increasing the international competitiveness of Leapwise d.o.o. by introducing a quality management system and information security" is to increase the international competitiveness of the company through the introduction of a management system according to international standards ISO 27001 (information security management) and ISO 9001 (quality management). The purpose of the project is to ensure high standards of safety and quality of products and services, increase customer confidence and facilitate entry to new international markets with their own software products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta "Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke Leapwise d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kvalitetom te informacijskom sigurnošću'' je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema međunarodnim standardima ISO 27001 (upravljanje informacijskom sigurnošću) i ISO 9001 (upravljanje kvalitetom). Svrha projekta je osigurati visoke standarde sigurnosti i kvalitete proizvoda i usluga, povećati povjerenje klijenata te olakšati ulazak na nova međunarodna tržišta vlastitim softverskim produktima.

Operation_Name_English: Nodefusion - Implementation of the management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nodefusion - Uvođenje sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The ‘Nodefusion – Deployment of management systems’ project aims to increase the competitiveness and trust of customers in a highly competitive IT sector. The overall objective of the project is to strengthen the market position of the company through compliance with internationally recognized ISO standards, which will ensure consistent service quality, increase operational efficiency, and improve the safety, resilience and sustainability of the business. The target groups are employees, who will improve competencies, and clients in the international market, who will provide a guarantee of quality and responsible business. The key result of the project is the certification of 8 management systems according to ISO standards. The implementation of the project contributes to easier entry into international markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Nodefusion – Uvođenje sustava upravljanja“ usmjeren je na povećanje konkurentnosti i povjerenja klijenata u visoko konkurentnom IT sektoru. Opći cilj projekta je jačanje tržišne pozicije poduzeća kroz usklađivanje s međunarodno priznatim ISO standardima, čime će se osigurati dosljedna kvaliteta usluga, povećanje operativne učinkovitosti, te unaprijediti sigurnost, otpornost i održivost poslovanja. Ciljne skupine su zaposlenici, koji će unaprijediti kompetencije, te klijenti na međunarodnom tržištu, kojima će se pružiti jamstvo kvalitete i odgovornog poslovanja. Ključan rezultat projekta je certificiranje 8 sustava upravljanja po ISO normama. Provedba projekta doprinosi lakšem ulasku na međunarodna tržišta.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of the public-social building - kindergarten Prugovo
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija zgrade javno-društvene namjene- dječji vrtić Prugovo
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: In the municipality of Klis in the Split-Dalmatia County, on the cadastral parcel 3072 k.o. Prugovo, there is an existing kindergarten building with a corresponding environment. On the ground floor of the building there is a kindergarten group with associated facilities. On the first floor of the building there is a kindergarten storage room and a local home. As the Municipality of Klis implements a pro-natal policy, more and more young families are moving in demand for pre-school services. Renovation and modernization of the facility is key to improving the working conditions, safety and quality of stay of children. Investing in the reconstruction and equipping of this preschool institution would provide infrastructural and material capacities to increase the availability of early childhood education in the municipality of Klis.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: U općini Klis u Splitsko-dalmatinskoj županiji na katastarskoj čestici 3072 k.o. Prugovo nalazi se postojeća zgrada vrtića sa pripadajućim okolišem. U prizemlju zgrade nalazi se jedna vrtićka skupina sa pripadajućim sadržajima. Na katu zgrade nalazi se spremište vrtića i mjesni dom. Obzirom da Općina Klis provodi pronatalitetnu politiku te se sve više mladih obitelji doseljava raste potražnja za predškolskim uslugama. Renovacija i modernizacija objekta je ključna za unapređenje uvjeta rada, sigurnosti i kvalitete boravka djece. Ulaganjem u rekonstrukciju i opremanje ove predškolske ustanove osigurali bi se infrastrukturni i materijalni kapaciteti za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja na području općine Klis.

Operation_Name_English: AIoT4Therapy - Research and development of integrated AI-IoT solutions for the personalisation of physical therapy and kinesitherapy
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: AIoT4Therapy – Istraživanje i razvoj integriranog AI-IoT rješenja za personalizaciju fizikalne terapije i kineziterapije
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in micro enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will develop a comprehensive IoT solution for physical therapy and kinesitherapy, which will integrate innovative sensory systems, multi-criteria decision-making, advanced AI algorithms for optimizing the therapeutic process and specially trained language models for patient counseling. The aim of the project is to enable better personalized therapeutic procedures, to ensure continuous improvement of the system based on patient feedback and to provide a platform for more effective education of professionals and patients through LLM models in particular. The solution will be an intuitive and easy-to-use digital tool for end-users. The target groups are experts in physical therapy and kinesitherapy, employees of partner companies and the general public.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Kroz projekt će se razviti sveobuhvatno IoT rješenje za fizikalnu terapiju i kineziterapiju, koje će integrirati inovativne senzorske sustave, višekriterijsko odlučivanje, napredne AI algoritme za optimiranje terapijskog postupka te posebno trenirane jezične modele za savjetovanje pacijenata. Cilj projekta je omogućiti bolje personalizirane terapijske postupke, osigurati kontinuirano usavršavanje sustava temeljem povratnih informacija pacijenata te pružiti platformu za učinkovitiju edukaciju stručnjaka i pacijenata kroz posebno LLM modele. Rješenje će za krajnje korisnike biti intuitivni digitalni alat jednostavan za korištenje. Ciljane skupine su stručnjaci u fizikalnoj terapiji i kineziterapji, zaposlenici tvrtki partnera te šira javnost.

Operation_Name_English: Packages of joy!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Paketi radosti!
Category_Label: Addressing material deprivation through food and/or material assistance to the most deprived, including accompanying measures
Operation_Summary_English: The Radosti! Packages project aims to alleviate poverty and social exclusion by providing continuous assistance in the form of food packages and basic material assistance, as well as accompanying measures aimed at supporting the most vulnerable people. The project will provide 103,560 packages of food for individuals and 252 packages of food for 6 soup kitchens, 51,780 packages of basic hygiene supplies, 25,890 packages of household cleaners and 8,630 packages of bedding, provide accompanying measures through information and counselling "I want better", the workshop "More thoughts - less waste and turn old into new" and the distribution of brochures, catalogues and cookbooks, which contributes to combating material deprivation in the NUTS 2 region of Pannonian Croatia
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Paketi Radosti! ima za cilj ublažavanje siromaštva i socijalne isključenosti pružanjem kontinuirane pomoći u obliku paketa hrane i osnovne materijalne pomoći, kao i popratnih mjera usmjerenih na podršku najugroženijim osobama. Projektom će se osigurati 103.560 paketa hrane za pojedince i 252 paketa hrane za 6 pučkih kuhinja, 51.780 paketa osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, 25.890 paketa sredstava za čišćenje kućanstva i 8.630 paketa posteljine, pružiti popratne mjere putem informiranja i savjetovanja "Želim bolje", radionica "Više misli - manje troši i pretvori staro u novo" te podjelom brošura, kataloga i kuharice čime se pridonosi suzbijanju materijalne oskudice u NUTS 2 Regiji Panonska Hrvatska

Operation_Name_English: AIDS IN COMPETITION IN BASIC SCHOOLS OF THE CITY OF DUBROVNIK - PHASE VI
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: POMOĆNICI U NASTAVI U OSNOVNIM ŠKOLAMA GRADA DUBROVNIKA - FAZA VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is to support the inclusion, with the support of 42 teaching assistants, of 42 pupils with disabilities in primary schools of the city of Dubrovnik in order to ensure the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The project will be implemented under the leadership of the City of Dubrovnik under the responsibility of the Administrative Department for Education, Sports, Social Welfare and Civil Society, and in partnership with primary schools Lapad, Montovjerna, Mokošica, M. Držić, M. Getaldić, I. Gundulić and A. Masle.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog projekta je pružanje potpore uključivanju, uz podršku 42 pomoćnika u nastavi, 42 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnom školama grada Dubrovnika kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Projekt će se provesti pod vodstvom grada Dubrovnika u nadležnosti Upravnog odjela za obrazovanje, šport, socijalnu skrb i civilno društvo, a u partnerstvu s osnovnom školama Lapad, Montovjerna, Mokošica, M. Držić, M. Getaldić, I. Gundulić i A. Masle.

Operation_Name_English: WE LEARN TOGETHER YOU
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: UČIMO ZAJEDNO VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Ensuring inclusive education of students with disabilities in primary and primary schools by providing PUN/CPC support to students with disabilities is in line with strategic documents and regulations. Through the implementation of the UZ VI project for 350 students with disabilities, integrated into the educational process in 68 school institutions of the Split-Dalmatia County, direct support to adequate education is provided with the support of 340 assistants (PUN/CPC), which will ensure the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The project will contribute to increasing social inclusion and integration of students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions and reducing child poverty in SDŽ.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u OŠ i SŠ pružanjem potpore PUN/SKP učenicima s teškoćama u skladu je sa strateškim dokumentima i propisima. Kroz provedbu projekta UZ VI za 350 učenika s teškoćama, integrirana u odgojno-obrazovni proces u 68 školskih ustanova Splitsko-dalmatinske županije, osigurava se neposredna podrška primjerenom obrazovanju potporom 340 pomoćnika (PUN/SKP), čime će se osigurati uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Projekt će doprinijeti povećanju socijalne uključenosti i integracije učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama i smanjenju dječjeg siromaštva u SDŽ.

Operation_Name_English: Varaždin County Social Plan 2024 - 2026.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalni plan Varaždinske županije 2024. - 2026.
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support to the County Social Plan for the period 2024-2026 and to improve the professional capacities and knowledge of the officers of the County Social Plan and the members of the Social Welfare Council for social planning, implementation and monitoring of the County Social Plan. The activities of the project are: analysis, data processing and preparation of the county social plan, data collection for the preparation of the plan, implementation of education for Council members and county officials and horizontal activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružiti potporu VŽŽ u izradi Županijskog socijalnog plana za razdoblje 2024.-2026. te unaprijediti stručne kapacitete i znanje službenika VŽŽ te članova Savjeta za socijalnu skrb za socijalno planiranje, provedbu i praćenje županijskog socijalnog plana. Aktivnosti projekta su: analiza, obrada podataka te izrada županijskog socijalnog plana, prikupljanje podataka za izradu plana, provedba edukacije za članove Savjeta te službenike županije te horizontalne aktivnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Coastal reconstruction and rehabilitation in the port of Rab – PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija i sanacija obale u luci Rab – FAZA 2
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the reconstruction of the coast and the construction of pier 3 in the port of Rab. The project is implemented through two programming periods 2014-2020 and 2021-2027, and the implementation of the project takes place in 2 phases. The total value of both phases of the project is EUR 4.961.171,96 of which EUR 4.848.233,15 is eligible and EUR 112.938.81 is ineligible (part of the terminal not dedicated to connecting to the islands and internet service of passenger equipment). The total value of the first phase of the project was EUR 4.035,742.69 with eligible costs of EUR 3,922,803.88 and ineligible costs of EUR 112,938.81. The total value of the second phase of the project is EUR 925,429.27, which is also the amount of eligible costs and grants.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je rekonstrukcija obale i izgradnja gata 3 u luci Rab. Projekt se provodi kroz dva programska razdoblja 2014.-2020. i 2021.-2027., te se provedba projekta odvija u 2 faze. Ukupna vrijednost obje faze projekta je 4.961.171,96 EUR od čega su prihvatljivi troškovi 4.848.233,15 EUR a neprihvatljivi 112.938.81 EUR (dio terminala koji nije namijenjen povezivanju s otocima i usluga interneta opreme za putnike). Ukupna vrijednost prve faze projekta iznosila je 4.035.742,69 EUR s prihvatljivim troškovima u iznosu 3.922.803,88 EUR i neprihvatljivim troškovima u iznosu 112.938,81 EUR. Ukupna vrijednost druge faze projekta je 925.429,27 EUR što je ujedno i iznos prihvatljivih troškova i bespovratnih sredstava.

Operation_Name_English: Revitalization of the park Viktorovac - construction and decoration
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Revitalizacija perivoja Viktorovac - izgradnja i uređenje
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Revitalization of Viktorovac Park - Construction and Decoration" will provide a place for recreation, rest and stay in the forest park within the urban city zone for all citizens of Sisak, and especially for young people. The decoration of the Viktorovac park will be adapted to the recreational, aesthetic and ecological function, which primarily refers to the arrangement of paths and paths and the square and access to the public sculpture Vera Ficher, the construction of a pavilion with a canopy, a children's playground, a system of public fountains, public sanitary facilities and the restoration of existing stone retaining walls, as well as the arrangement of a forest garden, a rain garden and a ditch, and the establishment of a network of interpretation panels. This refers to public urban infrastructure that will be accessible to citizens without any restrictions and conditions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Revitalizacija perivoja Viktorovac - izgradnja i uređenje" osigurat će se mjesto za rekreaciju, odmor i boravak u park šumi unutar urbane gradske zone za sve građane Siska, a osobito za mlade. Uređenje perivoja Viktorovac prilagodit će se rekreativnoj, estetskoj i ekološkoj funkciji, što se prvenstveno odnosi na uređenje staza i puteva te trga i pristupa do javne skulpture Vere Ficher, gradnju paviljona s nadstrešnicom, dječjeg igrališta, sustava javnih česmi, javnih sanitarija te obnovu postojećih kamenih potpornih zidova, kao i uređenje šumskog vrta, kišnog vrta i jaraka, te uspostavu mreže interpretacijskih ploča. Navedeno se odnosi na javnu gradsku infrastrukturu koja će biti dostupna građanima bez ikakvih ograničenja i uvjeta.

Operation_Name_English: Wish for Kiev
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI za Kijevo
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The specific objective of the project Zaželi za Kiev is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and adults with disabilities.
