Main activities: Recruitment of 15 service providers for 33 months for a minimum of 90 members of the target group, monitoring and control of services performed, procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Specifični cilj projekta Zaželi za Kijevo je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i punoljetnim osobama s invaliditetom. Glavne aktivnosti: zapošljavanje 15 pružatelja usluga na 33 mjeseca za minimalno 90 pripadnika ciljne skupine, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction and conversion of an existing public building into a Kindergarten Center
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija i prenamjena postojeće zgrade javne namjene u Dječji vrtić Centar
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project of reconstruction of the existing building at Školska ulica 6, k.č.br. 5494, k.o. Osijek, envisages the conversion of the public building into a kindergarten. The building will be adapted for the accommodation of children of nursery and kindergarten age, with the division of capacity into two nursery groups on the ground floor and two kindergarten groups in the attic, and the planned total capacity of children of nursery and kindergarten age is 58 children. The reconstruction includes the adaptation of the space to all relevant standards for preschool institutions and the decoration of the outdoor space for play and recreation. The main goal of this project is to provide additional capacities for preschool education in Osijek, improve the quality of education and provide better conditions for the youngest members of the community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom rekonstrukcije postojeće zgrade na adresi Školska ulica 6, k.č.br. 5494, k.o. Osijek, predviđena je prenamjena zgrade javne namjene u dječji vrtić. Zgrada će biti prilagođena za smještaj djece jasličke i vrtićke dobi, uz podjelu kapaciteta na dvije jasličke grupe u prizemlju i dvije vrtićke grupe u potkrovlju, a planirani ukupni kapacitet djece jasličke i vrtićke dobi iznosi 58 djece. Rekonstrukcija uključuje adaptaciju prostora prema svim relevantnim standardima za predškolske ustanove te uređenje vanjskog prostora za igru i rekreaciju. Glavni cilj ovog projekta je osigurati dodatne kapacitete za predškolski odgoj u Osijeku, unaprijediti kvalitetu obrazovanja i omogućiti bolje uvjete za najmlađe članove zajednice.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - for a better tomorrow III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi – za bolje sutra III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care through the provision of support and support services in everyday life. The project will employ 25 people who will care for at least 150 people.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencije institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu. Kroz projekt će se zaposliti 25 osoba koje će skrbiti za najmanje 150 osoba.

Operation_Name_English: Community for Defenders – prevention of institutionalisation
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: “Zajednica za branitelje – prevencija institucionalizacije“
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The ‘War Veterans’ Community – Prevention of Institutionalisation’ project is being implemented for a period of 18 months with the aim of providing care rest services to carers who care for household members who are dependent on their support and reducing the risk of institutionalisation of 35 members of the vulnerable group, who are dependent on carers’ care. The project will enable parents caregivers to relieve emotional and physical stress associated with their daily obligations, improve their emotional resilience and discover ways to improve the quality of life. In addition, the project will provide care for members of a vulnerable group, contribute to providing psychological assistance, strengthening socialization and digital literacy.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt “Zajednica za branitelje – prevencija institucionalizacije“ provodi se u trajanju od 18 mjeseci s ciljem pružanja usluge odmora od skrbi njegovateljima koje skrbe o članovima kućanstva koji su ovisni o njihovoj podršci te smanjenju rizike od insitucionalizacije 35 pripadnika ranjive skupine,ovisnih o skrbi njegovatelja. Projekt će omogućiti roditeljima njegovateljima da se oslobode emocionalnog i fizičkog stresa povezanog s njihovim svakodnevnim obavezama, poboljšaju svoju emocionalnu otpornost i otkriju načine kako unaprijediti kvalitetu života. Dodatno, Projekt će omogućiti skrb za pripadnike ranjive skupine, pridonijeti pružanju psihološke pomoći, jačanju socijalizacije te digitalnom opismenjavanju.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of FSB d.o.o. products to the market
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacijom proizvoda poduzeća FSB d.o.o. do tržišta
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The problem that the implementation of the project is trying to solve is lower sales, which is due to the fact that the company does not have certified products. The project is the certification of 8 passive fire protection products. The project will result in an increase in sales revenues by at least 31%, an increase in export revenues by at least 31% and the certification of 8 company products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Problem koji se pokušava riješiti provedbom projekta je manja prodaja koja je posljedica toga što poduzeće nema certificirane proizvode. Projekt je certificiranje 8 proizvoda pasivne protupožarne zaštite. Projekt će rezultirati povećanjem prihoda od prodaje za barem 31%, povećanjem prihoda od izvoza za barem 31% i certifikacijom 8 proizvoda poduzeća.

Operation_Name_English: Let's help one another VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: POMOZIMO JEDNI DRUGIMA VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective of the project "Let's help each other VII" is to contribute to increasing the social inclusion and integration of students with developmental difficulties in primary education institutions in the area of the city of Križevci and to provide them with support and security in their further life. The long-term benefit of this project is that students with disabilities, together with their PUN/CPC, will acquire and acquire new knowledge and skills, easier and easier to adapt to teaching and non-teaching activities, will increase their self-confidence and will become more independent for easier further education. It is very important to acquaint the general public with the activities and objectives of this project through promotional activities and to point out the great importance of teaching assistants.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta "Pomozimo jedni drugima VII" je doprinijeti povećanju socijalne uključenosti i integracije učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama na području grada Križevaca te im pružiti potporu i sigurnost u daljnjem životu. Dugoročna korist ovog projekta je to što će učenici s teškoćama u razvoju, zajedno sa svojim PUN/SKP, steći i usvojiti nova znanja i vještine, lakše i jednostavnije se prilagoditi u nastavne i van nastavne aktivnosti, povećat će im se samopouzdanje te će postati samostalniji za lakše daljnje školovanje. Vrlo je bitno kroz promotivne aktivnosti upoznati širu javnost s aktivnostima i ciljevima ovog projekta te ukazati na veliku važnost pomoćnika u nastavi.

Operation_Name_English: Business improvement through certification of the management system of the company "VEROX d.o.o."
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unapređenje poslovanja kroz certifikaciju sustava upravljanja poduzeća "VEROX d.o.o."
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Business improvement through certification of the management system of VEROX d.o.o.’ aims to increase the competitiveness, security and sustainability of the company’s operations by implementing the international standards ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 22301. The aim of the project is to standardize quality management, strengthen information security and resilience to crisis situations. The purpose of the project is to ensure compliance with international standards, increase the trust of clients and partners and enable easier access to international markets. Expected results include an increase in sales and export revenues, a reduction in operational risks and a strengthening of the market position. The project contributes to strengthening competitiveness and recognition in the global market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Unapređenje poslovanja kroz certifikaciju sustava upravljanja poduzeća VEROX d.o.o.“ usmjeren je na povećanje konkurentnosti, sigurnosti i održivosti poslovanja poduzeća implementacijom međunarodnih standarda ISO 9001, ISO 27001 i ISO 22301. Cilj projekta je standardizacija upravljanja kvalitetom, jačanje informacijske sigurnosti i otpornost na krizne situacije. Svrha projekta je osigurati usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima, povećati povjerenje klijenata i partnera te omogućiti lakši pristup međunarodnim tržištima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza, smanjenje operativnih rizika te jačanje tržišne pozicije. Projekt doprinosi jačanju konkurentnosti i prepoznatljivosti na globalnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Opportunity for all 7
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Prilika za sve 7
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to ensure inclusive education of students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions founded by KKŽ. The purpose of the project is to support the inclusion of 64 students with disabilities in 15 primary and 6 secondary schools founded by KKŽ in order to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The target group of the project is 64 students with disabilities, who will be supported with education through the employment and work of 54 teaching assistants over 36 months (1944 months in total) in the school years 2024/2025, 2025/2026 and 2026/2027.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama kojima je KKŽ osnivač. Svrha projekta je pružiti potporu uključivanju 64 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u 15 osnovnih i 6 srednjih škola kojima je osnivač KKŽ kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Ciljna skupina u projektu su 64 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju, kojima će biti pružena potpora obrazovanju kroz zapošljavanje i rad 54 pomoćnika u nastavi tijekom 36 mjeseci (1944 mjeseci ukupno) u školskim godinama 2024/2025, 2025/2026 i 2026/2027.

Operation_Name_English: Women working helping - Phase III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Žene radeći pomažu - faza III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the social inclusion of vulnerable groups and prevent their institutionalization by providing long-term care through employment of people from the Promina municipality, which will reduce the risk of poverty, encourage social inclusion and increase the quality of life of end users. 7 employees in the implementation of the project will provide support and support to at least 42 beneficiaries of the target group. These activities will reduce the accommodation of elderly people in homes and ensure a longer stay in their own home. The project will be presented to the public through promotional and visibility activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti ranjivih skupina i prevencija institucionalizacije istih osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz zapošljavanje osoba s područja općine Promina čime će se smanjiti rizik od siromaštva, potaknuti socijalnu uključenost i povećati kvalitetu života krajnjih korisnika. 7 zaposlenih osoba na provedbi projekta će pružiti potporu i podršku za najmanje 42 korisnika ciljane skupine. Navedene aktivnosti smanjiti će smještaj starijih osoba u domove i osigurati dulji boravak u vlastitom domu. Projekt će se prezentirati javnosti kroz aktivnosti promidžbe i vidljivosti.

Operation_Name_English: "Development of buildings and exterior space of the Teaching National Centre for Civil Protection in Jastrebarsko"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Uređenje građevina i vanjskog prostora Nastavnog nacionalnog središta civilne zaštite u Jastrebarskom"
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: floods and landslides (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
Operation_Summary_English: The project strengthens the capacities of the civil protection system through the arrangement and reconstruction of buildings, infrastructure and external spaces of the Teaching National Centre for the training of participants and members of the operational forces of the civil protection system in Jastrebarsko. The project envisages the development of buildings, infrastructure and external spaces of the Teaching National Centre for Civil Protection in Jastrebarsko. There is currently no adequate space in the Republic of Croatia for the Teaching National Centre for the Training of Civil Protection System Participants and Operational Forces. This project will achieve the objective of improving the training and readiness of the operational forces of the civil protection system.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se jačaju kapaciteti sustava civilne zaštite kroz uređenje i rekonstrukciju građevina, infrastrukture i vanjskih prostora Nastavnog nacionalnog središta za osposobljavanje sudionika i pripadnika operativnih snaga sustava civilne zaštite u Jastrebarskom. Projektom je predviđeno uređenje građevina, infrastrukture i vanjskih prostora Nastavnog nacionalnog središta civilne zaštite u Jastrebarskom. U Republici Hrvatskoj za sada ne postoji odgovarajući prostor za djelovanje Nastavnog nacionalnog središta za osposobljavanje sudionika sustava civilne zaštite i pripadnika operativnih snaga. Ovim Projektom ostvarit će se cilj, tj. poboljšat će se osposobljenost i spremnost pripadnika operativnih snaga sustava civilne zaštite.

Operation_Name_English: Possibilities of hyperspectral images for the purpose of developing solutions based on remote observation of the Earth
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mogućnosti hiperspektralnih snimaka u svrhu razvoja rješenja temeljenih na daljinskom opažanju Zemlje
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Remote Earth Observation is a method of collecting Earth's surface data using satellites or aerial vehicles for the purpose of environmental monitoring, natural resource management, urban planning or emergency intervention. Hyperspectral data from EnMAP and PRISMA satellite missions will be used to improve machine learning results and predict ambrosia growth locations in order to ultimately develop an application solution: Ambrosia risk map. The aim of this project proposal is to acquire the necessary professional and technical knowledge of using satellite hyperspectral images for the purpose of developing new services for predicting ambrosia growth locations and improving existing services based on remote Earth observation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Daljinsko opažanje Zemlje je metoda prikupljanja podataka o površini Zemlje korištenjem satelita ili zračnih letjelica u svrhu praćenja okoliša, upravljanja prirodnim resursima, za urbanističko planiranje ili hitne intervencije. Hiperspektralni podaci EnMAP i PRISMA satelitskih misija će se upotrijebiti za unaprjeđenje rezultata strojnog učenja i predviđanja lokacija rasta ambrozije kako bi se u konačnici razvilo aplikativno rješenje: karta rizika od ambrozije. Cilj ovog projektnog prijedloga je steći potrebna stručna i tehnička znanja korištenja satelitskih hiperspektralnih snimki u svrhu razvoja novih usluga za predviđanje lokacija rasta ambrozije te poboljšanja postojećih usluga temeljenih na daljinskom opažanju Zemlje.

Operation_Name_English: They want five islands.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi za pet otoka
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups on the islands of the Cres-Lošinj archipelago. Provide care through support and support in the life of over 65 years of age and OSI. The main activity of the project is to provide support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies for 36 people over 30 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina na otocima Cresko-lošinjski arhipelag. Osigurati skrb kroz potporu i podršku u životu starijima od 65 godina i OSI. Glavna aktivnost projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština za 36 osoba kroz 30 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a management system according to ISO 9001:2015 standard that will make the company more competitive on the national and international market and thus enable it to further grow in accordance with strategic goals. The implementation of the management system and the acquisition of ISO certification will result in greater customer confidence, but also a more productive, efficient and secure business, which is the interest of the company, employees, clients and suppliers who are the target group of the project. By implementing the project, the company will be able to get new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards, and in which so far it has not been able to compete.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normi ISO 9001:2015 koji će tvrtku učiniti konkurentnijom na nacionalnom i internacionalnom tržištu te joj time omogućiti daljnji rast u skladu sa strateškim ciljevima. Implementacija sustava upravljanja i stjecanje ISO certifikata rezultirat će većim povjerenjem kupaca, ali i produktivnijim, efikasnijim i sigurnijim poslovanjem, što je interes tvrtke, djelatnika, klijenata i dobavljača koji su ciljana skupina projekta. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama, a u kojima do sada nije mogla konkurirati.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading of the kindergarten in Tinjan
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja dječjeg vrtića u Tinjanu
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project plans to expand the capacity of the kindergarten by adding a new living room that will provide space for an additional 12 children of crèche age, which directly reduces the pressure on current capacities and waiting lists. The upgrade not only increases the number of places, but also modernises the infrastructure to create optimal conditions for upbringing and education. The new space will be equipped with modern didactic equipment that supports the overall development of children—physical, emotional, social and cognitive. In addition, built-in energy efficiency systems and environmentally friendly building materials will reduce operating costs and contribute to the preservation of the environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se planira proširenje kapaciteta vrtića dodavanjem novog dnevnog boravka koji će osigurati mjesta za dodatnih 12 djece jasličke dobi, čime se direktno smanjuje pritisak na trenutne kapacitete i lista čekanja. Dogradnjom se ne samo povećava broj mjesta, već se i modernizira infrastruktura kako bi se stvorili optimalni uvjeti za odgoj i obrazovanje. Novi prostor bit će opremljen suvremenom didaktičkom opremom koja podupire cjelokupni razvoj djece—fizički, emocionalni, socijalni i kognitivni. Osim toga, ugrađeni sustavi energetske učinkovitosti i ekološki prihvatljivi građevinski materijali smanjit će operativne troškove i doprinijeti očuvanju okoliša.

Operation_Name_English: Continued development of children and youth through STEM area - NARASTEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nastavak razvoja djece i mladih kroz STEM područje - NARASTEM
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Continuing the development of children and youth through STEM area - NARASTEM" is implemented by the association APOLD Rijeka in partnership with the association Blue Growth, Faculty of Engineering of the University of Rijeka (RITEH), elementary school Vladimir Gortan, elementary school Turnić, elementary school Eugen Kumičić Rijeka, Technical School Rijeka and Electro-industrial and crafts school Rijeka, and represents a continuation of the activities of the project RASTEM. The goal of NARASTEM is to promote STEM among children and young people. This goal will be met on the one hand by strengthening the capacity of CSOs and schools to promote STEM, and on the other by implementing STEM workshops in schools and STEM days in the STEM laboratory of RITEH as forms of continuous education of children and young people.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Nastavak razvoja djece i mladih kroz STEM područje - NARASTEM" provodi udruga APOLD Rijeka u partnerstvu s udrugom Plavi rast, Tehničkim fakultetom Sveučilišta u Rijeci (RITEH), OŠ Vladimir Gortan, OŠ Turnić, OŠ Eugen Kumičić Rijeka, Tehničkom školom Rijeka i Elektroindustrijskom i obrtničkom školom Rijeka, a predstavlja nastavak aktivnosti projekta RASTEM. Cilj NARASTEM-a je promocija STEM-a među djecom i mladima. Taj će cilj biti ispunjen s jedne strane jačanjem kapaciteta OCD-a i škola za promociju STEM-a, a s druge provedbom STEM radionica u školama i STEM dana u STEM laboratoriju RITEH-a kao oblicima kontinuirane edukacije djece i mladih.

Operation_Name_English: Development of innovative fireplaces with variable stove geometry and multi-layer heating power level
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inovativnih kamina s promjenjivom geometrijom ložišta i višeslojnom razinom stupnja snage grijanja
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project lasts 36 months and includes the formation of a SPIN consortium, consisting of the Applicant EMBER KAMIN d.o.o., the company TOMANI d.o.o., MICROPLET, a craft for tool making, plastic processing and metal processing, and the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture in Zagreb as an organization for research and knowledge dissemination. The consortium works with the aim of using modern technologies in the development of innovative fireplaces with variable stove geometry and multi-layer heating power level. The project consists of two phases, industrial research and experimental development, which will provide a thorough analysis and implementation of innovative technologies in the production of fireplaces. In addition, the project also includes a feasibility study activity.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt traje 36 mjeseci te obuhvaća formiranje SPIN konzorcija, koji čine Prijavitelj EMBER KAMIN d.o.o., poduzeće TOMANI d.o.o., MICROPLET, obrt za izradu alata, preradu plastike i obradu metala te Fakultet strojarstva i brodogradnje u Zagrebu kao organizacija za istraživanje i širenje znanja. Konzorcij djeluje s ciljem korištenja suvremenih tehnologija pri razvoju inovativnih kamina s promjenjivom geometrijom ložišta i višeslojnom razinom stupnja snage grijanja. Projekt se sastoji od dvije faze, industrijskog istraživanja i eksperimentalnog razvoja, koje će osigurati temeljitu analizu i implementaciju inovativnih tehnologija u proizvodnji kamina. Osim navedenog, projekt obuhvaća i aktivnost izrade studije izvedivosti.

Operation_Name_English: Small loans for industrial transition
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mali zajmovi za industrijsku tranziciju
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
NUTS3_Label: Brodsko-posavska županija|Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija|Virovitičko-podravska županija|Požeško-slavonska županija|Koprivničko-križevačka županija|Međimurska županija|Bjelovarsko-bilogorska županija|Šibensko-kninska županija|Karlovačka županija|Sisačko-moslavačka županija|Istarska županija|Zagrebačka županija|Varaždinska županija|Osječko-baranjska županija|Vukovarsko-srijemska županija|Zadarska županija|Primorsko-goranska županija|Ličko-senjska županija|Split-Dalmatia County
Operation_Summary_English: Support will be provided through investment loans with a lower share of working capital, exclusively related to business development and expansion activities in priority niches of the regional economies of the Adriatic, Pannonian and Northern Croatia
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Potpora će se pružati putem investicijskih zajmova s manjim udjelom obrtnih sredstava, isključivo povezana s aktivnostima razvoja i širenja poslovne aktivnosti u prioritetnim nišama regionalnoga gospodarstava Jadranske, Panonske te Sjeverne Hrvatske

Operation_Name_English: TIME - Parents' Time, Mental Energy Initiative
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: VRIME – Vrijeme Roditelja, Inicijativa za Mentalnu Energiju
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will last 16 months in the area of Split-Dalmatia County and is designed to provide innovative social holiday service to parents caregivers and caregivers of children with developmental disabilities and people with disabilities. Association Spektar, as the project holder, cooperates with partners Centre for Education Sava Raška Split and Association Perle to provide parents with a break from everyday care, providing replacement professional care for their household members.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt će trajati 16 mjeseci na području Splitsko dalmatinske županije i osmišljen je kako bi pružio inovativnu socijalnu uslugu odmora roditeljima njegovateljima i njegovateljima djece s teškoćama u razvoju i osoba s invaliditetom. Udruga Spektar, kao nositelj projekta, surađuje s partnerima Centrom za odgoj i obrazovanje Sava Raška Split i Udrugom Perle kako bi omogućili roditeljima predah od svakodnevne skrbi, pružajući zamjensku stručnu njegu za njihove članove kućanstva.

Operation_Name_English: STEM Magical World
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM čarobni svijet
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: STEM Magic World is a project whose overall goal is to strengthen the capacities of the Applicants Association in promoting STEM among children and students. This will be achieved through two specific objectives: 1. Enhanced capacities of the Association of Applicants for the implementation of programs in the field of STEM promotion and cooperation with higher education institutions and educational institutions 2. Activities carried out with the aim of promoting STEM among children and students. The project will be implemented in a partnership consisting of one Association (Applicant), two higher education institutions and four educational institutions. The project will last 24 months and will be implemented throughout the Republic of Croatia, but with a special emphasis on the Šibenik-Knin County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: STEM čarobni svijet je projekt čiji je opći cilj jačanje kapaciteta Udruge Prijavitelja u promociji STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. Navedeno će se ostvariti kroz dva specifična cilja: 1. Unaprijeđeni kapaciteti Udruge Prijavitelja za provedbu programa u području promocije STEM-a te suradnja sa visokim učilištima i odgojno - obrazovnim institucijama 2. Provedene aktivnosti s ciljem promocije STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. Projekt će se provesti u partnerstvu koje se sastoji od jedne Udruge (Prijavitelj), dva visoka učilišta i četiri odgojno - obrazovne institucije. Projekt će trajati 24 mjeseca i provodit će se na području cijele Republike Hrvatske, ali sa posebnim naglaskom na Šibensko - kninsku županiju.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of Pernica d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija poslovanja društva Pernica d. o. o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Certification of Pernica d.o.o.’ was created in response to the recognised need to ensure the quality, safety and compliance of products and processes with international standards. The primary objective of the project is to increase the competitiveness of applicants through product certification and management system. The focus of the project is on the implementation of standards that will improve the quality of products and management processes, reduce operational and other risks and enable entry into wider domestic and international markets. This ensures user confidence, revenue growth and long-term business sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Certifikacija poslovanja društva Pernica d.o.o." nastao je kao odgovor na prepoznatu potrebu za osiguravanjem kvalitete, sigurnosti i usklađenosti proizvoda i procesa s međunarodnim standardima. Primarni cilj projekta je povećanje konkurentnosti prijavitelja kroz certificiranje proizvoda i sustava upravljanja. Fokus projekta je na implementaciji normi koje će unaprijediti kvalitetu proizvoda i upravljačkih procesa, smanjiti operativne i druge rizike i omogućiti ulazak na šira domaća i međunarodna tržišta. Time se osigurava povjerenje korisnika, rast prihoda i dugoročna održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of pedestrian-cycling infrastructure in the Municipality of Vladislavci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja pješačko-biciklističke infrastrukture u Općini Vladislavci
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The construction and reconstruction of cycling infrastructure in the Municipality of Vladislavci will enable better communication of pedestrians and cyclists through the settlements of Vladislavci, Dopsin and Hrastin in response to the lack of public transport. The trail in the length of 3,764 km will be a link with the pedestrian-cycling trail on the route Čepin and Ernestinovo (as part of the UA Osijek). As it is a very busy section of the county road, it is of great importance for the local community to build a quality, long-lasting, safe and accessible pedestrian-cycling trail in accordance with legal regulations that will improve connectivity, encourage sustainable mobility and promote a healthy lifestyle by encouraging cycling as an alternative form of transport for all target groups.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Izgradnjom i rekonstrukcijom biciklističke infrastrukture u Općini Vladislavci omogućiti će se bolja komunikacija pješaka i biciklista kroz naselja Vladislavci,Dopsin i Hrastin kao odgovor nedostatku javnog prijevoza. Predmetna staza u duljini 3,764 km biti će poveznica s pješačko-biciklističkom stazom na relaciji Čepin i Ernestinovo (u sklopu UA Osijek). Kako se radi o izrazito prometnoj dionici županijske ceste, od velike je važnosti za lokalnu zajednicu izgraditi kvalitetnu, dugotrajnu, sigurnu i pristupačnu pješačko- biciklističku stazu sukladno zakonskim propisima koja će poboljšati povezanost, potaknuti održivu mobilnost te promicati zdrav način života kroz poticanje biciklizma kao alternativnog oblika prijevoza za sve ciljne skupine.

Operation_Name_English: Engage - prevention of institutionalization - Phase 4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uključi se - prevencija institucionalizacije - faza 4
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will provide care and care for at least 72 end users - older people and people with disabilities - with the delivery of a monthly package of household and hygiene supplies.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se omogućiti briga i skrb za najmanje 72 krajnja korisnika - osobe starije životne dobi i osobe s invaliditetom - uz isporuku mjesečnog paketa kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština.

Operation_Name_English: I give my hands - II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pružam ruke - II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups through the provision of support and support services in everyday life to the elderly and people with disabilities in the area of the city of Rijeka and the municipality of Čavle. The project includes activities providing support and support services and a division that includes: 1. Recruitment of 10 providers of support and support services, 2. Monitoring and control of performed services, 3. Purchase and division of packages into household and basic hygiene supplies, 4. Communication and visibility, 5. Project management and administration. Target groups are people over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities. The duration of the project is 36 months, of which the active provision of the service is 32 months. the total value of the project is 480.000,00 EUR.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom na području grada Rijeke i općine Čavle. Projekt obuhvaća aktivnosti pružanje usluge potpore i podrške i podjelu koja uključuje: 1. zapošljavanje 10 pružatelja usluge potpore i podrške, 2. praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, 3. nabava i podjela paketa k kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, 4. komunikacija i vidljivost, 5. upravljanje projektom i administracija. Ciljane skupine su osobe starije od 65 godina i odrasle osobe s invaliditetom. Trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci od čega aktivno pružanje usluge iznosi 32 mjeseca. ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 480.000,00 EUR.

Operation_Name_English: Teaching assistants/professional communication mediators in support of inclusive education, phase VI.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoćnici u nastavi/stručni komunikacijski posrednici kao potpora inkluzivnom obrazovanju, faza VI.

Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta pružiti je potporu uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju uz pomoć PUN i SKP u programe odgoja i obrazovanja u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama u cilju ostvarivanja njihove uspješnije socijalizacije te podizanja razine njihovih obrazovnih postignuća i emocionalnog funkcioniranja.

Komunikacija i vidljivost (minimalno izrada plakata s osnovnim informacijama o projektu te letaka za informiranje sudionika i objava na službenoj stranici Prijavitelja). 5. Upravljanje projektom i administracija (početkom provedbe projekta zaposliti će se voditelj projekta).

Operation_Name_English: I work and help IV.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Radim i pomažem IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective – to provide support and support services in daily life for 90 members of the target group, the elderly (85) and people with disabilities (5), which will directly contribute to their greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalisation, staying in their own home and ensuring the right to live in the community. Once a month, they will be assigned a package with prescribed household and basic hygiene supplies. This will be achieved by improving the position in the labour market (employment) of 15 less employable people with a lower level of education, in order to mitigate the consequences of their unemployment and the risk of poverty, as well as to foster social inclusion and increase the level of quality of life.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj – pružiti usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 90 pripadnika ciljane skupine, starijim osobama (85) i osobama s invaliditetom (5), što će direktno pridonijeti njihovoj većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguravanju prava na životu u zajednici. Jednom mjesečno bit će im dodijeljen paket s propisanim kućanskim i osnovnim higijenskim potrepštinama. To će se postići kroz unapređenje položaja na tržištu rada (zapošljavanje) 15 teže zapošljivih osoba s nižom razinom obrazovanja, kako bi ublažili posljedice njihove nezaposlenosti i rizika od siromaštva te potaknuli socijalnu uključenost i povećali razinu kvalitete života.

Operation_Name_English: "ABAKUS hybrid modular platform for information, content exchange and consulting in the field of agriculture - (AI Boosted Agri Knowledge Usage System)".
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "ABAKUS hibridna modularna platforma za informiranje, razmjenu sadržaja i savjetovanje iz područja poljoprivrede- (AI Boosted Agri Knowledge Usage System )".
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Agroklub d.o.o. and SPIN consortium partners represent a project aimed at improving the quality assessment of media content in the field of agrarians and food production. At a time when digital media produces large amounts of content with questionable social utility, this project seeks to establish a new standard through the development of an innovative, hybrid platform that integrates artificial intelligence (AI) and human expertise. The aim is to enable a more precise quality assessment, automatic distribution and better monetization of content. The new methodology and technological solutions will ensure ethics and a high level of quality in digital publishing, responding to modern challenges and market needs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Agroklub d.o.o. i partneri iz SPIN konzorcija predstavljaju projekt usmjeren na poboljšanje ocjenjivanja kvalitete medijskog sadržaja u području agrara i proizvodnje hrane. U doba kada digitalni mediji proizvode velike količine sadržaja s upitnom društvenom korisnošću, ovaj projekt teži uspostaviti novi standard kroz razvoj inovativne, hibridne platforme koja integrira umjetnu inteligenciju (AI) i ljudsku ekspertizu. Cilj je omogućiti precizniju procjenu kvalitete, automatsku distribuciju te bolju monetizaciju sadržaja. Nova metodologija i tehnološka rješenja osigurat će etičnost i visoku razinu kvalitete u digitalnom izdavaštvu, odgovarajući na suvremene izazove i potrebe tržišta.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - help and support in the home
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - pomoć i podrška u domu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The applicant will implement the project with a partner: They want help and support in the home. Objectives of the project OC-Reduction of social exclusion and prevention of institutionalization of people over 65 years of age and adults OSI, SC1-Increasing social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization for 180 older people and OSI by providing support and support services with procurement and distribution of packages. Activities: 1. Provide support and support services 2. Distribution of necessities 3. Communication and visibility 4. Project management and administration. The applicant will employ 30 service providers. The total value of the project is 1.485.000,00 euros. The estimated duration of the project is 35 months and will be implemented in the city of Zagreb.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavitelj će s partnerom provesti projekt: Zaželi - pomoć i podrška u domu. Ciljevi projekta OC-Smanjenje socijalne isključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije osoba starijih od 65 godina i odraslih OSI, SC1-Povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije za 180 starijih osoba i OSI pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa. Aktivnosti: 1. pružanje usluge potpore i podrške 2. podjela potrepština 3. komunikacija i vidljivost 4. upravljanje projektom i administracija. Prijavitelj će zaposliti 30 pružatelja usluga. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 1.485.000,00 eura. Predviđeno trajanje projekta iznosi 35 mjeseci i provest će se na području grada Zagreba.

Operation_Name_English: Loans for sustainable tourism
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Krediti za održivi turizam
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this financial instrument is to encourage investments and to support new, financially sustainable investments of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises, taking into account the contribution to the goals of the green transition and the quality of tourism products and services in the form of favourable loans with the possibility of capital write-offs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog financijskog instrumenta je poticanje investicija te pružanje potpore novim, financijski održivim ulaganjima mikro, malih i srednjih poduzetnika, vodeći računa o doprinosu ciljevima zelene tranzicije te kvaliteti turističkih proizvoda i usluga u vidu povoljnih kredita s mogućnošću otpisa glavnice.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of innovative digital products from AZONPRINTER d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija inovativnih digitalnih proizvoda tvrtke AZONPRINTER d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of the company AZONPRINTER through the certification of new generations of products in accordance with internationally recognized standards (CE, UL). The purpose is to enable product placement on global markets, increase customer confidence and ensure business sustainability and growth. Expected results include obtaining certification for four digital products, including a powder adhesive applicator, DTF and UVDTF printers, and a UV printer, which will ensure compliance with the technical and safety requirements of the target markets. Activities include testing in authorized laboratories and implementation of conformity assessment procedures, which will allow the placement of certified products on international markets and strengthen the company's position.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke AZONPRINTER kroz certifikaciju novih generacija proizvoda u skladu s međunarodno priznatim normama (CE, UL). Svrha je omogućiti plasman proizvoda na globalna tržišta, povećati povjerenje kupaca te osigurati održivost i rast poslovanja. Očekivani rezultati uključuju dobivanje certifikata za četiri digitalna proizvoda, uključujući aplikator ljepila u prahu, DTF i UVDTF printere te UV pisač, čime će se osigurati usklađenost s tehničkim i sigurnosnim zahtjevima ciljnih tržišta. Aktivnosti obuhvaćaju ispitivanja u ovlaštenim laboratorijima te provedbu postupaka ocjenjivanja sukladnosti, što će omogućiti plasman certificiranih proizvoda na međunarodna tržišta i jačanje pozicije tvrtke.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment and certification of quality management system according to ISO 9001
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uspostava i certifikacija sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema ISO 9001
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: By implementing this project, Skypala d.o.o. will introduce the quality management system ISO 9001, which will enable more efficient business management, a better response to market needs and the creation of a sustainable competitive advantage. The aim of the project is to contribute to the efficiency and sustainability of business processes, facilitate and improve access to the international market, strengthen international competitiveness and increase customer confidence and company reputation. The results of the project introduced a quality management system and increased sales and export revenues.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom ovog projekta poduzeće Skypala d.o.o. uvesti će u poslovanje sustav upravljanja kvalitetom ISO 9001, čime će omogućiti učinkovitije upravljanje poslovanjem, bolji odgovor na potrebe tržišta i stvaranje održive konkurentske prednosti. Cilj projekta je pridonijeti učinkovitosti i održivosti poslovnih procesa, olakšati i poboljšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu, ojačati međunarodnu konkurentnost te povećati povjerenje kupaca i ugled poduzeća. Rezultati projekta su uvedeni sustav upravljanja kvalitetom te povećani prihodi od prodaje i izvoza.

Operation_Name_English: With teaching assistants to inclusive education in Primorje-Gorski Kotar County VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uz pomoćnike u nastavi do inkluzivnog obrazovanja u Primorsko - goranskoj županiji VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective of the project is to create conditions for the undisturbed acquisition of knowledge, skills and competences of children/pupils with developmental difficulties in primary and secondary schools in the Primorje-Gorski Kotar County, and to provide support for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning in everyday life and work environment. The main activity of the project is to provide support in the education of students with disabilities through the work of PUN/CPC, which will be realized through the following sub-activities: Implementation of the PUN/CPC candidate selection process for pupils with disabilities; implementation of the PUN/CPC deployment programme; PUN/CPC operation; communication and visibility; project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je stvoriti uvjete za nesmetano stjecanje znanja, vještina i kompetencija djece/učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnim i srednjim školama na području Primorsko-goranske županije, te pružiti podršku za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje u svakodnevnom životu i radnoj okolini. Glavna aktivnost projekta je pružanje potpore u obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad PUN/SKP, koja će se realizirati slijedećim podaktivnostima: provedba postupka selekcije kandidata za PUN/SKP učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju; provedba programa uvođenje u rad PUN/SKP; rad PUN/SKP; komunikacija i vidljivost; upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: We are here for you
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Tu smo za Vas
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of the project are to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of older people and adults with disabilities and to contribute to the revitalization of rural areas such as Čabar. Activities are the provision of assistance and support services or employment for at least 6 members of the target group in organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and meeting other daily needs with monitoring and control of the services performed, procurement and distribution of packages of necessities, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta su povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije starijih osoba i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom te doprinos revitalizaciji ruralnih područja kao što je Čabar. Aktivnosti su pružanje usluge pomoći i podrške odnosno zapošljavanje za minimalno 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine u organiziranju prehrane, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, održavanju osobne higijene i zadovoljavanju drugih svakodnevnih potreba uz praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: "WORK OF HISTORY" - Reconstruction of the building of "Bosanski magazine" in the student food restaurant and interpretation center
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "ZALOGAJ POVIJESTI" - Rekonstrukcija zgrade "Bosanskog magazina" u restoran studentske prehrane i interpretacijski centar
Category_Label: Rehabilitation of industrial sites and contaminated land|Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘AMENDMENT OF HISTORY’ - Reconstruction of the building of ‘Bosanski magazine’ into a student food restaurant and interpretation centre will preserve cultural heritage for the purpose of economic, tourism and cultural development of the Greater Urban Area of Karlovac, including contributing to the improvement of student standards and the availability of higher education.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „ZALOGAJ POVIJESTI”- Rekonstrukcija zgrade „Bosanskog magazina” u restoran studentske prehrane i interpretacijski centar, očuvat će se kulturna baština u svrhu gospodarskog, turističkog i kulturnog razvoja Većeg urbanog područja Karlovac uključujući doprinos poboljšanju studentskog standarda i dostupnosti visokoškolskog obrazovanja.

Operation_Name_English: The Port of Hope
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Luka nade
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of this project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. Activities include: the provision of support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and persons with disabilities, with the procurement and distribution of a package of necessities that includes: recruitment of service providers, procurement and division of packages, monitoring and control of services performed, U&A and P&V.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj ovog projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnosti uključuju: pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje: zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga, nabava i podjela paketa, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, U&A i P&V.

Operation_Name_English: Wish and stay
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi i ostani
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The main objective of the project is to provide long-term care through support and support to older people in order to prevent institutionalization and increase the social inclusion of older people. In 36 months of implementation, support and support will be provided in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities through food organizations, household chores, personal hygiene maintenance and meeting daily needs. Support and support will be provided to a minimum of 42 people in the target group.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni je cilj projekta kroz potporu i podršku starijim osobama omogućiti dugotrajnu skrb kako bi se spriječila institucionalizacija te povećala socijalna uključenost starijih osoba. U 36 mjeseci provedbe osigurat će se potpora i podrška u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom kroz organizacije prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene te zadovoljavanje svakodnevnih potreba. Pružat će se potpora i podrška za minimalno 42 osobe ciljne skupine.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment of a management system in Frey
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uspostava sustava upravljanja u obrtu Frey
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to increase the competitiveness of Frey through the implementation of ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 standards in business processes. The project solves the problem of uncertified business processes for visualization, design, tailoring and sewing of luxury tapestries, which will enable better compliance of the process with clients' requirements and strengthen the position of the Craft on the market. The implementation of this Project will enable the solution of weaknesses through the certification of business processes, which will further increase the competitiveness and recognition of Applicants in the international market of luxury ship tapestries and interiors. The aim is to attract new customers, increase sales and export revenues and ensure continuous improvement of the management of business quality and environmental protection systems.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha Projekta je povećati konkurentnost obrta Frey kroz implementaciju normi ISO 9001 i ISO 14001 u poslovne procese. Projekt rješava problem necertificiranih poslovnih procesa za vizualizaciju, dizajn, krojenje i šivanje luksuzne tapiserije, što će omogućiti bolju usklađenost procesa sa zahtjevima klijenata te jačanje pozicije Obrta na tržištu. Provedba ovog Projekta omogućit će rješavanje slabosti kroz certifikaciju poslovnih procesa, što će dodatno povećati konkurentnost i prepoznatljivost Prijavitelja na međunarodnom tržištu luksuzne brodske tapiserije i interijera. Cilj je privući nove klijente, povećati prihode od prodaje i izvoza te osigurati kontinuirano poboljšanje upravljanja sustavima kvalitete poslovanja i zaštite okoliša.

Operation_Name_English: Revitalization of the ethnographic museum and ethno park through the decoration, equipping and development of digital and multimedia presentation of cultural heritage
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Revitalizacija etnografskog muzeja i etno parka kroz uređenje, opremanje i razvoj digitalne i multimedijalne prezentacije kulturne baštine
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Revitalisation of the ethnographic museum and ethno park through the arrangement, equipping and development of digital and multimedia presentations of cultural heritage’ contributes to the development of cultural content and cultural infrastructure in the Greater Bjelovar Urban Area. The project contributes to solving the problem of lack of cultural and tourist content in a tourist underdeveloped area.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Revitalizacija etnografskog muzeja i etno parka kroz uređenje, opremanje i razvoj digitalne i multimedijalne prezentacije kulturne baštine“ doprinosi razvoju kulturnih sadržaja i kulturne infrastrukture na području Većeg urbanog područja Bjelovar. Projekt doprinosi rješavanju problema nedostatka kulturno-turističkih sadržaja na turistički nerazvijenom području.

Operation_Name_English: Solidarity in the Community
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Solidarnost u zajednici
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes a target group, i.e. over 65 years of age and people with disabilities over 18 years of age, 90 people from the municipality of Viškovci and the employment of 15 service providers who will provide home assistance and support during the project implementation period for a period of 33 months. It will contribute to increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care through the provision of support and support services in the daily life of the target group within the local community. The implementation period is 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt uključuje ciljanu skupinu odnosno starije osobe od 65 godina starosti i osobe s invaliditetom starije od 18 godina, 90 osoba s područja općine Viškovci te zapošljavanje 15 osoba pružatelja usluga koje će tijekom razdoblja provedbe projekta pružati uslugu pomoći i potpore u kući kroz razdoblje od 33 mjeseca. Pridonijet će se povećanju socijalne uključenosti i prevenciji institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz pružanje usluga potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu ciljnoj skupini unutar lokalne zajednice. Razdoblje provedbe je 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Development of advanced web scraping systems using machine learning algorithms for ETL processes for VendueTech
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj sustava naprednog web scrapinga uz primjenu algoritama strojnog učenja za ETL procese za tvrtku VendueTech
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project addresses the problem of fragmentation and opacity of the real estate market in forced sales in the EU, which annually includes over 250,000 court auctions. The aim of this project is to acquire the necessary professional and technical knowledge in order to develop an innovative platform that integrates advanced web scraping and machine learning for the collection, analysis and presentation of real estate auction data from different sources and in different languages. The platform will overcome language and legal barriers, standardise data and provide in-depth analytical insights. Target groups include individual and institutional investors, real estate agencies, financial institutions and public administration bodies.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmetni projekt adresira problem fragmentiranosti i netransparentnosti tržišta nekretnina u prisilnoj prodaji u EU, koje godišnje obuhvaća preko 250.000 sudskih dražbi. Cilj predmetnog projekta jest steći potrebna stručna i tehnička znanja kako bi se razvila inovativna platforma koja integrira napredni web scraping i strojno učenje za prikupljanje, analizu i prezentaciju podataka o aukcijama nekretnina iz različitih izvora i na različitim jezicima. Platforma će premostiti jezične i pravne barijere, standardizirati podatke i pružiti dubinske analitičke uvide. Ciljne skupine uključuju individualne i institucionalne investitore, agencije za nekretnine, financijske institucije i tijela javne uprave.

Operation_Name_English: Help Hand III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ruka pomoći III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support services, increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization for at least 150 older people and people with disabilities. Project activities include the implementation of a public call for the involvement of interested participants, the recruitment of 25 service providers who will perform support and support services for a minimum of 150 members of the targeted group (min. 6 members per service provider), monitoring and control of the services performed, the procurement and distribution of packages of household and hygiene supplies, ensuring communication and visibility of the project, and administrative monitoring through the recruitment of project managers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške, povećanje socijalne uključenosti te prevencija institucionalizacije za min. 150 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom. Aktivnosti projekta uključuju provedbu javnog poziva za uključivanje zainteresiranih sudionika, zapošljavanje 25 pružatelja usluge koji će obavljati usluge potpore i podrške za min. 150 pripadnika ciljane skupne (min. 6 pripadnika po pružatelju usluge), praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština, osigurati komunikaciju i vidljivost projekta te administrativno praćenje zapošljavanjem voditelja projekta.

Operation_Name_English: The use of AI-based digital technologies in education (BrAIn)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Primjena digitalnih tehnologija temeljenih na umjetnoj inteligenciji u obrazovanju (BrAIn)
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to improve the quality and extend the time students spend in the educational process through the integration of digital technologies, the establishment of a personalized learning approach and the development of curricula from emerging digital technologies. The project will provide support to educational workers in the application of artificial intelligence in education and strengthen the capacity to raise students' competences. The main project activities are focused on the development of students' competences through research and curricula, the implementation of a system of smart recommendations in the CARNET ecosystem, automation of network surveillance (AIOps), the improvement of cybersecurity and education in the application of artificial intelligence in education.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt ima za cilj unaprijediti kvalitetu i produljiti vrijeme koje učenici provode u obrazovnom procesu kroz integraciju digitalnih tehnologija, uspostavu personaliziranog pristupa učenju i razvoj kurikuluma iz digitalnih tehnologija u nastajanju. Kroz projekt će se osigurati podrška obrazovnim radnicima u primjeni umjetne inteligencije u obrazovanju te jačanje kapaciteta za podizanje kompetencija učenika. Glavne projektne aktivnosti usmjerene su na razvoj kompetencija učenika kroz istraživanja i kurikulume, implementaciju sustava pametnih preporuka u CARNET-ov ekosustav, automatizaciju nadzora mreže (AIOps), unaprjeđenje kibernetičke sigurnosti te edukacije u primjeni umjetne inteligencije u obrazovanju.

Operation_Name_English: Social plan of Virovitica-Podravina County for the period 2024-2026
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalni plan Virovitičko-podravske županije za razdoblje od 2024.-2026.
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to the increase of accessibility and equal development of social services in the county by developing a social county plan. Specific goals are to provide support in the preparation of the county social plan, to empower the members of the Social Welfare Council and the employees of the branch office for the planning, implementation and monitoring of social plans.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je doprinijeti povećanju dostupnosti i ravnomjernom razvoju socijalnih usluga u županiji izradom socijalnog županijskog plana. Specifični ciljevi su pružiti podršku u izradi županijskog socijalnog plana, osnažiti članove Savjeta za socijalnu skrb te zaposlenike VPŽ za planiranje, provedbu i praćenje socijalnih planova.

Operation_Name_English: Rest, you have support.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmori se, imaš podršku
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The association "Jaglac" Orahovica in partnership with the Association Velikaka, Velika and the Center Niteo, Slavonski Brod will provide a rest service from care for 27 parents of caregivers/carers by providing care for 27 children with TUR/OSI dependent on their support in the area of 3 counties with less representation of social services and their providers: PWD, PWD and PWD. They will hire an expert team (2 eduk. rehab. and soc.rad.) with the aim of creating individual plans, educating and mentoring 9 family assistants to provide services to 27 users in their home / space of the association 216 days in 3 counties; conduct 4 user empowerment workshops and 4 workshops for children with TUR/OSI at location 3 of the association; carry out a final evaluation and develop guidelines for the further development of the service.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Udruga "Jaglac" Orahovica u partnerstvu s Udrugom Veličanka, Velika i Centrom Niteo, Slavonski Brod pružiti će uslugu odmor od skrbi za 27 roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja osiguravanjem skrbi za 27 djece s TUR/OSI ovisnih o njihovoj podršci na području 3 županije s manjom zastupljenosti socijalnih usluga i njihovih pružatelja: VPŽ, PSŽ i BPŽ. Angažirati će stručni tim (2 eduk. rehab. i soc.rad.) u cilju izrade individualnih planova, edukacije i mentoriranja 9 obiteljskih asistenata za pružanje usluge 27 korisnika u njihovom domu/prostoru udruge 216 dana u 3 županije; provesti 4 radionice osnaživanja korisnika i 4 radionice za djecu s TUR/OSI na lokaciji 3 udruge; provesti završnu evaluaciju i izraditi smjernice za daljnji razvoj usluge.

Operation_Name_English: Special purpose eco-asphalt layers carried out under a cold process with reduced CO2 emissions
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Eko-asfaltni slojevi posebne namjene izvedeni po hladnom postupkom uz smanjenu emisiju CO2
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to address the negative impact of conventional asphalt methods on the environment and infrastructure, including high greenhouse gas emissions, the creation of urban heat islands, high energy consumption and frequent maintenance needs due to asphalt degradation. The project proposal concerns the research and development activities of an innovative product of recycled asphalt mixture with added cold-installation emulsions and added stabilization additives with a coating for reduced UV absorption and reduced thermal emission, using dioskid titanium and additives for better adhesion. Target pools: construction sector, local population
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt želi riješiti problem negativnog utjecaja konvencionalnih metoda asfaltiranja na okoliš i infrastrukturu, uključujući visoke emisije stakleničkih plinova, stvaranje urbanih toplinskih otoka, visoku potrošnju energije i česte potrebe za održavanjem zbog degradacije asfalta. Projektni prijedlog se odnosi na istraživačke i razvojne aktivnosti inovativnog proizvoda mješavine recikliranog asfalta s dodanim emulzijama za hladnu ugradnju i dodanim aditivima za stabilizaciju s premazom za smanjenu apsorpciju UV zračenja i smanjenu emisiju toplinskog zračenja, korištenjem titanijum dioskida i aditiva za bolju prionjivost. Ciljne skupne: građevinski sektor, lokalno stanovništvo

Operation_Name_English: Rest, you deserve it!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmorite, zaslužili ste!
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: Association for children with developmental disabilities Zvončići has designed the project "Rest, you deserve!" through which it will provide innovative social services of rest from care and include at least 13 people who have a recognized right to the status of parents of caregivers for children / children with developmental difficulties. The project activities will be carried out in the Karlovac County. Through three activities, they will be given time for themselves through the care of a child who is cared for as a caregiver parent. The estimated duration of the project is 18 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Udruga za djecu s teškoćama u razvoju Zvončići osmislila je projekt "Odmorite, zaslužili ste!" kroz koji će pružati inovativne socijalne usluge odmora od skrbi te uključiti minimalno 13 osoba koje imaju priznato pravo na status roditelja njegovatelja za njegu djeteta/djece s teškoćama u razvoju. Aktivnosti projekta će se provoditi na području Karlovačke županije. Kroz tri aktivnosti omogućit će im se vrijeme za sebe kroz brigu za dijete za koje se osoba skrbi kao roditelj njegovatelj. Predviđeno trajanje projekta je 18 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Helping vulnerable groups together
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno pomažimo ranjivim skupinama
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective of the project – to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and persons with disabilities. Providing support and support services with the purchase and distribution of packages of supplies for at least 6 members of the target group. Service providers will be hired to help organize food, do household chores, maintain personal hygiene, procure and share packages with household and hygiene supplies. Monitoring and control of the services performed, communication and visibility, project management and administration will be carried out by the applicant with the partner.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta – pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština za min 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine. Zapošljavat će se pružatelje usluga koji će pomoći u organizaciji prehrane, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, održavanju osobne higijene, nabavit će se i podijeliti paketi s kućanskim i higijenskim potrepštinama. Praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju vršit će prijavitelj s partnerom.

Operation_Name_English: Urban Development Fund
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Urbani razvojni fond
Category_Label: Rehabilitation of industrial sites and contaminated land|Protection, development and promotion of public tourism assets and tourism services|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this financial instrument is to encourage investment in public and business infrastructure, with social and commercial content, which generates revenue from the collection of services of use by entrepreneurs, citizens and tourists
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog financijskog instrumenta je poticanje ulaganja u javnu i poslovnu infrastrukturu, s društvenim i komercijalnim sadržajima, koja ostvaruje prihode od naplate usluga korištenja od strane poduzetnika, građana i turista

Operation_Name_English: WANTS - realized in the municipality of Cista Provo
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI - ostvari u općini Cista Provo
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project Zaželi - Achieve in the Municipality of Cista Provo is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care for 108 elderly, disabled and disabled people. The main activities of the project are the process of selecting the project manager and coordinator, implementation of a public call for expressions of interest for participation in project activities, provision of support services and project management, administration and promotion and visibility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta Zaželi - ostvari u općini Cista Provo je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi za 108 starijih i nemoćnih osoba te osoba s invaliditetom. Glavne aktivnosti projekta su proces odabira voditelja i koordinatora projekta, provedba javnog poziva za iskaz interesa za sudjelovanjem u projektnim aktivnostima, pružanje usluge potpore te upravljanje projektom, administracija i promidžba i vidljivost.

Operation_Name_English: Education of Equal Opportunities IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obrazovanje jednakih mogućnosti IV
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Engagement of 45 PUN/CPC for students with disabilities in schools founded by the Lika-Senj County, which will provide support for students with disabilities in the area of Lika-Senj County during the implementation of the project in order to ensure conditions for improving educational achievements, as well as for increasing social inclusion and integration of students with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Angažiranje 45 PUN/SKP za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju u školama u kojima je osnivač Ličko-senjska županija koji će tijekom provedbe projekta pružati potporu za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju na području Ličko-senjske županije kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje obrazovnih postignuća, kao i za povećanje socijalne uključenosti i integracije učenika s teškoćama.

Operation_Name_English: Open scientific infrastructure platforms for innovative applications in the economy and society O-ZIP, Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Otvorene znanstvene infrastrukturne platforme za inovativne primjene u gospodarstvu i društvu O-ZIP, faza II
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in public research centres and higher education directly linked to research and innovation activities
Operation_Summary_English: O-ZIP includes the improvement of existing and the construction of new contents of the Ruđer Bošković Institute (RBI) for the implementation of top research. The project will result in the establishment of 4 multidisciplinary research platforms and the implementation of organizational reform within the RBI, in order to enable the achievement of new levels of scientific excellence. The implementation of the O-ZIP project will create the preconditions for increasing the scope, quality and efficiency of research aimed at solving social challenges, implementing top-notch collaborative research and promoting the importance of commercialization of research results, contributing to the development of innovative and competitive entrepreneurship.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: O-ZIP obuhvaća unapređenje postojećih i izgradnju novih sadržaja Instituta Ruđer Bošković (IRB-a) za provedbu vrhunskih istraživanja. Projekt će rezultirati uspostavom 4 multidisciplinarne istraživačke platforme te provedbom organizacijske reforme u sklopu IRB-a, kako bi se omogućilo dostizanje novih razina znanstvene izvrsnosti. Provedbom projekta O-ZIP stvorit će se preduvjeti za povećanje opsega, kvalitete i učinkovitosti istraživanja usmjerenih ka rješavanju društvenih izazova, provedbu vrhunskih kolaborativnih istraživanja te promicanje važnosti komercijalizacije rezultata istraživanja, doprinoseći razvoju inovativnog i konkurentnog poduzetništva.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrade of the Vrulje pier within the maritime-passenger terminal in the port of Šibenik (phase III of the project) - phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja gata Vrulje u sklopu pomorsko-putničkog terminala u luci Šibenik (III. faza zahvata) - faza 2
Category_Label: Multimodal transport (TEN-T)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the construction of a maritime-passenger terminal as an extension of the Vrulje pier in the port of Šibenik. The project is implemented through two programming periods 2014-2020 and 2021-2027, and the implementation of the project takes place in phase 2. The total value of both phases of the project is EUR 8,206,770.74, of which the eligible costs are EUR 4,274,351.06 and the ineligible EUR 3,932,419.68 (the part of the terminal not dedicated to connecting to the islands). The total value of the first phase was EUR 1.863.257,39 with eligible costs of EUR 822.498,44 and ineligible costs of EUR 1.040.758,95. The total value of the second phase of the project is EUR 6.343.513,35 of which EUR 3.451.852,62 are eligible costs and EUR 2.891.660,73 are ineligible.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgradnja pomorsko-putničkog terminala kao dogradnja gata Vrulje u luci Šibenik. Projekt se provodi kroz dva programska razdoblja 2014.-2020. i 2021.-2027., te se provedba projekta odvija u 2. faze.
