Ukupna vrijednost obje faze projekta je 8.206.770,74 EUR od čega su prihvatljivi troškovi 4.274.351,06 EUR, a neprihvatljivi 3.932.419,68 EUR (dio terminala koji nije namijenjen povezivanju s otocima). Ukupna vrijednost prve faze iznosila je 1.863.257,39 EUR s prihvatljivim troškovima u iznosu od 822.498,44 EUR i neprihvatljivim troškovima u iznosu od 1.040.758,95 EUR. Ukupna vrijednost druge faze projekta je 6.343.513,35 EUR od čega su prihvatljivi troškovi u iznosu od 3.451.852,62 EUR te neprihvatljivi od 2.891.660,73 EUR

Operation_Name_English: Construction and equipping of the regional building of the Bedekovčina Kindergarten in Poznanovec
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja i opremanje područnog objekta Dječjeg vrtića Bedekovčina u Poznanovcu
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of the project "Construction and equipping of the regional facility of the Bedekovčina kindergarten in Poznanovec" is to increase the infrastructural availability of preschool education through the construction and equipping of the regional kindergarten with a kitchen. The project will be implemented for 28 months, two (2) additional daily stays of the nursery group and three (3) daily stays of the kindergarten group of children will be realized, which will provide additional places for 84 children in the area of applicants and partners.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta "Izgradnja i opremanje područnog objekta Dječjeg vrtića Bedekovčina u Poznanovcu" je povećati infrastrukturnu dostupnost predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja kroz izgradnju i opremanje područnog vrtića s kuhinjom. Projekt će se provoditi 28 mjeseci, ostvarit će se dva (2) dodatna dnevna boravka jasličke skupine i tri (3) dnevna boravka vrtićke skupine djece čime će se osigurati dodatna mjesta za 84 djece na području prijavitelja i partnera.

Operation_Name_English: By certification until the growth of Proaxis d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do rasta tvrtke Proaxis d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Proaxis conducted a business analysis and identified problems that will be solved by the implementation of the project, including reduced competitiveness, inability to prove quality, lack of traceability of documentation and unoptimized business processes. Objective of the project: strengthen the company's capacities through the introduction of ISO 20000-1:2018, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 22301:2019 standards, i.e. optimization and improvement of 9 business processes, which will contribute to increasing its (international) competitiveness, facilitating access to the international market and increasing the competitiveness of SMEs by certifying management systems in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards = preconditions for the growth of sales revenues (5.1%) and export revenues (30.1%), by 2028. (m+2).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Proaxis je proveo analizu poslovanja i identificirao probleme koji će se riješiti implementacijom projekta, uključujući smanjenu konkurentnost, nemogućnost dokazivanja kvalitete, nepostojanje sljedivosti dokumentacije i neoptimizirane poslovne procese. Cilj projekta: osnažiti kapacitete tvrtke kroz uvođenje normi ISO 20000-1:2018, ISO 14001:2015 i ISO 22301:2019 tj. optimizaciju i unaprjeđenje 9 poslovnih procesa, a što će doprinijeti povećanju njezine (međunarodne) konkurentnosti, olakšavanju pristupa međunarodnom tržištu i povećanju konkurentnosti MSP-ova certifikacijom sustava upravljanja u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi = preduvjeti za rast prihoda od prodaje (5,1%) i prihoda od izvoza (30,1%), do 2028. (m+2).

Operation_Name_English: STEM in Healthcare with Firefly
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM u zdravstvu s Krijesnicom
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project "STEM in Health Care with Krijesnica" is to strengthen the capacity of civil society organizations in the promotion of STEM among children and students with a special emphasis on children suffering from rare diseases. The specific objectives of the project include improving the capacity of patient associations to implement programs in the field of STEM promotion through strengthening cooperation with educational institutions and the implementation of activities aimed at promoting STEM among children and students. Its implementation ensures more equal access to inclusive education by developing mobile education, which ultimately leads to a positive attitude of children and students towards STEM, and sensitises the general public to the problems of children with temporary or permanent disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta "STEM u zdravstvu s Krijesnicom" je jačanje kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva u promociji STEM-a među djecom i učenicima s osobitim naglaskom na djecu oboljelu od rijetkih bolesti. Posebni ciljevi projekta uključuju unaprjeđenje kapaciteta udruga pacijenata za provedbu programa u području promocije STEM-a kroz osnaživanje suradnje s odgojno-obrazovnim institucijama te provedbu aktivnosti s ciljem promocije STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. Njegovom provedbom osigurava se ravnopravniji pristup uključivom obrazovanju jer razvija mobilno obrazovanje što u konačnici dovodi do izgradnje pozitivnog stava djece i učenika o STEM-u, te senzibilizira širu javnost za probleme djece s privremenim ili trajnim teškoćama u razvoju.

Operation_Name_English: ZaMiSLi Museum for All
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZaMiSLi muzej za sve
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to increase the accessibility and participation of vulnerable groups in the cultural life of the local community through the reconstruction and equipping of the building of the Slatina Heritage Museum. The implementation of innovative technologies will make it easier for vulnerable groups to consume cultural content. The project aims to encourage the participation of vulnerable groups in cultural activities that will improve their creative skills and knowledge, increase social interactions, reduce the feeling of isolation and result in an overall improvement of the quality of life.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je povećati pristupačnost i sudjelovanje ranjivih skupina u kulturnom životu lokalne zajednice kroz rekonstrukciju i opremanje zgrade Zavičajnog muzeja Slatina. Kroz implementiranje inovativnih tehnologija ranjivim skupinama omogućit će se lakša konzumacija kulturnih sadržaja. Projektom se želi potaknuti sudjelovanje ranjivih skupina u kulturnim aktivnostima koje će unaprijediti njihove kreativne vještine i znanja, povećati društvene interakcije, smanjiti osjećaj izoliranosti te rezultirati ukupnim poboljšanjem kvalitete života.

Operation_Name_English: STEM Academy: the New Generation
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM Akademija: nove generacije
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The STEM Academy project: The new generation aims to strengthen the capacity of civil society organisations involved in the project to implement programmes in the field of STEM promotion among children and students. The target group within this project is the CSO, whose activities, in cooperation with the academic partner and educational institutions, aim to contribute to the popularization of STEM areas among children and students, i.e. the final beneficiaries of the project. The project will focus primarily on specific areas in which the higher education institution involved in the project is specialized, namely: software engineering, system engineering, multimedia production, 3D design, computer game development, business science and artificial intelligence, data science
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt STEM akademija: nove generacije ima za cilj ojačati kapacitete organizacije civilnog društva uključene u projekt za provedbu programa u području promocije STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. Ciljana skupina unutar ovog projekta je OCD koja svojim djelovanjem, a u suradnji s akademskim partnerom i odgojno-obrazovnim institucijama, želi pridonijeti popularizaciji STEM područja među djecom i učenicima, odnosno krajnjim korisnicima projekta. Projekt će se usmjeriti primarno na specifična područja u kojima je visoko učilište uključeno u projekt specijalizirano, a to su: programsko inženjerstvo, sistemsko inženjerstvo, multimedijska produkcija, 3D dizajn, razvoj računalnih igara, poslovna znanost i umjetna inteligencija, podatkovna znanost

Operation_Name_English: Trade union transformation and development of innovative services (STIVA©)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sindikalna transformacija i razvoj inovativnih usluga (STIVA©)
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project is aimed at strengthening the capacities of the Union through training, networking and development of new and improvement of existing systems. Activities are focused on the employees and commissioners of the Union and include the organization of workshops, study visits, round tables, education and implementation of innovative digital tools. The realization of these activities will lead to the transformation of business processes and increase the ability of the Union to more effectively represent the interests of its members in social dialogue at local, regional and national level.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je usmjeren na jačanje kapaciteta Sindikata kroz osposobljavanje, umrežavanje te razvoj novih i unaprjeđenje postojećih sustava. Aktivnosti su fokusirane na zaposlenike i povjerenike Sindikata te uključuju organizaciju radionica, studijskih posjeta, okruglih stolova, edukacija i implementaciju inovativnih digitalnih alata. Realizacija ovih aktivnosti dovest će do transformacije poslovnih procesa i povećanja sposobnosti Sindikata za učinkovitije zastupanje interesa svojih članova u socijalnom dijalogu na lokalnoj, regionalnoj i nacionalnoj razini.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the implementation of occupational health and safety measures
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje provedbe mjera zaštite na radu
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project Strengthening the Implementation of Occupational Safety and Health Measures continues the digitalisation of the MROSP business processes in conducting supervision over the work of authorised persons, passing professional examinations and the prescribed continuous professional development of occupational safety experts by developing new and upgrading existing modules of the IS ZNR, and the development of new OiRA tools. It digitalises learning to work safely within the e-learning system and implements educational-preventive activities to reduce musculoskeletal problems for physical workers. By implementing education and raising awareness of the importance of prevention in the occupational health and safety system, it directly affects the prevention of occupational injuries and the preservation of workers' health, which results in their longer stay in the world of work.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Jačanje provedbe mjera zaštite na radu nastavljaju se digitalizacija poslovnih procesa MROSP-a u provođenju nadzora nad radom ovlaštenih osoba, polaganju stručnih ispita i propisanom stalnom stručnom usavršavanju stručnjaka zaštite na radu razvojem novih i nadogradnjom postojećih modula IS ZNR-a, te izrada novih OiRA alata. Digitalizira se učenje za rad na siguran način u okviru sustava za e-učenje i provodi edukativno-preventivna aktivnosti u svrhu smanjenja mišićno-koštanih tegoba za fizičke radnike. Provedbom edukacija i podizanjem svijesti o značaju prevencije u sustavu zaštite na radu direktno se utječe na sprječavanje nastanka ozljeda na radu i očuvanje zdravlja radnika, što rezultira njihovim duljim ostankom u svijetu rada.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a port open to public transport of local importance Dajla-Belveder
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja luke otvorene za javni promet lokalnog značaja Dajla-Belveder
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Construction of a port open to public traffic of local significance" Dajla-Belveder aims to ensure the safety of navigation and reception of vessels in the port, to protect the property of the port and users and to ensure sufficient capacity of utility berths. The total value of the project is 7,554,350,00 euro, of which 6,990.225,00 euro refers to eligible costs and 564,125.00 euro to ineligible costs. Of the total eligible costs, EUR 4 705 683.75 relates to State aid and EUR 2 284 541.25 does not relate to State aid. Of the total eligible costs of the project, EUR 5,941,691.25 relates to the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) and EUR 1,048,533.75 to the State Budget (DP).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt izgradnja luke otvorene za javni promet lokalnog značaja Dajla-Belveder ima za cilj osiguravanje sigurnosti plovidbe i prihvata plovila u luci, zaštite imovine luke i korisnika te osiguravanje dostatnog kapaciteta komunalnih vezova. Ukupan vrijednost projekta je 7.554.350,00 eura od čega se 6.990.225,00 eura odnosi na prihvatljive, a 564.125,00 eura na neprihvatljive troškove. Od ukupnih prihvatljivih troškova 4.705.683,75 eura se odnosi na državne potpore, a 2.284.541,25 eura se ne odnosi na državne potpore. Od ukupnih prihvatljivih troškova projekta 5.941.691,25 eura se odnosi na sredstva Europskog fonda za regionalni razvoj (EFRR), a 1.048.533,75 eura na sredstva Državnog proračuna (DP).

Operation_Name_English: "Building the future with STEM"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Gradimo budućnost sa STEM-om"
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Building a Future with STEM" will contribute to strengthening the capacities of the Red Cross Križevci City Society and the Association of Maštara as civil society organizations for the popularization of STEM among children and students in partnership with the Polytechnic of Zagreb and the Polytechnic of Križevci. Partners on the project are four other educational institutions from the field of activity of GDCK Križevci. The project will carry out various activities such as training, mentoring, workshops with children and students, promoting STEM in public places, and promoting STEM in which children and students are involved. The duration of the project is 2 years.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Gradimo budućnost sa STEM-om" doprinijet će jačanju kapaciteta Gradskog društva Crvenog križa Križevci i Udruge Maštara kao organizacijama civilnog društva za popularizaciju STEM-a među djecom i učenicima u partnerstvu s Tehničkim veleučilištem u Zagrebu i Veleučilištem u Križevcima. Partneri na projektu su još 4 odgojno-obrazovne institucije s područja djelovanja GDCK Križevci. Kroz projekt će se provoditi razne aktivnosti poput izobrazbi, mentoriranja, radionica s djecom i učenicima, promoviranje STEM-a na javnim mjestima, te promoviranje STEM-a u koje su uključena djeca i učenici. Vrijeme trajanja projekta su 2 godine.

Operation_Name_English: Support and Connectivity in the Community
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podrška i povezanost u zajednici
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: General objective - improving social integration and preventing the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing continuous care. Specific objective - to provide support and support service in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. Main activity: identify persons for inclusion in the activities of the project by PUBLIC CALL in the prescribed manner. Recruitment of 25 service providers for at least 6 users for the provision of services in addition to the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies, with regulated content including: organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene, meeting other everyday needs. Monitoring and control of performed services. Communication and visibility. Project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj - unapređenje socijalne integracije i sprečavanje institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina pružanjem kontinuirane skrbi. Specifični cilj - osigurati uslugu potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Glavne aktivnost: identificirati osobe za uključivanje u aktivnosti projekta JAVNIM POZIVOM na propisan način. Zapošljavanje 25 pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 korisnika za pružanje usluge uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština, s propisanim sadržajem koja uključuje: organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba. Praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga. Komunikacija i vidljivost. Upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Developmental tests of TEENLIFTING 004 electromassage on EMC and LVD
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvojna ispitivanja elektromasažera TEENLIFTING 004 na EMC i LVD
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project solves the problem of limited efficiency of two-channel electromassages for muscle electrostimulation by introducing an advanced four-channel electromassage TEENLIFTING 004. The aim of the project is to increase the efficiency of treatments with an innovative product and shorten the duration, or at the same time to get twice as good results, ensuring high standards of safety and quality. Target groups include end users (for prevention and rehabilitation of muscles), franchise partners (polyclinics, dental practices and beauty salons) with whom we have active contracts and potential franchise partners with whom we can cooperate in the future using new devices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt rješava problem ograničene učinkovitosti dvokanalnih elektromasažera za elektrostimulaciju mišića uvođenjem naprednog četverokanalnog elektromasažera TEENLIFTING 004. Cilj projekta je inovacijskim proizvodom povećati učinkovitost tretmana i skratiti trajanje, ili u istom vremenu izvođenja tretmana dobiti duplo bolje rezultate, osiguravajući visoke standarde sigurnosti i kvalitete. Ciljne skupine uključuju krajnje korisnike (za prevenciju i rehabilitaciju mišića), franšizne partnere (poliklinike, stomatološke ordinacije i kozmetičke salone) s kojima imamo aktivne ugovore te potencijalne franšizne partnere s kojima u budućnosti možemo ostvariti suradnju koristeći nove uređaje.

Operation_Name_English: With a smile at the school PHASE VI
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: S osmijehom u školi FAZA VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide inclusive education to students with disabilities in 2 primary schools in Makarska in order to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The project will employ 26 PUN/CPCs that will work with a total of 32 students with developmental disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u 2 osnovne škole u Makarskoj u svrhu osiguravanja uvjeta za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. U okviru projekta zaposlit će se 26 PUN/SKP koji će raditi s ukupno 32 učenika s razvojnim teškoćama.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of DERMAMED d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva DERMAMED d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of DERMAMED d.o.o. by certifying five products according to the V-LABEL standard, which ensures their compliance with internationally recognized standards for vegan and cruelty-free cosmetics. The purpose of the project is to facilitate access to foreign markets, increase brand recognition and ensure transparency and product safety for consumers. Expected results include growth of export revenues by 100% and sales revenues by 16%, strengthening of market position and long-term business sustainability through compliance with international standards.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća DERMAMED d.o.o. certificiranjem pet proizvoda prema V-LABEL standardu, čime se osigurava njihova usklađenost s međunarodno priznatim normama za vegansku i cruelty-free kozmetiku. Svrha projekta je omogućiti lakši pristup stranim tržištima, povećati prepoznatljivost brenda te osigurati transparentnost i sigurnost proizvoda za potrošače. Očekivani rezultati uključuju rast prihoda od izvoza za 100% i prihoda od prodaje za 16%, jačanje tržišne pozicije te dugoročnu održivost poslovanja kroz usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the innovative 5RE service in the segment of sustainable furnishing of business interiors with designed wood furniture from Croatian forests
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inovativne usluge 5RE u segmentu održivog opremanja poslovnih interijera dizajniranim namještajem od drva iz hrvatskih šuma
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Five renowned Croatian companies, as SPIN consortium, through research and development activities of new products and services contribute to the green and digital transition and to solving key challenges in Pannonian Croatia. Developed products, patents and innovative services encourage structural changes in the economy, especially in the manufacturing industry. A strong regional value chain is also being developed for an innovative model of sustainable interior furnishing. Wooden ecological furniture and 5RE (reach, rent, return, renew, reuse) services for the global market are being researched and tested. Through new office concepts and an interactive platform, it contributes to the development of technological infrastructure and promotes the sustainable use of resources. Innovation is tested in public law bodies.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Pet renomiranih hrvatskih poduzeća, kao SPIN konzorcij, kroz aktivnosti istraživanja i razvoja novih proizvoda i usluga doprinose zelenoj i digitalnoj tranziciji te rješavanju ključnih izazova u Panonskoj Hrvatskoj. Razvijeni proizvodi, patent i inovativna usluga potiču strukturne promjene u gospodarstvu, posebno u proizvođačkoj industriji. Razvija se i jaki regionalni lanac vrijednosti za inovativni model održivog opremanja interijera. Istražuje se i testira drveni ekološki namještaj i usluga 5RE (reach, rent, return, renew, reuse) za globalno tržište. Kroz nove koncepte ureda i interaktivnu platformu doprinosi se razvoju tehnološke infrastrukture i promovira održivo korištenje resursa. Inovacija se testira u javnopravnim tijelima.

Operation_Name_English: TOGETHER RASTEMo
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAJEDNO raSTEMo
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the proposed project is to improve the capacities of CSOs at the partnership level for the implementation of programs in the field of STEM promotion and cooperation with higher education institutions and educational institutions and to increase the number of activities aimed at promoting STEM among children and students. The implementation of the project will empower CSOs and other stakeholders at the partnership level in the field of innovative approaches in teaching, presentation and promotion of STEM and implement activities that will inform, animate, educate and empower children and students in the field of STEM. The partnership consists of 2 CSOs, 3 higher education institutions and 4 educational institutions in the area of Osijek-Baranja and Vukovar-Srijem County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj predloženog projekta je unaprijediti kapacitete OCD-a na razini partnerstva za provedbu programa u području promocije STEM-a i suradnju sa visokim učilištima i odgojno-obrazovnim institucijama te povećati broj aktivnosti s ciljem promocije STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. Provedbom projekta osnažit će se OCD-i i ostali dionici na razini partnerstva u području inovativnih pristupa u poučavanju, prezentaciji i promociji STEM-a te provesti aktivnosti koje će informirati, animirati, educirati i osnažiti djecu i učenike za područje STEM-a. Partnerstvo čine 2 OCD-a, 3 visokoobrazovne institucije i 4 odgojno-obrazovne ustanove na području Osječko-baranjske i Vukovarsko-srijemske županije.

Operation_Name_English: Equal social and educational inclusion of students with disabilities IV - RAST IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ravnomjerna socijalna i obrazovna inkluzija učenika s teškoćama u razvoju IV - RAST IV
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure inclusive education of students with disabilities in primary education institutions founded by the City of Labin. The specific objective of the project is to support the inclusion of students with disabilities in primary education institutions founded by the City of Labin in order to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The main results of the project will be provided with professional support of 20 teaching assistants for a total of 20 students with disabilities for 36 months, i.e. 3 school years - 2024/2025, 2025/2026 and 2026/2027.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim odgojno obrazovnim ustanovama čiji je osnivač Grad Labin. Specifičan cilj projekta je pružiti potporu uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove čiji je osnivač Grad Labin kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Glavni rezultati projekta biti će osigurana stručna podrška 20 pomoćnika u nastavi za ukupno 20 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u trajanju od 36 mjeseci odnosno 3 školske godine - 2024/2025, 2025/2026 i 2026/2027.

Operation_Name_English: Power to help 4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Snaga pomoći 4
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Continuous implementation of the project will provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities with monthly distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies. It will contribute to greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in one's own home and ensuring the right to live in the community while improving the basic living conditions for the target group of the project, which is at least 180 people. Meetings of project team members and activity implementers will be held once a month, and the project will be implemented in the city of Đurđevac.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Kontinuiranom provedbom projekta pružat će se usluga potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom uz mjesečnu podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština. Pridonijet će se većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu i osiguravanju prava na životu u zajednici uz poboljšanje osnovnih životnih uvjeta za ciljnu skupinu projekta, a to je min 180 osoba. Sastanci članova projektnog tima i provoditelja aktivnosti održavat će se jednom mjesečno, a projekt će se provoditi na području grada Đurđevca.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of the water communal infrastructure of the agglomeration of Novalja - PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Poboljšanje vodno-komunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Novalja – FAZA 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes improvements in the area of public sewage and water supply system that will align the area of the City of Novalja with the Water Framework Directive (2000/60/EC), the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive (91/271/EEC) and the Drinking Water Quality Directive (98/83/EC). The project is implemented through two phases during the implementation of which the objectives of the project will be ensured. Phase 1 of the project includes the rehabilitation and construction of the drainage system, the USO, the procurement of equipment and the construction of the ‘Komorovac II’ VS, the rehabilitation of the ‘Komorovac I’ VS, the construction of the Komorovac PS, the water supply pipeline and the USO, as well as the construction of the UPOV, the second stage of purification, while phase 2 of the project covers the completion of all activities listed in phase 1, with the exception of the procurement of equipment completed in phase 1.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća poboljšanja na području sustava javne odvodnje i vodoopskrbe kojim će se područje Grada Novalje uskladiti sa Okvirnom direktivom o vodama (2000/60/EC), Direktivom o pročišćavanju komunalnih otpadnih voda (91/271/EEZ) i Direktivom o kakvoći vode za piće (98/83/EC). Projekt se provodi kroz dvije faze tijekom provedbe kojih će se osigurati ciljevi projekta.1. faza projekta obuhvaća sanaciju i izgradnju sustava odvodnje, NUS-a, nabavu opreme te izgradnju VS „Komorovac II“, sanaciju VS „Komorovac I“, izgradnju PS Komorovac, vodoopskrbnog cjevovoda i NUS-a kao i izgradnju UPOV-a, II. stupanj pročišćavanja dok 2. faza projekta obuhvaća završetak svih aktivnosti navedenih u 1. fazi, izuzev nabave opreme koja je završena u 1. fazi.

Operation_Name_English: Development of water communal infrastructure in the area of the agglomeration of Pozega – PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj vodnokomunalne infrastrukture na području aglomeracije Požega – FAZA 2
Category_Label: Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project involves improving the water supply (reconstruction of the Velika-Požega pipeline for 21,600 inhabitants) and increasing the connection to the sewage system and wastewater treatment (by 28,199 ES by 2026). It is aligned with the EU directives on water and wastewater treatment. The goals include the construction and reconstruction of drainage systems, increasing efficiency, connecting new users and introducing the economic price of water. The project is implemented in two phases over the 2014-2020 and 2021-2027 periods. The total value of the eligible costs of the project is €23.71 million, the value of the eligible costs of Phase 2 is €2.42, the grant amount of Phase 2 is €1.70 million. EUR
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Aglomeracija Požega Projekt obuhvaća poboljšanje vodoopskrbe (rekonstrukcija cjevovoda Velika–Požega za 21.600 stanovnika) te povećanje priključenosti na sustav odvodnje i pročišćavanje otpadnih voda (za 28.199 ES do 2026.). Usklađuje se s EU direktivama o vodama i pročišćavanju otpadnih voda. Ciljevi uključuju izgradnju i rekonstrukciju sustava odvodnje, povećanje učinkovitosti, priključenje novih korisnika te uvođenje ekonomske cijene vode. Projekt se provodi u dvije faze kroz razdoblja 2014.–2020. i 2021.–2027. Ukupna vrijednost prihvatljivih troškova projekta iznosi 23.71 mil., vrijednost prihvatljivih troškova 2. faze iznosi EUR, 2,42 EUR, iznos bespovratnih sredstava 2. faze 1,70 mil. EUR

Operation_Name_English: SERVICE OF THE COMMITTEE IN SPLITSKO DALMATIN COUNTRY
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: USLUGA ODMORA OD SKRBI U SPLITSKO DALMATINSKOJ ŽUPANIJI
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project develops and pilots an innovative COMMITTEE OF SKRBI service that will enable parents of carers and carers of persons with disabilities (25 persons) in the Split-Dalmatia County to engage in other activities that they cannot perform while caring for a dependent member, while at the same time enabling children and persons with the most severe type and degree of impairment to be more involved in the community. A total of 311 days of service will be carried out through group socialization activities, implementation of individual rehabilitation activities (physiotherapist, occupational therapist, rehabilitator, speech therapist), support for caregivers and secured transport.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se razvija i pilotira inovativna usluga ODMORA OD SKRBI koja će omogućiti roditeljima njegovateljima i njegovateljima osoba s invaliditetom (25 osoba) na području Splitsko-dalmatinske županije bavljenje drugim aktivnostima koje ne mogu obavljati dok skrbe za ovisnog člana, a istovremeno omogućiti djeci i osobama s najtežom vrstom i stupnjem oštećenja veću uključenost u zajednicu. Ukupno će se provesti 311 dana usluge kroz grupne socijalizacijske aktivnosti, provedbu individualnih rehabilitacijskih aktivnosti (fizioterapeut, radni terapeut, rehabilitator, logoped), podrške za njegovatelje te osigurani prijevoz.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of the water communal infrastructure of the agglomeration of Bjelovar - PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Poboljšanje vodnokomunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Bjelovar - FAZA 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project Improving the water utility infrastructure of the agglomeration of Bjelovar includes the necessary investments in the water supply system in order to be able to connect new users to the system and reduce losses on the network, all in order to comply with the requirements of the Directive on the quality of water intended for human consumption 98/83/EC. The project also includes investments in a sewage and wastewater treatment system to meet the requirements and to comply with the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive. The project consists of two phases: • Phase 1 of the project - investment investments within the financial period OPKK 2014-2020. • Phase 2 of the project - investment investments in the period 2024-2027 within the financial period of the PKK 2021-2027.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Poboljšanje vodnokomunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Bjelovar uključuje potrebna ulaganja u sustav vodoopskrbe kako bi se na sustav moglo priključiti nove korisnike te smanjilo gubitke na mreži a sve u svrhu usklađivanja sa zahtjevima Direktive o kvaliteti vode namijenjene za ljudsku potrošnju 98/83/EZ. Projekt također uključuje ulaganja u sustav odvodnje i pročišćavanja otpadnih voda u svrhu ispunjavanja uvjeta i s ciljem usklađivanja s Direktivom o pročišćavanju komunalnih otpadnih voda. Projekt se sastoji od dvije faze: • 1.faza projekta - investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja OPKK 2014-2020. • 2.faza projekta - investicijska ulaganja u razdoblju 2024-2027. unutar financijskog razdoblja PKK 2021-2027.

Operation_Name_English: DENTAL QUALITY - ISO standard
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: DENTAL kvaliteta - ISO standard
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes investments in the preparation, introduction and certification of quality management systems according to the requirements of ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 standards in the dental laboratory business, which will facilitate access to the international market and increase the competitiveness of the dental laboratory through reaching the applicable level of internationally recognized standards that prove the level of quality and safety in the exchange of goods and services and contribute to customer confidence, but also create a culture of continuous improvement, which is crucial for the further sustainable growth of the laboratory.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt uključuje ulaganja u pripremu, uvođenje i certificiranje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema zahtjevima standarda ISO 9001:2015 i ISO 13485:2016 u poslovanje dentalnog laboratorija, što će olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu i povećati konkurentnost dentalnog laboratorija kroz dostizanje primjenjive razine međunarodno priznatih standarda kojima se dokazuje razina kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni roba i usluga te pridonosi povjerenju kupaca, ali i stvara kultura kontinuiranog poboljšanja, koja je ključna za daljnji održivi rast laboratorija.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of the water and communal infrastructure of the Split-Solin agglomeration - Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Poboljšanje vodno-komunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Split-Solin - faza 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Water management and water resource conservation (including river basin management, specific climate change adaptation measures, reuse, leakage reduction)|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes: -Upgrading and reconstruction of the public water supply system: -Upgrading and reconstructing the public drainage system: -upgrading the existing CUPOV Pillar from I to II degree of purification (capacity 275.000 p.e.); in the area of the City of Split (settlement of Split, Stobreč, Kamen, Žrnovnica and Srinjine), the City of Solin (settlement of Solin, Vranjic, Mravince and Kučine), the Municipality of Klis (settlement of Klis), the Municipality of Dugopolje (settlement of Dugopolje and Koprivno) and the Municipality of Podstrana (settlement of Podstrana) with the aim of increasing the population's connection to public water supply and drainage systems and ensuring adequate wastewater treatment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća: -dogradnju i rekonstrukciju sustava javne vodoopskrbe: -dogradnju i rekonstrukciju sustava javne odvodnje: -nadogradnju postojećeg CUPOV-a Stupe s I. na II. stupanj pročišćavanja (kapaciteta 275.000 ES); na području Grada Splita (naselja Split, Stobreč, Kamen, Žrnovnica i Srinjine), Grada Solina (naselja Solin, Vranjic, Mravince i Kučine), Općine Klis (naselje Klis), Općine Dugopolje (naselja Dugopolje i Koprivno) i Općine Podstrana (naselje Podstrana) s ciljem povećanja priključenosti stanovništva na javne sustave vodoopskrbe i odvodnje te osiguravanje odgovarajućeg pročišćavanja otpadnih voda.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of Mihaljevac turnout
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija okretišta Mihaljevac
Category_Label: Clean urban transport infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Reconstruction of Mihaljevac Turnaround" aims at modernising and optimising tram infrastructure in order to improve sustainable mobility and reduce the carbon footprint. The reconstruction involves the technical improvement of the turning point, which entails the replacement of existing rails and the construction of supporting infrastructure that will enable more efficient traffic management and better traffic flow of trams, improve connectivity with other forms of public transport and increase the safety and comfort of public transport passengers. The planned duration of the implementation of the project is 19 months, and includes the execution of works on the reconstruction of the turnaround, supervision services and promotion and visibility. The total value of the project is 4,133,009.83 EUR.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Rekonstrukcija okretišta Mihaljevac“ usmjeren je na modernizaciju i optimizaciju tramvajske infrastrukture u cilju poboljšanja održive mobilnosti i smanjenja ugljičnog otiska. Rekonstrukcija uključuje tehničko unaprjeđenje okretišta koje podrazumijeva zamjenu postojećih tračnica i izgradnju popratne infrastrukture koja će omogućiti učinkovitije upravljanje prometom i bolji prometni tok tramvaja, poboljšati povezanost s ostalim oblicima javnog prijevoza te povećati sigurnost i udobnost putnika u javnom prijevozu. Planirano trajanje provedbe projekta je 19 mjeseci, a uključuje, izvođenje radova na rekonstrukciji okretišta, usluge nadzora te promidžbu i vidljivost. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 4.133.009,83 EUR.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of an integrated management and certification system to facilitate access to international markets and increase competitiveness
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Implementacija integriranog sustava upravljanja i certifikacija za olakšani pristup međunarodnim tržištima i povećanje konkurentnosti
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase international competitiveness by introducing and certifying management systems in accordance with internationally recognized standards:ISO 20000-1:2018, ISO 37001:2016 and ISO 37301:2016. The purpose of introducing these internationally recognized norms and management standards is to facilitate access to international markets, differentiation from competitors by optimizing business processes (reducing duplication of work, saving time and resources) and building the reputation of a reliable partner, which is the basis for healthy business. Three new management systems, certified according to the described standards, are the expected result of a project that will strengthen the company at all levels, from operational efficiency and legal compliance to reputation and market competitiveness.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj provedbe projekta je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti uvođenjem i certifikacijom sustava upravljanja sukladno međunarodno priznatim normama:ISO 20000-1:2018, ISO 37001:2016 te ISO 37301:2016. Svrha uvođenja ovih međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda upravljanja je olakšani pristup međunarodnim tržištima, diferencijaciju od konkurenata optimiziranjem poslovnih procesa (smanjuje se dupliciranje rada, štedi vrijeme i resursi) te izgradnjom ugleda pouzdanog partnera, što je temelj za zdravo poslovanje. Tri nova sustava upravljanja, certificirana sukladno opisanim normama, očekivani su rezultat projekta kojim ćepoduzeće ojačati na svim razinama, od operativne učinkovitosti i pravne usklađenosti do reputacije i tržišne konkurentnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the capacity of social partners in the area of social welfare
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje kapaciteta socijalnih partnera u području socijalne skrbi
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project is aimed at strengthening the capacity of social dialogue through the empowerment of social partners through training, networking and the introduction of digitalisation processes and innovative services for members of trade union organizations. Special emphasis is put on attracting new members through innovation and campaigns (initiatives). The aim is to strengthen key stakeholders who are co-creators of labour market policies and to enable them to participate with adequate capacities in fast-evolving changes in the labour market, driven by demographic developments and the green and digital transitions. The project aims to ensure the systematic impact of social partners on future developments in the social welfare and health system.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je usmjeren na jačanje kapaciteta socijalnog dijaloga kroz osnaživanje socijalnih partnera putem osposobljavanja, umrežavanja te uvođenja procesa digitalizacije i inovativnih usluga za članove sindikalnih organizacija. Poseban naglasak stavlja se na privlačenje novih članova kroz inovacije i kampanje (inicijative). Cilj je ojačati ključne dionike koji su sukreatori politika na tržištu rada te omogućiti da s adekvatnim kapacitetima sudjeluju u promjenama koje se ubrzano događaju na tržištu rada, a uvjetovano demografskim kretanjima te zelenom i digitalnom tranzicijom. Projekt nastoji osigurati sustavan utjecaj socijalnih partnera na buduća kretanja u sustavu socijalne skrbi i zdravstva.

Operation_Name_English: PREDAH - Rest from care and empowerment of parents caregivers of adults with disabilities
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PREDAH - Odmor od skrbi i osnaživanje roditelja njegovatelja odraslih osoba s invaliditetom
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "PREDAH - Rest from Care and Empowerment of Parents Caregivers of Adults with Disabilities" enables parents caregivers/carers of persons over the age of 21 to bring a person dependent on care to individual and group activities every working day from Monday to Saturday from 7 a.m. to 2 p.m., in accordance with the previous expert assessment and the need of parents caregivers/carers and persons dependent on care. Furthermore, supportive activities for parents, support groups, workshops, excursions will be organized. In addition, a multi-day stay of persons dependent on care at sea will be organized with organized accommodation and care/accompaniment of employees, with the aim of ensuring a multi-day rest from care for parents caregivers/carers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "PREDAH - Odmor od skrbi i osnaživanje roditelja njegovatelja odraslih osoba s invaliditetom" omogućuje roditeljima njegovateljima/njegovateljima osoba starijih od 21 godinu da svakim radnim danom od ponedjeljka do subote od 7 do 14 sati dovedu osobu ovisnoj o skrbi na individualne i grupne aktivnosti, a sukladno prethodnoj stručnoj procjeni te potrebi roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja i osobe ovisne o skrbi. Nadalje, organizirati će se podržavajuće aktivnosti za roditelje, grupe podrške, radionice, izleti. Uz navedeno, organizirati će se višednevni boravak osoba ovisnih o skrbi na moru uz organiziran smještaj i skrb/pratnju djelatnika, s ciljem osiguravanja višednevnog odmora od skrbi za roditelje njegovatelje/njegovatelje.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of FUSIO d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva FUSIO d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Objectives of the project: 1. Ensure product compliance with internationally recognised norms and standards (RoHS, REACH, PAHs, Organotin, LFGB). 2. Increase the international competitiveness of the company through product certification and standardization - CE marking for 5 product models 3. Provide access to global markets by demonstrating product quality and safety through energy testing and energy label 4. Strengthen sustainable growth and competitiveness of SMEs through investment in research and innovation. 5. To lay the foundations for the further development of products compliant with European environmental and safety regulations.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta: 1. Osigurati usklađenost proizvoda s međunarodno priznatim normama i standardima (RoHS, REACH, PAHs, Organotin, LFGB). 2. Povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost tvrtke kroz certificiranje i standardizaciju proizvoda - CE oznake za 5 modela proizvoda 3. Omogućiti pristup globalnim tržištima kroz dokazivanje kvalitete i sigurnosti proizvoda kroz energetsko ispitivanje i energetsku naljepnicu 4. Jačati održivi rast i konkurentnost MSP-ova kroz ulaganja u istraživanje i inovacije. 5. Stvoriti temelje za daljnji razvoj proizvoda usklađenih s europskim ekološkim i sigurnosnim propisima.

Operation_Name_English: STEM Learning Network
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM Learning Network
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The ‘STEM Learning Network’ project aims to improve the capacities of CSOs for the implementation of STEM promotion programmes in the Šibenik-Knin, Split-Dalmatia and Zagreb counties, and the City of Zagreb. Partnership with the Ruđer Bošković Institute and Algebra University will enable strengthening the capacities of partner CSOs through the acquisition of new knowledge, which will create the preconditions for further joint cooperation. Through the implementation of the STEM workshops program through partnership with educational institutions, they will contribute to better work with children and students, which will enable partner CSOs to continue their active role as popularizers of science.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „STEM Learning Network“ želi se unaprijediti kapacitete OCD-ova za provedbu programa promocije STEM-a na području Šibensko-kninske, Splitsko-dalmatinske i Zagrebačke županija, i Grada Zagreba. Partnerstvo s Institutom Ruđer Bošković i Sveučilištem Algebra će omogućiti jačanje kapaciteta partnerskih OCD-ova kroz usvajanje novih znanja čime će se stvoriti preduvjeti za daljnje zajedničke suradnje. Provedbom programa STEM radionica kroz partnerstvo s odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama doprinijet će kvalitetnijem radu s djecom i učenicima čime će partnerski OCD-ovi nastaviti s aktivnom ulogom popularizatora znanosti.

Operation_Name_English: By introducing the management system to the success of P.G.P.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenjem sustava upravljanja do uspjeha tvrtke P.G.P.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The problem of the company is the non-compliance of the current business with the requirements of the market, which requires the establishment and further continuation of cooperation by introducing certificates. Their introduction is necessary for further business improvement, and competitive and sustainable growth and development of the company. By introducing ISO certification, the company will improve competitiveness and market position, because business processes will be defined and controlled. In this way, services will be required and of uniform quality in accordance with environmental standards. In this way, the company will control and maintain the quality, safety and reliability of its products as well as the overall business, and will successfully expand into the EU market. Target groups are existing and potential clients.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Problem tvrtke je neusklađenost trenutnog poslovanja sa zahtjevima tržišta koji uvjetuje uspostavljanje i daljnji nastavak suradnje uvođenjem certifikata. Njihovo uvođenje je nužno za daljnje unaprjeđenje poslovanja, te konkurentan i održiv rast i razvoj tvrtke. Uvođenjem ISO certifikata tvrtka će unaprijediti konkurentnost i tržišni položaj, jer će poslovni procesi biti definirani i kontrolirani. Time će usluge biti zahtijevane i ujednačene kvalitete u skladu s ekološkim standardima. Na taj način će tvrtka kontrolirati i održavati kvalitetu, sigurnost i pouzdanost svojih proizvoda kao i cjelokupnog poslovanja, te će se uspješno proširiti na EU tržištu. Ciljne skupine su postojeći i potencijalni klijenti.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of cosmetics and medical devices and introduction of a management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija kozmetičkih i medicinskih proizvoda te uvođenje sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the project is the certification process of 4 newly developed cosmetic products and obtaining the Ecocert certificate, will increase the quality of products by ensuring their compliance with all applicable norms, laws and standards in the EU. Furthermore, the project plans to certify 2 management systems, of which the Halal certificate will enable sales and entry into foreign markets, while the implementation of the ISO 13485 standard will enable the production of a new type of medical products and the certification of medical products, of which it is planned to certify 8 new products. The project contributes to increasing competitiveness, especially in foreign markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet projekta je postupak certifikacije 4 novorazvijena kozmetička proizvoda te ishođenje Ekocert certifikata, povećati će kvalitetu proizvoda kroz osiguranje njihove sukladnost sa svim važećim normama, zakonima i standardima u EU. Nadalje, projektom je planirano certificiranje 2 sustava upravljanja od kojih će Halal certifikat omogućiti prodaju i ulazak na strana tržišta, dok će implementacija ISO 13485 standarda omogućiti proizvodnju nove vrste medicinskih proizvoda i certifikaciju medicinskih proizvoda od čega je planirano certificirati 8 novih proizvoda. Projekt doprinosi povećanju konkurentnosti, posebice na stranim tržištima.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of JET OSIJEK d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva JET OSIJEK d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the implementation and certification of quality management system according to ISO 9001 standard and information security management system according to ISO 27001 standard in the company Jet Osijek d.o.o. The certification will increase the efficiency of business processes, ensure higher data protection standards and improve the international competitiveness of the company. The project will facilitate access to new markets, increase customer and partner confidence and reduce operational risks. Certification according to internationally recognized standards will ensure the long-term viability of the business and strengthen the market position.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je implementacija i certifikacija sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema normi ISO 9001 i sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema normi ISO 27001 u poduzeću Jet Osijek d.o.o. Certifikacijom će se povećati učinkovitost poslovnih procesa, osigurati viši standardi zaštite podataka te poboljšati međunarodna konkurentnost poduzeća. Projekt će omogućiti lakši pristup novim tržištima, povećanje povjerenja klijenata i partnera te smanjenje operativnih rizika. Certifikacija prema međunarodno priznatim normama osigurat će dugoročnu održivost poslovanja i jačanje tržišne pozicije.

Operation_Name_English: LEARN TOGETHER VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: UČIMO ZAJEDNO VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Ensuring inclusive education of students with disabilities in elementary schools and primary schools in Split-Dalmatia County by providing PUN/CPC support to students with disabilities is in line with strategic documents and regulations. Through the three-year implementation of the UZ VII project for about 410 students with disabilities, integrated into the educational process in about 70 school institutions of the Split-Dalmatia County, immediate support to adequate education is provided with the support of about 370 assistants (PUN/CPC), which will provide the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and integration and emotional functioning, which will also affect the reduction of child poverty.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u OŠ i SŠ u Splitsko-dalmatinskoj županiji pružanjem potpore PUN/SKP učenicima s teškoćama u skladu je sa strateškim dokumentima i propisima. Kroz trogodišnju provedbu projekta UZ VII za oko 410 učenika s teškoćama, integriranih u odgojno-obrazovni proces u oko 70 školskih ustanova Splitsko-dalmatinske županije, osigurava se neposredna podrška primjerenom obrazovanju potporom oko 370 pomoćnika (PUN/SKP), čime će se osigurati uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i integraciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje, što će utjecati i na smanjenje dječjeg siromaštva.

Operation_Name_English: Support for the elderly
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podrška starijim osobama
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The main goal of the project is social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of elderly people and people with disabilities in the city of Zagreb. This is in line with the general objective of the call: increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care and the specific objective calls for: the provision of support and support services in the daily life of the elderly and persons with disabilities. The objectives of the project are to be achieved through the employment of 30 home helpers for a period of 33 months to help vulnerable groups in their daily lives.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osnovni cilj projekta je socijalno uključivanje i prevencija institucionalizacije starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom na području grada Zagreba. Navedeno je u skladu s općim ciljem poziva: povećanjem socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi te specifičnim ciljem poziva: pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Ciljevi projekta se namjeravaju ostvariti kroz zapošljavanje 30 pružatelja usluge pomoći u kući u trajanju 33 mjeseca da bi se pomoglo ranjivim skupinama u svakodnevnom životu.

Operation_Name_English: Improving the business of INSIDER PLUS d.o.o. by introducing ISO 27001 certificates
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje poslovanja tvrtke INSIDER PLUS d.o.o. uvođenjem ISO 27001 certifikata
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification project will enable Insider Plus d.o.o. to improve internal business processes, increase data processing security and optimize information security management. Certification will enable faster and more efficient cooperation with international partners, facilitate access to new markets and increase the export of InsiderCX software solution. The introduction of standards will improve the competitiveness of companies in the global market, shorten sales cycles and enable business expansion in the EU and beyond. Insider Plus will strengthen its market position and increase the number of international clients, thereby ensuring stable business growth and sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt certifikacije prema normi ISO/IEC 27001:2022 omogućit će Insider Plus d.o.o. unaprjeđenje internih poslovnih procesa, povećanje sigurnosti obrade podataka te optimizaciju upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću. Certifikacija će omogućiti bržu i efikasniju suradnju s međunarodnim partnerima, olakšati pristup novim tržištima te povećati izvoz softverskog rješenja InsiderCX. Uvođenjem standarda poboljšat će se konkurentnost poduzeća na globalnom tržištu, skratiti prodajni ciklusi i omogućiti širenje poslovanja u EU i šire. Insider Plus će ojačati svoju tržišnu poziciju i povećati broj međunarodnih klijenata, čime će osigurati stabilan rast i održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Virovitica Urban Development Strategy 2021-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strategija razvoja urbanog područja Virovitica 2021.-2027.
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The development of the SRUP will respond to the specific needs of the city and municipalities and support balanced territorial development based on the identified specific needs of the urban area of Virovitica. By involving cities and municipalities in the ITU, the mechanism aims to strengthen their developmental role, which will consequently reduce the differences between urban and rural areas, enable polycentric development and increase the quality of life in the entire gravitational area. The target group of the project is the population of the urban area of the city of Virovitica and the Municipality of Suhopolje and Lukač, as well as the general public or the public and civil sector.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Izradom SRUP-a odgovoriti će se na specifične potrebe grada i općina te poduprijeti ravnomjerni teritorijalni razvoj temeljen na identificiranim specifičnim potrebama urbanog područja Virovitice. Uključivanjem grada i općina u ITU mehanizam želi se ojačati njihova razvojna uloga, što će posljedično utjecati na umanjenje razlika između urbanih i ruralnih područja, omogućiti policentrični razvoj i povećati kvalitetu života na cjelokupnom gravitacijskom području. Ciljana skupina projekta je stanovništvo urbanog područja grada Virovitice te Općina Suhopolje i Lukač kao i šira javnost odnosno javni i civilni sektor.

Operation_Name_English: IMPROVEMENT OF WATER-COMMUNAL INFRASTRUKTURE IN THE AREA OF RIJEKA AGLOMERATION
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: POBOLJŠANJE VODNO-KOMUNALNE INFRASTRUKTURE NA PODRUČJU AGLOMERACIJE RIJEKA
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Improving the water-communal infrastructure of the Rijeka agglomeration’ will bring the Rijeka agglomeration into line with the Water Framework Directive (2000/60/EC) and the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive (91/271/EEC) in order to achieve and preserve good water status in order to protect human life and health and to protect aquatic and water-dependent ecosystems. Activities under the project include the reconstruction of the water supply system; new construction, reconstruction and rehabilitation of drainage systems and CS; design, construction and trial operation of wastewater treatment plants (capacity 200.000 ES, level II treatment).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Poboljšanje vodno-komunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Rijeka“ postići će se usklađivanje aglomeracije Rijeka s Okvirnom direktivom o vodama (2000/60/EC) i Direktivom o pročišćavanju komunalnih otpadnih voda (91/271/EEZ) kako bi se postiglo i očuvalo dobro stanje voda radi zaštite života i zdravlja ljudi, te zaštite vodnih i o vodi ovisnih ekosustava. Aktivnosti u okviru projekta uključuju rekonstrukciju sustava vodoopskrbe; novogradnju, rekonstrukciju i sanaciju sustava odvodnje i CS; projektiranje, izgradnju te probni rad uređaja za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda (kapaciteta 200.000 ES, II. stupanj pročišćavanja).

Operation_Name_English: SPIN PIT
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SPIN PIT
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the project is the development of an innovative product called PIT "Preparation and implementation tool", which belongs to the niche of the added value of Manufacturing technology, ICT solutions and models for Industry 4.0 within the Regional value chain of the Smart Industry of Northern Croatia and the encouragement of solving key social challenges of the region of Northern Croatia. The total value of the project is xx EUR, the total eligible costs of the project is xx EUR and the expected grant is xx EUR.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet projekta je razvoj inovativnog proizvoda pod nazivom PIT „Preparation and implementation tool“ koji pripada niši dodane vrijednosti Proizvodne tehnologije, IKT rješenja i modeli za industriju 4.0. u okviru Regionalnog lanca vrijednosti Pametne industrije Sjeverne Hrvatske te poticanje rješavanja ključnih društvenih izazove regije Sjeverna Hrvatska. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi xx EUR, iznos ukupno prihvatljivih troškova projekta je xx EUR dok očekivana bespovratna sredstva iznose xx EUR.

Operation_Name_English: CFO Evolution Hub - Research and development of an innovative digital platform for knowledge-based and high value-added professional advisory services
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: CFO Evolution Hub - Istraživanje i razvoj inovativne digitalne platforme za profesionalne savjetodavne usluge visoke dodane vrijednosti bazirane na znanju
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: The project addresses the main problem of the SPIN consortium - the inability to significantly enter the business consulting market, which is fundamentally changing due to the integration of digital technologies into business models of offering services. By implementing the SPIN project, the consortium will develop a digital platform that offers automation and digitalisation of accounting processes based on which innovative CFO reporting and specialized education services will be offered with an advanced system of internal and external job placement and taking over with high quality assurance, whose commercialization will result in increased competitiveness and contribute to solving the social challenges of Adriatic Croatia. Target groups are employees of the consortium directly involved in the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt adresira glavni problem SPIN konzorcija - nemogućnost značajnijeg ulaska u tržište poslovnog savjetovanja koje se suštinski mijenja uslijed integracije digitalnih tehnologija u poslovne modele nuđenja usluga. Provedbom projekta SPIN konzorcij će razviti digitalnu platformu koja nudi automatizaciju i digitalizaciju računovodstvenih procesa temeljem kojih će se nuditi inovativne usluge CFO izvještavanja i specijaliziranih edukacija uz napredni sustav internog i eksternog postavljanja i preuzimanja poslova uz osiguranje visoke kvalitete, čija će komercijalizacija rezultirati povećanjem konkurentnosti i doprinijeti rješavanju društvenih izazova Jadranske Hrvatske. Ciljne skupine su zaposlenici konzorcija direktno uključeni u projekt.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation and certification of management systems according to ISO 27001, ISO 31000 and ISO 22301 standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje i certifikacija sustava upravljanja prema standardima ISO 27001, ISO 31000 i ISO 22301
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With this project, the Applicant introduces and certifies business process and quality management systems according to the following standards: 1. ISO 27001 2. ISO 31000 3. ISO 22301 The aim of the project is to increase the competitiveness of Applicants on the domestic and foreign markets by certifying processes in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards or certification schemes. The project will facilitate access to the international market and increase the competitiveness of the Applicant by introducing management systems that demonstrate the level of quality and security in the exchange of goods and services and contribute to customer confidence. Expected results: Introduced and certified 3 management systems Increase in sales revenue in year m+2 by 33.1% Increase in export revenue in year m+2 by 100%
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom Prijavitelj uvodi i certificira sustave upravljanja poslovnim procesima i kvalitetom prema normama: 1. ISO 27001 2. ISO 31000 3. ISO 22301 Cilj projekta je povećanje konkurentnosti Prijavitelja na domaćem i inozemnom tržištu certifikacijom procesa u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi ili certifikacijskih shema. Projektom će se olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu i povećati konkurentnost Prijavitelja uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kojima se dokazuje razina kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni roba i usluga te pridonosi povjerenju kupaca. Očekivani rezultati: Uvedena i certificirana 3 sustava upravljanja Povećanje prihoda od prodaje u godini m+2 za 33,1% Povećanje prihoda od izvoza u godini m+2 za 100%

Operation_Name_English: Smart Sense - Quality Management System Certification (ISO 9001)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Smart Sense - certifikacija sustava upravljanja kvalitetom (norma ISO 9001)
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to facilitate access to the international market of Smart Sense and increase the company's competitiveness through the introduction of the ISO 9001 quality management system, which will result in an increase in sales revenue with an increase in export revenues as well as an increase in end-user satisfaction with the delivered products and services. This will be achieved through the implementation and certification of the ISO 9001 quality management system.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu tvrtke Smart Sense te povećati konkurentnost tvrtke kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom ISO 9001 što će za posljedicu imati povećanje prihoda od prodaje uz povećanje prihoda od izvoza kao i povećanje zadovoljstva krajnjih korisnika isporučenim proizvodima i uslugama. Navedeno će se ostvariti implementacijom i certifikacijom sustava upravljanja kvalitetom ISO 9001.

Operation_Name_English: I'll be your friend - Still together through life
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Bit ću ti prijatelj - I dalje zajedno kroz život
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support services to people with adequate income, in the area of the city of Sinj, surrounding settlements and municipalities in which the rural part is mostly older population that is not able to achieve basic living needs, which through this project will be tried to meet depending on the needs of users. It is also important that during the implementation of the project, the allocation of packages with hygienic and household necessities will be carried out. Accordingly, the main activities of the project that will be carried out by employees are: performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene, organizing food, meeting other everyday needs. Promotion and visibility as well as project management and administration are planned.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluga potpore i podrške osobama s odgovarajućim prihodima, na području grada Sinja, okolnih naselja i općina u kojima se na ruralnom dijelu nalazi uglavnom starije stanovništvo koje nije u mogućnosti ostvariti osnovne životne potrebe, koje će se putem ovog projekta nastojati zadovoljiti ovisno o potrebama korisnika. Također važno je što će se tijekom provedbe projekta vršiti i dodjela paketa s higijenskim i kućanskim potrepštinama. Sukladno navedenome, glavne aktivnosti projekta koje će provoditi zaposlenici su: obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, organiziranje prehrane, zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba. Planira se promidžba i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: State Scholarships for Students of Poor Socio-Economic Status
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Državne stipendije za studente slabijeg socio-ekonomskog statusa
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to continue providing direct financial support to a larger number of students for the purpose of full social inclusion in higher education and to increase the number of direct grants through the granting of a larger number of state scholarships to students of lower socio-economic status, over a period of 6 academic years. Complementary to investments from the state budget of the Republic of Croatia, this increase will reach the number of 8 500 state scholarships per year for students of lower socio-economic status, and thus contribute to the availability of higher education and the improvement of the social dimension of higher education and increase the finality in higher education.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je nastavak pružanja izravne financijske potpore za veći broj studenata sa svrhom potpune socijalne uključenosti u visoko obrazovanje te povećanje broja izravnih potpora putem dodjele većeg broja državnih stipendija studentima slabijeg socio-ekonomskog statusa, u razdoblju od 6 akademskih godina. Komplementarno na ulaganja iz državnog proračuna RH, ovim će se povećanjem dostići brojka od 8500 državnih stipendija godišnje za studente slabijeg socio-ekonomskog statusa, a time i doprinijeti dostupnosti visokog obrazovanja i unaprjeđenju socijalne dimenzije visokog obrazovanja te povećanju završnosti u visokom obrazovanju.

Operation_Name_English: STEM-anje.com
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM-anje.com
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of this project contributes to solving part of the challenges faced by CSOs of educational institutions. Only by changing the traditional subject teaching to a systematic, holistic teaching through a multidisciplinary STEM approach in which the student is an active participant who, by working on a wide variety of tasks, constructs their own usable knowledge, will they be able to cope with developmental challenges in the future, including environmental pollution, unpredictable climate phenomena, health problems, exhaustion of natural resources such as water and energy, and social and political conflicts. The links between CSOs and educational institutions and faculties will be strengthened, new knowledge of CSOs will be transferred and adopted, and educators will be educated and transferred to more than 600 students.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom ovoga projekta doprinosi se rješavanju dijela izazova s kojima se suočavaju OCD-i odgojno-obrazovne ustanove. Samo promjenom tradicionalne predmetne nastave na sustavno, cjelovito podučavanje kroz multidisciplinarni STEM pristup u kojem je učenik aktivan sudionik koji radom na najrazličitijim zadatcima konstruira vlastito upotrebljivo znanje moći će se u budućnosti nositi s razvojnim izazovima, uključujući onečišćenje okoliša, nepredvidive klimatske pojave, zdravstvene probleme, iscrpljenost prirodnih resursa poput vode i energije te društvene i političke sukobe. Osnažit će se veze OCD-a i odgojno-obrazovnih ustanova i fakulteta, prenijeti i usvojiti nova znanja OCD-a te educirati edukatore koji će to prenijeti na više od 600 učenika

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Zadar County Social Plan
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada socijalnog plana Zadarske županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The specific objective of the project is to empower social planning experts in order to better design, implement and monitor the county social plan, which will lead to the fulfillment of the needs of socially vulnerable groups, the prevention of social exclusion and the distribution of social welfare services. Activities are analysis and data processing and preparation of the plan, data collection for the preparation of the plan and implementation of education for members of the council and employees of the county for planning, implementation and monitoring of the county social plan.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Specifični cilj projekta je osnaživanje stručnjaka za socijalno planiranje kako bi se kvalitetnije izradio, provodio i pratio županijski socijalni plan što će dovesti do ispunjenje potreba socijalno osjetljivih skupina, prevencije socijalne isključenosti i distribucija usluga socijalne skrbi. Aktivnosti su analiza i obrada podataka te izrada plana, prikupljanje podataka za izradu plana i provedba edukacija za članove savjeta i djelatnike županije za planiranje, provedbu i praćenje županijskog socijalnog plana.

Operation_Name_English: Step into a Life of Equal Opportunities - Phase VI
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Korak u život jednakih mogućnosti - faza VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
