Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project aims to improve educational achievements, achieve more successful socialization and emotional functioning of students with developmental difficulties in primary schools in the area of Virovitica, through the provision of support and professional support of trained PUN. The project activity will provide assistance and support to 40 students with disabilities who are included in the regular primary education system in order to enable them to participate in the educational process on an equal footing and prevent their discrimination. Recruitment 38 PUN to students with disabilities will improve their educational achievement, increase socialization and integration in school and community. PUN will assist students with disabilities in the adoption of educational content and mediate in the establishment of interaction between students, which will result in the development and strengthening of the personality of students with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta žele se poboljšati obrazovna postignuća, postići uspješnija socijalizacija i emocionalno funkcioniranje učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnim školama s područja grada Virovitice, kroz pružanje potpore i stručne podrške osposobljenih PUN. Kroz projektnu aktivnost pružit će se pomoć i podrška za 40 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju koji su uključeni u redovan sustav osnovnoškolskog obrazovanja kako bi im se omogućilo ravnopravno sudjelovanje u odgojno obrazovnom procesu i spriječila njihova diskriminacija. Zapošljavanjem 38 PUN učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju poboljšat će se njihova obrazovna postignuća, povećati socijalizacija i integracija u školi i zajednici. PUN će pomagati učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u usvajanju odgojno-obrazovnog sadržaja te posredovati u uspostavljanju interakcije među učenicima što će rezultirati razvojem i jačanjem osobnosti učenika s teškoćama u razvoju.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the capacity of Netgen through the implementation and certification of management systems
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje kapaciteta tvrtke Netgen kroz implementaciju i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of implementation and certification of quality management system according to ISO 9001:2015 and information security management system according to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 in the company NETGEN d.o.o. lasts 12 months and is focused on establishing a quality and information security management system. Through ISO 9001, the company will develop quality policies and procedures for monitoring and improving services, with the aim of ensuring high quality and continuous improvement of business processes. In parallel, the implementation of ISO 27001 will ensure data protection through the development of security measures and employee training. The project will increase competitiveness and provide reliable, secure services to clients.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt implementacije i certifikacije sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema ISO 9001:2015 i sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema ISO/IEC 27001:2022 u tvrtki NETGEN d.o.o. traje 12 mjeseci i usmjeren je na uspostavu sustava upravljanja kvalitetom i sigurnošću informacija. Kroz ISO 9001, tvrtka će razviti politike kvalitete i procedure za praćenje i poboljšanje usluga, s ciljem osiguravanja visoke kvalitete i kontinuiranog poboljšanja poslovnih procesa. Paralelno, implementacija ISO 27001 osigurat će zaštitu podataka kroz razvoj sigurnosnih mjera i obuku zaposlenika. Projekt će povećati konkurentnost i pružiti pouzdane, sigurne usluge klijentima.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of the company KEČKEŠ by introducing a management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća KEČKEŠ uvođenjem sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of KEČKEŠ by introducing a management system with the help of grants and own resources. This project will implement 4 ISO standards: ISO 9001:2015 (quality management system), ISO 14001:2015 (environmental management system), ISO 45001:2018 (OSH management system) and EN 1090-2 EXC2. The purpose of the project is to enable the introduction of a management system facilitated access to the domestic market and the targeted foreign market, increase competitiveness, prove the level of quality and safety in the exchange of their products on the market and contribute to customer confidence. Expected results of the project are increased sales revenue and sales revenue in foreign markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta jest uz pomoć bespovratnih sredstava i vlastitih izvora povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost društva KEČKEŠ uvođenjem sustava upravljanja. Predmetnim će se projektom implementirati 4 ISO norme: ISO 9001:2015 (sustav upravljanja kvalitetom), ISO 14001:2015 (sustav upravljanja okolišem), ISO 45001:2018 (sustav upravljanja zdravljem i sigurnošću na radu) te EN 1090-2 EXC2. Svrha projekta je omogućiti uvođenjem sustava upravljanja olakšani pristup domaćem tržištu i ciljanom inozemnom tržištu, povećati konkurentnost, dokazati razinu kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni svojih proizvoda na tržištu te pridonijeti povjerenju kupaca. Očekivani rezultati projekta su povećani prihod od prodaje, te prihod od prodaje na inozemnim tržištima.

Operation_Name_English: Ražanac - my home + II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ražanac – moj dom + II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Ražanac - My Home + II" will employ 10 service providers for a period of 32 months in order to provide support and support to 60 members of the target group in the territory of the municipality of Ražanac in the rural part of Zadar County. The service provider will ensure the organization of food, perform household chores, maintain personal hygiene and meet other daily needs of the target group members. This will directly contribute to the reduction of poverty and social exclusion in all 8 settlements in the municipality of Ražanac. Once a month, one package of household and basic hygiene supplies will be provided for each member of the target group.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Ražanac - moj dom + II" zaposlit će se 10 pružatelja usluga u periodu od 32 mjeseca u svrhu pružanja potpore i podrške za 60 pripadnika ciljane skupine na području općine Ražanac u ruralnom dijelu Zadarske županije. Pružatelj usluga će osigurati organiziranje prehrane, obavljati kućanske poslove, održavati osobnu higijenu i zadovoljenje drugih svakodnevnih potreba pripadnika ciljane skupine. Time će se izravno doprinijeti smanjenju siromaštva i socijalne isključenosti na području svih 8 naselja općine Ražanac. Jednom mjesečno će biti osiguran jedan paket kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština za svakog pripadnika ciljane skupine.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of PROTEKO d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva PROTEKO d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the implementation and certification of information security management systems according to ISO 27001 and ISO/IEC 17025:2017, which ensures compliance of business processes with internationally recognized standards. The purpose is to increase the international competitiveness of enterprises by raising the level of data security and customer confidence, especially in sectors with high security requirements. The project includes analysis of the existing situation, employee education, policy development, implementation and certification of the system. Expected results include reducing the risk of security incidents, increasing sales revenue by 16% and exports by 100%, and strengthening the market position in the domestic and international markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je implementacija i certifikacija sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema normi ISO 27001 i ISO/IEC 17025:2017, čime se osigurava usklađenost poslovnih procesa s međunarodno priznatim standardima. Svrha je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća kroz podizanje razine sigurnosti podataka i povjerenja klijenata, posebno u sektorima s visokim zahtjevima sigurnosti. Projekt uključuje analizu postojećeg stanja, edukaciju zaposlenika, razvoj politika, implementaciju i certifikaciju sustava. Očekivani rezultati uključuju smanjenje rizika od sigurnosnih incidenata, povećanje prihoda od prodaje za 16% i izvoza 100%, te jačanje tržišne pozicije na domaćem i međunarodnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Paz(in)exclusive school
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Paz(in)kluzivna škola
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Paz(IN)inclusive school" will continue the good practice of providing support to primary school students with disabilities (target group) through the insurance of 19 PUN/CPC in primary school institutions of the city of Pazin in order to ensure conditions for even better educational achievements, socialization and emotional functioning of students with disabilities. The project will lay the foundations for ensuring equal opportunities for all children and will increase the social inclusion of children with disabilities. The project holder is the town of Pazin, and the partner is the elementary school Vladimir Nazor Pazin.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Paz(IN)inkluzivna škola" nastaviti će se dobra praksa pružanja podrške osnovnoškolskim učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju (ciljana skupina) kroz osiguranje 19 PUN/SKP u osnovnoškolskim ustanovama grada Pazina kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za još bolja obrazovna postignuća, socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje učenika s teškoćama u razvoju. Projektom će se postaviti temelji za osiguranje jednakih mogućnosti za svu djecu te će se povećati socijalna uključenost djece s teškoćama u razvoju. Nositelj projekta ja grad Pazin, a partner je OŠ Vladimira Nazora Pazin.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrade of the Leptirići Kindergarten in the Municipality of Podravske Sesvete
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja Dječjeg vrtića Leptirići u Općini Podravske Sesvete
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The specific objective of the project ‘Upgrade of the Leptirići Kindergarten in the Municipality of Podravske Sesvete’ is to upgrade the Leptirići Kindergarten and to increase the existing capacity of the living rooms for one additional nursery group at local level. The general objective of the project is to provide infrastructure and material capacities in the Municipality of Podravska Sesvete and to increase the availability of early childhood education and care in the Republic of Croatia. The implementation of the project solves the problem of the lack of adequate space for the organization of living rooms for one crèche group and benefits 12 children of crèche age from one to three years of age who will get a new and safe space for socializing, learning, growth and development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Specifični cilj projekta „Dogradnja Dječjeg vrtića Leptirići u Općini Podravske Sesvete“ je dogradnja matičnog Dječjeg vrtića Leptirići te povećanje postojećih kapaciteta dnevnih boravaka za jednu dodatnu jasličku skupinu na lokalnoj razini. Opći cilj projekta je osiguranje infrastrukturnih i materijalnih kapaciteta na području Općine Podravske Sesvete te povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja u Republici Hrvatskoj. Provedbom projekta rješava se problem nedostatka adekvatnog prostora za organizaciju dnevnih boravaka za jednu jasličku skupinu i ostvaruje se korist za 12 djece jasličkog uzrasta od jedne do tri godine života koja će dobiti nov i siguran prostor za druženje, učenje, rast i razvoj.

Operation_Name_English: Firehouse Mali Losinj
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Vatrogasni dom Mali Lošinj
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Firehouse Mali Lošinj’ focuses on the construction of a modern firehouse that will address the infrastructure needs of the fire service. Current conditions, with separate accommodation of people and equipment, make interventions more difficult, while spatial and planning restrictions prevent the reconstruction of an existing building. The new home will combine accommodation, storage of equipment and garages for vehicles, while complying with safety standards. The project will speed up reactions, improve working conditions, increase community security and provide education, strengthening the resilience of the Lošinj archipelago to risks.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Vatrogasni dom Mali Lošinj” usmjeren je na izgradnju suvremenog vatrogasnog doma koji će riješiti infrastrukturne potrebe vatrogasne službe. Trenutni uvjeti, s razdvojenim smještajem ljudstva i opreme, otežavaju intervencije, dok prostorno-planska ograničenja onemogućuju rekonstrukciju postojeće zgrade. Novi dom objedinit će smještaj, skladištenje opreme i garaže za vozila, uz usklađivanje sa sigurnosnim standardima. Projekt će ubrzati reakcije, poboljšati uvjete rada, povećati sigurnost zajednice i omogućiti edukaciju, jačajući otpornost Lošinjskog arhipelaga na rizike.

Operation_Name_English: Knowledge to all
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Znanje svima
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the Knowledge project is to ensure inclusive education for 42 students with disabilities in the process of education with the support of professionally trained teaching assistants in order to contribute to the improvement of students' educational achievements, their more successful socialization and emotional functioning. Students with developmental disabilities as the target group of this project form a vulnerable group of children and young people and need to be provided with quality education and the acquisition of knowledge, skills and competences necessary for employment, social inclusion, active citizenship and personal creation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta Znanje svima je osigurati inkluzivno obrazovanje za 42 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u proces odgoja i obrazovanja uz potporu stručno osposobljenih pomoćnika u nastavi kako bi se pridonijelo poboljšanju obrazovnih postignuća učenika, njihovoj uspješnijoj socijalizaciji i emocionalnom funkcioniranju. Učenici s teškoćama u razvoju kao ciljna skupina ovog projekta čine ranjivu skupinu djece i mladih ljudi te im je potrebno omogućiti kvalitetno obrazovanje i stjecanje znanja, vještina i kompetencija potrebnih za zapošljavanje, društvenu uključenost, aktivno građanstvo te osobno stvaranje.

Operation_Name_English: Video surveillance and early detection of forest fires - FIRESTOP
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Videonadzor i rano otkrivanje šumskih požara - FIRESTOP
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
NUTS3_Label: Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija|Šibensko-kninska županija|Karlovačka županija|Istarska županija|Vukovarsko-srijemska županija|Zadarska županija|Primorsko-goranska županija|Ličko-senjska županija|Split-Dalmatia County
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to expand the system for early detection of forest fires by installing an additional 82 cameras at 39 locations in the coastal area and 2 in the continental part of the Republic of Croatia, and the project will cover an area of 95,488 ha of state forests in nine counties. Expanding the system will increase safety and forest fire protection. By strengthening the existing video surveillance system, the initial fires will be detected in real time and thus shorten the time until the fire brigade intervention. It will also facilitate the cooperation of firefighting forces in the field (coordination) when extinguishing fires. This integrated approach aims to contribute to climate change adaptation and to strengthen resilience to the increased risks of forest fires in these areas.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je proširenje sustava za rano otkrivanje šumskih požara postavljanjem dodatne 82 kamere na 39 lokacija u priobalju i 2 u kontinentalnom dijelu RH te će se projektom pokriti površina od 95.488 ha državnih šuma na području devet županija. Proširenjem sustava podići će se sigurnost i povećati zaštita šuma od požara. Jačanjem postojećeg sustava videonadzora inicijalni požari otkrivat će se u realnom vremenu i time skratiti vrijeme do intervencije vatrogasnih postrojbi. Također olakšat će se suradnja vatrogasnih snaga na terenu (koordinacija) prilikom gašenja požara. Ovim integriranim pristupom namjera je doprinijeti prilagodbi klimatskim promjenama te jačanju otpornosti na povećane rizike od šumskih požara na tim područjima.

Operation_Summary_English: Objective: increasing the quality of life and prevention of institutionalization for the elderly and people with disabilities in the area of 4 partner municipalities. The service will be provided to the target group by a minimum of 35 employed providers for 28 months for a minimum of 210 members of the target group. Quality in implementation and reporting will be ensured through project management and administration activity.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj: povećanje kvalitete života i prevencija institucionalizacije za starije osobe i osobe s invaliditetom na području 4 partnerske općine. Na mjesečnoj razini će se vršiti praćenje i kontrola pruženih usluga od strane prijavitelja kako bi se osigurala kvaliteta i kontinuitet. Kroz aktivnost komunikacija i vidljivost održati će se uvodna i završna konferencija za medije s ciljem predstavljanja projekta i informiranja javnosti te će se tiskati promotivni materijal. Kvaliteta u provedbi i izvještavanje osigurat će se kroz aktivnost upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: High-Performance Power Systems Sensitivity Analysis Tool
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Alat visokih performansi za analizu osjetljivosti elektroenergetskih sustava
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Calculations of the power system (capacity, stability, security) carried out on a daily and/or hourly basis by system operators and coordination centres have a significantly limited execution time. Precisely the timing and complexity of the sensitivity analysis of the electrical network leads to the fact that the associated operating costs are extremely high, while the new processes envisaged by EU regulations seem impracticable with the current performance of similar tools. Uprise has developed a number of tools that are used for operational calculations on a daily basis and through this project in cooperation with the mathematical department of the Faculty of Science wants to examine the possibility of developing new or more efficient implementation of existing algorithms in order to increase its competitiveness on the market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Proračuni elektroenergetskog sustava (kapacitet, stabilnost, sigurnost) koje na dnevnoj i/ili satnoj bazi provode operatori sustava i koordinacijski centri imaju znatno limitirano vrijeme izvođenja. Upravo vrijeme izvođenja i kompleksnost analize osjetljivosti električne mreže dovodi do toga da su pripadajući operativni troškovi izuzetno visoki, dok novi procesi predviđeni EU regulativama izgledaju neizvedivo sa sadašnjim performansama sličnih alata. Uprise je razvio niz alata koji se koriste za operativne proračune na dnevnoj bazi te kroz ovaj projekt u suradnji s matematičkim odsjekom PMF-a želi ispitati mogućnost razvoja novih ili mogućnosti efikasnije implementacije postojećih algoritama kako bi povećao svoju konkurentnost na tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Give me your hands II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pruži mi ruke II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups in the city of Vukovar by providing long-term care. The specific objective of the project is to provide support and support services in everyday life for a total of 150 elderly people and people with disabilities in the area of the city of Vukovar. The main activity of the project is the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of a package of supplies that includes the employment of 25 service providers (33 months) for at least 6 members of the target group per employee, monitoring and control of the services performed, the procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies of the prescribed mandatory content, communication and visibility, as well as project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina na području grada Vukovara osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za ukupno 150 starijih osoba i osobama s invaliditetom na području grada Vukovara. Glavna aktivnost projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje zapošljavanje 25 pružatelja usluga (33 mj.) za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine po zaposlenom, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština propisanog obaveznog sadržaja, komunikaciju i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Summary_English: The project will carry out the distribution of aid in the form of standardised food packages and basic material assistance packages, will implement accompanying measures and the activity of distribution of donated food. Operation_Name_English: Development of the water communal infrastructure of the Ivanić-Grad agglomeration – Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj vodnokomunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Ivanić-Grad – faza 2
Category_Label: Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project consists of two phases. Phase 1 of the project includes investment investments within the financial period OPKK 2014-2020. Phase 2 of the project covers investment investments within the financial period of the PKK 2021-2027. The Ivanić-Grad agglomeration will be aligned with the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive (91/271/EEC) through the upgrade of the 3rd degree wastewater treatment plant, the upgrade of the drainage system, the increase of the connection to the drainage system and the reconstruction of part of the existing drainage system. The target group of this project are residents currently connected to the public drainage system and those who will be connected to the new and/or reconstructed public drainage system through this project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se sastoji od dvije faze. 1.faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja OPKK 2014-2020. 2.faza projekta obuhvaća investicijska ulaganja unutar financijskog razdoblja PKK 2021-2027. Aglomeracija Ivanić-Grad uskladiti će se sa Direktivom o pročišćavanju komunalnih otpadnih voda (91/271/EEZ) kroz nadogradnju uređaja za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda III. stupnja, dogradnju sustava odvodnje, povećanja priključenosti na sustav odvodnje te rekonstrukciju dijela postojećeg sustava odvodnje. Ciljna skupina ovog projekta su stanovnici trenutno priključeni na sustav javne odvodnje i oni koji će se putem ovog projekta priključiti na novi i/ili rekonstruirani sustav javne odvodnje.

Operation_Name_English: Development of innovative products under the priority niche Smart Agriculture - Agriculture Next Generation (ANG)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inovativnih proizvoda u okviru prioritetne niše pametna poljoprivreda - Agriculture Next Generation (ANG)
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project is implemented for 36 months and implies the establishment of a SPIN consortium consisting of the Applicant, the company MMM Agramservis d.o.o. and the companies Grič international d.o.o. and Maidea d.o.o. In addition, the consortium consists of three organizations for research and dissemination of knowledge, namely the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Computer Science and Information Technology Osijek, the Faculty of Agrobiotechnical Sciences Osijek and the Department of Ecology, Agronomy and Aquaculture of the University of Zadar. The aim of the project is to implement the set activities with the aim of developing a new generation AGRIVOLTAICS system of production and storage of electricity from a photovoltaic power plant with dual use of agricultural land and an autonomous robotic vehicle intended for spraying and fruit transport.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se provodi 36 mjeseci i podrazumijeva uspostavu SPIN konzorcija kojeg čini Prijavitelj, poduzeće MMM Agramservis d.o.o. te poduzeća Grič international d.o.o. i Maidea d.o.o. Cilj projekta je provedba zadanih aktivnosti s ciljem razvoja nove generacije AGRIVOLTAICS sustava proizvodnje i skladištenja električne energije iz fotonaponske elektrane uz dualno korištenje poljoprivrednog zemljišta te autonomnog robotskog vozila namijenjenog prskanju i transportu plodova.

Operation_Summary_English: Through the implementation of 18 children will receive PUN/CPC support, which will provide the opportunity for quality education, independence and help in carrying out school, extracurricular and extracurricular activities through collaborative teaching. Children with disabilities will, with the help of PUN/CPC, acquire the knowledge and skills necessary for employment and personal and social achievement. Krajnji korisnici projekta su stanovnici grada, stručni kadrovi OŠ, roditelji i drugi polaznici OŠ.

Operation_Name_English: Project "For Women - For Community" 4

During the duration of the project, beneficiaries will be provided with day-to-day assistance in the home, enable social contact and social connections, and increase their sense of value and belonging.
