Projekt će trajati 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the quality of health services on Korčula and Pelješac
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje kvalitete zdravstvenih usluga na Korčuli i Pelješcu
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria|Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community
Operation_Summary_English: The SB KALOS stationary building in its current state does not meet the current requirements of the Technology Regulation on rational energy use and thermal protection of buildings. Accordingly, the project plans to reconstruct the building envelope on the Stationary building with the aim of reducing heat losses, improving energy efficiency and improving the living conditions for users and employees. In addition, it is planned to decorate a neglected outdoor space in order to get a comfortable and functional space. As part of the Red Cross project, the Red Cross will carry out workshops on ‘Active ageing’ in the area of 4 municipalities in Korčula and Pelješac. The aim of the project is to increase the quality of health services and the activity of third-aged people on the island of Korčula and the Pelješac peninsula.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Zgrada stacionara SB KALOS u sadašnjem stanju ne zadovoljava aktualne zahtjeve Tehnčkog propisa o racionalnoj uporabi energije i toplinskoj zaštiti zgrada. Sukladno tome projektom se planira rekonstrukcija građevinske ovojnice na objektu Stacionara s ciljem smanjenja toplinskih gubitaka, poboljašnja energetske učinkovitosti i poboljšanjem uvijeta boravka za korisnike i zaposlenike. Uz to, planira se uređenje zapuštenog vanjskog prostora kako bi se dobio ugodan i funkcionalan prostor. U sklopu projekta Crveni križ će provoditi radionice na temu “Aktivno starenje” na području 4 JLS na Korčuli i Pelješcu. Cilj projekta je povećati kvaliteta zdravstvenih usluga i aktivnost osoba treće životne dobi na otoku Korčuli i poluotoku Pelješcu.

Operation_Name_English: Air quality monitoring in the Split Port Authority area
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Praćenje kvalitete zraka u području Lučke uprave Split
Category_Label: Air quality and noise reduction measures
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Air quality monitoring in the Port of Split Authority’ aims to establish a system for continuous air quality monitoring in one of the six ports of international economic importance for the Republic of Croatia. The project involves the installation of a fixed measuring station to monitor emissions of NO2, SO2 and PM10/PM2 particulate matter, while meteorological sensors monitor parameters such as pressure, temperature, air humidity and wind direction and speed. The aim is to ensure timely response to increased levels of air pollution and to enable the planning of effective measures to reduce emissions, thereby reducing negative impacts on human health and the environment, as well as reducing exposure to harmful substances and encouraging the sustainable development of the port authority.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Praćenje kvalitete zraka u području Lučke uprave Split“ ima za cilj uspostavu sustava za kontinuirano praćenje kvalitete zraka u jednoj od šest luka od međunarodnog gospodarskog značaja za Republiku Hrvatsku. Projekt uključuje instalaciju fiksne mjerne postaje za praćenje emisija štetnih tvari NO₂, SO₂ i lebdećih čestica PM10/PM2, dok meteorološki senzori prate parametre poput tlaka, temperature, vlažnosti zraka te smjera i brzine vjetra. Cilj je osigurati pravovremeno reagiranje na povećane razine zagađenja zraka te omogućiti planiranje učinkovitih mjera za smanjenje emisija, čime se smanjuju negativni utjecaji na zdravlje ljudi i okoliš, a također se smanjuje izloženost štetnim tvarima te potiče održivi razvoj lučke uprave.

Operation_Name_English: Wish for support
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi podršku
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Wish for Support" is intended to provide support and support services in everyday life for 90 elderly people and people with disabilities in the territory of the Republic of Croatia, thus contributing to their greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in their own home and ensuring the right to live in the community. This project will implement recruitment activities for 15 service providers for at least 90 members of the target group; monitoring and control of the services performed; procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies; communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Zaželi podršku" namjerava se pružiti usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 90 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom na području RH čime se pridonosi njihovoj većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguravanju prava na život u zajednici. Ovim projektom provodit će se aktivnosti zapošljavanja 15 pružatelja usluga za najmanje 90 pripadnika ciljane skupine; praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga; nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština; komunikacija i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of the Bicycle Infrastructure of the Municipality of Bilje
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističke infrastrukture Općine Bilje
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to build a safe and accessible cycling infrastructure that will improve connectivity in the Municipality of Bilje and with the urban center of the City of Osijek, encourage sustainable mobility, reduce CO2 emissions, and promote a healthy lifestyle of the Municipality's population by encouraging cycling as an alternative form of transport. The infrastructure is designed taking into account the needs of all users, including cyclists, pedestrians and people with disabilities, and will provide a safe and comfortable space for sports, recreation and walking. Through this project, the aim is to reduce emissions of harmful gases, encourage an active lifestyle and improve the quality of life of the local population.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgraditi sigurnu i pristupačnu biciklističku infrastrukturu koja će poboljšati povezanost u Općini Bilje i s urbanim središtem Gradom Osijekom, potaknuti održivu mobilnost, smanjiti emisiju CO2, te promicati zdrav način života stanovništva Općine kroz poticanje biciklizma kao alternativnog oblika prijevoza. Infrastruktura je dizajnirana uzimajući u obzir potrebe svih korisnika, uključujući bicikliste, pješake i osobe s invaliditetom, te će pružiti siguran i udoban prostor za sport, rekreaciju i pješačenje. Kroz ovaj projekt želi se utjecati na smanjenje emisije štetnih plinova, potaknuti aktivni način života te unaprijediti kvalitetu života lokalnog stanovništva.

Operation_Name_English: Assistance as a priority
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomoć kao prioritet
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The main goal of the project is social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of elderly people and people with disabilities in the city of Zagreb. This is in line with the general objective of the call: Increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups through the provision of long-term care, and the specific objective calls for: the provision of support and support services in the daily life of the elderly and persons with disabilities. The objectives of the project are to be achieved through the employment of 30 home helpers for a period of 33 months to help vulnerable groups in their daily lives.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osnovni cilj projekta je socijalno uključivanje i prevencija institucionalizacije starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom na području grada Zagreba. Navedeno je u skladu s općim ciljem poziva: povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi, te specifičnim ciljem poziva: pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom. Ciljevi projekta se namjeravaju ostvariti kroz zapošljavanje 30 pružatelja usluge pomoći u kući u trajanju od 33 mjeseca da bi se pomoglo ranjivim skupinama u svakodnevnom životu.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of an integrated quality and environmental management system ISO 9001:2015/ISO 14001:2015
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje integriranog sustava upravljanja kvalitetom i okolišem ISO 9001:2015/ISO 14001:2015
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase the quality of services and improve environmental protection in ESPERA d.o.o. and thus contribute to the realization of this project. The specific objective is to adapt to market requirements and increase the competitiveness of companies in the market. The result of the project will be 2 obtained certificates ISO 9001:2015 quality management system and ISO 14001:2015 environmental management system. The main target groups are employees of the company in the execution of construction works of high-rise buildings. Other interested parties of the company will benefit indirectly, namely: clients, investors, suppliers and business partners, social community, government bodies, financial institutions...
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje kvalitete usluga te poboljšanje zaštite okoliša u ESPERA d.o.o. te na taj način pridonijeti ostvarenju ovog projekta. Posebni cilj je prilagođavanje zahtjevima tržišta te povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća na tržištu. Rezultat projekta bit će 2 ishođena certifikata ISO 9001:2015 sustav upravljanja kvalitetom i ISO 14001:2015 sustav upravljanja okolišem. Glavne su ciljne skupine zaposlenici poduzeća na izvođenju građevinskih radova visokogradnje. Neizravnu korist imat će ostale zainteresirane strane poduzeća a to su: klijenti, investitori, dobavljači i poslovni partneri, društvena zajednica, tijela državne uprave, financijske institucije...

Operation_Name_English: Obtaining 18O enriched water using cryodistillation - CoolWater
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dobivanje 18O obogaćene vode primjenom kriodestilacije – CoolWater
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The CoolWater project addresses the need for efficient and sustainable production of 18O enriched water, essential for medical applications such as the production of 18F fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) radiopharmaceuticals for application in PET tomography. Through the cryodistillation of liquid oxygen, the project seeks to isolate the 18O isotope, using the surrounding air as raw material and electricity from renewable sources. The aim is to develop and optimise the process to a high proportion of the 18O isotope in the final product. Target groups include researchers in the field of medical isotopic chemistry, industry using enriched isotopes, and scientific institutions. The project will improve existing technological solutions and implement more energy efficient methods in the production of 18O enriched water.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt CoolWater adresira potrebu za efikasnom i održivom proizvodnjom 18O obogaćene vode, ključne za medicinske aplikacije poput proizvodnje radiofarmaka 18F fluorodeoksiglukoze (FDG) za primjenu u PET tomografiji. Kroz kriodestilaciju tekućeg kisika, projekt nastoji izolirati izotop 18O, koristeći okolni zrak kao sirovinu i električnu energiju iz obnovljivih izvora. Cilj je razviti i optimizirati proces do visokog udjela izotopa 18O u konačnom proizvodu. Ciljne skupine uključuju istraživače u području medicinske izotopne kemije, industriju koja koristi obogaćene izotope, te znanstvene institucije. Projekt će unaprijediti postojeća tehnološka rješenja i implementirati energetski učinkovitije metode kod proizvodnje 18O obogaćene vode.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of quality management system according to ISO 9001:2015 standard
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema ISO 9001:2015 standardu
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to implement and certify the management system according to ISO 9001:2015. By introducing a certified management system, the company will achieve an increase in quality, efficiency and competitiveness in business. Certification enables optimization of business processes, reduction of errors as well as better management of resources and risks. Implementation of ISO standards will contribute to increased competitiveness and recognizability of trades, which will result in expansion to new foreign markets and increase of income from trades.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je implementirati i certificirati sustav upravljanja prema ISO 9001:2015. Uvođenjem certificiranog sustava upravljanja, obrt će postići povećanje kvalitete, učinkovitosti i konkurentnosti u poslovanju. Certificiranje omogućava optimizaciju poslovnih procesa, smanjenje grešaka kao i bolje upravljanje resursima i rizicima. Implementacija ISO standarda doprinijet će povećanoj konkurentnosti i prepoznatljivosti obrta što će kao posljedicu imati širenje na nova inozemna tržišta te povećanje primitaka kod obrta.

Operation_Name_English: Research and development of innovative mini robot playroom in order to strengthen tourism offer, popularity of STEM and gaming industry in Pannonian Croatia
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Istraživanje i razvoj inovativne mini robotske igraonice u cilju jačanja turističke ponude, popularnosti STEMa i gaming industrije u Panonskoj Hrvatskoj
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: The project involves the research and development of an innovative mini robotic playroom, and the development of a STEM ‘tool kit’ kit for self-assembly of robots – tanks, all with the aim of strengthening the tourist offer, the popularity of STEM and the gaming industry in the Pannonian region of Croatia. For the purpose of the project, a Consortium with partners has been formed and will be involved in all key components of the development – from electronics to software, construction design and playroom monitoring and management systems. By collaborating with different partners, the project will create high-quality products, optimized for performance and safety, and ready for commercialization. Target groups are employees, partners, clients and suppliers of the company, and the gaming community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt uključuje istraživanje i razvoj inovativne mini robotske igraonice, te razvoj STEM „tool kit“ kompleta za samostalno sastavljanje robota – tenka, sve u cilju jačanja turističke ponude, popularnosti STEMa i gaming industrije u regiji Panonska Hrvatska. Za potrebe projekta formiran je Konzorcij s partnerima koji će biti uključen u sve ključne komponente razvoja – od elektronike do softvera, dizajna konstrukcije te sustava za praćenje i upravljanje igraonicama. Suradnjom različitih partnera, projekt će stvoriti visokokvalitetne proizvode, optimizirane za performanse i sigurnost, te spremne za komercijalizaciju. Ciljane skupine su zaposlenici, partneri, klijenti i dobavljači tvrtke, te gaming zajednica.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of the management system of BALI d.o.o. by introducing ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certificates into its own business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranje sustava upravljanja poduzeća BALI d.o.o. uvođenjem ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 i ISO 45001:2018 certifikata u vlastito poslovanje
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of this project is to facilitate access to the international market and increase the competitiveness of the company BALI d.o.o. through the certification of the business process and quality management system of the company and the introduction of ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certificates in its own business. In this way, the applicable level of internationally recognized standards and standards as well as management systems will be reached, which prove the level of quality and security in the exchange of goods and services and contribute to customer confidence. The target group of the project is represented by BALI d.o.o. and its existing and future employees, while the final beneficiaries are existing and potential customers, suppliers and business partners, other companies in the manufacturing sector and the local and wider community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha ovog projekta je olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu i povećati konkurentnost poduzeća BALI d.o.o. kroz certificiranje sustava upravljanja poslovnim procesima i kvalitetom poduzeća te uvođenjem ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 i ISO 45001:2018 certifikata u vlastito poslovanje. Na taj način dostići će se primjenjiva razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda kao i sustava upravljanja, kojima se dokazuje razina kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni roba i usluga te pridonosi povjerenju kupaca. Ciljnu skupinu projekta predstavljaju BALI d.o.o. te njeni postojeći i budući zaposlenici, dok su krajnji korisnici postojeći i potencijalni kupci, dobavljači te poslovni partneri, druga poduzeća u proizvodnom sektoru te lokalna i šira zajednica.

Operation_Name_English: Synergies for a more successful community
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sinergijom do uspješnije zajednice
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal will achieve the objectives of supporting inclusive education by including children with disabilities in primary school partner institutions and enabling support and support in mastering the school curriculum by employing 37 teaching assistants, without separating students from the rest of the class (strengthening the sense of belonging and self-esteem, equality, decent education, more successful socialization and emotional functioning). Project proposal activities include the implementation of selection procedures for teaching assistants, teaching assistants, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektnim prijedlogom ostvarit će se ciljevi pružanja potpore inkluzivnom obrazovanju uključivanjem djece s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim partnerskim ustanovama i omogućavanjem podrške i potpore u svladavanju nastavnog plana i programa škole zapošljavanjem 37 pomoćnika u nastavi, bez izdvajanja učenika od ostatka razrednog odjela (jačanje osjećaja pripadnosti i samopoštovanja, ravnopravnosti, dostojanstvenog obrazovanja, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje). Aktivnosti projektnog prijedloga obuhvaćaju provedbu postupaka selekcije kandidata za pomoćnike u nastavi, rad pomoćnika u nastavi, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Development Strategy of the Urban Agglomeration Osijek until 2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada Strategije razvoja Urbane aglomeracije Osijek do 2027.
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The project envisages the development of the Development Strategy of the Urban Agglomeration Osijek until 2027, which is a territorial strategy and act of strategic planning and a prerequisite for the implementation of the ITU mechanism.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom je predviđena izrada Strategije razvoja Urbane aglomeracije Osijek do 2027. koja je teritorijalna strategija i akt strateškog planiranja te preduvjet za provedbu ITU mehanizma.

Operation_Name_English: Aid to promote the employment and self-employment of young unemployed persons
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Potpore za poticanje zapošljavanja i samozapošljavanja mladih nezaposlenih osoba
Category_Label: Specific support for youth employment and socio-economic integration of young people
Operation_Summary_English: This project covers the implementation of active employment policy measures that encourage the employment and/or start-up of unemployed young people's own business. The project primarily covers the granting of employment aid, aid for self-employment and aid for traineeships, but it also covers the granting of other types of aid that co-finance employment. The target groups are all unemployed people up to the age of 30, with a particular focus on disadvantaged groups in the labour market. The project contributes to reducing long-term unemployment, increasing the employment rate and strengthening the workforce. The project is implemented through a financing model not linked to costs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom obuhvaćena je provedba mjera aktivne politike zapošljavanja kojima se potiče zapošljavanje i/ili pokretanje vlastitog poslovanja nezaposlenih mladih osoba. Projekt primarno obuhvaća dodjelu potpora za zapošljavanje, potpore za samozapošljavanje te potpore za pripravništvo, međutim obuhvaćena je i dodjela drugih vrsta potpora kojima se sufinancira zapošljavanje. Ciljane skupine su sve nezaposlene osobe starosti do 30 godina, s posebnim naglaskom na skupine u nepovoljnom položaju na tržištu rada. Projekt doprinosi smanjenju dugotrajne nezaposlenosti, povećanju stope zapošljavanja i osnaživanju radne snage. Projekt se provodi putem modela financiranja koje nije povezano s troškovima.

Operation_Name_English: DAKBOX
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: DAKBOX
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The DAKBOX project develops an innovative solution for issuing repaired electronic devices outside normal working hours, using security boxes with an electronic lock and a GSM module for communication. The goal is to provide users with flexible access to their devices at any time, which increases customer satisfaction and efficiency, especially in sectors that work non-stop. The project focuses on professionals and businesses whose working rhythm requires exceptional availability of service services, and on service centers that want to improve their service.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt DAKBOX razvija inovativno rješenje za izdavanje popravljenih elektroničkih uređaja izvan uobičajenog radnog vremena, koristeći sigurnosne kutije s elektroničkom bravom i GSM modulom za komunikaciju. Cilj je omogućiti korisnicima fleksibilan pristup svojim uređajima bilo kada, što povećava zadovoljstvo i efikasnost korisnika, posebno u sektorima koji rade non-stop. Projekt se fokusira na profesionalce i poslovne subjekte čiji radni ritam zahtijeva izvanrednu dostupnost servisnih usluga, te na servisne centre koji žele unaprijediti svoju uslugu.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of ISO certification into the business of Rinels d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje ISO certifikata u poslovanje tvrtke Rinels d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Rinels d.o.o. plans to implement internationally recognised ISO standards – ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 20000-1:2018, with the aim of improving business processes, ensuring a high level of service quality and strengthening information security. The introduction of these standards will enable the company to optimize its operational procedures, increase the trust of clients and partners, and strengthen its market position through compliance with the highest international requirements.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka Rinels d.o.o. planira implementaciju međunarodno priznatih ISO standarda – ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001:2022 i ISO 20000-1:2018, s ciljem unaprjeđenja poslovnih procesa, osiguranja visoke razine kvalitete usluga te jačanja informacijske sigurnosti. Uvođenje ovih standarda omogućit će tvrtki optimizaciju svojih operativnih procedura, povećanje povjerenja klijenata i partnera, te jačanje tržišne pozicije kroz usklađenost s najvišim međunarodnim zahtjevima.

Operation_Name_English: Development of digitally managed innovative welding and grinding services for irregular shaped tubular bodies
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj digitalno upravljanih inovativnih usluga zavarivanja i brušenja cjevastih tijela nepravilnih oblika
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project lasts 36 months and includes the formation of a SPIN consortium consisting of the applicant COLOR EMAJL d.o.o., the company Proton EE-Elektronika d.o.o., TTT STELA d.o.o. and the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture in Zagreb as an organization for research and knowledge dissemination. The aim of the project is to apply the latest technological developments in order to develop innovative welding services and rough and precise grinding of tubular bodies of irregular shapes. In addition to speeding up and automating services, reducing errors and costs and increasing efficiency, the project aims to increase the competitiveness of consortia. A multidisciplinary team, including robotics, technology experts and external consultants, will be engaged to ensure comprehensive R&D.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt traje 36 mjeseci te obuhvaća formiranje SPIN konzorcija kojeg čine prijavitelj COLOR EMAJL d.o.o., poduzeća Proton EE-Elektronika d.o.o.,TTT STELA d.o.o. te Fakultet strojarstva i brodogradnje u Zagrebu kao organizacija za istraživanje i širenje znanja. Cilj projekta je primijeniti najnovija tehnološka dostignuća u svrhu razvoja inovativnih usluga zavarivanja i grubog i preciznog brušenja cjevastih tijela nepravilnih oblika. Osim ubrzanja i automatizacije usluga, smanjenja pogrešaka i troškova te povećanja efikasnosti, projekt ima za cilj povećati konkurentnost konzorcija. Bit će angažiran multidisciplinarni tim, uključujući robotičare, tehnološke stručnjake i vanjske konzultante,koji će osigurati sveobuhvatno istraživanje i razvoj.

Operation_Name_English: Sail the STEM waters - a map for 2030.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaplovimo STEM vodama - karta za 2030.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Let's sail through STEM waters - a map for 2030" is focused on strengthening the capacity of 3 CSOs to promote STEM among children and students and establishing cooperation with 2 faculties and 2 educational institutions. Through workshops and public events, the project will stimulate interest in STEM, develop key skills for the future and promote social inclusion through education. In line with EU and Croatian policies, the aim is to encourage a positive attitude towards STEM, to contribute to economic competitiveness and social cohesion and to the preservation of marine and water ecosystems through education and innovation. The project involves the Faculty of Chemistry and Technology, Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, three associations: Sunce, Krka Knin, UKITS and two primary schools: ‘Good’ Elementary School, ‘Homeland Thanksgiving’ Elementary School.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Zaplovimo STEM vodama - karta za 2030" fokusiran je na jačanje kapaciteta 3 OCD-a za promociju STEM-a među djecom i učenicima te uspostavu suradnje s 2 fakulteta i 2 odgojno-obrazovne ustanove. Kroz radionice i javna događanja projekt će poticati interes za STEM, razvijati ključne vještine za budućnost te promicati socijalno uključivanje kroz obrazovanje. Usklađen s EU i hrvatskim politikama, cilj je potaknuti pozitivan stav prema STEM-u, doprinijeti gospodarskoj konkurentnosti i socijalnoj koheziji te očuvanju ekosustava mora i voda kroz edukaciju i inovacije. U projektu sudjeluju Kemijsko-tehnološki fakultet, Filozofski fakultet, tri udruge: Sunce, Krka Knin, UKITS i dvije osnovne škole: OŠ “Dobri”, OŠ “Domovinske zahvalnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Just and Green Transition Academy – the future of labour rights!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Akademija pravedne i zelene tranzicije – budućnost radničkih prava!
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to strengthen the capacities of SING and HES to operate in the labour market through training, networking and the development of new services for members. The capacity building will be achieved through education and networking of SING and HES with trade unions in the Republic of Croatia and the EU with the aim of acquiring knowledge and exchanging experiences regarding ESG reporting, policies related to the workforce, combating discrimination and protecting the rights of persons with disabilities. The project also includes the digital transformation of trade unions by improving the SING IT platform and establishing a new IT system for HES. Also, the project will develop an educational programme "Just and Green Transition Academy", which will, together with the establishment of new e-learning modules, enable continuous education of trade union members.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt ima za cilj ojačati kapacitete SING-a i HES-a za djelovanje na tržištu rada kroz osposobljavanje, umrežavanje i razvoj novih usluga za članove. Podizanje kapaciteta ostvarit će kroz edukaciju i umrežavanje SING-a i HES-a sa sindikatima u RH i EU s ciljem stjecanja znanja i razmjene iskustava u vezi ESG izvještavanja, politika povezanih s radnom snagom, suzbijanja diskriminacije i zaštite prava osoba s invaliditetom. Projekt obuhvaća i digitalnu transformaciju sindikata unapređenjem IT platforme SING-a te uspostavom novog IT sustava za HES. Također, projektom će se razviti edukacijski program „Akademija pravedne i zelene tranzicije“ kojim će se uz uspostavu novih e-learning modula omogućiti kontinuirana edukacija članova sindikata.

Operation_Name_English: Always at hand - Wish
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvijek pri ruci - Zaželi
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Providing support and support services in daily life for at least 120 older people and people with disabilities through 34 months. This will allow older people over 65 and adults with disabilities to have greater social inclusion and prevent or delay institutionalisation. Compulsory activity providing support and support services with procurement and distribution of supplies packages will employ 20 service providers, monitoring and control of services performed, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za min 120 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom kroz 34 mj. Time će se omogućiti starijima od 65 i punoljetnima s invaliditetom veća socijalna uključenost i prevencija ili odgađanje institucionalizacije. Obvezna aktivnost pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština zapošljavat će 20 pružatelja usluga, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of the water utility infrastructure of the Đakovo agglomeration – PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Poboljšanje vodnokomunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Đakovo – FAZA 2
Category_Label: Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes : - Construction and reconstruction of the public drainage system - Reconstruction of the public water supply system - Construction of UPOV with a capacity of 33,000 ES, III. Stages of purification + trial work lasting 12 months In FAZI 1 of the project, the following was performed : - Construction and reconstruction of the public drainage system completed - Reconstruction of the public water supply system completed - Construction permit obtained and construction of UPOV with capacity of 33,000 ES, III started. The purification levels in FAZI 2 of the project are planned : - Complete the construction of the UPOV with a capacity of 33,000 ES, III. Degree of purification and conduct trial work lasting 12 months
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća : - Izgradnju i rekonstrukciju sustava javne odvodnje - Rekonstrukciju sustava javne vodoopskrbe - Izgradnju UPOV-a kapaciteta 33.000 ES, III. Stupnja pročišćavanja + pokusni rad u trajanju od 12 mjeseci U FAZI 1 projekta izvedeno je slijedeće : - Završena je izgradnja i rekonstrukcija sustava javne odvodnje - Završena je rekonstrukciju sustava javne vodoopskrbe - Ishođena je građevinska dozvola i započeta je izgradnja UPOV-a kapaciteta 33.000 ES, III. Stupnja pročišćavanja U FAZI 2 projekta planira se : - Dovršiti izgradnju UPOV-a kapaciteta 33.000 ES, III. Stupnja pročišćavanja i provesti pokusni rad u trajanju od 12 mjeseci

Operation_Name_English: Holidays for a Better Tomorrow - OBS
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmor za bolje sutra - OBS
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The main goal of the project "Rest for a Better Tomorrow" is to support the development and provide innovative social services of rest from care for 20 users of parents caregivers with the aim of preventing institutionalization and greater inclusion in the community. Through the provision of temporary replacement care, parents will be given time to rest and take care of their own health, which will reduce the burden and risk of burning. The project includes the organization of psychological support, educational workshops and recreational / half-day activities for children and adults with disabilities, which will increase the quality of life of beneficiaries and their families.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Glavni cilj projekta "Odmor za bolje sutra" je pružanje podrške razvoju i pružanje inovativne socijalne usluge odmora od skrbi za 20 korisnika roditelja njegovatelja s ciljem prevencije institucionalizacije i veće uključenosti u zajednicu. Kroz osiguranje privremene zamjenske skrbi, roditeljima će biti omogućeno vrijeme za odmor i brigu o vlastitom zdravlju, što će smanjiti opterećenje i rizik od sagorijevanja. Projekt uključuje organizaciju psihološke podrške, edukativne radionice i rekreativne/poludnevne aktivnosti za djecu i odrasle s invaliditetom, čime će se povećati kvaliteta života korisnika i njihovih obitelji.

Operation_Name_English: More for workers
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Više za radnike
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: With this project, in addition to further improving the knowledge and skills of applicant and partner employees, we want to ensure the improvement of existing services and the development of new services for the further development of social dialogue at all levels, especially those that strengthen the capacities of trade union representatives on ways to improve cooperation between social partners, encourage collective bargaining and strengthen the influence of trade union representatives in decision-making processes both at the level of employers with whom we have membership and at the national level through the provision of advisory assistance to workers in the realization of appropriate working conditions, and the insurance of workers' labour, pension and social rights.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom osim daljnjeg unapređenja znanja i vještina zaposlenika prijavitelja i partnera želimo osigurati unapređenje postojećih usluga i razvoj novih usluga za daljnji razvoj socijalnog dijaloga na svim razinama, osobito onih koje osnažuju kapacitete sindikalnih predstavnika o načinima unaprjeđenja suradnje među socijalnim partnerima, potiču kolektivno pregovaranja i osnažuju utjecaj sindikalnih predstavnika u procesima donošenja odluka kako na nivou poslodavaca kod kojih imamo članstvo tako i na nacionalnom nivou kroz pružanje savjetodavne pomoći radnicima u ostvarenju odgovarajućih uvjeta rada, te osiguranju radnih, mirovinskih i socijalnih prava radnika.

Operation_Name_English: Want a happier future
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi sretniju budućnost
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective: the provision of support and support services in the daily life of the elderly and persons with disabilities. Once eligible persons have responded to the selection criteria laid down in the PDP in question, they will start recruiting service providers for at least 6 members of the target group. Employees on the project will help members of the target group to organize food, perform household chores, maintain personal hygiene, packages with household and hygiene supplies will be purchased and distributed, and the applicant together with the partner will maintain project visibility and project management and administration. 150 members of the target group are planned to be included, with a total of 25 domestic helpers employed.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj: pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Nakon što se po kriteriju odabira propisanim predmetnim PDP-om odazovu osobe koje zadovoljavaju uvjete krenut će se sa zapošljavanjem pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine. Zaposlene osobe na projektu pripadnicima ciljane skupine pomoći će u organizaciji prehrane, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, održavanju osobne higijene, nabavit će se i podijeliti paketi s kućanskim i higijenskim potrepštinama te će prijavitelj zajedno s partnerom održavati vidljivost projekta te upravljanje projektom i administracijom. Planira se uključiti 150 pripadnika ciljane skupine što ukupno broji 25 zaposlenih pružatelja usluge pomoći u kući.

Operation_Name_English: Balthazar 7
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Baltazar 7
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The Baltazar 7 project will provide 77 PUN/CPC for 95 students with disabilities in 29 primary and secondary educational institutions in Krapina-Zagorje County in the school year 2023/2024. The implementation of the project will directly contribute to the improvement of the conditions for the equalization of social inclusion and integration of students with disabilities in primary/secondary schools in the environment in which they live, the development of their safety and assertiveness in socialization with classmates, the improvement of their educational achievements and independence.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Baltazar 7 će u školskoj godini 2023./2024. osigurati 77 PUN/SKP za 95 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u 29 osnovnoškolskih i srednjoškolskih odgojno- obrazovnih ustanova na području Krapinsko-zagorske županije. Provedbom projekta izravno će se doprinijeti poboljšanju uvjeta za izjednačavanje socijalne uključenosti i integracije učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovne/srednje škole u sredini u kojoj žive, razvoju njihove sigurnosti i asertivnosti u socijalizaciji s vršnjacima iz razreda, poboljšanju njihovih obrazovnih postignuća te samostalnosti.

Operation_Name_English: "You are also part of society"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: „I ti si dio društva“
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Association "Paths of Grace" has prepared a project lasting 36 months, while the provision of services to members of the target group will last 30 months. The aim of the project is to improve the quality of life of the elderly and people with disabilities through raising the quality of health, increasing social inclusion as well as preventing their early institutionalization. The project will employ 25 people to provide support and support services with the purchase and distribution of in-house supplies for 150 end-users.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Udruga "Putevi milosti" pripremila je projekt u trajanju od 36 mjeseci, dok će pružanje usluga pripadnicima ciljne skupine trajati 30 mjeseci. Cilj je projekta poboljšanje kvalitete života starije životne dobi te osoba s invaliditetom kroz podizanje kvalitete zdravlja, povećanje socijalne uključenosti kao i sprečavanje njihove rane institucionalizacije. Projektom će se zaposliti 25 osoba koje će pružati usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština u kući za 150 krajnjih korisnika.

Operation_Name_English: Make a wish and make it happen together
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi i ostvarimo zajedno
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim is to enable social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups in the territory of the municipality through long-term care for a carefully selected number of users. 17 service, support and support providers will be recruited, and packages will be procured, covering 102 beneficiaries, persons belonging to vulnerable groups, i.e. 65+ persons and adults with disabilities. Services will be provided for 34 months, and the project will last a total of 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je omogućiti socijalnu uključenost i prevenirati institucionalizaciju ranjivih skupina na području općine kroz dugotrajnu skrb za pažljivo odabrani broj korisnika. Zaposlit će se 17 pružatelja usluge, potpore i podrške te će se nabaviti paketi i obuhvatiti 102 korisnika, pripadnika ranjivih skupina odnosno osobe 65+ i odrasle osobe s invaliditetom. Usluge će se pružati 34 mjeseca, a projekt će trajati ukupno 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a firehouse
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja vatrogasnog doma
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: fires (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community
Operation_Summary_English: The project will improve the conditions of accommodation and operation of the operational civil protection forces in the area of the City of Cres with the aim of increasing the level of safety and protection of persons and property of the island community. With the construction of the new firehouse, project partners and the local community will also have new premises for holding meetings and lectures for larger groups of people. The new facility will have sufficient capacity to accommodate all equipment currently used by civil protection, which will enable its better storage and maintenance, and thus extend its useful life. Better housing conditions for troops on standby for possible operational action on the ground will allow to increase their reaction speed and efficiency.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se unaprijediti uvjeti smještaja i rada operativnih snaga civilne zaštite na području Grada Cresa s ciljem povećanja razine sigurnosti te zaštite osoba i imovine otočne zajednice. Izgradnjom novog vatrogasnog doma projektni partneri i lokalna zajednica imat će na raspolaganju i nove prostore za održavanje sastanaka i predavanja za veće skupine ljudi. Novi objekt imat će dovoljne kapacitete za smještaj cjelokupne opreme koju civilna zaštita trenutno koristi što će omogućiti njeno kvalitetnije skladištenje i održavanje, a samim time i produljenje njenog uporabnog vijeka. Bolje uvjeti smještaja postrojbi koje su u pripravnosti za moguće operativno djelovanje na terenu, omogućit će povećanje brzine njihove reakcije i učinkovitost.

Operation_Name_English: Social plan of Brod-Posavina County for the period 2024-2026
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalni plan Brodsko-posavske županije za razdoblje 2024.-2026. godine
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The Social Plan BPŽ for the period 2024-2026 will provide support to the JRS in the preparation of the county social plan and will empower members of the Social Welfare Council and employees of the BPŽ in the field of social planning, implementation and monitoring of the county social plan, which will be prepared as a strategic document within this project, and which will contribute to increasing the availability and even regional development of social services at the level of the Republic of Croatia.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Socijalni plan BPŽ za razdoblje 2024.-2026. godine pružit će se podrška JRS u izradi županijskog socijalnog plana i osnažit će se članovi Savjeta za socijalnu skrb i djelatnici BPŽ u području socijalnog planiranja, provedbe i praćenja županijskog socijalnog plana koji će se kao strateški dokument izraditi u okviru ovog projekta, a kojim će se na razini RH doprinijeti povećanju dostupnosti i ravnomjernom regionalnom razvoju socijalnih usluga.

Operation_Name_English: HUP Connect: Social partnership for the future of business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: HUP Connect: Socijalno partnerstvo za budućnost poslovanja
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The HUP Connect project is aimed at strengthening the capacity of HUP employees, improving traditional, existing services, modernising and developing new digital and green services, and strengthening social dialogue. The aim of the project is to help membership in facing the challenges of modern business. The project improves the old, develops new services that provide CEA members with the opportunity to educate, exchange information, organize events and access digital tools. The project brings together the best of traditional services and innovative digital solutions and contributes to the modernisation, relevance and sustainability of HUP. Traditional services remain the foundation, while new ones expand capacities and respond faster and better to the challenges of modern business.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt HUP Connect usmjeren je na jačanje kapaciteta zaposlenika HUP-a, unapređenje tradicionalnih, postojećih usluga, modernizaciju i razvoj novih digitalnih i zelenih usluga, te jačanje socijalnog dijaloga. Cilj je projekta pružiti pomoć članstvu u suočavanju s izazovima modernog poslovanja. Kroz projekt se unapređuju stare, razvijaju nove usluge koje članovima HUP-a pružaju mogućnost edukacije, razmjenu informacija, organizaciju događanja i pristup digitalnim alatima. Projekt spaja najbolje iz tradicionalnih usluga i inovativnih digitalnih rješenja i pridonosi modernizaciji, relevantnosti i održivosti HUP-a. Tradicionalne usluge ostaju temelj, a nove proširuju kapaciteta te brže i kvalitetnije odgovaraju na izazove modernog poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Inclusion one step closer to a barrier-free society Phase V
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inkluzija korak bliže društvu bez prepreka faza V
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Inclusion One Step Closer to the Barrier-Free Society Phase V" in the 36 months of implementation of the project for students with disabilities (primary and secondary schools in Zadar County) will provide teaching assistants and professional communication mediators who will provide children with the opportunity to become and remain active and equal members of the school community and society despite the difficulties. Also, teaching assistants and professional communication mediators will be provided with the opportunity to enter the labour market and improve their knowledge and skills. Highlighting the positive examples provided by the model of inclusive education provides an opportunity to take another step closer to a society without obstacles and prejudices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Inkluzija korak bliže društvu bez prepreka faza V“ u 36 mjeseci provedbe projekta za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju (osnovne i srednje škole u Zadarskoj županiji) osigurat će se pomoćnici u nastavi i stručni komunikacijski posrednici koji će tijekom trajanja školske godine djeci pružiti mogućnost da unatoč teškoćama postanu i ostanu aktivni i ravnopravni članovi školske zajednice i društva. Također, pomoćnicima u nastavi i stručnim komunikacijskim posrednicima pružit će se mogućnost uključivanja na tržište rada, te unaprjeđivanje njihovih znanja i vještina. Isticanjem pozitivnih primjera koje pruža model inkluzivnog obrazovanja pruža se prilika za još jedan korak bliže društvu bez prepreka i predrasuda.

Operation_Name_English: Desires in Koška Municipality – Phase IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi u Općini Koška – faza IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of this project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care in the Koška municipality for 156 beneficiaries. The main activities of this project are: the employment of 26 women to support and support 156 beneficiaries in their daily lives for older persons with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha ovog projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguranje dugotrajne skrbi na području općine Koška za 156 korisnika. Glavne aktivnosti ovog projekta su: zapošljavanje 26 žena u svrhu pružanja potpore i podrške za 156 korisnika u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama s invaliditetom.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a kindergarten in Ivanovec
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja dječjeg vrtića u Ivanovcu
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: In the municipality of Antunovac, the problem of the lack of adequate infrastructure conditions for the implementation of early childhood education and care was recorded. The project will provide infrastructure conditions in the area of the village of Ivanovac, where there is currently no kindergarten facility. Through the construction and equipping of a kindergarten with 3 day stays, of which 1 day stay for the nursery group and 2 day stays for the kindergarten group, an additional capacity of 52 places will be built for kindergarten children in the municipality of Antunovac and enable families to achieve a work-life balance, which will also contribute to raising the standard of living and quality of life in the local community, i.e. achieving the set goals of this project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Na području Općine Antunovac evidentiran je problem nedostatka adekvatnih infrastrukturnih uvjeta za provedbu ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja. Projektom će se osigurati infrastrukturni uvjeti na području naselja Ivanovac, gdje trenutno ne postoji objekt dječjeg vrtića. Kroz izgradnju i opremanje područnog vrtića s 3 dnevna boravka, od čega 1 dnevni boravak za jasličku skupinu te 2 dnevna boravka za vrtićku skupinu, izgradit će se dodatni kapaciteti od 52 mjesta za djecu vrtićke dobi na području Općine Antunovac te omogućiti obiteljima postizanje ravnoteže između poslovnog i privatnog života, što će ujedno doprinijeti podizanju životnog standarda i kvalitete života u lokalnoj zajednici tj. ostvarenju zadanih ciljeva ovoga projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the parasport system in the Republic of Croatia
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje sustava parasporta u Republici Hrvatskoj
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase the social inclusion of persons with disabilities by participating in parasport activities. The specific objectives of the project are: 1. Strengthening the capacity of coaches and instructors (employees of clubs / federations that are members of the HPO) through their professional training and education with the aim of conducting practical trainings and activities with PWD and children with developmental disabilities; 2. Improving access to parasport facilities for persons with disabilities and children with disabilities. Project activities: 1. Training of professionals to work with OSI and children with disabilities (education of 44 trainers) 2. Implementation of 6336 parasport trainings intended for 400 OSI and children with disabilities 3. Communication and visibility 4. Project management.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti osoba s invaliditetom sudjelovanjem u parasportskim aktivnostima. Specifični ciljevi projekta su: 1. Jačanje kapaciteta trenera i instruktora (zaposlenika klubova/saveza koji su članice HPO-a) kroz njihovo stručno usavršavanje i edukacije s ciljem provođenja praktičnih treninga i aktivnosti s OSI i djecom s teškoćama u razvoju; 2. Poboljšanje pristupa parasportskim sadržajima osobama s invaliditetom i djeci s teškoćama u razvoju. Projektne aktivnosti: 1. Usavršavanje stručnjaka za rad s OSI i djecom s teškoćama u razvoju (edukacija 44 trenera) 2. Provedba 6336 parasportskih treninga namijenjenih 400 OSI i djece s teškoćama u razvoju 3. Komunikacija i vidljivost 4. Upravljanje projektom.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of the management system in SENAPLAST
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja u SENAPLAST
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The Senaplasta project aims to increase revenue and ensure export competitiveness through the introduction of management systems according to ISO 14001 and ISO 45001. These two management systems will be the main result of the project, enabling Senaplast to meet the requirements of internationally recognised environmental and occupational safety standards. With their introduction, the company will strengthen customer confidence, increase the quality of services and achieve easier access to international markets. This result contributes to the purpose of the call by increasing the competitiveness of SMEs and compliance with standards that foster quality, safety and sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Senaplasta ima za cilj povećati prihode i osigurati izvoznu konkurentnost kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema ISO 14001 i ISO 45001. Ova dva sustava upravljanja bit će osnovni rezultat projekta, omogućujući Senaplastu da ispuni zahtjeve međunarodno priznatih standarda u pogledu zaštite okoliša i sigurnosti na radu. Njihovim uvođenjem tvrtka će ojačati povjerenje kupaca, povećati kvalitetu usluga te ostvariti lakši pristup međunarodnim tržištima. Ovaj rezultat doprinosi svrsi poziva kroz povećanje konkurentnosti MSP-ova i usklađenost s normama koje potiču kvalitetu, sigurnost i održivost.

Operation_Name_English: Project for improvement of non-building flood risk management measures in the Republic of Croatia - VEPAR - Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Projekt unaprjeđenja negrađevinskih mjera upravljanja rizicima od poplava u Republici Hrvatskoj - VEPAR - Faza 2
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: floods and landslides (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)

Operation_Name_English: the Social Dialogue Against STRADITION
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalnim dijalogom protiv ŠTRAJKA
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project Social Dialogue against STRAJKA is aimed at strengthening trade union commissioners, networking and improving the Tiger Trade Union business through digitization and development of new and improvement of existing services for members. The aim of the project is to improve the working and material conditions of the members of the Union, to enable better protection of workers' rights and to increase the quality of trade union activity. The implementation of the project is expected to strengthen the professional and business competences of the members of the Union, increase its visibility and attractiveness for new members and contribute to the development of social dialogue in Croatia. The project is based on the experience of the Tiger Trade Union in the successful implementation of similar EU projects and responds to the identified needs of membership and the wider community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Socijalnim dijalogom protiv ŠTRAJKA usmjeren je na osnaživanje sindikalnih povjerenika, umrežavanje i unapređenje poslovanja Sindikata Tiger kroz digitalizaciju i razvoj novih i unaprjeđenje postojećih usluga za članove. Cilj projekta je poboljšati radne i materijalne uvjete članova Sindikata, omogućiti bolju zaštitu prava radnika te povećati kvalitetu sindikalnog djelovanja. Provedbom projekta očekuje se jačanje stručnih i poslovnih kompetencija članova Sindikata, povećanje njegove vidljivosti i atraktivnosti za nove članove te doprinos razvoju socijalnog dijaloga u Hrvatskoj. Projekt se temelji na iskustvu Sindikata Tiger u uspješnoj realizaciji sličnih EU projekata i odgovara na identificirane potrebe članstva i šire zajednice.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of the management system in the company UVID d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja u tvrtku UVID d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The problem of the company is the non-compliance of the current business with the requirements of the market, which requires the establishment and further continuation of cooperation by introducing certificates. Their introduction is necessary for further business improvement, and competitive and sustainable growth and development of the company. By introducing ISO certification, the company will improve competitiveness and market position, because business processes will be defined and controlled. In this way, services will be required and of uniform quality in accordance with environmental standards. In this way, the company will control and maintain the quality, safety and reliability of its products as well as the overall business, and will successfully expand into the EU market. Target groups are existing and potential clients.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Problem tvrtke je neusklađenost trenutnog poslovanja sa zahtjevima tržišta koji uvjetuje uspostavljanje i daljnji nastavak suradnje uvođenjem certifikata. Njihovo uvođenje je nužno za daljnje unaprjeđenje poslovanja, te konkurentan i održiv rast i razvoj tvrtke. Uvođenjem ISO certifikata tvrtka će unaprijediti konkurentnost i tržišni položaj, jer će poslovni procesi biti definirani i kontrolirani. Time će usluge biti zahtijevane i ujednačene kvalitete u skladu s ekološkim standardima. Na taj način će tvrtka kontrolirati i održavati kvalitetu, sigurnost i pouzdanost svojih proizvoda kao i cjelokupnog poslovanja, te će se uspješno proširiti na EU tržištu. Ciljne skupine su postojeći i potencijalni klijenti.

Operation_Name_English: Green Infrastructure Network: Parks Gradac, Pile and Platana
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mreža zelene infrastrukture: parkovi Gradac, Pile i Platana

Operation_Summary_English: Green Infrastructure Network: Parks Gradac, Pile and Platana - is a project in which green infrastructure measures are integrated into the urban space. The project will contribute to the formation of a green view of the city, arranging the environment and neglected spaces, which will contribute to the green urban renewal and the expansion of the network of green spaces, creating an example for the implementation of measures for the development of green infrastructure in the wider area of the UP. Also, the arrangement of content in the area of parks makes an important initiative for the development of socio-cultural content that will enable the implementation of programs of social, cultural and entertainment topics, as content for the benefit of the local community, thus ensuring the expansion of the tourist offer in the wider area of the UP.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Mreža zelene infrastruktura: parkovi Gradac, Pile i Platana - čini projekt u kojem se mjere zelene infrastrukture integriraju u urbani prostor. Projekt će doprinijeti formiranju zelene vizure grada, uređenju okoliša i zapuštenih prostora, čime će se dati doprinos zelenoj urbanoj obnovi i širenju mreže zelenih prostora, stvarajući primjer za implementaciju mjera razvoja zelene infrastrukture na širem prostoru UP-a. Također, uređenje sadržaja na području parkova čini važnu inicijativu razvoja društveno-kulturnih sadržaja koji će omogućiti odvijanje programa društvene, kulturne i zabavne tematike, kao sadržaja na dobrobit lokalne zajednice, osiguravajući na taj način i proširenje turističke ponude na širem prostoru UP-a.

Operation_Name_English: I-STEM - Synergies for STEM development in Istria
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: I-STEM - Sinergijom do razvoja STEM-a u Istri
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project I-STEM - Synergies to STEM development aims to improve the capacity of the Istrian County Technical Culture Community, strengthen cooperation with the Istrian Polytechnic, 2 primary and 3 secondary schools from the Istrian County and implement activities aimed at promoting STEM among children and students in the Istrian County. The project envisages the implementation of 332 workshops for a total of 600 children and students and the organization of 28 events with the aim of promoting STEM areas for children and students in public places. The target groups of the project are the Association of Technical Culture of the Istrian County as an important stakeholder for the popularization of STEM areas among children and students with the aim of social inclusion in the context of the educational sector, as well as children and students from the Istrian County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt I-STEM - Sinergijom do razvoja STEM-a ima za cilj unaprjeđenje kapaciteta Zajednice tehničke kulture Istarske županije, jačanje suradnje s Istarskim veleučilištem, 2 osnovne i 3 srednje škole iz Istarske županije te provedbu aktivnosti s ciljem promocije STEM-a među djecom i učenicima u Istarskoj županiji. Projektom je predviđena provedba 332 radionice za ukupno 600 djece i učenika te organizacija 28 događanja s ciljem promocije STEM područja za djecu i učenike na javnim mjestima. Ciljne skupine projekta su Zajednica tehničke kulture Istarske županije kao važan dionik za popularizaciju STEM područja među djecom i učenicima s ciljem socijalnog uključivanja u kontekstu obrazovnog sektora te djeca i učenici iz Istarske županije.

Ciljne skupine projekta uključuju: 1) proizvodni odjel, koji će imati koristi od optimizacije proizvodnih procesa, 2) upravu poduzeća, koja će imati bolji uvid u efikasnost i rezultate proizvodnje, te 3) odjel za razvoj i tehnologiju, koji će sudjelovati u implementaciji novih tehnoloških rješenja. Projekt će također doprinositi podizanju konkurentnosti i energetske učinkovitosti.

Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 96 starijih osoba od 65 godina i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom što će pridonijeti njihovoj većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguravanju prava na život u zajednici. Glavna aktivnost je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština što uključuje zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za min 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija i provedba radionica na temu podizanja svijesti za suzbijanje svih oblika diskriminacije.

Operation_Name_English: Požega-Slavonia County Social Plan
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalni plan Požeško-slavonske županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: The project will develop a county social plan and strengthen the capacities of experts, which will contribute to the plants' understanding and meeting the needs of socially vulnerable groups and improve the system of providing social services in the county. These objectives will be achieved by implementing the following activities: - the entire process of drafting the county social plan - educational activities for members of the Social Welfare Council and county officials
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se izraditi županijski socijalni plan te ojačati kapaciteti stručnjaka što će doprinijeti biljem razumijevanju i zadovoljenju potreba socijalno osjetljivih skupina i unaprijediti sustav pružanja socijalnih usluga na području županije. Navedeni će se ciljevi postići provedbom sljedećih aktivnosti: - cjelokupan proces izrade socijalnog plana županije - edukativne aktivnosti za članove Savjeta za socijalnu skrb i službenike županije

Operation_Name_English: Bicycle trails and promenade system Dugi Rat
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sustav biciklističkih staza i šetnice Dugi Rat
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘System of Bicycle Trails and Promenade Dugi Rat’ refers to the activities of constructing and equipping a walking and cycling trail in the length of 2884m, from the Bracera tavern in Dugi Rat to Camp Galeb in Omiš, all in the territory of the municipality of Dugi Rat. The project represents a significant step towards improving infrastructure for cyclists and pedestrians and ensuring greater traffic safety for all participants. The project encourages the reduction of car dependency, walking and the use of bicycles, reduces environmental pressures and provides better living and movement conditions. At the same time, adapted infrastructure for persons with reduced mobility ensures inclusiveness and accessibility of space, making the community more progressive and equitable.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Sustav biciklističkih staza i šetnice Dugi Rat“ odnosi se na aktivnosti izgradnje i opremanja pješačke i biciklističke staze u dužini od 2884m, od konobe Bracere u Dugom Ratu do kampa Galeb u Omišu, a sve na području općine Dugi Rat. Projekt predstavlja značajan korak prema unaprjeđenju infrastrukture za bicikliste i pješake te osiguranju veće sigurnosti u prometu za sve sudionike. Projektom se potiče smanjenje ovisnosti o automobilima, hodanje i korištenje bicikala, smanjuje se pritisak na okoliš i pružaju se bolji uvjeti za život i kretanje. Istovremeno, prilagođena infrastruktura osobama smanjene pokretljivosti osigurava inkluzivnost i dostupnost prostora, što čini zajednicu progresivnijom i pravednijom.

Operation_Name_English: Our help - your support
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Naša pomoć - vaša podrška
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide quality support and support services to the most vulnerable groups of rural areas and the city of Koprivnica, the elderly and OSI, thus increasing their social inclusion, quality of life and access to social services while preventing their institutionalization, enabling them to stay in their own home and live in the community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružiti kvalitetnu uslugu potpore i podrške najranjivijim skupinama ruralnih područja i grada Koprivnice, starijim osobama i OSI te na taj način povećati njihovu socijalnu uključenost, kvalitetu života i pristup socijalnim uslugama istovremeno sprečavajući njihovu institucionalizaciju, omogućujući im ostanak u vlastitom domu i život u zajednici.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of the existing track and construction of the second track on the section Hrvatski Leskovac-Karlovac on the railway line M202 Zagreb Gk-Rijeka - Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija postojećeg i izgradnja drugog kolosijeka na dionici Hrvatski Leskovac-Karlovac na željezničkoj pruzi M202 Zagreb Gk–Rijeka – 2. faza
Category_Label: Reconstructed or modernised railways - TEN-T core network
Operation_Summary_English: The project relates to the reconstruction of the existing and the construction of the second track on the section Hrvatski Leskovac-Karlovac with a length of 44.02 km on the railway line M202 Zagreb Gk-Rijeka. The project, in addition to the reconstruction and upgrading of the railway track, includes the reconstruction of the station, electric substation, individual RUCs, bridges, viaducts and other facilities, stops, conversion of the station into stops, installation of an electronic SS device, ETCS level 1 and a control-command infrastructure subsystem with remote control of external elements, electrification with 25 kV/50 Hz system, construction of underpasses and overpasses, new vault roads to abolish existing RUCs, construction of noise protection walls and a closed drainage system.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se odnosi na rekonstrukciju postojećeg i izgradnju drugog kolosijeka na dionici Hrvatski Leskovac-Karlovac duljine od 44,02 km na željezničkoj pruzi M202 Zagreb Gk-Rijeka. Projekt, osim rekonstrukcije i dogradnje željezničkog kolosijeka, uključuje rekonstrukciju kolodvora, elektrovučne podstanice, pojedinih ŽCP-a, mostova, vijadukata i ostalih objekata, stajališta, prenamjenu kolodvora u stajališta, ugradnju elektroničkog SS uređaja, ETCS razine 1 te prometno–upravljačkog infrastrukturnog podsustava sa daljinskog kontrolom vanjskih elemenata, elektrifikaciju sustavom 25 kV/50 Hz, izgradnju podvožnjaka i nadvožnjaka, novih svodnih cesta radi ukidanja postojećih ŽCP-a, izgradnju zidova zašite od buke i zatvorenog sustava odvodnje.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction and upgrading of the primary breakwater in the port of Novi Vinodolski with the landscaping of the ‘Podbaran’ coast
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija i dogradnja primarnog lukobrana u luci Novi Vinodolski uz parterno uređenje obale „Podbaran“
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The Port Authority of Novi Vinodolski, in partnership with the City of Novi Vinodolski, is implementing a project to reconstruct and upgrade the primary breakwater in the port of Novi Vinodolski, with the partership of the ‘Podbaran’ coastline, with the aim of protecting the port’s waters from dominant winds and rising sea levels, in order to ensure the safety of connections and the wider coastal area in all weather conditions and to increase the capacity of utility berths. The project contributes to the economic development of the city of Novi Vinodolski, bringing benefits primarily to the users of port services and the local community. The total value of the Project is estimated at 16,855,810,73€, of which the Port Authority and the City jointly bear 1,334,395,31€ of ineligible costs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Lučka uprava Novi Vinodolski u partnerstvu s Gradom Novi Vinodolski provodi projekt rekonstrukcije i dogradnje primarnog lukobrana u luci Novi Vinodolski uz parterno uređenje obale „Podbaran“, a s ciljem zaštite akvatorija luke od dominantnih vjetrova i rasta razine mora kako bi se omogućila sigurnost veza i šireg obalnog područja u svim vremenskim uvjetima te povećali kapaciteti komunalnih vezova. Projekt doprinosi gospodarskom razvoju grada Novog Vinodolskog donoseći korist prije svega korisnicima usluga luke i lokalnoj zajednici. Ukupna vrijednost Projekta procjenjuje se na 16.855.810,73€, od čega Lučka uprava i Grad zajednički snose 1.334.395,31€ neprihvatljivih troškova.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of BS in the village of Vuka
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja BS u naselju Vuka
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes the construction of a bicycle walking path within the village of Vuka by the steam side of Osječka Street, at k.č.br. 867,865,923,922,68/18,998/2 and 985/2, all in k.o, Vuka, with a total length of 2770.49 meters, which will be functional as an independent unit after completion and for the same will be obtained a use permit. As part of the project, a pedestrian-cycling bridge is being built across the Vuka River. In one part of the route, the existing walking trail is extended by the asphalt section in order to function as a cycling hiking trail, while the rest of the mentioned section is planned to build cycling hiking trails in full profile.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom je obuhvaćena izgradnja biciklističko pješačke staze unutar naselja Vuka parnom stranom Osječke ulice i to na k.č.br. 867,865,923,922,68/18,998/2 i 985/2, sve u k.o, Vuka, ukupne duljine 2770,49 metara, koja će nakon završetka biti funkcionalna kao samostalna cjelina i za istu će se ishoditi uporabna dozvola. U sklopu projekta gradi se i pješačko-biciklistički most preko rijeke Vuke. U jednom dijelu trase postojeća pješačka staza se proširuje asfaltnim dijelom kako bi funkcionirala kao biciklističko pješačka staza, dok se na ostatku navedene dionice planira gradnja biciklističko pješačkih staza u punom profilu.

Operation_Name_English: Call for STEM!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pozvoni za STEM!
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Association Zvončići in partnership with Polytechnic of Karlovac, Primary School Slunj, Primary School Antun Klasinc Lasinja, Primary School Seljan from Karlovac and Kindergarten Duga Resa is implementing the project "Balls for STEM!". The aim of the project is to promote STEM as an interdisciplinary approach among students and children and to strengthen the capacity of partners to implement STEM activities with children. The promotion of STEM among children and students will be realized through the implementation of workshops in Karlovac County and 12 public events in 10 Croatian counties. Empowerment of the Zvončići association and project partners will be achieved through study visits and conferences/seminars, as well as through training and mentoring by experts from the Karlovac Polytechnic.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Udruga Zvončići u partnerstvu s Veleučilištem u Karlovcu, Osnovnom školom Slunj, OŠ Antun Klasinc Lasinja, OŠ braće Seljan iz Karlovca te Dječjim vrtićem Duga Resa provodi projekt "Pozvoni za STEM!" . Cilj projekta je promocija STEM-a kao interdisciplinarnog pristupa među učenicima i djecom te osnaživanje kapaciteta partnera za provedbu STEM aktivnosti s djecom. Promocija STEM-a među djecom i učenicima bit će realizirana kroz provedbu radionica na području Karlovačke županije te 12 javnih događaja u 10 hrvatskih županija. Osnaživanje udruge Zvončići te partnera na projektu bit će ostvareno kroz studijske posjete i konferencije/seminare te izobrazbe i proces mentoriranja od strane stručnjaka s Veleučilišta u Karlovcu.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction and equipping of the City Library and Reading Room Virovitica
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija i opremanje Gradske knjižnice i čitaonice Virovitica
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Reconstruction and equipping of the City Library and Reading Room Virovitica" is planned to upgrade the library and equip it, introduce digitalisation in work and business, install renewable energy sources, all with the purpose of increasing accessibility and participation in the cultural life of all citizens, especially vulnerable groups and creating preconditions for the development of innovative services in culture. The aim of the project is to contribute to the informational, cultural, educational, economic, touristic development of the city of Virovitica and the wider community with the quality of its sources and services. The target groups of the project are visitors, members and employees of the City Library and Reading Room Virovitica, members of vulnerable groups and residents of the city of Virovitica and its surroundings.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Rekonstrukcija i opremanje Gradske knjižnice i čitaonice Virovitica" planira se nadogradnja knjižnice i opremanje, uvođenje digitalizacije u radu i poslovanju, ugradnja obnovljivih izvora energije, a sve sa svrhom povećanja pristupačnosti i sudjelovanju u kulturnom životu svih građana, osobito ranjivih skupina te stvaranje preduvjeta za razvoj inovativnih usluga u kulturi.
