Cilj projekta je kvalitetom svojih izvora i usluga doprinijeti informacijskom, kulturnom, obrazovnom, gospodarskom, turističkom razvoju grada Virovitice i šire zajednice. Ciljne skupine projekta su posjetitelji, članovi i zaposlenici Gradske knjižnice i čitaonice Virovitica, pripadnici ranjivih skupina te stanovnici grada Virovitice i šire okolice.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - Negoslavs - Phase IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi – Negoslavci - faza IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The 36-month project will employ 19 people on a 30-month contract to support at least 114 elderly and disabled people in the municipality of Negoslavci.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom u trajanju od 36 mjeseci zaposlit će se 19 osoba na ugovor od 30 mjeseci kako bi pružili podršku najmanje 114 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom na području općine Negoslavci.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a network of cycling infrastructure in the area of the city of Slavonski Brod - phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja mreže biciklističke infrastrukture na području grada Slavonskog Broda - faza II
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project "Building a network of cycling infrastructure in the area of the city of Slavonski Brod - phase 2" with a total value of 4.554.307.03 € will build a cycling infrastructure in the city in the length of 17.077.00 m, which will contribute to better connectivity on the daily migration lines in the urban area, reduction of pollutant emissions and increased safety of cyclists, but also other road users.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta "Izgradnja mreže biciklističke infrastrukture na području grada Slavonskog Broda - faza 2" ukupne vrijednosti 4.554.307,03 € izgraditi će se biciklistička infrastruktura u gradu u dužini 17.077,00 m što će doprinijeti boljoj povezanosti na linijama dnevnih migracija na urbanom području, smanjenju emisija onečišćujućih tvari te povećanoj sigurnosti biciklista, ali i ostalih sudionika u prometu.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of METALIS d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva METALIS d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal relates to the certification of 24 products of Metalis d.o.o., and relates to the following: 1. Certification of compliance according to DIN EN 61537 - 60 Tc/Sc 2 LK channel programme. Certification of conformity according to DIN EN 61537 — Cable carrier programme of channels and accessories 3. Certification of fire resistance of cable-specific route cable channels according to DIN EN 4102-12, program PKU Sc/Tc 4. Certification of fire resistance of cable-specific route cable channels according to DIN EN 4102-12, program PKU inoks
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni prijedlog se odnosi na certifikaciju 24 proizvoda tvrtke Metalis d.o.o., a odnosi se na sljedeće: 1. Certificiranje sukladnosti prema DIN EN 61537 – program LK kanala visine 60 Tc/Sc 2. Certificiranje sukladnosti prema DIN EN 61537 – program nosača kabel kanala i pribora 3. Certificiranje vatrootpornosti kabel-specifičnih trasa kabel kanala prema DIN EN 4102-12, program PKU Sc/Tc 4. Certificiranje vatrootpornosti kabel-specifičnih trasa kabel kanala prema DIN EN 4102-12, program PKU inoks

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of HILAND by introducing a management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti tvrtke HILAND uvođenjem sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of HILAND by strengthening internal capacities and introducing ISO 9001 and ISO 45 001 management systems into the business. The use of internationally recognised standards that demonstrate a level of quality and security in the exchange of goods and goods and contribute to customer confidence will facilitate access to the international market and increase the competitiveness of SMEs. This creates the preconditions for further growth and development of HILAND through an increase in sales revenue by 15% as well as an increase in export revenue by 15%. Target groups are existing and future employees, company management, and end users are clients and partners and the economy of the Republic of Croatia as a whole.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost tvrtke HILAND osnaživanjem internih kapaciteta i uvođenjem sustava upravljanja ISO 9001 i ISO 45 001 u poslovanje. Primjena međunarodno priznatih normi kojima se dokazuje razina kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni roba i dobara te pridonosi povjerenju kupaca olakšati će pristup međunarodnom tržištu i povećati konkurentnost MSP-ova. Navedenim se stvaraju preduvjeti za daljnji rast i razvoj tvrtke HILAND kroz povećanje prihoda od prodaje za 15% kao i rast prihoda od izvoza 15%. Ciljane skupine su postojeći i budući zaposlenici, menadžment tvrtke, a krajnji korisnici klijenti i partneri te gospodarstvo RH u cjelini.

Operation_Name_English: ITEO 2.0
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ITEO 2.0
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: ITEO 2.0 is a project that will improve the capacities of CSOs for the implementation of programs in the field of STEM and cooperation with higher education institutions and educational institutions and with new knowledge and skills to implement activities aimed at promoting STEM among children and students in the Međimurje County. Training and mentoring activities of employees/volunteers of CSOs by a higher education institution, attending trainings, study visits and participating in conferences and fairs will strengthen the capacities of CSOs so that they can then promote STEM areas through workshops with children and students and events in public places. The target groups of the project are CSOs in the project and children and students from the Međimurje County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: ITEO 2.0 je projekt kojim će se unaprijediti kapacitete OCD-ova za provedbu programa u području STEM-a te suradnja s visokim učilištem i odgojno-obrazovnim institucijama te s novim znanjima i vještinama provesti aktivnosti s ciljem promocije STEM-a među djecom i učenicima na području Međimurske županije. Aktivnostima izobrazbe i mentoriranja zaposlenika/volontera OCD-ova od strane visokog učilišta, pohađanjem izobrazbi, studijskim posjetama i sudjelovanjem na konferencijama i sajmovima ojačat će se kapaciteti OCD-ova kako bi zatim aktivnostima radionica s djecom i učenicima te eventima na javnim mjestima mogli promovirati STEM područja. Ciljne skupine projekta su OCD-ovi u projektu te djeca i učenici s područja Međimurske županije.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a bicycle path from Lug Street along Dr. Franjo Tuđman Street in Sveta Nedelja, phase 1
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističke staze od Ulice Lug uz Ulicu dr. Franje Tuđmana u Svetoj Nedelji, faza 1
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project of construction of a bicycle path from Lug Street along Dr. Franjo Tuđman Street in Sveta Nedelja includes the first phase of construction of a new two-way bicycle path in the length of 1.5 km and the accompanying municipal infrastructure, whose corridor will follow the existing main road to the City of Samobor. The result of the project (new cycling trail) is intended for public use by the inhabitants of the City of Sveta Nedelja and those who gravitate to it, and connecting various forms of transport acceptable for the environment in the UAZ area. The implementation of the project will further expand the existing cycling network, increase its quality, which will contribute to better connectivity on routes used for daily migration and greater use of public forms of transport.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt izgradnje biciklističke staze od Ulice Lug uz Ulicu dr. Franje Tuđmana u Svetoj Nedelji obuhvaća prvu fazu izgradnje nove dvosmjerne biciklističke staze u duljini 1,5 km i prateću komunalnu infrastrukturu, čiji će koridor pratiti postojeću glavnu prometnicu prema Gradu Samoboru. Rezultat projekta (nova biciklistička staza) namijenjen je javnoj uporabi od strane stanovnika Grada Sveta Nedelja i onih koji mu gravitiraju, te povezivanju raznih oblika prijevoza prihvatljivih za okoliš na području UAZ. Provedbom projekta postojeća biciklistička mreža će se dodatno razgranati, povećat će se njena kvaliteta, što će doprinijeti boljoj povezanosti na linijama koje služe za dnevne migracije i većem korištenju javnih oblika prijevoza.

Operation_Name_English: Support arm II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ruka podrške II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The problem of Šibenik-Knin County is the lack of adequate care for the elderly and people with disabilities. Through the "Hand of Assistance II" project, we plan to employ 20 women for a period of 30 months. The project will enable the provision of support and support to the elderly and people with disabilities. Employees will take care of 120 users. Activities of the project proposal are providing assistance in meeting basic living needs and support to the elderly and people with disabilities. The project provides non-institutional care and allows the target group to stay in their own home, thus contributing to a more dignified life of the target group and improving the quality of life.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Problem Šibensko-kninske županije predstavlja nepostojanje adekvatne skrbi za starije osobe i osobe s invaliditetom. Kroz projekt "Ruka pomoći II" planiramo zaposliti 20 žena na razdoblje 30 mjeseci. Projekt će omogućiti pružanje potpore i podrške starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Zaposlene osobe vodit će brigu o 120 korisnika. Aktivnosti projektnog prijedloga su pružanje pomoći u zadovoljavanju osnovnih životnih potreba i podršku starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Projekt osigurava izvaninstitucionalnu skrb i pruža ciljanoj skupini ostanak u vlastitom domu čime se pridonosi dostojanstvenijem življenju ciljane skupine te poboljšanju kvalitete života.

Operation_Name_English: Heart for the Elderly
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Srcem za starije
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The two main objectives of the project are to provide support and support services in everyday life for older persons and persons with disabilities and to prevent the institutionalization of older persons and persons with disabilities. We plan to hire 9 service providers to help the elderly in their home. Over a period of 33 months, service providers will improve the quality of life of end users through their work and activities, providing them with care and assistance in the home. Each employed person will provide support and support to at least six end-users. At the end of the project, we expect to reduce the long-term isolation of elderly and infirm people and increase their socialization and quality of life in their own household.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Dva glavna cilja projekta su pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom i sprečavanje institucionalizacije starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom. Na poslovima pomoći u kući starijim osobama namjeravamo zaposliti 9 pružatelja usluga. Pružatelji usluga u periodu od 33 mjeseca svojim će radom i aktivnostima poboljšati kvalitetu života krajnjim korisnicima pružajući im njegu i pomoć u kući. Svaka zaposlena osoba pružit će potporu i podršku za najmanje šest krajnjih korisnika. Po završetku projekta očekujemo smanjenje dugotrajne izoliranosti starijih i nemoćnih osoba te povećanje njihove socijalizacije i kvalitete života u vlastitom domaćinstvu.

Operation_Name_English: By assessing compliance and certification to increase the competitiveness of Lola Ribar d.d.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ocjenjivanjem sukladnosti i certifikacijom do povećanja konkurentnosti tvrtke Lola Ribar d.d.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The Applicant's project is aimed at increasing international competitiveness through product certification in accordance with the MDR 2017/745. The aim is to ensure that products comply with the MDR Regulation and the applicable harmonised standards for medical devices, thereby facilitating access to international markets and strengthening customer confidence. Planned activities include analysing existing systems and products, preparing the necessary documentation, improving the quality management system – ISO 13485:2016 and conducting internal and external audits. The expected results are the successful certification of medical devices in accordance with MDR 2017/745 , the increase of market share in foreign markets and the long-term improvement of business processes and sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Prijavitelja usmjeren je na povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti kroz certifikaciju proizvoda u skladu s Uredbom MDR 2017/745. Cilj je osigurati sukladnost proizvoda s MDR Uredbom te primjenjivim harmoniziranim standardima za medicinske proizvode, čime se olakšava pristup međunarodnim tržištima i jača povjerenje kupaca. Planirane aktivnosti uključuju analizu postojećih sustava i proizvoda, izradu potrebne dokumentacije, poboljšanje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom – ISO 13485:2016 te provođenje internih i eksternih audita. Očekivani rezultati su uspješna certifikacija medicinskih proizvoda sukladno uredbi MDR 2017/745 , povećanje tržišnog udjela na stranim tržištima te dugoročno poboljšanje poslovnih procesa i održivosti.

Operation_Name_English: Wishes on the island
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi na otoku
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The Zaželi project on the island will contribute to reducing the risk of social exclusion and preventing the institutionalization of elderly and disabled people from the area of the island municipalities of Pašman and Kali. The project contributes to social inclusion and improving the position of end users by providing them with assistance in carrying out their daily activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Zaželi na otoku doprinijet će se smanjenju rizika od socijalne isključenosti i prevenciji institucionalizacije starijih i nemoćnih osoba s područja otočkih općina Pašman i Kali. Projektom se doprinosi socijalnoj uključenosti te poboljšanju pozicije krajnjih korisnika na način da im se pruži pomoć u obavljanju svakodnevnih aktivnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of the company Primakon d.o.o. through certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti poduzeća Primakon d.o.o. kroz certifikaciju
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure the quality and safety of the Applicant's business in providing professional support and implementation of digital solutions to Clients through reaching the applicable level of internationally recognized ISO standard of information security management. The certification of the management system as a result of the project will ensure the objective and purpose of the project: achieve compliance of the Applicant with the NIS2 Directive as a supplier of key and important entities - entities subject to the application of measures from the Cyber Security Act (NN 14/24) and the Cyber Security Regulation (NN 135/24), increase the international competitiveness of the Applicant, increase exports and revenues.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguranje kvalitete i sigurnosti poslovanja Prijavitelja u pružanju stručne podrške i implementacije digitalnih rješenja Klijentima kroz dostizanje primjenjive razine međunarodno priznatog ISO standarda upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću. Predmetnom certifikacijom sustava upravljanja kao rezultatom projekta osigurat će se cilj i svrha projekta: postići usklađenost Prijavitelja s NIS2 Direktivom kao dobavljača ključnih i važnih subjekata - obveznika primjene mjera iz Zakona o kibernetičkoj sigurnosti (NN 14/24) i Uredbe o kibernetičkoj sigurnosti (NN 135/24), povećati međunarodna konkurentnost Prijavitelja, povećati izvoz i prihodi.

Operation_Name_English: By partnering for an active social dialogue for the future: Strengthening the capacity of trade union commissioners and developing new services for members
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Partnerstvom do aktivnog socijalnog dijaloga za budućnost: jačanje kapaciteta sindikalnih povjerenika i razvoj novih usluga za članove
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project is aimed at strengthening the capacity of two significant trade unions and developing new services for membership, with the aim of improving social dialogue, strengthening bargaining capacities and ensuring the sustainability of trade union structures. The project will implement training programs for trade union commissioners, networking activities and the development and modernisation of services for members. This will allow trade unions to have a stronger negotiating position, better adapt to social and market changes, and improve the quality of services and support to members. The project will result in strengthened capacities of social partners and directly contribute to the development of mutual dialogue and networking, while creating the preconditions for successful management of changes in the labour market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je usmjeren na jačanje kapaciteta dvaju značajnih sindikata i razvoj novih usluga za članstvo, s ciljem unaprjeđenja socijalnog dijaloga, jačanja pregovaračkih sposobnosti i osiguravanja održivosti sindikalnih struktura. Kroz Projekt će se provesti programi osposobljavanja sindikalnih povjerenika, aktivnosti umrežavanja te razvoj i modernizacija usluga za članove. To će omogućiti sindikatima snažniju pregovaračku poziciju, bolju prilagodbu društvenim i tržišnim promjenama te unaprjeđenje kvalitete usluga i podrške članovima. Projekt će rezultirati ojačanim kapacitetima socijalnih partnera i izravno doprinijeti razvoju međusobnog dijaloga i umrežavanja, uz stvaranje preduvjeta za uspješno upravljanje promjenama na tržištu rada.

Operation_Name_English: Every child has the right to education.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Svako dijete ima pravo na obrazovanje
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project actively works to create inclusive conditions for the education of children with developmental disabilities in school and in the community. The right of children with disabilities to an appropriate form of education is realized directly with the support of teaching assistants in primary schools. The project enables the employment of teaching assistants, financing their salaries and training. In the year 2023/24, 92 assistants were planned to be employed for 94 children. The project improves the growth and quality of life of children, their families and affects the positive climate in school and the community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se aktivno djeluje na stvaranje inkluzivnih uvjeta za školovanje djece s teškoćama u razvoju u školi i zajednici. Izravno se ostvaruje pravio djece s teškoćama u razvoju na primjeren oblik obrazovanja uz podršku pomoćnika u nastavi u osnovnom školama. Projekt omogućava zapošljavanje pomoćnika u nastavi, financiranje njihovih plaća i osposobljavanje. U šk. god 2023/24. planirano je zapošljavanje 92 pomoćnika za 94 djece. Projekt poboljšava odrastanje i kvalitetu života djece, njihovih obitelji te utječe na pozitivnu klimu u školi i zajednici.

Operation_Name_English: Karlovac County for Inclusive Schools
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Karlovačka županija za inkluzivne škole
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Students with developmental disabilities (n=61) who attend primary and secondary schools founded by Karlovac County and who are eligible for support under the Ordinance on PUN/CPC will be provided with support 58 PUN/CPC in the school year 2023/2024.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju (n=61) koji pohađaju osnovne i srednje škole kojima je osnivač Karlovačka županija, a ostvaruju pravo na potporu temeljem Pravilnika o PUN/SKP osigurat će se podrška 58 PUN/SKP u školskoj godini 2023./2024.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction and change of purpose of the existing polyclinic to the kindergarten (part of the building of the former barracks)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija i promjena namjene postojeće poliklinike u područni vrtić (dio zgrade bivše vojarne)
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project of reconstruction and change of purpose of the existing polyclinic to the regional kindergarten primarily addresses the problem of insufficient capacity for early and preschool education in the area of the City of Križevci. The aim of the project is to create spatial conditions for preschool education. The implementation of the project will open new capacities of pre-school education, which would reduce waiting lists, most of the children would be covered by the pre-school education system. The implementation of the project would establish 4 daily stays and accommodation for 80 children. The project affects the long-term sustainable development of the community because it will create spatial conditions for kindergarten education of preschool children, which will directly affect the retention of the younger population in the area of the City of Križevci.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt rekonstrukcije i promjene namjene postojeće poliklinike u područni vrtić primarno adresira problem nedovoljnih kapaciteta za rani i predškolski odgoj na području Grada Križevaca. Cilj projekta odnosi se na stvaranje prostornih uvjeta za predškolski odgoj. Provedbom projekta otvorit će se novi kapaciteti predškolskog odgoja čime bi se smanjile liste čekanja, veći dio djece bi bio obuhvaćen predškolskim sustavom obrazovanja. Provedbom projekta uspostavila bi se 4 dnevna boravka i smještaj 80 djece. Projekt utječe na dugoročni održivi razvoj zajednice jer će se stvoriti prostorni uvjeti za vrtićki odgoj predškolske djece čime će se direktno utjecati na zadržavanje mlađe populacije na području Grada Križevaca.

Operation_Name_English: Preparation and certification of the ISO standard Legit Software d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Priprema i certifikacija ISO standarda Legit Software d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Preparation and certification of the standards ISO 42001, ISO 27001 and ISO 27071 as part of the Legit sofware d.o.o. business will make it possible to prove the quality of business, improve business processes and ensure competitiveness in the domestic and foreign markets. The project will improve data protection, privacy and security management as well as compliance with international standards, increase customer trust and market expansion. Expected results include increased sales and export revenues, increased competitiveness and reduced business risks, and three introduced business process management systems.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Priprema i certifikacija standarda ISO 42001, ISO 27001 i ISO 27071 u sklopu poslovanja Legit sofware d.o.o. omogućit će dokazivanje kvalitete poslovanja, unapređenje poslovnih procesa i osiguranje konkurentnosti na domaćem i inozemnom tržištu. Projekt će poboljšati zaštitu podataka, privatnost i upravljanje sigurnošću kao i usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima, povećanje povjerenja klijenata i širenje tržišta. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza, rast konkurentnosti i smanjenje poslovnih rizik te tri uvedena sustava upravljanja poslovnim procesima.

Operation_Name_English: AgroAI 360: Automated, optimized and timely agricultural insights and decisions
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: AgroAI 360: Automatizirani, optimizirani i pravovremeni poljoprivredni uvidi i odluke
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: This project will develop tools for planning, managing and digitising agricultural production processes in combination with advanced tools based on AI technologies that will raise productivity and increase the competitiveness of agricultural production. Through the implementation of the planned R&D activities, the applicant and partners will develop globally innovative digital tools that will solve various specific problems faced by farmers and agricultural producers related to the use of resources, planning of production and production activities, the impact of weather on production and reducing the negative impact of agricultural production on the environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom razvit će se alati za planiranje, upravljanje i digitalizaciju procesa poljoprivredne proizvodnje u kombinaciji s naprednim alatima temeljenim na AI tehnologijama koji će podići produktivnost i povećati konkurentnost poljoprivredne proizvodnje. Prijavitelj i partneri će provedbom planiranih istraživačko-razvojnih aktivnosti razviti globalno inovativne digitalne alate koji će riješiti razne specifične probleme s kojim se susreću poljoprivrednici i poljoprivredni proizvođači a koji se odnose na korištenje resursa, planiranje proizvodnje i proizvodnih aktivnosti, utjecaj vremenskih prilika na proizvodnju i smanjenje negativnog utjecaja poljoprivredne proizvodnje na okoliš.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of VUPLAST d.o.o. according to ISO 13485 standard
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija tvrtke VUPLAST d.o.o. po ISO 13485 standardu
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Certification of the company VUPLAST d.o.o. according to the ISO 13485 standard" is designed to standardize production and improve the quality and safety of products in accordance with the ISO 13485:2016 standard, increase competitiveness and facilitate entry into international markets. By implementing a certified system, we achieve process standardisation, risk management optimization and continuous staff development through education, which ensures the sustainability of results. The project is in line with smart specialisations, fostering innovation, digitalisation and technological advancement in the health sector. This results in an increase in export and sales revenues, and thus in the long-term growth of Vuplast d.o.o. and a contribution to the protection of public health.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Certifikacija tvrtke VUPLAST d.o.o. po ISO 13485 standardu" osmišljen je za standardizaciju proizvodnje i unaprjeđenje kvalitete i sigurnosti proizvoda sukladno standardu ISO 13485:2016, povećanje konkurentnosti te lakši ulazak na međunarodna tržišta. Implementacijom certificiranog sustava postižemo standardizaciju procesa, optimizaciju upravljanja rizicima i kontinuirani razvoj kadrova putem edukacije, čime se osigurava održivost rezultata. Projekt je u skladu s pametnim specijalizacijama, potičući inovacije, digitalizaciju i tehnološko unapređenje u zdravstvenom sektoru. Time se ostvaruje povećanje prihoda od izvoza i prodaje, a time i dugoročni rast poduzeća Vuplast d.o.o. te doprinos zaštiti javnog zdravlja.

Operation_Name_English: Every child has the right to education.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Svako dijete ima pravo na obrazovanje
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project actively works to create inclusive conditions for the education of children with developmental disabilities in school and in the community. The right of children with disabilities to an appropriate form of education with the support of teaching assistants in primary schools is directly exercised. The project enables the employment of teaching assistants, financing their salaries and training. In 2024, 2025/26 and 2026/27, 102 assistants will be employed for 109 children in each school year. The project improves the growth and quality of life of children, their families and affects the positive climate in school and the community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se aktivno djeluje na stvaranje inkluzivnih uvjeta za školovanje djece s teškoćama u razvoju u školi i zajednici. Izravno se ostvaruje pravo djece s teškoćama u razvoju na primjeren oblik obrazovanja uz podršku pomoćnika u nastavi u osnovnim školama. Projekt omogućava zapošljavanje pomoćnika u nastavi, financiranje njihovih plaća i osposobljavanje. U šk.g. 2024/25., 2025/26 i 2026/27 zaposlit će se 102 pomoćnika za 109-ero djece u svakoj školskoj godini. Projekt poboljšava odrastanje i kvalitetu života djece, njihovih obitelji te utječe na pozitivnu klimu u školi i zajednici.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - Achievements II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - Ostvari II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: In the area of the city of Ilok (the settlements of Ilok, Šarengrad, Bapska and Mohovo) for 33 months will be implemented the activity of providing support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages with supplies to the elderly and adults with disabilities. Providing long-term care through household chores, parcel sharing and social support through conversation and socializing will increase social inclusion and prevent institutionalization for 180 older people and adults with disabilities, and 30 people/service providers will be employed to provide support and support services. The provision of support and support services to target groups contributes to ensuring the right to live in the community and to remain in one’s own home.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Na području grada Iloka (naselja Ilok, Šarengrad, Bapska i Mohovo) kroz 33 mjeseca će se provoditi aktivnost pružanja usluga potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa s potrepštinama starijim osobama i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom. Osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz obavljanje kućanskih poslova, podjelu paketa i socijalnu podršku razgovorom i druženjem povećat će se socijalna uključenost i prevenirati institucionalizacija za 180 starijih osoba i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom, a za pružanje usluga potpore i podrške zaposlit će se 30 osoba/pružatelja usluga. Pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške ciljnim skupinama pridonosi se osiguravanju prava na život u zajednici i ostanku u vlastitom domu.

Operation_Name_English: CERT 4 Charta
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: CERT 4 Charta
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the proposed project is to increase the international competitiveness of the company through the certification of internationally recognized standards and to create the preconditions for the further growth and development of Alpha Charta d.o.o.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha ovdje predloženog projekta jest povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost tvrtke kroz certifikaciju međunarodno priznatih normi te stvoriti pretpostavke za daljnji rast i razvoj poslovanja tvrtke Alpha Charta d.o.o. Ciljane skupine su tvrtka te njezini zaposlenici.

Operation_Name_English: DV GARDELIN, RIJEKA - Construction and equipping of institutions for preschool education (territory kindergarten with kitchen)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: DV GARDELIN, RIJEKA - Izgradnja i opremanje ustanove za predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje (područni vrtić s kuhinjom)
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project contributes to solving the problem of a large number of unregistered children of primary crèche age residing in the territory of the city of Rijeka through the construction and equipping of the preschool education institution - Gardelin Kindergarten. Currently, the PPO Gardelin kindergarten within the Rijeka Kindergarten is located at the location where the construction of this facility is planned. The existing facility is in a depressed state and no longer meets the needs of preschool education. Therefore, as the best option, the demolition of the existing facility and the construction of a completely new facility, appropriate to the modern principles of preschool education, was chosen. This project plans a facility with 7 upbringing groups, i.e. an increase of 3 groups compared to the existing one.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt doprinosi rješavanju problema velikog broja neupisane djece primarno jasličke dobi s prebivalištem na području grada Rijeke kroz izgradnju i opremanje ustanove predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja - Dječjeg vrtića Gardelin. Trenutno se na lokaciji na kojoj se planira izgradnja ovog objekta nalazi vrtić PPO Gardelin u sastavu Dječjeg vrtića Rijeka. Postojeći je objekt u derutnom stanju te više ne zadovoljava potrebe predškolskog odgoja. Stoga je kao najbolja opcija odabrano rušenje postojećeg objekta te izgradnja potpuno novog objekta, primjerenog suvremenim načelima predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja. Navedenim zahvatom planira se objekt sa 7 odgojnih skupina, odnosno povećanje za 3 skupine u odnosu na postojeći.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of Vinkovci Autumn Square in Vinkovci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija Trga Vinkovačkih jeseni u Vinkovcima
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure|Protection, development and promotion of public tourism assets and tourism services|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services|Physical regeneration and security of public spaces
Operation_Summary_English: The integrated project Reconstruction of Vinkovci Autumn Square in Vinkovci creates a new multifunctional, multifunctional open public space in the urban center that has a polycentric impact on the entire Urban area of Vinkovci and beyond. The project improves urban traffic and municipal infrastructure of the urban centre, and creates spatial prerequisites for innovative ways of interpreting, presenting and educating about the rich cultural and historical heritage of Vinkovci – the oldest city in Europe, thus enabling the improvement of various social events and numerous cultural events, some of which are national in character (Vinkovac Autumn).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Integriranim projektom Rekonstrukcija Trga Vinkovačkih jeseni u Vinkovcima stvora se novi višenamjenski, multifunkcionalni otvoreni javni prostor u urbanom središtu koji ima policentrični utjecaj na cijelo Urbano područje Vinkovci pa i šire. Projekt unapređuje gradski promet i komunalnu infrastrukturu urbanog središta, te stvara prostorne preduvjete za inovativne načine interpretacije, prezentacije i edukacije o bogatoj kulturno povijesnoj baštini Vinkovaca – najstarijeg grada u Europi, te time omogućava unapređenje različitih društvenih događanja i brojnih kulturnih manifestacija od kojih su neke nacionalnog karaktera (Vinkovačke jeseni).

Operation_Name_English: Hand in hand - Phase VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rukom pod ruku - faza VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to support the inclusion of 70 students with disabilities in primary education institutions in order to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning by employing 66 teaching assistants in nine primary schools in the city of Sisak. Partner schools will carry out a selection, and recruit and deploy assistants in direct work with students. The above indirectly affects the reduction of child poverty and contributes to the inclusion of students with disabilities in community life and the elimination of prejudice. All of the above helps to combat discrimination and social exclusion of children, and ensures inclusive education.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružiti potporu uključivanju 70 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje zapošljavanjem 66 pomoćnika u nastavi u devet osnovnih škola na području grada Siska. Škole partneri provesti će selekciju, te zaposliti i rasporediti pomoćnike u neposredan rad s učenicima. Gore navedeno posredno utječe na smanjenje dječjeg siromaštva i doprinosi uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u život u zajednici i eliminiranje predrasuda. Sve spomenuto pomaže u suzbijanju diskriminacije i socijalne isključenosti djece, te osigurava inkluzivan odgoj i obrazovanje.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a pedestrian-bike trail in Valpovačka Street in Bizovac
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja pješačko-biciklističke staze u Valpovačkoj ulici u Bizovcu
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to build a safe and accessible pedestrian-cycling trail in accordance with legal regulations that will improve connectivity in the municipality of Bizovac and other urban centres (UA Osijek), encourage sustainable mobility and promote a healthy lifestyle by encouraging cycling and walking as alternative and sustainable forms of transport. The 920-metre-long trail will be built and designed taking into account the needs of all target groups, including cyclists, pedestrians, people with disabilities and families with smaller children in a pram. Through this project, the aim is to influence the contribution of the local community in reducing emissions of harmful gases, encouraging physical activity and improving the quality of life of the local population.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgraditi sigurnu i pristupačnu pješačko-biciklističku stazu u skladu sa zakonskim propisima koja će poboljšati povezanost u općini Bizovac i drugim urbanim središtima (UA Osijek), potaknuti održivu mobilnost te promicati zdrav način života kroz poticanje biciklizma i pješačenja kao alternativnih i održivih oblika prijevoza. Staza u duljini 920 metara biti će izgrađena i dizajnirana uzimajući u obzir potrebe svih ciljnih skupina, uključujući bicikliste, pješake , osobe s invaliditetom te obitelji s manjom djecom u dječjim kolicima. Kroz ovaj projekt želi se utjecati na doprinos lokalne zajednice u smanjenju emisije štetnih plinova, poticanje fizičke aktivnosti te unaprjeđenje kvalitete života lokalnog stanovništva.

Operation_Name_English: Together to know with more elans V
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno do znanja uz više elana V
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Together to know with more than one element V" is planned to increase social inclusion and support the integration of 45 students with developmental difficulties who master the curriculum of the school they attend, but have difficulties that prevent them from functioning without teaching assistants in primary and secondary educational institutions founded by the Šibenik-Knin County through the employment of 45 teaching assistants in order to ensure conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning, which indirectly affects the reduction of child poverty.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Zajedno do znanja uz više elana V" planira se povećati socijalnu uključenost i podržati integraciju 45 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju koji svladavaju nastavni plan i program škole koju pohađaju, ali imaju teškoće koje ih sprečavaju u funkcioniranju bez pomoćnika u nastavi u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama kojima je osnivač Šibensko-kninska županija kroz zapošljavanje 45 pomoćnika u nastavi kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje što posredno utječe i na smanjenje dječjeg siromaštva.

Operation_Name_English: Two-spoke springs of the new generation
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dvokrake opruge nove generacije
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The ‘Next Generation Double Springs’ project aims to develop and implement innovative OptiFlex and DuraFlex double springs in line with the latest Industry 4.0 standards, including the implementation of advanced manufacturing technologies, automation and digitalisation through the development of a new production line. The results of the project will have a great contribution to solving the social challenges of Pannonian Croatia, the championship of the problem of depopulation, emigration, the development of the local labour market and insufficiently modernized production, especially in the metal processing industry, which is one of the priorities of the industrial transition of Pannonian Croatia. The project will be implemented in a consortium of 3 companies and in cooperation with the Faculty of Agrobiotechnical Sciences Osijek, which will implement
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Dvokrake opruge nove generacije“ ima za cilj razviti i implementirati inovativne dvokrake opruge OptiFlex i DuraFlex u skladu s najnovijim standardima Industrije 4.0, što uključuje implementaciju naprednih proizvodnih tehnologija, automatizacije i digitalizacije kroz razvoj nove proizvodne linije. Rezultati projekta će imati veliki doprinos rješavanju društvenih izazova Panonske Hrvatske prvenstvo problema depopulacije, iseljavanja, razvoja lokalnog tržišta rada i nedovoljno modernizirane proizvodnje, napose u metaloprerađivačkoj industriji, koja je jedan o prioriteta industrijske tranzicije Panonske Hrvatske. Projekt će se provoditi u konzorciju 3 poduzeća te suradnji s Fakultetom agrobiotehničkih znanosti Osijek koji će provesti

Operation_Name_English: Smart Start: Safe Steps to the World of AI
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pametni Start: Sigurni Koraci u Svijet AI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Smart Start - Safe Steps into the World of AI" aims to popularize STEM and artificial intelligence among children and young people. University North provides mentoring and training for employees and volunteers of the Blue Phone Association and the Croatian Deaf Sports Federation (HSSG). Blue Phone, as a project holder, manages the project, conducts workshops in primary schools and organizes public events to promote STEM. HSSG integrates children with hearing impairment into activities, while primary schools provide space and include students. The project includes education, mentoring program, workshops and public events, encouraging inclusion and practical learning.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Pametni Start - Sigurni Koraci u Svijet AI" ima za cilj popularizaciju STEM-a i umjetne inteligencije među djecom i mladima. Sveučilište Sjever osigurava mentoriranje i izobrazbu za zaposlenike i volontere Udruge Plavi Telefon i Hrvatskog sportskog saveza gluhih (HSSG). Plavi Telefon, kao nositelj projekta, upravlja projektom, provodi radionice u osnovnim školama i organizira javne događaje za promociju STEM-a. HSSG integrira djecu s oštećenjem sluha u aktivnosti, dok osnovne škole osiguravaju prostor i uključuju učenike. Projekt obuhvaća edukacije, mentorski program, radionice i javne događaje, potičući inkluzivnost i praktično učenje.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of Agilos IT d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija tvrtke Agilos IT d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The company AGILOS IT d.o.o. faces the problem of meeting clients' requests due to the inability to prove the quality and management of information security. The project aims to increase international competitiveness by strengthening its own capacities through the introduction of ISO 9001 and 27001 standards, which will facilitate access to the international market and increase the competitiveness of SMEs by applying internationally recognised standards that demonstrate the level of quality and information security, which contributes to customer confidence. This creates the preconditions for the growth of sales revenue by 15.5% and exports by 100%.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka AGILOS IT d.o.o. se suočava sa problemom zadovoljavanja zahtjeva klijenata zbog nemogućnosti dokazivanja kvalitete i upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću. Cilj je projekta povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti osnaživanjem vlastitih kapaciteta uvođenjem normi ISO 9001 i 27001 čime će se olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu i povećati konkurentnost MSP-ova primjenom međunarodno priznatih norma kojima se dokazuje razina kvalitete i informacijske sigurnosti što pridonosi povjerenju kupaca. Navedenim se stvaraju preduvjeti za rast prihoda od prodaje za 15,5% i izvoza za 100%.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a bicycle-pedestrian path in the village of Kunovec
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističko - pješačke staze u naselju Kunovec
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective of the project ‘Construction of a bicycle-pedestrian path in the village of Kunovec’ is to invest in the cycling infrastructure of the urban area of Koprivnica, i.e. the municipality of Koprivnički Ivanec, while the purpose of the project is to increase the use of zero-emission transport in the urban area of Koprivnica, i.e. the municipality of Koprivnički Ivanec. The main problem that this project aims to solve is the lack of cycling infrastructure, i.e. bicycle-pedestrian paths in the territory of the municipality of Koprivnički Ivanec and insufficient use of bicycles by the population of the municipality and beyond. The target group on which the project will have a direct and greatest impact is the population from the territory of the municipality of Koprivnički Ivanec.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta „Izgradnja biciklističko-pješačke staze u naselju Kunovec“ je ulaganje u biciklističku infrastrukturu urbanog područja Koprivnica, odnosno općine Koprivnički Ivanec dok je svrha projekta povećanje korištenja prijevoza s nultom razinom emisija u urbanom području Koprivnica, odnosno općini Koprivnički Ivanec. Glavni problem koji se ovim projektom želi riješiti je nedostatak biciklističke infrastrukture, odnosno biciklističko-pješačkih staza na području općine Koprivnički Ivanec te nedovoljno korištenje bicikla od strane stanovništva općine, a i šire. Ciljna skupina na koje će projekt imati izravan i najveći utjecaj je stanovništvo s područja općine Koprivnički Ivanec.

Operation_Name_English: I have time for myself!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Imam vrijeme za sebe!
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: Through the implementation of activities within this project, a total of 15 persons who have a recognised right to the status of parents of caregivers of children with disabilities and/or persons with disabilities will be provided with a rest from care. It will provide rest from the emotional and physical demands of day-to-day care and care for children with disabilities and/or persons with disabilities and will enable their inclusion in the life of the community and the prevention of institutionalization of those they care for. This will be made possible through the care of a household member who is dependent on the support of the caregiver's parents through three activities: "Care in my home", "Care in the premises of the Regoč Association" and through the activity "In a healthy body a healthy spirit".
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Kroz provedbu aktivnosti u okviru ovog projekta omogućit će se odmor od skrbi za ukupno 15 osoba koje imaju priznato pravo na status roditelja njegovatelja djece s teškoćama u razvoju i/ili osoba s invaliditetom. Osigurati će se odmor od emocionalnih i fizičkih zahtjeva koje nose svakodnevna skrb i briga za djecu s teškoćama u razvoju i/ili osobe s invaliditetom te će se omogućiti njihovo uključivanje u život zajednice i prevencija institucionalizacije onih o kojim skrbe. To će se omogućiti kroz skrb za člana kućanstva koji je ovisan o podršci roditelja njegovatelja kroz tri aktivnosti: "Skrb u mom domu", "Skrb u prostorima Udruge Regoč" i kroz aktivnost "U zdravom tijelu zdrav duh".

Operation_Name_English: Evoluta Gourmet Experience
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Evoluta Gourmet Experience
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The Evoluta Gourmet Experience project brings an innovative approach to eco-tourism with a focus on sustainability and local resources. It revitalizes the tourist experience in camps, vineyards and olive groves, offering culinary workshops that promote local ingredients and cultures. The aim is to develop a space dedicated to culinary and related workshops composed of multifunctional outdoor kitchens made of EvolutaCONCRETE and ecological materials, powered by a solar system. Activities include the development of 3 prototypes of EGE stages, digital platforms and EGE shows. Target groups are tourist companies, natural and legal persons and local communities. The project will result in innovation, increased revenues, number of employees and competitiveness of all consortium members.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Evoluta Gourmet Experience donosi inovativni pristup eko turističkoj ponudi s fokusom na održivost i lokalne resurse. Revitalizira turističko iskustvo u kampovima, vinogradima i maslinicima, nudeći kulinarske radionice koje promiču lokalne namirnice i kulture. Cilj je razvoj prostora namijenjenog kulinarskim i srodnim radionicama sastavljenog od višenamjenskih vanjskih kuhinja od EvolutaCONCRETE i ekoloških materijala, pogonjenih solarnim sustavom. Aktivnosti uključuju razvoj 3 prototipa EGE pozornica, digitalne platforme i EGE predstava. Ciljne skupine su turističke tvrtke, fizičke i pravne osobe i lokalne zajednice. Projekt će rezultirati inovacijama, povećanjem prihoda, broja zaposlenih i konkurentnosti svih članova konzorcija.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of the quality management system and information security management system of the company Synnefo sistem d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Implementacija sustava upravljanja kvalitetom i sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću poduzeća Synnefo sustavi d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Synnefo sistem d.o.o. is a specialized company that offers solutions in the field of cybersecurity and information infrastructure management with the aim of strengthening the security and efficiency of business systems. The company plans to comply with ISO 27001 as a necessary precondition for long-term sustainability and competitiveness, especially in the context of providing services to banks and government institutions. The implementation of the project, aimed at increasing security and compliance with regulations such as the DORA regulation, will be key to expanding business, reducing risks and strengthening customer confidence. ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certificates contribute to standardization, efficiency increase and cost reduction, i.e. increase the competitiveness of the Applicant on the market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Synnefo sustavi d.o.o. specijalizirano je poduzeće koje nudi rješenja u području kibernetičke sigurnosti i upravljanja informacijskom infrastrukturom s ciljem jačanja sigurnosti i učinkovitosti poslovnih sustava. Poduzeće planira usklađivanje s ISO 27001 kao nužnim preduvjetom za dugoročnu održivost i konkurentnost, osobito u kontekstu pružanja usluga bankama i državnim institucijama. Provedba projekta, usmjerenog na povećanje sigurnosti i usklađenost s regulativama poput DORA uredbe, bit će ključna za širenje poslovanja, smanjenje rizika i jačanje povjerenja klijenata. Certifikati ISO 27001 i ISO 9001 doprinose standardizaciji, povećanju učinkovitosti i smanjenju troškova, odnosno povećanju konkurentnosti Prijavitelja na tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 50001:2018 certification at Forte Solar d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija normi ISO 27001:2022 i ISO 50001:2018 u društvu Forte Solar d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Certification of standards ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 50001:2018 in the company Forte Solar d.o.o." is aimed at increasing the competitiveness of the company through the alignment of business with internationally recognized standards of information security and energy efficiency. By implementing ISO 27001, the company will ensure the protection of sensitive data, reduce cyber risks and strengthen customer confidence. ISO 50001 will enable systematic management of energy consumption, reduce operating costs and increase business sustainability. Certification will enable access to new markets, participation in tenders that require ISO standards and long-term business resilience in the renewable energy industry.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Certifikacija normi ISO 27001:2022 i ISO 50001:2018 u društvu Forte Solar d.o.o." usmjeren je na povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća kroz usklađivanje poslovanja s međunarodno priznatim standardima informacijske sigurnosti i energetske učinkovitosti. Implementacijom ISO 27001, poduzeće će osigurati zaštitu osjetljivih podataka, smanjenje kibernetičkih rizika i jačanje povjerenja klijenata. ISO 50001 omogućit će sustavno upravljanje potrošnjom energije, smanjenje operativnih troškova i povećanje održivosti poslovanja. Certifikacija će omogućiti pristup novim tržištima, sudjelovanje na natječajima koji zahtijevaju ISO standarde te dugoročnu otpornost poslovanja u industriji obnovljivih izvora energije.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of welding systems until business improvement
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem sustava zavarivanja do unapređenja poslovanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of certification of welding work quality system according to ISO 3834 and WPQR aims to ensure compliance with international standards, increase the competitiveness of ACROM d.o.o. and provide access to foreign markets. Activities include drafting technical documentation, certification, project management and promotion. Expected results are obtaining certificates, increasing exports and sales and ensuring financial sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt certificiranja sustava kvalitete zavarivačkih radova prema ISO 3834 i WPQR ima za cilj osigurati usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima, povećati konkurentnost tvrtke ACROM d.o.o. te omogućiti pristup stranim tržištima. Aktivnosti uključuju izradu tehničke dokumentacije, certificiranje, upravljanje projektom i promidžbu. Očekivani rezultati su dobivanje certifikata, povećanje izvoza i prodaje te osiguranje financijske održivosti.

Operation_Name_English: Microcosm of Inclusion
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mikrokozmos inkluzivnosti
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services for the daily life of the elderly and persons with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći je cilj projekta povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični je cilj pružanje usluge potpore i podrške svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom.

Operation_Name_English: ProgBlox - innovative solutions for early STEM development
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ProgBlox - inovativna rješenja za rani STEM razvoj
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal "ProgBlox - innovative solutions for early STEM development" " focuses on the transfer of professional and technical knowledge from the scientific research institution (FER) to didacta advance d.o.o. in the development of educational mobile robots for the youngest students. The implementation of the project will result in 3 new applicant products with improved technical capabilities and characteristics, which will consequently lead to an increase in sales revenue and business competitiveness.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni prijedlog "ProgBlox - inovativna rješenja za rani STEM razvoj" “ usmjeren je na transfer stručnih i tehničkih znanja iz znanstveno-istraživačke institucije (FER) poduzeću didacta advance d.o.o. u razvoju edukativnih mobilnih robota za najmlađe učenike. Provedba projekta rezultirat će s 3 nova proizvoda prijavitelja s poboljšanim tehničkim mogućnostima i karakteristikama što će posljedično dovesti do rasta prihoda od prodaje i i konkurentnosti poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: PROSTORIA Certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija tvrtke PROSTORIA
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Support for companies to certify products and implement management systems
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Potpora poduzećima za certifikaciju proizvoda i uvođenje sustava upravljanja

Operation_Name_English: AI supported smart platform for alternative SME financing
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: UI podržana pametna platforma za alternativno financiranje MSP
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project initiates development research and validation of the concept of solutions for automated preparation of business documentation required for access to investment funds. Proof of concept will examine technical challenges, input data structure and optimal processing models – both locally and in the cloud. The aim is to create a smart basis for informed decision-making and the further development of the next generation platform. The insights provided will serve as a catalyst for the commercialisation of a solution that accelerates and simplifies the connection of SMEs with investors, while redefining the user experience through automation, personalisation and data accuracy – ensuring long-term market relevance and competitive advantage.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt pokreće razvojno istraživanje i validaciju koncepta rješenja za automatiziranu pripremu poslovne dokumentacije potrebne za pristup investicijskim sredstvima. Kroz proof of concept ispitat će se tehnički izazovi, struktura ulaznih podataka te optimalni modeli obrade – lokalno i u oblaku. Cilj je stvoriti pametnu osnovu za informirano odlučivanje i daljnji razvoj platforme nove generacije. Dobiveni uvidi poslužit će kao katalizator za komercijalizaciju rješenja koje ubrzava i pojednostavljuje povezivanje MSP-ova s investitorima, uz redefiniranje korisničkog iskustva kroz automatizaciju, personalizaciju i podatkovnu preciznost – osiguravajući dugoročnu tržišnu relevantnost i konkurentsku prednost.

Operation_Name_English: One Woman's Life Changes III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jedna žena život mijenja III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: By employing 20 people, the project aims to contribute to reducing the unemployment gap between men and women and to improve the quality of life of 120 beneficiaries. Activities of the project are providing assistance in meeting the basic living needs of the elderly and persons with disabilities. Each person will provide a service for a minimum of 6 users (a total of at least 35 visits per month for their 6 users). The project provides non-institutional care and allows the target group to stay in their own home, thus contributing to a more dignified life for older and disadvantaged people and improving the quality of life of the unemployed.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je zaposlenjem 20 osoba doprinijeti smanjenju razlike u nezaposlenosti između muškaraca i žena i utjecati na podizanje kvalitete života 120 korisnika. Aktivnosti projekta su pružanje pomoći u zadovoljavanju osnovnih životnih potreba starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Svaka osoba će pružati uslugu za minimalno 6 korisnika (ukupno najmanje 35 posjeta mjesečno za svojih 6 korisnika). Projekt osigurava izvaninstitucionalnu skrb i pruža ciljanoj skupini ostanak u vlastitom domu čime se pridonosi dostojanstvenijem življenju starijih osoba i osoba u nepovoljnom položaju te poboljšanju kvalitete života nezaposlenih osoba.

Operation_Name_English: Modernisation of the alert system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Modernizacija sustava za uzbunjivanje
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: floods and landslides (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
NUTS3_Label: Krapinsko-zagorska županija|Brodsko-posavska županija|Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija|Virovitičko-podravska županija|Požeško-slavonska županija|Koprivničko-križevačka županija|Međimurska županija|Bjelovarsko-bilogorska županija|Šibensko-kninska županija|Karlovačka županija|Sisačko-moslavačka županija|Istarska županija|Zagrebačka županija|Varaždinska županija|Osječko-baranjska županija|Vukovarsko-srijemska županija|Zadarska županija|Primorsko-goranska županija|Grad Zagreb|Ličko-senjska županija|Split-Dalmatia County
Operation_Summary_English: The modernization of the system will establish a reliable system of alerting the population, in order to avoid casualties and reduce the consequences, and such a system will be a support to the civil protection system. The project will modernise the siren-based public alarm system in more densely populated areas and particularly endangered areas in the Republic of Croatia by modernising, procuring and installing equipment, i.e. acquire 185 new electronic siren, 21 new central devices containing software for monitoring and managing siren and new equipment necessary for modernising 217 existing siren (of which 55 electronic and 162 electric motor).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Modernizacijom sustava će se uspostaviti pouzdan sustav uzbunjivanja stanovništva, a u cilju izbjegavanja žrtava i smanjivanja posljedica te će takav sustav predstavljati potporu sustavu civilne zaštite. Projektom će se u gušće naseljenim područjima te posebno ugroženim područjima u Republici Hrvatskoj modernizacijom, nabavom i instalacijom opreme modernizirati sustav uzbunjivanja stanovništva baziran na sirenama odnosno nabaviti 185 novih elektroničkih sirena, 21 novi centralni uređaj koji sadrži softver za nadzor i upravljanje sirenama te nova oprema potrebna za modernizaciju 217 postojećih sirena (od čega 55 elektroničkih i 162 elektromotornih).

Operation_Name_English: Development strategy of the larger urban area of Bjelovar for the financial period 2021-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strategija razvoja Većeg urbanog područja Bjelovar za financijsko razdoblje 2021.-2027.
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The project consists of a claim for co-financing the costs of external services for the development of the Strategy for the development of the larger urban area of Bjelovar for the financial period 2021-2027, and whose developer is the City of Bjelovar as the city center of the larger urban area of Bjelovar.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se sastoji od potraživanja sufinanciranja troškova vanjske usluge za izradu Strategije razvoja većeg urbanog područja Bjelovar za financijsko razdoblje 2021.-2027., a čiji je nositelj izrade Grad Bjelovar kao grad središte Većeg urbanog područja Bjelovar.

Operation_Name_English: ‘Improving the competitiveness of Prehnit d.o.o. through the introduction of management systems according to ISO/IEC 20000 and ISO/IEC 22301’
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: „Unaprjeđenje konkurentnosti tvrtke Prehnit d.o.o. kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO/IEC 20000 i ISO/IEC 22301“
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Improving the competitiveness of Prehnit d.o.o. through the introduction of the management system according to ISO/IEC 20000 and ISO/IEC 22301’ introduces two international management systems that will enable the acquisition of the ISO/IEC 20000 certificate - service management system and ISO/IEC 22301 - business continuity management system with the aim of strengthening the competitiveness of Prehnit d.o.o. from Zagreb and strengthening exports on international markets. Apart from obtaining two certificates and conducting a supervisory audit by an accredited body, the project will also implement employee training necessary for the introduction of two new management systems and which will further strengthen the company's capacities. The estimated duration of the project is 12 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Unaprjeđenje konkurentnosti tvrtke Prehnit d.o.o. kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO/IEC 20000 i ISO/IEC 22301“ uvode se dva međunarodna sustava upravljanja kojim će se omogućiti stjecanje certifikata ISO/IEC 20000- sustav upravljanja uslugama i ISO/IEC 22301 – sustav upravljanja kontinuitetom poslovanja s ciljem jačanja konkurentnosti društva Prehnit d.o.o. iz Zagreba i jačanje izvoza na međunarodnim tržištima. Izuzev ishođenja dva certifikata te provedbe nadzornog audita od strane akreditiranog tijela, kroz projekt će se realizirati i edukacije djelatnika neophodne za uvođenje dva nova sustava upravljanja i koje će dodatno ojačati kapacitete društva. Predviđeno trajanje projekta je 12 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Flood protection of the city of Ogulin - PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaštita od poplava grada Ogulina – FAZA 2
Category_Label: Adaptation to climate change measures and prevention and management of climate related risks: floods and landslides (including awareness raising, civil protection and disaster management systems, infrastructures and ecosystem based approaches)
Operation_Summary_English: The project is located in the Republic of Croatia, Karlovac County, administrative area of the city of Ogulin. The aim of the project is to reduce flood risk, i.e. to improve the flood protection system of the city of Ogulin. In its current state, the city of Ogulin is exposed to frequent flood events due to the large waters of the river Gornja Dobra. This project will increase the level of security of the city of Ogulin from flood events. This is planned to be implemented through: 1) Construction of retention-retention building Ogulin 2) Cleaning measures of Đula's sink 3) Preparation of study and project documentation for the project "Flood Protection of the City of Ogulin 2"
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je lociran u RH, Karlovačka županija, administrativno područje grada Ogulina. Cilj projekta je smanjenje poplavnog rizika, odnosno poboljšanje sustava obrane od poplava grada Ogulina. U postojećem stanju grad Ogulin izložen je učestalim poplavnim događajima uslijed velikih voda rijeke Gornje Dobre. Ovim projektom će se povećati stupanj sigurnosti grada Ogulina od poplavnih događaja. Navedeno se planira provesti kroz: 1) Izgradnju retencijsko-zahvatne građevine Ogulin 2) Mjere čišćenja Đulinog ponora 3) Pripremu studijske i projektne dokumentacije za projekt "Zaštita od poplava grada Ogulina 2"

Operation_Name_English: Certification of management systems for additive manufacturing services
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija sustava upravljanja za usluge aditivne proizvodnje
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: "The project "Certification of the management system for additive manufacturing services" aims to increase the international competitiveness of the company IZIT d.o.o. through the introduction and certification of the management system according to the internationally recognized ISO 9001 quality standard and ISO 14001 environmental protection standard. The purpose of the project is to establish high business standards, increase customer confidence and expand access to international markets. Expected results include the acquisition of ISO certification, increased customer confidence, expansion to international markets and business optimization through sustainable and efficient processes, thus positioning the company as an innovative and reliable leader in the additive manufacturing sector.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: "Projekt „Certifikacija sustava upravljanja za usluge aditivne proizvodnje“ ima za cilj povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća IZIT d.o.o. kroz uvođenje i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja prema međunarodno priznatim ISO 9001 standardu za kvalitetu i ISO 14001 standardu za zaštitu okoliša. Svrha projekta je uspostaviti visoke standarde poslovanja, povećati povjerenje klijenata i proširiti pristup međunarodnim tržištima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju stjecanje ISO certifikata, povećano povjerenje klijenata, širenje na međunarodna tržišta i optimizaciju poslovanja kroz održive i učinkovite procese, čime se poduzeće pozicionira kao inovativan i pouzdan lider u sektoru aditivne proizvodnje.

Operation_Name_English: PUNa community bag II.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PUNa torba zajedništva II.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of the project "PUNa bag of community II" is to ensure inclusive education, increase social inclusion and integration for students with disabilities in regular and special programs in primary education institutions in the area of the towns of the founders of Poreč and Rovinj through providing support to an average of 59 teaching assistants per year for three school years (24/25, 25/26, 26/27). Project activities are Project Management and Administration, PUN Selection Procedure, Providing Support to Students with Disabilities through Monthly PUN Work and Communication and Visibility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta "PUNa torba zajedništva II." je osiguranje inkluzivnog obrazovanja, povećanje socijalne uključenosti i integracije za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju u redovne i posebne programe u osnovnoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama na području gradova osnivača Poreča i Rovinja kroz osiguranje podrške prosječno 59 pomoćnika u nastavi po godini za tri školske godine (24/25, 25/26, 26/27). Aktivnosti projekta jesu Upravljanje projektom i administracija, Postupak selekcije PUN, Pružanje potpore učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju kroz mjesečni rad PUN te Komunikacija i vidljivost.

Operation_Name_English: The potential of AI in analytics and the development of new models The use of AI in the field of analytics
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Potencijali umjetne inteligencije u analitici i razvoj novih modela Upotreba AI na području Analitike
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project addresses the problem of the untapped potential of artificial intelligence (AI) in data analytics, which represents a significant obstacle to the optimization of business processes. The project aims to thoroughly explore existing AI applications in the metal industry, identify key strengths, challenges and future trends, and develop new data analysis models that enable deeper insights, improving informed decision-making. Target groups include a company that uses data analytics to improve its operations, AI researchers, and decision makers interested in innovative solutions that can significantly increase productivity and optimise resources within the organisation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt adresira problem neiskorištenih potencijala umjetne inteligencije (UI) u analitici podataka, što predstavlja značajnu prepreku za optimizaciju poslovnih procesa. Cilj projekta je temeljito istražiti postojeće primjene UI u metalni industriji, identificirati ključne prednosti, izazove i buduće trendove, te razviti nove modele analize podataka koji omogućuju dublje uvide, poboljšavajući donošenje informiranih odluka. Ciljne skupine uključuju poduzeće koje koristi analitiku podataka za unapređenje svojih operacija, istraživače u području umjetne inteligencije te donositelje odluka koji su zainteresirani za inovativna rješenja koja mogu značajno povećati produktivnost i optimizirati resurse unutar organizacije.

Operation_Name_English: Helping, phase VI - project of providing teaching assistance to students with developmental difficulties in primary schools in Slavonski Brod
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Helping, faza VI - projekt pružanja pomoći u nastavi učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnim školama u Slavonskom Brodu
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project Holding, Phase IV is to provide conditions for the improvement of educational achievements, successful socialization and emotional functioning for 94 students with developmental difficulties through the provision of support for their inclusion in primary schools in Slavonski Brod by 77 teaching assistants/professional communication mediators.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta Holding, faza IV je osigurati uvjete za poboljšanje obrazovnih postignuća, uspješnu socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje za 94 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz pružanje potpore njihovom uključivanju u osnovne škole u Slavonskom Brodu od strane 77 pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika.

Operation_Name_English: ISKRA - Strengthening the competences of educational workers in accordance with the reform processes - Phase 1
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ISKRA - Jačanje kompetencija odgojno-obrazovnih radnika u skladu s reformskim procesima - faza 1
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The ISKRA project is a development project of the Education and Teacher Training Agency aimed at strengthening the competences of educational workers through the development and introduction of new ways of professional training, reform of the system of introducing trainees into the education system, as well as optimization and standardization of monitoring the direct work of educational workers. Also, this project directly provides support for the further development of competences of providers of professional training services - senior advisors of the Agency, heads of expert councils and directors in preschool institutions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt ISKRA razvojni je projekt Agencije za odgoj i obrazovanjem kojem je cilj jačanje kompetencija odgojno-obrazovnih radnika kroz izradu i uvođenje novih načina stručnog usavršavanja, reformu sustava uvođenja pripravnika u sustav odgoja i obrazovanja, kao i optimizaciju i standardizaciju praćenja neposrednog rada odgojno-obrazovnih radnika. Također, ovim projektom direktno se pruža podrška za daljnji razvoj kompetencija pružatelja usluga stručnog usavršavanja - viših savjetnika Agencije, voditelja stručnih vijeća te ravnatelja u predškolskim ustanovama.

Operation_Name_English: Pazin Urban Area Development Strategy 2022-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strategija razvoja Urbanog područja Pazin za razdoblje od 2022. do 2027. godine
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: This project includes the development of the Pazin Urban Area Development Strategy for the period from 2022 to 2027 and the prior evaluation of the Pazin Urban Area Development Strategy for the period from 2022 to 2027.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom obuhvaćena je izrada Strategije razvoja Urbanog područja Pazin za razdoblje od 2022. do 2027. godine te prethodno vrednovanje Strategije razvoja Urbanog područja Pazin za razdoblje od 2022. do 2027. godine.

Operation_Name_English: AIDS IN COMPETITION IN BASIC SCHOOLS OF THE CITY OF DUBROVNIK - PHASE VIL
