Operation_Name_Programme_Language: POMOĆNICI U NASTAVI U OSNOVNIM ŠKOLAMA GRADA DUBROVNIKA - FAZA VIl
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is to provide support for the inclusion, with the support of 42 teaching assistants, of 42 students with disabilities in primary schools in the City of Dubrovnik in order to ensure the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The project will be implemented under the leadership of the City of Dubrovnik under the responsibility of the Administrative Department for Education, Sports, Social Welfare and Civil Society, and in partnership with primary schools Lapad, Montovjerna, Mokošica, M. Držić, M. Getaldić, I. Gundulić and A. Masla.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog projekta je pružanje potpore uključivanju, uz podršku 42 pomoćnika u nastavi, 42 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u nastavu u osnovnim školama Grada Dubrovnika kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Projekt će se provesti pod vodstvom Grada Dubrovnika u nadležnosti Upravnog odjela za obrazovanje, šport, socijalnu skrb i civilno društvo, a u partnerstvu s osnovnim školama Lapada, Montovjerne, Mokošice, M. Držića, M. Getaldića, I. Gundulića i A. Masle.

Operation_Name_English: School for ALL with teaching assistants VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ŠKOLA ZA SVE uz pomoćnike u nastavi VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will entitle students with developmental difficulties (N=122) who, in accordance with the Personal Assistance Act (NN 71/2023) and the Decision of the Administrative Department of Karlovac County, have received support from teaching assistants/professional communication mediators. Through the work of 54 teaching assistants during the project period, students with disabilities will, according to their individual needs and possibilities, be provided with conditions for achieving better educational success, emotional functioning and more successful socialization. The project will contribute to equal participation in the educational process of students with disabilities and increase the social inclusion and integration of students with disabilities in all schools founded by the City of Karlovac.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju (N=122) koji su sukladno Zakonu o osobnoj asistenciji (NN 71/2023) te Rješenju Upravnog odjela Karlovačke županije ostvarili pravo na potporu pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnog komunikacijskog posrednika. Kroz rad 54 pomoćnika u nastavi u razdoblju trajanja projekta, učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju će se, prema njihovim individualnim potrebama i mogućnostima, osigurat uvjeti za postizanje boljih obrazovnih uspjeha, emocionalno funkcioniranje i uspješniju socijalizaciju. Projekt će doprinijeti ravnopravnom sudjelovanju u odgojno-obrazovnom procesu učenika s teškoćama te povećanju socijalne uključenosti i integracije učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u svim školama kojima je Grad Karlovac osnivač.

Operation_Name_English: Air quality monitoring in the area of Zadar Port Authority
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Praćenje kvalitete zraka u području Lučke uprave Zadar
Category_Label: Air quality and noise reduction measures
Operation_Summary_English: The Zadar Port Authority submitted the project ‘Monitoring of air quality in the area of the Zadar Port Authority’ through a co-financing tender from the Competitiveness and Cohesion Programme 2021-2027, with the aim of improving the infrastructure and capacity for monitoring and analysing air pollution from emissions in ports in its area. This project includes the installation of a continuous air quality monitoring system at two locations to ensure timely response to increasing pollution levels and to enable the planning of more effective emission reduction measures. Air quality monitoring will contribute to a healthier environment, providing tangible benefits for the local population by reducing exposure to harmful substances and encouraging the sustainable development of ports in Zadar.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Lučka uprava Zadar prijavila je projekt „Praćenje kvalitete zraka u području Lučke uprave Zadar“ putem natječaja za sufinanciranje iz Programa konkurentnost i kohezija 2021.-2027., s ciljem poboljšanja infrastrukture i kapaciteta za praćenje i analizu onečišćenja zraka iz emisija u lukama na svom području. Ovaj projekt uključuje postavljanje sustava za kontinuirano praćenje kvalitete zraka na dvije lokacije kako bi se osiguralo pravovremeno reagiranje na povećanje razine onečišćenja i omogućilo planiranje učinkovitijih mjera za smanjenje emisija. Praćenje kvalitete zraka doprinijet će zdravijem okolišu, pružajući konkretne koristi za lokalno stanovništvo kroz smanjenje izloženosti štetnim tvarima te poticanje održivog razvoja luka u Zadru.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading and equipping of the kindergarten in Tuhlj
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja i opremanje dječjeg vrtića u Tuhlju
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The municipality of Tuhelj will implement the project of upgrading the existing Potočić Tuheljski kindergarten with a partner city Klanjec with 2 additional daily stays for nursery groups and 1 additional stay for the kindergarten group. By upgrading the kindergarten, the capacities, equipment and services will meet pedagogical standards and meet the needs of residents, especially young families in the Tuhelj Municipality and partners of the City of Klanjec, and will ensure equal access to inclusive and quality education, training and lifelong learning services by developing accessible infrastructure through increasing the spatial capacities of the existing DV Potočić.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Općina Tuhelj provesti će projekt dogradnje postojećeg dječjeg vrtića Potočić Tuheljski s partnerom gradom Klanjcem s 2 dodatna dnevna boravka za jasličke skupine i 1 dodatnim boravkom za vrtićku skupinu. Dogradnjom će vrtić kapacitetima, opremom i uslugama zadovoljiti pedagoške standarde te udovoljiti potrebama stanovnika, posebice mladih obitelji na području Općine Tuhelj i partnera Grada Klanjca te će se osigurati jednaki pristup uključivim i kvalitetnim uslugama obrazovanja, osposobljavanja i cjeloživotnog učenja razvijajući pristupačnu infrastrukturu kroz povećanje prostornih kapaciteta postojećeg DV Potočić.

Operation_Name_English: Decent life in Daruvar - Phase IV
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi dostojanstven život u Daruvaru – faza IV
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support services to the elderly and people with disabilities in their daily lives by contributing to their greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in their own home and ensuring the right to live in the community. The main activities of the project are providing support and support with the procurement and distribution of a package of necessities that includes: Recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group, monitoring and control of the services performed, procurement and division of packages, communication and visibility, and project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom u svakodnevnom životu pridonoseći njihovoj većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguravanju prava na život u zajednici. Glavne aktivnosti projekta su pružanje potpore i podrške uz nabavku i podjelu paketa potrepština koje uključuje: zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga, nabava i podjela paketa, komunikacija i vidljivost te upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Abakus Traditions for Digital Ambition
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Abakus tradicije za digitalne ambicije
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Abakus Traditions for Digital Ambition" aims to promote STEM among children and young people through the organization of 250 workshops with an emphasis on the use of abakus for 2 years. The project will involve 600 participants, who will develop arithmetic skills, critical thinking and problem solving through workshops. The Abacus Croatia Association, in cooperation with project partners, has identified the need to improve mathematical skills and increase interest in STEM through many years of work with the target group. The project will also strengthen the capacities of the association and increase its impact in society through cooperation with educational institutions, which will ensure inclusiveness and equal access to education for all participants.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Abakus tradicije za digitalne ambicije" ima za cilj promociju STEM-a među djecom i mladima kroz organizaciju 250 radionica s naglaskom na korištenje abakusa tijekom 2 godine. Projekt će uključiti 600 sudionika, koji će kroz radionice razvijati aritmetičke vještine, kritičko razmišljanje i rješavanje problema. Udruga Abacus Hrvatska u suradnji s partnerima u projektu identificirala je potrebe za unapređenjem matematičkih vještina i povećanjem interesa za STEM kroz dugogodišnji rad s ciljanom skupinom. Projekt će također jačati kapacitete udruge i povećati njezin utjecaj u društvu kroz suradnju s obrazovnim institucijama čime će se osigurati inkluzivnost i jednak pristup obrazovanju za sve sudionike.

Operation_Name_English: Gaming Industry Center
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Centar gaming industrije
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in public research centres and higher education directly linked to research and innovation activities
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the entire project is investment in the construction, equipping and establishment of the Gaming Industry Center in the business zone of the City of Novska, a multifunctional complex that includes the construction, equipping and organizational establishment of a faculty, student dorm, incubator, accelerator and supporting infrastructure facilities, and the expansion of the scope of incubation and acceleration services to SMEs in the Sisak-Moslavina County (SMZ). As part of the first phase of this project, the construction, equipping and organizational establishment of a faculty, a student dormitory and supporting infrastructure facilities including roads and power plants with a canopy and a number of other activities are planned. The project will last 56 months, the project leader is the Regional Coordinator of the SMC.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet cjelokupnog projekta je ulaganje u izgradnju, opremanje i uspostavu Centra gaming industrije u poslovnoj zoni Grada Novske, multifunkcionalnog kompleksa koji uključuje izgradnju, opremanje i organizacijsku uspostavu fakulteta, studentskog doma, inkubatora, akceleratora i pratećih infrastrukturnih sadržaja, te širenje opsega inkubacijskih i akceleracijskih usluga MSP-ovima na području Sisačko-moslavačke županije (SMŽ). U okviru prve faze ovog projekta planira se izgradnja, opremanje i organizacijska uspostava fakulteta, studentskog doma i pratećih infrastrukturnih sadržaja uključujući prometnice i energanu s nadstrešnicom te niz drugih aktivnosti. Projekt će trajati 56 mjeseci, nositelj projekta je Regionalni koordinator SMŽ.

Operation_Name_English: Humanitarian packages of GDCK Virovitica and partners
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Humanitarni paketi GDCK-a Virovitica i partnera
Category_Label: Addressing material deprivation through food and/or material assistance to the most deprived, including accompanying measures
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal of the GDCK Virovitica and partners directly contributes to combating material deprivation in people at the highest risk of poverty and contributes to their social inclusion. This will be achieved by distributing food and basic material assistance packages for a total of 8,279 people, which will also be provided with appropriate accompanying measures aimed at inclusion in the social community. The project will provide continuous assistance to the most deprived persons through the division of a total of 206,975 standardized food and material assistance packages. The scope of the project covers all 8 counties of NUTS 2 of the Region of Pannonian Croatia and will be implemented in partnership with 7 Red Cross companies within the said area. The duration of the project is 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni prijedlog GDCK-a Virovitica i partnera izravno doprinosi suzbijanju materijalne oskudice kod osoba u najvećem riziku od siromaštva te pridonosi njihovom socijalnom uključivanju. Navedeno će se ostvariti podjelom paketa hrane i osnovne materijalne pomoći za ukupno 8.279 osoba kojima će se pružiti i odgovarajuće popratne mjere s ciljem uključivanja u društvenu zajednicu. Projektom će se osigurati kontinuirana pomoć najpotrebitijim osobama kroz podjelu ukupno 206.975 standardiziranih paketa hrane i materijalne pomoći. Područje provedbe projekta obuhvaća svih 8 županija NUTS 2 Regije Panonska Hrvatska i provodit će se u partnerstvu sa 7 društava Crvenog križa unutar navedenog područja. Trajanje provedbe projekta je 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of the management system according to international ISO standards for VIA MAGNIFICA d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Implementacija sustava upravljanja prema međunarodnim ISO standardima za VIA MAGNIFICA d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the implementation and certification of the management system according to ISO standards 9001, 14001 and 45001, which will enable Via Magnifica to improve the quality of its tourism services, ensure environmentally sustainable business and improve employee safety. The purpose of the project is to increase the competitiveness of companies on the international market through compliance with the highest standards of quality, sustainability and safety. Expected results include certification of services and business processes, which will allow easier access to new markets, strengthening the trust of foreign clients and confirming excellence on a global scale.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je implementacija i certifikacija sustava upravljanja prema ISO normama 9001, 14001 i 45001, čime će poduzeće Via Magnifica unaprijediti kvalitetu svojih turističkih usluga, osigurati ekološki održivo poslovanje i poboljšati sigurnost zaposlenika. Svrha projekta je povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća na međunarodnom tržištu kroz usklađivanje s najvišim standardima kvalitete, održivosti i sigurnosti. Očekivani rezultati uključuju certificiranje usluga i poslovnih procesa, što će omogućiti lakši pristup novim tržištima, jačanje povjerenja inozemnih klijenata i potvrdu izvrsnosti na globalnoj razini.

Operation_Name_English: Bicycle trail "SUTLA ROAD"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Biciklistička staza "SUTLA ROAD"
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The Municipality of Dubravica is located in the Sutla Valley, surrounded by natural beauties and diverse cultural heritage. Since there are currently no cycling trails in the municipality that would direct cyclists towards the banks of the Sutla River, the project is based on the construction of access cycling trails in several locations. The construction of such a bicycle path will contribute to the development of the Urban agglomeration of Zagreb, by directing cyclists from the county road to the less dangerous routes along the Sutla River. The project will increase the safety of cyclists and road users, and in addition, the trail will contribute to a healthier lifestyle.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Općina Dubravica smještena je u Sutlanskoj dolini, okružena prirodnim ljepotama i raznolikom kulturnom baštinom. S obzirom da trenutno na području općine ne postoje biciklističke staze koje bi usmjeravale bicikliste prema obalama rijeke Sutle, projekt se bazira na izgradnji prilaznih biciklističkih staza na nekoliko lokacija. Izgradnja ovako koncipirane biciklističke staze pridonijet će razvoju Urbane aglomeracije Zagreb, po kroz usmjeravanje biciklista s županijske ceste na manje opasne rute uz rijeku Sutlu. Projektom će se povećati sigurnost biciklista i sudionika u prometu, a osim toga staza će doprinijeti i zdravijem načinu života. smanjenju zagađenja okoliša tla, vode, zraka, te poticanju društvene aktivnosti stanovnika ovoga kraja.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the social plan of Lika-Senj County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada socijalnog plana Ličko-senjske županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: Objectives - data collection and analysis and development of the social plan of Lika-Senj County - empowering members of the council and employees of JP(R)S for social planning, implementation and monitoring of county social plans Activities - data analysis, data processing and development of the Social Plan of Lika-Senj County in accordance with the Ordinance on a uniform methodology for needs assessment (OG 90/23)
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi -prikupljanje i analiza podataka te izrada socijalnog plana ličko-senjske županije -osnaživanje članova savjeta i djelatnika JP(R)S za socijalno planiranje, provedbu i praćenje županijskih socijalnih planova Aktivnosti -analiza, obrada podataka te izrada Socijalnog plana Ličko-senjske županije u skladu s Pravilnikom o jedinstvenoj metodologiji za procjenu potreba (NN, br.90/23)

Operation_Name_English: Development of the water communal infrastructure of the Novska agglomeration - PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj vodnokomunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Novska - FAZA 2
Category_Label: Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The agglomeration of Novska comprises the town of Novska, the settlement of Bročice and the eastern settlements – Stari Grabovac, Paklenica, Voćarica, Jazavica, Roždanik, and part of the settlement of Brestača. At the level of the agglomeration, it is necessary to build and reconstruct the drainage system of 40,308 m' and reconstruct the 12,998 m' water supply network, reconstruct the 1,753.2 m' sewage network to build 18, pumping stations and 2 rain overflows, and build UPOV and acquire municipal equipment that will facilitate the maintenance of the sewage and water supply system. The project is implemented in 2 phases: Phase 1 was carried out from 2018 to 2023 and then the sewage network was built and reconstructed, the plumbing was reconstructed and the municipal equipment was purchased. In phase 2, which runs from 2024 to 2025, UPOV will be built.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Aglomeracija Novska obuhvaća grad Novsku, naselje Bročice i istočna naselja – Stari Grabovac, Paklenica, Voćarica, Jazavica, Roždanik, te dio naselja Brestača. Na razini aglomeracije potrebno je izgraditi i rekonstruirati sustav odvodnje 40.308 m' i rekonstruirati 12.998 m' vodovodne mreže, rekonstruirati 1.753,2 m' kanalizacijske mreže izgraditi 18, crpnih stanica i 2 kišna preljeva te izgraditi UPOV i nabaviti komunalnu opremu koja će olakšati održavanje kanalizacijskog i vodovodnog sustava. Projekt se provodi u 2 faze: 1. faza je provođena od 2018. do 2023. i tada je izgrađena i rekonstruirana kanalizacijska mreža, rekonstruiran vodovod i nabavljena komunalna oprema. U 2. fazi koja traje od 2024. do 2025. će se izgraditi UPOV.

Operation_Name_English: Amphorarium Construction and equipping of a center for culture and interpretation of the heritage of the island of Murter
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Amphorarium Izgradnja i opremanje centra za kulturu i interpretaciju baštine otoka Murtera
Category_Label: Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: With the "Amphorarium" project, the Municipality of Murter-Kornati plans to restore the centuries-old gusterna on the island of Murter and turn it into a center for culture, preservation and interpretation of Murter heritage. Visits, exhibitions, concerts and cultural and educational programs will be held in the newly renovated space, enriching the cultural life of the community. The new infrastructure will enable cooperation between local artists and cultural professionals, encouraging creativity and the realization of island projects. Amphorarium will, through a permanent exhibition and multimedia exhibitions on amphorae, educate visitors about Murter's cultural and natural heritage and enable an authentic connection with the island's heritage. The project will have a positive effect on the attractiveness of the entire area and reduce seasonality.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Amphorarium" Općina Murter-Kornati planira obnoviti stoljetnu gusternu na otoku Murteru i pretvoriti je u centar za kulturu, očuvanje i interpretaciju murterske baštine. U novouređenom prostoru održavat će se posjete, izložbe, koncerti i kulturno-edukativni programi, obogaćujući kulturni život zajednice. Nova infrastruktura omogućit će suradnju lokalnih umjetnika i kulturnih djelatnika, potičući kreativnost i realizaciju otočnih projekata. Amphorarium će, kroz stalni postav i multimedijalne izložbe o amforama, educirati posjetitelje o murterskoj kulturnoj i prirodnoj baštini te omogućiti autentično povezivanje s naslijeđem otoka. Projekt će pozitivno djelovati na atraktivnost cijelog područja i smanjenje sezonalnosti.

Operation_Name_English: The Hand of Love II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ruka ljubavi II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Hand of Love" will achieve the goal of increasing social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups in the area of Šibenik-Knin County by providing long-term care in everyday life to the elderly and people with disabilities. Activities are: - employment of 15 service providers for at least 90 members of the target group - service providers will organize food, household chores, maintain personal hygiene and take care of meeting other needs - implementation of promotional activities through the partners' and applicants' websites, Radio Šibenik and the sharing of promotional materials of leaflets and posters - project promotion through the initial and final conference - procurement and distribution of packages - project management, monitoring and control of the services performed by the project team.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Ruka ljubavi" ostvarit će se cilj povećanja socijalne uključenosti te prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina na području Šibensko-kninske županije osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnosti su: - zapošljavanje 15 pružatelja usluga za minimalno 90 pripadnika ciljane skupine - pružatelji usluga obavljat će organiziranje prehrane, kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene te brinuti o zadovoljavanju drugih potreba - provedba promotivnih aktivnosti kroz web stranice partnera i prijavitelja, Radio Šibenikom te dijeljenjem promotivnih materijala letaka i plakata - promocija projekta putem početne i završne konferencije - nabava i podjela paketa - upravljanje projektom, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga od strane projektnog tima.

Operation_Name_English: FLY UP - Strengthening Trade Union Organisation in the Air Transport Sector
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: FLY UP - Jačanje sindikalnog organiziranja u sektoru zračnog prometa
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project FLY UP - Strengthening Trade Union Organization in the Air Transport Sector, applicant of the Croatian Professional Union of Air Traffic Controllers, is aimed at strengthening the capacity of trade unions and promoting social dialogue in the sector. The project includes education of trade union members, development of sectoral policies and promotion of trade union action through innovative approaches to information and networking at national and international level. Activities shall contribute to sustainable employment, improved working conditions and better communication practices, in line with the objectives of the call 'Strengthening the capacity of social partners - Phase I' and European standards.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt FLY UP - Jačanje sindikalnog organiziranja u sektoru zračnog prometa, prijavitelja Hrvatskog strukovnog sindikata kontrolora letenja, usmjeren je na jačanje kapaciteta sindikata i promicanje socijalnog dijaloga u sektoru. Projekt uključuje edukaciju članova sindikata, razvoj sektorskih politika te promociju sindikalnog djelovanja putem inovativnih pristupa informiranja i umrežavanja na nacionalnoj i međunarodnoj razini. Aktivnosti doprinose održivom zapošljavanju, unaprjeđenju radnih uvjeta i boljim komunikacijskim praksama, u skladu s ciljevima poziva "Jačanje kapaciteta socijalnih partnera - faza I" i europskim standardima.

Operation_Name_English: STEP FROM STEP, Phase VI.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: KORAK UZ KORAK, faza VI.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The objectives of the project are to support the inclusion of students with disabilities in primary education institutions, to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The main project activity is to provide continuous support to students with disabilities through the work of PUN/CPC.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi projekta su pružiti potporu uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove, osiguranje uvjeta za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Glavna projektna aktivnost je kontinuirano tijekom provedbe pružati potporu učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad PUN/SKP.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation and certification of management systems according to ISO 14001, ISO 22301 and TISAX standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje i certifikacija sustava upravljanja prema standardima ISO 14001, ISO 22301 i TISAX
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With this project, the Applicant introduces and certifies business process and quality management systems according to the following standards: 1. ISO 14001 2. ISO 22301 3. TISAX The aim of the project is to increase the competitiveness of Applicants on the domestic and foreign markets by certifying processes in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards or certification schemes. The project will facilitate access to the international market and increase the competitiveness of the Applicant by introducing management systems that demonstrate the level of quality and security in the exchange of goods and services and contribute to customer confidence. Expected results: Introduced and certified 3 management systems Increase in sales revenue in year m+2 by 33.1% Increase in export revenue in year m+2 by 33.1%
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom Prijavitelj uvodi i certificira sustave upravljanja poslovnim procesima i kvalitetom prema normama: 1. ISO 14001 2. ISO 22301 3. TISAX Cilj projekta je povećanje konkurentnosti Prijavitelja na domaćem i inozemnom tržištu certifikacijom procesa u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi ili certifikacijskih shema. Projektom će se olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu i povećati konkurentnost Prijavitelja uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kojima se dokazuje razina kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni roba i usluga te pridonosi povjerenju kupaca. Očekivani rezultati: Uvedena i certificirana 3 sustava upravljanja Povećanje prihoda od prodaje u godini m+2 za 33,1% Povećanje prihoda od izvoza u godini m+2 za 33,1%

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction and equipping of the Socio-cultural home Supetar
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija i opremanje Društveno-kulturnog doma Supetar
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures compliant with energy efficiency criteria|Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal aims to renovate and equip the building of the Socio-cultural home in Supetar on the island of Brač, which has not been in use for years due to the damaged construction. The reconstruction will ensure adequate conditions for the work of local cultural and artistic associations and thus encourage the involvement of the population in the activities of civil society organisations, which will directly improve the quality of life in the local community. In addition, through a partnership with the Bol Cultural Centre, the project has a wider island integration, enabling the newly established cultural infrastructure to benefit not only the residents of Supetar, but also visitors and residents of the entire island of Brač, providing space for various cultural activities and events.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni prijedlog ima za cilj obnoviti i opremiti zgradu Društveno-kulturnog doma u Supetru na otoku Braču, koja se zbog narušene konstrukcije ne koristi već godinama. Rekonstrukcijom će se osigurati primjereni uvjeti za rad lokalnih kulturno-umjetničkih udruga i tako potaknuti uključenost stanovništva u aktivnosti organizacija civilnog društva, čime će se izravno poboljšati kvaliteta života u lokalnoj zajednici. Uz to, kroz partnerstvo s Centrom za kulturu Bol, projekt ima širu otočnu integriranost, omogućujući da novouspostavljena kulturna infrastruktura koristi ne samo stanovnicima Supetra, već i posjetiteljima te stanovnicima cijelog otoka Brača, pružajući prostor za raznovrsne kulturne aktivnosti i događaje.

Operation_Name_English: Research and development of a smart fire extinguisher: SPIN consortium cooperation to an innovative ICT solution for Industry 4.0 and environmental monitoring and protection
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Istraživanje i razvoj pametnog vatrogasnog aparata: suradnjom SPIN konzorcija do inovativnog IKT rješenja za industriju 4.0 i monitoring i zaštitu okoliša
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Digitalisation and networking are transforming manufacturing and many other sectors. The fire extinguishers market has not yet effectively taken advantage of these technologies, especially in the control and monitoring segment. Often outdated technologies, a high degree of manual operations, fragmented data and suboptimal processes characterize the production of many fire extinguishers. The Five Times Nine Consortium, Pastor and Smart Sense proposes a project to develop innovative products Smart Fire extinguisher and Sensees Environment Fire Extinguisher that will contribute to the development of PN Production Technology, ICT solutions and models for Industry 4.0 PN Environmentally friendly materials and green technologies for RES, municipal economy and environmental protection.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Digitalizacija i umrežavanje transformiraju proizvodne i mnoge druge sektore. Tržištevatrogasnih aparata još uvijek nije učinkovito iskoristilo prednosti ovih tehnologija, posebno ne u segmentu upravljanja i nadzora. Često zastarjele tehnologije, visok stupanj manualnih operacija, fragmentiranih podataka i suboptimalnih procesa karakteriziraju proizvodnju mnogih vatrogasnih aparata. Konzorcij Pet puta devet, Pastor i Smart Sense predlaže projektrazvoja inovativnih proizvoda Pametni vatrogasni aparat i Sensees Environment Fire Extinguisher koji će doprinijeti razvoju PN Proizvodne tehnologije, IKT rješenja i modeli za industriju 4.0 PN Ekološki prihvatljivi materijali i zelene tehnologije za OIE, komunalno gospodarstvo i zaštitu okoliša.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of the National Library and Reading Room Murter
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje Narodne knjižnice i čitaonice Murter
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Improvement of the National Library and Reading Room Murter’ has the objectives of (1) improving the spatial and management capacity of the National Library Murter and (2) increasing the number of users of the premises and services/programmes of the National Library Murter. The purpose of the project is to increase accessibility and participation in the cultural life of the inhabitants and visitors of the Municipality of Murter-Kornati, paying special attention to members of vulnerable groups and improving the capacity of the National Library of Murter as a prerequisite for the development of innovative services in culture in the territory of the Municipality of Murter-Kornati.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Unaprjeđenje Narodne knjižnice i čitaonice Murter“ ima ciljeve (1) unaprjeđenja prostornog i upravljačkog kapaciteta Narodne knjižnice Murter te (2) povećanje broja korisnika prostora i usluga/programa Narodne knjižnice Murter. Svrha projekta je povećanje pristupačnosti i sudjelovanja u kulturnom životu stanovnika i posjetitelja općine Murter-Kornati, pri tom posebnu pažnju stavljajući na pripadnike ranjivih skupina te unaprjeđenje kapaciteta Narodne knjižnice Murter kao preduvjeta za razvoj inovativnih usluga u kulturi na području općine Murter-Kornati.

Operation_Name_English: PETICA FOR TWO - Help - Education - Team - Integration - Targeting - Affirmation FOR TWO - Phase VIII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PETICA ZA DVOJE - Pomoć - Edukacija - Tim - Integracija - Ciljanost - Afirmacija ZA DVOJE - VIII. faza
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to ensure inclusive education of students with disabilities by engaging teaching assistants/professional communication mediators in order to contribute to the improvement of students' educational achievements, their more successful socialization and emotional functioning.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se nastoji osigurati inkluzivno obrazovanje učenika s teškoćama u razvoju angažiranjem pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika kako bi se pridonijelo poboljšanju obrazovnih postignuća učenika, njihovoj uspješnijoj socijalizaciji i emocionalnom funkcioniranju.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction of the existing Bakery building into the city library and reading room Mladen Kerstner Ludbreg
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija postojeće zgrade Pekare u gradsku knjižnicu i čitaonicu Mladen Kerstner Ludbreg
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the project application is the reconstruction of the existing ‘Pekare’ building with its conversion into a public-social purpose – the city library and reading room at kčbr. 1765/1 k.o. Ludbreg. The aim of the project is to invest in the reconstruction of a building of public cultural infrastructure that is currently unused and no activity is carried out in it. The activities carried out will result in a newly reconstructed and renovated building in which cultural activities will take place on a larger area than the existing building of the city library, which will provide more services and programs for citizens and the entire local community, with an emphasis on the integration of vulnerable groups.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet prijave projekta je rekonstrukcija postojeće zgrade „Pekare“ s prenamjenom u javno-društvenu namjenu – gradsku knjižnicu i čitaonicu na kčbr. 1765/1 k.o. Ludbreg. Cilj projekta je ulaganje u rekonstrukciju zgrade javne kulturne infrastrukture koja je trenutno nekorištena i u njoj se ne obavlja nikakva djelatnost. Provedene aktivnosti rezultirat će novo-rekonstruiranom i obnovljenom zgradom u kojoj će se odvijati kulturne djelatnosti na većoj površini od postojeće zgrade gradske knjižnice u kojoj će se pružati više usluga i programa za građane i cijelu lokalnu zajednicu, sa naglaskom na integraciju ranjivih skupina.

Operation_Name_English: Challenges of social dialogue in the digital economy: Focus on the private sector and ICT "SD-DEI - Social Dialogue in the Digital Economy and ICT"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izazovi socijalnog dijaloga u digitalnoj ekonomiji: Fokus na privatni sektor i ICT "SD-DEI - Socijalni dijalog u Digitalnoj ekonomiji i ICT-u"
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project deals with the strengthening of social dialogue and collective bargaining in Croatia through the education of employees, trade union commissioners and volunteers, the development of new and improved existing services for members and the exchange of knowledge through networking activities between the two social partners of the Croatian Telecommunications Union and the Republic Workers' Union with a focus on the challenges of social dialogue in the digital economy. The aim is to improve the capacity of social partners to better cope with labour market challenges in the digital and telecommunications sectors. The project contributes to the long-term sustainability of the social partners and enables them to adapt to future changes and improves collective bargaining.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se bavi jačanjem socijalnog dijaloga i kolektivnog pregovaranja u Hrvatskoj kroz edukaciju zaposlenika, sindikalnih povjerenika i volontera, razvoju novih i unaprijeđenu postojećih usluga za članove i razmjenu znanja putem aktivnosti umrežavanja dvoju socijalnih partnera Hrvatskog sindikata telekomunikacija i Republičkog sindikata radnika s fokusom na izazove socijalnog dijaloga u digitalnoj ekonomiji. Cilj je unaprijediti kapacitete socijalnih partnera kako bi se bolje nosili s izazovima na tržištu rada u digitalnom i telekomunikacijskom sektoru. Projekt doprinosi dugoročnoj održivosti socijalnih partnera te im omogućuje prilagodbu budućim promjenama i unaprjeđuje kolektivno pregovaranje.

Operation_Name_English: Revitalization of brownfield object in Glavice
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Revitalizacija brownfield objekta u Glavicama
Category_Label: Energy efficiency renovation or energy efficiency measures regarding public infrastructure, demonstration projects and supporting measures|Rehabilitation of industrial sites and contaminated land|Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project Revitalisation of the brownfield facility in Glavice will allow the City of Sinj to renovate the abandoned building in Glavice and repurpose it for the purpose of opening a new branch of the Bili cvitak Kindergarten – Muljika Kindergarten. This will contribute to solving one of the key societal challenges – the insufficient capacity of kindergartens in the City of Sinj, by exploiting the currently unused infrastructure. The project will thus encourage balanced social and economic development of the City of Sinj and the Urban Agglomeration of Split.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Revitalizacija brownfield objekta u Glavicama Gradu Sinju omogućit će obnovu napuštene građevine u Glavicama te njezinu prenamjenu za potrebe otvaranja nove podružnice Dječjeg vrtića Bili cvitak – Dječji vrtić Muljika. Time će se kroz iskorištavanje trenutno nekorištene infrastrukture doprinijeti rješavanju jednog od ključnih društvenih izazova – nedostatnih kapaciteta dječjih vrtića u Gradu Sinju. Projekt će tako potaknuti uravnoteženi društveni i gospodarski razvoj Grada Sinja i Urbane aglomeracije Split.

Operation_Name_English: Zagreb City Library and Socio-Cultural Center at Paromlin
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Gradska knjižnica grada Zagreba i društveno-kulturni centar na lokaciji Paromlin
Category_Label: Rehabilitation of industrial sites and contaminated land|Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘The City Library of the City of Zagreb and the socio-cultural centre at the Paromlin site’ will revitalise the valuable cultural industrial heritage at the brownfield site into a multifunctional public space that will combine all the functions of a modern library and a socio-cultural centre with accessible public services for all residents of the Zagreb Urban Agglomeration. The duration of the project is 36 months. The project applicant is the City of Zagreb, and the partners of the Zagreb City Library (KGZ) and the New Spaces of Culture (NPK). The total value of the investment is EUR 94.5 million, while the total value of the project proposal is EUR 66,573,073.26, of which EUR 40,000,000,00 in grants are claimed from the European Regional Development Fund.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Gradska knjižnica Grada Zagreba i društveno-kulturni centar na lokaciji Paromlin“ revitalizirat će se vrijedna kulturna industrijska baština na brownfield lokaciji u multifunkcionalni javni prostor koji će objedinjavati sve funkcije suvremene knjižnice i društveno-kulturnog centra s pristupačnim javnim uslugama za sve stanovnike Urbane aglomeracije Zagreb. Trajanje provedbe projekta je 36 mjeseci. Prijavitelj projekta je Grad Zagreb, a partneri Knjižnice grada Zagreba (KGZ) i Novi prostori kulture (NPK). Ukupna vrijednost ulaganja iznosi 94,5 milijuna EUR, dok ukupna vrijednost projektnog prijedloga iznosi 66.573.073,26 EUR, od čega se iz Europskog fonda za regionalni razvoj potražuje 40.000.000,00 EUR bespovratnih sredstava.

Operation_Name_English: Development of hydrofoil catamaran for transport of persons with disabilities
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj hidrokrilnog katamarana za prijevoz osoba s invaliditetom
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is the development of an innovative vessel for the transport of persons with disabilities. The boat type is a catamaran accompanied by a hydrofoil made of natural fibres and biodegradable resins. Hydrofoils are dynamically positioned for the optimal angle of attack depending on the speed, the state of the sea and the load of the boat. Hydrocrylics are composite (biofibre and bio epoxy) with a specially mixed resin that retains 200 to 600 nm long carbon nanotubes. The purpose of the vessel is the transport of persons with disabilities, and for this reason a special platform-crane is being developed for the rapid autonomous loading and unloading of persons with disabilities in wheelchairs. The catamaran is 12m hull length with a length of 13.5m overall made of aluminum with a maximum width of 4.5m.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog projekta je razvoj inovativnog plovila za prijevoz osoba s invaliditetom. Tip plovila je katamaran asistiran sa hidrokrilom izrađenim od prirodnih vlakna i bio-razgradivih smola. Hidrokrila se dinamički pozicioniraju za optimalni napadni kut ovisno o brzini, stanju mora i opterećenju brodice. Hidrokrila su kompozitna (biovlakna i bio epoksi) sa specijalno zamješanom smolom koja u sebi zadrži karbonske nanotube dužine 200 do 600 nm. Namjena plovila je prijevoz osoba s invaliditetom pa se iz toga razloga razvija i specijalna platforma-dizalica za brzi autonomni ukrcaj i iskrcaj osoba s invaliditetom u kolicima. Katamaran je 12m duljine trupa sa dužinom preko svega 13.5m izrađen od aluminija maksimalne širine 4.5m.

Operation_Name_English: Restoration of the heating of the city of Rijeka - phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obnova toplinarstva grada Rijeke - faza II
Category_Label: High efficiency co-generation, district heating and cooling
Operation_Summary_English: The project of renovation of the heating system of Rijeka envisages the modernization of 7 heating systems in such a way that 3 systems will be connected into one, while 1 system will be modernized independently. The modernization of each system involves the reconstruction of the production facility to become an energy efficient system using high-efficiency cogeneration and renewable energy sources and the reconstruction of the distribution hot water network of each of the seven systems. Modernisation and reconstruction of production facilities was carried out by 31 December 2023, while the modernisation and reconstruction of the distribution hot water network is expected in the phase, with 1.8 km of the hot water network being reconstructed by 31 December 2023, and 8.5 km remaining for reconstruction in Phase II.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom obnove sustava toplinarstva Rijeke predviđa se modernizacija 7 sustava toplinarstva na način da će se po 3 sustava spojiti u jedan dok će 1 sustav biti moderniziran samostalno. Modernizacija svakog sustava uključuje rekonstrukciju proizvodnog pogona kako bi postao energetski učinkoviti sustav uz korištenje visokoučinkovite kogeneracije i obnovljivih izvora energije te rekonstrukciju distribucijske toplovodne mreže svakog od navedenih 7 sustava. Modernizacija i rekonstrukcija proizvodnih je pogona izvršena do 31.12.2023. dok se u faziranju očekuje modernizacija i rekonstrukcija distributivne toplovodne mreže pri čemu je do 31.12.2023. rekonstruirano 1,8 km toplovodne mreže te je za rekonstrukciju u Fazi II. preostalo 8,5 km.

Operation_Name_English: Development of innovative cosmetic products based on wild Mediterranean plants
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inovativnih kozmetičkih proizvoda na bazi samoniklog mediteranskog bilja
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project addresses the growing consumer concern about synthetic ingredients in cosmetic products and the negative environmental impact of production, and focuses on the lack of high-quality organic products that meet sustainability standards. Through the development of innovative cosmetic products based on medicinal plants harvested using sustainable ‘wildpicking’ methods, the project responds to the need for natural, safe and environmentally friendly solutions. The aim of the project is to develop 10 high-quality organic creams, serums, tonics and balms that will provide effective anti-ageing care and support the specific needs of sensitive and problematic skin.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt adresira sve veću zabrinutost potrošača zbog sintetičkih sastojaka u kozmetičkim proizvodima i negativnog utjecaja proizvodnje na okoliš, te fokus stavlja na nedostatak visokokvalitetnih organskih proizvoda koji zadovoljavaju standarde održivosti. Kroz razvoj inovativnih kozmetičkih proizvoda na bazi ljekovitog bilja ubranog održivim metodama „wildpickinga“, projekt odgovara na potrebu za prirodnim, sigurnim i ekološki prihvatljivim rješenjima. Cilj projekta je razviti 10 visokokvalitetnih organskih krema, seruma, tonika i balzama koji će pružati učinkovitu anti-ageing njegu i podršku specifičnim potrebama osjetljive i problematične kože.

Operation_Name_English: Social inclusion to reduce institutionalisation
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Socijalnim uključivanjem do smanjenja institucionalizacije
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Objective of the project – to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and persons with disabilities. Providing support and support services with the purchase and distribution of packages of supplies for at least 6 members of the target group. They will hire service providers to help organize food, do household chores, maintain personal hygiene, procure and share packages with household and hygiene supplies. Monitoring and control of the services performed, communication and visibility, project management and administration will be carried out by the applicant with the partner.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta – pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština za min 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine. Zapošljavat će pružatelje usluga koji će pomoći u organizaciji prehrane, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, održavanju osobne higijene, nabavit će se i podijeliti paketi s kućanskim i higijenskim potrepštinama. Praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju vršit će prijavitelj s partnerom.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of fire extinguishers from Pastor TVA d.d.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija vatrogasnih aparata tvrtke Pastor TVA d.d.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of certification of fire extinguishers of the company Pastor TVA d.d. aims to ensure compliance of new models of extinguishers and shutters on fire extinguishers with the EN 3-7 standard, enabling placement on the international market and strengthening competitiveness. The purpose of the project is to increase the safety, quality and environmental acceptability of the product through conformity assessment and certification. Expected results include obtaining certification, export growth and strengthening the market position.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt certifikacije vatrogasnih aparata tvrtke Pastor TVA d.d. ima za cilj osigurati sukladnost novih modela aparata i zatvarača na vatrogasnim aparatima s normom EN 3-7, omogućujući plasman na međunarodno tržište i jačanje konkurentnosti. Svrha projekta je povećati sigurnost, kvalitetu i ekološku prihvatljivost proizvoda kroz ocjenjivanje sukladnosti i certifikaciju. Očekivani rezultati uključuju dobivanje certifikata, rast izvoza i jačanje tržišne pozicije.

Operation_Name_English: OPATIJA - CITY OF ONE POSSIBILITY
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: OPATIJA - GRAD JEDNAKIH MOGUĆNOSTI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The City of Opatija is the applicant and the Elementary School "Rikard Katalinić Jeretov" is a partner in the project "OPATIJA - CITY OF ONE POSSIBILITY". The aim of the project is to provide inclusive education for students with disabilities, i.e. to help them in educational achievements, in more successful socialization and emotional functioning. Through the project, the primary school will employ teaching assistants who will provide students with developmental disabilities with immediate support during the three full school years during the educational process, in movement, in taking food and drinks, in performing hygiene needs, in everyday teaching and extracurricular activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Grad Opatija je prijavitelj, a Osnovna škola "Rikard Katalinić Jeretov" partner u projektu „OPATIJA – GRAD JEDNAKIH MOGUĆNOSTI“. Cilj projekta je osigurati za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju inkluzivno obrazovanje, odnosno pomoći im u obrazovnim postignućima, u uspješnijoj socijalizaciji i emocionalnom funkcioniranju. Osnovna škola će pomoću projekta zaposliti pomoćnike u nastavi koji će učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju kroz tri pune školske godine pružati neposrednu potporu tijekom odgojno-obrazovnog procesa, u kretanju, pri uzimanju hrane i pića, u obavljanju higijenskih potreba, u svakidašnjim nastavnim i izvannastavnim aktivnostima.

Operation_Name_English: Let's get together VII.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obrazujmo se zajedno VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to ensure inclusive education of students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions. The specific objective is to support the inclusion of students with disabilities (69 students) in 10 elementary schools and 5 educational institutions founded by PSŽ in order to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning through employment PUN (63). The activity of the project is: supporting the education of students with disabilities through PUN. Description of the activity: selection of candidates; implementation of the PUN deployment programme; communication and visibility; project management.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je osiguranje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama. Specifični cilj je pružanje potpore uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju (69 učenika) u 10 OŠ i 5 SŠ odgojno-obrazovnih ustanova kojima je osnivač PSŽ kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje kroz zapošljavanje PUN (63). Aktivnost projekta je: pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz PUN. Opis aktivnosti: selekcija kandidata; provedba programa uvođenja u rad PUN; komunikacija i vidljivost; upravljanje projektom.

Operation_Name_English: Development of innovative AI SMARTMICRO motor spindles for smart factory applications
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inovativnih AI SMARTMICRO motorvretena za primjenu u pametnim tvornicama
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the development and implementation of advanced SMARTMICRO motor spindles with integrated sensor technologies and artificial intelligence for predictive performance maintenance and optimization. The result of the project is the development of new prototypes that will be tested in laboratory and operational conditions on the level of three innovative products: SMART AI motor spindle HSK-A63 and SMART MICRO motor spindle HSK-A25 and HSK-EZ15. New products will improve the efficiency and reliability of machining machines and increase productivity. By using advanced R&D methods, including rapid prototyping, iterative testing and industrial testing, the project will enable the commercialisation of innovative products and strengthen regional competitiveness.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je razvoj i implementacija naprednih SMARTMICRO motorvretena s integriranim senzorskim tehnologijama i umjetnom inteligencijom za prediktivno održavanje i optimizaciju performansi. Rezultat projekta je razvoj novih prototipove koji će biti testirani u laboratorijskim i operativnim uvjetima na razini tri inovativna proizvoda: SMART AI motorvreteno HSK-A63 te SMART MICRO motorvretena HSK-A25 i HSK-EZ15. Novi proizvodi će unaprijediti efikasnost i pouzdanost obradnih strojeva te povećati produktivnost. Korištenjem naprednih metoda istraživanja i razvoja, uključujući brzu prototipizaciju,iterativno testiranje i industrijsko testiranje,projekt će omogućiti komercijalizaciju inovativnih proizvoda i jačanje regionalne konkurentnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Development of spatial data processing and machine learning models in water surface research projects
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj modela obrade prostornih podataka i strojnog učenja u projektima istraživanja vodnih površina
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Investment in intangible assets in large enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: The goal is to develop a new technology of spatial data processing and machine learning in water surface research projects that will implement innovative solutions for object detection on Side-scan sonar data. In addition to the new technology for object detection on SSS data, the goal is to use the knowledge and resources acquired through the project to contribute to the further development of data processing obtained from other sensors such as sub-bottom profiler (SBP) and magnetometer (MAG). This solution will have a direct impact on navigation safety, river infrastructure and environmental protection. For testing the solution, the interest of CROATIAN WATER that wants to ensure better management of waterways by monitoring sedimentation and morphology of water surfaces was expressed.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je razviti novu tehnologiju obrade prostornih podataka i strojnog učenja u projektima istraživanja vodnih površina koja će implementirati inovativna rješenja za detekciju objekata na Side-scan sonar podacima. Osim nove tehnologije za detekciju objekata na SSS podacima, cilj je iskoristiti znanja i resurse stečene kroz projekt kako bi doprinijeli daljnjem razvoju obrade podataka dobivenih iz drugih senzora poput sub-bottom profiler (SBP) i magnetometer (MAG). Navedenim rješenjem direktno će se utjecati na sigurnost plovidbe, riječnu infrastrukturu i zaštitu okoliša. Za testiranje rješenja iskazan je interes HRVATSKIH VODA koje žele osigurati bolje gospodarenje plovnim putevima praćenjem sedimentacije i morfologije vodnih površina.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Strategy for the Development of the Urban Area Sisak for the financial period 2021-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada Strategije razvoja Urbanog područja Sisak za financijsko razdoblje 2021.-2027.
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The project Development of the Development Strategy of the Urban Area Sisak for the financial period 2021-2027 co-finances the development of a strategy that is a prerequisite for the use of the ITU mechanism. As part of the preparation of the strategy, the implementation of the preliminary evaluation process will be co-financed. The aim of the project is to support urban areas in developing territorial strategies. The target group are the City of Sisak and the municipalities of Sunja and Martinska Ves, which are part of the Urban Area of Sisak and citizens of the Urban Area of Sisak covered by the strategy. Problems defined in the Urban area are part of the conducted Analysis of the situation, which is an annex to the SRUP, and in order to solve these problems, the objectives and vision of the SRUP are defined.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Izrada Strategije razvoja Urbanog područja Sisak za financijsko razdoblje 2021.-2027. sufinancira se izrada strategije koja je preduvjet za korištenje ITU mehanizma. U sklopu izrade strategije, sufinancirat će se i provedba postupka prethodnog vrednovanja. Cilj projekta je podrška urbanim područjima u izradi teritorijalnih strategija. Ciljna skupina jesu Grad Sisak i Općine Sunja i Martinska Ves, koje su dio Urbanog područja Sisak te građani Urbanog područja Sisak koji su obuhvaćeni predmetnom strategijom. Problemi definirani u Urbanom području dio su provedene Analize stanja, koja je prilog SRUP-a, te su u svrhu rješavanja navedenih problema definirani ciljevi i vizija SRUP-a.

Operation_Name_English: Management system certification
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project is aimed at increasing the applicant's competitiveness through the implementation of four management systems with the aim of facilitating access to international markets and strengthening the market position. Planned activities include the introduction and certification of business process management systems according to international standards ISO 9001 and ISO 22000 and certification according to the market-recognized FSC CoC and PEFC CoC scheme. Through the implementation of the project, business processes will be adjusted and optimized, systematic control and documentation will be established, and employee education will be carried out. It includes conducting internal audits and certification by an accredited body, which will ensure compliance with the prescribed standards and increase competitiveness.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je usmjeren na povećanje konkurentnosti prijavitelja kroz implementaciju četiri sustava upravljanja s ciljem olakšanog pristupa međunarodnim tržištima i jačanja tržišne pozicije. Planirane aktivnosti uključuju uvođenje i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja poslovnim procesima prema međunarodnim normama ISO 9001 i ISO 22000 te certifikaciju prema tržišno priznatoj FSC CoC i PEFC CoC shemi. Kroz provedbu projekta prilagodit će se i optimizirati poslovni procesi, uspostaviti sustavna kontrola i dokumentacija te provesti edukacija zaposlenika. Uključuje provođenje internih audita i certifikaciju od strane akreditiranog tijela, čime će poduzeće osigurati usklađenost s propisanim standardima i povećati konkurentnost.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of Orto Rea d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva Orto Rea d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Objective of the project: Increase the international competitiveness of companies by certifying quality and safety management systems, ensuring compliance with internationally recognised standards and market requirements. Purpose of the project: Enable easier access to foreign markets, increase customer confidence and optimize business processes through the introduction of high quality and security standards. Expected results: Certification of 4 business process management systems, increasing export and sales revenues and strengthening the company's reputation in the international market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta: Povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća certificiranjem sustava upravljanja kvalitete i sigurnosti čime će se osigurati usklađenost s međunarodno priznatim normama i zahtjevima tržišta. Svrha projekta: Omogućiti lakši pristup inozemnim tržištima, povećati povjerenje klijenata i optimizirati poslovne procese kroz uvođenje visokih standarda kvalitete i sigurnosti. Očekivani rezultati: Certificiranje 4 sustava upravljanja poslovnim procesima, povećanje prihoda od izvoza i prodaje te jačanje reputacije poduzeća na međunarodnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Bicycle trails Vinkovci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Biciklističke staze Vinkovci
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the Project is the construction of cycling infrastructure in the area of the city of Vinkovci in order to contribute to a better connection with daily migration lines, increase the use of alternative modes of transport, reduce CO2 emissions and the safety of cyclists and other road users of the city of Vinkovci. The attractiveness of the city of Vinkovci will be further stimulated through the strengthening of cyclotourism, because the infrastructure in question forms part of the Srijem cycling route, which builds on the international route. The aim is to strengthen the green, clean, smart and sustainable urban traffic of the city of Vinkovci through the construction of 5.8 km of cycling infrastructure in the city of Vinkovci. The target groups are: local population and potential users of cycling trails of the town of Vinkovci.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha Projekta je izgradnja biciklističke infrastrukture na području grada Vinkovci kako bi se doprinijelo boljoj povezanosti sa linijama dnevnih migracija, povećalo korištenje alternativnih oblika prijevoza,smanjenju emisija CO2 te sigurnosti biciklista i ostalih sudionika u prometu grada Vinkovaca. Dodatno će se potaknuti atraktivnosti grada Vinkovaca kroz jačanje cikloturizma, jer predmetna infrastruktura čini dio biciklističke rute Srijem, koja se nadovezuje na međunarodnu rutu. Cilj je jačanje zelenog, čistog, pametnog i održivog gradskog prometa grada Vinkovaca kroz izgradnju 5,8 km biciklističke infrastrukture u gradu Vinkovcima. Ciljne skupine su: lokalno stanovništvo, te potencijalni korisnici biciklističkih staza grada Vinkovaca.

Operation_Name_English: Smile at School 6
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: S osmijehom u školu 6
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to support the inclusion of students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions in Brod-Posavina County in order to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning, all due to the increase of social inclusion and integration of students with disabilities (TUR) in primary and secondary education institutions in the county. Project proposal activities include the cost of the work of the teaching assistant/professional communication mediator for 88 teaching assistants. The work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators is necessary in order to provide support to students with disabilities in education and thus enable the realization of the project goal.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružiti potporu uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske i srednjoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove u Brodsko-posavskoj županiji kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje, a sve zbog povećanja socijalne uključenosti i integracije učenika s teškoćama u razvoju (TUR) u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama u županiji. Aktivnosti projektnog prijedloga uključuju trošak rada pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnog komunikacijskog posrednika za 88 pomoćnika u nastavi. Rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnog komunikacijskog posrednika neophodan je kako bi se učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju osigurala podrška u obrazovanju i tako omogućila realizacija projektnog cilja.

Operation_Name_English: Research and development of advanced formulation for increasing alveolar reef - OSTEOproDENT
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Istraživanje i razvoj napredne formulacije za povećanje alveolarnog grebena - OSTEOproDENT
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The research and development project addresses the problem of insufficient bone tissue regeneration in dental medicine, which represents a significant challenge when installing dental implants. The aim of the project is to develop an autologous replacement of a dental bone transplant based on an autologous coagulum of bloody recombinant human bone morphogenetic protein 6. The project will be implemented within the SPIN consortium and contribute to the industrial transition of the region towards an advanced health industry, stimulating innovation and competitiveness in Northern Croatia.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt istraživanja i razvoja adresira problem nedostatne regeneracije koštanog tkiva u dentalnoj medicini, što predstavlja značajan izazov pri postavljanju dentalnih implantata. Cilj projekta je razviti autologni nadomjestak dentalnog koštanog transplantata temeljen na autolognom koagulumu krvivi rekombinantnom humanom koštano morfogenetskom proteinu 6. Projekt će biti realiziran unutar SPIN konzorcija te doprinijeti industrijskoj tranziciji regije prema naprednoj zdravstvenoj industriji, potičući inovacije i konkurentnost u Sjevernoj Hrvatskoj.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to Smartnet's Digital Excellence and Competitiveness
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacijom do digitalne izvrsnosti i konkurentnosti tvrtke Smartnet
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project will increase the international competitiveness of Smartnet d.o.o. through the implementation and certification of management systems in accordance with internationally recognized standards. By certifying according to ISO 14001, ISO 9001 and ISO/IEC 27001, the company will ensure a high level of quality, data security and environmental responsibility, which is crucial for business with public institutions and international partners. Standardization of business processes, increasing operational efficiency will contribute to the growth of market relevance of the applicant. The implementation of the project will facilitate access to international markets, increase competitiveness and increase sales and export revenues.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedba projekta povećat će međunarodnu konkurentnost društva Smartnet d.o.o. kroz implementaciju i certificiranje sustava upravljanja u skladu s međunarodno priznatim normama. Certificiranjem prema standardima ISO 14001, ISO 9001 i ISO/IEC 27001, društvo će osigurati visoku razinu kvalitete, sigurnosti podataka i ekološke odgovornosti, što je ključno za poslovanje s javnim institucijama i međunarodnim partnerima. Standardizacija poslovnih procesa, povećanje operativne učinkovitosti pridonijet će rastu tržišne relevantnosti prijavitelja. Provedba projekta omogućit će olakšani pristup međunarodnim tržištima, povećanje konkurentnosti te rast prihoda od prodaje i izvoza.

Operation_Name_English: Modular façade system for the production of heat and electricity from solar and wind energy
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Modularni fasadni sustav za proizvodnju toplinske i električne energije iz energije sunca i vjetra
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in micro enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop an innovative solar collector as well as an innovative modular façade system (MHFS) for hot water and el.en. from solar and wind energy with integrated storage tanks hot water and el.en. that will contribute to solving social challenges such as: 1. energy surge in intensive sectors such as buildings and industry 2. environmental pollution and global warming 3. load on supply systems and energy diff. Target groups are Indian buildings such as factories and logistics centers due to the high total consumption of en., hospitals, hotels and food industry due to the year-round need for top. en., all buildings during construction / reconstruction due to the requirement to meet zero-energy standards
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je razviti inovativni sunčani kolektor kao i inovativni modularni fasadni sustav (MHFS) za proizv. tople vode i el.en. iz energije sunca i vjetra uz integrirane spremnike za pohranu topl. i el.en. koji će doprinijeti rješavanju društvenih izazova kao što su: 1. porast potr. energije u en. intenzivnim sektorima kao što su zgradarstvo i industrija 2. onečišćenje okoliša i globalno zatopljenje 3. opterećenost sustava za opskrbu i distr. energije. Ciljne skupine su ind. zgrade poput tvornica i logističkih centara zbog velike ukupne potrošnje en., bolnice, hoteli i prehrambena industrija zbog cjelogod. kontin. potrebe za topl. en., sve zgrade prilikom izgradnje/rekonstr. zbog zahtjeva za zadovoljavanje nul-energetskih standarda

Operation_Name_English: DRACO RENEWABLE WASTE - Development of waterproofing building materials by recovery of industrial waste
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: DRACO RENEWABLE WASTE - Razvoj hidroizolacijskih građevinskih materijala oporabom industrijskog otpada
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: SPIN Consortium consists of the holder Draco d.o.o. and partners of Fitter d.o.o., Jidro stil d.o.o., Protect & Eco d.o.o. and Struktura product d.o.o., as well as the University of Split, Faculty of Chemistry and Technology. The project develops innovative waterproofing products that use industrial waste as a key raw material, reducing the environmental footprint and fully stimulating the circular economy. The main goal (purpose) of the project is to ensure the strengthening of the competitiveness of RLV by investing in priority niches based on cooperation on the development of innovative solutions of high added value - waterproofing materials based on the recovery of industrial waste.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SPIN Konzorcij čine nositelj Draco d.o.o. te partneri tvrtke Fitter d.o.o., Jidro stil d.o.o., Protect & Eco d.o.o. te Struktura produkt d.o.o., kao i Sveučilište u Splitu, Kemijsko tehnološki fakultet. Projektom se razvijaju inovativni hidroizolacijski proizvodi koji koriste industrijski otpad kao ključnu sirovinu, smanjujući ekološki otisak i u potpunosti potičući kružnu ekonomiju. Glavni cilj (svrha) projekta je osigurati jačanje konkurentnosti RLV-a ulaganjem u prioritetne niše temeljem suradnje na razvoju inovativnih rješenja visoke dodane vrijednosti - hidroizolacijski materijali bazirani na oporabi industrijskog otpada.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of products and management system TEDING d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija proizvoda i sustava upravljanja TEDING d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Certification of products and management systems of TEDING d.o.o." is aimed at increasing the international competitiveness of the company by certifying products and management systems. Certification of key products according to standards HRN EN 1729-2, HRN EN 16121, HRN EN 13150 and HRN EN 15372, EN 61010-1+A1, and systems according to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015, ensures compliance with international standards, quality and product safety. The project enables access to new markets, brand strengthening, optimization of business processes and increasing the trust of customers and business partners. This creates long-term business sustainability, increases the competitive advantage and ensures greater recognition of TEDING d.o.o. on the market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Certifikacija proizvoda i sustava upravljanja TEDING d.o.o." usmjeren je na povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke certificiranjem proizvoda i sustava upravljanja. Certifikacijom ključnih proizvoda prema normama HRN EN 1729-2, HRN EN 16121, HRN EN 13150 i HRN EN 15372, EN 61010-1+A1, te sustava prema ISO 9001:2015 i ISO 14001:2015, osigurava se usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima, kvaliteta i sigurnost proizvoda. Projekt omogućuje pristup novim tržištima, jačanje brenda, optimizaciju poslovnih procesa te povećanje povjerenja kupaca i poslovnih partnera. Time se stvara dugoročna održivost poslovanja, povećava konkurentska prednost i osigurava veća prepoznatljivost TEDING d.o.o. na tržištu.
