Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of N. C. USLUGE d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva N. C. USLUGE d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes a certification activity for 12 road asphalt products and is implemented with the aim of increasing international market competitiveness and facilitating access to new applicant markets. Activities include the process of drafting technical documentation of product testing, analysis of compliance with standards, and certification by authorized bodies. The aim of the project is to confirm the quality and safety of the product, enable wider application and strengthen the market position of the applicant. The results include increased visibility of certified products, market share growth and strengthening the innovation capacity and commercial viability of the business. Implementation contributes to the realisation of the smart specialisation strategy and adaptation to the requirements of sustainable development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća aktivnost certificiranja 12 proizvoda cestovnog asfalta i provodi se s ciljem povećanja međunarodne tržišne konkurentnosti i olakšanja pristupa novim tržištima prijavitelja. Aktivnosti uključuju proces izrade tehničke dokumentacije ispitivanja proizvoda, analizu sukladnosti sa standardima, te certificiranje kod ovlaštenih tijela. Cilj projekta je potvrditi kvalitetu i sigurnost proizvoda, omogućiti širu primjenu i osnažiti tržišnu poziciju prijavitelja. Rezultati uključuju povećanu vidljivost certificiranih proizvoda, rast tržišnog udjela te jačanje inovacijskog kapaciteta i komercijalne održivosti poslovanja. Provedba doprinosi ostvarivanju strategije pametne specijalizacije i prilagodbi zahtjevima održivog razvoja.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of the management system - MILLA COSMETICS d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Implementacija sustava upravljanja - MILLA COSMETICS d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The certification project according to ISO 14001 (Environmental Management System) and ISO 27001 (Information Security Management System) will enable Milla Cosmetics d.o.o. to modernise its operations, increase its competitiveness and comply with international standards. The implementation of ISO 14001 will optimize resource use and reduce the environmental footprint, while ISO 27001 will ensure data protection and resilience to security threats. The project is implemented according to the PDCA methodology, with continuous monitoring and improvement of the process. Certification will strengthen the market position of companies, increase customer confidence and contribute to sustainable development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt certifikacije prema ISO 14001 (Sustav upravljanja okolišem) i ISO 27001 (Sustav upravljanja informacijskom sigurnosti) omogućit će Milla Cosmetics d.o.o. modernizaciju poslovanja, povećanje konkurentnosti i usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima. Implementacija ISO 14001 optimizirat će korištenje resursa i smanjiti ekološki otisak, dok će ISO 27001 osigurati zaštitu podataka i otpornost na sigurnosne prijetnje. Projekt se provodi prema PDCA metodologiji, uz kontinuirano praćenje i poboljšanje procesa. Certifikacija će ojačati tržišni položaj poduzeća, povećati povjerenje klijenata i doprinijeti održivom razvoju.

Operation_Name_English: Product certification for expansion into new markets
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija proizvoda za širenje na nova tržišta
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to achieve international competitiveness of Kristalni Idea Ltd. through the certification of 4 innovative products (Respira, iMod, PointIn, PointOut) according to CE standards and the introduction of a quality management system according to ISO 9001:2015. The purpose is to enable entry into new markets, increase exports and improve product quality and safety. Expected results include increased competitiveness, improvement of business processes and employee training. The project will provide access to new markets, reduce barriers to export and long-term business growth through increased sales and innovative products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je postizanje međunarodne konkurentnosti Kristalne ideje d.o.o. kroz certificiranje 4 inovativna proizvoda (Respira, iMod, PointIn, PointOut) prema CE standardima te uvođenje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema ISO 9001:2015. Svrha je omogućiti ulazak na nova tržišta, povećanje izvoza i unapređenje kvalitete i sigurnosti proizvoda. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje konkurentnosti, poboljšanje poslovnih procesa te obuku zaposlenika. Projekt će omogućiti pristup novim tržištima, smanjenje prepreka za izvoz i dugoročni rast poduzeća kroz povećanu prodaju i inovativne proizvode.

Operation_Name_English: Future innovators - involving children and students in STEM education
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Budući inovatori - uključivanje djece i učenika u STEM edukacije
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The importance of applying STEM in the early childhood education and care system and in the primary education system is extremely high due to the growing demands for knowledge and skills in the labour market. In the Republic of Croatia, STEM has been recognized as an integral part of learning, and lately efforts have been made to maximize the coverage of children and students with STEM from the earliest age. The aim of the project is to strengthen the capacity of the association "ŽENA" to implement the program of promoting STEM among children and students (900 of them) in partnership with the Polytechnic of Šibenik and 2 kindergartens and 1 primary school. The goal will be achieved through the activities of strengthening the capacities of employees and volunteers of the association and educational institutions and through the implementation of STEM promotion activities among children and students.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Važnost primjene STEM-a u sustavu ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja te u sustavu osnovnoškolskog obrazovanja je izuzetno velika zbog sve većih zahtjeva za znanjima i vještinama na tržištu rada. U RH STEM kao sastavni dio učenja je prepoznat te se u posljednje vrijeme ulažu napori za što većim obuhvatom djece i učenika STEM-om od najranijeg doba. Cilj projekta je jačanje kapaciteta udruge "ŽENA" za provedbu programa promocije STEM-a među djecom i učenicima (njih 900) u partnerstvu s Veleučilištem Šibenik te 2 dječja vrtića i 1 osnovnom školom. Cilj ćemo ostvariti kroz aktivnosti jačanja kapaciteta zaposlenika i volontera udruge i odgojno -obrazovnih institucija te kroz provedbe aktivnosti promocije STEM-a među djecom i učenicima.

Operation_Name_English: Prevention of the institutionalisation of care for vulnerable groups and their social inclusion
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Prevencija institucionalizacije skrbi ranjivih skupina i njihovo socijalno uključivanje
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalisation of people over 65 and adults with disabilities. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life. During the project, 30 people will be employed to provide support services and support to 180 targeted groups.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije osoba starijih od 65 i odraslih osoba s invaliditetom. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge podrške i potpore u svakodnevnom životu. Tijekom projekta zaposlit će se 30 osoba za pružanje usluga potpore i podrške za 180 pripadnika ciljanih skupina.

Operation_Name_English: heptabit CLOAK&AM;DAGGER
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: heptabit CLOAK&DAGGER
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: The heptabit CLOAK&AM;DAGGER project aims to explore and develop 2 products, radical innovations whose application will allow easy upgrade of mobile devices and personal computers available today and enable users to fully secure communication, resistant to today's security threats, but also threats that will occur by developing quantum computers, allowing access to security solutions for users in the government and private sector and individual users. Protection will be achieved through research of post-quantum communication protocols, hardware architecture, methods of protection against physical compromise and security mechanisms at UX and AI level, and then through the development of prototypes and their demonstrations in the operational environment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt heptabit CLOAK&DAGGER za cilj ima istražiti i razviti 2 proizvoda, radikalne inovacije čija će primjena omogućiti jednostavnu nadogradnju danas dostupnih mobilnih uređaja i osobnih računala i omogućiti korisnicima potpuno sigurnu komunikaciju, otpornu na danas prisutne sigurnosne prijetnje, ali i prijetnje do kojih će doći razvojem kvantnih računala, omogućavajući pristup sigurnosnim rješenjima korisnicima u vladinom i privatnom sektoru i pojedinačnim korisnicima. Zaštita će se postići kroz istraživanje post-kvantnih komunikacijskih protokola, hardverske arhitekture, metoda zaštite od fizičke kompromitacije i sigurnosnih mehanizama na UX i UI razini, a zatim kroz razvoj prototipa i njihovih demonstracija u operativnom okruženju.

Operation_Name_English: STEP for STEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEP for STEM
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the STEP for STEM project is to strengthen the capacity of the Croatian Society of Geotechnical Engineers (HDIG) and partner associations (HDIO, OI Varaždin, AMAC-GFV and DGIT) to implement STEM promotion activities among primary school students. This will be achieved through a partnership of associations with the Faculty of Geotechnical Engineering, IV. Primary School Varaždin and Primary Schools in Klenovnik, Donja Voća and Maruševac. As a result of strengthened capacities, volunteers and employees of CSO project partners will develop programs of 6 "small STEM schools" and during the project implement them in the STEM center for children and youth in Varaždin, through at least 90 cycles and with at least 900 students. In this way, students will be encouraged and focused on their personal life and career path in STEM.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta STEP for STEM je jačanje kapaciteta Hrvatskog društva inženjera geotehnike (HDIG) i partnerskih udruga (HDIO, OI Varaždin, AMAC-GFV i DGIT) za provedbu aktivnosti promocije STEM-a među učenicima osnovnih škola. To će se postići kroz partnersku suradnju udruga s Geotehničkim fakultetom, IV. osnovnom školom Varaždin i osnovnim školama u Klenovniku, Donjoj Voći i Maruševcu. Kao rezultat ojačanih kapaciteta, volonteri i zaposlenici projektnih partnera OCD-a izradit će programe 6 "malih STEM škola" i tijekom projekta ih provesti u STEM centru za djecu i mlade u Varaždinu, kroz najmanje 90 ciklusa i s najmanje 900 učenika. Na taj će se način učenike nastojati potaknuti i usmjeriti na osobni životni i karijerni put u STEM području.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of children's crèches in the Municipality of Tkon
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja dječjih jaslica na području Općine Tkon
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: "Construction of nurseries in the Municipality of Tkon" is an innovative and environmentally friendly project that aims to provide infrastructure and material capacity to increase the availability and quality of early childhood education for children up to the age of 3 from the entire island of Pašman. The new prefabricated building of the regional institution will provide 1 additional living room for the accommodation of a total of 12 children, that is, the accommodation of children of crèche age from the area of the Municipality of Tkon and children from the area of the Municipality of Pašman, which also promotes the work-life balance of the island's population.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: "Izgradnja dječjih jaslica na području Općine Tkon" predstavlja inovativan i okolišno prihvatljiv projekt koji ima za cilj osigurati infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete za povećanje dostupnosti i kvalitete ranog predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja za djecu do navršene 3 godine s područja cijelog otoka Pašmana. Nova montažna zgrada područne ustanove omogućiti će 1 dodatni dnevni boravak za smještaj ukupno 12 djece, odnosno smještaj djece jasličke dobi s područja Općine Tkon i djece s područja Općine Pašman čime se promiče i ravnoteža poslovnog i privatnog života otočnog stanovništva.

Operation_Name_English: WORLD - STEM Skills for Strengthening Educational and Technological Innovations; Education, Progress and Creativity
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SVJETIONIK - STEM Vještine za Jačanje Edukacijskih i Tehnoloških Inovacija; Obrazovanje, Napredak i Kreativnost
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project is aimed at strengthening specific knowledge and skills among volunteers/employees of CSOs, educational staff, children and students, through the processing of relevant and adapted topics related to the issue of climate change through STEM areas. Project activities include organizing 120 STEM educational workshops for children and students per year and strengthening the capacities of volunteers/employees of CSOs and partner schools, through training and mentoring of experts from the Faculty of Science Split, education, study visits and professional conferences. 12 public events per year will also be organised to stimulate interest in STEM fields and sustainable development, strengthening young people's skills for the challenges of the future in an interesting and interactive way.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je usmjeren na jačanje specifičnih znanja i vještina među volonterima/zaposlenicima OCD-ova, odgojno-obrazovnim djelatnicima, djecom i učenicima, kroz obradu relevantnih i prilagođenih tema vezanih uz problematiku klimatskih promjena kroz STEM područja. Aktivnosti projekta uključuju organizaciju 120 STEM edukativnih radionica za djecu i učenike godišnje te jačanje kapaciteta volontera/zaposlenika OCD-ova i partnerskih škola, kroz izobrazbe i mentoriranje stručnjaka s PMF-a Split, edukacije, studijske posjete i stručne konferencije. Organizirat će se i 12 javnih manifestacija godišnje kako bi se potaknuo interes za STEM područja i održivi razvoj, jačajući vještine mladih za izazove budućnosti na zanimljiv i interaktivan način.

Operation_Name_English: Vučedol Archaeological Park - Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Arheološki park Vučedol - faza II
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is to significantly contribute to the economic revitalization and development of the city of Vukovar, Vukovar-Srijem County and the wider region by building and arranging the Vučedol Archaeological Park (AP) through the improvement of cultural (archaeological) and tourist infrastructure and offer, communal infrastructure, the promotion of tourism, the development of entrepreneurship and rural space, the use of new technologies and creative ideas in education, presentation and promotion of unique culture and historical heritage in the park area. The project envisages investing in the decoration and additional facilities of the archaeological museum, as well as the accompanying infrastructure for visitors. The applicant/future user is the Vučedol Culture Museum established in 2013 by the Republic of Croatia.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog projekta je značajno doprinijeti gospodarskoj revitalizaciji i razvoju grada Vukovara, Vukovarsko-srijemske županije i šire regije izgradnjom i uređenjem Arheološkog parka Vučedol (AP) kroz unapređenje kulturne (arheološke) i turističke infrastrukture i ponude, komunalne infrastrukture, promociju turizma, razvoj poduzetništva i ruralnog prostora, korištenjem novih tehnologija i kreativnih ideja pri obrazovanju, prezentaciji i promociji jedinstvene kulture i povijesne baštine na prostoru parka. Projekt predviđa ulaganje u uređenje i dodatne sadržaje arheološkog muzeja, te popratnu infrastrukturu za posjetitelje. Prijavitelj/budući korisnik je Muzej Vučedolske kulture osnovan 2013. od strane Republike Hrvatske.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of ISO process management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje ISO sustava upravljanja procesima
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project will carry out an analysis of the existing situation, preparation for compliance with the standard and certification according to ISO 27001:2022. Compliance with the standard will allow us to manage risks and protect against threats so that information assets, from financial information and intellectual property to employee data and much more, are safe. The introduction of the standard itself will increase the market competitiveness of companies, as they will be able to participate in public tenders in which the contracting authority is required to hold an ISO 27001 certificate as a condition. The project will run for 9 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta izvršit će se analiza postojećeg stanja, priprema za usklađivanje sa normom i certifikacija prema normi ISO 27001:2022. Usklađivanje sa normom omogućit će nam upravljanje rizicima i zaštitu od prijetnji kako bi informacijska imovina, od financijskih informacija i intelektualnog vlasništva do podataka o zaposlenicima i još mnogo toga bila sigurna. Uvođenje samog standarda povećat će tržišnu konkurentnost poduzeća jer će moći sudjelovati u javnim natječajima na kojima se kao uvjet od naručitelja traži posjedovanje certifikata ISO 27001. Provedba projekta trajat će 9 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment and certification of an integrated management system according to IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uspostava i certifikacija integriranog sustava upravljanja prema normama IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 i ISO 45001
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: By implementing this project, the company SUSRET d.o.o. will introduce into the business management system according to the standards IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, which will enable more efficient business management, a better response to market needs and the creation of a sustainable competitive advantage. The aim of the project is to contribute to the efficiency and sustainability of business processes, facilitate and improve access to the international market, strengthen international competitiveness and increase customer confidence and company reputation. The project results are certified management system according to IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards and increased sales and export revenues.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom ovog projekta poduzeće SUSRET d.o.o. uvesti će u poslovanje sustava upravljanja prema normama IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 i ISO 45001, čime će omogućiti učinkovitije upravljanje poslovanjem, bolji odgovor na potrebe tržišta i stvaranje održive konkurentske prednosti. Cilj projekta je pridonijeti učinkovitosti i održivosti poslovnih procesa, olakšati i poboljšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu, ojačati međunarodnu konkurentnost te povećati povjerenje kupaca i ugled poduzeća. Rezultati projekta su certificirani sustav upravljanja prema normama IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 i ISO 45001 te povećani prihodi od prodaje i izvoza.

Operation_Name_English: Sustainable Harvest and Solar Optimization (SHADOW)
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Održiva berba uz solarnu optimizaciju / Sustainable Harvest and Solar Optimization (SHADOW)
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project consortium consisting of 5 SMEs and 2 OIŠZ addresses the challenge of balancing the needs of energy and agriculture through research and development of an automated system of agro-sun power plants (ASE). The aim of the project is to optimize the production of food and energy through innovative technology that enables the joint use of space and thus ensure the contribution to the development of priority niches grouped in Adriatic Croatia's RLV within the S3 thematic areas of Green and Clean Energy and Digital Products and Platforms. Target groups include farmers, energy experts and those interested in sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni konzorcij sastavljen od 5 MSP-ova i 2 OIŠZ-a bavi se izazovom balansiranja potreba energetike i poljoprivrede kroz istraživanje i razvoj automatiziranog sustav agrosunčanih elektrana (ASE). Cilj projekta je optimizirati proizvodnju hrane i energije kroz inovativnu tehnologiju koja omogućuje zajedničku uporabu prostora te tako osigurati doprinos razvoju prioritetnih niša grupiranih u RLV Jadranske Hrvatske u okviru S3 tematskih područja Zelena i čista energija te Digitalni proizvodi i platforme. Ciljne skupine uključuju poljoprivrednike, energetske stručnjake i zainteresirane za održivost.

Operation_Name_English: Reconstruction and upgrading of the St. Peter's Gate Petra in the City Port of Split
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcija i dogradnja Gata sv. Petra u Gradskoj luci Split
Category_Label: Seaports (TEN-T) excluding facilities dedicated to transport of fossil fuels
Operation_Summary_English: Purpose of the project "Reconstruction and upgrading of the Gat Sv. Petra in the City Port of Split" is aimed at increasing manipulative space and reducing traffic congestion of vehicles and vessels. The expansion of the pier by about 53 meters will enable 5.350 m2 of new area, the construction of two new ones and the extension and extension of three existing ro-ro (ferry) ramps, which will improve the capacity for the reception of larger vessels and ferry traffic. Reducing congestion and reducing the boarding time of passengers and vehicles are the main objectives, and the project also contributes to reducing CO2 emissions and noise in the city of Split. Modernization activities will directly increase the availability of scheduled coastal traffic for island residents and other users, including tourists and businessmen.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta "Rekonstrukcija i dogradnja Gata sv. Petra u Gradskoj luci Split" usmjerena je na povećanje manipulativnog prostora i smanjenje zagušenosti prometa vozila i plovila. Proširenje gata za oko 53 metra omogućit će 5.350 m² nove površine, izgradnju dvije nove te dogradnju i proširenje tri postojeće ro-ro (trajektne) rampe, čime će se poboljšati kapacitet za prihvat većih plovila i trajektni promet. Smanjenje gužvi i skraćenje vremena ukrcaja putnika te vozila glavni su ciljevi, a projekt doprinosi i smanjenju emisija CO2 i buke u gradu Splitu. Aktivnosti modernizacije direktno će povećati dostupnost obalnog linijskog prometa za stanovnike otoka i druge korisnike, uključujući turiste i gospodarstvenike.

Operation_Name_English: Want a better life in the wolf
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi bolji život u općini Vuka
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services

Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Potpora sustavu civilne zaštite za helikoptersko spašavanje

Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to increase preparedness for disaster management by strengthening the capabilities and capacities of operational forces in the Republic of Croatia (hereinafter: Croatia) through the procurement of one (1) multi-purpose equipped helicopter, assembly hangar and associated equipment for the needs of the civil protection system as well as training of operational forces and civil protection system participants to use multi-purpose equipped helicopter and equipment, for action in the event of emergencies, major accidents and disasters. Helicopter support to the civil protection system will thus ensure the ability of all operational forces and civil protection system participants to operate in a timely and efficient manner in the event of emergencies, major accidents and disasters
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je povećanje spremnosti za upravljanje katastrofama kroz jačanje sposobnosti i kapaciteta operativnih snaga u Republici Hrvatskoj (dalje u tekstu: RH) kroz nabavu jednog (1) višenamjenski opremljenog helikoptera, montažnog hangara i popratne opreme za potrebe sustava civilne zaštite kao i obuke operativnih snaga i sudionika sustava civilne zaštite za korištenje višenamjenski opremljenog helikoptera i opreme, za djelovanje u slučaju izvanrednih događaja, velikih nesreća i katastrofa. Helikopterska potpora sustavu civilne zaštite tako će osigurati sposobnost pravovremenog i efikasnog operativnog djelovanja svih operativnih snaga i sudionika sustava civilne zaštite u slučaju izvanrednih događaja, velikih nesreća i katastrofa

Operation_Name_English: Together we are safer III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno smo sigurniji III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The realization of the project "Together we are safer III", will influence the increase of social inclusion and the prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups through the provision of long-term care in their local community. The project will employ 15 service providers who will take care of 90 users. The service will be provided in the area of Šibenik-Knin County, while the public and the target group will be informed about the project through promotional tools (websites, media, posters, leaflets and conferences).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Realizacijom projekta "Zajedno smo sigurniji III", utjecat će se na povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevenciju institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina kroz osiguranje dugotrajne skrbi u njihovoj lokalnoj zajednici. Na projektu će biti zaposleno 15 pružatelja usluge koji će brinuti o 90 korisnika. Usluga će biti pružena na području Šibensko-kninske županije dok će javnost i ciljana skupina o projektu biti informirana putem promotivnih alata (web stranice, medija, plakata, letaka i konferencija).

Operation_Name_English: Construction of Kindergarten Kuševac
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja dječjeg vrtića Kuševac
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project Construction of a kindergarten in Kuševac is aimed at creating a modern and functional space for preschool education.The project includes the construction of two living rooms, one nursery group and one kindergarten group, which will provide adequate accommodation and care for children of different ages. The aim of the project is to meet the needs of the local community for additional capacities of preschool institutions and to provide a safe, stimulating and quality environment for children's development. The project will significantly improve the availability and quality of educational services in Kuševac, providing support to families in the area, thus contributing to the objectives and indicators of the call.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Izgradnje dječjeg vrtića u Kuševcu usmjeren je na stvaranje modernog i funkcionalnog prostora za predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje.Projekt obuhvaća izgradnju dva dnevna boravka, jednu jasličku skupinu i jednu vrtićku skupinu, čime će se omogućiti odgovarajući smještaj i briga za djecu različitih uzrasta. Cilj projekta je zadovoljiti potrebe lokalne zajednice za dodatnim kapacitetima predškolskih ustanova te osigurati sigurno, poticajno i kvalitetno okruženje za razvoj djece. Projekt će značajno unaprijediti dostupnost i kvalitetu obrazovnih usluga u Kuševcu, pružajući podršku obiteljima u tom području te će se na taj način doprinjeti ciljevima i pokazateljima poziva.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of KRIK STUDIO d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards

Planirane aktivnosti: 1. Implementacija i certificiranje sustava prema normi ISO 9001:2015 2. Implementacija i certificiranje sustava prema normi ISO 27001:2022

Operation_Name_English: Development of innovative IT solutions in destination tourism - Green DestiPay-IS
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inovativnog IT rješenja u destinacijskom turizmu - Green DestiPay-IS

The Green DestiPay-IS destination tourism project, implemented within the SPIN consortium, consists of 3 business entities, all three of which belong to the SME category: Utiliter d.o.o., Collective Mind Lab d.o.o. and Mil-sunce d.o.o. will be in charge of testing the product and the project associate, the public law body of the University of Applied Sciences Baltazar. Operation_Name_English: Certainly in the future
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sigurno u budućnost
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: With the project "Safe in the Future" for employees, trade union trustees and volunteers of applicants and partners, we ensure access to professional, negotiation and communication knowledge and the renewal of existing ones, create conditions for the exchange of experience and best practices for quality, fast and efficient solving of problems and challenges in social dialogue, encourage the resolution of inter-trade union conflicts with the development of partnerships and cooperation, promote networking, trade union activism and the importance of social partnership, improve respect for workers' rights and collective agreements, and build a digital platform that will ensure more efficient implementation of business processes and improve communication with membership.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Sigurno u budućnost" za zaposlenike, sindikalne povjerenike i volontere prijavitelja i partnera osiguravamo pristup stručnim, pregovaračkim i komunikacijskim znanjima i obnovi postojećih, kreiramo uvjete za razmjenu iskustva i najboljih praksi za kvalitetno, brzo i efikasno rješavanje problema i izazova u socijalnom dijalogu, potičemo rješavanje međusindikalnih sukoba uz razvoj partnerstva i suradnje, promičemo umrežavanje, sindikalni aktivizam i važnost soc. partnerstva, unapređujemo poštivanje prava radnika i kolektivnih ugovora, te gradimo digitalnu platformu kojom ćemo osigurati učinkovitiju provedbu poslovnih procesa i unaprijediti komunikaciju s članstvom.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening competitiveness by certification of management systems according to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 50001:2018
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti certifikacijom sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 i ISO 50001:2018
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of the company Tehno-Razvoj d.o.o. by certifying the management system according to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 50001:2018. The purpose is to standardize business processes and establish a management system in an environmentally and energy-sustainable way, aligned with international standards. Expected results include increased customer confidence, easier access to foreign markets and increased export revenues. By implementing the certificate, the applicant will optimize processes, reduce risks and ensure recognition as a reliable and safe partner in the international market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poduzeća Tehno-razvoj d.o.o. certifikacijom sustava upravljanja prema ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 i ISO 50001:2018. Svrha je standardizacija poslovnih procesa i uspostava sustava upravljanja na ekološki i energetski održiv način, usklađen s međunarodnim standardima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje povjerenja klijenata, olakšan pristup inozemnim tržištima i rast prihoda od izvoza. Implementacijom certifikata Prijavitelj će optimizirati procese, smanjiti rizike i osigurati prepoznatljivost kao pouzdan i siguran partner na međunarodnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction and certification of the management system of Saron Management Solutions d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje i certificiranje sustava upravljanja Saron Management Solutions d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the introduction and certification of a quality management system according to the ISO 9001:2015 standard, which will increase the competitiveness of Saron Management Solutions d.o.o. on the national and international market and enable further growth in accordance with strategic goals. The implementation of the system will ensure the standardisation of business processes, greater operational efficiency and compliance with internationally recognized standards, which will improve the quality of services and the trust of clients, partners and suppliers. Through the implementation of the project, the company will have access to new markets and participate in contracts requiring certified service providers, thereby strengthening the market position and ensuring sustainable growth.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje i certificiranje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema normi ISO 9001:2015, čime će se povećati konkurentnost Saron Management Solutions d.o.o. na nacionalnom i međunarodnom tržištu te omogućiti daljnji rast u skladu sa strateškim ciljevima. Implementacija sustava osigurat će standardizaciju poslovnih procesa, veću operativnu učinkovitost i usklađenost s međunarodno priznatim normama, čime će se unaprijediti kvaliteta usluga i povjerenje klijenata, partnera i dobavljača. Provedbom projekta poduzeće će imati pristup novim tržištima te sudjelovati u ugovorima koji zahtijevaju certificirane pružatelje usluga, čime će ojačati tržišnu poziciju i osigurati održivi rast.

Operation_Name_English: Level Up STEM: Explore, learn, create!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Level Up STEM: Istraži, nauči, stvori!
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Level Up STEM: Explore, learn, create!" aims to strengthen the capacity of civil society organizations to promote STEM among children and students in Istria County. Through cooperation with the University, CSOs will acquire new knowledge and skills for the implementation of innovative STEM programs that they will implement in cooperation with educational institutions. Project activities include trainings and study visits for CSO staff and a number of various workshops for children and students in the field of 3D technology, robotics, mathematics and programming. This project will improve the quality of education and stimulate children's and students' interest in science and technology, thus contributing to their future education and career in STEM fields.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Level Up STEM: Istraži, nauči, stvori!" ima za cilj jačanje kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva za promociju STEM-a među djecom i učenicima u Istarskoj županiji. Kroz suradnju sa Sveučilištem OCD-i će steći nova znanja i vještine za provedbu inovativnih STEM programa koje će provoditi i u suradnji s odgojno-obrazovnim institucijama. Projektne aktivnosti uključuju izobrazbe i studijske posjete za djelatnike OCD-a te niz raznih radionice za djecu i učenike u području 3D tehnologije, robotike, matematike i programiranja. Ovim projektom poboljšati će se kvaliteta edukacije i potaknuti interes djece i učenika za znanost i tehnologiju, a čime ćemo doprinijeti njihovom budućem obrazovanju i karijeri u STEM područjima.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of ALUK TIM d.o.o. by certifying products according to international standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća ALUK TIM d.o.o. certificiranjem proizvoda prema međunarodnim normama

The target groups of the project include architects, designers, construction companies, investors and end-users, who will benefit from safer and more reliable certified continuous glass fence systems. The implementation of the project ensures easier access to international
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća ALUK TIM d.o.o. certificiranjem proizvoda prema međunarodnim normama“ usmjeren je na certificiranje sustava kontinuiranih staklenih ograda prema normi DIN 18008-4, čime se osigurava njihova sigurnost, kvaliteta i usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima. Ciljne skupine projekta uključuju arhitekte, projektante, građevinske tvrtke, investitore i krajnje korisnike, koji će imati koristi od sigurnijih i pouzdanijih certificiranih sustava kontinuiranih staklenih ograda. Provedbom projekta osigurava se lakši pristup međunarodnim

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of the water communal infrastructure of the agglomeration Lipik-Pakrac - PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Poboljšanje vodno-komunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Lipik-Pakrac - FAZA 2
Category_Label: Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Improvement of the water communal infrastructure of the Lipik-Pakrac agglomeration’ includes the City of Pakrac Town of Lipik. The project envisages: Reconstruction, extension and extension of 36,367 meters of the water supply system and reconstruction, extension and extension of 55,933 meters of the sewage system and upgrade of the existing WWTP from level I to level III with a capacity of 13,500 ES . The project is implemented in two phases over the 2014-2020 and 2021-2027 periods. PHASE 2 covers the completion of the construction of the UPOV with trial operation, Supervision over the execution of works, Project Management and Promotion and Visibility. The total value is 36.8 million. EUR 5 618 643.89, of which EUR 5 618 643.89 is a second-stage grant.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Poboljšanje vodno-komunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Lipik-Pakrac“ obuhvaća Grad Pakrac Grad Lipik U okviru projekta predviđeno je izvesti: Rekonstrukciju, dogradnju i proširenje 36.367 metara vodoopskrbnog sustava i rekonstrukciju, dogradnju i proširenje 55.933 metara sustava odvodnje otpadnih voda i nadogradnja postojećeg UPOV-a sa I. na III. stupanj sa kapacitetom 13.500 ES . Projekt se provodi u dvije faze kroz razdoblja 2014.–2020. i 2021.–2027. FAZA 2 obuhvaća završetak izgradnje UPOV-a s pokusnim radom, Nadzor nad izvođenjem radova, Upravljanje projektom i Promidžba i vidljivost. Ukupna vrijednost iznosi 36,8 mil. EUR, od čega bespovratna sredstva druge faze iznose 5.618.643,89 EUR.

Operation_Name_English: Further develop quality assurance systems in adult education and raise awareness of the importance of lifelong learning
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Daljnji razvoj sustava osiguravanja kvalitete u obrazovanju odraslih i podizanje svijesti o važnosti cjeloživotnog učenja
Category_Label: Support for adult education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve the quality assurance system by conducting external evaluation of adult education institutions and promoting various opportunities for lifelong learning in the Republic of Croatia and strengthening the competences of educational staff from the adult education system. The main activities are the further development of the quality assurance system in adult education, the strengthening of competences of educational staff and other stakeholders and the promotion of lifelong learning.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je unaprjeđenje sustava osiguravanja kvalitete provedbom vanjskog vrednovanja ustanova za obrazovanje odraslih i promocija različitih mogućnosti za cjeloživotno učenje u RH te jačanje kompetencija obrazovnog osoblja iz sustava obrazovanja odraslih. Glavne aktivnosti su daljnji razvoj sustava osiguravanja kvalitete u obrazovanju odraslih, jačanje kompetencija obrazovnog osoblja i ostalih dionika i promocija cjeloživotnog učenja.

Operation_Name_English: New Port of Korčula - Port of Polačište - Phase II of the project
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Nova luka Korčula - luka Polačište – II. faza projekta
Category_Label: Other seaports
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the ‘New Port of Korčula – Port of Polačište’ project is to modernise the transport infrastructure on the island of Korčula and improve connectivity between the island of Korčula and the surrounding islands and the mainland, as well as to create better conditions for increasing the quality of life of islanders. The implementation of the project has a positive impact on improving the accessibility of the island of Korčula for its inhabitants. The total value of the project is EUR 25,178,091.41, of which the eligible costs are EUR 24,238,314.81. The total value of the project in phase II is EUR 17,919,594.39, and the eligible costs are EUR 17,009,870.56. The planned duration of the project in phase II is 31 months, from 01.06.2023 to 31.12.2025.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta „Nova luka Korčula – luka Polačište,“ je modernizacija prometne infrastrukture na otoku Korčuli i poboljšavanje povezanosti između otoka Korčule s okolnim otocima i kopnom, ali i stvaranje boljih uvjeta za povećanje kvalitete života otočana. Provedba projekta pozitivno utječe na poboljšanje dostupnosti otoka Korčule za njegove stanovnike. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 25.178.091,41 EUR, od čega su prihvatljivi troškovi 24.238.314,81 EUR. Ukupna vrijednost projekta u II fazi je 17.919.594,39 EUR, a prihvatljivi su troškovi u iznosu od 17.009.870,56 EUR. Planirano trajanje projekta u fazi II je 31 mjesec, od 01.06.2023. do 31.12.2025.

Operation_Name_English: Revitalization of the hot water network in the City of Zagreb - Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Revitalizacija vrelovodne mreže na području grada Zagreba - 2. faza
Category_Label: High efficiency co-generation, district heating and cooling
Operation_Summary_English: More than half of the existing hot water network of the central heating system of the city of Zagreb was built in the period when the technology of canal laying of hot water was used, which led to increased heat losses and an increased number of interruptions in the supply of heat energy. The project, in the period until 31.12.2026, is planned to replace 25.406 km of 66.182 km of the most critical sections of the hot water network with the aim of increasing the energy efficiency of the heat system and the reliability of the heat supply in the city of Zagreb. The project in question represents the second phase of the ‘Revitalisation of the hot water network in the City of Zagreb’. As part of the first phase, in the period until 31 December 2023, the exchange of 40,776 km of 66,182 km of shares was carried out.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Više od polovice postojeće vrelovodne mreže centralnog toplinskog sustava grada Zagreba je izgrađeno u razdoblju kada se koristila tehnologija kanalnog polaganja vrelovoda, što je dovelo do povećanih toplinskih gubitaka i povećanog broja prekida opskrbe toplinskom energijom. Projektom je, u razdoblju do 31.12.2026 godine, planirana zamjena 25,406 km od 66,182 km najkritičnijih dionica vrelovodne mreže s ciljem povećanja energetske učinkovitosti toplinskog sustava i pouzdanosti opskrbe toplinskom energijom na području grada Zagreba. Predmetni projekt predstavlja drugu fazu „Revitalizacije vrelovodne mreže na području grada Zagreba“. U sklopu prve faze, u razdoblju do 31.12.2023. godine, provedena je zamjena 40,776 km od 66,182 km dionica.

Operation_Name_English: ‘With a smile at school’ – assistants in the teaching of Makarska schoolchildren – phase VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: “S osmijehom u školu“ – pomoćnici u nastavi makarskih školaraca - faza VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide inclusive education to students with developmental disabilities by hiring teaching assistants in two primary schools in Makarska in order to contribute to the elimination of prejudice, the improvement of students' educational achievements, their more successful socialization and emotional functioning. As part of this project, 18 teaching assistants will be recruited annually to work with a total of 24 students with developmental disabilities, providing them with the necessary support and assistance in their educational process. The project will include, according to the projections of the professional services of the two partner schools, the same number of assistants and students during all 3 years of implementation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju angažiranjem pomoćnika u nastavi u dvije osnovne škole u Makarskoj kako bi se pridonijelo eliminaciji predrasuda, poboljšanju obrazovnih postignuća učenika, njihovoj uspješnijoj socijalizaciji i emocionalnom funkcioniranju. U okviru predmetnog projekta, zaposlit će se 18 pomoćnika u nastavi godišnje koji će raditi s ukupno 24 učenika s razvojnim teškoćama, pružajući im potrebnu podršku i pomoć u njihovom obrazovnom procesu. Navedeni projekt tijekom sve 3 godine provedbe uključit će, prema projekcijama stručnih službi dvije škole partnera, isti broj pomoćnika i učenika.

Operation_Name_English: Development Tests on Orqa BodyCam and Bluetooth Module Products
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvojna ispitivanja na proizvodima Orqa BodyCam i Bluetooth modul
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The applicant is engaged in the development of a very complex technology of a wide range of applications (industry, public safety, unmanned systems), and is based on low latency video signal transmission. Such systems consist of a large number of components that are subject to different regulatory rules, which vary from one country to another. The aim of this project is to conduct tests and measurements for the purpose of obtaining the necessary certificates as one of the prerequisites for the placing on the market of two new products - Orqa BodyCam and Bluetooth modules.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavitelj se bavi razvojem vrlo kompleksne tehnologije širokog spektra primjene (industrija, javna sigurnost, bespilotni sustavi), a bazirana je na prijenosu video signala niske latencije. Takvi sustavi se sastoje od velikog broja komponenata koje podliježu različitim regulatornim pravilima koja se razlikuju ovisno o državi. Cilj ovog projekta je provesti ispitivanja i mjerenja za potrebe ishodovanja potrebnih certifikata kao jedan od preduvjeta za plasiranje na tržište dva nova proizvoda - Orqa BodyCam-a i Bluetooth modula.

Operation_Name_English: OPATIJA - CITY OF ONE POSSIBILITY
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: OPATIJA - GRAD JEDNAKIH MOGUĆNOSTI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The City of Opatija and Primary School Rikard Katalinić Jeretov as a Partner apply the project "Opatija - the city of ONE POSSIBILITY". Through the implementation of the mandatory activities of the Call, the goal of the project will be achieved, employing 10 PUN/CPC for the purpose of ensuring inclusive education for 10 students with developmental disabilities, their more successful socialization and emotional functioning.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Grad Opatija i OŠ Rikard Katalinić Jeretov kao Partner prijavljuju projekt "Opatija - grad JEDNAKIH MOGUĆNOSTI". Kroz provedbu obavezne aktivnosti Poziva ostvarit će se cilj projekta, zapošljavanje 10 PUN/SKP u svrhu osiguranja inkluzivnog obrazovanja za 10 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju, njihovu uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje.

Operation_Name_English: WANT TO BE IN THE CAPELLE
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI U KAPELI
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "WANTS IN THE CAPEL" will employ 10 people to provide support and support services in everyday life and deliver monthly packages of personal household and hygiene supplies to 60 users from the target group (people over 65 and adults with disabilities) for 28 months. The implementation of the project will improve the level of quality of life for beneficiaries who need support and support in carrying out their daily activities, as well as household assistance and their social integration with the aim of increasing social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization. The project is implemented in the municipality of Kapela in Bjelovar-Bilogora County for a total duration of 34 months, and the estimated value of the project is 420.000,00 EUR.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "ZAŽELI U KAPELI" zaposliti će se 10 osoba za pružanje usluga potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu te dostavu mjesečnih paketa osobnih kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština za 60 korisnika iz ciljane skupine (osobe starije od 65 godina i odrasle osobe s invaliditetom) tijekom 28 mjeseci. Provedbom projekta poboljšat će se razina kvalitete života korisnicima kojima je potrebna potpora i podrška u obavljanju svakodnevnih aktivnosti te pomoć u kućanstvu i njihovoj socijalnoj integraciji s ciljem povećanja socijalne uključenosti i prevencije institucionalizacije. Projekt se provodi na području općine Kapela u Bjelovarsko-bilogorskoj županiji u ukupnom trajanju od 34 mjeseca, a predviđena vrijednost projekta je 420.000,00 EUR.

Operation_Name_English: We want a dignified age and inclusion in the community
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželimo dostojanstvenu starost i inkluziju u zajednici
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Providing long-term care through the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of a package of necessities that includes organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and long needs for 33 months, will increase social inclusion for 180 members of the target group from the area of the Vrbanja municipality (Vrbanja village, Soljani and Strošinci) - people over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities. 30 service providers will be recruited. A project team will be formed to monitor and control the services performed, conduct the procurement procedure, and for the communication and conductivity of the project.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Osiguravanje dugotrajne skrbi kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja obuhvaća organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene i dugih potreba tijekom 33 mjeseca, povećat će se socijalna uključenost za 180 pripadnika ciljane skupine s područja općine Vrbanja (naselja Vrbanja, Soljani i Strošinci) - osobe starije od 65 godina i odrasle osobe s invaliditetom. Zaposlit će se 30 pružatelja usluga. Formirat će se projektni tim za praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, provođenje postupka nabave te za komunikaciju i vodljivost projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Safety and quality on the way to conquering new markets of Le’slastice d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Sigurnost i kvaliteta na putu osvajanja novih tržišta poduzeća Le’slastice d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the Safety and Quality on the way to conquering new markets of Le’slastice d.o.o. project is to implement and certify a management system according to the internationally recognised IFS standard (version 8) in Le’Slastice d.o.o., which will ensure high safety and quality standards in the production of confectionery products. The implementation of the project will optimize internal business processes and strengthen the position on domestic and international markets, satisfying the requirements of the retail chains with which the applicant cooperates or will cooperate, and improving consumer confidence in products from its own pastry assortment.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta Sigurnost i kvaliteta na putu osvajanja novih tržišta poduzeća Le’slastice d.o. je implementirati i certificirati sustav upravljanja prema međunarodno priznatoj normi IFS (verzija 8) u poduzeću Le’Slastice d.o.o., čime će se osigurati visoki standardi sigurnosti i kvalitete u proizvodnji slastičarskih proizvoda. Provedbom projekta optimizirat će se interni poslovni procesi te ojačati pozicija na domicilnom i međunarodnim tržištima, zadovoljavajući zahtjeve trgovačkih lanaca s kojima prijavitelj surađuje ili će surađivati te unaprjeđujući povjerenje potrošača u proizvode iz vlastitog slastičarskog asortimana.

Operation_Name_English: Research and development of dynamic flow-loop system and integrated gas analysis process encapsulated at an industrial facility for the purpose of disposal of Co2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Istraživanje i razvoj dinamičkog flow-loop sustava i integriranog procesa analize plina kaptiranog na industrijskom postrojenju u svrhu zbrinjavanja Co2
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
NUTS3_Label: Brodsko-posavska županija|Sisačko-moslavačka županija|Osječko-baranjska županija|Vukovarsko-srijemska županija|Grad Zagreb
Operation_Summary_English: The project involves the research and development of a dynamic flow-loop system to test the impact of different flow conditions and CO2 admixtures on equipment made of different materials in the CCS chain and an integrated gas analysis process encapsulated at an industrial plant. The success of the project implementation and the placement of innovative products on the market would enable industrial facilities to improve CO2 capture, transport and storage technology. A Consortium was formed with partners to be involved in all key development components. By collaborating with different partners, the project will create high-quality products, optimized and ready to commercialize to the global capture market Co2. The target groups are CO2 emitters in industrial installations.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt uključuje istraživanje i razvoj dinamičkog flow-loop sustava za ispitivanje utjecaja različitih protočnih uvjeta i primjesa CO2 na opremu od različitih materijala u CCS lancu i integriranog procesa analize plina kaptiranog na industrijskom postrojenju. Uspješnost provedbe projekta i plasman inovativnih proizvoda na tržište omogućili bi da industrijska postrojenja unaprijede tehnologiju hvatanja, transporta i skladištenja CO2. Formiran je Konzorcij s partnerima koji će biti uključeni u sve ključne komponente razvoja. Suradnjom različitih partnera, projekt će stvoriti visokokvalitetne proizvode, optimizirane i spremne za komercijalizaciju na globalno tržište hvatanja Co2. Ciljane skupine su emiteri CO2 u industrijskim postrojenjima.

Operation_Name_English: Employment of women for the benefit of the community - Phase III
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zapošljavanje žena za dobrobit zajednice - faza III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support services to socially vulnerable people with special emphasis on the elderly and people with disabilities through increased social inclusion through organized assistance in meeting basic living needs with the purpose of improving the quality of life and preventing institutionalization. The goals will be achieved through the care of 90 elderly people and people with disabilities for 30 months through providing the service of organizing food in the household of users, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and meeting everyday other needs with the distribution of hygiene packages on a monthly basis. The activity will be carried out in the area of the city of Drniš and the city of Šibenik in the duration of 30 months, with the project lasting 33 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške socijalno ugroženim osobama s posebnim naglaskom na starije i osobe s invaliditetom kroz povećanje socijalne uključenosti putem organizirane pomoći pri zadovoljenju osnovnih životnih potreba sa svrhom unapređenja kvalitete života i sprečavanja institucionalizacije. Ciljevi će se ostvariti putem skrbi o 90 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom tijekom 30 mjeseci kroz pružanje usluge organiziranja prehrane u domaćinstvu korisnika, obavljanju kućanskih poslova, održavanja osobne higijene te zadovoljenje svakodnevnih drugih potreba uz podjelu higijenskih paketa na mjesečnoj razini. Aktivnost će se provoditi na području grada Drniša i grada Šibenika u trajanju od 30 mj., s tim da će projekt trajati 33 mjeseca.

Operation_Name_English: Rest, you deserve it!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmorite, zaslužili ste!
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: With the project "Rest, You Deserve" and providing an innovative social service rest from care that includes adequate psychosocial support and a series of meaningful activities aimed at parents caregivers and caregivers as well as members of their families whom they care for themselves, we will empower them and improve their quality of life and help them cope more easily and successfully with the problems arising from their status. The project will be implemented in the eastern part of Zagreb County in partnership with the Red Cross City Society Vrbovec and will include 20 parents-carers as well as members of their families they care for and who are dependent on their support.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Odmorite, zaslužili ste" i pružanjem inovativne socijalne usluge odmor od skrbi koja uključuje adekvatnu psihosocijalnu podršku i niz smislenih aktivnosti usmjerenu roditeljima njegovateljima i njegovateljima kao i članovima njihovih obitelji o kojima sami skrbe, osnažit ćemo ih i unaprijediti njihovu kvalitetu življenja i pomoći im da se lakše i uspješnije nose s problematikom koja proizlazi iz njihova statusa. Projekt će se provoditi na području istočnog dijela Zagrebačke županije u partnerstvu s Gradskim društvom Crvenog križa Vrbovec a obuhvatiti će 20 roditelja-njegovatelja kao i članove njihovih obitelji o kojima skrbe i koji su ovisni o njihovoj podršci.

Operation_Name_English: Certification and implementation of the management system of Azara Adria d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija i uvođenje sustava upravljanja društva Azara Adria d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Support for companies to certify products and implement management systems
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Potpora poduzećima za certifikaciju proizvoda i uvođenje sustava upravljanja

Operation_Name_English: Give, empower, change
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Daruj, osnaži, mijenjaj
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Reducing the risk of further social exclusion of 65+ persons and persons with disabilities and providing them with assistance and support. Increasing social inclusion and prevention of institutionalisation through long-term care insurance. Recruitment of 20 people who will provide support and support services in everyday life to project beneficiaries. Assistance in preparing meals, obtaining food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene, delivering packages of household and hygiene supplies. Min 6 users per employee.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Smanjivanje rizika od daljnjeg socijalnog isključivanja osoba 65+ i osoba s invaliditetom i omogućavanje istima pomoć i podršku. Povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi. Zapošljavanje 20 osoba koje će pružati usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu korisnicima projekta. Pomoć u pripremi obroka, nabavi hrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene, dostava paketa kućanskih i higijenskih potrepština. Min 6 korisnika na jednu zaposlenu.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international competitiveness of Serengeti d.o.o. by introducing a quality management system and information security
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke Serengeti d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kvalitetom te informacijskom sigurnošću
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project "Increasing the international competitiveness of Serengeti d.o.o. by introducing a quality management system and information security" is to increase the international competitiveness of the company through the introduction of an information security management system according to the requirements of the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standard and a quality management system according to the requirements of the ISO 9001:2015 standard. The purpose of the project is to ensure high standards of safety and quality of products and services, increase customer confidence and facilitate entry to new international markets with their own software products.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta "Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke Serengeti d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kvalitetom te informacijskom sigurnošću'' je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću prema zahtjevima norme ISO/IEC 27001:2022 i sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema zahtjevima norme ISO 9001:2015. Svrha projekta je osigurati visoke standarde sigurnosti i kvalitete proizvoda i usluga, povećati povjerenje klijenata te olakšati ulazak na nova međunarodna tržišta vlastitim softverskim produktima.

Operation_Name_English: Clinical testing and validation of AI systems for early detection of neurodevelopmental deviations in infants SENDDToMedicalDevice
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kliničko testiranje i validacija AI sustava za ranu detekciju neurorazvojnih odstupanja kod dojenčadi SENDDToMedicalDevice
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: SENDDToMD aims at clinical validation and further testing of the SENDD AI system – a solution developed to support physicians in assessing spontaneous infant movements for early detection of neurodevelopmental deviations. Innovation vouchers will carry out the key phase of clinical trials required to register the system as a medical device (SaMD), testing and validating its application to the high-risk group – premature infants. Validation is carried out in cooperation with the Faculty of Education and Rehabilitation Sciences.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SENDDToMD ima za cilj kliničku validaciju i dodatno testiranje AI sustava SENDD – rješenja razvijenog kao podrške liječnicima u procjeni spontanih pokreta dojenčadi radi ranog otkrivanja neurorazvojnih odstupanja. Kroz inovacijske vaučere provest će se ključna faza kliničkih ispitivanja potrebnih za registraciju sustava kao medicinskog uređaja (SaMD), uz testiranje i validaciju njegove primjene na visoko neurorizičnoj skupini – nedonoščadi. Validacija se provodi u suradnji s Edukacijsko-rehabilitacijskim fakultetom.

Operation_Name_English: Automation of business processes powered by artificial intelligence
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Automatizacija poslovnih procesa pokretana umjetnom inteligencijom
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the ‘Automation of Artificial Intelligence-driven business processes’ project is to develop innovative ‘DOCUMAN Capture’ solutions and an independent software library for recording incoming accounts and bank statements using advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies, which will enable private and public entities to automate their accounting and documentation management processes. Through the cooperation of the academic and business community and public law bodies, the project will contribute to solving the social challenges of the region of Northern Croatia and enable the development of new digital products and services of high added value for the purpose of business diversification and economic transformation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj Projekta „Automatizacija poslovnih procesa pokretana umjetnom inteligencijom“ je razviti inovativna rješenja „DOCUMAN Capture“ i neovisnu programsku biblioteku za knjiženje ulaznih računa i bankovnih izvoda korištenjem naprednih tehnologija umjetne inteligencije i strojnog učenja, a koja će privatnim i javnim subjektima omogućiti automatizaciju procesa računovodstva i upravljanja dokumentacijom. Kroz suradnju akademske i poslovne zajednice te tijela javnog prava Projekt će doprinijeti rješavanju društvenih izazova regije Sjeverne Hrvatske i omogućiti razvoj novih digitalnih proizvoda i usluga visoke dodane vrijednosti u svrhu diversifikacije poslovanja i transformacije gospodarstva.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of the ISO 45001 system in the company AM projekt i trgovina d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava ISO 45001 u poduzeće AM projekti i trgovina d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: As part of the project, the applicant will implement 1 ISO standard, which is crucial for improving the process of implementing health and safety at work. Operation_Summary_English: The project Inclusion contributes to the social inclusion and integration of students with developmental difficulties by employing 93 educated PUN/CPC in 22 regular schools and 2 special educational institutions founded by the City of Rijeka.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Inkluzija pridonosi socijalnoj uključenosti i integraciji učenika s teškoćama u razvoju zapošljavanjem 93 educirana PUN/SKP u 22 redovne škole i 2 posebne odgojno-obrazovne ustanove kojima je osnivač grad Rijeka.

Operation_Name_English: The streams of knowledge - learning by discovery
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Potočići znanja - učenje otkrivanjem
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project is based on the cooperation of experts from the Faculty of Science, HPD, three kindergartens and four primary schools with the aim of strengthening the capacity to promote STEM. The project will enable shaping a positive attitude about STEM and contribute to increasing human resources in the field in the long term. In addition, the cooperation of university teachers, employees-popularizers of the association, educators and teachers of natural science subjects will contribute to the increase of their natural science competences for the creation and implementation of activities based on the strategy of learning through discovery. The goals will be achieved through a series of trainings, workshops, direct mentoring and public actions that will promote and strengthen the STEM competences of children, students and ultimately the general public.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se temelji na suradnji stručnjaka s PMF-a, HPD-a, tri dječja vrtića i četiri osnovne škole s ciljem jačanja kapaciteta za promociju STEM-a. Projekt će omogućiti oblikovanje pozitivnog stava o STEM-u i dugoročno doprinijeti povećanju ljudskih potencijala u tom području. Dodatno, suradnja sveučilišnih nastavnika, djelatnika-popularizatora udruge, odgojitelja i učitelja prirodoslovnih predmeta doprinijet će povećanju njihovih prirodoslovnih kompetencija za kreiranje i provođenje aktivnosti koje se temelje na strategiji učenja otkrivanjem. Ciljeve će se ostvariti nizom izobrazbi, radionica, izravnih mentoriranja i javnih akcija kojima će se promovirati i jačati STEM kompetencije djece, učenika i u konačnici šire javnosti.

Operation_Name_English: And you can
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: I ti možeš
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will provide 146 students with disabilities with teaching support in accordance with their individual needs by including 145 PUN/CPC, which will facilitate their participation in social and educational processes, contribute to the quantity and quality of acquired knowledge, the progress of their skills and abilities, the development of social skills through interaction, acceptance and respect of individual differences, and thus readiness for independent work and equal participation in the community, and the prevention of their discrimination. The implementation of the project will provide the conditions for improving their educational achievements, socialization and emotional functioning.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će za 146 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju biti osigurano pružanje potpore u nastavi u skladu sa njihovim individualnim potrebama uključivanjem 145 PUN/SKP, a što će im olakšati sudjelovanje u socijalnim i odgojno-obrazovnim procesima, doprinijeti kvantiteti i kvaliteti usvojenog znanja, napretku njihovih vještina i sposobnosti, razvoju socijalnih vještina kroz interakciju, prihvaćanje i poštivanje individualnih razlika, a time i spremnost za samostalni rad i ravnopravno sudjelovanje u zajednici, te sprečavanje njihove diskriminacije. Provedbom projekta će se osigurati uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, socijalizacije i emocionalnog funkcioniranja.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a management system according to ISO 9001:2015 standard that will make the company more competitive on the national and international market and thus enable it to further grow in accordance with strategic goals. The implementation of the management system and the acquisition of ISO certification will result in greater customer confidence, but also a more productive, efficient and secure business, which is the interest of the company, employees, clients and suppliers who are the target group of the project. By implementing the project, the company will be able to get new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards, and in which so far it has not been able to compete.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normi ISO 9001:2015 koji će tvrtku učiniti konkurentnijom na nacionalnom i internacionalnom tržištu te joj time omogućiti daljnji rast u skladu sa strateškim ciljevima. Implementacija sustava upravljanja i stjecanje ISO certifikata rezultirat će većim povjerenjem kupaca, ali i produktivnijim, efikasnijim i sigurnijim poslovanjem, što je interes tvrtke, djelatnika, klijenata i dobavljača koji su ciljana skupina projekta. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama, a u kojima do sada nije mogla konkurirati.

Operation_Name_English: Improving business and opening new markets by establishing an integrated management system according to ISO standards.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje poslovanja te otvaranje novih tržišta uspostavom integriranog sustava upravljanja prema ISO normama.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project establishes an integrated process management system, quality, information security and business according to ISO standards. The aim is to increase the international competitiveness of Reactor Studio by certifying management systems, ensuring higher quality of services, data security and more efficient business operations. ISO 9001 will increase quality management, standardize processes and increase customer satisfaction, ISO 27001 will reduce information security risks, and ISO 20000-1 will optimize IT services. Expected results are greater operational efficiency, lower costs, regulatory compliance and enhanced customer confidence, which paves the way for expansion to international markets.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se uspostavlja integrirani sustav upravljanja procesima, kvalitetom, sigurnošću informacija i poslovanjem prema ISO standardima. Cilj je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost Reactor Studia certifikacijom sustava upravljanja, osiguravajući višu kvalitetu usluga, sigurnost podataka i učinkovitije poslovanje. ISO 9001 povećat će upravljanje kvalitetom, standardizirati će procese i povećati zadovoljstvo klijenata, ISO 27001 smanjit će rizike informacijske sigurnosti, a ISO 20000-1 optimizirat IT usluge. Očekivani rezultati su veća operativna učinkovitost, manji troškovi, usklađenost s regulativama i jačanje povjerenja klijenata, što otvara put širenju na međunarodna tržišta.

Operation_Name_English: Together we can do anything! - 7
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno možemo sve! - 7
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Together We Can All 7" continues the good practice from the previous six implemented projects that provided PUN for students with disabilities in the Dubrovnik-Neretva County. The implementation of this project will enable students with disabilities to successfully participate in the education system in the environment in which they live.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Zajedno možemo sve 7" nastavlja se dobra praksa iz prethodnih šest provedenih projekata kojima su se osigurali PUN za učenike s teškoćama na području Dubrovačko-neretvanske županije. Provedbom ovog projekta učenicima s teškoćama omogućit će se uspješno uključivanje u sustav odgoja i obrazovanja u sredini u kojoj žive.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of TEHNO SISTEM d.o.o. through the implementation and certification of management systems
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti tvrtke TEHNO SISTEM d.o.o. kroz implementaciju i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of implementation and certification of international standards ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO 22301:2019 and ISO 20000-1:2018 aims to improve the business of Tehno Sistem d.o.o. by standardizing key processes, increasing quality and security and strengthening competitiveness. Activities in the duration of 12 months include analysis of the situation, preparation of documentation, education of employees, implementation of internal verification and preparation for certification audits. Certification covers the development and integration of software solutions and the provision of IT customer support. The results of the project are the implementation of four management systems and the acquisition of four ISO certificates, which makes the company a more reliable and competitive partner in the market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt implementacije i certifikacije međunarodnih standarda ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO 22301:2019 i ISO 20000-1:2018 ima za cilj unaprijediti poslovanje poduzeća Tehno Sistem d.o.o. kroz standardizaciju ključnih procesa, povećanje kvalitete i sigurnosti te jačanje konkurentnosti.
