Aktivnosti u tranjanju 12 mjeseci uključuju analizu stanja, izradu dokumentacije, edukaciju zaposlenika, provedbu unutarnje provjere i pripremu za certifikacijske audite. Certifikacija obuhvaća područje razvoja i integracije programskih rješenja te pružanja IT korisničke podrške. Rezultati projekta su implementacija četiri sustava upravljanja i stjecanje četiri ISO certifikata, čime poduzeće postaje pouzdaniji i konkurentniji partner na tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Support to Smile
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Podrškom do osmjeha
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of people over 65 years of age and adult OSI in island environments. The project will provide people over 65 years of age and OSI with support and support services in everyday life, which will result in an increase in the quality of life, encourage socialization and ensure a dignified life for people of third age and OSI.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije osoba starijih od 65 godina te odraslih OSI u otočnim sredinama. Projektom će se osobama starijim od 65 godina i OSI pružiti usluga podrške i potpore u svakodnevnom životu što će rezultirati povećanjem kvalitete života, potaknut će se socijalizacija i osigurati dostojanstven život osobama treće životne dobi i OSI.

Operation_Name_English: Syrmia Cultural Center
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Srijemski kulturni centar
Category_Label: Protection, development and promotion of cultural heritage and cultural services
Operation_Summary_English: The project involves the reconstruction of the building of the cultural centre with the aim of establishing the Syrmia Cultural Centre and the Syrmia Library as an infrastructural platform for the activities of local cultural associations. The activities of local cultural associations within the newly renovated center will ensure the diversity of cultural activities, organize educational, affirmative and creative workshops and through advanced technologies ensure social innovation in culture with the purpose of social inclusion of as many local population as possible, especially focusing on vulnerable target groups such as women, youth, unemployed and elderly people and ensure urbanization of the deprived rural area.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt podrazumijeva rekonstrukciju zgrade kulturnog centra s ciljem osnivanja Srijemskog kulturnog centra i Srijemske knjižnice kao infrastrukturne platforme za djelovanje lokalnih udruga u kulturi. Djelovanjem lokalnih udruga u kulturi u okviru novoobnovljenog centra osigurati će se raznolikost kulturnih djelatnosti, organizirati edukativne, afirmativne i kreativne radionice te kroz napredne tehnologije osigurati socijalne inovacije u kulturi sa svrhom socijalnog uključivanja što većeg broja lokalnog stanovništva, posebno se orijentirajući na ranjive ciljne skupine poput žena, mladih, nezaposlenih i starijih osoba te osigurati urbanizaciju depriviranog ruralnog područja.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a bicycle path with sidewalk and public lighting in Kurilovec
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističke staze s nogostupom i javnom rasvjetom u Kurilovcu
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Construction of a bicycle path with a sidewalk and public lighting in Kurilovec" contributes to sustainable mobility, traffic safety and quality of life of citizens of Velika Gorica. It includes the construction of 2,102.05 m cycling and hiking trails with energy-efficient lighting, adapted for people with disabilities. Measures are planned to increase safety, including tactile fields, ramps and signalling. The project includes the installation of 80 bike racks, which allows 160 bikes to be parked. The aim is to reduce CO2 emissions, encourage cycling as an ecological transport and provide accessible infrastructure for all citizens. The project promotes a healthier lifestyle and sustainable development, while raising awareness of the importance of cycling and environmental protection.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Izgradnja biciklističke staze s nogostupom i javnom rasvjetom u Kurilovcu“ doprinosi održivoj mobilnosti, sigurnosti prometa i kvaliteti života građana Velike Gorice. Obuhvaća izgradnju 2.102,05 m biciklističke i pješačke staze s energetskom učinkovitom rasvjetom, prilagođene osobama s invaliditetom. Planirane su mjere za povećanje sigurnosti, uključujući taktilna polja, rampe i signalizaciju. Projekt uključuje postavljanje 80 stalaka za bicikle, što omogućuje parkiranje 160 bicikala. Cilj je smanjiti emisije CO2, poticati biciklizam kao ekološki prijevoz i osigurati dostupnu infrastrukturu za sve građane. Projekt promiče zdraviji način života i održivi razvoj, istovremeno podižući svijest o važnosti biciklizma i okolišne zaštite.

Operation_Name_English: NEW POSSIBILITY 4!
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: NOVE MOGUĆNOSTI 4!
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project and the provision of support and support services for everyday life of persons over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities contributes to their greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in their own home and ensuring the right to live in the community - 150 members of the target group. The duration of the project is 36 months, and the support and support service will be provided by 25 people for a duration of 34 months through the activity of providing support and support with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies, which includes the recruitment of service providers, monitoring and control of the services performed, the procurement and distribution of packages, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta te pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške svakodnevnom životu osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom pridonosi se njihovoj većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguravanju prava na život u zajednici - 150 pripadnika ciljane skupine. Trajanje projekta je 36 mj., a uslugu potpore i podrške pružat će 25 osoba u trajanju od 34 mj. kroz aktivnost pružanja potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština što uključuje zapošljavanje pružatelja usluge, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga nabavu i podjelu paketa, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: PRSTEN ASSISTANCE YOU.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PRSTEN POTPORE VI.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Project Support Ring VI. It enables the inclusion of students with disabilities in the regular educational system of Zagreb County. The project provides PUN/CPC for 200 pupils in primary and secondary schools.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Prsten potpore VI. Omogućuje inkluziju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u redoviti odgojno-obrazovni sustav Zagrebačke županije. Projektom se osiguravaju PUN/SKP za 200 učenika u osnovnim i srednjim školama.

Operation_Name_English: Together to know with more elans VI
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno do znanja uz više elana VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Together to the knowledge of more than one school VI’ is planned to increase the social inclusion and integration of 45 pupils with developmental disabilities who master the curriculum of the school they attend, but have difficulties preventing them from functioning without teaching assistants in primary and secondary educational institutions founded by the Šibenik-Knin County through the employment of 45 teaching assistants in order to ensure conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialisation and emotional functioning, which also indirectly affects the reduction of child poverty.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Zajedno do znanja uz više elana VI“ planira se povećati socijalnu uključenost i integracija 45 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju koji svladavaju nastavni plan i program škole koju pohađaju, ali imaju teškoće koje ih sprečavaju u funkcioniranju bez pomoćnika u nastavi u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama kojih je osnivač Šibensko – kninska županija kroz zapošljavanje 45 pomoćnika u nastavi kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje što posredno utječe i na smanjenje dječjeg siromaštva.

Operation_Name_English: Providing teaching assistants and professional communication mediators in the City of Vinkovci 2024-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Osiguravanje pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika u Gradu Vinkovci 2024-2027
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Ensuring teaching assistants and professional communication mediators in the City of Vinkovci 2024-2027" will ensure the quality integration of 50 students with disabilities into the regular educational system through the work of teaching assistants and professional communication mediators through three school years in primary and one secondary school in the city of Vinkovci.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom "Osiguravanje pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika u Gradu Vinkovci 2024-2027" osigurat će se kvalitetna integracija 50 učenika s teškoćama u redoviti odgojno-obrazovni sustav kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi, te stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika kroz tri školske godine u osnovnim i jednoj srednjoj školi na području grada Vinkovaca.

Operation_Name_English: "Our Community-Our House-Phase II"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: „Naša zajednica-Naša Kuća-faza II“
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support services to socially vulnerable people with special emphasis on older people and people with disabilities through increased social inclusion through organized assistance in meeting basic living needs with the purpose of improving the quality of life and preventing their institutionalization. The goals will be achieved through care for 132 elderly people and people with disabilities for 30 months feasible through the provision of services of organizing food in the household, performing household chores , maintaining personal hygiene and meeting daily other needs with the distribution of hygiene packages on a monthly basis.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške socijalno ugroženim osobama s posebnim naglaskom na starije osobe i osobe s invaliditetom kroz povećanje socijalne uključenosti putem organizirane pomoći pri zadovoljavanju osnovnih životnih potreba sa svrhom unapređenja kvalitete života i sprečavanja njihove institucionalizacije. Ciljevi će se ostvariti putem skrbi za 132 starije osobe i osobe s invaliditetom tijekom 30 mjeseci provedive kroz pružanje usluge organiziranja prehrane u domaćinstvu, obavljanja kućanskih poslova , održavanja osobne higijene te zadovoljavanje svakodnevnih drugih potreba uz podjelu higijenskog paketa na mjesečnoj razini.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the water communal infrastructure of the agglomeration of Ploče - PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj vodnokomunalne infrastrukture aglomeracije Ploče - FAZA 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project includes investments in: Construction and reconstruction of the public drainage system; construction of a mechanical purification UPOV (8.939 ES) with a long submarine discharge; reconstruction of the water supply network in the corridors of planned sewerage collectors; with the aim of increasing the connection of the population to the public sewage system and ensuring adequate treatment of waste water and reducing losses in the water supply system.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt obuhvaća ulaganja u: Izgradnju i rekonstrukciju sustava javne odvodnje; izgradnju UPOV-a mehaničkog pročišćavanja (8.939 ES) s dugim podmorskim ispustom; rekonstrukciju vodoopskrbne mreže u koridorima planiranih kanalizacijskih kolektora; s ciljem povećanja priključenosti stanovništva na javni sustav odvodnje i osiguravanja odgovarajućeg pročišćavanja otpadnih voda te smanjenje gubitaka u vodoopskrbnom sustavu.

Operation_Name_English: PONOS V - Continuing Helper - Engaging students with developmental disabilities V
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PONOS V – POmoćnika u Nastavi – OSigurajmo učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju V
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support activities to students with disabilities in educational institutions in mastering educational and personal tasks, in order to ensure conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization, emotional functioning and a model of inclusion in the community in the city of Varaždin. The project area is the city of Varaždin, the applicant is the City of Varaždin, and partners 8 regular primary school and 1 special educational institution. The target group is a minimum of 63 students with disabilities who have been granted the right to support by a decision (right to PUN/CPC) in accordance with the Personal Assistance Act (OG 71/2023) and who will receive support from PUN or CPC within 36 months of project implementation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osigurati aktivnosti podrške učenicima s teškoćama u odgojno-obrazovnim institucijama u savladavanju obrazovnih i osobnih zadaća, kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za unapređenje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju, emocionalno funkcioniranje te model inkluzije u zajednici na području grada Varaždina. Projektno područje je grad Varaždin, prijavitelj je Grad Varaždin, a partneri 8 redovnih osnovnoškolskih i 1 posebna odgojno obrazovna institucija. Ciljna skupina je min. 63 učenika s teškoćama kojima je rješenjem priznato pravo na potporu (pravo na PUN/SKP) u skladu sa Zakonom o osobnoj asistenciji (NN 71/2023) i koji će primiti podršku PUN-a ili SKP-a unutar 36 mjeseci provedbe projekta.

Operation_Name_English: Improvement of the environmental and labour safety management system in accordance with ISO standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje sustava upravljanja okolišem i sigurnošću rada u skladu s ISO standardima
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Improvement of the environmental and labour safety management system in accordance with ISO standards" at EIT - Elektroinstalacijski tehnika d.o.o. aims to implement and certify according to ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards. The purpose of the project is to strengthen access to the international market and increase competitiveness through compliance with internationally recognized standards that confirm quality and safety in the exchange of goods and services. The introduction of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications will contribute to customer confidence and enable the EIT to stand out as a leader in the electrical engineering industry that promotes sustainable and safety practices.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Unaprjeđenje sustava upravljanja okolišem i sigurnošću rada u skladu s ISO standardima" u tvrtki EIT – Elektroinstalacijska tehnika d.o.o. ima za cilj implementaciju i certifikaciju prema ISO 14001 i ISO 45001 standardima. Svrha projekta je ojačati pristup međunarodnom tržištu i povećati konkurentnost kroz usklađivanje s međunarodno priznatim normama koje potvrđuju kvalitetu i sigurnost u razmjeni roba i usluga. Uvođenje ISO 14001 i ISO 45001 certifikata će doprinijeti povjerenju kupaca i omogućiti EIT-u da se istakne kao lider u elektrotehničkoj industriji koji promiče održive i sigurnosne prakse.

Operation_Name_English: Together with you
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno s vama
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to: 1. Increasing social inclusion 2. Prevention of the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups through the provision of long-term care Specific objective refers to the provision of support and support in everyday life to older persons and persons with disabilities. The activities of the project are the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of necessities that include: 1. Recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group 2. Monitoring and control of performed services 3. Acquisition and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies 4. Communication and visibility 5. Project management and administration
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je: 1. Povećanje socijalne uključenosti 2. Prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi Specifični cilj odnosi se na pružanje potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnosti projekta su pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koje uključuju: 1. zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine 2. praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga 3. nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština 4. komunikacija i vidljivost 5. upravljanje projektom i administraciju

Operation_Name_English: "Give a hand to the needy"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Pruži ruku potrebitima"
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will increase social inclusion and prevent institutionalisation. The aim is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. The number of people planning to provide the service is min 198. The activity of providing support and support in addition to the procurement and distribution of the supplies package includes the recruitment of 33 service providers for at least 6 members of the target groups.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se povećati socijalna uključenost i prevenirati institucionalizacija. Cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Broj osoba kojima se planira pružiti usluga je min 198. Aktivnost pružanje potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština uključuje zapošljavanje 33 pružatelja usluga za min 6 pripadnika ciljanih skupina.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Arx ECUX2 electrical cabinet
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj električnog ormarića Arx ECUX2
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The Arx bowling project solves the technical and market problem of the lack of a certified bowling automation control unit, which combines all functions in one solution. The aim of the project is to conduct tests of the ARX ECUX2 electronic cabinet in order to confirm its safety and functionality and ensure the market readiness of the product. The project will result in an innovative Croatian product ready for commercialization. The target groups covered by the project activities are Arx Boling’s company and employees, as well as customers, operators of sports facilities, bowling equipment installers and end-users – sports clubs, recreationalists and bowling alley operators.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt društva Arx bowling rješava tehnički i tržišni problem nedostatka certificiranog upravljačkog uređaja za automatizaciju kuglana, koji objedinjuje sve funkcije u jednom rješenju. Cilj projekta je provesti ispitivanja elektroničkog ormarića ARX ECUX2 kako bi se potvrdila njegova sigurnost i funkcionalnost te osigurala tržišna spremnost proizvoda. Projekt će rezultirati inovativnim hrvatskim proizvodom spremnim za komercijalizaciju. Ciljne skupine obuhvaćene projektnim aktivnostima su poduzeće i djelatnici Arx bolinga te kupci operatori sportskih objekata, instalateri kuglačke opreme i krajnji korisnici – sportski klubovi, rekreativci i upravitelji kuglana.

Operation_Name_English: Education without difficulty: Implementation of the Teaching Assistant/Professional Communication Intermediary Service for Students with Disabilities - Phase VII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obrazovanje bez teškoća: implementacija usluge pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju – faza VII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project entitled ‘Education without difficulties: implementation of the service of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators to students with disabilities - phase VII", increases social inclusion and integration, through the provision of support to 73 teaching assistants/professional communication mediators for the inclusion of 86 students with disabilities in primary and secondary schools in the Vukovar-Srijem County in order to improve the quality of their education, socialization and self-esteem.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt pod nazivom „Obrazovanje bez teškoća: implementacija usluge pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju - faza VII", povećava socijalnu uključenost i integraciju, kroz pružanje potpore 73 pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika za uključivanje 86 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske i srednjoškolske ustanove na području Vukovarsko-srijemske županije u svrhu poboljšanja kvalitete njihova obrazovanja, socijalizacije i samopoštovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Active inclusion in community life - prevention of institutionalization
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Aktivno uključivanje u život zajednice - prevencija institucionalizacije
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Overall objective of the project – to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups through the provision of long-term care. Specific objective – the provision of support and support services in the daily life of older persons and persons with disabilities. Main activities - providing support and support services with procurement and distribution of packages of supplies for at least 6 members of the target group. It will employ service providers, monitoring and control of services performed, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta – povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguranjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj – pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Glavne aktivnosti - pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština za min 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine. Zapošljavat će pružatelje usluga, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Hand Hand - Phase 3
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ruka ruci - faza 3
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to influence the prevention of institutionalization of older people and people with disabilities and to foster social inclusion of vulnerable groups. The specific objectives of the project are to provide support and assistance in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities and inclusion in the community. The target group are older persons over 65 years of age and persons with disabilities of 3rd and 4th degree from the territory of the municipality of Gradac and its surroundings. The activities that will be implemented mostly relate to the improvement of family and community care services with the basic activity of providing support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of necessities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći je cilj projekta utjecati na sprječavanje institucionalizacije osoba starije životne dobi i osoba s invaliditetom i poticanje socijalne uključenosti ranjivih skupina. Specifični ciljevi projekta su pružanje podrške i pomoći u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom te uključivanje u zajednicu. Ciljna skupina su starije osobe od 65. godina te osobe s invaliditetom 3. i 4. stupnja s područja općine Gradac i okolice. Aktivnosti koje će se provoditi najviše se odnose na unaprjeđenje usluga skrbi u obitelji i zajednici s osnovnom aktivnosti pružanja usluga potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština.

Operation_Name_English: COSMIC - Croatian Observatories and Schools Making Innovative Curricula
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: COSMIC - Croatian Observatories and Schools Making Innovative Curricula
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The COSMIC project aims to interest students in natural and technical sciences through the timeless appeal of space themes and to develop innovative non-institutional education programs based on an interdisciplinary approach using modern technology. The centers of activity are two observatories, in Križevci and in Zagreb, which through their earlier recognition give a strong impetus to new programs. These observatories are not only places of observation of celestial bodies, but centers of knowledge where students can discover the magic of exploring the world. The performance is supported by teachers, experts and scientists from the experience of rich civil society organizations, schools and public institutions with the help of the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing of the University of Zagreb.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt COSMIC želi kroz svevremensku privlačnost tematike svemira zainteresirati učenike za prirodne i tehničke znanosti te razvijati inovativne izvaninstitucionalne programe obrazovanja koji počivaju na interdisciplinarnom pristupu koristeći modernu tehnologiju. Središta aktivnosti čine dvije zvjezdarnice, u Križevcima i u Zagrebu, koje kroz svoju raniju prepoznatljivost daju novim programima jak poticaj. Ove zvjezdarnice nisu samo mjesta promatranja nebeskih tijela, već centri znanja gdje učenici mogu otkriti čari istraživanja svijeta. Izvedbu podržavaju učitelji, stručnjaci i znanstvenici iz iskustvom bogatih organizacija civilnog društva, iz škola i javnih ustanova uz pomoć Fakulteta elektrotehnike i računarstva Sveučilišta u Zagrebu.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Strategy for the Development of the Urban Area of the City of Požega for the financial period from 2021 to 2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada Strategije razvoja urbanog područja grada Požege za financijsko razdoblje od 2021. do 2027. godine
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to finance the costs of the external service of drafting the Strategy for the Development of the Urban Area of the City of Požega for the financial period from 2021 to 2027.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je financiranje troškova vanjske usluge izrade Strategije razvoja urbanog područja grada Požege za financijsko razdoblje od 2021. do 2027. godine.

Operation_Name_English: AIDA: Intelligent Nutrition Platform
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: AIDA: Platforma za inteligentnu prehranu
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in micro enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project integrates five related components, multiplying their combined effect. It consists of the Food and Nutrition Knowledge Repository, the AIDA AI virtual nutritionist, the AIDA mobile application, the external systems connection platform (LLMconnect) and the implementation of the food consultant in the web shop. The elements are coordinated through the cooperation of consortia. Each of the four partners builds on the previous work with their own expertise and experience, with direct cooperation on individual activities. Repository provides detailed information about foods and recipes, AI nutritionist uses it and offers personalized advice, LLMconnect allows their integration, and web shop integration improves user experience and sales.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt integrira pet povezanih komponenti, multiplicirajući tako njihov zajednički učinak. Sastoji se od Repozitorija znanja o hrani i prehrani, AIDA AI virtualnog nutricionista, AIDA mobilne aplikacije, platforme za povezivanje vanjskih sustava (LLMconnect) i implementacije prehrambenog savjetnika u web shopu. Elementi su koordinirani kroz suradnju konzorcija. Svaki od četvoro partnera nadograđuje rad prethodnog vlastitom ekspertizom i iskustvom, uz izravnu suradnju na pojedinim aktivnostima. Repozitorij pruža detaljne informacije o namirnicama i receptima, AI nutricionist ga koristi i nudi personalizirane savjete, LLMconnect omogućuje njihovu integraciju, a web shop integracija unapređuje korisničko iskustvo i prodaju.

Operation_Name_English: PETICA FOR TWO - Help - Education - Team - Integration - Targeting - Affirmation FOR TWO - VII. Phase
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: PETICA ZA DVOJE - Pomoć - Edukacija - Tim - Integracija - Ciljanost - Afirmacija ZA DVOJE - VII. Faza
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to support the inclusion of students with disabilities in primary education institutions in order to provide the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The activity of the project is to support the education of students with disabilities through the work of PUN/CPC.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta pružiti potporu uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim odgojno- obrazovnim ustanovama kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Aktivnost projekta je pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad PUN/SKP.

Operation_Name_English: Testing of a concrete mixture with the addition of new phase-changeable materials (PCM) to achieve a higher degree of energy efficiency of concrete used in residential or commercial buildings
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ispitivanje betonske smjese s dodatkom novih fazno promijenjivih materijala (PCM) radi dostizanja višeg stupnja energetske učinkovitosti betona korištenog u stambenim ili komercijalnim zgradama
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project is carried out for 4 months and implies the procurement of the service of laboratory testing of the properties of concrete mixture resulting from the application of new forms of phase-changeable materials (PCM) in order to achieve greater energy efficiency and better regulation of the internal temperature of buildings by a scientific research organization (Institut IGH d.d.) in order to complete the phase of technological development 5 (TRL 5) and create the preconditions for the further development of the new product and future commercialization.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se provodi 4 mjeseca i podrazumijeva nabavku usluge laboratorijskog ispitivanja svojstava betonske smjese nastale primjenom novih oblika fazno promijenjivih materijala (PCM) radi dosezanja veće energetske učinkovitosti i bolje regulaciju unutarnje temperature zgrada od strane znanstveno-istraživačke organizacije (Institut IGH d.d.) kako bi se završila faza tehnološkog razvoja 5 (TRL 5) te stvorile pretpostavke za nastavak daljnjeg razvoja novog proizvoda i buduću komercijalizaciju.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international competitiveness of Rentlio d.o.o. by introducing an information security management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke Rentlio d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of the project "Increasing the international competitiveness of Rentlio d.o.o. by introducing an information security management system" is to increase the international competitiveness of the company through the introduction of a management system according to international standards ISO 27001 (information security management). The purpose of the project is to ensure high standards of product and service safety, increase customer confidence and facilitate entry to new international markets with their own software products. The total investment is EUR 11,503, the amount of aid requested is EUR 6,902 and the own co-financing is EUR 4,601.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta "Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti tvrtke Rentlio d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću'' je povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema međunarodnim standardima ISO 27001 (upravljanje informacijskom sigurnošću). Svrha projekta je osigurati visoke standarde sigurnosti proizvoda i usluga, povećati povjerenje klijenata te olakšati ulazak na nova međunarodna tržišta vlastitim softverskim produktima. Ukupno ulaganje iznosi 11.503 EUR, iznos tražene potpore 6.902 EUR, a vlastito sufinanciranje 4.601 EUR.

Operation_Name_English: Venture Capital Fund
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Fond rizičnog kapitala
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Equity and quasi-equity investments in entrepreneurial projects (in particular start-ups or scale-ups) in the initial or early stages of development and growth of high-tech enterprises whose development is based on new technologies and innovations (active SMEs in the early stages of development, seeking additional funding from investors and those in the process of being set up), including an accelerator activity with a mentoring component, as well as equity financing through venture capital in the early stages of development for the commercialisation of innovation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Vlasnička i kvazi-vlasnička ulaganja u projekte poduzetnika (posebno start-up ili scale-up tvrtki) u početnim ili ranim fazama razvoja i fazama rasta visokotehnoloških poduzeća čiji razvoj se temelji na novim tehnologijama i inovacijama (aktivnih MSP-ova u ranoj fazi razvoja, koji traže dodatna sredstva ulagatelja i onih koji su u procesu osnivanja), uključujući akceleratorsku aktivnost sa mentorskom komponentom, kao i dioničko financiranje putem rizičnog kapitala u ranim fazama razvoja za komercijalizaciju inovacija.

Operation_Name_English: Get STEM and educated! Phase II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEMiziraj se i educiraj! - Faza II.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Project "Stemzite and educate yourself! - Phase II", worth 262,080,00 euros, strengthens the capacity of CSOs to popularize STEM among children and students. Capacity-building activities include study visits, attending fairs and conferences on innovative STEM presentation methods, and training and mentoring from a higher education institution for social inclusion in the education sector. 233 annual workshops and 12 public promotions of STEM will increase children's interest in STEM and ensure visibility of the project and ESF+ co-financing, encouraging other CSOs to participate in similar projects. The duration of the project is 36 months and is implemented in cooperation with 11 partners.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "STEMziraj se i educiraj! - faza II", vrijednosti 262.080,00 eura, jača kapacitete OCD-a za popularizaciju STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. Aktivnosti jačanja kapaciteta uključuju studijske posjete, pohađanje sajmova i konferencija o inovativnim metodama prezentacije STEM-a, te izobrazbu i mentorstvo od Visokog učilišta radi socijalnog uključivanja u obrazovni sektor. Kroz 233 godišnje radionice i 12 javnih promocija STEM-a povećat će se interes djece za STEM i osigurati vidljivost projekta i ESF+ sufinanciranja, potičući druge OCD-e na sudjelovanje u sličnim projektima. Trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci i provodi se u suradnji s 11 partnera.

Operation_Name_English: Quality Assurance in Higher Education
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Osiguravanje kvalitete u visokom obrazovanju
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to ensure quality and accessible education through increasing the quality and efficiency of Croatian higher education institutions by developing new and improving existing external quality assurance procedures and strengthening the role of the internal quality assurance system of higher education institutions. The implementation of the project will ensure the further development of the system of external quality assurance of higher education through the implementation of new models of external evaluation, strengthen the process of internal quality assurance and strengthen the capacities of higher education institutions, and improve the internal business processes of ASHE.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je osiguranje kvalitetnog i dostupnog obrazovanja kroz povećanje kvalitete i učinkovitosti hrvatskih visokih učilišta razvojem novih i poboljšanjem postojećih postupaka vanjskog osiguravanja kvalitete te jačanjem uloge unutarnjeg sustava osiguranja kvalitete visokih učilišta. Provedbom projekta osigurat će se daljnji razvoj sustava vanjskog osiguravanja kvalitete visokog obrazovanja kroz provedbu novih modela vanjskih vrednovanja, osnažiti proces unutarnjeg osiguravanja kvalitete i ojačati kapacitete ustanova za visoko obrazovanje, te unaprijediti interne poslovne procese AZVO-a.

Operation_Name_English: #fastermorebetter
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: #brževišebolje
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to strengthen NZSVO and SP capacities to operate in the labour market through training, networking and the development of new services for members. The capacity building will be achieved through education and networking of NZSVO and SP with trade unions in the Republic of Croatia and the EU with the aim of acquiring knowledge and exchanging experiences in improving the position of workers in the education sector. The project also covers the digital transformation of trade unions by upgrading existing and developing new digital services for members aimed at increasing the visibility and accessibility of services to members. The project will also develop different approaches to support specific to young scientists and teaching assistants through the development of the ‘Assistent’ support programme and the ‘Teaching Assistant – PON’ web application.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt ima za cilj ojačati kapacitete NZSVO-a i SP-a za djelovanje na tržištu rada kroz osposobljavanje, umrežavanje i razvoj novih usluga za članove. Podizanje kapaciteta ostvarit će kroz edukaciju i umrežavanje NZSVO-a i SP-a sa sindikatima u RH i EU s ciljem stjecanja znanja i razmjene iskustava u unapređenju položaja radnika u obrazovnom sektoru. Projekt obuhvaća i digitalnu transformaciju sindikata unapređenjem postojećih i razvojem novih digitalnih usluga za članove koje imaju za cilj povećati vidljivost i dostupnost usluga članovima. Također, projektom će se razviti različiti pristupi podrške specifično za mlade znanstvenike i asistente u nastavi putem razvoja programa podrške „Asistent“ i web aplikacije „Pomoćnik u nastavi – PON“.

Operation_Name_English: Wish for MS vol.2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi za MS vol.2
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care through support and support service activities with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies, which necessarily include the employment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group for: organizing food, performing household chores, maintaining personal hygiene and meeting other daily needs, monitoring and controlling the services performed (procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies), communication and visibility and project and administration management. 10 service providers are employed for at least 60 users in the area of Brod-Posavina and Požega-Slavonia counties.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi kroz aktivnosti pružanja usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština, koja obavezno uključuju zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine za: organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova, održavanje osobne higijene i zadovoljavanje drugih svakodnevnih potreba, praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga (nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština), komunikacija i vidljivost i upravljanje projektom i administracijom. Zapošljava se 10 pružatelja usluga za min. 60 korisnika na području Brodsko-posavske i Požeško-slavonske županije.

Operation_Name_English: Providing school meals for children at risk of poverty
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Osiguravanje školske prehrane za djecu u riziku od siromaštva
Category_Label: Addressing material deprivation through food and/or material assistance to the most deprived, including accompanying measures
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide financing/co-financing of school meals to pupils in primary schools at risk of poverty with the purpose of alleviating child poverty and providing assistance in the form of providing free meals to pupils in primary schools. In 2023/2024, funds were provided from the Fund for European Aid to the Most Deprived through the Ministry of Labour, Pension System, Family and Social Policy and from the State Budget of the Republic of Croatia through the Ministry of Science, Education and Youth. The intention is to protect the standard of pupils and parents by financing/co-financing the diet of primary school pupils at risk of poverty from families who are entitled to the allowance for children of the first and second census groups.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguravanje financiranja/sufinanciranja školske prehrane učenicima u osnovnim školama koja su u riziku od siromaštva sa svrhom ublažavanja siromaštva djece i pružanje pomoći u obliku osiguravanja besplatnih obroka učenika u osnovnim školama. Sredstva su se 2023./2024. šk. g. osiguravala iz Fonda europske pomoći za najpotrebitije putem Ministarstva rada, mirovinskoga sustava, obitelji i socijalne politike i iz Državnog proračuna RH putem Ministarstva znanosti, obrazovanja i mladih. Namjera je kroz financiranje/sufinanciranje prehrane učenika osnovnih škola u riziku od siromaštva iz obitelji koje ostvaruju pravo na doplatak za djecu prve i druge cenzusne grupe, zaštititi standard učenika i roditelja.

Operation_Name_English: Croatian safe steps CROSS
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Croatian safe steps CROSS
Category_Label: Nature and biodiversity protection, natural heritage and resources, green and blue infrastructure
NUTS3_Label: Šibensko-kninska županija|Karlovačka županija|Sisačko-moslavačka županija|Ličko-senjska županija|Split-Dalmatia County
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to demin a total of 34,515.087 m2 (3,451.5 ha) of forest and forest land from mine-explosives (MES) and unexploded ordnance (UXO), in the area of 5 counties (Karlovačka, Ličko-senjska, Sisak-Moslavačka, Split-Dalmatia and Šibenik-Knin). Demining activities will be carried out at 45 demining sites and the implementation of the project will enable the effective reduction of mine suspected areas (MIA), improving the safety of citizens and tourists in the Republic of Croatia, protecting the health and life of people, protecting the environment and preserving property. Out of 45 demining sites, 20 are located in a protected area of the Natura 2000 ecological network. The applicant is the Ministry of the Interior (MoI).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je razminiranje ukupno 34.515.087 m2 (3.451,5 ha) šuma i šumskog zemljišta od minsko-eksplozivnih sredstava (MES) i neeksplodiranih ubojnih sredstava (NUS), na području 5 županija (Karlovačka, Ličko-senjska, Sisačko-moslavačka, Splitsko-dalmatinska i Šibensko-kninska). Aktivnosti razminiranja provodit će se na 45 radilišta razminiranja te će se provedbom projekta omogućiti učinkovito smanjenje minski sumnjivog područja (MSP), poboljšanje sigurnosti građana i turista u RH, zaštita zdravlja i života ljudi, zaštita okoliša i očuvanje imovine. Od 45 radilišta razminiranja, 20 radilišta se nalazi na zaštićenom području ekološke mreže Natura 2000. Prijavitelj je Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova (MUP).

Operation_Name_English: Introduction of quality management system according to ISO 9001 and ENEC certification in the company INEA d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema normi ISO 9001 i ENEC certifikata u poduzeće INEA d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project is aimed at improving the competitiveness and market position of the Applicant through the introduction of a quality management system according to the requirements of the ISO 9001:2015 standard and the certification of two key products with an ENEC certificate. The introduction of ISO 9001:2015 will ensure the standardisation of business processes, increase the efficiency and quality of services, while ENEC certification will confirm the compliance of products with strict European safety and performance standards. The expected results of the project include an increase in turnover, sales and export revenues, which will strengthen the company's presence in the domestic and international markets. The project contributes to the long-term growth and sustainability of the company's business by improving the quality and customer satisfaction.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmetni projekt usmjeren je na unapređenje konkurentnosti i tržišne pozicije Prijavitelja kroz uvođenje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema zahtjevima norme ISO 9001:2015 te certifikacija dva ključna proizvoda ENEC certifikatom. Uvođenjem ISO 9001:2015 osigurat će se standardizacija poslovnih procesa, povećanje učinkovitosti i kvalitete usluga, dok će ENEC certifikacija potvrditi usklađenost proizvoda sa strogim europskim standardima sigurnosti i performansi. Očekivani rezultati projekta uključuju povećanje prometa, prihoda od prodaje i izvoza, čime će poduzeće ojačati svoju prisutnost na domaćem i međunarodnom tržištu. Projekt doprinosi dugoročnom rastu i održivosti poslovanja tvrtke kroz poboljšanje kvalitete i zadovoljstva korisnika.

Operation_Name_English: Clinical testing and validation of AI systems for early detection of neurodevelopmental deviations in infants SENDDToMedicalDevice Voucher II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kliničko testiranje i validacija AI sustava za ranu detekciju neurorazvojnih odstupanja kod dojenčadi SENDDToMedicalDevice Vaučer II
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: SENDDToMD aims at clinical validation and further testing of the SENDD AI system – a solution developed to support physicians in assessing spontaneous infant movements for early detection of neurodevelopmental deviations. Innovation vouchers will carry out the key phase of clinical trials required to register the system as a medical device (SaMD), testing and validating its application to the high-risk group – premature infants. Validation is carried out in cooperation with the Faculty of Education and Rehabilitation Sciences.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: SENDDToMD ima za cilj kliničku validaciju i dodatno testiranje AI sustava SENDD – rješenja razvijenog kao podrške liječnicima u procjeni spontanih pokreta dojenčadi radi ranog otkrivanja neurorazvojnih odstupanja. Kroz inovacijske vaučere provest će se ključna faza kliničkih ispitivanja potrebnih za registraciju sustava kao medicinskog uređaja (SaMD), uz testiranje i validaciju njegove primjene na visoko neurorizičnoj skupini – nedonoščadi. Validacija se provodi u suradnji s Edukacijsko-rehabilitacijskim fakultetom.

Operation_Name_English: Development strategy for the urban area of Varaždin for the period from 2021 to 2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strategija razvoja urbanog područja Varaždin za razdoblje od 2021. do 2027. godine
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project is to develop a Strategy for the Development of the Urban Area of Varaždin for the period from 2021 to 2027. (hereinafter: SRUP Varazdin). Elaboration of SRUP Varaždin aims to encourage integrated and inclusive social and economic development, development in the field of environment, culture, natural heritage, sustainable tourism and security in the Urban area of Varaždin (hereinafter: UPVŽ) in which the ITU mechanism is implemented in the financial period 2021-2027.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta je izrada Strategije razvoja urbanog područja Varaždin za razdoblje od 2021. do 2027. (dalje: SRUP Varaždin). Izrada SRUP-a Varaždin za cilj ima poticanje integriranog i uključivog društvenog i gospodarskog razvoja, razvoja u području okoliša, kulture, prirodne baštine, održivog turizma i sigurnosti na Urbanom području Varaždin (dalje: UPVŽ) u kojemu se provodi ITU mehanizam u financijskom razdoblju od 2021. do 2027. godine.

Operation_Name_English: Balthazar 8
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Baltazar 8
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The Baltazar 8 project in Krapina-Zagorje County provides 82 teaching assistants/professional communication mediators for 102 students with disabilities in 30 primary and secondary schools in the period from 1 September 2024 to 31 August 2027, i. e. for 36 months. The partnership approach and joint implementation of project activities strengthen the establishment of a professional and sustainable system of providing support to students with disabilities, which contributes to the realization of the right to adequate and inclusive education, equal opportunities for improving educational success and directly affects the creation of preconditions for improving their integration into the environment, easier mastering of the teaching process, socialization and cognitive and emotional development.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom Baltazar 8, Krapinsko-zagorska županija u razdoblju 1.9.2024.-31.8.2027 . odnosno tijekom 36 mjeseci, osigurava se 82 pomoćnika u nastavi/stručna komunikacijska posrednika za 102 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u 30 osnovnih i srednjih škola. Partnerski pristup i zajednička provedba projektnih aktivnosti jačaju uspostavu stručnog i održivog sustava osiguravanja podrške učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju što doprinosi ostvarivanju prava na primjereno i inkluzivno obrazovanje, jednake mogućnosti za poboljšanje odgojno-obrazovnog uspjeha te izravno utječe na stvaranje preduvjeta za poboljšanje njihove integracije u okolinu, lakše svladavanje nastavnog procesa, socijalizaciju te kognitivni i emocionalni razvoj.

Operation_Name_English: "We want, we can!"
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: „Zaželimo, možemo!“
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project focuses on people who are in a disadvantaged socio-economic or health situation to actively involve them in the community. Providing the necessary assistance and support to older people to enable them to age with dignity, focusing on their daily needs and activities. Persons with disabilities receive support and assistance to improve their quality of life, facilitate daily mobility and enable greater independence.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se fokusira na osobe koje se nalaze u nepovoljnom socioekonomskom ili zdravstvenom položaju da ih se aktivno uključi u zajednicu. Pružanje potrebne pomoći i podrške starijim osobama kako bi im se omogućilo dostojanstveno starenje, uz naglasak na njihove svakodnevne potrebe i aktivnosti. Osobe s invaliditetom dobivaju podršku i pomoć kako bi se poboljšala njihova kvaliteta života, olakšala svakodnevna mobilnost i omogućila veća neovisnost.

Operation_Name_English: STEM FOR ALL 2.0
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM ZA SVE 2.0
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: STEM FOR ALL 2.0 is a logical continuation of the project UP.04.2.1.10.0099 STEM FOR ALL. The project idea was created on the basis of the proposal of the Applicant RIT Croatia, partner kindergartens and the Association for Autism Zagreb, after in Call UP.04.2.1.10 we successfully strengthened the capacities of 4 civil society organizations and acquired the necessary STEM equipment, and developed pilot projects for the popularization of STEM among children. Through STEM FOR ALL 2.0 we will contribute to strengthening the capacity of civil society organizations to popularize STEM among children and students with the aim of social inclusion in the context of the education sector, and especially in rural areas of all counties of the Republic of Croatia with an emphasis on inclusion and inclusion of children with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: STEM ZA SVE 2.0 logičan je nastavak projekta UP.04.2.1.10.0099 STEM ZA SVE. Projektna ideja nastala je temeljem prijedloga Prijavitelja RIT Croatia, partnerskim dječjim vrtićima i Udruzi za autizam Zagreb, nakon što smo u Pozivu UP.04.2.1.10 uspješno ojačali kapacitete 4 organizacije civilnog društva i nabavili potrebnu STEM opremu, te razvili pilot projekte za popularizaciju STEM-a među djecom. Kroz STEM ZA SVE 2.0 doprinijeti ćemo jačanju kapaciteta organizacija civilnoga društva za popularizaciju STEM-a među djecom i učenicima s ciljem socijalnog uključivanja u kontekstu obrazovnog sektora, a osobito u ruralnim područjima svih županija RH s naglaskom na inkluzivnost i uključivanje djece s teškoćama.

Operation_Name_English: Innovative wagon for loading, unloading and transport of municipal waste
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inovativni vagon za utovar, istovar i prijevoz komunalnog otpada
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in micro enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal "Innovative wagon for loading, unloading and transport of municipal waste" will develop a new innovative wagon specialized in waste manipulation, as soon as significant savings and reduction of environmental pollution will be ensured. The project envisages product development from TRL 2 to TRL 8. The newly developed innovative product will be protected as intellectual property in two ways, as a product (patent) and as an industrial design. The estimated duration of the project is 36 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektnim prijedlogom "Inovativni vagon za utovar, istovar i prijevoz komunalnog otpada" razviti će se novi inovativni vagon specijaliziran za manipulaciju otpadom, a čim će se osigurati značajne uštede i smanjenje zagađenja okoliša. Kroz projekt je predviđen razvoj proizvoda od TRL 2 do TRL 8. Novi razvijeni inovativni proizvod zaštiti će se kao intelektualno vlasništvo na dva načina, kao proizvod (patent) i kao industrijski dizajn. Predviđeno trajanje projekta je 36 mjeseci.

Operation_Name_English: Let's study together VIII
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obrazujmo se zajedno VIII
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to ensure inclusive education of students with disabilities in primary and secondary educational institutions. The specific objective is to support the inclusion of students with disabilities (80 students) in 11 elementary schools and 5 educational institutions founded by PSŽ in order to provide conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning through employment of PUN (73). The activity of the project is: supporting the education of students with disabilities through the work of the PUN. Description of the activity: implementation of the selection procedure for PUN candidates, PUN operation in accordance with the MZOM Rules, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno obrazovanim ustanovama. Specifični cilj je pružanje potpore uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju (80 učenika) u 11 OŠ i 5 SŠ odgojno-obrazovnih ustanova kojima je osnivač PSŽ kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje kroz zapošljavanje PUN (73). Aktivnost projekta je: pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad PUN. Opis aktivnosti: provedba postupka selekcije kandidata za PUN, rad PUN u skladu s Pravilnikom MZOM, komunikacija i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Loans for community-based social services
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajmovi za socijalne usluge u zajednici
Category_Label: Other social infrastructure contributing to social inclusion in the community
Operation_Summary_English: Encourage sustainability and ensure the quality of care in the foster care system.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Potaknuti održivost i osigurati kvalitetu skrbi u sustavu udomiteljstva.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of certification in the company Eurometal d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Provedba certifikacije u tvrtki Eurometal d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With the proposed project, Eurometal d.o.o. plans to generate revenue in new markets by introducing three certificates into its business, namely ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, ISO 9001:2015. The estimated duration of the project is 12 months. By implementing the project, the company would ensure all the preconditions for concluding new contracts with customers, as the target group of the project are all employees and business partners.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka Eurometal d.o.o. predloženim projektom planira ostvarivanje prihoda na novim tržištima uvođenje tri certifikata u svoje poslovanje, a to su norma ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, ISO 9001:2015. Predviđeno trajanje projekta je 12 mjeseci. Provedbom projekta tvrtka bi osigurala sve preduvjete za sklapanje novih ugovora sa kupcima, kao ciljana skupina projekta su svi zaposlenici i poslovni partneri.

Operation_Name_English: Wish - you have support
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - imaš podršku
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support services to beneficiaries who have made the greatest contribution to society and deserve a dignified age without social exclusion. Older people are the most vulnerable group in society and need daily help and support. The implementation of the project would reduce institutionalisation and consequently the depopulation of rural areas. The main activity is to provide support and support in the performance of everyday tasks, to help maintain personal hygiene and to purchase hygiene kits.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške korisnicima koji su dali najveći doprinos društvu i zaslužuju dostojanstvenu starost bez socijalnog isključivanja. Starije osobe najranjivija su skupina društva te im je potrebno pružiti svakodnevnu pomoć i podršku. Provođenjem projekta smanjila bi se institucionalizacija te posljedično depopulacija ruralnih područja. Glavna aktivnost je pružanje podrške i potpore u obavljanju svakodnevnih poslova, pomoć u održavanju osobne higijene te nabava paketa higijenskih potrepština.

Operation_Name_English: MOZAK VOLI STEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: MOZAK VOLI STEM
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective of the project is to strengthen the capacities of DNDM and DNDP in the promotion of STEM among children and students. SPECIFIC OBJECTIVES ARE (I) To improve the capacities of DNDM and DNDP for the implementation of programs in the field of STEM promotion and cooperation with higher education and education institutions (II) Implementation of activities aimed at promoting STEM among children and students. The project implements the activities A1, A2, A3 and A4 foreseen by the PDP. A1 and A2 contribute to SC1, A3 and A4 contribute to SC2. The purpose of the project is aligned with the purpose of the Call in a way that through the set goals and activities of the project directly contributes to the strengthening of children's interest in science and offers different approaches to the acquisition of knowledge, with the aim of long-term sustainability of the non-institutional service provided by CSOs.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: OPĆI CILJ projekta je Jačanje kapaciteta DNDM i DNDP u promociji STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. SPECIFIČNI CILJEVI SU (I) Unaprijediti kapacitete DNDM i DNDP za provedbu programa u području promocije STEM-a te suradnja s visokim učilištem i odg-obraz institucijama (II) Provedba aktivnosti s ciljem promocije STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. Na projektu se provode aktivnosti A1, A2, A3 i A4 predviđene PDP-om. A1 i A2 doprinose SC1, a A3 i A4 SC2. SVRHA projekta je usklađena sa svrhom Poziva na način da se kroz postavljene ciljeve i aktivnosti projekta izravno doprinosi jačanju interesa djece za znanost te se nude drugačiji pristupi usvajanju znanja, a sa ciljem dugoročne održivosti izvaninstitucijske usluge koju pruža OCD.

Operation_Name_English: Our support for you
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Naša podrška vama
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Project activities include the provision of support and support services in addition to the procurement and distribution of a package of supplies that includes the recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektne aktivnosti uključuju pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština koja uključuje zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljne skupine.

Operation_Name_English: Preparation of study and project documentation for the modernisation of the railway line M202 Zagreb GK – Rijeka, section Karlovac – Oštarije – Phase 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada studijske i projektne dokumentacije za modernizaciju željezničke pruge M202 Zagreb GK – Rijeka, dionica Karlovac – Oštarije – 2. faza
Category_Label: Reconstructed or modernised railways - TEN-T core network
Operation_Summary_English: The current state of the Karlovac-Oštarije railway section does not meet the technical and technological requirements that must be met by the main corridor railway lines for international traffic, does not meet the technical specifications for the interoperability of the railway system and its permeability does not meet the planned traffic on the section in question. The aim of the project is to prepare study and project documentation for the modernisation and construction of the Zagreb-Rijeka traffic route on connecting the wider area of Karlovac and Oštarije, in addition to meeting the technical and technological conditions that must be met by the main corridor railways for international traffic, which will be achieved through phase 1 and phase 2.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Trenutno stanje pružne dionice Karlovac-Oštarije ne zadovoljava tehničko-tehnološke uvjete koje moraju zadovoljavati glavne koridorske željezničke pruge za međunarodni promet, ne zadovoljava tehničke specifikacije za interoperabilnost željezničkog sustava te joj propusna moć ne zadovoljava planirani promet na predmetnoj dionici. Cilj projekta je izrada studijske i projektne dokumentacije za modernizaciju i izgradnju prometnog pravca Zagreb – Rijeka na povezivanju šireg područja Karlovca i Oštarija, uz zadovoljavanje tehničko-tehnoloških uvjeta kojima moraju udovoljavati glavne koridorske željezničke pruge za međunarodni promet, što će se ostvariti kroz fazu 1 i fazu 2.

Operation_Name_English: Innovative product for monitoring and optimization of paint lines MES CoatTrack
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inovativni proizvod za praćenje i optimizaciju lakirnih linija MES CoatTrack
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The MES CoatTrack project addresses the problem of insufficient traceability and optimization of manufacturing processes in the industry, especially in the field of painting and varnishing. The aim of the project is to develop an innovative system for monitoring production enot and predicting quality in real time using advanced data analytics and artificial intelligence. The target groups of the project include: 1) the production department, which will benefit from the optimization of production processes, 2) the management of the company, which will have a better insight into the efficiency and results of production, and 3) the development and technology department, which will participate in the implementation of new technological solutions. The project will also contribute to raising competitiveness and energy efficiency.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt MES CoatTrack adresira problem nedostatne sljedivosti i optimizacije proizvodnih procesa u industriji, osobito u području bojenja i lakiranja. Cilj projekta je razvoj inovativnog sustava za praćenje proizvodnih enot i predikciju kvalitete u stvarnom vremenu korištenjem napredne analitike podataka i umjetne inteligencije. Ciljne skupine projekta uključuju: 1) proizvodni odjel, koji će imati koristi od optimizacije proizvodnih procesa, 2) upravu poduzeća, koja će imati bolji uvid u efikasnost i rezultate proizvodnje, te 3) odjel za razvoj i tehnologiju, koji će sudjelovati u implementaciji novih tehnoloških rješenja. Projekt će također doprinositi podizanju konkurentnosti i energetske učinkovitosti.

Operation_Name_English: Support arm
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ruka podrške
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of elderly people and people with disabilities in the Koprivnica-Križevci County through the provision of support and support in everyday life.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom na području Koprivničko-križevačke županije kroz pružanje podrške i potpore u svakodnevnom životu.

Operation_Name_English: Development of an innovative structural carrier for industrial flat roofs
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj inovativnog nosača konstrukcija za industrijske ravne krovove
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in small and medium-sized enterprises (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: With this project, the applicant and partners plan to develop an innovative substructure carrier that is physically mounted and attached to industrial roofs, and consists of 2 main components: 1. Tiles that are installed and attached by telescopic screws to the roof, while maintaining the waterproofing of the roof. 2. Aluminium lightweight and aerodynamic constructions that are mounted on the installed polyamide plate Innovative brackets, when developed, offer radical advantages over existing solutions thanks to their universal compatibility, waterproofing, ease of installation, strength and resistance. In addition to all the above, the product is extremely inexpensive, which will have a disruptive effect on the substructure market for FN panels
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Prijavitelj i partneri ovim projektom planiraju razviti inovativni nosač potkonstrukcija koji se fizički montira i pričvršćuje na industrijske krovove, a sastoji se od 2 glavne komponente: 1. Pločice koja se postavlja i pričvršćuje teleskopskim vijcima na krov, zadržavajući vodonepropusnost krova. 2. Aluminijske konstrukcije lake i aerodinamične izvedbe koja se montira na postavljenu poliamidnu pločicu Inovativni nosači, kad budu razvijeni, nude radikalne prednosti u odnosu na postojeća rješenja zahvaljujući svojoj univerzalnoj kompatibilnosti, vodonepropusnosti, jednostavnosti instalacije, čvrstoći i otpornosti. Uz sve navedeno proizvod je iznimno jeftin, što će imati disruptivni učinak na tržište potkonstrukcija za FN panele

Operation_Name_English: OptiSolar AI: Autonomous system for optimal storage and distribution of electricity based on artificial intelligence
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: OptiSolar AI: Autonomni sustav za optimalnu pohranu i distribuciju električne energije temeljen na umjetnoj inteligenciji
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to develop innovative products based on artificial intelligence with the purpose of optimizing the management of battery systems for electricity production in order to achieve a higher level of efficiency. • Stakeholders in the renewable energy market • Regional and local self-government units whose developed solutions will affect the resolution of a number of social problems identified in development strategies and plans • Residents in areas where the developed solutions will be implemented TOTAL VALUE of the project: EUR 3,587,553.06, of which EUR 2,591,043.53 in grants.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta jest kroz primjenu stručnih znanja i iskustava članova konzorcija te podršku istraživačke organizacije, razviti inovativne proizvode bazirane na umjetnoj inteligenciji sa svrhom optimizacije upravljanja baterijskim sustavima za proizvodnju električne energije radi postizanja više razine efikasnosti Ciljne skupine su: • Dionici na tržištu obnovljivih izvora energije • Jedinice regionalne i lokalne samouprave kojima će razvijena rješenja utjecati na rješavanje većeg broja društvenih problema identificiranih u razvojnim strategijama i planovima • Stanovnici na područjima u kojima će se razvijena rješenja implementirati UKUPNA VRIJEDNOST PROJEKTA: 3.587.553,06 EUR, od čega 2.591.043,53 EUR bespovratnih sredstava.

Operation_Name_English: Measurement stations for measuring air quality in the Port of Ploče
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mjerne postaje za mjerenje kvalitete zraka u Luci Ploče
Category_Label: Air quality and noise reduction measures
Operation_Summary_English: The Ploče Port Authority submitted the project ‘Air quality measurement station in the Port of Ploče’ through a co-financing tender from the Competitiveness and Cohesion Programme 2021-2027, with the aim of improving the infrastructure and capacity for monitoring and analysing air pollution from emissions in ports in its area. This project includes the installation of a system for continuous air quality monitoring at a single location, to ensure timely response to increasing pollution levels and to enable the planning of more effective emission reduction measures. Air quality monitoring will contribute to a healthier environment, providing tangible benefits for the local population by reducing exposure to harmful substances and encouraging the sustainable development of the Port of Ploče.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Lučka uprava Ploče prijavila je projekt „Mjerna postaja za mjerenje kvalitete zraka u Luci Ploče“ putem natječaja za sufinanciranje iz Programa konkurentnost i kohezija 2021.-2027., s ciljem poboljšanja infrastrukture i kapaciteta za praćenje i analizu onečišćenja zraka iz emisija u lukama na svom području. Ovaj projekt uključuje postavljanje sustava za kontinuirano praćenje kvalitete zraka na jednoj lokaciji, kako bi se osiguralo pravovremeno reagiranje na povećanje razine onečišćenja i omogućilo planiranje učinkovitijih mjera za smanjenje emisija. Praćenje kvalitete zraka doprinijet će zdravijem okolišu, pružajući konkretne koristi za lokalno stanovništvo kroz smanjenje izloženosti štetnim tvarima te poticanje održivog razvoja luke Ploče.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of a bicycle path in the Municipality of Stari Jankovci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističke staze na području Općine Stari Jankovci
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to build a cycling trail in the Stari Jankovci Municipality in the due area of 11 002.13 m, which will contribute to the strengthening of green, clean, smart and sustainable transport, better connection of daily migrations in the Vinkovci urban area, reduction of pollutant emissions and increased safety of cyclists and other road users. The activities of the project are: 1.Works on the construction of the bicycle path 2. Project management 3. Promotion and visibility.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgradnja biciklističke staze na području Općine Stari Jankovci u dužni od 11 002,13 m, koja će doprinijeti jačanju zelenog, čistog, pametnog i održivog prometa, boljoj povezanosti dnevnih migracija na Vinkovačkom urbanom području, smanjenju emisija onečišćujućih tvari te povećanoj sigurnosti biciklista i ostalih sudionika u prometu. Aktivnosti projekta su: 1.Radovi na izgradnji biciklističke staze 2. Upravljanje projektom 3. Promidžba i vidljivost.

Operation_Name_English: Mobile multimedia ZEZ Centre – MMZC
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mobilni multimedijalni ZEZ centar – MMZC
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The UPB's "Mobile Multimedia ZEZ Centre - MMZC" promotes STEM among students through a range of activities. It improves UPB's capacity to implement STEM programs and educates 4 employees and at least 6 volunteers in cooperation with Algebra University. The project includes the organization of 80 STEM science-popular events per year for 6th and 7th grade students of elementary school, with an emphasis on the development and use of multimedia content. It includes 600 students per year (240 STEM events and 1800 students). Programs are the basics of graphic design and design, tools for image processing, video and sound, animation, and web distribution and content promotion. The project also includes the organization of 40 STEM promotions per year for three years with the aim of popularizing STEM in public.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: "Mobilni multimedijalni ZEZ centar – MMZC" UPB-a promovira STEM među učenicima kroz niz aktivnosti. Unaprjeđuje kapacitete UPB-a za provedbu programa STEM-a i educira 4 zaposlenika i najmanje 6 volontera u suradnji sa Sveučilištem Algebra.
