Projekt uključuje organizaciju 80 STEM znanstveno-popularnih događanja godišnje za učenike 6. i 7. razreda OŠ, s naglaskom na razvoj i upotrebu multimedijalnog sadržaja. Obuhvaća 600 učenika godišnje (240 STEM događanja i 1800 učenika). Programi su osnove grafičkog oblikovanja i dizajna, alati za obradu slike, videa i zvuka, animacija, te web distribucija i promocija sadržaja. Projekt uključuje i organizaciju 40 promocija STEM-a godišnje tijekom tri godine s ciljem popularizacije STEM-a u javnosti.

Operation_Name_English: WANT 3 in the municipality of Oprisavci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ZAŽELI 3 u općini Oprisavci
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The specific objective of the project WANTS 3 in the municipality of Oprisavci is to provide support services in everyday life to the elderly and adults with disabilities. Main activity: 1. Recruitment of 10 service providers per 33 months for a minimum of 60 members of the target group (minimum 6 beneficiaries per person employed) 2. Monitoring and control of performed services 3. Supply and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies (once a month) 4. Communication and visibility (minimum production of posters with basic information about the project and leaflets for informing participants and publication on the official website of the Applicant) 5. Project management and administration (the project manager will be hired at the beginning of the implementation)
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Specifični cilj projekta ZAŽELI 3 u općini Oprisavci je pružanje usluge podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i punoljetnom osobama s invaliditetom. Glavna aktivnost: 1. Zapošljavanje 10 pružatelja usluge na 33 mjeseca za minimalno 60 pripadnika ciljane skupine (minimalno 6 korisnika po zaposlenom) 2. Praćenje i kontrola izvršenih usluga 3. Nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština (jednom mjesečno) 4. Komunikacija i vidljivost (minimalno izrada plakata s osnovnom informacijama o projektu te letaka za informiranje sudionika i objava na službenoj stranici Prijavitelja) 5. Upravljanje projektom i administracija (početkom provedbe zaposlit će se voditelj projekta)

Operation_Name_English: A Drop of Goodness 5
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Kap dobrote 5
Category_Label: Addressing material deprivation through food and/or material assistance to the most deprived, including accompanying measures
Operation_Summary_English: The project Drop of Goodness 5 is aimed at contributing to the suppression of material deprivation and alleviation of the worst forms of poverty in the area of Pannonian Croatia, covering eight counties, with an emphasis on rural areas. The aim is to provide continued assistance in the form of food packages (60000) and basic material assistance (30000) to those at highest risk of poverty and social exclusion. The target group will include people over 65 with low incomes, people under 65 with low incomes and beneficiaries of the Guaranteed Minimum Benefit (GMI). In addition to sharing the package, the beneficiary and partner will also implement accompanying measures such as workshops for social inclusion and empowerment of beneficiaries and carry out a campaign to raise awareness of food donation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt kap dobrote 5 usmjeren je na doprinos suzbijanju materijalne deprivacije i ublažavanju najgorih oblika siromaštva na području Panonske Hrvatske, obuhvaćajući osam županija, s naglaskom na ruralna područja. Cilj je pružiti kontinuiranu pomoć u obliku paketa hrane (60000) i osnovne materijalne pomoći (30000) osobama s najvećim rizikom od siromaštva i socijalne isključenosti. Ciljna skupina će uključivati osobe starije od 65 godina s niskim primanjima, osobe mlađe od 65 godina s niskim primanjima te korisnike zajamčene minimalne naknade (ZMN). Korisnik i partner osim podjele paketa provodi će i popratne mjere poput radionica za socijalno uključivanje i osnaživanje korisnika te provoditi kampanju za podizanje svijesti doniranja hrane.

Operation_Name_English: Maritime passenger terminal Resnik-Divulje in the port area of the Kaštela basin - Pool D - Resnik
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pomorsko-putnički terminal Resnik-Divulje u lučkom području Kaštelanskog bazena – Bazen D – Resnik
Category_Label: Seaports (TEN-T) excluding facilities dedicated to transport of fossil fuels
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Maritime Passenger Terminal Resnik-Divulje" improves maritime transport, relieves capacity and connects the mainland, Split Airport and islands. It includes the construction of a pier (53x6 m) and the extension of the coastal wall (52.27 m), allowing, in addition to the existing one, an additional mooring of two vessels up to 40 m and one catamaran. Port excavation (-5.30 m) increases safety. Energy-efficient solutions, including LED lighting and ship connectors, are planned. Traffic is expected to grow by 38,678 passengers by 2028 and contribute to sustainable mobility and environmental performance. The project increases maritime transport capacity and contributes to the diversion of traffic from roads to sea.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Pomorsko-putnički terminal Resnik-Divulje" poboljšava pomorski prijevoz, rasterećuje kapacitete i povezuje kopno, Zračnu luku Split i otoke. Obuhvaća izgradnju gata (53x6 m) i produljenje obalnog zida (52,27 m), omogućujući, uz postojeće jedno, dodatni privez dvaju plovila do 40 m i jednog katamarana. Lučki iskop (-5,30 m) povećava sigurnost. Planirana su energetski učinkovita rješenja, uključujući LED rasvjetu i priključke za brodove. Očekuje se rast prometa za 38.678 putnika do 2028. te doprinos održivoj mobilnosti i ekološkoj učinkovitosti. Projekt povećava kapacitete pomorskog prijevoza i pridonosi preusmjeravanju prometa s cesta na more.

Operation_Name_English: Mapping skills for the green and digital transitions
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Mapiranje vještina za zelenu i digitalnu tranziciju
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: During 2022, as part of the National Recovery and Resilience Plan 2023-2026, the MROSP started the implementation of the voucher system. In order to detect educational programmes eligible for the award of vouchers, it is necessary to carry out a process of mapping relevant skills and establish a sustainable database that will also enable the future implementation of the voucher system. Skills mapping will focus on digital and green skills, which is also a prerequisite for the implementation of the voucher system. A skills assessment module will also be developed to further professional development and support users in the process of selecting educational programmes and using voucher systems to acquire green and digital competences.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: MROSP je tijekom 2022.g. u okviru Nacionalnog plana oporavka i otpornosti 2023.-2026. započelo s provedbom sustava vaučera. Kako bi se detektiralo obrazovne programe prihvatljive za dodjelu vaučera, potrebno je provesti postupak mapiranja relevantnih vještina te uspostaviti održivu bazu podataka koja će omogućiti i buduću implementaciju sustava vaučera. Mapiranjem vještina stavit će se fokus na digitalne i zelene vještine, što je ujedno i preduvjet za provedbu sustava vaučera. Također će se razviti i modul za procjenu vještina u cilju daljnjeg profesionalnog razvoja i pružanja podrške korisnicima u procesu odabira obrazovnih programa i korištenju sustava vaučera za stjecanje zelenih i digitalnih kompetencija.

Operation_Name_English: It's time for workers.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Vrijeme je za radnike
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The Croatian labour market has undergone dramatic changes in recent years – unemployment is at a historically low level, the share of foreign workers is increasing rapidly, wages are rising at a pace that has not been recorded for several decades, and significant minimum wage growth has led to a reduction in wage ranges for many employers. Lack of workers also causes an increased workload, which makes stress management and protection against harassment at work increasingly important occupational safety issues. The project will strengthen the capacities of the SSSH and SOMK for social dialogue related to these challenges, and improve communication and organization management, through training activities, networking, and the development and improvement of services for members.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Hrvatsko tržište rada proteklih godina prolazi kroz dramatične promjene – nezaposlenost je na povijesno niskoj razini, udio stranih radnika ubrzano se povećava, plaće rastu dinamikom kakva nije zabilježena nekoliko desetljeća, a značajan rast minimalne plaće doveo je do smanjivanja raspona plaća kod mnogih poslodavaca. Nedostatak radnika uzrokuje i povećano radno opterećenje, uslijed čega upravljanje stresom i zaštita od uznemiravanja na radu postaju sve važnijim pitanjima zaštite na radu. Projekt će ojačati kapacitete SSSH i SOMK-a za socijalni dijalog vezan uz navedene izazove, te unaprijediti komunikaciju i upravljanje organizacijom, kroz aktivnosti osposobljavanja, umrežavanja, te razvoja i unapređenja usluga za članove.

Operation_Name_English: Certification of management systems according to ISO 27001 and ISO 50001
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranje sustava upravljanja prema normama ISO 27001 i ISO 50001
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the Project is to increase the competitiveness of Bandić Maritime through the implementation of ISO 27001 and ISO 50001, which will improve the information security and energy efficiency management system. The project solves the problem of uncertified business processes in the provision of logistics services and shipping agency operations and enables compliance with client requirements. The project will have a direct impact on the Company, its employees and clients, who will receive lower environmental footprint services and a higher level of information security, with additional confidence in the compliance of the business with international standards. The aim is to attract new customers, increase sales and export revenues and ensure continuous improvement of process management.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha Projekta je povećati konkurentnost društva Bandić Maritime kroz implementaciju normi ISO 27001 i ISO 50001, čime će se unaprijediti sustav upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću i energetskom učinkovitošću. Projekt rješava problem necertificiranih poslovnih procesa u pružanju logističkih usluga i brodarskih agencijskih operacija te omogućava usklađenost sa zahtjevima klijenata. Projekt će izravno utjecati na Poduzeće, njegove zaposlenike te klijente, koji će dobiti usluge nižeg ekološkog otiska i veće razine sigurnosti informacija, uz dodatno povjerenje u usklađenost poslovanja s međunarodnim standardima. Cilj je privući nove klijente, povećati prihode od prodaje i izvoza te osigurati kontinuirano poboljšanje upravljanja procesima.

Operation_Name_English: Establishment of eDelivery and e-Based Collective Agreements systems
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uspostava sustava za e-dostavu i e-bazu kolektivnih ugovora
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project Establishing a system for e-delivery and e-base of collective agreements will contribute to strengthening the efficiency of public administration by digitalising the business process of delivery, recording and publication of collective agreements, and by enabling the development of analyses of additional labour rights, it will contribute to the improvement of national labour legislation and collective bargaining. An information system for e-delivery and e-base of collective agreements will be established, the capacities of the organisational units of the Ministry of Labour, Pension System, Family and Social Policy responsible for this business process will be strengthened, as well as the coordination of collective bargaining, a manual and study will be developed, and the importance of social partnership and collective bargaining will be promoted to stakeholders.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Uspostava sustava za e-dostavu i e-bazu kolektivnih ugovora pridonijet će jačanju učinkovitosti javne uprave digitalizacijom poslovnog procesa dostave, evidentiranja i objave kolektivnih ugovora, a omogućavanjem izrade analiza dodatnih radnih prava pridonijet će unaprjeđivanju nacionalnog radnog zakonodavstva i kolektivnog pregovaranja. Uspostavit će se informacijski sustav za e-dostavu i e-bazu sklopljenih kolektivnih ugovora, ojačati kapaciteti ustrojstvenih jedinica Ministarstva rada, mirovinskoga sustava, obitelji i socijalne politike nadležnih za ovaj poslovni proces ali i koordinaciju kolektivnog pregovaranja, izraditi priručnik i studija te promovirati važnost socijalnog partnerstva i kolektivnog pregovaranja dionicima.

Operation_Name_English: Improving the competitiveness of RIO BIZ d.o.o. introducing a quality management system according to ISO 9001:2015
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Unaprjeđenje konkurentnosti poduzetnika RIO BIZ d.o.o. uvođenje sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema normi ISO 9001:2015
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Improving the competitiveness of RIO BIZ d.o.o. by introducing a quality management system according to ISO 9001:2015’ is aimed at standardising business processes and improving quality control in the process of production and placement of clothing on the markets. The overall objective of the project is to strengthen the market position of the company through compliance with internationally recognized standards, ensuring the quality of services, increasing efficiency and reducing costs. The target groups are employees, who will improve competencies, and clients both on the domestic and international market, who will benefit from the improved quality of services. The implementation of the project will contribute to easier entry into international markets and long-term competitiveness of companies.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „ Unaprjeđenje konkurentnosti poduzetnika RIO BIZ d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kvalitetom prema normi ISO 9001:2015“ usmjeren je na standardizaciju poslovnih procesa i poboljšanje kontrole kvalitete u procesu proizvodnje i plasmana odjeće na tržišta. Opći cilj projekta je jačanje tržišne pozicije poduzeća kroz usklađivanje s međunarodno priznatim standardima, osiguranje kvalitete usluga, povećanje učinkovitosti i smanjenje troškova. Ciljne skupine su zaposlenici, koji će unaprijediti kompetencije, te klijenti kako na domaćem tako i na međunarodnom tržištu, koji će imati koristi od poboljšane kvalitete usluga. Provedbom projekta doprinijet će se lakšem ulasku na međunarodna tržišta i dugoročnoj konkurentnosti poduzeća.

Operation_Name_English: CEEP: Development and certification of EPS products in accordance with environmental standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: CEEP: Razvoj i certifikacija EPS proizvoda sukladno ekološkim standardima
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project "CEEP" is focused on the certification of EPS products Plastform d.o.o. according to international EPD (ISO 14025) and CE standards. Certification ensures environmental transparency, technical compliance and competitive advantage in the EU market. The project enables the strengthening of export, market recognition and business sustainability through the placement of certified EPS products in the energy efficient construction sector.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "CEEP" usmjeren je na certifikaciju EPS proizvoda Plastform d.o.o. prema međunarodnim standardima EPD (ISO 14025) i CE. Certifikacija osigurava ekološku transparentnost, tehničku usklađenost i konkurentsku prednost na EU tržištu. Projekt omogućuje jačanje izvoza, tržišne prepoznatljivosti i održivosti poslovanja kroz plasman certificiranih EPS proizvoda u sektor energetski učinkovite gradnje.

Operation_Name_English: Let's give them a smile III.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Vratimo im osmijeh III
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Provide care and care for project beneficiaries living in single or two-person households with monthly delivery of household and basic hygiene supplies, which will enable them a better quality of life and affect the prevention of loneliness. The general objective of the project is to prevent the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups and foster social inclusion. The specific objective is to provide daily support to the target group. This will be achieved by employing 10 service providers to perform various tasks including food organization, household chores, personal hygiene maintenance, etc. Project activities include service monitoring, procurement and distribution of packages, as well as project management and communication to ensure the quality and visibility of the project to the target group and the general public.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Omogućiti brigu i skrb za korisnike projekta koji žive u samačkom ili dvočlanom kućanstvu uz mjesečnu isporuku paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština čime ćemo im omogućiti kvalitetniji život i utjecati na sprečavanje osamljivanja. Projekt za opći cilj ima sprečavanje institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina i poticanje socijalne uključenosti. Specifični cilj je pružanje svakodnevne podrške ciljanoj skupini. To će se postići zapošljavanjem 10 pružatelja usluga za obavljanje različitih poslova uključujući organiziranje prehrane, kućanske poslove, održavanje osobne higijene i dr. Projektne aktivnosti uključuju praćenje usluga, nabavu i distribuciju paketa te upravljanje projektom i komunikaciju kako bi se osigurala kvaliteta i vidljivost projekta prema ciljanoj skupini i široj javnosti.

Operation_Name_English: Care holiday - We are here for you
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmor od skrbi - Tu smo za vas
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project "Innovative social services through rest from care" is aimed at supporting parents caregivers who take care of family members with developmental difficulties or disabilities on a daily basis. The project consists of two groups of activities: Individual and group. Professional caregivers will work in three regions (island of Brac, City of Split, Cetinska krajina) with the occasional support of additional professional staff in order to provide rest from care. Through thematic workshops, temporary placement of children during the use of uniforms from care, acquisition of assistive technology and organization of social activities, the project aims to reduce the burden on parents, improve their quality of life and improve care for their families.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt "Inovativne socijalne usluge kroz odmor od skrbi" usmjeren je na podršku roditeljima njegovateljima koji svakodnevno brinu o članovima obitelji s teškoćama u razvoju ili invaliditetom. Projekt se sastoji od dvije grupe aktivnosti: individualnih i grupnih. Stručni njegovatelji djelovati će u tri regije (otok Brač, Grad Split, Cetinska krajina) uz povremenu podršku dodatnog stručnog osoblja u cilju pružanja odmora od skrbi. Kroz tematske radionice, privremeni smještaj djece za vrijeme korištenja odora od skrbi, nabavu asistivne tehnologije i organizaciju društvenih aktivnosti, projekt ima cilj smanjiti opterećenje roditelja, poboljšati njihovu kvalitetu života te unaprijediti skrb za njihove obitelji.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of S-COLOR d.o.o. by introducing a quality management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća S-COLOR d.o.o. uvođenjem sustava upravljanja kvalitetom
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The company S-COLOR d.o.o. by introducing the management system certificate according to the requirements of the ISO standard strengthens international competitiveness and introduces its products to new, foreign markets. The implementation of the project enables increasing the competitiveness of the company S-COLOR d.o.o., strengthening the sales network in foreign markets and increasing sales and export revenues.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Poduzeće S-COLOR d.o.o. uvođenjem certifikata sustava upravljanja prema zahtjevima norme ISO jača međunarodnu konkurentnost te uvodi svoje proizvode na nova, inozemna tržišta. Provedba projekta omogućuje povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća S-COLOR d.o.o., jačanje prodajne mreže na inozemnim tržištima te povećanje prihoda od prodaje i prihoda od izvoza.

Operation_Name_English: Characteristics of the New Age
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ČAROBNJACI NOVOG DOBA
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The New Age Wizards project is aimed at improving the capacity of civil society organizations in cooperation with educational institutions (DV Cvrčak Beli Manstir, Trnava Primary School, A.Horvata Đakovo Primary School) and higher education institution (UNIOS - Department of Physics) to implement educational and promotional STEM activities among children and young people. The project will be implemented for 24 months in rural and/or less developed areas in Osijek-Baranja County through 10 trainings and mentoring of experts, implementation of 120 workshops per year with 300 children and students and 10 promotional activities in public places in the year of implementation. The project will also provide study visits in the country and abroad and participation in STEM conferences.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Čarobnjaci novog doba usmjeren je na unaprjeđenje kapaciteta organizacije civilnoga društva u suradnji s odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama (DV Cvrčak Beli Manstir, OŠ Trnava, SŠ A.Horvata Đakovo) i visokim učilištem (UNIOS - Odjel za fiziku) za provedbu edukacijskih i promotivnih STEM aktivnosti među djecom i mladima. Projekt će se provoditi 24 mjeseca u ruralnim i/ili manje razvijenim područjima u Osječko-baranjskoj županiji kroz 10 izobrazbi i mentoriranja stručnjaka, provedbu 120 radionica godišnje s 300 djece i učenika te 10 promotivnih aktivnosti na javnim mjestima u godini provedbe. Kroz projekt će se osigurati i studijski posjeti u zemlji i inozemstvu te sudjelovanje na STEM konferencijama.

Operation_Name_English: Education without difficulty: implementation of the service of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators to students with disabilities.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Obrazovanje bez teškoća: implementacija usluge pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednik učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to support the inclusion of 93 students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions for the purpose of developing their self-esteem, social skills, raising the quality of life and improving their educational achievements.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta pružiti potporu uključivanju 93 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolske i srednjoškolske odgojno-obrazovne ustanove u svrhu razvoja njihovog samopoštovanja, socijalnih vještina, podizanja kvalitete života i poboljšanja njihovih obrazovnih postignuća.

Operation_Name_English: Blue Zone: Innovative Path to Healthy Cookies
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: "Plava zona ": Inovativni Put prema Zdravim Kolačićima
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation processes, technology transfer and cooperation between enterprises, research centres and universities, focusing on the low carbon economy, resilience and adaptation to climate change
Operation_Summary_English: With the SPIN project, the consortium participates in R&D&I activities aimed at developing innovative food products that help maintain metabolic flexibility and prevent diabetes. The aim of the research is to create healthy sweet and salty snacks using lyophilization technologies and dry spray drying. The consortium holder is Bobis, and partners are Jafra Print, Bokun, Jurin dvor, Polyclinic Dr. Obad and the Faculty of Chemistry and Technology in Split. The main objective of the project is to ensure the strengthening of the competitiveness of RLV by investing in priority niches based on cooperation on the development of innovative solutions of high added value of food products that help maintain metabolic flexibility and prevent diabetes.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom SPIN konzorcij sudjeluje u IRI aktivnostima s ciljem razvoja inovativnih prehrambenih proizvoda koji pomažu u održavanju metaboličke fleksibilnosti i prevenciji dijabetesa. Cilj istraživanja je stvoriti zdrave slatke i slane međuobroke koristeći tehnologije liofilizacije i dry spray sušenja. Nositelj konzorcija je Bobis,a partneri su Jafra Print, Bokun, Jurin dvor, Poliklinika dr. Obad te Kemijsko tehnološki fakultet u Splitu. Glavni cilj projekta je osigurati jačanje konkurentnosti RLV-a ulaganjem u prioritetne niše temeljem suradnje na razvoju inovativnih rješenja visoke dodane vrijednosti prehrambenih proizvoda koji pomažu u održavanju metaboličke fleksibilnosti i prevenciji dijabetesa.

Operation_Name_English: Smile at school 7
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: S osmijehom u školu 7
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure more inclusive education of students with disabilities in primary and secondary educational institutions. This project will support the inclusion of students with disabilities in primary and primary schools in order to ensure the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. The activity of the project proposal includes the cost of work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators for 83 teaching assistants and 3 professional communication mediators. The work of teaching assistants/professional communication mediators is necessary in order to provide support to students with disabilities in education and thus enable the realization of the project goal.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osigurati inkluzivnije obrazovanje učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno obrazovnim ustanovama. Ovim projektom pružit će se potpora uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u OŠ i SŠ kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Aktivnost projektnog prijedloga uključuje trošak rada pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnog komunikacijskog posrednika za 83 pomoćnika u nastavi i 3 stručna komunikacijska posrednika. Rad pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnog komunikacijskog posrednika neophodan je kako bi se učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju osigurala podrška u obrazovanju i tako omogućila realizacija projektnog cilja.

Operation_Name_English: SPIN ESG
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SPIN ESG
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the development of a purpose-designed elastic-flexible structure (EGS) that could be shaped into various variants for the production of furniture with the achievement of top mechanical-physical performance of flexibility and elasticity and high standards of ergonomics, marketable and marketing attractive, usable and recognizable stripped elegant aesthetics of the structure, with minimal use of materials for its development and reduced negative environmental footprint. New products, three versions of the elastic-flexible structure built into the sofa bed, folding chair and deck chair will be protected by an industrial design, and the developed elastic-flexible structure will be protected by a patent.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je razvoj namjenski dizajnirane elastično-gibljive strukture (EGS) koja bi se mogla oblikovati u različite varijante za izradu namještaja uz postizanje vrhunskih mehaničko-fizikalne performansi gipkosti i elastičnosti te visoke standarde ergonomije, tržišno i marketinški privlačne, iskoristive i prepoznatljive ogoljene elegantne estetike konstrukcije, a uz minimalnu upotrebu materijala za njen razvoj te smanjeni negativni otisak na okoliš. Novi proizvodi, tri izvedbe elastično-gibljive strukture ugrađene u sofu na razvlačenje, rasklopnu stolicu i ležaljku će biti zaštićene industrijskim dizajnom, a razvijena elastično-gibljiva struktura će biti zaštićena patentom.

Operation_Name_English: We learn together 7
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Učimo zajedno 7
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Increasing the social inclusion and integration of students with disabilities with a regular education system in order to provide the conditions for improving their educational, emotional and social status. The project plans to implement activities aimed at providing support to students with disabilities through the work of teaching assistants. The target group will be at least 186 students with disabilities in accordance with the relevant regulations on education of students with disabilities, teaching assistants, professional communication mediators, who master the curriculum of the school they attend with difficulties that prevent them from functioning independently. The main goal of the project is to make the educational system more accessible to everyone.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Povećanje socijalne uključenosti i integracije učenika s teškoćama u razvoju uz redovit sustav obrazovanja radi osiguranja uvjeta za poboljšanje njihovog obrazovnog, emocionalnog i socijalnog statusa. Kroz projekt se planiraju provesti aktivnosti usmjerene na pružanje podrške učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi. Ciljana skupina bit će minimalno 186 učenika s teškoćama sukladno relevantnim pravilnicima o odgoju i obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju, pomoćnicima u nastavi, stručnim komunikacijskim posrednicima, a koji svladavaju nastavni plan i program škole koju pohađaju uz teškoće koje ih sprečavaju u samostalnom funkcioniranju. Temeljno nastojanje projekta je učiniti odgojno-obrazovni sustav dostupniji svima.

Operation_Name_English: Development of flow redox battery systems for grid energy storage
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj protočnih redoks baterijskih sustava za mrežnu pohranu energije
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in large enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in large enterprises, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: In order to achieve climate neutrality, the need for sustainable and cost-effective energy storage technology is extremely high. Flow redox batteries are potentially the leading technology for stationary storage of renewable energy that can be integrated into the electrical distribution system. This project will develop an advanced system for storing and distributing large amounts of energy needed to supply consumers, industry and the stability of the power grid based on the described technology. Based on the analysis of existing technologies and their own expertise, they will develop and test an improved and more energy-efficient system with innovative electrolyte and optimal control.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: U cilju postizanja klimatske neutralnosti potreba za održivom i isplativom tehnologijom za pohranu energije izuzetno je velika. Protočne redoks baterije potencijalno su vodeća tehnologija za stacionarnu pohranu obnovljive energije koju je moguće integrirati u elektro distributivni sustav. Ovim projektom razvit će se napredni sustav za pohranu i distribuciju velikih količina energije potrebnih za opskrbu potrošača, industrije i stabilnost elektroenergetske mreže temeljene opisanoj tehnologiji. Na temelju analize postojećih tehnologija i vlastite ekspertize razvit će i testirati unaprijeđeni i energetski efikasniji sustav s inovativnim elektrolitom i optimalnim upravljanjem.

Operation_Name_English: Kindergarten in Mravinci
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dječji vrtić u Mravincima
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: By reconstructing and equipping the existing building for another purpose in order to expand the capacity of the Cvrčak Kindergarten, Solin, additional capacities will be provided and 32 children from the city of Solin will be enrolled in 2 new daily stays (1 kindergarten and 1 nursery group) in the new building of DV Mravince. The implementation of the project will enable the socialization and integration of children and make it easier for their parents to establish a work-life balance. The aim of the project is to provide additional infrastructural and material capacities to increase the availability of early childhood education and care in the city of Solin by building 2 new daily stays (1 kindergarten and 1 nursery group).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Rekonstrukcijom i opremanjem postojeće građevine druge namjene u svrhu proširenja kapaciteta Dječjeg vrtića Cvrčak, Solin, osigurat će se dodatni kapaciteti te omogućiti upis 32 djece iz grada Solina u 2 nova dnevna boravka (1 vrtićka i 1 jaslička skupina) u novom objektu DV Mravince. Provedbom projekta omogućit će socijalizacija i integracija djece a njihovim roditeljima olakšati uspostavljanje ravnoteže poslovnog i privatnog života. Cilj projekta je osigurati dodatne infrastrukturne i materijalne kapacitete za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja u gradu Solinu izgradnjom 2 nova dnevna boravka (1 vrtićka i 1 jaslička skupina).

Operation_Name_English: Certification of products of the company REDOX d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija proizvoda poduzeća REDOX d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The objective of the project investment ‘Certification of products of REDOX d.o.o.’ is to ensure compliance with internationally recognised standards that will prove the quality and safety of products for children. Project realization allows the applicant to free the products from market restrictions and increase trust among users in order to achieve a certain business impact in international markets and positioning in the market with specific and innovative products. The project application results in obtaining 45 certificates for 341 products available to target and end users.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projektnog ulaganja „Certificiranje proizvoda poduzeća REDOX d.o.o.“ je osiguranje usklađenosti sa međunarodno priznatim normama kojima će se dokazati kvaliteta i sigurnost proizvoda za djecu. Projektna realizacija omogućava prijavitelju da se proizvodi oslobode od tržišnih ograničenja i poveća povjerenje među korisnicima u svrhu postizanja određenog poslovnog učinka na međunarodnim tržištima i pozicioniranost na tržištu specifičnim i inovativnim proizvodima. Projektna prijava rezultira s ishođenjem 45 certifikata za 341 proizvod dostupan ciljanim i krajnjim korisnicima.

Operation_Name_English: Upgrading and equipping of the kindergarten in Magadenovac
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Dogradnja i opremanje dječjeg vrtića u Magadenovcu
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project of upgrading and equipping the kindergarten "Snjeguljica" in the village of Magadenovac is important for the provision of infrastructure and material capacities to increase the availability of early childhood education and care. By upgrading and equipping the institution for preschool education, it is possible to increase the capacity of preschool education because the current existing capacities of the kindergarten are not sufficient considering the number of children living in the territory of the Municipality of Magadenovac, who have a need for kindergarten. The aim of the project is to upgrade and equip 1 living room in the kindergarten "Snjeguljica" in the village of Magadenovac and provide them with the opportunity to ensure quality preschool education, regardless of socioeconomic status.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt dogradnja i opremanje dječjeg vrtića "Snjeguljica" u naselju Magadenovac važan je zbog osiguravanja infrastrukturnih i materijalnih kapaciteta za povećanje dostupnosti ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja. Dogradnjom i opremanjem ustanove za predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje omogućava se povećanje kapaciteta predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja jer trenutni postojeći kapaciteti dječjeg vrtića nisu dovoljni s obzirom na broj djece koja žive na području Općine Magadenovac, a koja imaju potrebu za vrtićem. Cilj projekta je dograditi i opremiti 1 dnevni boravak u dječjem vrtiću "Snjeguljica" u naselju Magadenovac i pružiti im priliku za osiguran kvalitetni predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje, bez obzira na socioekonomski status.

Operation_Name_English: With support everything is possible, phase VI
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uz potporu sve je moguće, faza VI
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to ensure inclusive education that puts the needs of 57 students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions founded by the Bjelovar-Bilogora County at the centre. Providing direct support in accordance with the individual needs of students through the project will involve 57 teaching assistants/professional communication mediators in order to contribute to the improvement of students' achievements and their successful socialization with a tendency to independence.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je osiguravanje inkluzivnog obrazovanja koji u središte stavlja potrebe 57 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama kojima je osnivač Bjelovarsko-bilogorska županija. Pružanjem neposredne podrške u skladu s individualnim potrebama učenika kroz projekt uključit će se 57 pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika kako bi se pridonijelo poboljšanju postignuća učenika i njihovoj uspješnoj socijalizaciji s tendencijom osamostaljivanja.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the capacity of the Cvrčak Kindergarten Beli Manastir
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje kapaciteta Dječjeg vrtića Cvrčak Beli Manastir
Category_Label: Infrastructure for early childhood education and care
Operation_Summary_English: The project Increasing the Capacity of the Cvrčak Kindergarten Beli Manastir at Vladimira Nazora 34a, Beli Manastir, refers to the extension of the kindergarten's home building. The project will expand the capacity of the kindergarten for two new children's groups, a recreation hall and office spaces. This upgrade increases the capacity of the kindergarten by enabling the reception of a larger number of children and improves the quality of the services provided through the modernization of premises and equipment. The project is aligned with the Competitiveness and Cohesion Programme and the National Plan for the Development of the Education System 2021-2027, ensuring inclusive and accessible education for all children.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Povećanje kapaciteta Dječjeg vrtića Cvrčak Beli Manastir na adresi Vladimira Nazora 34a, Beli Manastir odnosi se na dogradnju matične zgrade vrtića. Projektom će se proširiti kapacitet vrtića za dvije nove dječje skupine, dvoranom za rekreaciju i uredskim prostorijama. Ova dogradnja povećava kapacitet vrtića omogućavajući prijem većeg broja djece te poboljšava kvalitetu pruženih usluga kroz modernizaciju prostora i opreme. Projekt je usklađen s programom Konkurentnost i kohezija te Nacionalnim planom razvoja sustava obrazovanja 2021.-2027., osiguravajući inkluzivno i pristupačno obrazovanje za svu djecu.

Operation_Name_English: The digital age: Networking and strengthening the capacity of trade unions to act more efficiently
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Digitalno doba: Umrežavanje i jačanje kapaciteta sindikata za efikasnije djelovanje
Category_Label: Measures to modernise and strengthen labour market institutions and services to assess and anticipate skills needs and to ensure timely and tailor-made assistance
Operation_Summary_English: The project is focused on the development of SMH-IS capacities through the education of employees and trustees, the exchange of experiences through networking and the development of new and improvement of existing services through the implementation of digital tools. The expected outcome of the project is to strengthen the capacity of trade unions, which will lead to more efficient work and better representation of workers.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt je usmjeren na razvoj kapaciteta SMH-IS kroz obrazovanje zaposlenika i povjerenika, razmjenu iskustava putem umrežavanja te razvoj novih i unaprjeđenje postojećih usluga implementacijom digitalnih alata. Očekivani ishod projekta je jačanje kapaciteta sindikata, što će dovesti do učinkovitijeg rada i kvalitetnijeg zastupanja radnika.

Operation_Name_English: Development of social plan of Koprivnica-Križevci County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada socijalnog plana Koprivničko-križevačke županije
Category_Label: Measures to promote equal opportunities and active participation in society
Operation_Summary_English: This project will draw up a county social plan for the period from 2024 to 2026. The social plan of the counties will be drawn up in accordance with the Rules on a uniform methodology for assessing needs up to the level of readiness for adoption. The overall objective is to contribute to increasing the availability and balanced regional development of social services in the Republic of Croatia. The specific objective is to support the county in developing a social plan and to empower experts in social planning, implementation and monitoring of county social plans.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom će se izraditi socijalni plan županije za razdoblje od 2024. do 2026. Socijalni plan županija e bit će izrađen sukladno Pravilniku o jedinstvenoj metodologiji za procjenu potreba do razine spremnosti za usvajanje. Opći cilj je doprinijeti povećanju dostupnosti i ravnomjernom regionalnom razvoju socijalnih usluga u RH. Specifični cilj je pružiti podršku županiji u izradi socijalnog plana te osnažiti stručnjake za socijalno planiranje, provedbu i praćenje županijskih socijalnih planova.

Operation_Name_English: The victorious aging
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pobjedonosno starenje
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. The activity of the project is the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of necessities, which includes: Recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group, monitoring and control of performed services, procurement and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnost projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština, koja uključuje: zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Poverty alleviation in Adriatic Croatia
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ublažavanje siromaštva u Jadranskoj Hrvatskoj
Category_Label: Addressing material deprivation through food and/or material assistance to the most deprived, including accompanying measures
Operation_Summary_English: The project will bring together four other project partners who care for the same group of beneficiaries in the remaining five Adriatic counties and will jointly implement the activity Distribution of assistance in the form of food packages and packages of basic material assistance to the members of the target group and the provision of accompanying measures, all in order to contribute to the achievement of the specific objective of the PDP and the general objective of the PDP.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će prijavitelj Caritas Zadarske nadbiskupije koji skrbi o potrebitim osobama u dvije Jadranske županije okupiti još četiri projektna partnera koji skrbe o istoj skupini korisnika u preostalih pet Jadranskih županija te će zajednički provoditi aktivnost Podjela pomoći u obliku paketa hrane i paketa osnovne materijalne pomoći pripadnicima ciljane skupine te pružanje popratnih mjera, a sve kako bi se doprinijelo ostvarivanju specifičnog cilja PDP-a te Općeg cilja PDP-a.

Operation_Name_English: CE certification as a prerequisite for export to the EU market
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacija CE oznakom kao preduvjet izvoza na tržište EU
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The Green Deal company, through the implementation of this project, seeks to solve the key problem of lack of certificates for the purpose of expanding its business and entering new markets. By introducing the CE certificate for compost, the company will ensure compliance of its product – compost with European quality and safety standards, which will enable the product to be placed on the EU market, which will result in increased sales and export revenues and strengthening the competitiveness of the company through the expansion of market reach, greater product recognition and easier access to customers. The target groups of the project are customers, suppliers, employees and the local community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Poduzeće Zeleni plan provedbom ovog projekta nastoji riješiti ključan problem nedostatka certifikata za potrebe proširenja poslovanja i ulaska na nova tržišta. Uvođenjem CE certifikata za kompost poduzeće će osigurati usklađenost svoga proizvoda – komposta s europskim standardima kvalitete i sigurnosti, čime će se omogućiti plasman proizvoda na tržište Europske unije što će rezultirati povećanjem prihoda od prodaje i izvoza te jačanjem konkurentnosti poduzeća kroz širenje tržišnog dosega, veću prepoznatljivost proizvoda i lakši pristup kupcima. Ciljne skupine projekta su kupci, dobavljači, zaposlenici i lokalna zajednica.

Operation_Name_English: Wood4STEM 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Wood4STEM 2
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project strengthens the capacities of the Wood Cluster SLAVONSKI HRAST to promote STEM among children and students. The project leader is Wood Cluster SLAVONSKI HRAST, with partners: Faculty of Forestry and Wood Technology, University of Zagreb, Vinkovci School of Wood Technology, Gradište Elementary School and Kindergartens Mali svijet in Gradište and Maslačak in Županja. The goals are to improve the capacities of the association for the implementation of STEM programs, to encourage the interest of children and young people in STEM and to ensure better cooperation of educational institutions through training, study visit, STEM workshops and conferences with a focus on biotechnology. The purpose is to increase children's interest in STEM, improve their skills and knowledge and provide education programmes adapted to the labour market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt jača kapacitete Drvnog klastera SLAVONSKI HRAST za promociju STEM-a među djecom i učenicima. Nositelj projekta je Drvni klaster SLAVONSKI HRAST, uz partnere: Fakultet šumarstva i drvne tehnologije Sveučilišta u Zagrebu, Drvodjelsku tehničku školu Vinkovci, Osnovnu školu Gradište te dječje vrtiće Mali svijet u Gradištu i Maslačak u Županji. Ciljevi su unaprijediti kapacitete udruge za provedbu STEM programa, potaknuti interes djece i mladih za STEM te osigurati bolju suradnju obrazovnih institucija kroz izobrazbu, studijski posjet, STEM radionice i konferencije s fokusom na biotehnologiju. Svrha je povećati interes djece za STEM, unaprijediti njihove vještine i znanja te osigurati obrazovne programe prilagođene tržištu rada.

Operation_Name_English: Cycling Port - section of Zagorje highway
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Biciklistička Luka -dionica zagorske magistrale
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the construction of two sections of the pedestrian-cycling trail and marking and equipping the entire route of the cycling Zagorje highway D6 that passes through the Municipality of Luka. A total of 790 m will be built in the part of Dubravka Ožegovića Street and 6.6 km of road will be equipped and marked for the use of environmentally friendly means of transport and better transport connections in the Municipality of Luka . The trail is part of the so-called Zagorje Bike Highway and will connect the Municipality of Kupljenvo and the Municipality of Veliko trgovišče. The target group of the project are residents of the Municipality of Luka , as well as all cyclists who will use the cycling infrastructure in the area of the cycling-connected UA Zagreb in the future.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je izgradnja dvije dionice pješačko- biciklističke staze te označavanje i opremanje cijele trase biciklističke Zagorske magistrale D6 koja prolazi kroz Općinu Luku. Ukupno 790 m u dijelu ulice Dubravka Ožegovića će se izgraditi a opremiti se i obilježiti 6,6 kilometra ceste namijenjene korištenju ekološki prihvatljivih sredstava prijevoza i boljoj prometnoj povezanosti u Općini Luka . Predmetna staza je dio tzv. Zagorske biciklističke magistrale te će te će povezati Općine Kupljenovo i Općinu Veliko trgovišče. Ciljna skupina projekta su stanovnici Općine Luka , kao i svi biciklisti koji će u budućnosti koristiti biciklističku infrastrukturu na području biciklistički povezane UA Zagreb.

Operation_Name_English: STEM games
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEM igrice
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The goal of STEM games is to strengthen the capacity of STEM practitioners through attending trainings, attending fairs/conferences, and conducting STEM workshops and STEM promotions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: STEM igrice imaju cilj jačanje kapaciteta provoditelja STEM aktivnosti putem pohađanja izobrazbi, odlaske na sajmove/konferencije te provođenje STEM radionica i STEM promocija.

Operation_Name_English: STEMerica is moving on.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: STEMerica ide dalje
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Objectives: improving the capacity of CSOs to implement programmes in the field of STEM promotion and cooperation with higher education institutions and educational institutions. Project activities: cooperation with 1 HEI (mentoring) and training activities carried out, study visits and attendance at fairs/conferences; promotion of STEM areas among children and students (81 workshops/activities per year - 243 in 36 months, 600 children/pupils per year - 1800 for 36 months); promotion of STEM areas in public places (40 events). Purpose and justification of the project: strengthening the capacities of CSOs and promoting STEM through scientific-popular events and gaining the knowledge that knowledge can be adopted in a fun, stimulating and close way for students.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ciljevi: unapređivanje kapaciteta OCD-a za provedbu programa u području promocije STEM-a i suradnja s visokim učilištem i odgojno-obrazovnim institucijama. Aktivnosti projekta: suradnja s 1 visokim učilištem (mentoriranje) i provedene aktivnosti izobrazbe, studijski posjeti i pohađanje sajmova/konferencija; promocija STEM područja među djecom i učenicima (81 provedena radionica/aktivnosti godišnje - 243 u 36 mjeseci, 600 uključene djece/učenika godišnje - 1800 za 36 mj); promocija STEM područja na javnim mjestima (40 manifestacija). Svrha i opravdanost projekta: jačanje kapaciteta OCD-a i promocija STEM-a kroz znanstveno-popularna događanja te stjecanje spoznaje da se znanje može usvajati na zabavan, poticajan i učenicima blizak način.

Operation_Name_English: SPIN HEYGUEST ISLAND
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: SPIN HEYGUEST ISLAND
Category_Label: Investment in intangible assets in SMEs (including private research centres) directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The subject of the project is the development of an innovative product called HEYGUEST ISLAND Self-sustaining sales island that belongs to the niche of the added value of SmartTech solutions for smart cities and smart islands within the Regional value chain of the Smart Industry of Adriatic Croatia and the encouragement of solving key social challenges of the Adriatic Croatia region. The total value of the project is EUR 4,818,598.35, the total eligible costs of the project is EUR 4,687,500.40 and the expected grant is EUR 2,998,662.26.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Predmet projekta je razvoj inovativnog proizvoda pod nazivom HEYGUEST ISLAND Samoodrživi prodajni otok koji pripada niši dodane vrijednosti SmartTech rješenja za pametne gradove i pametne otoke u okviru Regionalnog lanca vrijednosti Pametne industrije Jadranske Hrvatske te poticanje rješavanja ključnih društvenih izazove regije Jadranska Hrvatska. Ukupna vrijednost projekta iznosi 4.818.598,35 EUR, iznos ukupno prihvatljivih troškova projekta je 4.687.500,40 EUR dok očekivana bespovratna sredstva iznose 2.998.662,26 EUR.

Operation_Name_English: Lighthouse of Equal Values
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Svjetionik jednakih vrijednosti
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. The specific objective is to provide support and support services in everyday life for the elderly and people with disabilities. The activity of the project is the provision of support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of necessities, which includes: Recruitment of service providers for at least 6 members of the target group, monitoring and control of performed services, procurement and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and visibility, project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Specifični cilj je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom. Aktivnost projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština, koja uključuje: zapošljavanje pružatelja usluga za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine, praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, nabavu i podjelu paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, komunikaciju i vidljivost, upravljanje projektom i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Wanted for the municipality of Stankovci II
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi za općinu Stankovci II
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The implementation of the project "Wish for the municipality of Stankovci II" will affect social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups through providing assistance in the home and in carrying out everyday activities to the elderly and people with disabilities in the municipality of Stankovci. The project will employ a total of 12 providers, while care will be provided for 72 users. The service includes performing small household chores (cleaning, preparing simple meals), buying groceries and medicines, paying bills, socializing and talking to users. The project team will coordinate the management and administration of the project. The public and the target group will be informed about the project through the applicant's website, media, posters, leaflets and conferences.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Provedbom projekta "Zaželi za općinu Stankovci II" utjecat će se na socijalnu uključenost i prevenciju institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina kroz pružanje pomoći u kući i pri obavljanju svakodnevnih aktivnosti starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom na području općine Stankovci. Na projektu će biti zaposleno ukupno 12 pružatelja/pružateljica usluga, dok će skrb biti omogućena za 72 korisnika. Usluga obuhvaća obavljanje sitnih kućanskih poslova (čišćenje, priprema jednostavnih obroka), kupnju namirnica i lijekova, plaćanje računa, druženje i razgovor s korisnicima. Projektni tim će koordinirati upravljanje i administraciju projekta. Javnost i ciljana skupina o projektu će biti informirana putem web stranice prijavitelja, medija, plakata, letaka i konferencija.

Operation_Name_English: By caring for the elderly, let's help Zagora
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Brigom za starije pomozimo Zagori
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to contribute to social inclusion and the improvement of the quality of life of the target group members, persons over 65 and persons with disabilities from the territory of the municipality by providing support and support services for everyday life.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta doprinijeti socijalnoj uključenosti i poboljšanju razine kvalitete života pripadnika ciljne skupine, osoba starijih od 65 i osoba s invaliditetom s područja općine pružanjem usluge potpore i podrške svakodnevnom životu.

Operation_Name_English: In-In - integration and inclusion
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: In-In - integracija i inkluzija
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The overall objective of the project is to ensure inclusive education of students with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions. The main project activity includes providing support to the education of students with TUR through the work of PUN/CPC (selection of candidates for PUN/CPC, implementation of the programme of introduction into the work of PUN/CPC, work of PUN/CPC with students with disabilities.)
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je osiguranje inkluzivnog obrazovanja učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno obrazovnim ustanovama. Glavna projektna aktivnost uključuje pružanje potpore obrazovanju učenika s TUR kroz rad PUN/SKP (selekcija kandidata za PUN/SKP, provedba programa uvođenja u rad PUN/SKP, rad PUN/SKP s učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju.)

Operation_Name_English: You are not forgotten
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Niste zaboravljeni
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: Increasing social inclusion and preventing the institutionalisation of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care. Providing support and support services for the elderly and persons with disabilities in their daily lives.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi. Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom.

Operation_Name_English: Get involved
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uključi se
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: By employing 17 people, the project aims to include 120 members of targeted groups who will be provided with support and support services and contribute to their social inclusion. Activities include the provision of support and support services and procurement and the distribution of supplies packages.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je zapošljavanjem 17 osoba uključiti 120 pripadnika ciljanih skupina kojima će se pružati usluga potpore i podrške te doprinijeti njihovoj socijalnoj uključenosti. Aktivnosti uključuju pružanje usluga potpore i podrške i nabavu te podjelu paketa potrepština.

Operation_Name_English: Desires and achieves 4
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi i ostvari 4
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of this project is to provide support and support in everyday life to people over 65 years of age and adults with disabilities, increase social inclusion and prevent the institutionalization of vulnerable groups in the area of Lipovljani municipality. The project will provide a service for at least 90 members of the target group who will improve the quality of life through project activities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj ovog projekta je pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu osobama starijim od 65 godina i odraslim osobama s invaliditetom, povećanje socijalne uključenosti te prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina na području općine Lipovljani. Projektom će se usluga pružati za najmanje 90 osoba pripadnika ciljne skupine kojima će kroz projektne aktivnosti omogućiti unaprjeđenje kvalitete života.

Operation_Name_English: Examination of the possibility of developing new generation positron emission tomography devices in the Republic of Croatia
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Ispitivanje mogućnosti razvoja uređaja za pozitronsku emisijsku tomografiju nove generacije u Republici Hrvatskoj
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: MEDiLAB has been present in the medical diagnostics market for more than 30 years and as one of the directions of business development sees the inclusion in research and development (R&D) of advanced medical technologies, with which better quality diagnostics would be made more accessible to more patients. Positron emission tomography (PET) is an imaging method that is successfully used in medical diagnostics, and the current state of the technique shows the possibility of its progress. As part of the MEDiLAB project, based on the expertise of the Faculty of Science, it will determine the plan of inclusion in the R&D PET of the new generation, as the first company that enters this type of research in the Republic of Croatia, which would open up new market potential and create opportunities for the Croatian industry.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: MEDiLAB je više od 30 godina prisutan na tržištu medicinske dijagnostike te kao jedan od smjerova poslovnog razvoja vidi uključivanje u istraživanje i razvoj (R&D) naprednih medicinskih tehnologija, uz koje bi se kvalitetnija dijagnostika učinila dostupnijom većem broju pacijenata. Pozitronska emisijska tomografija (PET) je slikovna metoda koja se uspješno koristi u medicinskoj dijagnostici, a trenutno stanje tehnike pokazuje mogućnost njenog napretka. U sklopu projekta MEDiLAB će na temelju ekspertize Prirodoslovno-matematičkog fakulteta, odrediti plan uključivanja u R&D PET-a nove generacije, kao prva tvrtka koja ulazi u ovaj tip istraživanja u RH, čime bi se otvorio novi tržišni potencijal te stvorile prilike za hrvatsku industriju.

Operation_Name_English: Equal in education
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jednaki u obrazovanju
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal ‘Equal in Education’ has a duration of 36 months and aims to increase the social inclusion and integration of 173 pupils with disabilities in primary and secondary education institutions by supporting the education of students with disabilities through 164 teaching assistants/professional communication mediators for the target group, pupils with disabilities, for the next three school years (2024/2025, 2025/2026, 2026/2027).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni prijedlog „Jednaki u obrazovanju“ traje 36 mjeseci, a ima za cilj povećanje socijalne uključenosti i integracije 173 učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama kroz pružanje podrške obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju kroz 164 pomoćnika u nastavi/stručnog komunikacijskog posrednika za ciljnu skupinu, učenike s teškoćama u razvoju, za naredne tri školske godine (2024./2025., 2025./2026., 2026./2027.).

Operation_Name_English: Providing support and support services for the elderly and persons with disabilities in their daily lives
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide support and support services in everyday life to the elderly and people with disabilities in the area of Split-Dalmatia County and Šibenik-Knin County. On the basis of a public call, 180 users will be selected and 30 employees will provide support and support services over 30 months.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj je projekta pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom na području Splitsko-dalmatinske županije i Šibensko-kninske županije. Na temelju javnog poziva birat će se 180 korisnika kojima će 30 zaposlenika tijekom 30 mjeseci pružati usluge potpore i podrške.

Operation_Name_English: Construction of cycling infrastructure in the village of Laslovo
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izgradnja biciklističke infrastrukture u naselju Laslovo
Category_Label: Cycling infrastructure
Operation_Summary_English: The purpose of the project "Construction of cycling infrastructure in the village of Laslovo" is to build 4,280 meters of cycling and walking trails, contributing to better connectivity of rural and urban areas of the urban agglomeration of Osijek, reduced use of personal vehicles for the benefit of local cycling, as well as reducing emissions of harmful substances that affect the pollution of the atmosphere and the environment. The duration of the project is 24 months, and the location of implementation is the village of Laslovo, which administratively belongs to the Municipality of Ernestinovo in the Osijek-Baranja County.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Svrha projekta "Izgradnja biciklističke infrastrukture u naselju Laslovo" je izgraditi 4.280 metara biciklističko - pješačke staze pridonoseći boljoj povezanosti ruralnih i urbanih područja urbane aglomeracije Osijek, smanjenom korištenju osobnih vozila u korist lokalnih putovanja biciklom, kao i smanjenju emisija štetnih tvari koje utječu na zagađenje atmosfere i okoliša. Trajanje projekta je 24 mjeseca, a lokacija provedbe je naselje Laslovo koje administrativno pripada Općini Ernestinovo u Osječko - baranjskoj županiji.

Operation_Name_English: School FULL OF POSSIBILITY 7.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: ŠKOLA PUNa MOGUĆNOSTI 7.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The program of teaching assistants has proven to be an important factor in achieving educational success, more successful socialization and emotional functioning, and there is a visible progress in the development of skills and abilities of students with disabilities, which equalizes their opportunities. The purpose of this project is to support the inclusion of 116 students with TUR in 9 primary schools of the city of Zadar during the school year 2023/2024, which will directly contribute to increasing the social inclusion and integration of students with TUR in the primary school of the city of Zadar, in order to ensure the conditions for improving their educational achievements, more successful socialization and emotional functioning. Thus, the purpose and objective of the project are directly aligned with the general and specific objective of this Call as well as with the EU national strategic documents, which are precisely and exhaustively listed in the Instructions for Applicants.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Program pomoćnika u nastavi pokazao se kao bitan faktor u postizanju odgojno-obrazovnih uspjeha, uspješnijoj socijalizaciji i emocionalnom funkcioniranju te je vidljiv napredak u razvoju vještina i sposobnosti učenika s teškoćama u razvoju čime se izjednačuju njihove mogućnosti. Svrha ovog projekta je pružiti podršku uključivanju 116 učenika/ca s TUR u 9 osnovnih škola grada Zadra tijekom školske godine 2023./2024., čime će se izravno doprinijeti povećanju socijalne uključenosti i integracije učenika s TUR u OŠ grada Zadra, a kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje. Time su svrha i cilj projekta izravno usklađeni s općim i specifičnim ciljem ovog Poziva kao i s EU nacionalnim strateškim dokumentima koji su precizno i taksativno navedeni u Uputama za prijavitelje.

Operation_Name_English: Growing up with STEM
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Rastimo uz STEM
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project titled "Growing Up with STEM" will be implemented in the Šibenik-Knin County for a period of 24 months. Beneficiaries of the project are kindergarten children and pupils of lower grades of primary schools, it is planned to include a total of 300 children per year of project implementation. The project applicant is the Youth Association ''Youth in the EU'', partners are: VUŠ, DV Maslina, KK Kolan and the City of Šibenik. The main activity of the project is the implementation of STEM workshops for users and the implementation of public events with the aim of promoting STEM areas.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt pod nazivom ''Rastimo uz STEM'' provoditi će se na području Šibensko-kninske županije u trajanju od 24 mjeseca. Korisnici projekta su djeca vrtićke dobi i učenici nižih razreda osnovnih škola, planirano je po godini provedbe projekta obuhvatiti ukupno 300 djece. Prijavitelj projekta je Udruga mladih ''Mladi u EU'', partneri su: VUŠ, DV Maslina, KK Kolan i Grad Šibenik. Glavna aktivnost projekta je provedba STEM radionica za korisnike te provođenje javnih događanja sa ciljem promoviranja STEM područja.

Operation_Name_English: Certification to increase competitiveness and improve and expand the company's business
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do povećanja konkurentnosti te unaprjeđenja i širenja poslovanja tvrtke
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to introduce a management system according to ISO 9001:2015 standard that will make the company more competitive on the national and international market and thus enable it to further grow in accordance with strategic goals. The implementation of the management system and the acquisition of ISO certification will result in greater customer confidence, but also a more productive, efficient and secure business, which is the interest of the company, employees, clients and suppliers who are the target group of the project. By implementing the project, the company will be able to get new jobs/contracts and new clients that require suppliers to comply with internationally recognized standards, and in which so far it has not been able to compete.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je uvođenje sustava upravljanja prema normi ISO 9001:2015 koji će tvrtku učiniti konkurentnijom na nacionalnom i internacionalnom tržištu te joj time omogućiti daljnji rast u skladu sa strateškim ciljevima. Implementacija sustava upravljanja i stjecanje ISO certifikata rezultirat će većim povjerenjem kupaca, ali i produktivnijim, efikasnijim i sigurnijim poslovanjem, što je interes tvrtke, djelatnika, klijenata i dobavljača koji su ciljana skupina projekta. Provedbom projekta tvrtka će biti u mogućnosti dobivati nove poslove / ugovore i nove klijente koji zahtijevaju od dobavljača usklađenost prema međunarodno priznatim normama, a u kojima do sada nije mogla konkurirati.

Operation_Name_English: Humanity in the Home
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Humanost u domu
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to provide quality support services in everyday life for 150 elderly people and people with disabilities located in the territory of the city of Knin. The realisation of support services, including the procurement and distribution of packages, includes the following activities: employment of 25 persons for the provision of services, systematic monitoring and control of the services provided, organization and distribution of household and basic hygiene supplies, promotion, increasing the visibility of the project and U&A.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta fokusira se na pružanje kvalitetnih usluga podrške u svakodnevnom životu za 150 starijih osoba i osoba s invaliditetom smještenih na teritoriju grada Knina. Realizacija usluga podrške, uključujući nabavu i distribuciju paketa uključuje sljedeće aktivnosti: zapošljavanje 25 osoba za pružanje usluge, sustavno praćenje i kontrola pruženih usluga, organiziranje i distribucija kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština, promociju, povećanje vidljivosti projekta te U&A.

Operation_Name_English: Rest from care - Varaždin County
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmor od skrbi - Varaždinska županija
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will enable a temporary takeover of the care of a person with a disability, either at the user's home or in the applicant's premises. The service will be adapted to the specific needs of each family, either within a few hours a week or as a multi-day support, depending on individual circumstances. Users will also be provided with emotional and psychological support (individual and group), along with physical care for a person with disabilities. Users will be able to get advice or support via the Internet or phone, to feel supported and to be emotionally strengthened. Joint excursions and gatherings are also planned, going to the theater, cinema, to plays, to museums, and users will be offered the services of the City Pools Varaždin.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se omogućiti privremeno preuzimanje brige o osobi s invaliditetom, bilo kod kuće korisnika ili u prostoru prijavitelja. Usluga će se prilagođavati specifičnim potrebama svake obitelji, bilo kroz nekoliko sati tjedno ili kao višednevna podrška, ovisno o individualnim okolnostima. Korisnicima će se pružati i emocionalna i psihološka podrška (individualna i grupna), uz fizičku skrb o osobi s invaliditetom. Korisnici će moći dobiti savjetovanje ili podršku putem interneta ili telefona, kako bi se osjećali podržano i kako bi bili emocionalno ojačani. Također se planiraju i zajednički izleti i druženja, odlasci u kazalište, kino, na predstave, u muzeje, a korisnicima će se ponuditi i usluge Gradskih bazena Varaždin.

Operation_Name_English: Integrated approach to the removal of buildings, production and finishing of building materials - RuCEP
