Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Integrirani pristup zahvatima uklanjanja građevina, proizvodnji i doradi građevinskih materijala - RuCEP
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: The project Integrated Approach to Construction Removal, Production and Finishing of Building Materials - RuCEP is implemented in Pannonian Croatia, within the RLV Green Growth, priority niche Green Building. The project is implemented by a consortium consisting of 6 SME partners, 1 OIŠZ partners and in cooperation with the City of Požega. The aim of the project is to develop 3 innovations based on the principles of the circular economy and the use of the latest available technologies of 3D spatial data collection, artificial intelligence and production automation.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Integrirani pristup zahvatima uklanjanja građevina, proizvodnji i doradi građevinskih materijala - RuCEP provodi se u Panonskoj Hrvatskoj, u okviru RLV Zeleni rast, prioritetnoj niši Zelena gradnja. Projekt provodi konzorcij koji se sastoji od 6 partnera MSP-ova, 1 partnera OIŠZ te u suradnji s Gradom Požegom. Cilj projekta je razvoj 3 inovacije temeljene na principima kružnog gospodarstva te upotrebi najnovijih dostupnih tehnologija prikupljanja 3D prostornih podataka, umjetnoj inteligenciji te automatizaciji proizvodnje.

Operation_Name_English: Schools of Equal Opportunities in Međimurje County in the school year 2023/2024
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Škole jednakih mogućnosti u Međimurskoj županiji u školskoj godini 2023./2024.
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The project will provide support for the inclusion of students with disabilities in elementary schools and elementary schools founded by Međimurje County in order to ensure conditions for the improvement of their educational achievements , more successful socialization and emotional functioning and thus solve the problem of lack of support to students with disabilities who cannot function independently without PUN support.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom će se pružati potpora uključivanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u OŠ i SŠ kojima je Međimurska županija osnivač kako bi se osigurali uvjeti za poboljšanje njihovih obrazovnih postignuća , uspješniju socijalizaciju i emocionalno funkcioniranje i time će se riješiti problem nedostatka potpore učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju koji ne mogu samostalno funkcionirati bez podrške PUN-a.

Operation_Name_English: We learn together 8
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Učimo zajedno 8
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: Increasing the social inclusion and integration of students with disabilities into a regular education system in order to provide the conditions for improving their educational, emotional and social status. The project plans to implement activities aimed at providing support to students with disabilities through the work of teaching assistants. The target group will be at least 186 students with disabilities in accordance with the legal regulations on the education of students with disabilities, teaching assistants, professional communication mediators, who master the curriculum of the school they attend with difficulties that prevent them from functioning independently. The main goal of the project is to make the educational system more accessible to everyone.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Povećanje socijalne uključenosti i integracije učenika s teškoćama u razvoju u redovit sustav obrazovanja radi osiguravanja uvjeta za poboljšanje njihovog obrazovnog, emocionalnog i socijalnog statusa. Kroz projekt se planiraju provesti aktivnosti usmjerene na pružanje podrške učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju kroz rad pomoćnika u nastavi. Ciljna skupina bit će minimalno 186 učenika s teškoćama sukladno zakonskim regulativama o odgoju i obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju, pomoćnicima u nastavi, stručnim komunikacijskim posrednicima, a koji svladavaju nastavni plan i program škole koju pohađaju uz teškoće koje ih sprečavaju u samostalnom funkcioniranju. Temeljno nastojanje projekta je učiniti odgojno-obrazovni sustav dostupniji svima.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of the company JATRO d.o.o. by implementing the quality management system ISO 9001
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća JATRO d.o.o. implementacijom sustava upravljanja kvalitetom ISO 9001
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Increasing the competitiveness of JATRO d.o.o. by implementing the ISO 9001 quality management system’ is aimed at solving the problem of insufficient standardisation of business processes and quality control, which hinders competitiveness in the shipbuilding and construction market. The overall objective of the project is to strengthen the market position of the company through compliance with internationally recognized standards, ensuring the quality of services, increasing efficiency and reducing costs. The target groups are employees, who will improve competencies, and clients in the international market, who will benefit from improved service quality. The implementation of the project contributes to easier entry into international markets and long-term competitiveness of companies.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća JATRO d.o.o. implementacijom sustava upravljanja kvalitetom ISO 9001“ usmjeren je na rješavanje problema nedostatne standardizacije poslovnih procesa i kontrole kvalitete, što otežava konkurentnost na tržištu brodogradnje i građevinarstva. Opći cilj projekta je jačanje tržišne pozicije poduzeća kroz usklađivanje s međunarodno priznatim standardima, osiguranje kvalitete usluga, povećanje učinkovitosti i smanjenje troškova. Ciljne skupine su zaposlenici, koji će unaprijediti kompetencije, te klijenti na međunarodnom tržištu, koji će imati koristi od poboljšane kvalitete usluga. Provedbom projekta doprinosi se lakšem ulasku na međunarodna tržišta i dugoročnoj konkurentnosti poduzeća.

Operation_Name_English: Zaželi - prevention of institutionalization - City of Županja
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zaželi - prevencija institucionalizacije - Grad Županja
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project aims to contribute to greater social inclusion, prevention of institutionalization, staying in one's own home and ensuring the right to live in the community for members of target groups in the city of Županja. 35 service providers will be employed to implement the project and will provide services to at least 210 people over a 28-month period.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom se želi doprinijeti većoj socijalnoj uključenosti, prevenciji institucionalizacije, ostanku u vlastitom domu te osiguravanju prava na život u zajednici pripadnicima ciljnih skupina u gradu Županji. Za provedbu projekta zaposlit će se 35 pružatelja usluga koji će tijekom 28 mjeseci pružati usluge za minimalno 210 osoba.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of KAMIKS EKO d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva KAMIKS EKO d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is the implementation and certification of the business continuity management system according to ISO 22301. The purpose is to increase the company's resilience to business interruptions and to ensure compliance with internationally recognised standards. The project includes analysis of the current situation, education of employees, development of policies and procedures, implementation of the system and certification. Expected results include revenue growth of 16% 9 export revenue growth of 31%.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je implementacija i certifikacija sustava upravljanja kontinuitetom poslovanja prema normi ISO 22301. Svrha je povećati otpornost tvrtke na prekide u poslovanju i osigurati usklađenost s međunarodno priznatim standardima. Projekt uključuje analizu trenutnog stanja, edukaciju zaposlenika, razvoj politika i procedura, implementaciju sustava te certifikaciju. Očekivani rezultati uključuju rast prihoda 16% 9 rast prihoda od izvoza 31%.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the international business competitiveness of Layer d.o.o. by reaching the applicable levels of internationally recognized norms and standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti poslovanja društva Layer d.o.o. dostizanjem primjenjivih razina međunarodno priznatih normi i standarda
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to improve business processes and increase the international competitiveness of the company through the certification of management systems according to internationally recognized standards ISO 20000-1 (management of IT services) and ISO 22301 (management of business continuity). The purpose of the project is to ensure the standardization, quality and resilience of the business and strengthen the trust of clients and partners in the global market. Expected results include implementation and certification of two management systems, increase in sales revenue by 15% and export by 20%, and strengthening the position of the company on the international market through meeting the requirements of recognized standards. These activities will enable sustainable growth and long-term competitiveness.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je unaprijediti poslovne procese i povećati međunarodnu konkurentnost poduzeća kroz certificiranje sustava upravljanja prema međunarodno priznatim normama ISO 20000-1 (upravljanje IT uslugama) i ISO 22301 (upravljanje kontinuitetom poslovanja). Svrha projekta je osigurati standardizaciju, kvalitetu i otpornost poslovanja te ojačati povjerenje klijenata i partnera na globalnom tržištu. Očekivani rezultati uključuju implementaciju i certificiranje dva sustava upravljanja, povećanje prihoda od prodaje za 15% i izvoza za 20%, te jačanje pozicije poduzeća na međunarodnom tržištu kroz ispunjavanje zahtjeva priznatih normi. Ove aktivnosti omogućit će održiv rast i dugoročnu konkurentnost.

Operation_Name_English: Community strengthens us
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedništvo nas jača
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The project will contribute to the prevention of institutionalization and increase the social inclusion of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care through the provision of support and support services in everyday life to the elderly and persons with disabilities.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt će doprinijeti prevenciji institucionalizacije i povećanju socijalne uključenosti ranjivih skupina osiguravajući dugotrajnu skrb kroz pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i osobama s invaliditetom.

Operation_Name_English: ‘Strengthening the competitiveness of TUBUS d.o.o. by implementing an environmental management system’
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: „Jačanje konkurentnosti društva TUBUS d.o.o. implementacijom sustava upravljanja okolišem“
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of TUBUS d.o.o. by implementing an environmental management system. The purpose of the project is to align business processes with international environmental standards with the aim of raising the level of quality and security in the exchange of goods and services and customer confidence. Expected results include implemented environmental management system as ISO 14001:2015, increased sales and export revenues, increased turnover. International competitiveness will be achieved by the company's certification of business processes in accordance with the requirements of the standard as ISO 14001:2015, which will ensure greater recognition and trust of customers. The project includes employee education and promotional activities that will ensure the sustainability of the business in the long term.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti društva TUBUS d.o.o. implementacijom sustava upravljanja okoliša. Svrha projekta je usklađivanje poslovnih procesa s međunarodnim ekološkim normama s ciljem podizanja razine kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni roba i usluga te povjerenja kupaca. Očekivani rezultati uključuju implementiran sustav upravljanja okolišem kao ISO 14001:2015, povećanje prihoda od prodaje i izvoza, povećani promet. Međunarodnu konkurentnost društvo će postići certifikacijom poslovnih procesa u skladu sa zahtjevima norme kao ISO 14001:2015, što će osigurati veću prepoznatljivost i povjerenje kupaca. Projekt uključuje edukaciju zaposlenika i promidžbene aktivnosti koje će dugoročno osigurati održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Virtuoz STEM Academy
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Virtuoz STEM akademija
Category_Label: Support for primary to secondary education (excluding infrastructure)
Operation_Summary_English: The Virtuoz STEM Academy project will strengthen the capacities of the World Youth Alliance South East Europe through the establishment of cooperation with 6 educational institutions (4 kindergartens, 1 school, 1 faculty). 7 employees and volunteers of the association will participate in 6 trainings, study visits and conferences, while the employees of the Faculty of Chemical Engineering and Technology will conduct 10 trainings and 10 mentorings for employees of the SSM SEE and partner schools and kindergartens. All this will strengthen the capacities of the association and partners for the implementation of 360 STEM workshops with 900 children and students during the 3 years of the project implementation. Also, 12 public events will be organized annually to promote STEM in public places, and will include 3 STEM stands, 5 STEM exhibitions and 4 STEM competitions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Virtuoz STEM akademija ojačat će kapacitete udruge Svjetski savez mladih Jugoistočna Europa kroz uspostavu suradnje sa 6 obrazovnih ustanova (4 vrtića, 1 škola, 1 fakultet). 7 zaposlenika i volontera udruge sudjelovat će u 6 izobrazbi, studijskih posjeta i konferencija, dok će djelatnici Fakulteta kemijskog inžinjerstva i tehnologije provesti 10 izobrazbi i 10 mentoriranja za djelatnike SSM JIE i partnerskih škola i vrtića. Sve ovo će ojačati kapacitete udruge i partnera za provedbu 360 STEM radionica s 900 djece i učenika tijekom 3 godine provedbe projekta. Također, godišnje će se organizirati 12 javnih događanja za promociju STEM-a na javnim mjestima, a uključivat će 3 STEM štanda, 5 STEM izložbi i 4 STEM natjecanja.

Operation_Name_English: Implementation of the management system according to international ISO standards for SMART CODE d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Implementacija sustava upravljanja prema međunarodnim ISO standardima za SMART CODE d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project of introducing ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2022 into Smart Code d.o.o. is aimed at improving the quality of business processes and strengthening information security. By implementing these standards, the company will ensure a high level of compliance with international standards, increase operational efficiency and strengthen the trust of clients and partners. Certification increases competitiveness in the international market, which opens up new business opportunities. Successful implementation of the project will enable long-term sustainability and recognition of the company in the IT sector.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt uvođenja ISO 9001:2015 i ISO 27001:2022 u Smart Code d.o.o. usmjeren je na poboljšanje kvalitete poslovnih procesa i jačanje sigurnosti informacija. Implementacijom ovih standarda poduzeće će osigurati visoku razinu usklađenosti s međunarodnim normama, povećati operativnu učinkovitost te ojačati povjerenje klijenata i partnera. Certifikacijom se podiže konkurentnost na međunarodnom tržištu, što otvara nove poslovne prilike. Uspješna provedba projekta omogućit će dugoročnu održivost i prepoznatljivost tvrtke u IT sektoru.

Operation_Name_English: Development of the Development Strategy of the Urban Area Dubrovnik
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Izrada Strategije razvoja Urbanog područja Dubrovnik
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Development of the Strategy for the Development of the Dubrovnik Urban Area’ co-finances the development of a strategy that is a prerequisite for the use of the ITU mechanism, as well as the implementation of the preliminary evaluation procedure. The aim of the project is to support urban areas in developing territorial strategies. The Strategy is an act of strategic planning within the regional development policy that serves as a multi-sectoral strategic framework that is planned for the development of UP Dubrovnik as an urban development unit within the new financial period 2021-2027. The target group is the LGUs within UP Dubrovnik: it targets a diverse range of stakeholders, including the business community, residents, cultural operators and the tourism sector, and also promotes the active participation of associations.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektom „Izrada Strategije razvoja Urbanog područja Dubrovnik“ sufinancira se izrada strategije koja je preduvjet za korištenje ITU mehanizma, kao i provedba postupka prethodnog vrednovanja. Cilj projekta je podrška urbanim područjima u izradi teritorijalnih strategija. Strategija predstavlja akt strateškog planiranja u okviru politike regionalnoga razvoja koja služi kao multisektorski strateški okvir koji se planira razvoja UP Dubrovnik kao urbane razvojne cjeline unutar novog financijskog razdoblja 2021.-2027. Ciljna skupina su JLS-ovi u sastavu UP Dubrovnik: usmjerena je prema raznolikom krugu dionika, uključujući poslovnu zajednicu, stanovnike, kulturne subjekte i turistički sektor te promiče i aktivno sudjelovanje udruga.

Operation_Name_English: Strong family, strong me
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Snažna obitelj, snažan ja
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to contribute to the general objective of this Call, which is to support the development and provision of innovative social services with the aim of preventing institutionalization and greater inclusion in the community. Through the implementation of the activities within the project, care breaks will be provided to persons who have a recognised right to the status of parents of caregivers/caregivers of persons with disabilities. Parents carers will be provided with a rest from emotional and physical demands that carry daily care and care and will enable their inclusion in the life of the community and the prevention of institutionalization of those they care for.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je doprinijeti općem cilju ovog Poziva, a to je pružanje podrške razvoju i pružanju inovativnih socijalnih usluga s ciljem prevencije institucionalizacije i veće uključenosti u zajednicu. Kroz provedbu aktivnosti u okviru projekta omogućit će se odmor od skrbi osobama koje imaju priznato pravo na status roditelja njegovatelja/njegovatelja za njegu osobe s invaliditetom. Roditeljima njegovateljima će se osigurati odmor od emocionalnih i fizičkih zahtjeva koje nose svakodnevna skrb i briga te će se omogućiti njihovo uključivanje u život zajednice i prevencija institucionalizacije onih o kojima skrbe.

Operation_Name_English: DEVELOPMENT OF VODNO-KOMUNAL INFRASTRUKTURE DUBROVNIK - PHASE 2
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: RAZVOJ VODNO-KOMUNALNE INFRASTRUKTURE DUBROVNIK - FAZA 2
Category_Label: Provision of water for human consumption (extraction, treatment, storage and distribution infrastructure, efficiency measures, drinking water supply) compliant with efficiency criteria|Water management and water resource conservation (including river basin management, specific climate change adaptation measures, reuse, leakage reduction)|Waste water collection and treatment
Operation_Summary_English: The project DEVELOPMENT OF WATER-COMMUNAL INFRASTRUCTURE includes investments in the water supply system and the sewage and wastewater treatment system. The project is being implemented in the City of Dubrovnik. The project area is part of the Dubrovnik-Neretva County in the Republic of Croatia. Project activities will be carried out in the settlements of the service area Vodovod Dubrovnik. Project activities for the water supply system will be carried out in the settlements of VOS Dubrovnik, VOS Zaton-Orašac and VOS Moševići-Visočani. Project activities for the sewage and wastewater treatment system will be carried out in the settlements of the Dubrovnik Agglomeration: Bosanka, Čajkovica, Čajkovići, D. Obuljen, Dubrovnik, G. Obuljen, Knežica, Komolac, Lozica, Mokošica, N. Mokošica Osojnik, P. Selo, Pobrežje...
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt RAZVOJ VODNO-KOMUNALNE INFRASTRUKTURE uključuje ulaganja u sustav vodoopskrbe i sustav odvodnje i pročišćavanja otpadnih voda. Projekt se provodi na području Grada Dubrovnik. Projektno područje dio je Dubrovačko neretvanske županije u Republici Hrvatskoj. Projektne aktivnosti će se provoditi u naseljima uslužnog područja Vodovod Dubrovnik. Projektne aktivnosti za sustav vodoopskrbe će se provoditi u naseljima VOS Dubrovnik, VOS Zaton-Orašac i VOS Moševići-Visočani. Projektne aktivnosti za sustav odvodnje i pročišćavanja otpadnih voda će se provoditi u naseljima Aglomeracije Dubrovnik: Bosanka, Čajkovica, Čajkovići, D. Obuljeno, Dubrovnik, G. Obuljeno, Knežica, Komolac, Lozica, Mokošica, N. Mokošica Osojnik, P. Selo, Pobrežje...

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of MRNJAVAC d.o.o. by implementing a quality management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća MRNJAVAC d.o.o. implementacijom sustava upravljanja kvalitetom
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project ‘Increasing the competitiveness of MRNJAVAC d.o.o. by implementing a quality management system’ is aimed at standardising business processes and improving quality control in road and maritime transport and logistics. By implementing ISO 9001:2015 and IFS Logistics, the company will increase operational efficiency, reduce costs and ensure compliance with international standards. The overall objective of the project is to strengthen the market position by improving the quality of services and increasing competitiveness. Target groups are employees, who will develop additional competencies, and clients, who will benefit through improved services. The project contributes to the expansion to international markets and long-term business sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt „Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća MRNJAVAC d.o.o. implementacijom sustava upravljanja kvalitetom“ usmjeren je na standardizaciju poslovnih procesa i poboljšanje kontrole kvalitete u cestovnom i pomorskom prijevozu te logistici. Implementacijom ISO 9001:2015 i IFS Logistics, poduzeće će povećati operativnu učinkovitost, smanjiti troškove i osigurati usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima. Opći cilj projekta je jačanje tržišne pozicije kroz unaprjeđenje kvalitete usluga i povećanje konkurentnosti. Ciljne skupine su zaposlenici, koji će razviti dodatne kompetencije, te klijenti, koji će ostvariti benefite kroz poboljšane usluge. Projekt doprinosi širenju na međunarodna tržišta i dugoročnoj održivosti poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening competitiveness by certification of management systems according to ISO 9001:2025 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti certifikacijom sustava upravljanja prema ISO 9001:2025 i ISO/IEC 27001:2022
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The aim of the project is to increase the international competitiveness of Lloyds Digital by certifying the management system according to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022. The purpose is to standardise business processes and establish an information security management system to ensure consistent service quality, data protection and compliance with international standards. Expected results include increased customer confidence, easier access to foreign markets and increased export revenues. By implementing the certificate, Lloyds Digital will optimize processes, reduce risks and ensure recognition as a reliable and safe partner in the global market.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Cilj projekta je povećanje međunarodne konkurentnosti Lloyds Digitala certifikacijom sustava upravljanja prema ISO 9001:2015 i ISO/IEC 27001:2022. Svrha je standardizacija poslovnih procesa i uspostava sustava upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću kako bi se osigurala dosljedna kvaliteta usluga, zaštita podataka i usklađenost s međunarodnim standardima. Očekivani rezultati uključuju povećanje povjerenja klijenata, olakšan pristup inozemnim tržištima i rast prihoda od izvoza. Implementacijom certifikata Lloyds Digital će optimizirati procese, smanjiti rizike i osigurati prepoznatljivost kao pouzdan i siguran partner na globalnom tržištu.

Operation_Name_English: Holidays with purpose
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmor sa svrhom
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: DEBRA, in partnership with HURID, will implement the project "Rest with Purpose" during which it will provide an innovative service of using rest from care for 13 parents of carers from the City of Zagreb, Zagreb County and Koprivnica-Križevci County. To provide this innovative service, 3 health care providers will be employed, while a logotherapist will be employed to empower parents during the holiday. During the project, 400 days of rest to care will be provided and individual hours of psychotherapy for parents of caregivers will be carried out. In addition, an "Art Therapy Box" will be created, the purpose of which will be to encourage parents to become aware of their own emotions and interests.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Udruga DEBRA u partnerstvu udrugom HURID provest će projekt "Odmor sa svrhom" tijekom kojega će omogućiti inovativnu uslugu korištenja odmora od skrbi za 13 roditelja njegovatelja s područja Grada Zagreba, Zagrebačke županije i Koprivničko-križevačke županije. Za pružanje ove inovativne usluge bit će zaposlena 3 izvršitelja zdravstvene svrhe, dok će za osnaživanje roditelja tijekom odmora biti zaposlena logoterapeutkinja. Tijekom projekta omogućit će se 400 dana odmora do skrbi i provesti individualni sati psihoterapije za roditelje njegovatelje. Dodatno će se oblikovati "Art terapijska kutija" čija će svrha biti potaknuti roditelje na osvještavanje vlastitih emocija i interesa.

Operation_Name_English: Evolutionary hyperheuristics for the problem of two-dimensional packaging
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Evolucijska hiperheuristika za problem dvodimenzionalnog pakiranja
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: Textiloop addresses the key challenges of the textile industry: low resource efficiency, excessive waste and a lack of transparency and communication between industrial stakeholders. The aim of the project is to test (in laboratory emulated industrial conditions) an innovative heuristic that enables real-time optimization of the cutting surface and resource efficiency in the sector in cooperation with ZIO. The target group includes small and medium-sized enterprises within the TCLF sector, textile producers, processors and recoverers, and end-users interested in sourcing secondary textile raw materials. The project improves the sustainability and profitability of the textile sector, creating the foundations for the transition to the textile industry 5.0.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt Textiloop adresira ključne izazove tekstilne industrije: nisku resursnu učinkovitost, prekomjernu količinu otpada te nedostatak transparentnosti i komunikacije među industrijskim dionicima. Cilj projekta testirati je (u laboratorijski emuliranim industrijskim uvjetima) inovativnu heuristiku koja omogućava stvarnovremensku optimizaciju krojne površine i resursne učinkovitosti u sektoru u suradnji sa ZIO. Ciljna skupina uključuje mala i srednja poduzeća unutar TCLF sektora, proizvođače tekstila, prerađivače i oporabitelje, te krajnje korisnike zainteresirane za nabavu sekundarnih tekstilnih sirovina. Projekt unaprjeđuje održivost i profitabilnost tekstilnog sektora, stvarajući temelje za tranziciju prema tekstilnoj industriji 5.0.

Operation_Name_English: Conducting laboratory testing of the control component of the autonomous forklift
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Provedba laboratorijskog testiranja upravljačke komponente autonomnog viličara
Category_Label: Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The company Gideon Brothers d.o.o. develops a product called "Trey - Medium Duty (MD)" which represents a forklift for autonomous loading and unloading of goods in and out of trucks. The aim of this project, in cooperation with Končar Institute of Electrical Engineering Ltd., is to conduct tests on the key component of the overall solution in order to confirm the correctness of the design, compliance with the necessary standards, and in the finality, the level of robustness that will ensure the long-term operation of the system in demanding operating conditions.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka Gideon Brothers d.o.o. razvija proizvod naziva "Trey - Medium Duty (MD)" koji predstavlja viličara za autonomni utovar i istovar robe u i iz kamiona. Cilj ovog projekta je u suradnji s Končar institutom za elektrotehniku d.o.o. provesti ispitivanja na ključnoj komponenti ukupnog rješenja kako bi se potvrdila ispravnost dizajna, sukladnost potrebnim normama, i u konačnosti, razina robusnosti koja će osigurati dugotrajan rad sustava u zahtjevnim uvjetima rada.

Operation_Name_English: Development strategy of the Rijeka Urban Agglomeration for the financial period 2021-2030 20-2027
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Strategija razvoja Urbane aglomeracije Rijeka za financijsko razdoblje 2021. – 2027. godine
Category_Label: Territorial development initiatives, including preparation of territorial strategies
Operation_Summary_English: The Urban Area Development Strategy is a planning document of regional development policy that plans the development of an urban area, i.e. an urban agglomeration for a certain period of time and is a prerequisite for the use of the ITU mechanism in accordance with the multiannual financial framework of the European Union's cohesion policy. It is prepared in accordance with the Regional Development Act of the Republic of Croatia (OG 147/14, 123/17 and 118/18) and the Guidelines for the establishment of urban areas and the development of the urban development strategy for the financial period 2021-2027, version 2.0 and version 2.1, adopted by the Ministry of Regional Development and EU Funds.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Strategija razvoja urbanog područja je planski dokument politike regionalnoga razvoja kojim se planira razvoj urbanog područja, odnosno urbane aglomeracije za određeni vremenski period te predstavlja preduvjet za korištenje ITU mehanizma u skladu s višegodišnjim financijskim okvirom kohezijske politike Europske unije. Izrađuje sukladno Zakonu o regionalnom razvoju RH (NN 147/14, 123/17 i 118/18) i Smjernicama za uspostavu urbanih područja i izradu strategije razvoja urbanih područja za financijsko razdoblje 2021.-2027., verzija 2.0 i verzija 2.1., donesene od strane Ministarstva regionalnoga razvoja i fondova Europske unije.

Operation_Name_English: By certification until the growth of Saltuaris d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certificiranjem do rasta tvrtke Saltuaris d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: Saltuaris has conducted a business analysis and identified problems that will be solved by the implementation of the project, including reduced competitiveness, inability to prove quality, lack of traceability of documentation and unoptimized business processes. Objective of the project: strengthen the company's capacities through the introduction of ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 standards, i.e. optimization and improvement of 9 business processes, which will contribute to increasing its international competitiveness, facilitating access to the international market and increasing the competitiveness of SMEs by certifying management systems in accordance with the requirements of internationally recognized standards = prerequisites for the growth of sales revenues (15.1%) and export revenues (15.1%), by 2028. (m+2).
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Tvrtka Saltuaris je provela analizu poslovanja i identificirala probleme koji će se riješiti implementacijom projekta, uključujući smanjenu konkurentnost, nemogućnost dokazivanja kvalitete, nepostojanje sljedivosti dokumentacije i neoptimizirane poslovne procese. Cilj projekta: osnažiti kapacitete tvrtke kroz uvođenje normi ISO 9001 i ISO 27001 tj. optimizaciju i unaprjeđenje 9 poslovnih procesa, a što će doprinijeti povećanju njezine međunarodne konkurentnosti, olakšavanju pristupa međunarodnom tržištu i povećanju konkurentnost MSP-ova certifikacijom sustava upravljanja u skladu sa zahtjevima međunarodno priznatih normi = preduvjeti za rast prihoda od prodaje (15,1%) i od izvoza (15,1%), do 2028. (m+2).

Operation_Name_English: An inclusive future-innovative way of social inclusion
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Inkluzivna budućnost-inovativni način socijalnog uključivanja
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective is to provide support and support to the elderly and OSI through the provision of non-institutional social services in order to increase their quality of life and prevent social exclusion. The specific goal is to provide a home help service for at least 90 people aged 65+ and OSI in the area of the city of Zagreb, Sisak-Moslavina, Brod-Posavina, Varaždin and Karlovac counties. The activities of the project are the provision of support and support with the procurement and distribution of a package of necessities within which: 1. Recruit 15 service providers 2. Recruit 1 Coordinator 3. Purchase monthly packages with supplies according to the number of members of the target group 4. Ensure visibility and promotion of the project through leaflets and social networks. Ensure management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj je kroz osiguravanje vaninstitucionalnih socijalnih usluga osigurati potporu i podršku osobama starije životne dobi i OSI kako bi se povećala kvaliteta njihovog života i spriječila socijalna isključenost. Specifični cilj je pružiti uslugu pomoći u kući za min. 90 osoba u dobi od 65+ i OSI na području grada Zagreba, Sisačko-moslavačke, Brodsko-posavske, Varaždinske i Karlovačke županije. Aktivnosti projekta su pružanje potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština u sklopu koje će se: 1. Zaposliti 15 pružatelja usluge 2. Zaposliti 1 koordinatora 3. Nabaviti mjesečni paketi s potrepštinama sukladno broju pripadnika ciljane skupine 4. Osigurati vidljivost i promocija projekta putem letaka i društvenih mreža. Osigurati upravljanje i administraciju.

Operation_Name_English: Development of new products and technologies of variable acoustic quality parameters – by modelling reverberation to modern multifunctional spaces
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Razvoj novih proizvoda i tehnologija promjenjivih parametara akustičke kvalitete – modeliranjem reverberacije do modernih multifunkcionalnih prostora
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in micro enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking
Operation_Summary_English: The project explores and develops advanced acoustic panels with a focus on innovative materials and technologies such as nano coatings and perforated designs. The aim is to create high-quality, aesthetically adaptable and environmentally friendly solutions that improve sound insulation and absorption in various spaces, from commercial to residential buildings. The project includes research, development of prototypes, testing and preparation for commercialization. The aim of the project is to develop and commercialize innovative acoustic panels that provide superior sound insulation and absorption, improve the quality of life and work space, and contribute to sustainable development through the use of environmentally friendly materials and technologies.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt istražuje i razvija napredne akustične panele s fokusom na inovativne materijale i tehnologije poput nano premaza i perforiranih dizajna. Cilj je stvoriti visokokvalitetna, estetski prilagodljiva i ekološki prihvatljiva rješenja koja poboljšavaju zvučnu izolaciju i apsorpciju u različitim prostorima, od komercijalnih do stambenih objekata. Projekt uključuje istraživanje, razvoj prototipova, testiranje i pripremu za komercijalizaciju. Cilj projekta je razviti i komercijalizirati inovativne akustične panele koji pružaju superiornu zvučnu izolaciju i apsorpciju, poboljšavaju kvalitetu života i radnog prostora, te doprinose održivom razvoju kroz korištenje ekološki prihvatljivih materijala i tehnologija.

Operation_Name_English: TIMEOUT for parents
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: TIMEOUT za roditelje
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The TIMEOUT project for parents deals with the provision of innovative social services of rest from care for parents caregivers who care for a child with disabilities and / or a person with disabilities from the area of Koprivnica-Križevci and Varaždin County, who cannot use personal assistance services or half-day stay. Family members cared for by parents caregivers often have multiple impairments, and they need continuous care, and parents caregivers respite from everyday psychophysical efforts. The implementation of the project for parents of carers will provide assistance and support, while at the same time providing high-quality social services to dependent family members and enabling them to be more involved in the community.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt TIMEOUT za roditelje bavi se pružanjem inovatine socijalne usluge odmor od skrbi za roditelje njegovatelje/njegovateljice koji skrbe o djetetu s teškoćama i /ili osobi s invaliditetom s područja Koprivničko-križevačke i Varaždinske županije, a koji ne mogu koristiti usluge osobne asistencije niti poludnevnog boravka. Članovi obitelji o kojima skrbe roditelji njegovatelji često imaju višestruka oštećenja, te im je potrebna kontinuirana skrb, a roditeljima njegovateljima predah od svakodnevnih psihofizičkih napora. Provedbom projekta za roditelje njegovatelje osigurati će se pomoć i podrška, a istodobno za ovisne članove obitelji o kojima skrbe visokokvalitetne socijalne usluge te će im se omogućiti veća uključenost u zajednicu.

Operation_Name_English: Strengthening the competitiveness of Sinitech Industries d.o.o. through the implementation and certification of management systems
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Jačanje konkurentnosti tvrtke Sinitech Industries d.o.o. kroz implementaciju i certifikaciju sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project lasts 12 months and aims to implement and certify production processes according to ASME BPVC Section VIII Division 1. The focus is on improving the quality of production of pressure equipment, increasing safety and competitiveness on the international market. The project includes the analysis of existing processes, adaptation of the quality management system, employee education and final certification. Upon completion, Sinitech Industries d.o.o. will receive ASME certification, which will ensure access to new markets, increase exports and long-term business sustainability.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt traje 12 mjeseci i ima za cilj implementaciju i certifikaciju proizvodnih procesa prema ASME BPVC Section VIII Division 1. Fokus je na unaprjeđenju kvalitete proizvodnje tlačne opreme, povećanju sigurnosti i konkurentnosti na međunarodnom tržištu. Projekt obuhvaća analizu postojećih procesa, prilagodbu sustava upravljanja kvalitetom, edukaciju zaposlenika i završnu certifikaciju. Po završetku, Sinitech Industries d.o.o. će dobiti ASME certifikat, čime će osigurati pristup novim tržištima, povećati izvoz i dugoročnu održivost poslovanja.

Operation_Name_English: Increasing the competitiveness of K-Tech by introducing a management system
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Povećanje konkurentnosti poduzeća K-Tech uvođenjem sustava upravljanja
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The project proposal includes the introduction of ISO 1090-3 EXC-2, which refers to the assessment of conformity of structural components when performing aluminium structures at the second level of complexity of static and dynamic loaded parts. By introducing the certificate, the company K-TECH d.o.o. will prove that the production process meets a high level of quality control in accordance with European standards, which will increase the competitiveness of the company. The purpose of the project is to enable the introduction of a management system facilitated access to the domestic market and the targeted foreign market, increase competitiveness, prove the level of quality and safety in the exchange of their products on the market and contribute to customer confidence.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projektni prijedlog obuhvaća uvođenje norme ISO 1090-3 EXC-2 koja se odnosi na ocjenjivanje sukladnosti konstrukcijskih komponenta prilikom izvedbe aluminijskih konstrukcija na drugoj razini složenosti statičkih i dinamičkih opterećenih dijelova. Uvođenjem certifikata poduzeće K-TECH d.o.o. dokazat će da proizvodni proces zadovoljava visoki nivo kontrole kvalitete u skladu sa europskim standardima čime će se povećati konkurentnost poduzeća. Svrha projekta je omogućiti uvođenjem sustava upravljanja olakšani pristup domaćem tržištu i ciljanom inozemnom tržištu, povećati konkurentnost, dokazati razinu kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni svojih proizvoda na tržištu te pridonijeti povjerenju kupaca.

Operation_Name_English: Together for the Elderly
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Zajedno za starije
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the delivery of family and community-based care services
Operation_Summary_English: The general objective of the project is to increase social inclusion and prevention of institutionalization of vulnerable groups by providing long-term care, which will be achieved through the specific objective of the project: provision of support and support services in everyday life to the elderly and OSI. The project includes activities of providing support and support services with the procurement and distribution of packages of supplies with the employment of 10 service providers that will take care of at least 6 members of the target group (a total of 60 people through 32 months: organization of food, performance of household chores and maintenance of personal hygiene), monitoring and control of performed services, procurement and distribution of packages of household and basic hygiene supplies, communication and conductivity activities and project management and administration.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Opći cilj projekta je povećanje socijalne uključenosti i prevencija institucionalizacije ranjivih skupina osiguravanjem dugotrajne skrbi što će se ostvariti kroz specifični cilj projekta: pružanje usluge potpore i podrške u svakodnevnom životu starijim osobama i OSI. Projekt uključuje aktivnosti pružanja usluge potpore i podrške uz nabavu i podjelu paketa potrepština uz zapošljavanje 10 pružatelja usluga koji će se brinuti za najmanje 6 pripadnika ciljane skupine (ukupno 60 osoba kroz 32.mj.: organiziranje prehrane, obavljanje kućanskih poslova i održavanje osobne higijene), praćenje i kontrolu izvršenih usluga, nabava i podjela paketa kućanskih i osnovnih higijenskih potrepština te aktivnosti komunikacije i vodljivosti i upravljanje projektom i administracija.

Operation_Name_English: Certification step-up of MEDITEX d.o.o.
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Certifikacijski iskorak tvrtke MEDITEX d.o.o.
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: The problem of MEDITEX lies in the current non-compliance of the business with increasingly strict regulatory requirements and standards of the medical device market, which makes it difficult to establish new and continue cooperation with key business partners. The implementation of certification will improve competitiveness and market position in the domestic and foreign markets. Business processes will be standardized, defined and strictly controlled, which will ensure uniform quality of products and services. The target groups of this project are existing and potential clients of the company, for whom product certification will provide additional security and trust in the quality and compliance of MEDITEX products with international standards.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Problem tvrtke MEDITEX leži u trenutnoj neusklađenosti poslovanja sa sve strožim regulatornim zahtjevima i standardima tržišta medicinskih proizvoda, što otežava uspostavljanje novih i daljnji nastavak suradnje s ključnim poslovnim partnerima. Provedbom certifikacije, unaprijedit će se konkurentnost i tržišni položaj na domaćem i inozemnom tržištu. Poslovni procesi bit će standardizirani, definirani i strogo kontrolirani, čime će se osigurati ujednačena kvaliteta proizvoda i usluga. Ciljne skupine ovog projekta su postojeći i potencijalni klijenti tvrtke, kojima će certifikacija proizvoda pružiti dodatnu sigurnost i povjerenje u kvalitetu i usklađenost proizvoda MEDITEX-a s međunarodnim standardima.

Operation_Name_English: Introduction and certification of management systems according to SCCP and ISO 27001 standards
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Uvođenje i certifikacija sustava upravljanja prema standardima SCCP i ISO 27001
Category_Label: SME business development and internationalisation, including productive investments
Operation_Summary_English: With this project, the Applicant introduces and certifies management systems according to SCCP (Safety Certificate Contractors for Petrochemicals) and ISO 27001 (Information Security Management System). The aim of the project is to increase the competitiveness of Applicants on the domestic and foreign markets. The project will facilitate access to the international market and increase the competitiveness of Applicants by introducing certificates that prove the level of quality and security in the exchange of goods and services and contribute to customer confidence. Expected results: Introduced and certified 2 management systems Increase in sales revenue in year m+2 by 33.1% Increase in export revenue in year m+2 by 33.1%
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Ovim projektom Prijavitelj uvodi i certificira sustave upravljanja prema normama SCCP (Safety Certificate Contractors for Petrochemicals ) i ISO 27001 (Sustav upravljanja informacijskom sigurnošću). Cilj projekta je povećanje konkurentnosti Prijavitelja na domaćem i inozemnom tržištu. Projektom će se olakšati pristup međunarodnom tržištu i povećati konkurentnost Prijavitelja uvođenjem certifikata kojima se dokazuje razina kvalitete i sigurnosti u razmjeni roba i usluga te pridonosi povjerenju kupaca. Očekivani rezultati: Uvedena i certificirana 2 sustava upravljanja Povećanje prihoda od prodaje u godini m+2 za 33,1% Povećanje prihoda od izvoza u godini m+2 za 33,1%

Operation_Name_English: Rest from the care we deserve - the support of the community we belong to
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Odmor od skrbi kojeg zaslužujemo - podrška zajednice kojoj pripadamo
Category_Label: Measures to enhancing the equal and timely access to quality, sustainable and affordable services
Operation_Summary_English: The project is being implemented in Dubrovnik and Korčula for 18 months. Both locations will provide parents/carers with regular care breaks – a minimum of two hours per week, and participation in support groups every other Saturday, under the professional guidance of a psychologist. During this time, members of the household, dependent on care, will be provided with adequate care by professionals - caregivers who come to the family one day a week, while on Saturdays organized group workshops with a working therapist. An important prerequisite for the success of the project is the selection and education of all professionals and the creation of trust during the first months of implementation. To develop a support network for all stakeholders in the local community, we will use media, social networks, meetings and social gatherings.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Projekt se provodi u Dubrovniku i na Korčuli 18 mjeseci. Na obje lokacije će se omogućiti roditeljima njegovateljima/njegovateljima redovite odmore od skrbi – min. dva sata tjedno, te sudjelovanje u grupama podrške svake druge subote, uz stručno vodstvo psihologa. Za to vrijeme, članovima kućanstva, ovisnima o skrbi, adekvatnu njegu pružit će stručne osobe - njegovatelji koji tijekom jednog dana u tjednu dolaze u obitelj, dok se subotama organiziraju grupne radionice s radnim terapeutom. Važan preduvjet uspjeha projekta je selekcija i edukacija svih stručnih osoba i stvaranje povjerenja tijekom prvih mjeseci provedbe. Za razvoj mreže podrške svih dionika u lokalnoj zajednici, koristit ćemo medije, društvene mreže, sastanke i druženja.

Operation_Name_English: Research and development of microencapsulated pollen for modulation of small intestine microbiota
Operation_Name_Programme_Language: Istraživanje i razvoj mikroenkapsulirane peludi za modulaciju mikrobiote tankog crijeva
Category_Label: Investment in fixed assets, including research infrastructure, in micro enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Investment in intangible assets in micro enterprises directly linked to research and innovation activities|Research and innovation activities in micro enterprises including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)|Research and innovation activities in SMEs, including networking|Research and innovation activities in public research centres, higher education and centres of competence including networking (industrial research, experimental development, feasibility studies)
Operation_Summary_English: Intestinal disorders, such as excessive bacterial overgrowth syndrome in the small intestine and irritable bowel syndrome, represent an increasing health and financial burden on a global scale. Starting from a significant societal challenge and lack of effective solutions, the project explores and develops microencapsulation of punch pollen and microencapsulated pollen as an innovative dietary supplement intended for modulation of the small intestine microbiota. The aim is for SPIN consortium members to contribute to the industrial transition of Adriatic Croatia through research and development of higher value-added products and services, prevention and alleviation of symptoms of these disorders and their adverse consequences at the social level.
Operation_Summary_Programme_Language: Crijevni poremećaji, kao što su sindrom pretjeranog bakterijskog prerastanja u tankom crijevu i sindroma iritabilnog crijeva, predstavljaju sve veće zdravstveno i financijsko opterećenje na globalnoj razini. Polazeći od značajnog društvenog izazova i nedostatka učinkovitih rješenja, projektom se istražuje i razvija mikroenkapsulacija peludi bušinca i mikroenkapsulirana pelud kao inovativan dodatak prehrani namijenjen modulaciji mikrobiote tankog crijeva. Cilj je da članovi SPIN konzorcija kroz istraživanje i razvoj proizvoda i usluga više dodane vrijednosti doprinesu industrijskoj tranziciji Jadranske Hrvatske, prevenciji i ublažavanju simptoma navedenih poremećaja i njihovih nepovoljnih posljedica na društvenoj razini.
